# anilkaya.org: system map

Snapshot: commit `ba2acfe` (origin/main after PR 148), asset version `240`, fonts token `230`. Read-only reference built from the source itself; every `file:line` was taken with `grep -n` or `sed -n` on this commit and audited by independent verifiers and by script. When `git log -1 --format=%h` differs from the snapshot, treat line numbers as approximate and re-grep the symbol.

How to use it: Part I is the shape of the system and a glossary; Part II is where state and configuration live (D1, caches, the Durable Object, browser storage, every var and cap); Part III follows a request or a payload end to end; Part IV is the lookup table, the change playbooks (files, edit order, tests, rituals) and the test matrix with the global invariants; Part V is the per-file detail of every area; Part VI lists documentation drift, suspected defects and what only production can prove. Area ids (10 to 62) are stable names used across all parts. The file is large (about 16,000 lines): do not read it whole. Use the Contents below: every entry carries its start line, so `sed -n "START,ENDp" map.md` or a `Read` with offset and limit lands on it.

## Orientation: what the system is, architecture, repository tree, glossary, reading guide

### What the system is

anilkaya.org (repository `anilkaya001/anilkaya.org`, Worker name `anilkaya`, `wrangler.toml:1`) is the personal site of Anıl Kaya (dotless ı, as the site and AGENTS.md write it) and it hosts two separate products behind one Cloudflare Worker with no frontend framework, bundler or runtime npm dependency: (1) the public **Quant Econometrics Academy** at `/lab/` (the UI kicker at `lab/index.html:256`; AGENTS.md still calls it the "Econometrics Lab"), for learners, which runs real Python/statsmodels in the browser through Pyodide 0.26.4 (`assets/js/lab-core.js:4`), teaches 12 courses / 365 stages / 84 skills (`lab/index.html:257`), keeps progress in localStorage and, after optional Google sign-in, in D1; and (2) **Flows** at `/flows/*`, a members-only options-flow intelligence product for the owner and a few named members (`FLOWS_CREDENTIALS`), built on the Unusual Whales REST API: nightly ranked bullish/bearish boards, per-name cards and dossiers, a deterministic "Neuron" reading with optional Workers AI wording, an Ask box, a premium desk and strategy lab that run one shared options-pricing engine in the Worker and the browser, a live layer refreshed every five minutes, and a real-time WebSocket rail. The landing page (`/`) is a particle-field hero with an eight-market clock board and an index ticker; `/articles/` is an empty index plus a private template. The heavy batch computation runs outside Cloudflare (GitHub Actions Node 22 for the nightly and Tier 2, the visitor's browser for Pyodide and the quant bundles); the Worker serves, authenticates, stores in D1, runs four cron jobs (the Tier 1 tick, the focus tick, housekeeping and the board summary), calls Workers AI through a daily budget cap, re-runs the options engine only on demand (`/api/flows/strategy?engine=1`, the desk's chain ranking) and hosts one Durable Object.

| Runtimes | Cloudflare workerd (Worker + DO), GitHub Actions Node 22, browsers, Pyodide/WASM, local Node >= 22.13 + Playwright 1.61.1 + wrangler 4.110.0 | `compatibility_date = "2026-07-08"` (`wrangler.toml:3`), `tests/package.json` |

Legend, one line each (the same numbers are used in the hop lists below):

| # | Hop | Where |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | Every browser request reaches the edge; `/assets/*` stops at the asset layer | `wrangler.toml:10`, `_headers` |
| 2 | WebSocket upgrade for the rail is a normal request to `/api/rt/ws`, same-origin and Flows-session gated | `shared/flows-rt-routes.js:16-53` |
| 3 | Non-asset paths enter `fetch()`; `route()` may return, throw `HttpError`, or fall through to `env.ASSETS.fetch` | `worker.js:3990-4014`, `:3915` |
| 4 | D1 binding `DB` (`iewt`): Lab tables, `flows_payload`, `flows_live`, `flows_tape`, `flows_clock`, `flows_ledger`, `flows_neuron`, AI usage, `flows_dossier_cache` | `wrangler.toml:16-20`, 12-config-infra |
| 5 | `serveRt` forwards to the single named object `pulse:1` as `https://pulse.internal/ws`, `/snap` or `/status` | `shared/flows-rt-routes.js:35-36` (stub and target), `:53` and `:56` (the two `stub.fetch` calls), `RT_OBJECT_NAME` `flows-rt.js:13` |
| 6 | Every model call goes through `cappedAi` (`meteredAi` `worker.js:1297`) | `shared/flows-ai.js:151` |
| 7 | Cache API entries under synthetic `https://flows-*.internal/...` URLs plus the course page and last-good copies | see "Caches" in 11-worker-b |
| 8 | On-demand vendor-call limiter, fails open when absent | `shared/flows-live-worker.js:935-936` |
| 9 | Static bundle; `renderCourse` also fetches `/lab/course` through it | `worker.js:2716`, `:3915` |
| 10 | The hub polls Unusual Whales over REST only while a socket or a recent `snap` exists | `shared/flows-rt-hub.js:12`, 35-rail |
| 11 | Neuron, board summary, reading and Ask reach `env.AI` only through `cappedAi`; the `!env.AI` guards are at | `worker.js:1399, 1578, 1598, 1925`; `flows-reading-worker.js:176`; the binding is read in `flows-ai.js:152` |

#### Dispatch order inside the Worker

`route()` is one chain of `if (path ...)` blocks; first match wins (`worker.js:2762-3916`).

| Order | Match (line) | Handler / effect |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | `/auth/google` 2766, `/auth/callback` 2784, `/auth/logout` 2836 (POST only), other `/auth/*` 2848 | Google OAuth code flow; `recordSignIn` 2816; cookie `session` |
| 2 | `/api/me` 2852, `/api/markets` 2858 | session probe; public market snapshot |
| 3 | `/api/v2/bootstrap` 2867, `/progress` 2877, `/attempt` 2915, `/preferences` 2972, `/project` 2996 | Academy v2 API |
| 4 | `/api/bootstrap` 3024, `/api/progress` 3034, `/api/stats` 3120, `/api/placement` 3182, `/api/mastery` 3245 | Lab v1 API (owner header + generation fence) |
| 5 | `/flows` 3337 (308 to `/flows/`), `/flows/login/` 3342 (GET, login page), `/flows/login` 3350 (POST, same-origin, credential check), `/flows/logout` 3387 (POST, 303), `FLOWS_READER_FROM` `?t=` redirects to `/flows/ticker/` 3393-3407 (302), `FLOWS_ROUTES` object 3409-3427 and lookup 3428-3442, no-slash redirects 3444-3452 (308) | Flows HTML (login page when no valid `flows_session`) |
| 6 | `/api/flows/ingest` 3454-3599 | ingest door |
| 7 | `/api/flows/*` 3601-3884 (session required, 401 JSON) | read API: board 3607, market 3624, events 3631, scoretrack 3638, meta 3645, flowalerts/pulse/news 3652, lk 3661, now 3666, tape 3672, political 3683, unusual 3690, movers/sectors 3697, sector-premium 3705, universe/regime/ideas/focus/... 3712, ai-usage 3720, summary 3725, dossier 3747, live 3756, brief 3764, ask 3780, record 3809, card/card-x/hist 3818, chain 3835, strategy 3856 |
| 8 | other `/flows/` 3885 (404), `/api/rt/` 3889, other `/api/` 3893 (404) | rail hook; JSON 404s |
| 9 | legacy `/lab/course`, `/lab/lesson` paths 3897 (308), `/lab/<slug>/` 3904, fallthrough 3915 | `renderCourse`; `env.ASSETS.fetch(request)` |

Flows HTML pages come from `shared/flows-pages.js` (`FLOWS_PAGES` L1041): `loginPage` 328, `overviewPage` 363, `sidePage` 452 (long and short), `deskPage` 468, `watchPage` 618, `marketPage` 639, `eventsPage` 697, `trackPage` 724, `unusualPage` 746, `tickerPage` 781, `historyPage` 835, `politicalPage` 863, `askPage` 887, `strategyPage` 909; wrapper `flowsDocument` 1029 (see 30-flows-server-core, 50-fe-core).

`finalize` (`worker.js:3918`) is the single response chokepoint: it starts with `new Response(response.body, response)`, sets the seven security headers on everything, adds the HTML CSP (`CSP` L102, `SECURITY_HEADERS` L117), `no-store` on `/api/`, `/auth/`, `/flows` (a 200 GET of `/api/markets` keeps the route's own `public, max-age=300`, `worker.js:3931-3932`), `no-cache` on HTML, immutable one year for `/assets/*?v=`, one hour otherwise, and `X-Server-Now` on `/api/flows/*`. Errors: `HttpError` (L150) is mapped in `fetch()`. An unreadable store on a stored-payload route throws `storeGone()` (`503 store_unreadable`, `Retry-After: 30`, L1036); `fetch()` then swaps in the 24-hour Cache API copy (`recallLastGood` L1083, written by `rememberLastGood` L1064, only for the 22 `LAST_GOOD_PATHS` GET routes L1041, stamped `X-Fresh-State: stale`, `X-Fresh-Reason: store`) when one exists (`worker.js:3998`). Any other uncaught error matching `STORE_QUOTA_RE` (L1030) becomes `503 store_quota` with `Retry-After` to 00:00 UTC (`worker.js:4009`).

#### Principal hop-by-hop flows

Each flow is numbered; the later chapters (flows I-III) expand them. Line numbers are in the file named at the hop.

**A. A member opens a Flows board and reads a stored payload**
1. Browser loads `/flows/long/` -> edge (not `/assets/`) -> `fetch` `worker.js:3990` -> `route` -> `FLOWS_ROUTES["/flows/long/"]` `:3411` -> `FLOWS_PAGES.sidePage` `flows-pages.js:452` (login page if `currentFlowsUser` `:904` returns null).
2. The page links `/assets/css/*.css?v=240` and `/assets/js/flows-ui.js?v=240`, `flows-rt.js`, `flows-board.js` (served by the asset layer, no Worker).
3. `flows-board.js` calls `getJson("/api/flows/board?side=long")` (`flows-board.js:1467`); `FlowsUI`'s `window.fetch` wrapper (`flows-ui.js:1818`) applies the 401/403 gate.
4. `route` -> `/api/flows/` branch `:3601` -> session check `:3604` -> board branch `:3607` -> `readFlowsPayload(env, "board:long")` `:991` (one D1 `SELECT` through `FLOWS_LIVE.NIGHTLY_ROW_SQL`) -> `passthrough` -> response.
5. `fetch` calls `rememberLastGood` `:1064` (Cache API copy for outage) then `finalize` `:3918` (headers, `no-store`, `X-Server-Now`).
6. Overlaid keys (`flowalerts`, `pulse`, `news`) go through `readWithOverlay` `:2097` which merges the nightly row with the live row (`overlayPulse` `flows-live-worker.js:1158`).
7. Meanwhile `FlowsUI.rt` opens `wss://.../api/rt/ws?k=px` (flow E) and streamed prices replace the polled `live:strips` body (`flows-board.js:1400` `takeLive`).

**B. The nightly publishes a session**
1. Trigger: `flows-pipeline.yml:5-8` cron, the Worker `nightlyTick` (`flows-live-worker.js:554`, from the `*/30` cron at `worker.js:3982`) or the Tier 2 loop's `createNightlyStart` (`starts.mjs:39`); the workflow's gate step (`:49-74`) lets only the intended firing run, then `node scripts/flows-pipeline.mjs --dry-run` (`:78`) then the real run (`:88`) with `UW_API_KEY`, `FLOWS_INGEST_TOKEN`, `FLOWS_INGEST_URL`.
2. `main()` `pipeline.mjs:4675`: `resolveSessionDate` `:937` -> `intradayRefusal` `:973` -> `sameSessionGate` `:1756` (may turn the run into an unranked refresh `:4725-4727`) -> screener `harvestScreener` `:4762` -> pooled `enrich` `:876` (`runPooled` `:424`, rate controller `stepRateController` `:245`, vendor client `uw` `:533`, spacing `makePermitQueue` `flows-permits.js:1`).
3. `computeFeatures` `:1158` -> `scoreBoard` `:1414` -> `partitionSides` `:1537` (dead band `DEAD_BAND` `:1410`, hysteresis `applyHysteresis` `flows-features.js:872`) -> `buildCard` `flows-card.js:1541` -> engine block (`QP.engineBlock` `flows-quant-pipeline.mjs:198`, `runCardEngine` `flows-quant-card.js:529`).
4. Legs (call sites inside `main()`; definitions: `publishPulse` `:4083`, `publishSectorPremium` `:4146`, `publishNews` `:4216`, `retireAndRoster` `:4454`, the others in `scripts/flows-legs/*`): `runMarketLegs` `:5256` (universe, regime, events, ownership), `publishPulse` `:6118`, `publishSectorPremium` `:6274`, `publishNews` `:6276`, `runVolLeg` `:6397`, `runFlowLeg` `:6752`, `buildIndexDossiers` `:6790`, `buildFocusPayload` `:6819`, `retireAndRoster` `:6847`.
5. Every write is `publish(key, payload)` `:3049` -> `ingestHeaders` `:121` (Bearer) -> `POST /api/flows/ingest?key=...` with retry/backoff and the D1-quota wait (`storeQuotaWait` `health.mjs:292`).
6. Worker ingest door `worker.js:3454`: `tokenKind` `:3463` -> `ingestScope` -> `readBounded` <= 128 KiB (`FLOWS_MAX_PAYLOAD_BYTES` `:923`) -> `JSON.parse` -> `ensureFlowsTables` `:2583` -> dated key: `archiveWriteAction` `:3563` and `INSERT ... DO NOTHING` `:3579` (trigger `flows_archive_immutable`, `schema.sql:226`); other keys: upsert `:3590-3592`; `meta` also batches the ledger row (`FLOWS_LIVE.nightlyLedger` `:3594`).
7. End: `runHealthGate` `pipeline.mjs:7085` (`health.mjs:686`) judges the clock, live keys, ledger, Neuron coverage, edge refusals and Lab sign-in age and fails the job with repair text citing DEPLOY.md sections.

**C. Tier 1 and the focus tick (Worker cron)**
1. Cloudflare fires `scheduled()` `worker.js:3950` with a cron string; `FLOWS_LIVE.cronJob` `flows-live-worker.js:75` maps it to `rth`, `focus`, `summary` or `housekeeping` (unknown strings fall back to minute arithmetic).
2. `rth`: `ensureFlowsTables` `:2583` -> `rthTick` `flows-live-worker.js:371`: stamp `tier1At` + ledger tick in one batch, read `flows_clock` + live ages in one batch, return early when the day is closed (`holiday`), else if `tier1Due` (`flows-freshness.js:384`) read `TIER1_CALLS` (`flows-live.js:81`: market tide and sector ETFs) through `uwFetch`.
3. `shapeMarketLive` `flows-live.js:403` -> `live:market` via `writeLiveStatement` (byte cap from `LIVE_KEYS`), clock patch (`sessionStatePatch` `:299`), ledger outcome (`ledgerOutcomeStatement`).
4. `liveDispatchDue` `flows-freshness.js:392` -> `dispatchWorkflow` `:343` starts `flows-live.yml` (`origin: worker`); `liveStalled` `:410` -> watchdog re-dispatch (`origin: watchdog`).
5. `focus`: `focusTick` `:504` reads the focus roster and writes `live:focus`.

**D. Tier 2 live loop (GitHub Actions)**
1. `flows-live.yml` starts (cron, Worker dispatch, or its own chain); the job runs `node scripts/flows-pipeline.mjs --live` (`:121`) with `FLOWS_LIVE_LOOP=1`, `FLOWS_LIVE_KEEP=1`, `permissions: id-token: write`.
2. `runLiveMode` `pipeline.mjs:4602` -> `liveCredential` `:102` mints a GitHub OIDC token via `actionsIdToken` `flows-oidc.js:136` (cached, single-flight) -> `runLiveLoop` `live.mjs:482` with a `watch` from `createWatch` `watch.mjs:27`.
3. Each pass `runLive` `live.mjs:100`: `liveWindow` `:15` (regular session + 25 min after close), read `board:*` and `focus` via ingest GET, `boardPlan` `:72`, vendor reads, then `put(...)` of `live:breadth` `:233`, `live:strips` `:261`, `live:strips:series` `:266`, `live:vol` `:267`, `live:movers` `:268`, `live:alerts` `:273`, `live:gex` `:282`, `live:tape` `:286`, `live:news` `:292`, `live:heartbeat` `:311`.
4. Each write is `POST /api/flows/ingest?key=live:*` with the OIDC bearer; Worker: `looksLikeJwt` -> `oidcKind` `:664` (JWKS cache, 1 h TTL) -> `ingestScope` -> `ingestLive` `:695` -> `checkLiveWrite` `flows-live.js:1332` -> `flows_live` upsert; the heartbeat write also stamps `liveDoneAt`.
5. Between passes `watch.tick` runs the witness (`createWitness` `witness.mjs:296`, GitHub Issues) and the nightly start (`createNightlyStart` `starts.mjs:39`, 17:30 ET dispatch of `flows-pipeline.yml`).

**E. A rail frame reaches a browser**
1. `flows-rt.js` (`assets/js/flows-rt.js:744` `connect`) opens `GET /api/rt/ws?k=px,mk&f=NVDA` (one socket per tab, refcounted topics).
2. `route` `worker.js:3889` -> `serveRt` `flows-rt-routes.js:16`: gate order inside `serveRt`: `rtSwitches` kill switch (404 `rt_off`), `env.PULSE` binding check (404 `rt_off`), path allowlist (404), GET only (405), Flows session (401), owner/audience gate (403; `/api/rt/status` is owner-only under either audience), topic list (400), then for `/ws` only the `Upgrade: websocket` header (426), `requireSameOrigin`, ticker `f` check, strip client `X-RT-*` and cookie, set `X-RT-User`/`X-RT-Exp`, `stub.fetch("https://pulse.internal/ws?...")` on `idFromName("pulse:1")` (with the `FLOWS_RT_HINT` location hint).
3. `Pulse.fetch` -> `upgrade` `flows-rt-hub.js:900` (`acceptWebSocket`, `hub.admit`) -> `arm()` alarm.
4. `Pulse.alarm` -> `RtHub.tick` -> `createRestUpstream` (`flows-rt-hub.js:57`) polls Unusual Whales per `RT_UPSTREAM` (`flows-rt.js:75`), shapers (`shapePx`, `shapeFl`, ...) produce neutral frames, `mergeTopic` (`flows-rt.js:594`) keeps latest-wins state, the hub broadcasts `{v:1,k,ep,sq,at,fresh,meta,rows}` (`checkFrame` `flows-rt.js:143`).
5. Browser: sequence gap detection (`createSeq` `flows-rt.js:270` on the server side, a twin in `assets/js/flows-rt.js`), `FlowsUI.rt.strips()` maps `px` rows back to the `live:strips` body; the freshness pill takes `rt:px` as a source. Fallback ladder: socket -> `GET /api/rt/snap` every 5 s -> the pages' own heartbeats -> `off` on 401/403/404 (35-rail).

**F. Lab sign-in and progress sync**
1. `/auth/google` `worker.js:2766` sets `oauth_state` and redirects to Google `:2779`; `/auth/callback` `:2784` exchanges the code `:2793`, reads userinfo `:2808`, `recordSignIn` `:2816` (users upsert, `signed_in_at`), `signSession` with `aud: LEARN_AUDIENCE`, cookie `session`, redirect `/lab/?auth=ok`.
2. Browser `Auth.init` (`assets/js/auth.js:954`) -> `GET /api/v2/bootstrap` (`auth.js:930`) or `/api/bootstrap` (`:939`) -> `loadAcademyBootstrapSnapshot` / `loadBootstrapSnapshot` (`worker.js:2867`, `:3024`).
3. Local progress (via `IEWTStorage`, `storage.js:634`) is unioned with the server copy and only missing work is uploaded: `PUT /api/progress` with `X-IEWT-Owner` and `X-IEWT-Generation` -> `requireMutationOwner` `:202` -> `learningBatch` `:354` runs the generation-guarded JSON-union upsert (`worker.js:3090-3092`).
4. Stale generation -> `409 reset_required` (`worker.js:347`); reset = `DELETE /api/progress` one `DB.batch()` (`worker.js:3049-3083`) that bumps `learning_sync.generation`.

**G. A model-written reading (summary route)**
1. `GET /api/flows/summary?t=NVDA` `worker.js:3725` -> `summaryResponse` `:1718` runs `tickerNeuron` `:1760` and `FLOWS_READING.readingSafe` (`flows-reading-worker.js:242`, wrapper over `readingFor` `:172`) in one `Promise.all` (`worker.js:1720-1723`), then returns the Neuron body plus `read`.
2. Neuron: `readFlowsPayload` of `card:NVDA` + universe row -> `neuronTier` (`flows-neuron.js:839`) picks priced / stand-aside / family / screen / unpriceable / expired / none; `buildContext` `:926`; stored row in `flows_neuron` (claim `markNeuronGenerating` `:1473`, 90 s takeover); engine path `generateEngineNeuron` `:1574` calls `env.AI` through `cappedAi`, `vetEngineReply` (`flows-neuron.js:1431`) refuses any number or level not in the facts.
3. Reading: floor / fingerprint check on `flows_neuron` scope `read:<T>`; else `assembleDossier` (`flows-dossier-worker.js:317`: one D1 batch of primary-key lookups + vendor fan-out through `uwFetch` and `UW_ONDEMAND`) -> `heldTags` (`flows-reading.js:399`) -> one `cappedAi` call at `READ_BUDGET_SHARE` 0.75 (floor `AI_INTRADAY_REFRESH_MS` 45 min, `flows-ai.js:204`) -> `vetReading` `:716`; failure -> `readingFallback` `:892` (deterministic).
4. `finalize` as in flow A. Ask (`POST /api/flows/ask` `:3780`) reads `brief`, `askAnswer` `:1878`, `guardAnswer` (`flows-ask.js:1173`).

**H. A course page is served**
1. `GET /lab/ordinary-least-squares/` -> `route` `:3904` matches `COURSE_BY_SLUG` (`shared/course-seo.js`, generated) -> `renderCourse` `:2702` -> Cache API hit (`COURSE_EDGE_TTL_S`) else `env.ASSETS.fetch("/lab/course")` with identity encoding.
2. `HTMLRewriter` sets title, description, canonical, OG/Twitter, JSON-LD (`courseStructuredData` `:2651`), a crawlable `#course` fallback and `#courseOverview`, and prepends preloads for `manifest.json` and the first module under `/assets/data/courses/<id>/` with `?v=` from `<html data-asset-version>`.
3. Browser: `lab-core.js` (Pyodide from jsDelivr), `lab-suite.bundle.js`, `lab-course.js:58` `ensureModule` fetches module payloads lazily (fetch at `:64`); Python cells run in Pyodide.

| Durable Object `Pulse` (same bundle) | `shared/flows-rt-hub.js`, `flows-rt.js` | `export { Pulse }` `worker.js:38`; `wrangler.toml:33-39` |
| GitHub Actions (Node 22) | `scripts/flows-pipeline.mjs`, `scripts/flows-legs/*`, `scripts/flows-quant-pipeline.mjs`, probes; imports `shared/*` | `.github/workflows/*.yml` |
| Browser | `assets/js/*` IIFEs (globals allowlisted in AGENTS.md "Design and accessibility invariants") | HTML pages |

| Local / CI test | `tests/*.mjs` under Node >= 22.13, Playwright Chromium, `wrangler dev --local` | `tests/package.json:9` |

### Glossary

Each row gives the term, the project-specific meaning and the defining `file:line`. Where a word has several meanings the rows are separate. Lines were taken with `grep -n` at ba2acfe.

#### Time, tiers, schedule

| Term | Meaning | Defined at |
|---|---|---|
| Tier 1 | The Worker's own 5-minute tick: two vendor reads (market tide, sector ETFs) written as `live:market`, clock/ledger telemetry, may dispatch Tier 2 | `rthTick` `shared/flows-live-worker.js:371`; `RTH_CRON` `:70`; `TIER1_CALLS` `shared/flows-live.js:81` |
| focus tick | Worker cron minutes 3-58/5 writing `live:focus` | `focusTick` `flows-live-worker.js:504`; `FOCUS_CRON` `:71` |
| Tier 2 | GitHub Actions live loop writing ten `source: "actions"` `live:*` keys | `runLive` `scripts/flows-legs/live.mjs:100`; `LIVE_KEYS` `flows-live.js:13` |
| live loop (kept-alive) | The self-chaining 355-minute job with a 340-minute loop budget | `runLiveLoop` `live.mjs:482`; `LIVE_LOOP` `:348`; `flows-live.yml:66` |
| nightly | The ranked publish that writes boards, cards, universe, regime, etc. | `main` `scripts/flows-pipeline.mjs:4675`; `flows-pipeline.yml`; Worker side `nightlyTick` `flows-live-worker.js:554` |
| housekeeping / summary cron | `*/30 * * * *` (market snapshot, nightly dispatch, prunes) and `15,45 * * * *` (board summary) | `HOUSEKEEPING_CRON` `:72`; `SUMMARY_CRON` `:73`; `cronJob` `:75`; `summaryFiring` `worker.js:1423` |
| watchdog | Tier 1 re-dispatches Tier 2 when `live:breadth` is stale | `liveStalled` `flows-freshness.js:410`; use in `rthTick` `flows-live-worker.js:457` |
| dispatch | Worker POSTs `workflow_dispatch` to GitHub | `dispatchWorkflow` `flows-live-worker.js:343` |
| Flows clock | Singleton D1 row `flows_clock`: trading-day verdict, tier/dispatch stamps | `LIVE_SCHEMA_SQL` `:21`; `cachedClock` `:188`; `memoizedClock` `:121`; `clockPatchStatement` `:205` |
| clock key | `GET /api/flows/ingest?key=clock`, the Worker's clock read by the runners and health gate | `worker.js:3508-3511`; `serveIngestClock` `flows-live-worker.js:845` |
| clock verdict | Whether today is a trading day, learned from tape reads, reversible | `sessionStatePatch` `flows-live-worker.js:299`; `VERDICT` `flows-live.js:458` |
| session | The New York trading date a payload describes (`sessionDate`/`session`); not the cookie | `easternDay` `flows-freshness.js:64`; `resolveSessionDate` `pipeline.mjs:937` |
| phase | Pre-open / open / close / post / closed minutes of an Eastern day | `phaseAt` `flows-freshness.js:218`; `PHASE_MINUTES` `:16` |
| NYSE calendar | Holidays, early closes, special closures, shared by Worker and pipeline | `nyseHolidays` `shared/flows-quant-time.js:55` |
| freshness class | The cadence/live/stale table: quote, tape, market, breadth, nightly, rt, rtSlow, rtNews | `FRESH_CLASSES` `flows-freshness.js:3` |
| `X-Fresh-*` | Response headers carrying the server's freshness verdict (state, reason) | `freshHeaders` `:334`; `pendingHeaders` `:355`; `freshnessState` `:282` |
| session ledger | Per-day D1 row `flows_ledger` of gap/outcome counters for Tier 1, focus, Tier 2 and the nightly | `LEDGER_SCHEMA_SQL` `shared/flows-ledger.js:13`; `ledgerView` `:131`; `worstStale` `:136`; `nightlyLedger` `flows-live-worker.js:857` |
| witness | Mutual watchdog in the live loop: evaluates Tier 1, Tier 2, nightly and files GitHub Issues | `createWitness` `scripts/flows-legs/witness.mjs:296`; `WITNESS_CHECKS` `:28` |

### Reading guide

#### Order of chapters in map.md

| Slot | Chapter (working file, H2 title) | Open it when |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | 00 Orientation (this file) | you need the picture, a term, or the right area id |
| 2 | State map I: storage (91a-state-storage: D1, caches, Durable Object, browser storage) | you ask where a piece of state lives and who writes and reads it |
| 3 | State map II: configuration, switches, thresholds, quotas, versions, workflows, deployment status (91b-state-config) | you ask which env var, kill switch, cap, token or cron controls a behaviour |

| 8 | Lookup II: where is X (pipeline, legs, workflows, frontend, tests) (92b-lookup-rest) | the same, for the pipeline, legs, workflows, frontend and tests |
| 9 | Change playbooks (92c-playbooks) | you are about to change something |
| 10 | Test-to-module matrix and global invariants (92d-matrix-invariants) | you need the cross-area rules, the `npm test` chain and the traps before editing |
| 11+ | Area parts 10, 11, 12, 13, 20, 21, 22, 30-35, 40-45, 50-53, 60-62 | you need file-level detail (File table, Symbol index, Data and interfaces, Flows, Invariants and traps, How to change it) |

## State map I: storage (D1, caches, Durable Object, browser storage)

Commit ba2acfe (asset version 240, fonts token 230); line numbers from `grep -n` / `sed -n` on that tree; "see NN-area" names the area part holding the surrounding detail; source wins over AGENTS.md / DEPLOY.md (disagreements in section 8).

### 0. Stores at a glance

```text
Browser
  localStorage iewt:*  (Lab, only storage.js)        sessionStorage flows:rt:off, flows:gate   (Flows pages)
  cookies: session, oauth_state, flows_session (server-set, HttpOnly)   flows_gate (client-set)
      |  HTTPS / WSS
Cloudflare edge
  asset layer: /assets/* straight from the static bundle, policy from _headers (no Worker)
  Cache API caches.default, per data centre: 12 key shapes from 10 put sites (section 3)
      |
Worker isolate (worker.js; module memory in section 7)
  |- D1 "iewt", binding DB: 24 tables, 3 indexes, 1 trigger (section 1)
  |     ^ writes arrive only through: Lab/Flows routes, OAuth callback, crons, and the ingest door
  |     ^ ingest door /api/flows/ingest <- Actions legs (nightly token | GitHub OIDC JWT); scripts/ hold no D1 handle
  |- Durable Object class Pulse, one instance "pulse:1", binding PULSE (section 4): memory + socket attachments + alarm, no rows
  |- Workers AI, binding AI: every call is metered in D1 flows_ai_usage* before and after (section 1.4)
  |- UW_ONDEMAND rate limiter 120 per 60 s: counter state is the platform's (section 7)
  '- GitHub: workflow_dispatch from the Worker, Issues from the witness leg (section 7)
```

Counts: D1 24 tables (20 in `schema.sql`, 4 only in migrations 0006-0009 and inline); Cache API 12 key shapes from 10 `cache.put` sites (11 rows in section 3, news and levels share one); Durable Object 1 class, 1 instance, 0 SQL rows; browser 16 `localStorage` key names (`storage.js:6-24`), 2 `sessionStorage` keys, 4 cookies (3 server-set, 1 client-set).

#### 1.3 Lab and site tables: writers, readers, retention

All learner writes are generation-fenced: the INSERT carries `WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM learning_sync WHERE user_id=? AND generation=?)` (fence sites `worker.js:2893,2898,2932,2985,3011,3094,3142,3202,3221,3278`). Every `learningBatch` (and so every learning GET) starts with `INSERT INTO learning_sync ... VALUES (?, 0) ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING` (`worker.js:354-359`), so a first read creates the row.

| table | written by (file:line) | read by (file:line) | retention and key shape |
|---|---|---|---|
| `users` | `recordSignIn` `lab-sign-in.js:11` (SQL :3, legacy :5) from the OAuth callback `worker.js:2816`; id is `g_<googleSub>` | `readLabActiveAt` `lab-sign-in.js:33` (`MAX(created_at)`, `MAX(signed_in_at)` here; `MAX(updated_at)` of `stats` and `progress` with a 30-day lag, LAB_ACTIVITY :26-31) via `serveIngestClock` `flows-live-worker.js:845`, nightly token only | never deleted (no DELETE on `users` in the tree); reset does not touch it |
| `progress` | `PUT /api/progress` JSON-union upsert `worker.js:3092`; `PUT /api/v2/progress` `:2897`; reset DELETE `:3058` | `loadProgressSnapshot` `:735` (SQL :739); bootstrap `:810`; derived points `:759`; `readLabActiveAt` | one row per (user, course id); `done_json` is a sorted integer array of stage indexes; cleared by reset |
| `stats` | `PUT /api/stats` `:3140`; reset upsert `:3067`; heal of a poisoned `last` `:788`, `:851` | `loadStatsSnapshot` `:765` (SQL :770); bootstrap `:811`; `readLabActiveAt` | one row per user; cleared to 0/0/NULL by reset |
| `learning_sync` | ensure-row `:357`; reset increment (NULL at MAX_SYNC_GENERATION so the batch fails) `:3053` | every snapshot `:672,701,716,737,769,809` and every fence | one row per user; generation is the reset fence (header `X-IEWT-Generation`) |
| `mastery` | `PUT /api/mastery` `:3282`; reset `:3059` | `loadMasterySnapshot` `:670` (SQL :675); bootstrap `:814`; PUT read-back `:3312` | key = review item id `<course>:<stage>`; cleared by reset |
| `mastery_attempts` | insert `:3275`, mark applied `:3308`, prune `:3320`, reset `:3060` | `:3286`, `:3316` | idempotency ledger; rows older than 48 h (`ATTEMPT_LEDGER_TTL_MS` `:127`) deleted on each attempt write |
| `placement` | `PUT` `:3219`; `DELETE` (fenced) `:3201`; reset `:3061` | `loadPlacementSnapshot` `:699` (SQL :703); bootstrap `:816` | one row per user; only a 15-question summary, never answers |
| `progress_v3` | `PUT /api/v2/progress` `:2892` (keeps `MIN(completed_at)`); reset `:3062` | bootstrap `:822`; `:2907` | key = (user, course id, stable stage id) |
| `skill_mastery` | `PUT /api/v2/attempt` `:2936`; reset `:3063` | bootstrap `:823`; `:2956` | key = skill id |
| `skill_attempts` | insert `:2931`, mark `:2955`, prune 48 h `:2960`, reset `:3064` | `:2938`, `:2958` | same ledger rule as `mastery_attempts` |
| `learning_preferences` | `PUT /api/v2/preferences` `:2984` | bootstrap `:824` | NOT cleared by reset (preferences deliberately survive) |
| `project_progress` | `PUT /api/v2/project` `:3010`; reset `:3065` | bootstrap `:825` | key = (user, project id) |
| `market_snapshot` | `refreshMarketSnapshot` `:475` (SQL :484); negative touch in `startMarketFlight` `:495` (SQL :501, bumps `updated_at` only on conflict) | `readMarketSnapshot` `:527` | single row id = 1; triggered by anonymous `GET /api/markets` (`loadMarketSnapshot` `:541`, route `:2858`) and the housekeeping cron (`refreshMarketSnapshotIfDue` `:533`, called `:3978`); stale after 45 min, cron refresh when older than 25 min or inside the ET session window |

Reset (`DELETE /api/progress`, `worker.js:3049-3083`) is one `academyBatch`: increments `learning_sync.generation`, deletes `progress`, `mastery`, `mastery_attempts`, `placement`, `progress_v3`, `skill_mastery`, `skill_attempts`, `project_progress` for the user, upserts `stats` to zeros; `users` and `learning_preferences` are untouched (see 10-worker-a, 11-worker-b).

#### 1.5 Key shapes and values worth knowing

- `flows_neuron.ideas` is JSON text with three forms: a legacy array, the engine object `{v:3, verdict, claims, ideas, refused}` recognised by `neuronFrom` `worker.js:1452-1456`, or `{v:1, kind:"reading", shape, refused}` for `read:` rows (`flows-reading-worker.js:106-110`). `version` is written as `NEURON_CONTEXT_VERSION` (6, `flows-neuron.js:6`) for both scopes (see 34-neuron-ai).
- `flows_live.source` is `worker` for `live:market` and `live:focus` and `actions` for the other ten; the `writer` string is `worker@tier1` (`flows-live-worker.js:426`), `worker@focus` (`:480`) or the value the leg puts in `fresh.writer` (`checkLiveWrite` `flows-live.js:1332`).
- `flows_clock` is the shared verdict row: `trading` NULL means undecided and counts as a trading day, only an explicit 0 closes it (see 30-flows-server-core).
- `flows_tape.payload` is the body `{v:1, key:"tape", ticker, session, fresh, legs, units, prem, alerts, gex}` assembled by `assembleTape` (`flows-live.js:1236-1259`), with a pending placeholder for a leg not read yet; a row may exist with `payload` NULL (lease taken, nothing read yet).

#### 1.6 Immutability, quota and caps

- Dated archive rows (`board:long:DATE`, `board:short:DATE`, `scores:DATE`) cannot be UPDATEd: trigger `schema.sql:226` / `flows-live-worker.js:33`; DELETE is allowed, which is how the 126-day sweep works. The ingest route reads first and asks `archiveWriteAction` (`flows-archive.js:1`): unreadable 503 `archive_unreadable`, absent write, identical `stored: "unchanged"`, different 409 `archive_immutable`; the write is `ON CONFLICT(id) DO NOTHING` and a lost race is 409 `archive_raced` (`worker.js:3560-3592`). `DATED_ARCHIVE_KEY_RE` (`worker.js:935`) admits only `long` and `short`, so a dated `board:watch` can never be ingested although the trigger GLOB would also match it.
- A `CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS` never replaces an existing trigger: changing the GLOB needs a DROP migration (see 30-flows-server-core).
- D1 Workers Free caps are 100,000 rows written and 5,000,000 rows read per UTC day, account-wide (AGENTS.md; DEPLOY.md 10.4c). Error 7500 is mapped by `STORE_QUOTA_RE` `worker.js:1030` / `isStoreQuota` `:1031` to `503 store_quota` with `Retry-After` to 00:00 UTC (`fetch()` catch `:4008-4010`); a failed nightly read is `storeGone()` `:1036` (503 `store_unreadable`, `Retry-After: 30`) and may be answered from the last-good Cache API copy (section 3).
- Never scan a payload table or expand `json_each` over a large array on a polled route (AGENTS.md). Existing `json_each` users on payload tables: `LITE_SQL` over the `universe` name list (`worker.js:1111-1114`) and `GATE_SQL` over the `events` rows array (`:1117`), both on the cold absent-card path only; `KNOWN_SQL` over the `universe` name list (`:1123`), which rides every `/api/flows/tape` batch but is `UNION ALL ... LIMIT 1` behind the `card:<T>` primary-key probe, so a carded name stops at that row and only a universe-only name walks `$.t`; `FOCUS_NIGHTLY_SQL` / `FOCUS_HELD_SQL` over small focus payloads, and the rail's `RT_BOARDS_SQL` over three board payloads every 5 minutes while demanded (`flows-rt-hub.js:220-224`; not in the `flows-reads-contract` ceilings, see 35-rail).

#### 2.2 `flows_live` (12 registered ids; registry `LIVE_KEYS` `flows-live.js:13`, key pattern `LIVE_KEY_RE` :7)

A write must carry `fresh.v = 1`, a valid `fresh.readAt`, `fresh.session` day, `fresh.cadenceS` equal to the registry value and `fresh.source` equal to the registry writer (`checkLiveWrite` `flows-live.js:1332`); ingest passes `{source: "actions"}`, so a `worker` key through the door is 403 `wrong_writer`. Byte caps are checked by `ingestLive` against `spec.maxBytes` (413 `too_large`).

#### 2.3 What each ingest credential may touch

| credential | verified by | GET | POST | DELETE |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| nightly (`FLOWS_INGEST_TOKEN`) | `tokenKind` `flows-live-worker.js:601`, timing-safe compare `worker.js:925` | any allowlisted key, `?keys=`, `?list=`, `?key=clock` (adds `labActiveAt` and the ledger view), `live:*` reads | any allowlisted nightly key (403 `nightly_token_scope` for `live:*`) | dated archive keys, and `card:`/`card-x:`/`hist:` keys; never a view key such as `board:long` (`worker.js:3538-3548`) |
| live (GitHub OIDC JWT via `oidcKind` `:664`, or the legacy static `FLOWS_LIVE_TOKEN`) | claim policy `flows-oidc.js:3` (repository id, workflow ref on `main`, audience, lifetime) and JWKS memo | `live:*`, `NIGHTLY_READ_KEYS` (`board:long`, `board:short`, `board:watch`, `meta`, `focus`), `?key=clock` without `labActiveAt`/ledger; `?keys=` and `?list=` are 403 `live_token_scope` | `live:*` keys whose registry writer is `actions`, at most 128 KiB and the per-key cap | none (403) |

An OIDC key-set outage answers 503 so the leg retries (`worker.js:3465-3468`); no configured credential and no JWT answers 503 (`:3459`) (see 30-flows-server-core).

### 3. Cache API entries (`caches.default`, per data centre, GET keys on synthetic `*.internal` URLs)

Every use is guarded by `typeof caches !== "undefined"`; the entries are best effort and are evicted by TTL or earlier. Put sites: `worker.js:1077`, `1193-1194`, `1690`, `2076-2077`, `2177-2178` (chain and strategy share it), `2353-2354`, `2756`; `flows-dossier-worker.js:312,349`; `flows-live-worker.js:983-984` (10 sites, 12 key shapes). Physical TTL is the `Cache-Control: max-age` on the stored response; logical TTL is what the reader enforces on a stamp inside the entry.

| key | physical TTL / logical rule | writer | reader | purpose and failure behaviour |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `https://flows-lastgood.internal/api/flows/<name>` plus `?side=long`, `short` or `watch` for the board and `?t=<T>` for `card`, `card-x`, `hist` | `public, max-age=86400` (`worker.js:1075`); reader refuses an entry whose `X-Last-Good-At` is older than 24 h (`:1088-1089`); per-isolate refresh at most every 10 min per key, 256 keys (`:1038-1040,1044`) | `rememberLastGood` `:1064`, called from `fetch()` `:3994` for a 200 that carries a numeric `X-Payload-Updated` and no `X-Fresh-Last-Good`; put in `ctx.waitUntil` `:1077` | `recallLastGood` `:1083`: board route on a failed read `:3615`; `fetch()` on any `store_unreadable` `:3998` | last good copy of 22 nightly read paths (`LAST_GOOD_PATHS` `:1041-1043`: board, market, events, scoretrack, meta, flowalerts, pulse, political, unusual, movers, sectors, sector-premium, universe, regime, ideas, focus, roster, news, record, card, card-x, hist); served with `X-Fresh-State: stale`, `X-Fresh-Reason: store`, `X-Fresh-Last-Good`; not kept: brief, summary, ask, dossier, chain, strategy, live, lk, now, tape, ai-usage |
| `https://flows-class.internal/<T>` | `max-age=43200` (`CLASS_TTL_S` `:1125`); a `known:true` row is trusted 15 min in regular hours (`CLASS_RTH_MS` `:1160`, `rowCurrent` `:1163`) and outside them until the breadth-class freshness verdict for its read time is `stale`, a `known:false` row for the full 12 h | `classifyTicker` `:1171` (puts `:1193-1194`) | same function | vendor screener verdict for a name with no card `{known, row, readAt}`; limiter refusal returns the held stale verdict |
| `https://flows-screen.internal/<T>` | `max-age=300` (`SCREEN_TTL_S` `:1649`) | `absentNeuron` `:1669` (put `:1690`) | same | whole screen / absent Neuron body for a name with no card; no model, no vendor call |
| `https://flows-info.internal/<T>` | `max-age=21600` (`INFO_TTL_SECONDS` `:1999`) | `cachedTickerInfo` `:2048` (puts `:2076-2077`) | same | `{nextEarningsDate, announceTime, issueType, beta}` from `/api/stock/<T>/info`; failures are not cached |
| `https://flows-index.internal/SPY` | `max-age=120` (`CHAIN_TTL_SECONDS` `:1995`) | `cachedIndexSpot` `:2329` (puts `:2353-2354`) | same | SPY spot for the strategy page |
| `https://flows-chain.internal/<T>?strategy=<csp,cc,both>&rank=<key>` | `max-age=120`; logical age from `X-Chain-Stored`; `?refresh=1` serves the hit when younger than 15 s (`CHAIN_REFRESH_FLOOR_SECONDS` `:2001`) | `serveCachedVendorRead` `:2147` (puts `:2177-2178`); key built `:3849` | same, `X-Chain-Cache: hit, throttled, miss` | built chain payload (vendor reads are not behind `UW_ONDEMAND`; this cache is the only protection) |
| `https://flows-strategy.internal/<T>[/<expiry>][?engine=1]` | same as chain | same function; key `:3873` | same | strategy context or per-expiry payload |
| `https://<origin>/lab/<slug>/` (the canonical course URL, `url.origin + meta.path`) | `max-age=60` (`COURSE_EDGE_TTL_S` `:42`), GET and status 200 only | `renderCourse` `:2702` (put `:2756`) | same (hit returned raw `:2707-2708`) | HTMLRewriter output of the private `lab/course.html` shell; the only entry written for anonymous requests |
| `https://flows-live.internal/<T>` | physical `max-age=21600` (`quoteKeepS`); logical TTL by phase from `quoteTtlS` (rth 5 s, pre/post 30 s, closed 6 h) against `X-Quote-Stored` | `serveQuote` `flows-live-worker.js:946` (puts `:983-984`) | same | quote card; a limiter refusal returns the held body stamped stale/throttled |
| `https://flows-dossier.internal/assembled/<T>` | `max-age=30` and `now - at > 30 s` rejected (`ASSEMBLED_TTL_S` `flows-dossier-worker.js:24`, `:334`) | `writeAssembled` `:342`, only for a complete assembly | `readAssembled` `:329` | whole assembled dossier incl. rendered prompt; skipped on `opts.fresh` |
| `https://flows-dossier.internal/news/<T>` and `/levels/<T>` | `max-age=300` and `60` (`FAST_TTL_S` `:22`); logical rule in `planFetches`: refetch when `now - at >= ttl` (`:264`) | `writeFast` `:308` from `persistParts` `:512` | `readFast` `:299` | vendor news and dark-pool levels extracts |

Not in the Cache API (checked): the tape (D1 `flows_tape`), the landing market snapshot (D1 `market_snapshot`), the rail snapshot `GET /api/rt/snap` (Durable Object memory, section 4), the board summary (D1 `flows_ai_summary`). The dossier `quote` fast-cache id is defined (`FAST_TTL_S.quote` :22) but never written: `persistParts` skips `src.id === "quote"` (`flows-dossier-worker.js:510`). HTTP caching of `/assets/*` is the asset layer's, policy by path in `_headers` (immutable one year for css, js, fonts; one hour for img, data and the two version tokens) and is not stored by the Worker (see 12-config-infra).

### 4. The Pulse Durable Object

| item | value (file:line) |
|---|---|
| class, binding, migration | `export { Pulse }` `worker.js:38` from `shared/flows-rt-hub.js:854`; `[[durable_objects.bindings]] PULSE / Pulse` `wrangler.toml:33-35`; `[[migrations]] tag = "v1" new_sqlite_classes = ["Pulse"]` `:37-39`; no `script_name` |
| instance | exactly one, `RT_OBJECT_NAME = "pulse:1"` (`shared/flows-rt.js:13`), obtained by `ns.idFromName` with `locationHint` from `FLOWS_RT_HINT` (`enam`) (`flows-rt-routes.js:35`) |
| SQLite storage | declared, unused: no `ctx.storage.sql`, `put` or `get` anywhere; `ctx.storage` is used only for `getAlarm`/`setAlarm` (`flows-rt-hub.js:869-870,884`) and `deleteAlarm` (`:944`) |
| D1 | read-only: `loadRosterFromD1` `:231` runs one 3-statement batch (`flows_clock`, the three `board:*` ids via `RT_BOARDS_SQL`, `FOCUS_NIGHTLY_SQL`) at hub start and every `rosterMs` 5 min while demanded, 3 s timeout (`ensureRoster` `:616`); never writes D1; no Cache API, no KV, no `env.AI`, no `UW_ONDEMAND` (scan `tests/flows-rt-contract.mjs:1421-1447`) |
| alarms | `arm(ms)` `:866` sets an alarm only if none is pending or the pending one is later; `alarm()` `:876` runs `hub.tick()` and re-arms at `now + max(25, delay)` (2000 ms after an exception while demanded); `release()` `:941` stops the hub and deletes the alarm when nothing demands; the constructor re-arms 50 ms when sockets survived hibernation (`:863`) |
| demand | a live socket, or a `/snap` read within `snapLingerMs` 60 s (`demand` `:349`; `RT_LIMITS` `shared/flows-rt.js:32-60`); no demand means no vendor call |
| sockets | accepted with `ctx.acceptWebSocket(server, ["u:" + user])` (`:913`); the tag is never queried (`ctx.getWebSockets()` is called unfiltered, `:861`; no `getTags` anywhere); per-user cap `userCap` default 3 (`FLOWS_RT_USER_CAP`, clamp 1..10, `hubConfig` `:21`), 200 total (`RT_LIMITS.sockets`); over cap the socket gets `bye` 4009 / 4012 (`admit` `:526`) |
| socket attachment | `serializeAttachment({u, exp, k, f})` at admit (`persist` `:553`); `sockState` rebuilds `{u, exp, topics, f}` from it after hibernation (`:329-337`); `have`, `lastRs`, `burst` are rebuilt empty |
| ping/pong | `setWebSocketAutoResponse("ping" -> "pong")` in the constructor (`:858`); the client sends the JSON `{"t":"p"}` instead, which does wake the object |
| epoch | `ep` is 0 in the constructor (`:285`); `start(now)` sets `ep = max(now, ep + 1)` (`:377`), so every hub (re)start, session rollover or hibernation wake is a new epoch |
| sequences | one counter per topic (`createCounter` `shared/flows-rt.js:295`, `RtHub.counter` `:282`), reset in `resetRun` `:297`, +1 per `emit` `:456`; snapshots carry `peek` so the next delta is `sq + 1` (`:446`) |
| per-topic memory | `topics[k]` = `newTopic` (`:250`): merge state (`createPxState` rows Map + allow set; `createFlowState` ring, seen Map, cursor; `createGexState`, `createMarketState` rows Map; `createNewsState` ring, seen Map; `shared/flows-rt.js:556-592`), `hasData`, `readAt`, `vendorAt`, frame/byte counters, lag stats (256 samples) |
| other memory | `roster`, `rosterAt`, `clock`, `session`, `base` (prior-close base), `gex` rotation, `focus`, `degraded`, `forceThrottle`, `closedKey`, `waiters`, budget rings (`createBudget` 240 calls per minute, `FLOWS_RT_CALLS_PER_MIN`), `lastSnapAt`, `logged` (32 keys), `socks` WeakMap, `closing` WeakSet (`:260-295`) |
| survives hibernation | only what the platform keeps: the accepted sockets with their tags and attachments, the pending alarm; the `Pulse` constructor runs again and the next `tick()` finds `running === false`, so it calls `start(now, {notify: "restart"})` and broadcasts `ctl.resync reason restart`; each socket's `have` set is empty, so the next emit is a snapshot (`tick` `:732-735`, `start` `:374-385`) |
| lost on deploy or hibernation | epoch and every sequence counter, all merged rows and rings, roster, session, gex rotation, degrade state, call budget, lag statistics; a deploy also drops the sockets (clients reconnect with jitter) |
| gate in front | `serveRt` `flows-rt-routes.js:16`: `FLOWS_RT_MODE` off or no `PULSE` binding 404 `rt_off` (even anonymous); non-GET 405; no Flows session 401; `status` owner-only (`FLOWS_RT_USERS`); `ws`/`snap` need `FLOWS_RT_AUDIENCE` `owner` (default) or `members`; `ws` also needs `Upgrade`, same-origin and a valid `f`; headers `X-RT-*` and `Cookie` are stripped and `X-RT-User` / `X-RT-Exp` set from the verified session (see 35-rail) |
| polling window | 04:00-20:00 ET on trading days only; outside it `ctl.closed` once and no vendor call (`tick` `:725-760`) |

### 6. Who may write what

#### 6.1 Store by writer class

Writer classes: **L** Lab learning routes (cookie `session`, `aud` learn, same-origin, `X-IEWT-Owner`, `X-IEWT-Generation`); **O** OAuth callback; **A** anonymous request; **F** signed-in Flows member route (cookie `flows_session`, any active member); **N** ingest door with the nightly token; **V** ingest door with the live credential (OIDC or static); **K** Worker cron; **D** Pulse object; **B** browser JavaScript. C = create or upsert, U = update only, X = delete, `-` = never.

| store | L | O | A | F | N | V | K | D | B |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `users` | - | C | - | - | - | - | - | - | - |
| `progress`, `progress_v3`, `skill_mastery`, `project_progress`, `mastery`, `placement` | C X | - | - | - | - | - | - | - | - |
| `stats` | C U | - | - | - | - | - | - | - | - |
| `mastery_attempts`, `skill_attempts` | C U X | - | - | - | - | - | - | - | - |
| `learning_preferences` | C | - | - | - | - | - | - | - | - |
| `learning_sync` | C U (every route, incl. GET) | - | - | - | - | - | - | - | - |
| `market_snapshot` | - | - | C (`GET /api/markets`) | - | - | - | C (housekeeping) | - | - |
| `flows_login_failures` | - | - | C X (`POST /flows/login`) | - | - | - | - | - | - |
| `flows_payload` | - | - | - | - | C X | - | - | - | - |
| `flows_live` | - | - | - | - | - | C (10 `actions` keys) | C (`live:market`, `live:focus`) | - | - |
| `flows_clock` | - | - | - | - | - | C (heartbeat sets `live_done_at`) | C (all other columns) | - | - |
| `flows_ledger` | - | - | - | - | C (`meta` landing) | C (Tier 2 pass) | C X (tick, outcome, focus; prune) | - | - |
| `flows_tape` | - | - | - | C U (`/api/flows/tape`) | - | - | X (prune) | - | - |
| `flows_dossier_cache` | - | - | - | C (`dossier`, `summary?t=`, `ask`, via assembly) | - | - | - | - | - |
| `flows_ai_usage`, `flows_ai_usage_model` | - | - | - | C (`ask`, `summary?t=`) | - | - | C (board summary) | - | - |
| `flows_ai_summary` | - | - | - | - | - | - | C (summary cron) | - | - |
| `flows_neuron` | - | - | - | C (`summary?t=`) | - | - | - | - | - |
| Cache API, course HTML | - | - | C (`GET /lab/<slug>/`) | - | - | - | - | - | - |
| Cache API, all `*.internal` keys | - | - | - | C (read routes, `waitUntil`) | - | - | - | - | - |

| `sessionStorage` `flows:*`, cookie `flows_gate` | - | - | - | - | - | - | - | - | C |

| static data | `assets/data/**` (77 course files, 4 project files, `review-bank.json`, `placement-bank.json`, `challenge-bank.json`, `skill-graph.json`; `stage-id-map-v2.json` is excluded from the bundle by `.assetsignore:16`) | read-only bundle content fetched by pages; one hour at the edge and in browsers (`_headers`) | changed only by a deploy plus an asset-version bump |

### 8. Source versus documentation, and storage traps

1. AGENTS.md says `schema.sql` provisions the Flows tables; four of the Flows tables (`flows_ai_usage`, `flows_ai_usage_model`, `flows_ai_summary`, `flows_neuron`) are absent from `schema.sql` (it has 20 tables) and exist only in migrations 0006-0009 and `FLOWS_SCHEMA_SQL` (`worker.js:136-140`). A database built from `schema.sql` alone gets them on the first Flows request. The name-parity test also skips them (see 12-config-infra).
2. AGENTS.md "Client persistence" lists only the v2 envelopes and `iewt:guideW`; source also writes five v3 envelopes (`stableProgress`, `skillMastery`, `skillOutbox`, `preferences`, `projects`, `storage.js:16-20`), preserves `iewt:preferences:v3:<owner>` on reset, and Flows pages write `flows:rt:off`, `flows:gate` and the `flows_gate` cookie outside `IEWTStorage` (the "all access through `IEWTStorage`" rule governs Lab data only).
3. AGENTS.md calls `Pulse` "SQLite-backed" and the hub reads D1; source declares `new_sqlite_classes` but writes no SQL rows; the socket tag `u:<user>` is set and never queried (user counting reads the attachment).
4. DEPLOY.md 10.5l lists a 5 s Cache API `quote` entry for the dossier; `persistParts` never writes one (`flows-dossier-worker.js:510`).
5. `stats.points` is only ever written as 0 (PUT insert `worker.js:3140`, reset `:3067`); `users` has no delete path.
6. Reads that write: every learning GET inserts the `learning_sync` row on first sight (`worker.js:357`); anonymous `GET /api/markets` can write `market_snapshot`; any active Flows member's GET can write `flows_neuron`, `flows_dossier_cache`, `flows_tape`, `flows_ai_usage*` and Cache API entries.
7. No retention exists for `flows_ai_usage*`, `flows_neuron`, `flows_dossier_cache`, `flows_ai_summary`, `users` (no DELETE in the tree); `flows_login_failures` is pruned only when some failure is recorded; `flows_tape` and `flows_ledger` are pruned once a day at 03:00-03:30 ET.
8. The pipeline cannot list the store by itself, so `roster` doubles as the retire ledger; a night whose roster write fails after its cards landed leaves an older roster behind, which the next run detects (roster more than one session old) and the `?list=` listing repairs by unioning unknown keys into the ledger (DEPLOY.md 10.4b; see 42-pipeline-c).
9. `live:gex` (14 vendor reads a pass) and `live:tape` (3) are written every Tier 2 pass although no browser reader was found for them; `live:movers` is derived from the strips read and costs no call (`LIVE_KEYS` `flows-live.js:13-25`; see 30-flows-server-core, 35-rail).
10. Cache API entries are per data centre and a no-op on `workers.dev`; the last-good copy is proven only on local workerd and a Cache API fake (AGENTS.md; see 10-worker-a trap T20). The `cache.put` of `serveCachedVendorRead` is un-caught (`worker.js:2177-2178`), as are the `waitUntil` puts of `cachedTickerInfo` (`:2076`) and `cachedIndexSpot` (`:2353`) (see 10-worker-a trap T21).
11. The contract that polices browser storage scans only for the string `localStorage` (`tests/contracts.mjs:356-359`), so `sessionStorage` and `document.cookie` writes in Flows pages are outside it.
12. A Worker deploy restarts the Durable Object: new epoch, dropped sockets, empty rings; deploy outside 04:00-20:00 ET on trading days (DEPLOY.md 10.5n).
13. Any new table must be added in `schema.sql` (unless deliberately inline-only), a migration, the inline DDL and, for per-learner data, the bootstrap statements and the reset batch; the 13-statement bootstrap count, `academy-contract.mjs:114-120` and the column-parity tests fail otherwise (see 12-config-infra "How to change it").

## State map II: configuration, switches, thresholds, quotas, versions, workflows, deployment status

Commit ba2acfe (origin/main after PR 148, authored 2026-10-03; 68 commits in the history), asset version 240, fonts token 230. Line numbers come from `grep -n` / `sed -n` on that tree, or are copied from the area part named ("see NN-area"). Source wins over AGENTS.md and DEPLOY.md; disagreements are listed in 8.8. Anything no file in the repository can prove is labelled "from session notes, not derivable from code" and is collected in 8.7. Storage (tables, caches, Durable Object, browser storage) is the sibling chapter 91a-state-storage; this chapter is everything that configures behaviour or limits it.

### 0. Where each kind of setting lives

```text
 COMMITTED, applied by a deploy                       SET OUTSIDE THE REPO                        TEST / CI ONLY
 ----------------------------------------------       ----------------------------------------    -----------------------------
 wrangler.toml [vars]   17 plain strings              wrangler secret put   (deploys at once)     tests/worker-server.mjs --var
 wrangler.toml bindings ASSETS DB AI UW_ONDEMAND      dashboard secret      (dormant till Deploy) FLOWS_TEST_SANDBOX, RT_ONLY, ...
                        PULSE                         GitHub repository secrets                   workflow env: blocks
 wrangler.toml crons (4), migration v1                Cloudflare dashboard: Workers Builds,
 _headers, .assetsignore  (asset layer)                 WAF skip rule, Transform Rules, domains
 constants in code: FRESH_CLASSES, LIVE_BUDGET,       .dev.vars (git-ignored), developer shell
   RT_LIMITS, WITNESS, HEALTH, caps ...                 (.mcp.json expands ${UW_API_KEY})
   each one pinned by a test: a change is a commit
```

A `[vars]` edit made in the dashboard is overwritten by the next deploy ("the dashboard's variable list is overwritten by a deploy, so change the file", DEPLOY.md:2891-2892). A secret put with the CLI deploys at once; one added in the dashboard waits for its Deploy button and the running Worker behaves as if it were unset (DEPLOY.md:593-613).

#### 1.2 Cron triggers (wrangler.toml:26; routed by `cronJob`, flows-live-worker.js:75; handler `scheduled`, worker.js:3950)

Cloudflare numbers cron weekdays 1 = Sunday to 7 = Saturday, so weekdays are written by NAME. The numeric `1-5` this file once carried ran Tier 1 Sunday to Thursday and never on Friday 2026-09-25 (test message at tests/flows-live-contract.mjs:983-993, which also asserts exactly four crons, five fields each, weekday field `*` or three-letter names). GitHub Actions cron files use standard numeric weekdays (`1-5`, 0 = Sunday), see section 7.

| cron string (UTC) | constant (flows-live-worker.js) | job | fires | does |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `1-59/5 13-21 * * MON-FRI` | `RTH_CRON` :70 | rth (Tier 1) | minutes 1,6,...,56 of UTC hours 13-21, Mon-Fri | `rthTick` :371: two vendor calls to `live:market`, clock stamp, ledger row; may dispatch `flows-live.yml` at :01/:16/:31/:46 and the watchdog re-dispatch. Does work only in the window `tier1Due` allows (open to close + 10 min), or at a verdict re-probe of a day the clock holds as closed (`verdictReprobeDue` :293: from 09:45 ET until 11:00 on a calendar holiday or 15:45 on a calendar trading day, minutes % 15 < 5); outside a re-probe, a day held as closed (`trading = 0`) records `tier1_why = holiday` and returns `skipped: "holiday"` (:392-397) |
| `3-58/5 13-21 * * MON-FRI` | `FOCUS_CRON` :71 | focus | minutes 3,8,...,58, same hours | `focusTick` :504: one screener call to `live:focus` (cadence 300 s) |
| `*/30 * * * *` | `HOUSEKEEPING_CRON` :72 | housekeeping | :00 and :30 every day | `refreshMarketSnapshotIfDue` (worker.js:3978), `nightlyTick` :554 (dispatch of `flows-pipeline.yml`), and at 03:00-03:30 ET `pruneTape` + `pruneLedger` (worker.js:3983-3986; `pruneDue` :588) |
| `15,45 * * * *` | `SUMMARY_CRON` :73 | summary | :15 and :45 every day | `summaryFiring` worker.js:1423 -> `refreshFlowsSummary` :1337, then stamps `flows_clock.summary_at` |

An unknown or stale trigger string is routed by the instant (flows-live-worker.js:80-88): minute % 30 = 0 is housekeeping, minute % 30 = 15 is summary, outside Mon-Fri UTC hours 13-21 is housekeeping, minute % 5 = 3 is focus, anything else is rth, so no job ever runs at another job's minutes. Four crons are within the five a Free account may register (DEPLOY.md:498). After a deploy confirm all four are registered; `wrangler triggers deploy` re-registers them (DEPLOY.md:2423-2465). The nightly health gate names a missing cron (`HEALTH: Tier 1 never ticked`, `live:focus has never been written`, `the summary cron has never completed a firing`; DEPLOY.md:2455-2462).

Expired (401) turns the nightly red with a remedy; 403/404/422 each have their own (`DISPATCH_ADVICE`, health.mjs:32-38) |

Local development: the same names go in git-ignored `.dev.vars` (`.gitignore` also drops `.env*`; `.assetsignore` keeps `.dev.vars*` and `.env*` out of the bundle). README.md:147-153 shows `GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID`, `GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET` and `SESSION_SECRET` for local Google OAuth; DEPLOY.md:2405-2407 puts a static `FLOWS_LIVE_TOKEN` there for a local `--live` run (pointing `FLOWS_INGEST_URL` at `http://127.0.0.1:8787/api/flows/ingest`). `tests/worker-server.mjs` injects its own test values with `--var` (1.5). Test-only overrides sit in section 3.1. Secrets that must match in two places: `UW_API_KEY` and `FLOWS_INGEST_TOKEN`. `FLOWS_INGEST_URL` is an optional GitHub secret (script default `https://anilkaya.org/api/flows/ingest`, scripts/flows-pipeline.mjs:87). The vendor key is a developer-shell variable for `.mcp.json` (`Authorization: Bearer ${UW_API_KEY}`, an MCP convenience for Claude Code sessions, ignored by the bundle).

#### 2.3 The OIDC live credential and what each ingest token may do

`LIVE_OIDC` (flows-oidc.js:3-17): issuer `https://token.actions.githubusercontent.com`, audience `https://anilkaya.org/api/flows/ingest#live`, repository `anilkaya001/anilkaya.org` with id `1284743712`, owner id `107927045`, workflow ref `anilkaya001/anilkaya.org/.github/workflows/flows-live.yml@refs/heads/main`, ref `refs/heads/main`, events `schedule` and `workflow_dispatch`, runner `github-hosted`, skew 60 s, maximum token life 3,600 s, at most 8,192 characters. Renaming the workflow file or repository, dispatching from another ref, a self-hosted runner or a reusable workflow all make the Worker refuse the token (trap 15 in 45-probes-workflows). JWKS memo: TTL 1 h, retry floor 60 s warm / 5 s cold, 4 s fetch timeout, 5 s join wait (flows-live-worker.js:608-612).

| route / key | nightly token | live token (OIDC or static) |
|---|---|---|
| POST `live:*` | refused 403 `nightly_token_scope` | allowed (registry-checked, wrong writer 403) |
| POST/DELETE any other key | allowed (dated archive keys insert-once; DELETE for dated keys and card/card-x/hist) | refused |
| GET `board:long`, `board:short`, `board:watch`, `meta`, `focus` | allowed | allowed (`NIGHTLY_READ_KEYS` flows-live-worker.js:90) |
| GET `?key=clock` | allowed, plus `labActiveAt` and `ledger` | allowed, without them |
| GET `?list=` (card, card-x, hist), `?keys=` (at most 96) | allowed | 403 `live_token_scope` |

Hops, nightly: `flows-pipeline.yml:84` env `FLOWS_INGEST_TOKEN` -> `scripts/flows-pipeline.mjs:123` -> `Authorization: Bearer` with UA `anilkaya-flows-pipeline/1` (:90) -> POST `${FLOWS_INGEST_URL}?key=` -> Cloudflare edge (a WAF or Bot Fight 403 is possible, DEPLOY.md:414-456) -> `worker.js:3454` -> `FLOWS_LIVE.tokenKind` (flows-live-worker.js:601, timing-safe compare worker.js:925) -> kind `nightly` -> D1. Hops, live: `flows-live.yml:55` `id-token: write` -> `actionsIdToken` (flows-oidc.js:136) -> `liveCredential` (scripts/flows-pipeline.mjs:102, bearer cached until 60 s before expiry, `LIVE_BEARER_MARGIN_MS` :92) -> POST `live:*` -> `looksLikeJwt` (worker.js:3458) -> `oidcKind` (flows-live-worker.js:664) -> `jwksKeys` -> `verifyLiveOidc` (flows-oidc.js:121: claims policy, then key by `kid` with one forced refresh, then RS256 signature) -> kind `live` -> `ingestScope` :678 -> `ingestLive` :695. An unreadable key set is 503 so the pipeline retries; any other failure is 401 with the reason and non-secret claims logged.

#### 3.2 What pulling each lever does, hop by hop

A. Rail off (`FLOWS_RT_MODE = "off"`; a one-line deploy; deploy outside 04:00-20:00 ET on trading days because a deploy restarts the object, DEPLOY.md:2938-2941).
1. Deploy applies the var; the object restarts and drops its sockets.
2. `rtSwitches(env)` flows-rt.js:109 returns `mode: "off"`.
3. `serveRt` flows-rt-routes.js:16-18 throws 404 `rt_off` before it looks at the binding, the method, the path or the session.
4. A surviving object: `RtHub.tick` flows-rt-hub.js:729 `shutdown(4011, "rt-off")`; `admit` :528 `bye(4011)`; `Pulse.fetch` :889 answers 404.
5. Client: the refused upgrade and the 404 snapshot send `goFinal` (assets/js/flows-rt.js:578): mode `off`, 403/404 memoised in `sessionStorage["flows:rt:off"]` for 10 minutes; pages behave exactly as before the rail (heartbeats and polled reads).
6. Cost of an off rail: one refused upgrade and one 404 snapshot on the first page of a tab.

B. Reading off (`FLOWS_READ_MODE = "off"`, deploy). `summaryResponse` (worker.js:1718) -> `readingSafe` -> `readingFor` (flows-reading-worker.js:172; `readMode` :31 at :174) returns the deterministic reading with `why: "off"` (:212); no `read:<T>` row is read (:182 is gated on `canModel`) and no model is called, but the dossier is still assembled first (:191), so its one D1 batch and its vendor fan-out still run; the Neuron's own generation keeps running.

C. Live layer off (`FLOWS_LIVE_MODE = "off"`, deploy). `scheduled` worker.js:3950 -> `rthTick` writes `tier1_why = "off"` and returns (flows-live-worker.js:380-383); `focusTick` :506 and `nightlyTick` :555 return `{skipped: "off"}`; the Tier 2 workflow keeps running on its own starters but nothing dispatches it from the Worker; readers fall back to the nightly rows.

D. Model off (any of: `FLOWS_AI_DAILY_CAP_NEURONS = "0"`, `FLOWS_AI_DAILY_CAP_CALLS = "0"`, blank `FLOWS_ASK_MODEL`, or a spent budget). A blank primary takes the shorter path: `aiChain` flows-ai.js:75 returns `[]`, every call site (worker.js:1399, 1578, 1598, 1925) writes its deterministic answer without touching the binding, and the reading answers `fallback` with `why: "no-model"` (flows-reading-worker.js:176, 213); no budget failure is recorded. The other three go through the meter: `budgetVerdict` :130 -> `cappedAi.run` :155 throws `FLOWS_AI_BUDGET_SPENT: <reason>` before `env.AI.run` -> `askFailure` :45 -> failure `budget` -> `askModels` stops the chain -> stored guard `unreachable:budget` -> deterministic reading/summary stands and the reader is told the site's own budget is spent; retried after the cooldown (the reading: 30 min for `unreachable:budget`, `READ_COOLDOWN_MS` flows-reading-worker.js:13-26; the Neuron: `NEURON_RETRY_MS` 5 min, worker.js:1448, for any retryable `unreachable:*` guard) or when the UTC day turns.

E. Sign everyone out. Raise `FLOWS_SESSION_EPOCH` in `wrangler.toml` and deploy (or raise one member's `epoch`, or end `until`, or remove the member in `FLOWS_CREDENTIALS` with `wrangler secret put`, no deploy). Rotating `FLOWS_PEPPER` or passwords signs nobody out.

F. Stop the rail spending the vendor budget without turning it off: lower `FLOWS_RT_CALLS_PER_MIN` (floor 10): the ring refuses polls and the degraded reason becomes `budget`.

### 4. Freshness classes, phases and thresholds

#### 4.1 `FRESH_CLASSES` (shared/flows-freshness.js:3-12, frozen; pinned verbatim by tests/flows-live-contract.mjs:55-61 and for the rail by tests/flows-freshness-contract.mjs:76-91)

| class | source | cadence s | live s | stale s | extra | used by |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `quote` | ondemand | 5 | 20 | 90 | | the quote card (`serveQuote` flows-live-worker.js:946) |
| `tape` | ondemand | 60 | 150 | 600 | | per-ticker tape (`TAPE_SPEC` flows-live.js:28) |
| `market` | worker | 300 | 660 | 1500 | | `live:market`, `live:focus` (Worker-written) |
| `breadth` | actions | 900 | 1200 | 2700 | | the other ten `live:*` keys; `checkLiveWrite` requires `fresh.cadenceS` to equal the registry's |
| `nightly` | nightly | 0 | none | none | `graceS` 18,000 (5 h) | every `flows_payload` row via `nightlyFreshMeta` (flows-live.js:1360) |
| `rt` | hub | 5 | 15 | 60 | `extended: true` | rail topics `px`, `fl` |
| `rtSlow` | hub | 10 | 30 | 120 | `extended: true` | rail topics `gx`, `mk` |
| `rtNews` | hub | 30 | 75 | 300 | `extended: true` | rail topic `nw` |

The live line is three cadences plus a margin; `rtNews` exists because a 30 s live line would flip to fresh between every two 30 s polls (PR 148 message). `classOf` (flows-freshness.js:274) takes `meta.klass` if known, else the cadence (exact match, skipping `source: "hub"`), else buckets (<=5 quote, <=60 tape, <=300 market, else breadth; 0 or missing = nightly). `REFRESH_CADENCE_MINUTES` = market cadence / 60 = 5, the number pages quote (flows-freshness.js:14).

Verdict boundaries for a key read at T (derived): `live:market`/`live:focus` live until T + 11 min, fresh until T + 25 min, stale after (the 25-minute line is also `LEDGER_LIMITS.tier1Ms`/`focusMs` and `WITNESS.tier1StaleMs`); `live:breadth` and the other breadth keys live until T + 20 min, fresh until T + 45 min (`LEDGER_LIMITS.tier2Ms`, `WITNESS.tier2StaleMs`); a quote card 20 s / 90 s; a tape 150 s / 10 min.

#### 4.2 Phases (`PHASE_MINUTES` flows-freshness.js:16-25, Eastern minutes; `phaseAt` :218)

| phase | window (ET) | notes |
|---|---|---|
| `closed` | non-trading day (weekend, computed NYSE holiday, tape verdict closed), or before 04:00, or from 20:00 | `session` is the previous trading day before 04:00 |
| `pre` | 04:00 (`preOpen` 240) to 09:30 (`open` 570) | |
| `rth` | 09:30 to 16:00 (`close` 960); 13:00 (`earlyClose` 780) on early closes | |
| `post` | close to 20:00 (`postEnd` 1200) | |
| nightly due | `nightlyAfter` 17:15 (1035), retry `nightlyRetry` 18:15 (1095), session probe `sessionProbe` 09:45 (585) | the nightly is expected 21:00 ET (close + 5 h grace, even on early closes) |

Other windows: `isRefreshWindow` weekday 09:15-16:15 ET, not holiday aware (flows-freshness.js:39-40, :83), gates only the landing-page market snapshot refresh; the rail polls only 04:00-20:00 ET on trading days (hub `phaseAt`, outside it a `ctl.closed` once per reason and zero vendor calls); an undecided clock (`flows_clock.trading` NULL) counts as a trading day, only an explicit `0` closes it (`clockClosed` :158).

#### 4.3 `freshnessState(meta, at, clock)` (flows-freshness.js:282-333), as rules

1. No clock: stale `no-clock`. No `readAt`: stale `unstamped`.
2. Class `nightly`: `expected = expectedNightlySession` (latest trading day whose 16:00 ET close + 5 h has passed, :262); no session: stale `unsessioned`; session before expected: stale `behind`; else fresh `session` with `staleAt` = the following trading day's 16:00 ET + 5 h.
3. Other classes in `rth` (or `pre`/`post` for `extended` classes, measured from 04:00 ET): `readAt` before the window start: closed `awaiting-first-read` until start + live, then stale `missed-open`; age <= live: live `cadence`; age <= stale: fresh `cadence`; else stale `behind`.
4. Outside the session: `readAt` >= last close minus one cadence: closed `session-final`; else stale `missed-close`.
5. Rail stamped topics (`px`, `gx`, `mk`; `streamEntry` flows-rt.js:171): a `live` frame is demoted by the vendor-lag guard: unstamped -> fresh `vendor-unstamped`; clock-skewed -> fresh `vendor-skew`; lag > staleS + bar -> stale `vendor-lag`; lag > liveS + bar -> fresh `vendor-lag`; `liveUntil` nulled. Bars: `gx` 60 s, `mk` 300 s, `px` 0 (RT_TOPICS flows-rt.js:62-68), so px is live at lag <= 15 s and stale past 60 s, gx live <= 90 s and stale past 180 s, mk live <= 330 s and stale past 420 s (derived). Event topics `fl`, `nw` are live by the success of the poll.
6. States `live`, `fresh`, `closed`, `stale` (`pending` only via `pendingHeaders` :355). Headers: `X-Fresh-State`, `-Reason`, `-Class`, `-Read-At`, `-Source`, `-Cadence`, `-Session`, `-Live-Until`, `-Stale-At`, `-Phase`, `-Phase-Ends`, plus `X-Server-Now`.

#### 4.4 Clock and dispatch thresholds

| constant | value | where | meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `LIVE_CLOCK.tier1AfterCloseMin` | 10 | flows-freshness.js:27-37 | Tier 1 works to close + 10 min |
| `dispatchAfterCloseMin` / `runAfterCloseMin` | 16 / 25 | same | Worker dispatch window ends close + 16; the Tier 2 loop's window ends close + 25 |
| `dispatchEveryMin` / `dispatchMinute` | 15 / 1 | same | Worker dispatches only when minute % 15 = 1 (:01/:16/:31/:46) |
| `inFlightMs` | 10 min | same | no second dispatch within 10 min of a send unless `liveDoneAt >= liveDispatchedAt` |
| `watchdogMs` | 45 min | same | `liveStalled`: RTH only, at least 45 min after open, `live:breadth` older than 45 min or absent; re-dispatch at most once per 45 min, `origin: "watchdog"` |
| `earlyCloseQuietMs`, `holidayProbeMin` | 30 min, 10 | same | `sessionStatePatch` (flows-live-worker.js:299-329) marks an early close only when the tide tape has not moved for 30 min, after 13:30 ET, with its last point at or before 13:05 ET; a weekday holiday is probed only 09:45 to 09:55 ET (`holidayProbeDue` flows-freshness.js:374-381) |
| `VERDICT` | provisional until 11:00 ET, unscheduled until 15:45 ET, `agreeMs` 15 min, re-probe every 15 min, `closedDaysMax` 20 | flows-live.js:458-464 | a closed-day verdict needs two agreeing probes at least 15 min apart |
| `nightlyDispatchDue` | trading day, minutes >= 1035, `metaSession < today`; first send in window; one retry at >= 1095 | flows-freshness.js:419-432 | Worker nightly dispatch; first possible firing is 17:30 ET (housekeeping `*/30`), retry 18:30 ET |
| `NIGHTLY_MISSING_AFTER_MIN` | 300 | flows-live-worker.js:92 | logs `nightly missing` from 21:00 ET |

#### 5.5 Real-time rail (`RT_LIMITS` flows-rt.js:32-60)

`userSockets` 3 (`FLOWS_RT_USER_CAP`), `sockets` 200 (4012 `hub-full`), `laggardFrames` 10 (4008), `snapLingerMs` 60,000 (a `/snap` request keeps the hub awake 60 s), `snapWaitMs` 3,000, `hbMs` 5,000 (30,000 when closed), `tickMs` 1,000, `rsMinGapMs` 2,000, `messageBurst` 20 per `messageWindowMs` 10,000 (1008 flood), client message at most 256 bytes (`RT_CLIENT_MAX_BYTES` :25; 1009), `focusMax` 8, `gexFocusEvery` 4, `rosterMs` 300,000, `callsPerMinute` 240, `callTimeoutMs` 4,000, `degradeAfterMs` 15,000, `pause429MaxMs` 120,000 / `pause429BaseMs` 5,000, `flowLimit` 200, `seenMax` 1,000, `newsLimit` 100, `lagSamples` 256. Row caps per topic: px 200, fl 200, gx 64, mk 16, nw 60 (`RT_TOPICS`). Cadences: px 5 s, fl 5 s, gx 1 s, mk 10 s (two calls), nw 30 s. Close codes: 1008, 1009, 4001 expired, 4003 audience (defined, never sent), 4008, 4009, 4011, 4012 (`RT_CLOSE` :27). Client: hello deadline 10 s (`HELLO_MS`), silence watchdog the larger of 16 s and 3.2 times the hello's `hbS` (100 s while the hub says closed; :432), poll 5 s, snapshot fetch deadline 8 s (`DEADLINE_MS`), hidden-tab close at 30 s, probe the socket again at about 1/2/4/8 s (`FAST_TRIES` 4) then each minute, resync request gap 2.6 s with at most 5 tries before the topic is declared dead (`RS_GAP_MS`, `RS_TRIES`), at most 2,000 rows a frame, final statuses 400/401/403/404 (assets/js/flows-rt.js:6-32). Documented, not re-measured: px frame 32,042 bytes for 157 rows; 433 KB a minute on the socket (all topics), 1.6 MB a minute on the poll rung; receive path 0.8-1.0 ms per px frame (DEPLOY.md:3090-3101).

Traps: a blanket `?v=` rewrite also hits the 16 woff2 URLs (`grep -rn 'woff2?v=' --include=*.html --include=*.css .` must show only 230); the first forward deploy after any rollback must bump the asset version because the asset layer stores an immutable 404 for a missing css/js/fonts file (DEPLOY.md:318-346; tests/worker-regression.mjs:262-267). The tokens sit beside `assets/fonts/`, not inside it, because a second `_headers` rule matching the same path joins its `Cache-Control` onto the first. #### 7.3 Who starts whom

```text
 Cloudflare cron 1-59/5 13-21 MON-FRI --rthTick--> liveDispatchDue (minute%15==1, 09:30..close+16)
        --dispatchWorkflow(flows-live.yml, {tick, origin: worker})------------------------------+
        --liveStalled (>45 min since live:breadth) --{origin: watchdog}--------------------------+
 flows-live loop (340 min budget) --chainDispatch(flows-live.yml, {tick, origin: chain})---------+--> flows-live (355 min job)
 32 GitHub crons (backup; delivered late: 6 runs for 63 slots, 2026-09-23..25)-------------------+
 human: gh workflow run flows-live.yml [-f drill=true]-------------------------------------------+

 Cloudflare cron */30 --nightlyTick--(>=17:15 ET, so 17:30 ET first, 18:30 ET retry)--dispatchWorkflow(flows-pipeline.yml, {origin: worker})--+
 flows-live loop 17:30 ET (retry >=18:15) --nightly start--dispatch(flows-pipeline.yml, {origin: live-loop})----------------------------------+--> flows-pipeline build
 GitHub crons 21:30 UTC (EDT) / 22:30 UTC (EST) primary, 01:17 and 03:47 UTC Tue-Sat backups (gate admits one primary per zone)---------------+
 human: gh workflow run flows-pipeline.yml [-f republish_session=true / origin=live-loop]---------------------------------------------------------+

 flows-pipeline keepalive (Monday, New York) --PUT enable--> flows-pipeline, flows-live, flows-probe, regression
 flows-live --Issues (issues: write, job token)--> [flows-witness:*]        flows-live --ingest GET/POST (OIDC)--> Worker /api/flows/ingest
 flows-pipeline --ingest POST (FLOWS_INGEST_TOKEN)--> Worker /api/flows/ingest
```

Dispatch input contract (a wrong input is a 422): `flows-live.yml` declares `tick`, `origin`, `drill`; `flows-pipeline.yml` declares `dry_run`, `allow_intraday`, `republish_session`, `origin` only. The loop's chain body is `{ref: "main", inputs: {tick, origin: "chain"}}` (live.mjs:393-408); the loop sends only `{origin: "live-loop"}` to the nightly; the Worker sends `{tick, origin: worker/watchdog}` to live and `{origin: "worker"}` to the nightly (flows-live-worker.js:449, 465, 571). `origin` of the nightly is only echoed by the gate, never passed to the script.

The nightly gate keys on the cron STRING that fired and on the New York zone, never on wall time: `30 21 * * 1-5` is admitted only under EDT, `30 22 * * 1-5` only under EST, the two backups always; a dispatch always proceeds ("Dispatched by: $ORIGIN"). The pipeline itself refuses an in-progress session (09:30-16:00 ET) unless `allow_intraday`, and a same-session re-run refreshes only `pulse`, `sector:premium` and `news` unless `republish_session` (a repair that works only before the next weekday's 09:30 ET open, health.mjs `republishRepair`).

### 1. Page request: edge, Worker, finalizer, course rewrite (flow A)

#### 1.1 Topology

```text
Browser ──HTTPS──► Cloudflare edge          wrangler.toml:5-10
                    [assets] directory "." (repo root minus .assetsignore, 26 patterns)  binding ASSETS
                    html_handling "auto-trailing-slash" (:8)   not_found_handling "404-page" (:9)
                    run_worker_first = ["/*", "!/assets/*"] (:10)
   │
   ├─ path starts with /assets/ ──► ASSET LAYER (Worker NOT invoked, finalize NOT run)
   │       headers from _headers (29 lines): 7 security headers (:1-8) + Cache-Control by path (:10-29); never a CSP
   │       hit  -> file                         miss -> 404.html under the same path policy
   │
   └─ every other path ───────────► Worker "anilkaya"   export default.fetch worker.js:3990
           route() :2762  ─►  [/auth/*]  [/api/*]  [/flows/*]  [/api/rt/*]  [/lab/<slug>/]  [fall-through]
              │                                                                                   │
              │ rememberLastGood :3994 (no-op for Lab/auth/HTML)                          env.ASSETS.fetch :3915
              ▼
           finalize :3918  ─►  response    (HttpError / other throw: :3996-4013 -> finalize as well)
```

#### 1.2 Hop list: any request

1. Hostname. The apex serves the Worker; `www` is a GitHub Pages redirect as last observed on 2026-07-12 (`AGENTS.md:96-99`, `DEPLOY.md:164-169`; external, see section 6).
2. Edge decision: `wrangler.toml:10`. The literal is pinned by `contracts.mjs:826-827`. Bundle content is the repo root (`wrangler.toml:6`) filtered by `.assetsignore:1-26` (excludes `worker.js`, `wrangler.toml`, `shared/`, `scripts/`, `tests/`, `migrations/`, `schema.sql`, `CNAME`, `*.md`, dotfiles, `articles/_template/` (:10), the four authoring curriculum scripts (:12-15) and `assets/data/stage-id-map-v2.json` (:16); it also lists `flows/` (:11) and `functions/` (:8), neither of which exists in the tree; `docs/` is not listed, so `docs/uw-openapi.yaml` ships).
3. Branch `/assets/*`: the asset layer answers alone. Headers come from `_headers`: the same seven headers as `SECURITY_HEADERS` (`worker.js:117-125`) on `/assets/*` (`_headers:1-8`); `public, max-age=31536000, immutable` for css (`_headers:10-11`), js (`13-14`), fonts (`16-17`); `public, max-age=3600` for img (`19-20`), data (`22-23`), `version.txt` (`25-26`), `fonts-version.txt` (`28-29`). The asset layer matches by path only, so `?v=` is irrelevant and an unversioned `/assets/css/base.css` is also immutable (`worker-regression.mjs:216-233`). A missing file returns `404.html` (`wrangler.toml:9`) under the same path policy, so a missing `/assets/{css,js,fonts}/*` file is a one-year immutable 404 with no CSP (`worker-regression.mjs:260-267`). `_headers` itself is uploaded but not served; `.gitignore:7-8` re-includes it against the `_*` rule and `.assetsignore` must not list it (`contracts.mjs:830-833`).
4. Branch everything else: `fetch` (`worker.js:3990`) builds `url` (:3991) and awaits `route(request, env, url, ctx)` (:3993).
5. `route()` walks a chain of `if (path ...)` blocks, first match wins (table 1.3).
6. Success: `rememberLastGood` (`worker.js:3994`; body `1064-1081`) returns at once unless the response is a 200 with a non-zero `X-Payload-Updated`, which only the 22 nightly Flows read paths carry (`LAST_GOOD_PATHS`, `worker.js:1041-1043`, keyed by `lastGoodKey` :1046-1058; the header is set by `passthrough` :1232-1241 and at :3776 and :3832), so it never stores Lab, auth or HTML responses. Then `finalize` (:3995).
7. `HttpError` thrown anywhere in `route()` (:3997): code `store_unreadable` first tries `recallLastGood` (:3998-3999); otherwise `apiError` (:4000; `worker.js:168-169`) renders `{ "error": { "code", "message" }, ...details }` with the error's own headers (for example `Allow`, `X-IEWT-Generation`, `Retry-After`).
8. Any other throw: structured `request failed` log (:4002-4007); `isStoreQuota` (D1 error 7500 or "free tier daily row", `worker.js:1030-1031`) gives 503 `store_quota` with `Retry-After` to 00:00 UTC (:4008-4010); anything else 500 `internal_error` (:4012). Both go through `finalize`.
9. `finalize` (`worker.js:3918-3946`) begins with `new Response(response.body, response)` (:3919); that line is AGENTS.md invariant 1 and must not become a header-dictionary rebuild (it would corrupt `Content-Encoding`; `AGENTS.md:652-696`).

#### 1.4 finalize() decision table (`worker.js:3918-3946`)

| Case | Branch | Result |
|---|---|---|
| every response | :3920 | the seven `SECURITY_HEADERS` set |
