| 200 or 304 GET or HEAD with `?v=` under `/assets/` | :3939-3941 | immutable one year; unreachable for real traffic because `/assets/*` never reaches the Worker |
| other 200 or 304 GET or HEAD with a non-JSON type | :3942-3943 | `public, max-age=3600` |
| redirects | `redirect()` `worker.js:171-175` | `Cache-Control: no-store`; no later branch applies |

#### 1.5 Worked hop list: `GET /lab/ordinary-least-squares/`

1. Edge: not `/assets/` -> Worker (:3990). `route()` falls past every earlier block (string compares at 2766-3897) and `courseMatch` matches at :3904.
2. :3905 requires the slug in `COURSE_BY_SLUG` (generated `shared/course-seo.js`, written by `generate-course-payloads.mjs:312`); :3906 `requireMethod(GET, HEAD)`; :3908-3910 a path other than `meta.path` gets 308 to the canonical slash form.
3. :3912 `renderCourse` (`worker.js:2702`). Cache lookup on `origin + meta.path` for GET only (:2704-2709), a hit is returned as is.
4. Miss: copy request headers, force `Accept-Encoding: identity`, drop `If-None-Match`, `If-Modified-Since`, `If-Match`, `If-Unmodified-Since`, `Range`, `If-Range` (:2711-2715), then `env.ASSETS.fetch(origin + "/lab/course")` (:2716; `COURSE_ASSET_PATH` :40). `html_handling` resolves it to `lab/course.html`, whose `<html data-asset-version="240">` is line 2 of the shell.
5. A non-HTML ASSETS answer is returned untouched (:2717).
6. `HTMLRewriter` (:2724-2746): `html` captures `data-asset-version` (:2725); `head` prepends two `<link rel="preload" as="fetch" crossorigin="anonymous">` for `/assets/data/courses/<id>/manifest.json?v=` and `<id>/<modules[0].id>.json?v=` (:2726-2731); `title`, `meta description`, `canonical`, `og:title/description/url/site_name/image`, `twitter:title/description/image` (:2732-2742); `#courseStructuredData` gets Course plus BreadcrumbList JSON-LD with every `<` replaced by the six characters `\u003c` (:2743, `courseStructuredData` :2651-2672); `#course` gets the no-JS `courseFallback` with the H1 (:2744, :2674); `#courseOverview` gets the module outline and related links (:2745, :2684).
7. `new Response(transformed.body, transformed)` and deletion of `ETag`, `Last-Modified`, `Content-Length`, `Content-Encoding`, `Accept-Ranges` (:2747-2750).
8. A 200 is stored in `caches.default` with `Cache-Control: max-age=60` (`COURSE_EDGE_TTL_S` :42) inside `ctx.waitUntil` (:2752-2758).
9. Back in `fetch`: `finalize` adds the seven headers and the CSP (HTML) and replaces the entry's `max-age=60` with `Cache-Control: no-cache` for the client (:3936-3938). The 60 seconds lives only in the Cache API entry, per data centre.
10. Browser: preloads start `manifest.json` and the first module in parallel with the five deferred scripts (`lab/course.html:31-35`: nav, lab-core, lab-suite.bundle, lab-fx, lab-course). `lab-course.js` takes the slug from the path (:6), finds `TOPIC_META` (:8), fetches the manifest with `?v=<dataset.assetVersion>` (:32-33, fallback to `<id>.json` only when the manifest is not ok) and each module lazily through `ensureModule` (:58). The same bundle starts `Auth.init` (flow C). `worker-regression.mjs:366-380` and `regression.mjs:919-921` pin that the preload, not a second request, serves the first module.

#### 1.7 Traps (flow A)

- T-A1. `/assets/*` has no Worker, no finalizer and no CSP. The `?v=` branch at `worker.js:3939-3941` is dead for real traffic. Policy lives only in `_headers`, held exactly by `contracts.mjs:826-870` (eight path rules, no CSP, the `/assets/*` block equal to `SECURITY_HEADERS`, one rule for every child of `assets/`).
- T-A2. Every Worker-served response must leave through `finalize`; the rail hook is inside `route()` for that reason (`flows-rt-contract.mjs:1438-1439`). `renderCourse` also uses `new Response(transformed.body, transformed)` (:2747).
- T-A3. Dashboard Transform Rules can rewrite headers after the Worker runs (`AGENTS.md:693-695`), so live header readback is part of every deploy (section 5.5).
- T-A4. A course page hit in `caches.default` is served up to 60 seconds after a deploy that changed `lab/course.html` or `shared/course-seo.js`, per data centre. A rolled-back or newer `data-asset-version` appears only after the entry expires.
- T-A5. `/api/flows/*` runs `requireMethod` before the session check, so HEAD is 405 even for anonymous callers, and unknown sub-routes are 401 for anonymous callers (:3603-3605, :3882).
- T-A6. The CSP hard-codes `wss://anilkaya.org` in `connect-src` (`worker.js:111`); AGENTS.md invariant 3 does not mention it.
- T-A7. `renderCourse` is the only code path that serves `lab/course.html`; direct requests are 308'd first (:3897), so the shell is never indexable.

### 2. Google OAuth sign-in, the two session systems, sign-out (flow B)

#### 2.1 Sequence diagram

```text
Browser                         Worker (worker.js)                         Google                    D1 "iewt"
  │ click #authBtn (lab-ui.js:112)
  │ Auth.signIn() auth.js:809-812 ─ backend true? location.href="/auth/google"
  │──GET /auth/google─────────────►│ 2766 requireMethod GET; requireGoogleConfig 2768 (221-227)
  │                                │ state=crypto.randomUUID() 2769; redirect_uri=origin+"/auth/callback" 2772
  │◄─302 accounts.google.com/o/oauth2/v2/auth?client_id&redirect_uri&response_type=code&scope=openid email profile
  │   Set-Cookie oauth_state (Max-Age 600; HttpOnly Secure SameSite=Lax) ; Cache-Control no-store
  │──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────►│ user picks account, consents
  │◄─302 /auth/callback?code&state────────────────────────────────────────│
  │──GET /auth/callback + Cookie oauth_state─►│ 2784 try {
  │                                │ 2788-2791 code, state, saved cookie; state === saved else throw
  │                                │──POST oauth2.googleapis.com/token (2793-2803)───►│
  │                                │◄─access_token───────────────────────────────────│
  │                                │──GET www.googleapis.com/oauth2/v3/userinfo (2808)►│
  │                                │◄─{sub,email,name}───────────────────────────────│
  │                                │ user={sub:"g_"+sub,email,name} 2815
  │                                │──recordSignIn(env.DB,user,now) 2816──────────────────────────────────►│ UPSERT users
  │                                │ signSession({sub,email,name,aud:"learn",exp:now+30d}, SESSION_SECRET) 2818-2822
  │◄─302 /lab/?auth=ok  Set-Cookie session (HttpOnly Secure Lax Max-Age 2592000) + oauth_state cleared (2823-2826)
  │                                │ } catch -> log "oauth callback failed" 2828; 302 /lab/?auth=error 2832
  │──GET /lab/ ──► static ──► lab-suite.bundle.js ──► Auth.init() auth.js:999 ──► GET /api/v2/bootstrap (flow C)
  │                                │ currentUser 2638-2645: getCookie("session") -> verifySession -> isLearnAudience
```

#### 2.2 Hop list: sign-in

1. `Auth.signIn` (`auth.js:809-812`): with `backend` true (set by a successful bootstrap at `auth.js:959`) it assigns `location.href = "/auth/google"`; otherwise it only toasts that sign-in is unavailable and progress stays on the device.
2. `/auth/google` (`worker.js:2766-2782`): GET only (:2767); `requireGoogleConfig` (:2768; `worker.js:221-227` needs non-empty `SESSION_SECRET`, `GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID`, `GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET`, else 503 `service_unavailable`); `state` is a random UUID (:2769); the authorize URL carries `redirect_uri` built from the request's own origin (:2772), `response_type=code`, `scope=openid email profile`, `access_type=online`, `prompt=select_account`; the reply is `redirect(..., 302, [cookie("oauth_state", state, { maxAge: 600 })])`.
3. `redirect()` (`worker.js:171-175`) adds `Cache-Control: no-store` and one `Set-Cookie` per cookie. `cookie()` (`shared/session.js:59-63`) writes `name=encodeURIComponent(value); Path=/; HttpOnly; Secure; SameSite=Lax` and `Max-Age`, never a `Domain`, so cookies are host-only.
4. `/auth/callback` (`worker.js:2784-2833`): GET only; the whole body is inside `try`. Missing `code`, `state` or the saved cookie, or `state !== saved`, throws (:2791). The state check is a bare string compare; there is no PKCE.
5. Token exchange: `POST https://oauth2.googleapis.com/token` with `code`, client id and secret, `redirect_uri`, `grant_type=authorization_code` (:2793-2803); a non-OK answer or a missing `access_token` throws (:2804-2806).
6. User lookup: `GET https://www.googleapis.com/oauth2/v3/userinfo` with the bearer token (:2808-2811); `info.sub` is required (:2813).
7. Identity: `user = { sub: "g_" + info.sub, email, name }` (:2815). The Lab "owner" everywhere (D1 `user_id`, `X-IEWT-Owner`, localStorage `user:<id>`) is this `g_<googleSub>` string.
8. `recordSignIn(env.DB, user, Date.now())` (:2816; `shared/lab-sign-in.js:11-24`): upsert into `users(id, email, name, created_at, signed_in_at)` keeping `created_at` (:3-4); if the error names `signed_in_at` it runs `ALTER TABLE users ADD COLUMN signed_in_at INTEGER` and retries, then falls back to the 4-column legacy upsert (:5-7). A database with no `users` table throws here and the flow ends at hop 11.
9. `signSession` (:2818-2822; `shared/session.js:19-24`): token is `base64url(JSON(claims)) + "." + base64url(HMAC-SHA256(SESSION_SECRET, thatBase64Body))`, claims `{ sub, email, name, aud: LEARN_AUDIENCE, exp: Date.now() + LAB_SESSION_MS }` where `LEARN_AUDIENCE` is `"learn"` (`flows-auth.js:5`, imported at `worker.js:3`) and `LAB_SESSION_MS` = 30 days (`lab-sign-in.js:1`).
10. Success: `redirect(origin + "/lab/?auth=ok", 302, [cookie("session", session, { maxAge: LAB_SESSION_MS / 1000 }), cookie("oauth_state", "", { maxAge: 0 })])` (:2823-2826; `session` is the signed token from hop 9, so `Max-Age=2592000`).
11. Failure of any step: log `{"message":"oauth callback failed"}` (:2828-2831) and `302 /lab/?auth=error` with the state cookie cleared (:2832). No client file reads the `auth` query parameter (grep over `assets/js`, `lab/` and `index.html` is empty), so a failed sign-in is silent.
12. Next load: `lab/index.html` runs the bundle, `Auth.init` fires `GET /api/v2/bootstrap` and the server resolves the user with `currentUser` (`worker.js:2638-2645`): `getCookie(request, "session")` (`session.js:52-57`), `verifySession` (`session.js:26-39`: length at most 4096, two parts, HMAC verify, object with non-empty string `sub`, finite `exp`, `Date.now() < exp`), then `isLearnAudience` (`shared/flows-auth.js:179-183`: `aud` absent or null is accepted as a legacy token, otherwise it must equal `"learn"`). A bad or expired cookie yields `null`: the caller is anonymous and nothing throws.

#### 2.3 Learning session versus Flows member session

| Aspect | Lab (learning) | Flows (members) |
|---|---|---|
| Issued by | `/auth/callback` after Google OAuth (`worker.js:2784-2833`) | `POST /flows/login` after a PBKDF2 password check (`worker.js:3350-3385`) |
| Identity | `g_<googleSub>` | member name from the `FLOWS_CREDENTIALS` secret (`parseCredentials`, `flows-auth.js:99-102`), `FLOWS_PEPPER` for the hash |
| Cookie | `session` | `flows_session` (`FLOWS_COOKIE`, `flows-auth.js:6`) |
| Claims | `{ sub, email, name, aud: "learn", exp }` | `{ sub, aud: "flows", epoch, exp, uep? }` (`signFlowsSession`, `flows-auth.js:157-161`) |
| Lifetime | 30 days (`lab-sign-in.js:1`, cookie `Max-Age` `worker.js:2824`) | 14 days (`FLOWS_SESSION_TTL_SECONDS`, `flows-auth.js:8`) |
| Signing key | `SESSION_SECRET`, HMAC-SHA256 | the same `SESSION_SECRET` (`worker.js:906-907` and `2640-2641`) |
| Verify | `currentUser` `worker.js:2638` | `currentFlowsUser` `worker.js:904-908` -> `verifyFlowsSession` (`flows-auth.js:163-177`): `aud === "flows"`, `epoch === FLOWS_SESSION_EPOCH` (`wrangler.toml:42`), member present, not past `until`, `uep` equals the member's epoch |
| Revocation | expiry, or rotating `SESSION_SECRET` (no server-side list) | bump `FLOWS_SESSION_EPOCH` (needs a deploy), end or re-epoch one member (secret update, no deploy), or rotate `SESSION_SECRET` |
| Anonymous behaviour | learning routes answer JSON 401; `/api/bootstrap` and `/api/me` answer 200 with `user: null` | `/flows/<page>/` answers the login page with HTTP 200 (:3428-3442); `/api/flows/*` 401 (:3605); `/api/rt/*` has its own order |
| Sign-out | `POST /auth/logout` (:2836) | `POST /flows/logout` (:3387) |
| Mutation fence | `X-IEWT-Owner` plus `X-IEWT-Generation` | no owner or generation header; `POST /flows/login` and `POST /flows/logout` check same-origin (`worker.js:3352`, `:3389`); Flows data writes go through bearer-token ingest; `POST /api/flows/ask` is gated by the Flows cookie alone (`askQuestion`, `worker.js:1864-1876`, has no same-origin check) |
| Throttle | none | 8 failures (`LOCKOUT.maxFailures`, `flows-auth.js:186`) inside a 15-minute window counted from the first failure lock the `bucket\|address` key until that window ends; `isLocked` (`flows-auth.js:191-196`) reads only `maxFailures` and `windowSeconds`, and `lockSeconds` (`:188`) is read nowhere; D1 `flows_login_failures`, `worker.js:2600-2636` |

The audiences cannot be swapped: a Flows token placed in the `session` cookie fails `isLearnAudience` (`aud` is `"flows"`), and a Lab token placed in `flows_session` fails `payload.aud !== FLOWS_AUDIENCE` (`flows-auth.js:165`). Legacy Lab tokens with no `aud` still verify (the regression suite signs its test session without one, `worker-regression.mjs:458`).

#### 2.3a Hop list: Flows member sign-in (the other session)

1. An anonymous visitor to `/flows/login/` or any of the 14 `FLOWS_ROUTES` pages gets `FLOWS_PAGES.loginPage()` with HTTP 200 (`worker.js:3342-3348`, `:3428-3442`); no redirect.
2. The form POSTs to `/flows/login` (`worker.js:3350`): `requireMethod(POST)` :3351, `requireSameOrigin` :3352, `SESSION_SECRET` present else 503 `unavailable` :3353.
3. `parseCredentials(env.FLOWS_CREDENTIALS)` :3355 (`flows-auth.js:99-102`) and a non-empty `FLOWS_PEPPER`, else 503 `unavailable` :3357-3359.
4. `readFlowsForm` :3360 (`worker.js:910-913`, body capped at 4,096 bytes by `readBounded`); username trimmed and lower-cased :3361; password :3362.
5. Throttle: `flowsThrottleKey` :3364 (`worker.js:2600-2602`: the name when it is in the hard-coded `FLOWS_USERNAMES` list, `flows-auth.js:10-14`, else the shared `*` bucket, joined with the `CF-Connecting-IP` address as `bucket|address`), `flowsLockRecord` :3365, `isLocked` :3366; a lock answers `flowsLoginResponse` (:3367; `worker.js:915-921`), which is an HTML login page with HTTP 401.
6. `verifyCredential` :3370 (`flows-auth.js:137-148`): `deriveHash` (:31-42) is PBKDF2-SHA-256, 10,000 iterations (`PBKDF2_ITERATIONS` :7), salt `flows:<username>`, key material `password + NUL + pepper`; an unknown name is hashed against a decoy; `timingSafeEqual`; the member must still be active (`until`).
7. Failure: `recordFlowsFailure` :3373, then the 401 login page "Those credentials were not recognised." :3374.
8. Success: `clearFlowsFailures` :3377 (skipped for the shared bucket), `signFlowsSession` :3378-3381 (claims in 2.3), then `303 /flows/` with `flows_session`, `Max-Age` 1,209,600 (14 days) :3382-3384.
9. Next request: `currentFlowsUser` (`worker.js:904-908`) verifies the cookie against the live member list on every call; `POST /flows/logout` (:3387-3391) clears it with a 303.

#### 2.4 Sign-out and the CSRF rule

1. `Auth.signOut` (`auth.js:813-836`) returns false unless `backend`, `user` and not `resetting`; it sends `POST /auth/logout` with `X-IEWT-Owner: <user.id>` (:819-822).
2. `/auth/logout` (`worker.js:2836-2846`): `requireMethod(POST)` (:2837), `requireSessionSecret` (:2838), `requireSameOrigin` (:2839), `currentUser` (:2840), and only when a valid session exists `requireMutationOwner` (:2842). Then `json({ ok: true }, 200, { "Set-Cookie": cookie("session", "", { maxAge: 0 }) })` (:2843-2845). The cookie is cleared after every check passed.
3. `requireSameOrigin` (`worker.js:183-200`): an `Origin` header, when present, must equal the request origin, and `Sec-Fetch-Site`, when present, must be `same-origin`, else 403 `forbidden`; absent headers pass. `requireMutationOwner` (:202-206): `X-IEWT-Owner` must equal `user.id`, else 409 `account_changed`.
4. The rule: sign-out is POST only. A GET answers JSON 405 with `Allow: POST` and changes nothing, so a cross-site image or link cannot force a sign-out (`DEPLOY.md:194-203` is the production probe). Do not restore a GET route.
5. Client after success (`auth.js:823-827`): `user = null`, `store.bindOwner(null, { claimAnonymous: false, announce: true })`, `location.href = "/lab/"`.
6. Contrast: `/flows/logout` (`worker.js:3387-3391`) is POST plus same-origin but reads no session and needs no owner header.
7. Tests: `worker-regression.mjs:454-479` (GET 405 with `Allow: POST`, cross-origin POST 403, stale-owner POST 409, success clears `session` with `Max-Age=0`).

#### 2.5 What a sign-in feeds besides the cookie

`users.created_at`, `users.signed_in_at` and the Lab write timestamps are the only evidence the Google OAuth client is still in use. `readLabActiveAt` (`lab-sign-in.js:33-43`) takes the newest of four `MAX()` reads (`LAB_ACTIVITY`, :26-31): `users.created_at` and `users.signed_in_at` exactly as stored (`lagMs` 0), and `stats.updated_at` and `progress.updated_at` each less `LAB_SESSION_MS`, 30 days (`lagMs`), because a write can land up to one session after the sign-in that made it (`flows-live-contract.mjs:2836-2840` and `flows-worker-contract.mjs:2025-2032` pin both). `serveIngestClock` (`flows-live-worker.js:845-855`) adds it as `labActiveAt` only for the nightly credential (`worker.js:3508-3511`, `lab: tokenKind === "nightly"`). The nightly health gate `labCheck` (`scripts/flows-legs/health.mjs:336-363`) compares it with `LAB_SIGN_IN = { warnDays: 120, failDays: 150, goneDays: 180 }` (:328); from 150 days the nightly run turns red, which emails the owner (DEPLOY.md owner action 4, `DEPLOY.md:457-491`). So the Lab sign-in path is also an input to the Flows nightly.

#### 2.6 Traps (flow B)

- T-B1. `redirect_uri` is `url.origin + "/auth/callback"` (:2772, :2800). Every origin that serves `/auth/google` must have its own callback registered with Google; production is `https://anilkaya.org/auth/callback` (`DEPLOY.md:123-129`). A `www` or preview host that reached the Worker would fail Google's redirect check unless registered separately.
- T-B2. `users` is never created at runtime (only `schema.sql` / `0001_baseline.sql` create it), so a database without it turns every sign-in into `/lab/?auth=error` (12-config-infra trap 8).
- T-B3. One `SESSION_SECRET` signs both cookie families (:906, :2640); rotating it ends all Lab and Flows sessions at once.
- T-B4. `flows-live-contract.mjs:2841-2846` scans the callback's source text: `exp: Date.now() + LAB_SESSION_MS }`, `cookie("session", session, { maxAge: LAB_SESSION_MS / 1000 })`, `await recordSignIn(env.DB, user, Date.now());` must stay, and the text `INSERT INTO users` must not appear in `worker.js`.
- T-B5. The suite never completes a Google round trip. `worker-regression.mjs:444-452` asserts the 302 to Google with `oauth_state` and that a wrong state yields `/lab/?auth=error`; the token exchange and the success cookie are covered only by the source-text scan (T-B4). The upsert and `labActiveAt` are exercised against the real `users` table by `flows-worker-contract.mjs:2020-2062`.
- T-B6. Google deletes OAuth clients unused for about six months (DEPLOY.md owner action 4); replacing one means `wrangler secret put GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID` and `GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET` (`DEPLOY.md:480-482`).

### 3. Learning progress sync (flow C)

#### 3.1 State on each side

Browser (only `assets/js/storage.js`, and the generated bundle that embeds it, may say `localStorage`: `contracts.mjs:356-360`; key names `storage.js:6-24`; 16 names). The owner part is `encodeURIComponent("user:<id>")` or `anonymous`.

| Kind | Key | Content | Cleared by `resetLearning` (`storage.js:548-575`) |
|---|---|---|---|
| progress (legacy, index based) | `iewt:progress:v2:<owner>` | `{ course: { done: [stage index] } }` | yes |
| stable progress | `iewt:progress:v3:<owner>` | `{ course: { done: [stage id] } }` | yes |
| gamify | `iewt:gamify:v2:<owner>` | `{ points, streak, last }` | yes |
| review mastery plus outbox | `iewt:mastery:v2:<owner>`, `iewt:mastery-outbox:v2:<owner>` | per item record; pending attempts (at most 500) | yes |
| skill mastery plus outbox | `iewt:skill-mastery:v3:<owner>`, `iewt:skill-outbox:v3:<owner>` | per skill record; pending attempts | yes |
| placement | `iewt:placement:v2:<owner>` | 5-field summary or null | yes |
| projects | `iewt:projects:v3:<owner>` | `{ id: { mode, done } }` | yes |
| preferences | `iewt:preferences:v3:<owner>` | path, session minutes, weekly goal | no |
| sync generation | `iewt:sync:v2:<owner>` | `{ version: 2, owner, generation }` | rewritten to the new generation |
| active owner | `iewt:activeOwner` | `anonymous` or `user:<id>`, cross-tab marker | no |
| guide width | `iewt:guideW` (legacy `iewt:splitW`) | percent 25-72 | no |
| anonymous mirrors | `iewt:progress`, `iewt:gamify` | raw JSON of the anonymous v2 values | yes (anonymous) |

Server (D1 `iewt`, see 91a-state-storage): `users`, `learning_sync` (per-owner generation), `progress`, `stats`, `mastery`, `mastery_attempts`, `placement`, `progress_v3`, `skill_mastery`, `skill_attempts`, `learning_preferences`, `project_progress`. `DELETE /api/progress` clears eight of them and zeroes `stats`; it leaves `users` and `learning_preferences` (`worker.js:3051-3070`).

#### 3.2 Sequence diagram: hydrate, write, reset, stale write

```text
Page(lab-*.js)    Auth (auth.js)                 IEWTStorage                Worker route()                         D1 (DB.batch)

 │                  │──(2) GET /api/v2/bootstrap  Accept json, no owner header──►│ 2867 currentUser; null -> {user:null}
 │                  │                                │                           │ requireReadOwnerIfPresent 2872     │
 │                  │                                │                           │──(3) one batch, 11 statements─────►│ [0] INSERT learning_sync(gen 0) DO NOTHING

#### 3.3 Hop list: hydration on page load

1. Bundle load: the `Auth` IIFE snapshots `bootAnonymousProgress`, `bootAnonymousGamify`, `bootAnonymousStableProgress` (`auth.js:9-11`) and ends with `window.Auth = Object.freeze(Auth); void init();` (:998-999). `lab-suite.bundle.js` embeds `auth.js` verbatim (flow D). The placement page loads `storage.js` and `auth.js` directly, without the bundle (`lab/placement/index.html:34-35`).
2. `init` (`auth.js:954`): status `checking`; `initialPayload` (:927-952) tries `GET /api/v2/bootstrap` (no owner header), on 404 or 405 `GET /api/bootstrap`, then `GET /api/me`; any other error rethrows to the offline path. The legacy `/api/bootstrap` (`worker.js:3024-3032`) is the same route logic with `loadBootstrapSnapshot` (:882-884, `runBootstrapBatch(academy=false)`, the 6 legacy statements): no `stableProgress`, `skillMastery`, `preferences` or `projects`. Both bootstrap routes answer `{ user: null }` with HTTP 200 for an anonymous caller (:2871, :3028) and a 503 `service_unavailable` when `SESSION_SECRET` is unset.
3. Worker `/api/v2/bootstrap` (`worker.js:2867-2875`): `requireMethod`, `requireSessionSecret`, `currentUser`, `{ user: null }` when anonymous, `requireReadOwnerIfPresent` (:208-213; a present but different `X-IEWT-Owner` is 409), `loadAcademyBootstrapSnapshot` (:886-902) -> `runBootstrapBatch(academy=true)` (:829-859) -> `academyBatch` (:426) -> `placementBatch` (:411) -> `masteryBatch` (:395) -> `learningBatch` (:354-372).
4. `learningBatch` runs one `DB.batch([INSERT INTO learning_sync (user_id, generation) VALUES (?, 0) ON CONFLICT(user_id) DO NOTHING, ...statements])` (:354-361). Each wrapper catches only its own "no such table" or "no such column last_day" error, creates the object from the inline DDL (`worker.js:50-97`) and reruns the same batch once (`D1.batch` is atomic, so nothing applies twice).
5. The 11 statements (6 in `bootstrapLegacyStatements` :806-818, 4 in `bootstrapAcademyStatements` :820-827, plus the ensure row) return `results[1]` derived points, `[2]` generation, `[3]` progress, `[4]` stats, `[5]` mastery, `[6]` placement, `[7]` stable stages, `[8]` skills, `[9]` preferences, `[10]` projects (parse at :834-846 and :886-902). A malformed stored `stats.last` is healed once with an UPDATE and a second batch (:847-857).
6. Response `json(snapshot, 200, generationHeaders(g))` (:2874): `{ user, progress, stats, mastery, placement, generation, stableProgress, skillMastery, preferences, projects }` plus `X-IEWT-Generation`. `stableProgress` is `progress_v3` rows unioned with the legacy index progress projected to stage ids; `skillMastery` merges stored skill rows with review mastery projected through `REVIEW_ITEM_BY_ID[...].skillIds`.
7. Client binding (`auth.js:960-968`): validate the payload shape, set `user`, `accountScopeExisted = store.hasOwnerState(user.id)` (:967, taken BEFORE binding), `store.bindOwner(user.id, { claimAnonymous: true, announce: true })` (:968). `bindOwner` (`storage.js:349-399`) moves the 10 anonymous kinds into the owner scope only when the owner scope has no state, then writes `iewt:activeOwner` and emits `iewt:owner-changed`.
8. `pullAll(mutationEpoch, user.id, payload)` (:970-971) runs inside `enqueue` (:396-397):
   a. progress (:402-432): `acceptGeneration` (:407; `replaceStaleGeneration` :125-145); union of local and remote indexes per course (:411-416); `store.setProgress`; parallel `PUT /api/progress` for each model where local holds indexes the server lacks (:418-426).
   b. stats (:434-461): `Gamify.merge(remote, { progressComplete })`; `PUT /api/stats {streak,last}` only when local and remote differ (:452).
   c. mastery (:463-478): `store.setMastery(remote)` (the server record replaces the local one), then `flushMasteryOutbox` (:371-394), sequential replay.
   d. placement (:480-506): `PUT /api/placement` with the local summary when there is no remote or `local.completedDay >= remote.completedDay`, otherwise adopt the remote value.
   e. `pullAcademyState` (:293-369; without `stableProgress` in the payload, as from the legacy `/api/bootstrap`, it returns four false flags at :294 and does nothing, which makes `pullAll` resolve false): sequential `PUT /api/v2/progress` per local-only stage id (:301-310); skill mastery replaced by the server copy then `flushSkillOutbox` (:317-324); preferences adopted from the server if `accountScopeExisted`, otherwise the local value is PUT (:326-335); projects unioned and PUT where they differ (:341-366).
9. `iewt:synced` is emitted (:510), status `ready`, `resolveReady()`, `iewt:auth-ready` (:973-982). An exception anywhere in `init` sets `backend = false`, rebinds the anonymous owner and status `offline` (:974-979); the page keeps working on local state.

#### 3.4 Hop list: completing a stage

1. `mark(i, originEl)` (`lab-course.js:84`): returns if the index is already done (:86); adds the index (:87); `store.setProgress` (:88); `paintProgress`, `paintNext`; points come from the generated `COURSE_STAGE_POINTS[topic.id][i]`, else the authored `points`, else the type default (:91-95); `Gamify.award(pts)` (:96); `Auth.pushProgress(topic.id, [...d])` (:100); `Auth.pushStableProgress(topic.id, stages[i].id)` (:101).
2. `Gamify.award` (`gamify.js:41-60`): points are recomputed as `max(derivedPoints(), remotePointFloor)` from the local progress and the generated manifest (`gamify.js:13-26`), the day streak is advanced, the state is written, and `Auth.pushStats(s)` is called (:58).
3. `pushProgress` (`auth.js:837-863`): waits for `ready` when status is `checking` or `syncing`; returns false without a backend or user or while resetting; `mergeLocalProgress` (:164); emits `iewt:synced {local:true}`; `enqueue`.
4. `enqueue` (`auth.js:108-113`) chains every server mutation on one promise (`mutationTail`), so mutations are strictly serialized. `current(owner, epoch)` (:115-118) is checked after every await: same epoch, same user, `store.ownerMatches(owner)`, not resetting.
5. `putJSON` (`auth.js:85-93`): `PUT` with `Content-Type: application/json`, `Accept`, `X-IEWT-Owner: <owner>` and `X-IEWT-Generation: <store.syncGeneration(owner)>`. The body never contains points.
6. Worker `/api/progress` (`worker.js:3034`): `requireMethod` :3035, `requireSessionSecret` :3036, `currentUser` :3037, 401 :3038, `requireSameOrigin` :3046, `requireMutationOwner` :3047, then (the DELETE branch at :3049 returns first) `mutationGeneration` :3085, `readJSON` :3086, `normalizeDone` :3087, `learningBatch` :3090.
7. `mutationGeneration` (`worker.js:723-733`): the header must match `^(0|[1-9]\d*)$`; missing or malformed loads the current generation and throws 409 `reset_required` with the generation in body and `X-IEWT-Generation`.
8. `readJSON` (`worker.js:255-272`): `application/json` only (415), a body (400), at most 16 KiB (`MAX_JSON_BYTES` :47, 413 via `readBounded` :229-253), a non-array object (400). `normalizeDone` (:274-285): `model` must be a key of `COURSE_STAGE_POINTS`, at most the course's stage count, every entry an integer inside the range; otherwise 400 `invalid_progress`.
9. The write (:3091-3110): `INSERT INTO progress ... SELECT ?, ?, json(?), ? WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM learning_sync WHERE user_id=? AND generation=?) ON CONFLICT(user_id, model_id) DO UPDATE SET done_json = <distinct union of old and new integers below the course length, sorted>, updated_at = MAX(old, new) RETURNING done_json`, then `SELECT generation FROM learning_sync`. The union is done in SQL, so concurrent snapshots from two devices cannot delete completed stages.
10. Verification (:3112-3114): no returned row, or a generation different from the request's, throws `reset_required` with the current generation. Success is `json({ ok: true, done: merged, generation }, 200, generationHeaders(g))` (:3117).
11. `pushStableProgress` (`auth.js:865-892`) writes the stage id into the local stable envelope first, even when signed out (:869-875), then `PUT /api/v2/progress {courseId, stageId, complete: true}` (:2877-2912). The Worker validates `STAGE_KEY_BY_COURSE["<course>:<stage>"]` (:2886-2888), then one `academyBatch`: upsert `progress_v3` keeping `MIN(completed_at)`; union the stage's flattened `index` into legacy `progress.done_json` bounded by `COURSE_STAGE_POINTS[course].length`; `SELECT generation`; `SELECT` the course's stable rows (:2890-2909). Both RETURNING rows and the generation are verified (:2910-2911).

#### 3.5 Result-index offset and the fence

`learningBatch` always prepends the ensure-row INSERT (`worker.js:357-361`), so statement N of a builder is `results[N+1]`. Every consumer depends on it.

| Route | Wrapper | Statements (builder order) | Reads |
|---|---|---|---|
| `PUT /api/progress` | learningBatch | upsert, SELECT generation | written `results[1]`, generation `[2]` (:3112-3113) |
| `PUT /api/stats` | learningBatch | upsert (CASE merge keeps the newer activity) | `results[1]` (:3165), then `loadStatsSnapshot` (:765) and a generation compare (:3167-3168) |
| `PUT /api/placement` | placementBatch | upsert (newer `completed_day` wins) | `results[1]` (:3235), then `loadPlacementSnapshot` |
| `DELETE /api/placement` | placementBatch | `DELETE ... AND EXISTS(gen)`, SELECT generation | generation `[2]` (:3207) |
| `PUT /api/mastery` | masteryBatch | attempt insert, mastery upsert, mark applied, SELECT mastery, SELECT generation, SELECT attempt, prune | `[1]` duplicate flag, `[4]` record, `[5]` generation, `[6]` attempt (:3324-3333) |
| `PUT /api/v2/progress` | academyBatch | `progress_v3` upsert, `progress` union, SELECT generation, SELECT rows | `[1]`, `[2]`, generation `[3]`, rows `[4]` (:2910-2912) |
| `PUT /api/v2/attempt` | academyBatch | same shape as mastery | generation `[5]`, attempt `[6]` (:2962-2966) |
| `PUT /api/v2/preferences`, `/project` | academyBatch | upsert, SELECT generation | `[1]`, generation `[2]` (:2991-2992, :3018-3019) |
| `DELETE /api/progress` | academyBatch | generation bump RETURNING, 8 deletes, stats zero | new generation from `[1]` (:3071) |

Every write carries `WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM learning_sync WHERE user_id=? AND generation=?)`. A reset raises the generation, so a delayed write from before the reset inserts nothing and gets 409; a reset cannot be undone by a late upload. A GET snapshot also runs the ensure-row INSERT, so every learning read is a write statement.

#### 3.6 Derived points

Points are never accepted from a client: `PUT /api/progress` carries `{model, done}`, `PUT /api/stats` carries `{streak, last}` only. The server computes them on every read: `derivedPointsSelectStatement` (`worker.js:752-763`) joins `json_each(JSON.stringify(COURSE_STAGE_POINTS))` with `json_each(progress.done_json)` for the user and sums the weights of distinct (course, index) pairs. It runs inside `loadStatsSnapshot` (:765-804) and as the first bootstrap statement (:808). `stats.points` is a vestigial column (insert sets 0, :3141; reset sets 0, :3067). The browser mirrors it: `Gamify.read` (`gamify.js:28-37`) rewrites stored points to `max(derived, remotePointFloor)` on every read. A new course scores 0 on the server until the regenerated `shared/course-points.js` is deployed (flow D).

#### 3.7 Reset

1. `lab-ui.js:113` -> `openResetDialog` (:314) -> `confirmReset` (:330) -> `Auth.resetProgress()` (:343).
2. `resetProgress` (`auth.js:523-586`): `await ready`; single-flight `resetPromise`; `epoch = ++mutationEpoch`; `resetting = true` (new attempts throw "Learning data is being reset", e.g. `auth.js:590`); status `resetting`.
3. Signed in: inside `enqueue`, `current(owner, epoch, true)` (:537), then `DELETE /api/progress` with `X-IEWT-Owner` only (`auth.js:95-99`; reset needs no generation).
4. Worker (`worker.js:3049-3083`): one `academyBatch`: `INSERT INTO learning_sync ... generation = CASE WHEN generation < MAX_SYNC_GENERATION THEN generation+1 ELSE NULL END RETURNING generation` (the NOT NULL violation at the cap fails the batch rather than wrapping); `DELETE` from `progress`, `mastery`, `mastery_attempts`, `placement`, `progress_v3`, `skill_mastery`, `skill_attempts`, `project_progress`; upsert `stats` to 0/0/NULL. `learning_preferences` and `users` are untouched. Response: `{ ok, progress: {}, stats: {0,0,null}, mastery: {}, stableProgress: {}, skillMastery: {}, projects: {}, placement: null, generation }`.
5. Client (`auth.js:538-549`): `payloadGeneration`, `store.resetLearning(owner, { generation, announce: active })`, `Gamify.reset({ storageAlreadyCleared: true })`, events `iewt:progress-reset` and `iewt:synced {reset:true}`, status `ready`.
6. Signed out: local reset only (`auth.js:557-572`). Failure: the wrapped error "Nothing was removed from this device" (`auth.js:516-521`, thrown at :575-581), local data intact, dialog open with the message (`lab-ui.js:350-357`).
7. Tests: `worker-regression.mjs:894-1005` (pre-reset writes fenced with 409, each reset advances the generation by exactly one, another user untouched, `learning_preferences` preserved at :939); `contracts.mjs:602-769` (client reset, failed server reset keeps local data, owner switch during reset).

#### 3.8 Review and skill attempts: idempotency

1. `recordMasteryAttempt(itemId, options)` (`auth.js:588-634`): waits for `ready`, throws while resetting, validates the item id and booleans, takes `attemptId` from the caller (the review page mints a UUID once per submission, `lab-review.js:31-35, 493`, and `persistPending` `:419` retries with it) or `newAttemptId()` (:196), applies `MasteryScheduler.apply` locally, `store.queueMasteryAttempt(event)` (the outbox), emits `iewt:mastery-state {synced:false}`.
2. Signed in: `enqueue` -> `PUT /api/mastery {itemId, attemptId, correct, hinted, day}` with the stored generation; on success the server record replaces the local one and `store.removeMasteryAttempt(attemptId)` runs; on failure the event stays in the outbox and the UI retries with the SAME attempt id.
3. Worker (`worker.js:3245-3335`): validates `itemId` against `REVIEW_ITEM_BY_ID`, `attemptId` against `^[A-Za-z0-9._:-]{1,128}$`, booleans, `day` via `normalizeActivityDay` (not beyond UTC today plus one day). One `masteryBatch` of 7 statements: (a) `INSERT INTO mastery_attempts ... WHERE EXISTS(gen) ON CONFLICT(user_id, attempt_id) DO NOTHING RETURNING` (:3274-3280); (b) the `mastery` upsert guarded by `WHERE EXISTS (attempt row with applied=0)`: level rule wrong -> 0, hinted -> `MIN(level,1)`, clean -> `MIN(5, level+1)`, due +1/3/7/21/60 days, an out-of-order day (`excluded.last_day < last_day`) leaves level and due day alone; (c) `UPDATE mastery_attempts SET applied=1`; (d) read back; (e) generation; (f) read the attempt row; (g) delete this user's ledger rows older than 48 hours (`ATTEMPT_LEDGER_TTL_MS` :127).
4. Outcome (:3324-3334): generation mismatch -> 409 `reset_required`; the stored attempt row differing in item, correctness, hint flag or day -> 409 `attempt_conflict`; otherwise `{ ok, record, duplicate: !results[1].results[0], generation }`. A replay of the same id returns the current record with `duplicate: true` and no counter change.
5. The skill path is the same shape: `recordSkillAttempt` (`auth.js:636-678`) -> `PUT /api/v2/attempt` (`worker.js:2915-2970`) with `skill_attempts` / `skill_mastery`; different rule (wrong -> level-1, hinted-correct -> level unchanged).
6. Replay after an outage: `flushMasteryOutbox` and `flushSkillOutbox` (`auth.js:371-394`, `258-279`) run during `pullAll`, in order; `isPoison` (:253-256) drops an event that gets a 4xx other than `reset_required`, `invalid_generation`, `stale_generation`.
7. Tests: `worker-regression.mjs:668-691` (duplicate flag, `attempt_conflict`), `:738-739` (concurrent retry applied once), `:746-770` (stable progress and skill attempts), `:776-806` (out-of-order days), `mastery-contract.mjs:19-20`, `academy-contract.mjs` (browser and server scheduler parity).

#### 3.9 Placement

1. `placement.js` (loaded with `storage.js` and `auth.js` only, `lab/placement/index.html:34-36`) grades 15 answers in the browser; `finishDiagnostic` (:686) -> `persistResult` (:268-290) -> `Auth.savePlacement` (`auth.js:736-766`).
2. `savePlacement` writes the 5-field summary locally (`store.setPlacement`) and emits `iewt:placement-state {synced:false}`; signed in, it `enqueue`s `PUT /api/placement` with the stored generation.
3. Worker (`worker.js:3182-3243`): `normalizePlacement` (:308-318) accepts only `total === 15`, an integer score 0-15, `band` equal to the score band (<=6 foundation, <=11 applied, else advanced), a valid `completedDay`, and `recommendedTopic` among the seven legacy course ids (`PLACEMENT_TOPICS` :306). The upsert keeps the newer `completed_day` per column (:3222-3229) and is generation-fenced. Individual answers never leave the browser.
4. `DELETE /api/placement` requires owner and generation (:3194-3196) and deletes only when the generation matches.
5. During `pullAll`, the local summary is uploaded only if it is not older than the remote one (`auth.js:490-498`).

#### 3.10 Error and header contract

| Request header | Where required | Check |
|---|---|---|
| `X-IEWT-Owner` | every PUT and DELETE; optional on GET | `requireMutationOwner` :202 (409 `account_changed`), `requireReadOwnerIfPresent` :208 |
| `X-IEWT-Generation` | every PUT and `DELETE /api/placement`; not `DELETE /api/progress` | `mutationGeneration` :723 (409 `reset_required`) |
| `Origin`, `Sec-Fetch-Site` | PUT, DELETE, `POST /auth/logout`, `POST /flows/login` | `requireSameOrigin` :183 (403 `forbidden`) |
| `Content-Type: application/json` | PUT bodies | `readJSON` :255 (415) |

| Error | Status | Thrown at | Client reaction |
|---|---|---|---|
| `unauthorized` | 401 | each route after `currentUser` | `getJSON` throws with `status` 401; the mutation returns false and emits `iewt:sync-error`; a queued attempt is dropped as poison at the next flush |
| `forbidden` | 403 | :183-200 | same as 401 (4xx outside the three generation codes is poison) |
| `account_changed` | 409 | :202-206 | the mutation fails and a queued attempt is dropped as poison; a stale tab is moved to status `account-changed` when another tab changes `iewt:activeOwner` (`auth.js:986-996`) |
| `reset_required` (body `generation` plus `X-IEWT-Generation`) | 409 | :344-352 | `handleGenerationConflict` (`auth.js:152-158`): a newer generation resets the owner's local state and bumps `mutationEpoch` |
| `attempt_conflict` | 409 | :3328, :2966 | event dropped as poison |
| `invalid_*`, `payload_too_large`, `unsupported_media_type`, `invalid_json` | 400, 413, 415 | validators | event dropped as poison |
| `service_unavailable` | 503 | :215-219 | bootstrap failure -> status `offline`, local mode |

#### 3.11 Tests and traps (flow C)

- Tests: `worker-regression.mjs` (workerd; fresh D1 from `schema.sql` only: owner and generation fences :522-590, placement :636-661, mastery :668-740, v2 :746-870, reset :894-1005); `contracts.mjs:430-820` (vm client harness for storage, gamify, auth against fake fetch); `academy-contract.mjs` and `mastery-contract.mjs` (no server); `placement-contract.mjs` (Chromium, its own Node HTTP server answering the bootstrap routes itself, never loads `worker.js`); `regression.mjs` (Playwright against workerd).
- T-C1. (read, not run) Course-stage skill attempts are rejected. `recordSkills` (`lab-course.js:211-214`) sends `itemId = st.variantId || st.id`, for example `ols-line-04-core` (`generate-course-payloads.mjs:168`). `validSkillItem` (`worker.js:662-668`) accepts `<skillId>:v1`, `:v2`, `:v3`, a `REVIEW_ITEM_BY_ID` key or a `COURSE_STAGE_BY_ID` key; the manifests are keyed `ols:ols-line-04` (`shared/review-manifest.js:2`, `shared/stage-manifest.js:5`), so `ols-line-04-core` matches none. The Worker answers 400 `invalid_skill_attempt`; the event stays in the skill outbox until `flushSkillOutbox` drops it as poison (`auth.js:253-256, 258-279`), and `pullAcademyState` replaces local skill mastery with the server copy (:319). Only challenge-page attempts (`<skill>:v1..v3`) persist; `worker-regression.mjs:755-770` sends only `:v1`.
- T-C2. First sign-in on a browser with no scope for the account PUTs the local preferences over the server's: `accountScopeExisted` is false (`auth.js:967`), so `pullAcademyState` takes the `putJSON("/api/v2/preferences", local)` branch (:326-330); the upsert overwrites (`worker.js:2972-2994`).
- T-C3. (read, not run) Anonymous work claimed on a fresh browser is discarded when the account has ever been reset: `bindOwner` claims it (`auth.js:968`), then `acceptGeneration` (:407) sees a server generation above the local default 0 (`storage.js:104-110`) and `replaceStaleGeneration` calls `resetLearning` on the owner scope (`auth.js:125-145`, `storage.js:548-575`). No test pairs a claim with a server generation above 0 (`contracts.mjs:771-800` seeds an existing scope).
- T-C4. The placement page runs `storage.js` and `auth.js` without `COURSE_STAGE_IDS`, so `cleanStableProgress` returns `{}` and the stored stable-progress envelope is rewritten empty (self-healing from the legacy index on the next bundle page; measured by running `storage.js` in a vm, 21-learning-runtime trap 4).
- T-C5. Reads write: every `store.progress()` style getter rewrites its envelope (`storage.js:420-423`), and every learning GET runs the ensure-row INSERT; a read-only D1 replica would break the routes.
- T-C6. `project.js` and `challenge.js` do not wait for `Auth.whenReady()`, so a signed-in first load can use pre-hydration local state.
- T-C7. AGENTS.md says reset preserves only `iewt:guideW` (`AGENTS.md:266`); source also preserves preferences (`storage.js:548-575`, `worker.js:3051-3070`, `worker-regression.mjs:939`).
- T-C8. Progress is stored by flattened stage index beside stable ids; inserting or reordering stages changes the meaning of stored progress (flow D).

#### 4.4 What to commit after a content change

- The edited source(s).
- Every path git reports from the table in 4.2: `assets/data/courses/**`, `assets/data/{review-bank,challenge-bank,skill-graph}.json`, `assets/js/{review-catalog,stage-catalog,lab-suite.bundle}.js`, `shared/{review-manifest,stage-manifest,skill-manifest,course-points,course-seo}.js`. AGENTS.md (`:208-212`) names only a subset and says `schemaVersion: 1`.
- `assets/version.txt` plus every `?v=` reference, each lab page's `data-asset-version`, and `ASSET_VERSION` in `shared/flows-pages.js:1` (anything under `assets/css`, `assets/js`, `assets/data` changed; `/assets/data/*` is cached one hour by URL, so readers keep stale payloads without a new `?v=`).
- If a count changed: the literals in the generator (:257, :259, :284), `contracts.mjs:153, 177, 212`, `academy-contract.mjs`, `mastery-contract.mjs:20`, `lab/index.html` text, `sitemap.xml`.
- A regeneration that changes nothing needs no bump. DEPLOY.md requires this check before every release: run the generator and `test -z "$(git status --short -- assets/data/courses)"` (`DEPLOY.md:26-28`). No test runs the generator (grep over `tests/` and `.github/` is empty), so that manual check is the only proof that outputs equal sources.

#### 4.5 Traps (flow D)

- T-D1. `stage-id-map-v2.json` is frozen. Renaming a legacy stage title or type, or reordering stages that share a fingerprint (several "Check" quizzes), can hand a frozen id to a different stage and silently remap `progress_v3`; give such a stage an explicit `id`. A new stage in a legacy course has no frozen id and must carry an explicit id.
- T-D2. Progress is stored by flattened stage index (`progress.done_json`, `COURSE_STAGE_POINTS[course][i]`), so only append at the end of the last module or ship a migration.
- T-D3. A gate that throws mid-run (the 6 KiB module gate, :242) leaves earlier module files and `skill-graph.json` already rewritten; fix the source and rerun to completion or `git checkout` the generated paths.
- T-D4. Editing any of the 8 files embedded in `lab-suite.bundle.js` (`course-catalog`, `skill-catalog`, `stage-catalog`, `mastery`, `skill-mastery`, `storage`, `gamify`, `auth`) without rerunning the generator fails `contracts.mjs:294-297`. Never hand-edit a generated file.
- T-D5. The Worker takes new course ids, slugs, points, stage keys, review ids and skills from the regenerated shared modules at the next deploy; a content-only deploy needs no Worker code change. Placement is the exception: it stays on the seven legacy ids (`worker.js:306`, the D1 CHECK in `schema.sql:65`).
- T-D6. `review-catalog.js` must stay answer-free; the banks contain answers and are public static files.
- T-D7. Doc drift: AGENTS.md describes seven courses, four modules, `schemaVersion: 1`, a 14 KiB gzip course cap, 96 review items (`AGENTS.md:131, 199, 210, 232, 763-764`). Source: 12 courses, 365 stages, `schemaVersion: 2`, 6,144 bytes gzip per module (`generate-course-payloads.mjs:242`, `contracts.mjs:150`), five courses with 5 modules, 106 review items.

                                                                                                                  ──► D1: manual `d1 execute --remote --file` (not part of deploy)
                                                                                                                  ──► smoke tests DEPLOY.md:176-291, header readback, rollback :318-346
```

#### 5.2 Hop list

1. Work on a branch; the history is squash-merged pull requests whose subjects end `(#148)`, `(#147)`, ... (`git log --oneline`). Nothing in the repo forbids pushing to `main`; branch protection is dashboard state (external).
2. Local gates (`DEPLOY.md:21-45`, `AGENTS.md:748-790`): Node 22.13 or newer (`tests/package.json:5-7`); regeneration is a no-op; `cd tests && npm ci && npx playwright install chromium && npm test`; `./tests/node_modules/.bin/wrangler deploy --dry-run --outdir /tmp/anilkaya-dry-run`. Agent sandboxes run server suites with `FLOWS_TEST_SANDBOX=1` (`tests/worker-server.mjs:14, 163`).
3. Asset change? Bump `assets/version.txt` and every reference (section 5.5). `contracts.mjs` is link 1 of the chain, so a missed bump fails first.
4. Open a PR: `pull_request` triggers `regression.yml` (:6); `workflow_dispatch` (:7) and a Monday cron `17 6 * * 1` (:8-9) also trigger it; the weekly run exists so a fixture date overtaken by the real clock fails within a week.
5. Job `test` (`regression.yml:19-44`, timeout 40 minutes :21, `contents: read` :11-12, `cancel-in-progress: true` :14-16): checkout with `fetch-depth: 0` and `persist-credentials: false` (:23-26); `setup-node` 22 with the npm cache keyed on `tests/package-lock.json` (:27-31); `npm ci` (:32-34); `npx playwright install --with-deps chromium` (:35-37); `wrangler deploy --dry-run --outdir /tmp/anilkaya-worker-dry-run` validating config, bindings, the DO export and bundling without uploading (:38-39); `npm test` with `ASSET_DIFF_BASE: ${{ github.event.pull_request.base.sha || github.event.before }}` (:40-44).
6. `npm test` is one `&&` chain of 77 `npm run test:*` links on `tests/package.json:9` (81 node processes: `test:flows` runs 4 files, `test:pipeline` 2). It stops at the first failure. Positions: 1 `contracts`, 2 `markets`, 3 `market-ticker`, 4 `flows`, 5 `pipeline` (the dry run plus its contract, about 123 s), 6-7 probes, 12 `mastery`, 13 `academy`, 14 `placement`, 15 `worker` (workerd), 16 `flows-worker`, 17 `flows-rt-server`, 31 `browser` (`regression.mjs`), 40 `flows-live`, 42 `flows-starts`, 77 `flows-reading-render`. A suite that is not in the chain never runs in CI; a new suite needs a `test:<name>` script and an `&& npm run test:<name>` link.
7. The asset gate (`contracts.mjs:921-983`): base = `ASSET_DIFF_BASE`, else `git rev-parse origin/main`, else `HEAD^` when the base is all zeros; if any changed or untracked file matches `^assets/(css|js|data)/` the version must exceed the base's; if any matches `^assets/fonts/` (not `.md` or `.txt`) the fonts token must exceed the base's. With no resolvable base the gate is skipped silently, which is why CI uses `fetch-depth: 0`.
8. Merge to `main`: `push: branches [main]` (`regression.yml:4-5`) reruns the same job with `ASSET_DIFF_BASE = github.event.before`.
9. Deploy (outside the repository, see 5.3). The repo contains no deploy workflow (`grep -rn "wrangler\|CLOUDFLARE\|deploy" .github/workflows` finds only the dry run at `regression.yml:39`).
10. What a deploy ships: the Worker bundle (`main = "worker.js"`, `wrangler.toml:2`, its `shared/` import graph); the static directory (`wrangler.toml:6`, minus `.assetsignore`, `_headers` included); the `[[migrations]]` tag for the Durable Object (section 5.4); the four cron triggers (`wrangler.toml:25-26`); `[vars]` (`wrangler.toml:41-58`); bindings D1 `DB`, `AI`, `UW_ONDEMAND`, `PULSE`. Secrets are separate (`DEPLOY.md:92-130`).
11. Post-deploy checks (section 5.5): smoke tests, header readback, manual Lab checks, dashboard rule inspection.
12. Rollback (section 5.5) with the version-bump rule for the next forward deploy.

#### 5.3 In the repository versus outside it

| Fact | In the repo | Outside (external, unverified here) |
|---|---|---|
| CI gate | `regression.yml` (dry run plus 77-link chain) | whether a failing run blocks a merge (branch protection) |
| Who deploys | nothing: no deploy workflow, `DEPLOY.md:131-163` asks the owner to pick one deployment owner | Cloudflare Workers Builds branch mapping, root directory, install, build and deploy commands, preview behaviour (`AGENTS.md:90-93`, `DEPLOY.md:141-153`, `README.md:182-191`) |
| Build command | none; `wrangler.toml` has no `[build]` and Workers Builds ignores it (commit `4383183` message), so any build command is a dashboard field | the dashboard field itself |
| Preview versus production | not stated. `wrangler.toml` has no `[env]`, no routes, no `workers_dev` key | By Cloudflare's design a Workers Builds build of a non-production branch ends in a version upload (a preview, not a deploy) and a build of the production branch in `wrangler deploy`; this repository neither configures nor verifies it. A preview hostname proves nothing for caches: the Cache API does nothing on `workers.dev` (`DEPLOY.md:1012`), and a preview origin needs its own Google callback (`DEPLOY.md:129`) |
| Manual release | `./tests/node_modules/.bin/wrangler deploy --strict` after the gates; `--strict` refuses to overwrite conflicting remote changes (`DEPLOY.md:154-160`) | the Cloudflare login used |
| Secrets | names and uses (`DEPLOY.md:92-130`, 12-config-infra) | values; a secret added in the dashboard stays dormant until its Deploy button, while `wrangler secret put` deploys at once (`DEPLOY.md:593-613`) |
| Transform Rules | warning only (`AGENTS.md:693-695`) | the rules themselves; the zone `Security Headers` transform no longer wrote a second CSP on 2026-07-15 (`AGENTS.md:101-106`) |

#### 5.4 Migrations

D1 (not applied by `wrangler deploy`):

1. Fresh or local database: `wrangler d1 execute iewt --local --file schema.sql` (`tests/worker-server.mjs:162`, `DEPLOY.md:53-54`). `schema.sql` holds 20 tables; the four AI tables (`flows_ai_usage`, `flows_ai_usage_model`, `flows_ai_summary`, `flows_neuron`) exist only in migrations 0006-0009 and the Worker's inline DDL.
2. Production: apply the one file you need, `wrangler d1 execute iewt --remote --file=./migrations/00NN_*.sql` (`DEPLOY.md:512, 2714`). Never `d1 migrations apply`: `migrations_dir = "migrations"` is configured (`wrangler.toml:20`) but the earlier migrations were applied out of band, so bookkeeping is out of date and `apply` would rerun them (`DEPLOY.md:515-523`). Before any non-idempotent change, inspect with `pragma_table_info` (`DEPLOY.md:58-60`).
3. Non-idempotent `ALTER` migrations: 0003, 0011, 0012, 0013, 0014. Their runtime twins tolerate a duplicate column: `addDayColumn` (`worker.js:382-389`), `upgradeClockColumns` (`flows-live-worker.js:47`), `recordSignIn` (`lab-sign-in.js:11-24`).
4. Inline first-use creation: `learningBatch` / `masteryBatch` / `placementBatch` / `academyBatch` create their tables on "no such table" (`worker.js:354-435`); `ensureFlowsTables` (:2583-2593) waits on `startFlowsSchemaFlight` (:2569-2582), one `DB.batch` of the 12 `FLOWS_SCHEMA_SQL` statements (`worker.js:132-143`: 6 inline, 5 from `LIVE_SCHEMA_SQL`, 1 dossier cache) plus `PRAGMA table_info(flows_clock)` as the last statement (:2572; its result is read at `results[FLOWS_SCHEMA_SQL.length]`, :2573). `users`, `progress`, `stats` are never created at runtime.
5. Three declaration sites per table must agree (`schema.sql`, a numbered migration, the inline DDL). Name-level parity is pinned for 0001, 0002, 0004, 0005, 0010, 0015, 0016 by `academy-contract.mjs:114-120`; a new migration must be added to that union.
6. Order: apply D1 changes before the deploy that needs them when operational access is available; the inline fallbacks make a code rollout independent of a dashboard migration for the learning and Flows tables (`DEPLOY.md:82-85`).

Durable Object:

1. `wrangler.toml:33-35` binds `PULSE` to class `Pulse`; `wrangler.toml:37-39` declares `[[migrations]] tag = "v1"` with `new_sqlite_classes = ["Pulse"]`. The class is defined at `shared/flows-rt-hub.js:854` and re-exported from the Worker entry at `worker.js:38`.
2. `flows-rt-contract.mjs:1438-1442` pins the export, the route hook inside `route()`, the binding text and the migration text. The first real deploy that carries the class applies `v1` (`DEPLOY.md:3017-3018`; `DEPLOY.md:99-100` says to read 10.5n first).
3. Rules held by the repo: never edit `v1` after it has deployed; any rename, deletion or move of the class needs a new `[[migrations]]` tag (12-config-infra trap 15; the transfer-a-class order is in `DEPLOY.md:2985-2996`); `Pulse` must stay exported from `worker.js`.
4. The object is hosted in the same Worker, so a Worker deploy restarts it (`DEPLOY.md:2994-2995` states that moving it to its own Worker is what would stop site deploys from restarting it). It holds memory, hibernating WebSockets and alarms and writes no SQL rows (see 35-rail), so a restart costs a reconnect and a resnapshot, not data.
5. Kill switches are `[vars]` entries (`FLOWS_LIVE_MODE` `wrangler.toml:50`, `FLOWS_RT_MODE` `:55`, `FLOWS_READ_MODE` `:49`), so a change reaches production with a deploy; `DEPLOY.md:2467-2468` calls `FLOWS_LIVE_MODE = "off"` the instant rollback (the deploy requirement is inferred from how `[vars]` work, not stated there).
6. (external, a Cloudflare platform rule the repo relies on but does not state) a migration tag is applied once and in order, and a class cannot change its storage backend afterwards; hence the "new tag, never edit `v1`" rule above.
7. `compatibility_date = "2026-07-08"` (`wrangler.toml:3`) must not exceed the pinned miniflare's `supportedCompatibilityDate` (`contracts.mjs:907-914`), else local suites run on an older runtime than production.

Crons: they register at deploy; four of the five crons a Free account may hold are used (`DEPLOY.md:498-499`, `flows-live-contract.mjs:983-993`). Stale triggers after a deploy are repaired with `wrangler triggers deploy` (`DEPLOY.md:2439-2445`); the handler routes an unknown trigger string by instant (`flows-live-worker.js:75`). Weekdays must be named (`MON-FRI`) because Cloudflare counts 1 as Sunday (`flows-live-contract.mjs:983-993`).

#### 5.5 Post-deploy: header smoke test, asset version ritual, rollback

Header smoke test (mandatory, `AGENTS.md:693-695`; `DEPLOY.md:176-291`):

1. `/api/me`: 200 JSON `user: null` when signed out, `Cache-Control: no-store`, `X-Frame-Options: DENY`, `Cross-Origin-Opener-Policy: same-origin`; protected endpoints return structured JSON 401 (`DEPLOY.md:180-192`).
2. `GET /auth/logout` returns JSON 405 with `Allow: POST` (`DEPLOY.md:194-211`).
3. `/lab/course?m=ols` is a 308; `/lab/ordinary-least-squares/` carries the exact title, canonical, H1 and `id="courseStructuredData"` (`DEPLOY.md:212-226`).
4. Cache and encoding: `curl --compressed` the versioned `base.css` and `cmp` it with the repo file; `Cache-Control: public, max-age=31536000, immutable`; `/` is `no-cache`; the Inter woff2 with the FONTS token is immutable; `/assets/fonts-version.txt` is `public, max-age=3600`; the asset responses carry the three security headers and no CSP (`DEPLOY.md:227-281`). Any byte mismatch or decoding error blocks the release; do not rebuild an asset response from a header dictionary.
5. `curl -fsSI https://anilkaya.org/` and `https://www.anilkaya.org/` to confirm apex and `www` ownership (`DEPLOY.md:282-291`).
6. Then `DEPLOY.md:292-317` manual Lab checks (reset, union across devices, POST logout, `409 reset_required`, D1 rows) and the dashboard Transform Rule inspection (`DEPLOY.md:170-175`).

Asset version ritual (`AGENTS.md:697-747`, enforced by `contracts.mjs:325-355, 921-983`):

1. Any change under `assets/css`, `assets/js` or `assets/data`: increment `assets/version.txt`.
2. Rewrite every local CSS and JS `?v=` in the HTML (`index.html`, `404.html`, `articles/`, `lab/`), `data-asset-version` on the seven shells that carry it (`lab/course.html`, review, placement, challenge, 3 projects), and `ASSET_VERSION` at `shared/flows-pages.js:1` (`tests/flows-features.mjs:846-849` holds it equal). `atmosphere.svg?v=` in `base.css:123` and `flows.css:11` carries the same token but no contract checks it.
3. The 16 woff2 references (8 `@font-face` in `base.css`, 8 Inter preloads) carry `assets/fonts-version.txt` instead. After a bump run `grep -rn 'woff2?v=' --include=*.html --include=*.css .`; every hit must show the fonts token. A blanket `?v=` rewrite or a merge that brings one moves the fonts when the two tokens are equal.
4. A font change: set `assets/fonts-version.txt` to the new asset version, update the 16 references, and bump `assets/version.txt` too (`base.css` changed).
5. The fonts token never exceeds the asset token (`contracts.mjs:329-330`); neither token may be excluded by `.assetsignore` (`contracts.mjs:331-334`).

Rollback (`DEPLOY.md:318-346`): `wrangler versions list`, then `wrangler rollback <VERIFIED_VERSION_ID>`, then rerun the smoke tests. A code rollback does not undo D1 changes or dashboard rules. The first forward deploy after any rollback must bump `assets/version.txt` (and the fonts token if a font was involved) even with no asset change, because the asset layer stores an immutable one-year 404 for a missing css, js or font URL (`worker-regression.mjs:260-267`) and a browser that fetched the newer HTML against the older bundle keeps that 404 at that exact URL.

#### 5.6 Traps (flow E)

- T-E1. Green CI is not a deploy and does not prove Workers Builds waited for it (`DEPLOY.md:152-153`, `README.md:189-191`).
- T-E2. `DEPLOY.md:135-140` recommends a CI-gated deploy job; none exists.
- T-E3. A Workers Builds build command is a dashboard field; `wrangler.toml` `[build]` is ignored (commit `4383183`). `scripts/strip-comments.mjs` stays only for that reason and rewrites `assets/js` in place unless run with `--check` (`AGENTS.md:1077-1079`).
- T-E4. `wrangler.toml` is parsed as text by tests: `run_worker_first`, `html_handling`, the one-line four-cron array, the `PULSE` and `v1` blocks, `FLOWS_RT_MODE`, `FLOWS_RT_AUDIENCE`, `FLOWS_LIVE_MODE` spacing (`contracts.mjs:826, 871`, `flows-live-contract.mjs:983-993`, `flows-rt-contract.mjs:1441-1447`). Reformatting it breaks CI.
- T-E5. Server suites need `FLOWS_TEST_SANDBOX=1` in the agent sandbox or `wrangler dev` hangs on symlink loops; a silent timeout is not an assertion failure. A server suite may not hold an ISO date within the next 400 days unless it is listed in `ANCHORED` (`contracts.mjs:873-905`).
- T-E6. CI wall time is capped at 40 minutes (`regression.yml:21`); `flows-rt-server` alone is about 150 s.
- T-E7. The asset gate asks for a token strictly higher than the base commit's (`contracts.mjs:968-981`), so a PR that touches assets must bump even if the same number was already taken by a merged PR; rerun `contracts.mjs` after every merge or rebase.
- T-E8. `docs/uw-openapi.yaml` is not in `.assetsignore` (only `*.md` is), so it ships in the static bundle (13-docs-runbooks trap 7).
- T-E9. Local OAuth, caches and the rail cannot be proven on a preview host (section 5.3).

### 6. The GitHub Pages / CNAME hybrid (flow F)

1. `CNAME` is one line, `anilkaya.org`, tracked in git (`CNAME:1`). It exists for GitHub Pages' custom-domain setting. The Worker bundle excludes it (`.assetsignore:23`), and `worker-regression.mjs:269-271` requires `/CNAME` to be a 404 on the Worker. `contracts.mjs:1078-1085` requires `.assetsignore` to keep listing it.
2. Last observed state (2026-07-12): the apex serves the Worker; `www.anilkaya.org` was still served by GitHub Pages, which redirected to the apex (`AGENTS.md:96-99`, `DEPLOY.md:164-169`, `README.md:29-32`). This is a snapshot; the repo cannot prove the present state. The AGENTS.md rule: keep `CNAME` until `www` is attached to the Worker and its redirect is verified.
3. What the repo can show: no Pages workflow exists (`.github/workflows/` holds five files, none Pages), and no Pages configuration file. The root `index.html` and `404.html` are plain static files and valid on either host, but a Pages publish of the repo root would serve them without the Worker: no `_headers`, no API, no HTMLRewriter. Whether Pages still publishes is dashboard state (external).
4. Verification commands: `curl -fsSI https://anilkaya.org/` and `curl -fsSI https://www.anilkaya.org/` (`DEPLOY.md:282-289`); README step 5 repeats it (`README.md:186`).
5. What breaks if `www` served the Worker without redirecting: the OAuth `redirect_uri` is built from the request origin (`worker.js:2772`), and Google only knows the apex callback (`DEPLOY.md:123-129`); cookies are host-only (`session.js:59-63`), so a `www` visit would have its own cookie jar and its own `localStorage` origin; the CSP `connect-src` names only `wss://anilkaya.org` (`worker.js:111`); canonical URLs, JSON-LD and the sitemap are written with the apex `SITE_ORIGIN` (`shared/course-seo.js:1`). `www` is therefore a redirect, not a second origin.
6. Removal checklist for `CNAME`: attach `www` to the Worker (dashboard), verify the redirect to the apex from `www` over HTTPS, update the AGENTS.md and DEPLOY.md paragraphs, then delete `CNAME` (the `.assetsignore` pin in `contracts.mjs:1078-1085` and the 404 check in `worker-regression.mjs:269` would need to change with it).

### 7. Cross-flow couplings and disagreements between documents and source

| Coupling | Flows | Where it bites |
|---|---|---|
| The asset version string is read by the Worker | A, D, E | `renderCourse` copies `data-asset-version` into the preload `?v=` (`worker.js:2725-2730`); `lab-course.js:32-33` builds the same URL; a mismatch loses the preload (`worker-regression.mjs:366-380`) |
| `lab-suite.bundle.js` embeds `auth.js` and `storage.js` | C, D, E | editing either without the generator fails `contracts.mjs:294-297`; the placement page loads them unbundled (`lab/placement/index.html:34-35`) |
| Generated manifests are Worker allowlists | C, D | `COURSE_STAGE_POINTS`, `STAGE_KEY_BY_COURSE`, `REVIEW_ITEM_BY_ID`, `SKILL_BY_ID` decide what `/api/progress`, `/api/v2/*`, `/api/mastery` accept (`worker.js:14-18, 100`) |
| `SESSION_SECRET` signs both cookie families | B, flows | rotating it signs everybody out (section 2.6) |
| `users` / `progress` / `stats` writes feed `labActiveAt` | B, C, nightly | the nightly health gate reads sign-in recency (section 2.5) |
| `_headers` equals `SECURITY_HEADERS` | A, E | edit both together (`contracts.mjs:826-870`); live readback after deploy |
| Cron strings in `wrangler.toml` equal the constants in `flows-live-worker.js:70-73` | E | `flows-live-contract.mjs:983-993` |
| Course slugs share `/lab/<x>/` with static pages | A, D | a slug equal to `review`, `placement`, `challenge` or `projects` would be served by `renderCourse` instead of the static page (`worker.js:3904-3912`); `course` and `lesson` would meet the legacy redirect first (`worker.js:3897`) |

| Tier 1 | Worker `scheduled()` -> `rthTick` and `focusTick` (`worker.js:3959-3970`) | cron `1-59/5 13-21 * * MON-FRI` and `3-58/5 13-21 * * MON-FRI` (`wrangler.toml:26`) | none (D1 binding, `UW_API_KEY` secret) | `live:market` (writer `worker@tier1`), `live:focus` (`worker@focus`), `flows_clock`, `flows_ledger` | `market` 300/660/1500 s | 2 + 1 per tick |
| Tier 2 | GitHub Actions job `live`, `node scripts/flows-pipeline.mjs --live` (`flows-live.yml:64-121`) | Worker dispatch at :01/:16/:31/:46 and watchdog; the previous hop's chain; 32 GitHub crons; humans | GitHub OIDC JWT, kind `live`, verified against GitHub's JWKS (`flows-oidc.js:121`) | ten `live:*` keys (`LIVE_KEYS` writer `actions`) | `breadth` 900/1200/2700 s | 37 to 41 per pass (`LIVE_BUDGET.tier2MaxCalls` 48 is a test ceiling) |

On-demand reads (`flows_tape` rows, the quote card, the chain) and the real-time rail (`Pulse` Durable Object, see 35-rail) are the other two sources a reader meets. They use classes `tape`, `quote` and `rt`/`rtSlow`/`rtNews` of the same table (`flows-freshness.js:3-12`). Line numbers are at `ba2acfe`; "see NN-area" names the area part with the detail; where source and docs disagree the source is used and the difference sits in section 8.

### 2. Path (a): the nightly pipeline

#### 2.1 Dispatch: three starters, one workflow

1. GitHub schedule. Four crons (`flows-pipeline.yml:5-8`). The gate step (`:49-74`) reads `TZ=America/New_York date +%Z`; it admits `30 21 * * 1-5` only in EDT (`:62`), `30 22 * * 1-5` only in EST (`:65`), both backup crons (`:68`) and any event that is not a schedule (`:59`); the other zone's primary sets `run=false` (`:71-73`).
2. Worker clock. `scheduled()` (`worker.js:3950`) gets `housekeeping` from `cronJob` for `*/30 * * * *` (`flows-live-worker.js:75-79`; the explicit `rth`, `focus`, `summary` branches return first at `worker.js:3959-3976`), runs `refreshMarketSnapshotIfDue` (`:3978`), then `ensureFlowsTables` (`:3981`, defined `:2583`) and `FLOWS_LIVE.nightlyTick(env, at)` (`:3982`).
3. `nightlyTick` (`flows-live-worker.js:554`):
   1. `liveMode(env) === "off"` returns `{skipped:"off"}` (`:555`, `:366-369`).
   2. One D1 batch reads `flows_clock` and `meta.sessionDate` (`:556-559`).
   3. `nightlyDispatchDue(at, clock, metaSession)` (`flows-freshness.js:419-433`): trading day, minutes at least 1035, `metaSession < today`; first send `why:"window"`; with `nightly_day == today`, minutes at least 1095 (18:15) and no `nightlyRedispatchedAt`, one `redispatch:true`; otherwise `dispatched` or `landed`.
   4. From close + 300 min (21:00 ET) with `meta` still behind it logs `nightly missing` (`:566-569`, `NIGHTLY_MISSING_AFTER_MIN` `:92`).
   5. `dispatchWorkflow(env, FLOWS_NIGHTLY_WORKFLOW || "flows-pipeline.yml", {origin:"worker"})` (`:571-572`): POST `/repos/<FLOWS_LIVE_REPO>/actions/workflows/<wf>/dispatches` with `Bearer GITHUB_DISPATCH_TOKEN`, body `{ref, inputs}` (`:343-364`). Outcomes `no-token`, `bad-base`, `bad-repo`, `unreachable`, `refused`, `sent` (204).
   6. On `sent`: `clockPatchStatement` writes `nightlyDay` and `nightlyDispatchedAt` (first) or `nightlyRedispatchedAt` (retry), plus `dispatchWhy:"sent"` (`:573-577`). On failure `dispatchWhy` becomes `refused:<status>` and so on (`:331-335, 578-583`); `no-token` is not logged as an error.
4. Loop starter. `createWatch.tick` (`watch.mjs:35`) sets `wantMeta` on the first tick, while a nightly issue is open, or when trading minutes >= 17:30 and `meta` has not landed today (`:46-47`), reads `meta` through `withDeadline(..., 10 s)` and `normalizeRead` (`:32, 48-53`), and calls `nightly.step` (`:57`). `nightlyStartDue` (`starts.mjs:17-37`): `NIGHTLY.atMin` 17:30, `firstTries` 3 on consecutive 5-minute slots until one is accepted, second send only at 18:15 or later and at least `retryGapMs` 30 min after the last attempt, transient refusals (5xx, 429, 408, no answer) retried every 30 min while minutes <= 20:30 and at most `softRetries` 6, never a third accepted send; a permanent refusal stops at four calls. The send is `chainDispatch({workflow:"flows-pipeline.yml", inputs:{origin:"live-loop"}})` (`starts.mjs:53-54`, `live.mjs:393-408`) with the job's `GITHUB_TOKEN`. `tick` is not sent: the nightly workflow does not declare it and GitHub would answer 422 (`flows-pipeline.yml:9-27`).
5. Serialisation. `concurrency: flows-pipeline`, `cancel-in-progress: false` (`flows-pipeline.yml:32-34`). The second dispatch queues; when it runs, `sameSessionGate` finds the session archived and it becomes the one-minute unranked refresh (section 2.3, stage 2).
6. Job `build` (45 min, `:37-39`): checkout (`:41`), Node 22 (`:45`), gate (`:49-74`), `node scripts/flows-pipeline.mjs --dry-run` whenever the gate says run (`:76-78`), then the real run unless dispatched with `dry_run` (`:80-88`) with env `UW_API_KEY`, `FLOWS_INGEST_TOKEN`, `FLOWS_INGEST_URL`, `FLOWS_ALLOW_INTRADAY`, `FLOWS_REPUBLISH_SESSION` (`:82-87`).
7. Job `keepalive` (`:90-115`): schedule events only, New York Mondays only, `PUT .../workflows/{flows-pipeline,flows-live,flows-probe,regression}.yml/enable`, red unless all answers are 204.

The Worker's effective first dispatch is 17:30 ET, not 17:15: `nightlyDispatchDue` opens at 17:15 (`flows-freshness.js:22`) but the only cron that calls it fires at :00 and :30 (`wrangler.toml:26`). It needs `GITHUB_DISPATCH_TOKEN`; without it `dispatchWhy` is `no-token` and the loop and the GitHub crons carry the start (`health.mjs:616-620` calls that a supported mode).

#### 2.2 Credentials: what the nightly uses, what Tier 2 mints

The nightly has no OIDC step. `ingestHeaders` (`flows-pipeline.mjs:121-128`) sends `Authorization: Bearer ` + `process.env.FLOWS_INGEST_TOKEN` unless `LIVE_MODE`, in which case it awaits `liveCredential()`. Headers sent on every ingest call: `Authorization`, `User-Agent: anilkaya-flows-pipeline/1 (+https://github.com/anilkaya001/anilkaya.org)` (`:90`), `Content-Type: application/json` on POST. Five request sites build the URL as `ingestURL() + "?key=" or "?keys=" or "?list="` (`:1858, 1906, 1922, 2979, 3070`), always with `redirect: "error"` so a redirect cannot strip the header.

| Kind | Chosen by | Bearer | Worker check | Scope (`ingestScope`, `flows-live-worker.js:678-693`) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `nightly` | `ingestHeaders` outside `--live` | repo secret `FLOWS_INGEST_TOKEN`, byte-identical to the Worker secret | `tokenKind` (`:601-606`) with `timingSafeEqualStr` (`worker.js:925`) | any key, but a `live:*` key only by GET (the health gate reads `live:market` with it); a `live:*` write or DELETE is 403 `nightly_token_scope` (`:686-689`); only this kind may use `?list=`, `?keys=`, DELETE of `card:`/`card-x:`/`hist:`, and receives `labActiveAt` plus `ledger` on `key=clock` |
| `live` (OIDC) | `liveCredential` (`:102-119`) under `--live` | GitHub-minted JWT | `looksLikeJwt` (`worker.js:3458`) then `oidcKind` (`:3465`) | `live:*` read and write, GET of `board:long`, `board:short`, `board:watch`, `meta`, `focus` (`NIGHTLY_READ_KEYS` `:90`), no DELETE, no `?keys=`/`?list=` (403 `live_token_scope`) |
| `live` (static) | `FLOWS_LIVE_TOKEN` short-circuit (`:103`) | env value | `tokenKind` | same; dev only, never set in production (part 30) |

OIDC minting and verification, hop by hop:

1. The workflow grants `id-token: write` (`flows-live.yml:53-57`), which makes the runner inject `ACTIONS_ID_TOKEN_REQUEST_URL` and `ACTIONS_ID_TOKEN_REQUEST_TOKEN`.
2. `runLiveMode` only checks `liveCredentialSource()` (`flows-pipeline.mjs:96-100, 4607-4608`); it never mints. A pinned test forbids a `liveCredential(` call in its body, so a skipped pass needs no token service.
3. The first ingest call reaches `ingestHeaders` -> `liveCredential` (`:102`): a cached token is reused while its `exp - now > LIVE_BEARER_MARGIN_MS` (60 s, `:92, 105`) for the same request URL; otherwise one single-flight mint (`:106-117`) calls `actionsIdToken(env, {audience: LIVE_OIDC.audience})` (`flows-oidc.js:136-149`): GET `ACTIONS_ID_TOKEN_REQUEST_URL?audience=https://anilkaya.org/api/flows/ingest#live` with the request token, `redirect:"error"`; the body's `value` must satisfy `looksLikeJwt` (<= 8,192 chars). The result is cached as `{token, exp: jwtExpiry(token), url}` (`:110`).
4. The Worker, for a JWT-shaped bearer that matches no static token, calls `oidcKind` (`flows-live-worker.js:664`) -> `verifyLiveOidc` (`flows-oidc.js:121-134`): `inspectLiveOidc` (`:80`) -> `claimsProblem` (`:59-78`) returns the first failing check among `alg` RS256, `kid`, `iss`, `aud`, `repository` (name, `repositoryId` 1284743712, `ownerId` 107927045), `workflow` (`workflow_ref` must equal `anilkaya001/anilkaya.org/.github/workflows/flows-live.yml@refs/heads/main`, and `job_workflow_ref` too when present), `ref` `refs/heads/main`, `event` schedule or workflow_dispatch, `runner` github-hosted, `time`, `expired`/`early` with 60 s skew, `lifetime` <= 3,600 s.
5. Key lookup: `jwksKeys` (`flows-live-worker.js:627-662`) memoises GitHub's JWKS for 1 h (`JWKS_TTL_MS` `:608`), refetches no more than every 60 s warm or 5 s cold, 4 s fetch timeout; an unknown `kid` forces one refresh (`flows-oidc.js:126-131`); the signature is WebCrypto RSASSA-PKCS1-v1_5 (`:107-119`).
6. Result: `{kind:"live"}`; unreadable key set -> 503 `unavailable` so the pipeline's retry ladder runs (`worker.js:3466-3468`); anything else -> 401 (`:3471`). Failures are logged with `claimsBrief` (`flows-live-worker.js:669-674`).

#### 2.3 `main()`: modes and stage order (`flows-pipeline.mjs:4675-7094`)

| Invocation | Effect |
|---|---|
| plain | nightly ranked run; needs `UW_API_KEY` and `FLOWS_INGEST_TOKEN` (`:4684`) |
| `--dry-run` | `DRY_RUN` (`:78`): fixtures only, `publish` logs `[dry-run] key: ...` and adds to `landedKeys` (`:3056-3064`), `sessionDate` fixed `DRY_SESSION_DATE` 2026-08-24 (`:4695, 3881`), ends with `dryLiveTicks` (`:7019`); health gate evaluates run facts only (`health.mjs:688-697`). CI runs it before every real run (`flows-pipeline.yml:76-78`) |

| `FLOWS_REPUBLISH_SESSION=1` | gate mode `republish`: after ranking succeeds, `retireSession` deletes the dated boards then `scores:` last (`:4708-4712, 5044, 2389`) |

Vendor client and budgets: `uw()` (`:533-621`) takes a permit (`permits`, 6 in flight, spacing `delayMs`), retries up to `RATE.maxRetries` + 1 = 5 attempts, treats 429 as a consumed attempt with `Retry-After` capped at 30 s, 5xx and network errors double the delay, any other 4xx throws at once; nearly every caller wraps it in `.catch(() => [])`, so an error and an empty answer look alike. Rate: `RATE` (`:144`) start 120 ms, floor 60 ms, floor ceiling 400 ms. Only under `--live` does a request carry an abort: `LIVE_VENDOR.timeoutMs` 20 s (override `FLOWS_UW_TIMEOUT_MS`, honoured from 100 ms to 60 s) with one retry of a timed-out call before it throws (`:523-529, 562, 575`); `vendorTimeoutMs` returns 0 for the nightly, which has no per-request timeout. `DEADLINE_MS` is 36 min counted from module load (`:256`); the chain leg stops at start + 30 min (`CHAIN_RESERVE_MS` `:353`); the job is killed at 45 min. Worker ingest cap 128 KiB (`worker.js:923`); card soft cap 100 KiB.

#### 2.4 The write: `publish()` and the transport (`flows-pipeline.mjs:3049-3132`)

1. `LIVE_MODE` and a key not matching `^live:[a-z]+(?::[a-z]+)?$` -> throw before anything else (`:3050`).
2. `publishedStore[key] = payload` (`:3054`, a reference, so later mutation shows in the brief and in `ensureArchived`).
3. `EMIT`/`DRY_RUN` -> log and return (`:3056-3064`).
4. Loop: `await ingestWrites.acquire()` (`:3068`; 400 ms spacing, 2 in flight, `:375`) -> `fetch(ingestURL() + "?key=" + encodeURIComponent(key), {method:"POST", redirect:"error", headers: await ingestHeaders({json:true}), body})` (`:3069-3079`).
5. A 403 is classified by `noteRefusal` (`refusalOf`: `worker`, `challenge`, `block`, `unmarked`, `health.mjs:79`); other retried statuses are tallied by `noteAnswer` (`:3081-3082`, `:1838-1850`). These tallies feed the health gate.
6. 503 `store_quota` with `Retry-After`: `storeQuotaWait` returns a wait (section 7); `attempt--`, not charged to the retry budget (`:3083-3095`).
7. Otherwise a status in `PUBLISH_RETRYABLE` {403, 408, 429, 500, 502, 503, 504} that is not a Worker-issued 403 gets `publishRetryDelay` 1 s, 4 s, 9 s while the run-wide budget `PUBLISH_RETRY_BUDGET_MS` 90 s allows (`:3035-3043, 3096-3112`).
8. Still not ok -> `Error("ingest <key> -> HTTP s (server: ..., cf-ray: ...) body: ...")` with `.status` (`:3116-3129`). Success -> `landedKeys.add(key)` (`:3130`).
