#### 2.6 Close-out and the health gate

1. `await prunePromise` (`:6881`).
2. `ensureArchived` (`:6885`, defined `:2423`): per dated key `written` (in `landedKeys`), `held` (store already has it; a 409 also counts), `repaired` (rewritten), `lost`. `lost` prints `ARCHIVE LOST` and `republishRepair(sessionDate)` and sets `process.exitCode = 1` (`:6901-6909`).
3. `neuronCoverage` (`:6917`) builds the coverage ledger carried in `meta.neuron`.
4. `publish("meta", {...})` (`:6928`) is the "nightly landed" signal: the door adds the `flows_ledger` nightly row (`worker.js:3594`), the witness reads it (`watch.mjs:46-54`), and the pill's fallback reads `/api/flows/meta` for `FRESH.nightly` (`flows-ui.js:1775-1780, 1997`). `brief` follows (`:7012`).
5. `runHealthGate({sessionDate, read: readStored, dry, edge: edgeSnapshot, annotate, night: {...}})` (`:7085-7092`); `if (health.failures.length) process.exitCode = 1` (`:7093`). `edgeSnapshot` (`:1834`) hands the 403/5xx tallies and `retrySpentMs` to the gate.

`runHealthGate` (`health.mjs:686`) reads five keys with the nightly credential (`clock`, `live:market`, `live:focus`, `live:heartbeat`, `live:strips:series`; only this token's `clock` answer carries `ledger` and `labActiveAt`), builds `healthChecks` (`:528`), prints notes, warnings (as `::warning title=...` in Actions) and failures. `applies:false` when there is no valid session date (`:543`), when the run is for another Eastern day (only `ledgerChecks` run, `:549-558`), or before close + `settleMin` 10 (`:562`); `FLOWS_LIVE_MODE=off` returns early (`:585-588`).

Nothing else is needed.` The deadline exists because from that open the pipeline refuses an in-progress session and after that close it ranks the newer one |

### 3. Path (b): Tier 1 (Worker cron)

Crons (`wrangler.toml:26`, constants `flows-live-worker.js:70-73`): `1-59/5 13-21 * * MON-FRI` = `rth` (minutes 1, 6, 11 ...), `3-58/5 13-21 * * MON-FRI` = `focus` (3, 8, 13 ...), `*/30 * * * *` = housekeeping, `15,45 * * * *` = `summary`. Weekdays are written by name because Cloudflare numbers Sunday as 1; the numeric `1-5` once ran Sunday to Thursday and Tier 1 never ticked on a Friday (part 30, held by `tests/flows-live-contract.mjs:988`). The four minute sets never coincide.

`rthTick` (`flows-live-worker.js:371-478`), hop by hop:

1. `scheduled()` (`worker.js:3950`) computes `at` from `event.scheduledTime` (`:3951`), `cronJob` returns `rth` (`:3958-3959`), `guard()` wraps the work in `ctx.waitUntil` and logs rejections (`:3952-3956`), `ensureFlowsTables` (`:3961`), then `rthTick(env, at, {fetchVendor: uwFetch})` (`:3962`).
2. Beat: `clockPatchStatement(db, {tier1At: at})` plus `ledgerTickStatement` in one `batchWithLedger` (`:375-378`); `telemetry` records whether it landed.
3. `liveMode(env) === "off"` -> `tier1_why = "off"`, return (`:380-383`).
4. One batch reads `flows_clock` and every `flows_live` age row (`LIVE_AGES_SQL` `:288`, `:384-387`); `normalizeClock` (`:125`); `breadthReadAt` (`:390-391`).
5. Closed day: `closedToday` (`:392`) without a due re-probe (`verdictReprobeDue` `:293`) -> `tier1_why = "holiday"`, `memoClock`, return (`:394-398`). An undecided day (`trading` NULL) is a trading day; only `0` closes it (`clockClosed`, `flows-freshness.js:158`).
6. `if (reprobe || tier1Due(at, clock))` (`:403`): no `UW_API_KEY` -> `why = "error:no-key"` (`:404`); else `tier1Reads` (`:281-286`) runs `TIER1_CALLS` (`flows-live.js:81-84`): `/api/market/market-tide?interval_5m=true` and `/api/market/sector-etfs`, in parallel, each wrapped in a 6 s timeout resolving to `{__failed}`.
7. `sessionStatePatch` (`:299-329`): day roll with nulled verdict (`:303`); from 09:45 the verdict `verdictPatch` (`flows-live.js:484-496`) needs two agreeing "earlier day" probes at least `agreeMs` 15 min apart before it writes `trading: 0` (one probe suffices on a calendar holiday, `:491`), and `closedDays` keeps 20; `tapeAt`/`tapeMovedAt` from the newest tide row (`:313-317`); early-close mark after 13:30 with a quiet tide for 30 min, unmark if the tide moves (`:319-326`).
8. `shapeMarketLive` (`flows-live.js:403`) builds `{v, key, session, fresh, units, tide, sectors, last}`. Gates: reprobe without `trading = 1` -> `holiday`; `anyAnswered(marketFeeds)` else `no-feed-answered`; bytes > 16 KiB -> `over-cap`; else `writeLiveStatement(db, "live:market", ...)` (`:425-427`, upsert guarded by `excluded.read_at >= flows_live.read_at`, `:233`) and `patch.tier1OkAt` (`:429`).
9. `tier1_why` is recorded when anything was due (`:439-440`); `ledgerOutcomeStatement` with `worstStale(liveRows, at, merged)` (`:443-446`; `flows-ledger.js:136-152` scans every live row against its class stale line).
10. Dispatch: `liveDispatchDue(at, merged)` (`:447`, `flows-freshness.js:392-408`) -> `dispatchWorkflow(env, "flows-live.yml", {tick: ISO, origin: "worker"})` (`:449-450`) -> `dispatchWhy`, `liveDispatchedAt` (`:452-454`).
11. Watchdog: `liveStalled(at, breadthReadAt, merged)` (`:457`, `flows-freshness.js:410-417`) logs `live layer stalled` (`:460`); with a token, no `liveRedispatchedAt` within 45 min and no dispatch this tick, it dispatches with `origin: "watchdog"` (`:462-471`) and stamps both `liveRedispatchedAt` and `liveDispatchedAt`.
12. One final batch: live write + clock patch + ledger outcome (`:473-474`); `memoClock` (`:475`). Up to three D1 round trips per due tick; vendor reads are the only network.

`focusTick` (`flows-live-worker.js:504-552`): `scheduled` -> `focus` (`worker.js:3966-3970`); one batch reads `flows_clock`, the nightly `focus` groups/session/closes (`FOCUS_NIGHTLY_SQL` `:495-498`) and the held `live:focus` priced names (`FOCUS_HELD_SQL` `:500-502`); `focusDue` = trading and `tier1Due` (`:484-487`); `focusNames` caps 40 (`:489-493`); one `/api/screener/stocks?ticker=<names>&limit=500` (`FOCUS_READ` `:482`, `:519-520`, 6 s timeout); `priorCloseBase` from the nightly closes (`:523`); `shapeStrips(raw, {key:"live:focus", writer:"worker@focus", base})` (`:524`). It refuses to write when nothing priced, when over cap, or when it would drop a name a same-session held row priced within `FRESH_CLASSES.market.liveS` (`:530-540`, reason `partial`); otherwise `batchWithLedger([writeLiveStatement], ledgerFocusStatement)` (`:548-550`).

Due-tests and clocks (`flows-freshness.js`):

| Function | Line | Rule | Caller |
|---|---|---|---|
| `tier1Due` | 384 | trading and 09:30 <= minutes <= close + 10; inferred early-close days keep 16:00; non-trading weekday holidays only in the 09:45 to 09:55 probe window (374-382) | `rthTick` 403, `focusDue` 486 |
| `liveDispatchDue` | 392 | trading; 09:30 to close + 16; minutes % 15 == 1; not `in-flight` (sent < 10 min ago and no `liveDoneAt >= sent`) | `rthTick` 447 |
| `liveStalled` | 410 | phase `rth`, >= 45 min after the open, `live:breadth` missing or older than 45 min | `rthTick` 457 |
| `nightlyDispatchDue` | 419 | section 2.1 | `nightlyTick` 563 |
| `expectedNightlySession` | 262 | newest trading day whose close + 5 h has passed | `freshnessState`, `serveNow`, witness |
| `phaseAt` | 218 | `pre` from 04:00, `rth`, `post` to 20:00, else `closed`; before 04:00 `session` is the previous trading day | everywhere |
| `isRefreshWindow` | 83 | weekday 09:15 to 16:15, holiday-blind; gates the landing-page snapshot refresh only | `refreshMarketSnapshotIfDue` (`worker.js:533`) |
| `pruneDue` | `flows-live-worker.js:588` | ET minutes in [180, 210) | `worker.js:3983` |

Ledger statements, each appended to a batch that already exists (zero extra round trips), with one exception: a focus tick that writes nothing has no batch to join, so its single ledger statement runs alone (`flows-live-worker.js:545`). `batchWithLedger` (`:217-225`) retries the core statements without the ledger statement if the batch is refused, so a ledger fault never blocks a write:

|---|---|---|
| `ledgerTickStatement` | `flows-ledger.js:47` | `rthTick` beat (every tick) |
| `ledgerOutcomeStatement` | `:52` | `rthTick` final batch (when something was due) |
| `ledgerFocusStatement` | `:69` | `focusTick` (ok, partial or failed) |
| `ledgerPassStatement` | `:90` | `ingestLive` for `live:heartbeat` via `heartbeatLedger` (`flows-live-worker.js:717, 723-728`) |
| `ledgerNightlyStatement` | `:97` | `meta` ingest (`worker.js:3594`) |

The summary cron `15,45 * * * *` runs `summaryFiring` (`worker.js:1423`, stamps `flows_clock.summary_at`, read by the health gate at `health.mjs:572-583`); the housekeeping firing refreshes the landing-page market snapshot (`worker.js:3978`, `:533`).

#### 4.2 One hop of the loop

1. Job `live`, 355 min (`:64-66`); sparse checkout of `scripts` and `shared` (`:75-81`); Node 22; a log step reports how late GitHub delivered a scheduled run (`:88-109`).
2. `node scripts/flows-pipeline.mjs --live` with `FLOWS_LIVE_LOOP=1`, `FLOWS_LIVE_KEEP=1`, `FLOWS_LIVE_ORIGIN`, `GITHUB_TOKEN` (`:111-121`).
3. `main` -> `runLiveMode` (`flows-pipeline.mjs:4677, 4602`): drill short-circuit (`:4603`); requires `UW_API_KEY` and a live credential source, refusing `FLOWS_INGEST_TOKEN` on purpose (`:4605-4612`); `delayFloorMs` and `delayMs` raised to `LIVE_READ_PACE_MS` 333 ms (`:4615-4616`); `readClock` = `readLiveClock(readStoredOnce, {seen})` (`:4634`); `createWatch` when `FLOWS_LIVE_KEEP=1` (`:4653-4656`); `runLiveLoop({readClock, watch, pass, chain})` (`:4657-4671`).
4. `runLiveLoop` with a watch delegates to `keepLoop` (`live.mjs:482-496` -> `:431`). Per iteration: `refresh()` reads the clock under a 10 s deadline and keeps the last good one; `here = window(now, clock)` (`liveWindow` `:15-32`: trading day, 09:30 to close + 25 min, with `wait` for a provisional closed day or early close); `pass({first, index, clock})` when `here.run` (an exception becomes `{errored, threw}` and the loop carries on); `watch.tick` (exceptions caught); `busy = here.run || here.wait || beat.busy`; `wake = nextSlot(t, busy ? 5 min : 15 min)`; if the next open is known and `wake` would reach it, `wake` becomes open + 60 s (`:467`); if `wake - startedAt > 340 min`, `chain({at})`, `watch.chainFailed` when not sent, return `{exit:"budget", keep:true, ...}` (`:468-477`); else `sleep(wake - now())`.
5. `pass`: `resetPublishRetryBudget()` (`:4660`), then `runLive({uw, publish, readStored, shapeNews, origin, skipRecent: first, clock})` (`:4662`).
6. After the loop: `settle` (`:4635-4646`) prints the witness line and sets exit 1 when `liveRunVerdict` (`live.mjs:329-346`) finds every pass dead, a budget exit with a refused chain, or a confirmed witness lapse.

#### 4.3 One pass: `runLive` (`live.mjs:100-319`)

1. `liveWindow(startedAt, clock)`; outside it and not forced -> `{skipped: why}` (`:105-110`).
2. `readStored("live:heartbeat")`; if the last run finished < 8 min ago (`tier2HeartbeatSkipMs`, `flows-live.js:35`) and `skipRecent` (first pass of a hop only) -> `{skipped:"recent"}` (`:114-119`).

Reads `board:long`, `board:short`, `board:watch`, `focus` from the Worker (`:121-123`, live credential may GET these), `boardPlan` (`:124`, `:72-91`: names via `stripNames` = SPY, QQQ, IWM first, then up to 40 focus names, then boards round-robin, cap 160; `ranked`; `deep` <= 50), `priorCloseBase(nightlySources(...))` (`:125-128`), `gexRotation` (`:129-130`).

Vendor reads through `read()` which counts calls and turns an error into `{__failed}` (`:135-143`): 11 `/api/market/<sector>/sector-tide` and 4 `/api/market/<SPY|QQQ|IWM|DIA>/etf-tide` in parallel (`:153-158`); 2 `/api/net-flow/expiry` (`:159-162`); 1 `/api/screener/stocks` (`:163`, same request text as the focus tick, test-pinned); up to 5 `/api/option-trades/flow-alerts` pages of 200 (`:165-182`); 14 `/api/stock/<T>/spot-exposures` (`:184-187`); `total-options-volume`, `top-net-impact`, `darkpool/recent`, `news/headlines` (`:189-194`). 37 calls with one alert page, 41 with five.
5. `put(key, payload, {answered})` (`:200-223`): a key whose reads all failed is not published (its held row keeps its own `read_at` and goes stale on its own clock); over-cap payloads are dropped with an error line, never truncated; `publish` errors are collected.
6. Publish order: `live:breadth` (`:233`), `live:strips` (`:261`), `live:strips:series` (`:266`), `live:vol` (`:267`), `live:movers` (`:268`), `live:alerts` only if `merged.write` (`:273`), `live:gex` (`:282`), `live:tape` (`:286`), `live:news` if the pipeline injected `shapeNews` (`:288-297`), `live:heartbeat` last, always (`:311`). The heartbeat body `run` carries origin, times, `calls`, `failedCalls`, per-key bytes, errors, notes, `quoteLag`, `quoteAhead`, `prevFill`.
7. `passOutcome` (`:321`) -> `{answered, landed, errored}` for the loop verdict.

#### 4.4 The live ingest on the Worker

1. `POST /api/flows/ingest?key=live:...` with the OIDC bearer -> door steps 1 to 3 and 7 of section 2.5 (`worker.js:3454-3522`).
2. `ingestScope(key, "POST", "live")` allows `live:*` only (`flows-live-worker.js:680-685`); the nightly kind is refused for any `live:*` write (`:686-689`).
3. `ingestLive` (`:695-721`): `Object.hasOwn(LIVE_KEYS, key)` else 400 `invalid_key`; body parsed (400 `invalid_payload`); `text.length > spec.maxBytes` -> 413 `too_large`; `checkLiveWrite(key, body, {source:"actions"})` (`flows-live.js:1332-1358`): writer must be `actions` (403 `wrong_writer`; Worker keys cannot be written through ingest), `fresh.v === 1`, `fresh.readAt` an instant, `fresh.session` a day, `fresh.cadenceS` equal to the registry value, `fresh.source` equal to the writer (400 `invalid_fresh`).
4. `writeLiveStatement` (monotone on `read_at`); for `live:heartbeat` also `clockPatchStatement({liveDoneAt: now})` and `heartbeatLedger`, all in one `batchWithLedger` (`:715-718`); answer `{ok, key, bytes, stored: "written" or "older-than-held"}` (`:720`).

#### 4.6 Loop watch: witness, nightly start, alert channel

`createWatch.tick` (`watch.mjs:35-70`) composes everything with no extra clock read:

| Step | Rule | Lines |
|---|---|---|
| first tick | `witness.start()` seeds by listing open issues authored by `github-actions[bot]` titled `[flows-witness:<id>]`; `witness.clear("chain")` closes a chain issue left by the previous hop | `watch.mjs:36-39`; `witness.mjs:311-345` |
| view | `witnessView(latestClock())` parses the clock body the loop just read | `watch.mjs:40` |
| reads (single try, 10 s each) | `live:market` and `live:focus` inside the Tier 1 window (open to close + 10); `live:breadth` inside the Tier 2 window (open + 45 min to close + 25); `meta` when `wantMeta` | `watch.mjs:15-25, 43-53` |
| evaluators | `evaluateTier1` (`witness.mjs:112`): any of Tier 1's last tick, `live:market.fresh.readAt`, `live:focus.fresh.readAt` older than `WITNESS.tier1StaleMs` 25 min counted from max(value, open); `evaluateTier2` (`:148`): `live:breadth` older than 45 min; `evaluateNightly`; `probe` (nothing readable) | `watch.mjs:59-70` |
| lifecycle | `breach` confirms after `WITNESS.confirm` {tier1 2, tier2 2, nightly 1 (2 when pending), chain 1, probe 3}; `ok` recovers after {tier1 3, tier2 3, nightly 1, chain 1, probe 3}; `inconclusive` changes nothing; one issue per check, reopened within 6 h, reminder every 6 h; only bot-authored issues are adopted | `witness.mjs:11-19, 472-489` |
| exit | a confirmed breach turns the run red through `liveRunVerdict` | `live.mjs:341-343` |

The two stale lines are not independent constants: `WITNESS.tier1StaleMs` and `tier2StaleMs` read `FRESH_CLASSES.market.staleS` and `breadth.staleS` (`witness.mjs:9-10`), `LEDGER_LIMITS` reads the same (`flows-ledger.js:7-11`), and the Tier 2 verdict agrees minute by minute with the Worker's `liveStalled` (part 43).

### 5. Path (d): read-time overlays and shapers

#### 5.1 Day-change base and strip shaping

1. Sources. `nightlySources({boards, focus})` (`flows-live.js:650-669`) returns `{name, sessionDate, close}` for `focus` (last element of each `closes` series) and for `board:long`, `board:short`, `board:watch` (row `px`). `runLive` passes the boards and `focus` it just read (`live.mjs:125-128`); `focusTick` passes the SQL-extracted last closes (`flows-live-worker.js:497, 523`).
2. `priorCloseBase(sources, session, clock)` (`flows-live.js:671-688`): `want = prevTradingDay(session, clock)`; only sources dated exactly `want` contribute (others are listed in `other` for the notes); per ticker the first positive close wins; returns `{date, close, from, other}`. It does no agreement test.
3. `shapeStrips(raw, {at, session, names, writer, key, base, lag})` (`:699-794`): de-dups rows by ticker; `rowDate` = the most common vendor `date`; if it precedes the session the whole payload is `status:"prior"` (`:725-727, 783`); agreement test over rows that carry a vendor `prev_close` and a base close: tolerance `FILL_AGREE.tol` 0.05%, `declined` when at least `minChecked` 5 were checked and fewer than 90% agree (`:646, 729-738`); a row dated before the session is held out as an all-null row for a wanted name (`:751-759`, 20 dates kept); otherwise `stripValues(row, {at, fill})` fills only a null `prev` (`:613-623`), then `chg = px / prev - 1` and `qa` (`lagSeconds` `:596-601`: whole seconds the read is behind the vendor `quote_time`, null if the quote is more than 60 s ahead).
4. Output: `status` ok, prior or unreadable; `asked`, `returned`, `missing`, `lag`, `ahead {n, maxS}`, `off {n, dates}`, `prevFill {date, n, from, agree, tickers}` or `{declined:"disagrees"}` (`:781-793`); 23 ordered columns `STRIP_FIELDS` (`:576`).
5. Callers: `runLive` for `live:strips` (`live.mjs:236`), `focusTick` for `live:focus`, the rail's `shapePx` (`shared/flows-rt.js:427-428`). The health gate prints the fill outcome from `run.prevFill` (`health.mjs:662-666`).
6. Reader rule. Boards accept a live body only when `live.session > payload.sessionDate`, then copy both `px` and `chg`, so a streamed price is never printed next to a nightly change; a verdict `[X-Fresh-State, staleAt, skew]` read from the response headers restores every held row once it lapses (`flows-board.js:1318-1328, 1400-1448`).

#### 5.2 Nightly keys overlaid by live keys (`worker.js:2095-2118`)

| Route | Overlay key | Rule | Output |
|---|---|---|---|
| `/api/flows/pulse` | `live:market` | `pulseWithLive` (`flows-live.js:1273-1294`): live tide `ok` with points; a lone live point never replaces a nightly river of >= 2 points; live day not older than the nightly's; nightly `readAt` older than live `readAt` | nightly pulse with `tide` rebuilt from the live tide, `refreshed:"intraday"`, `live:{key,session,tideDate}`, `X-Live-Overlay: live:market`, live key's `X-Fresh-*` |
| `/api/flows/flowalerts` | `live:alerts` | `liveAlertsWin` (`:1296-1300`): the live session is a valid day and strictly newer than the nightly session (or the nightly has none); a same-session live row never overrides the nightly | the live row itself, `X-Live-Overlay: live:alerts` |
| `/api/flows/news` | `live:news` | `liveNewsWins` (`:1302-1308`): live session newer, or same session and live `readAt` newer than the nightly's | `newsWithLive` (`:1310-1315`) only when the live body is `ok` with rows: `refreshed:"intraday"`, `live:{key,session}`, `X-Live-Overlay: live:news` |
| `/api/flows/brief` | `live:market`, `live:alerts` | `briefWithLive` (`worker.js:1324-1335`) -> `liveBriefFeeds` (`flows-live-worker.js:1198-1219`) | refreshed intraday facts; header lists the overlays |

Hops: `/api/flows/<name>` (`worker.js:3652`) -> `readWithOverlay` (`:2097`) -> one `readOverlayRows(db, nightlyKey, liveKey, now)` batch of nightly row, live row and the clock row when due (`flows-live-worker.js:1184-1196`) -> `overlayFlowalerts` / `overlayPulse` / `overlayNews` (`:1153-1177`). A null overlay falls through to `passthrough(stored)` with the nightly headers (`worker.js:3658`); a failed batch falls back to `readFlowsPayload` (`:2102-2105`) and then to `storeGone()` (`:3656`). Client: the overview skips the pill registration for an overlaid response (`flows-overview.js:2006`, `__ff.overlay` from `X-Live-Overlay` in `flows-fresh.js:46`).

#### 5.3 Tape and quote TTLs

`tapeTtlMs(phase, row, clock)` (`flows-live-worker.js:997-1005`):

| Case | TTL |
|---|---|
| row lacks either leg (`legs !== 3`, bits prem 1 and gex 2, `:989-990`) | 0 |
| phase `rth`, both legs | `FRESH_CLASSES.tape.cadenceS` = 60 s |
| `pre` or `post`, and the read covers the last close less one cadence (`tapeCoversClose` `:992-995`) | `tapePreTtlMs` 15 min |
| `closed`, covers the close, and `row.session >= phase.lastClosed` | unbounded |
| otherwise | 0 |

`serveTape` (`:1068-1151`): fresh -> `X-Tape: fresh`; otherwise `usable` (any age outside `rth`, <= `tapeUsableMs` 30 min inside it); claim a 20 s lease with a conditional UPDATE; the winner refreshes one leg (`tapeLegFor` `:1018-1030`: `prem` first, then `gex`) in `waitUntil` while serving the stale row (`stale-refreshing`), or inline when nothing is usable (`refreshed`); losers wait <= 1.5 s (`waited`, else `pending`/`leased`); the limiter `UW_ONDEMAND` (120 per 60 s) can answer `stale-throttled`. Headers use class `tape` (`:1077-1079`).

`serveQuote` (`:946-987`): TTL by phase from `LIVE_BUDGET.quoteTtlS` (`rth` 5 s, `pre`/`post` 30 s, `closed` 21,600 s, `flows-live.js:51`), a Cache API entry `https://flows-live.internal/<T>`; the response is dated by the body's own `readAt` with class `quote`; a limiter refusal returns the cached body with `X-Fresh-State: stale`, `X-Fresh-Reason: throttled`, `X-Fresh-Throttled: 1` (`:964-976`).

### 6. Path (e): the freshness path, end to end

```text
 stamp                      verdict (server)                       transport                    client
 -----                      ----------------                       ---------                    ------
 flows_live row:            classOf(meta) 274                      HTTP headers                 fromHeaders 27 --+
  read_at session           freshnessState(meta, at, clock) 282     X-Fresh-* + X-Server-Now   fromEntry 50   --+-> wrap 62
  cadence_s source          phaseAt(at, clock) 218 <- flows_clock     <- freshHeaders 334                          stateAt(now)
 flows_payload row:         expectedNightlySession 262              JSON entries                                   nextAt(now)
  session, read_iso ->      nightlyFreshMeta (flows-live.js:1360)    entryOf (live-worker 256)                     forFreshness(now)
 quote body.readAt          pendingHeaders 355 (state pending)        in lk envelope 755, now 871                       |
 flows_tape row.read_at                                             rail frame `fresh`                                  v
                                                                      <- streamEntry (shared/flows-rt.js:171)   UI.freshness({ff, source})
                                                                                                        FRESH.ffs -> freshState 1664
                                                                                                        freshAggregate 1659 -> paintFresh 1706 -> #fxFresh
```

#### 6.1 Classes and states (`flows-freshness.js:3-12, 282-332`)

| Class | cadence / live / stale s | Used for |
|---|---|---|
| `quote` | 5 / 20 / 90 | `/api/flows/live` quote card |
| `tape` | 60 / 150 / 600 | per-ticker `flows_tape` |
| `market` | 300 / 660 / 1500 | `live:market`, `live:focus` |
| `breadth` | 900 / 1200 / 2700 | the other ten live keys |
| `nightly` | 0 / null / null, `graceS` 5 h | every `flows_payload` row (`nightlyFreshMeta`) |
| `rt`, `rtSlow`, `rtNews` | 5/15/60, 10/30/120, 30/75/300, `extended` | rail frames; windows apply in `pre` and `post` too |

`freshnessState(meta, at, clock)` returns `{klass, cadenceS, phase, readAt, session, liveUntil, staleAt, phaseEndsAt, state, reason}`:

| Condition | state | reason |
|---|---|---|
| no clock / `readAt` not finite | stale | `no-clock` / `unstamped` (296-297) |
| nightly, no session | stale | `unsessioned` (302) |
| nightly, `session < expectedNightlySession` | stale | `behind` (303) |
| nightly otherwise; `staleAt` = next trading day's close + 5 h | fresh | `session` (304-306) |
| other class in `rth` (or `rt*` in `pre`/`post`), read before the phase start | closed until `from + liveS`, then stale | `awaiting-first-read` / `missed-open` (314-319) |
| age <= `liveS` | live | `cadence` (322) |
| age <= `staleS` | fresh | `cadence` (323) |
| older | stale | `behind` (324) |
| outside the session, read at or after last close - one cadence; `staleAt` = next open + `liveS` | closed | `session-final` (328-330) |
| outside the session, earlier read | stale | `missed-close` (331) |
| never written (via `pendingHeaders`, `serveLiveKey`, `serveTape`) | pending | `unpublished` (355-371) |

#### 6.2 Server emitters

| Emitter | Class and meta | Lines |
|---|---|---|
| nightly routes: `passthrough` -> `nightlyFreshHeaders` -> `freshHeaders(stored.fresh, now, memoizedClock())` | `nightly`, `readAt` = `read_iso`, `session` = `sessionDate` | `worker.js:1000-1003, 1232-1241` |
| single live key: `liveResponse` | the row's own `readAt`, `session`, `cadenceS`, `source` | `flows-live-worker.js:730-736, 785-797` |
| several live keys: `liveEnvelope` | per-key `entryOf`; aggregate headers = worst state by rank live < fresh < closed < stale < pending, earliest `Read-At`, `Live-Until`, `Stale-At` | `:752-783` |
| heartbeat: `serveNow` | one `entryOf(freshHeaders(...).fresh)` per live key and per `n=` nightly key, plus `tier1`, `clock`, `expected`, `phase` | `:871-927` |
| quote, tape | classes `quote`, `tape` | `:946-987, 1068-1151` |
| rail | `streamEntry` adds `vendor-lag`, `vendor-unstamped`, `vendor-skew` so a lagging vendor never reads as live | `shared/flows-rt.js:171-188` |
| store outage | `recallLastGood` forces `stale` / `store` and adds `X-Fresh-Last-Good` | `worker.js:1083-1097` |
| every `/api/flows/*` | `finalize` adds `X-Server-Now` when missing; `no-store` | `worker.js:3933-3935` |

Access. Every `/api/flows/*` read route in this chapter (`pulse`, `flowalerts`, `news`, `lk`, `now`, `tape`, `live`, the nightly views) runs after `currentFlowsUser` (`worker.js:3601-3605`, defined `:904`): GET only (`ask` alone is POST), and a missing or invalid Flows session cookie is JSON 401 `unauthorized`, which the client wrapper turns into the signed-out gate (6.3). `/api/flows/ingest` is dispatched earlier (`worker.js:3454`), ignores the cookie and takes only its bearer (2.5). The rail's `/api/rt/*` has its own audience gate (see 35-rail).

Request caps on the live read routes: `lk` takes at most `LK_MAX_KEYS` 8 live keys (`flows-live-worker.js:738-742`); `now` takes a `k=` list of live keys and an `n=` list of nightly keys (`NOW_NIGHTLY_KEYS`, 18 names, `:94-97`, plus `card:<TICKER>`), each at most 16 entries (`parseList` default `max`, `:804`, `:872-874`), and `t=` adds the quote card (`:921-925`).

Wire facts. Headers: `X-Fresh-State`, `-Reason`, `-Class`, `-Read-At`, `-Source`, `-Cadence`, `-Session`, `-Live-Until`, `-Stale-At`, `-Phase`, `-Phase-Ends`, plus `X-Server-Now` (`flows-freshness.js:338-351`); Worker-only extras `X-Fresh-Throttled`, `X-Fresh-Last-Good`, `X-Live-Overlay`, `X-Payload-Updated`, `X-Tape`, `X-Quote-Ttl`, `X-Chain-Cache`, `X-Chain-Age`. Entry: `{state, reason, klass, cadenceS, source, session, updatedAt, readAt, liveUntil, staleAt}` (`flows-live-worker.js:256-260`); pending entry `{state:"pending", reason:"unpublished", klass}` (`:266`).

#### 6.3 Client hops

1. The fetch wrapper (`flows-ui.js:1817-1828`) acts on URLs containing `/api/flows/`: `HANG` when signed out; `/api/flows/meta` -> `takeMeta`; `/api/flows/now` -> `watchNow` (takes `expected` and `phase` into `SRV`, stamps `hbAt` for a keyed beat, `:1628-1640`); `observe` dates unannotated pages from `sessionDate`/`generatedAt` in the body (`:1757-1774`); `gate` handles 401 and 403 (`:1804-1815`).
2. `freshFrom(src)` (`flows-fresh.js:86-91`): an object with a string `state` goes through `fromEntry`, anything else through `fromHeaders` (`:27-48`, unknown state becomes `stale`). `wrap` (`:62-84`) adds `skewMs = serverNow - Date.now()` and: `stateAt(now)` (pending and stale are terminal; `closed` turns stale at `staleAt`; live before `liveUntil`; fresh before `staleAt`; else stale), `nextAt(now)`, `forFreshness(now)`.
3. `heartbeat(opts)` (`:109-174`): URL `/api/flows/now?k=<live keys>&n=<nightly keys>&t=<ticker>`; each beat has an 8 s abort (`:9, 137-138`); `schedule()` waits `heartbeatInterval` = null when hidden or the phase is not `rth`/`pre`/`post`, 20 s on the ticker page and 30 s elsewhere in `rth`, 60 s in `pre`/`post` (`:102-107`); in a closed phase it sleeps until `phaseEndsAt` (`:131`); failures double a backoff capped at 5 min (`:10, 160`); hidden stops the timer and becoming visible beats at once (`:164-168`). On success each key becomes `freshFrom(entry, {serverNow, phase})` and `UI.freshness({ff, source: key})` (`:149-152`); `changed` lists keys whose `updatedAt` moved after the first beat (`:153-154`), and `onChange` refetches only those regions.
4. `freshness(o)` (`flows-ui.js:1722-1737`) keeps `FRESH`: `ffs` map of verdict objects, `sources` map of session days, `primary` session, `readAt`/`live` for price reads, `transport` label; every call repaints.
5. `freshAggregate(list, phase)` (`:1659-1663`): empty -> `pending`; any `stale` -> `stale`; any `live` -> `live`; phase not `rth` or all `closed` -> `closed`; any `fresh` -> `fresh`.
6. `freshState()` (`:1664-1677`): `market()` (`:1647-1654`) gives `open` from the server phase `rth` while `SRV.until` is in the future, else weekday 09:30 to 16:00 ET, and `expected` from the server or from `localExpected` (weekday and >= 21:00 ET -> today, else the previous weekday, `:1620-1625`); `S = primary || sessionDate || nightly`; `behind = S < expected`, and when `expected` is only the local guess `confirmExpected()` asks `/api/flows/now` once (60 s throttle, `:1641-1646`) and holds `behind` false while pending; state is `stale` if `behind` or `freshAggregate` of the registered verdicts is stale; else `live` (a live read younger than 3 min while open), `fresh` (open), `closed`, or `pending` before anything settled.
7. `paintFresh()` (`:1706-1721`): label `Live`, `Stale` (stale but not behind), `Today`, a day like `Sep 24` (behind), `Session` (pending), `Closed`, `Open`; glyph and word from `STATES` (`:267-276`: `fresh` is "Current session"); `data-state`, `data-label`, `data-feed`; a no-op when unchanged. Wiring in `initShell`: click opens `freshDetails()`, 800 ms `/api/flows/meta` fallback when nothing registered, 6 s `settled`, 30 s repaint so time alone can turn the pill stale (`:1989-2000`). A separate `#fxGate` element replaces the pill for `out` (401, link to sign in) and `off` (edge 403) (`:1791-1803`).

Page registrations (heartbeat call sites): overview keys `market`, `breadth`, `strips`, `focus`, `news` and nightly `pulse`, `focus` (`flows-overview.js:2101-2102`); market keys `market`, `breadth`, nightly `pulse` (`flows-market.js:1532`); unusual key `alerts`, nightly `flowalerts`, `unusual` (`flows-unusual.js:992-993`); ticker no live keys, `ticker` set, nightly `card:<T>` unless the card is lite (`flows-ticker.js:2909-2910`), and every third beat in `rth` refetches the tape (`:2916`); boards poll `lk?k=strips` themselves and register `{ff:{stateAt}, source:"strips"}` (`flows-board.js:1376, 1411`). The rail's browser half (`assets/js/flows-rt.js:135-149`) registers `rt:<topic>` verdicts from frame `fresh` entries through the same `freshFrom`, sets `readAt`/`live` for `px` only when both the frame and `stateAt()` say live, drops entries on reset or close (`:97-98, 201`), and labels the transport through `freshness.transport` (`:102`).

### 7. Path (f): store quota (D1 error 7500)

Caps (AGENTS.md): 100,000 rows written and 5,000,000 rows read per UTC day, shared account-wide, reset 00:00 UTC. `STORE_QUOTA_RE` (`worker.js:1030`) matches the error text; `secondsToUtcMidnight` (`:1032`, at least 60 s).

| Where the D1 error surfaces | What happens | Lines |
|---|---|---|
| nightly read routes (`board`, `market`, `events`, `scoretrack`, `meta`, `political`, `unusual`, `movers`, `sectors`, `sector-premium`, `universe`, `regime`, `ideas`, `focus`, `roster`, `record`, `card`, `card-x`, `hist`) | `readFlowsPayload` swallows the rejection and sets `trace.failed`; `readServed` then throws `storeGone()` (503 `store_unreadable`, `Retry-After: 30`, body `{status:"unavailable", reason:"store"}`); the `board` route recalls the last-good copy directly | `worker.js:995-997, 1036, 1099-1104, 3612-3616` |
| overlay routes `pulse`, `flowalerts`, `news` | `readWithOverlay` failure -> `storeGone()` | `worker.js:3654-3656` |
| any `HttpError` `store_unreadable` | the `fetch()` catch calls `recallLastGood(request, url)`; a hit becomes the response with `X-Fresh-State: stale`, `X-Fresh-Reason: store`, `X-Fresh-Last-Good`; no hit -> bare 503 | `worker.js:3997-3999, 1083-1097` |
| `lk` (several keys) and `now` | 503 `store_unreadable` HttpError; these paths are not in `LAST_GOOD_PATHS`, so the bare 503 stands | `flows-live-worker.js:799, 890`; `worker.js:1041-1043` |
| `lk` (one key) | `batchWithClock` returns `{results:null}` on failure; the row reads as absent and the answer is 200 `{key, status:"pending"}` | `flows-live-worker.js:788-796, 196-203` |
| errors that escape `route()` (ingest upsert or DELETE, other uncaught D1 calls) | 503 `store_quota` with `Retry-After` to 00:00 UTC, logged as `request failed` | `worker.js:4002-4011` |
| cron ticks | `rthTick` and `focusTick` catch batch failures; `guard()` logs any other rejection | `flows-live-worker.js:384-387, 511`; `worker.js:3952-3956` |

Last-good copy writer: `rememberLastGood` (`worker.js:1064-1081`) runs after every route response (`:3994`); it stores only a 200 with a non-zero `X-Payload-Updated`, not itself a last-good response, for the 22 paths in `LAST_GOOD_PATHS` (`:1041-1043`), at most once per 10 min per key per isolate (`LAST_GOOD_REFRESH_MS`) and at most 256 keys (`LAST_GOOD_MAX_KEYS`), under Cache API key `https://flows-lastgood.internal/api/flows/<name>[?side=|?t=]` with a 24 h TTL (`:1038, 1057, 1075`). It lives only in the data centre that served the key and can be evicted early (AGENTS.md).

Pipeline side (`publish`, section 2.4 step 6): `storeQuotaWait(response, text, {now, firstAt})` (`health.mjs:292-302`) returns a wait only for a 503 whose body code is `store_quota` and whose `Retry-After` is a positive number: wait = `Retry-After` + `marginMs` 30 s, provided `now + wait - firstAt <= QUOTA_WAIT.maxMs` (20 min); just after 00:00 UTC (`lagWindowMs` 10 min) it falls back to 60 s steps (`lagStepMs`). The wait is not charged to the 90 s retry budget (`attempt--`, `flows-pipeline.mjs:3085-3094`). `statusRemedies` reports ingest answers that carried the Worker's `store_quota` as a `HEALTH:` line with the `D1_QUOTA` sentence (`health.mjs:259-262`, `D1_QUOTA` `:156`). Budgeting: `tests/flows-reads-contract.mjs` holds a rows-read ceiling per read route (part 30); the ledger adds a handful of statements to batches that already exist.

### 8. Cross-tier invariants, failure signatures, doc versus source

| Failure | First reader-visible signal | Operator signal |
|---|---|---|
| Tier 1 stops | `live:market` or `live:focus` crosses `FRESH_CLASSES.market.staleS` 1,500 s: the overview heartbeat (keys `market`, `focus`) and the market page heartbeat (key `market`) report it and the pill goes `stale` | witness `tier1` after 2 ticks (`witness.mjs:11`); ledger gap line in the nightly's health gate (`health.mjs:479-491`); `tier1_why` on the ingest clock |
| Tier 2 stops | the Tier 2 keys cross `breadth.staleS` 2,700 s: pill `stale` through the heartbeat, and a board restores its nightly prices when the `live:strips` verdict lapses (`flows-board.js:1410-1417`) | Worker `live layer stalled` log and `origin: "watchdog"` dispatch (`flows-live-worker.js:457-471`); witness `tier2`; ledger `passes === 0` or gap |
| Nightly missing | at 21:00 ET `behind`: pill shows the older day, `stale` | `nightly missing` log (`:566-569`); witness `nightly`; next run's ledger check (`health.mjs:517-524`) |
| Vendor 429 or 5xx in the nightly | none until the budget is spent | `edgeFailures` and `retrySpentMs >= 60,000` in the health gate |
| D1 quota | stale/store last-good copies, pending live keys | `store_quota` wait lines in the pipeline log |

Invariants that bind the tiers (a change in one moves the others):

1. `FRESH_CLASSES` is the single source for `LIVE_KEYS` cadences, `checkLiveWrite`, `LEDGER_LIMITS`, the `WITNESS` stale lines and `liveStalled`; `flows-fresh.js` hard-codes no class threshold (`fromHeaders` `:27-48`), and the only client-side numbers are the pill's local fallbacks: a live read counts as live for 3 min (`flows-ui.js:1667`), the 21:00 ET local `expected` (`:1621`) and the 30 h / 4 d `staleness` rule (`:29-30`). The table is pinned verbatim by `tests/flows-live-contract.mjs:55-61` (part 30).
2. One writer per `live:*` key; a Worker key cannot arrive through ingest; `shared/flows-live-worker.js` must never write `flows_payload` (scan at `flows-live-contract:732-740`); `--live` can only publish keys matching `^live:[a-z]+(?::[a-z]+)?$` (`flows-pipeline.mjs:3050`).
3. The live credential reads only `NIGHTLY_READ_KEYS` and `live:*`; `labActiveAt` and `ledger` ride only the nightly token's `clock` answer (`worker.js:3511`).
4. Worker crons use weekday names; the four strings in `wrangler.toml:26` equal `RTH_CRON`, `FOCUS_CRON`, `HOUSEKEEPING_CRON`, `SUMMARY_CRON` (`flows-live-worker.js:70-73`) and `HEALTH.focusCron`/`summaryCron` (`health.mjs:10-11`). GitHub workflow crons use numeric `1-5`.
5. An undecided day is a trading day; a closed verdict needs two probes at least 15 min apart (`flows-live.js:458-496`).
6. The nightly is due 21:00 ET on every session including early closes (`graceS` 5 h, `flows-freshness.js:8, 268`).
7. Tier 1 reads two small feeds only (CPU); the 390-row feeds belong to Tier 2 (part 30).
8. Dated archive rows are insert-once; a `republish_session` run deletes first (scores last) and only after ranking succeeded (`flows-pipeline.mjs:2389, 5044`).

Doc versus source, and traps found while tracing (OIDC is the Tier 2 credential only: the nightly sends the static secret, `flows-pipeline.mjs:123`, and `--live` refuses it, `:4610-4611`):

| Doc says | Source says |
|---|---|
| DEPLOY.md 10.5i (`DEPLOY.md:1883`) and `PHASE_MINUTES.nightlyAfter` say the Worker dispatches the nightly "at or after 17:15 ET" | The only caller is the `*/30` cron, so the first send is 17:30 ET and the retry 18:30 (`wrangler.toml:26`, `flows-live-worker.js:554`) |
| AGENTS.md: the Worker "turns [the 7500] error into 503 `store_quota` ... serves the last good copy ... instead of a bare 503" | Nightly reads catch the error and answer `store_unreadable` (then last-good); `store_quota` is the answer only for errors that escape `route()`, such as ingest writes (`worker.js:995-997, 3997-3999, 4008-4010`); `lk`/`now` have no last-good fallback |
| AGENTS.md file map: `focus.mjs` and `health.mjs` build "the nightly `focus` and `roster` payload builders" | `focus.mjs` builds only `focus`; `roster` is built by `buildRoster` (`shared/flows-universe.js:177`) inside `retireAndRoster` (`flows-pipeline.mjs:4454`); `health.mjs` builds no payload (part 43) |

### (d) The reading: `readingFor`

Entry is `readingSafe` (flow (b) hop 2). All steps below are `RW:` unless noted.

1. Mode and capability: `readMode(env)` `RW:31` (`off` only for the trimmed, lower-cased value `off`, so `OFF` also turns it off; anything else is on); `chain = aiChain(env)` `AI:75` (`[FLOWS_ASK_MODEL, FLOWS_ASK_FALLBACK_MODEL]`); `canModel = mode on && env.AI && chain.length && env.DB` `RW:176`.
2. If `canModel`: `deps.readRow("read:T")` `RW:183` (`readingDeps.readRow` `W:1708`, `NEURON_ROW_SQL`); a throw sets `storeDown`.
3. Floor `RW:187`: a good row (`llm === 1`, a stored shape, guard not `generating` - `good` `RW:69`) whose fingerprint ends with `"|" + readSignature` (`aiCallSignature + "|r1"` `RW:38-40`) and younger than `AI_INTRADAY_REFRESH_MS = 45 min` (`AI:204`) is returned as `status: "ready", held: "floor"` WITHOUT assembling the dossier (one row read).
4. Otherwise `deps.assemble({own: true, now})` `RW:191` raced against `boxMs` 1500 ms `RW:193-200`: on timeout the assembly continues in `waitUntil` and the answer is `generating` / why `assembling` with no sections.
5. `hasSubstance(dossier)` `R:989` false -> `absentFrom` `RW:160`: status `absent`, why `nothing`, every packet named unknown, no model `RW:206`. Else `tags = heldTags(dossier)` `R:399` (22 codes, thresholds `TAG_LINES` `R:17`, each rule over grade >= 2 facts of ok/partial packets), `fingerprint = dossier.fingerprint + "|" + readSignature` `RW:42,208`.
6. Branch order (first match wins):

| order | test | result | lines |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | `mode === "off"` | deterministic fallback, why `off` (the dossier was already assembled at step 4) | `RW:212` |
| 2 | `!canModel` (no AI binding, no chain, no DB) | fallback, why `no-model` | `RW:213` |
| 3 | `storeDown` | fallback, why `store` | `RW:214` |
| 4 | good row with identical fingerprint | `ready`, `held: "fingerprint"` | `RW:216` |
| 5 | row `guard === "generating"` younger than `READ_GENERATING_MS` (90 s) | fallback shape, status `generating` | `RW:218` |
| 6 | failed row (`!good`, guard set, not generating) inside `cooldownMs(guard)` - the fingerprint is NOT compared | fallback, why `cooldown`, `retryAfterS` | `RW:220-223` |
| 7 | in-isolate `flights` Map holds the ticker | `generating` | `RW:225` |
| 8 | `deps.mark` -> `markNeuronGenerating(scope, fingerprint, chain[0])` `W:1709`; `failed` -> fallback `store`; no `startedAt` (another isolate holds the claim) -> `generating` | | `RW:227-229` |
| 9 | claim won: `generate(...)` started, kept in `flights`, `ctx.waitUntil(work)`; the caller gets the deterministic reading with status `generating` | | `RW:231-239` |

7. `generate` `RW:105-152`: `renderForReading(dossier)` `R:1051` (`forReading` `R:98` drops `options.idea.*`, `noTrade`, `noIdea`, `idea` so no ranked structure can be cited; budget `READING_BUDGET_TOKENS = 4200` `R:5`) -> `promptForReading` `R:1083` (system = the 9-rule `READING_RULES` `R:1055-1081`; user = rendered dossier + `HELD TAGS` block with evidence ids, which stay citable whatever the render shed `R:1091-1104`) -> `askModels(deps.ai(), chain, ..., {maxTokens: READING_MAX_TOKENS 1300, temperature: 0.15})` `RW:112-118` (`deps.ai` = `cappedAi` at 75% of the neuron cap, `W:1711`; `onUsage` -> `askRecordSpend` `W:1712`).
8. Outcomes: no text -> store failure row with `said.guard` (default `unreachable:empty`) `RW:119-122`; reply > `SECTION_CAPS.reply` (7,000) -> `read:overlong` `RW:123-126`; `parseReading` `R:697` null (JSON object from a possibly fenced reply) -> `read:unparsable` `RW:127-131`; `vetReading` `R:716` not ok -> `read:refused` + first 16 refusals `RW:132-136`. Failure rows are `llm 0`, empty summary, `ideas = {v:1, kind:"reading", shape:null, refused}` via `deps.write` -> `writeNeuron` `W:1710,1492`.
9. `vetReading` order, per item (`R:735-746`): `checkText` (shape, cap) -> `checkCites` `R:591` (id exists, ok/partial packet, grade >= 1, was shown to the model) -> `checkNumbers` `R:634` (every numeral appears in a cited fact via the Ask guard's normalisation, with sign/unit checks) -> `checkEntities` `R:663` -> `checkQuote` `R:668` (no run of 7 words, 10 for descriptions, copied from untrusted text) -> `checkDealer` `R:680` (the clause "on the vendor's convention (dealers long calls, short puts)") -> `checkAttribution` `R:675` -> `checkGrounding` `R:684` (identity only, >= 60% grounded in cited profile text). `unknown` entries carry no digits and may only name packets that are not ok `R:767-789`. Tags outside `heldTags` are dropped `R:795-799`. No `now` section, or fewer than two surviving sections, refuses the whole reply `R:803-805`.
10. Success `RW:137-151`: a refused identity is replaced by the template identity (`template: true`); `neuronCost(env, billed, usage)` `RW:44` (neurons from reported usage x `FLOWS_ASK_NEURONS` rates); `readingShape` `R:997` (every cite resolved at write time); `store(summary = identity or now text, shape, llm 1, model, guard = "read:trimmed:N" or null, refused)`.
11. Next read: the stored shape is served as is (`readyFrom` `RW:71`), status `ready`, label "Model wording". While `generating` or in cooldown the page gets `fallbackShape` `RW:154` = `readingFallback` `R:892` (templates over the same facts, every sentence cited and passing the same checks) with a provenance sentence per reason `RW:75-89`. A `generate` throw writes `unreachable:unreachable` `RW:234` (5-minute cooldown).

Cooldowns (`READ_COOLDOWN_MS` `RW:13-26`):

| stored guard | wait |
|---|---|
| `read:refused`, `read:unparsable`, `read:overlong` | 20 min |
| `unreachable:budget`, `unreachable:allowance` | 30 min |
| `unreachable:capacity`, `unreachable:unreachable` | 5 min |
| `unreachable:plan` | 60 min |
| `unreachable:empty`, `unreachable:length` | 60 min (`AI_LENGTH_RETRY_MS` `AI:3`) |
| any other guard | 10 min (`READ_COOLDOWN_DEFAULT_MS` `RW:26`) |

Read shape (`readingShape` `R:997`): `version, status (ready|generating|fallback|absent|unavailable), ticker, generated, label, model, modelName, neurons, tokens, provenance, note, why, fingerprint, asOf, session, generatedAt, coverage, tags[], sections{identity, now, drivers[], tensions[], unknown[], watch[]}, refused[], held?, retryAfterS?`. `why` codes: `off`, `no-model`, `store`, `cooldown`, `generating`, `assembling`, `nothing`, `error`.

### (e) The Ask box

1. Browser: the dock (any gated page except `/flows/ask/`, markup `FP:185-198`, renderer lazily appended by `flows-dock.js` `ensureRenderer` `:16`) or the `/flows/ask/` page (`askPage`, `FP:887`, route `W:3419`) loads `flows-ask.js`. `DOCKED` `FA:10`; `ON_PAGE` = `?t=` of the current URL if it matches `^[A-Z][A-Z0-9.\-]{0,9}$` (`pageTicker` `FA:448`). Submit `FA:832` -> `post(question, ON_PAGE)` `FA:802` -> `POST /api/flows/ask {question, subject}` `FA:803`. An empty question sends nothing and spends no model call `FA:836-844`; a 401 reply redirects to `/flows/` `FA:808`.
2. Gate `W:3601-3605` (method POST only for this path `W:3603`). Route `W:3780`: `askQuestion` `W:1864` (JSON body; `question` trimmed and CUT to `ASK_QUESTION_MAX = 400` `W:1245,1875`; `subject` accepted only if it matches the ticker pattern after upper-casing `W:1859-1862`); `readFlowsPayload(env, "brief")` `W:3785`: absent -> `status: pending|unreadable` body `W:3787-3796`; unparsable -> 500 `brief_unreadable` `W:3802`. `briefWithLive` `W:1324` overlays live flow-alert and pulse facts (`FLOWS_LIVE.liveBriefFeeds` + `FLOWS_ASK.refreshIntradayFacts` `ASK:860`).
3. `askAnswer` `W:1878`: with a `subject` whose `card:S` has panels, `contextFacts(neuronContextFor(card))` (`N:1490`, ids `neuron:S/<key>`) are appended to the fact pool `W:1882-1893`; `selectFacts(pool, question, {subject})` `ASK:991` (named ticker 100, page subject 50, word 10, default max 14); `askDossier` `W:1844` -> `askTicker` `W:1836` (first all-caps 2-5 character token not in `ASK_NOT_TICKERS` `W:1834`, only when the question also has a lowercase letter; else the page subject) -> `askDossierFor` `RW:252` -> `assembleDossier({own:false})` (flow (c); vendor calls possible) -> `hasSubstance` -> `askPick` `R:1133` (question -> up to 5 kinds via `ASK_INTENT` `R:1108`; <= 10 facts, <= 3 untrusted texts rewrapped in `UNTRUSTED«»`, an `about` line naming silent kinds) ; failure -> no extra facts `W:1854-1856`.
4. `picked = selected.concat(dossier.facts)` `W:1900`; `plain = renderFactsPlain(picked, framed)` `W:1905` (`ASK:1255`) is the default answer; `spend = askSpend(env)` `W:1909`; `base` object `W:1910-1922` (`answer`, `llm:false`, `guard`, `why`, `capped`, `withheld`, `subject`, `subjectApplied`, `neuronFacts`, `dossierFacts`, `facts`, `silences`, `briefUpdatedAt`, `model`, `note`, `spend`, `session`).
5. No AI binding or empty chain -> `base` + note "No model is configured" `W:1925-1929`. Else prompt `FLOWS_ASK.promptFor(selected + dossier.promptFacts, framed, age)` `W:1931` (`ASK:1294`), system + `ASK_QUOTE_RULE` `W:1932`, user + `about` `W:1933`; ONE `askModels(meteredAi(env), chain, msgs, {maxTokens: 1024, temperature: 0.2}, onUsage -> askRecordSpend)` `W:1935-1938`.
6. Failure `W:1942-1967`: `said.failure` -> notes from `emptyNote` / `thrownThenEmptyNote` / `FALLBACK_FAILED` `W:1247-1253`, `llmFailure: failed.why`, and `spendDisagrees` when the allowance failure contradicts a meter with credits left; plain answer served. Empty text -> plain answer + `emptyNote` `W:1970-1974`.
7. Guard `W:1976`: `guardAnswer(generated, picked)` (`ASK:1173`) with DEFAULT options: every numeral must appear character for character in a picked fact (years 1900-2100 and, because `smallIntegers` defaults true, 1..12 pass), spelled-out numbers are checked, forecast lexicon (`FORECAST` `ASK:29`) refused, no modal check, no level-mislabel check. Rejected -> plain answer + `guard` + `fallback` + a note saying the wording was discarded `W:1977-1988`; accepted -> `answer: generated, llm: true, model, guard` `W:1989-1990`.
8. Browser `paintAnswer` `FA:501`: spend meter, provenance word from `provenance()` `FA:246-261` (`Model refused` when a guard fired, `Model wording` when the route says a model wrote it, `Wording unstated` when the route does not say, else `Pipeline wording`), a separate `Figures checked` tag only when `guard.numerals.length > 0` `FA:572`, qualifiers, fact grid, silences. The client ignores `dossierFacts`, `neuronFacts` and has no `dossier:` branch in `figureOf`; those facts render through the generic numeric fallback (53-fe-ask-unusual).

The guard is the same function for every model output on the site; options differ: Ask default (above), board summary `{smallIntegers:false}` `W:1415`, Neuron legacy `guardOptions` (`smallIntegers:false, modals:true, levels`) `W:1604,1638`, reading `checkNumbers` `R:634`, screen sentences (test-only).

### (f) The options engine: nightly chain -> card -> Neuron -> desk and strategy

Nightly build (PIPE, run on Actions; areas 40-42, 33-quant-engine):

1. Chains per ticker are collected as `quantRows`; `treasuryRaw` from `/api/economy/treasury-yield` (3-month) `PIPE:5833`; `QP.rateFromRuns` `PIPE:5834` (`scripts/flows-quant-pipeline.mjs:141`): median parity rate from SPX/SPXW/SPY in 20..200 DTE (`QC:163`), else `ln(1 + 3-month yield)` (`QC:178`), else constant 0.04 (`QC:192`).
2. `QP.preparePass` `PIPE:5836` (`flows-quant-pipeline.mjs:160`): per name `chainRowsByExpiry` -> `buildSlices` `QC:198` -> `buildExpiry` `ENG:723` (parity forward in fixed-discount mode, `prepareQuotes` `flows-quant-smile.js:282`, `fitSlice` `flows-quant-smile.js:859`: SVI/SSVI/mixture/flat decision tree with butterfly, calendar and Lee-wing checks) plus `zeroGammaOf` `QC:292` and rr25; then `crossSection` percentile rank (needs >= 10 names).
3. Per carded name `PIPE:6492-6587`: `QP.earningsFromVendor` `PIPE:6492` -> `QP.refitGarch` `PIPE:6493` (GARCH refit excluding earnings days) -> `buildCard` -> `QP.garchLaw` `PIPE:6565` (`flows-quant-pipeline.mjs:114`: seeded 32,768-path scrambled-Sobol GJR skew-t simulation `flows-quant-world.js:269`, `binnedLawsFromSimulation` `flows-quant-world.js:309` -> 64-bin laws at horizons 1,2,3,5,10,21,42,63,126 sessions, drift-neutral; EWMA lognormal fallback, grade 1) -> `regimeState(card)` `PIPE:6566` (`N:586`) -> `QP.engineBlock` `PIPE:6567` -> `runCardEngine` `QC:529` -> `runEngine` `ENG:935` -> `compactEngine` `QC:498` -> `QP.attachEngine` `PIPE:6572` (inline, or `engine:{status:"split", key:"card-x:T"}` with the block in `card-x:T` when the card passes 128 KiB) -> `publish("card-x:"+T)` `PIPE:6585`, `publish("card:"+T)` `PIPE:6586`, `cardTier` -> coverage ledger `PIPE:6587`; `QP.leadIdea` -> `ideas` payload `PIPE:6620`.

`runEngine` `ENG:935-1021` (pure, deterministic; the same code runs in Node, the Worker and the browser bundle):

4. Per expiry `buildExpiry` with the previous slice for calendar checks; the first expiry on/after the earnings date is flagged `firstAfter` so the mixture can be tried `ENG:941-952`. `setupEngine` `ENG:867` builds the context: `eventFor` (bucket from `move.event.ratio` vs 0.8/1.25), `jumpsFor` `ENG:852` (empirical earnings atoms from >= 6 moves, else +-`jq` scaled by realized-over-implied), shared `lawCache`, `qtab`.
5. Family selection: `tierOf` (liquidity A/B/C by median relative spread of OTM quotes with forward delta .25-.75) `ENG:956`; `scoreFamilies` `ST:153` (affinity x grade/3 over IV-rank, VRP, term, skew, event, liquidity buckets, plus Neuron-state preference; vetoes `state.avoid`, `family.desk-only`, `state.undetermined`, `liq.tier-c`, `dir.none`, `dir.against`); `chooseExpiry` `ENG:805` per family (`expiry.none` veto); `eventVeto`/`eventAffinity` `ENG:967-974` (`event.inside` for short-vol/credit families); keep unvetoed families with score > 0, top 5 `ENG:978-979`.
6. Candidates `ENG:980-993`: each chosen family x `DELTA_TARGETS[family]` variant, `buildLegs` `ST:273` (wall/flip/one-sigma snapping) or `buildMulti` `ENG:1023` (calendar, diagonal); dedupe; stop at 24 (`MAX_CANDIDATES`). The 22 structure families are `STRUCTURES` `ST:8` (row 23 is `no-position`, never priced).
7. `priceCandidate` `ENG:525-661`: per leg the listed NBBO quote, smile vol `sliceVolK`, Black-76 model price (`black76` `flows-quant-bs.js:120`), forward delta, per-leg liquidity gate `legGate` `ST:466`; cost basis `mid` / `natural` / `fill = mid + 0.25 (natural - mid)` `ENG:547-551`.
8. Laws `ENG:557-560`: Q = `lawFromSlice(front.slice)` (analytic risk-neutral law of the fitted smile); P = `ctx.lawsOf` -> `lawsFor` `ENG:492`: horizon `max(1/390, hSessions)`, `binsAtHorizon(pLaw, h, F/S)` (interpolated between the nightly knots, drift-neutral), `overlayJumps` when the expiry contains earnings; earnings inside the expiry with no jump atoms withholds the P law (grade 0, `world.event-missing` `ENG:500`); alternates are lognormals at `ewmaVol` and `coneMedianVol`.
9. EV and PoP `ENG:562-582`: single expiry uses the exact piecewise-linear payoff `expiryProfile` `ENG:73` and `lawExpect` `ENG:121` (`A + B*mean + sum hinge_i * lawHinge(law, K_i)`); multi-expiry uses `calibrateBackLegs` `ENG:210`, `multiProfile` `ENG:241`, `lawIntegrate`. `evQ = (D*E_Q - cost)*100`, `evP = (D*E_P[main] - cost)*100`, `edge = D*(E_P - E_Q)*100`, `pBand` = min/max over the P-law variants `ENG:575-580`; `popQ = lawIntervalsProb(qLaw, profitIntervals)`, `popP` under the main P law `ENG:581-582`; short-strike touch probabilities `touchProbability` `ENG:585-588`; capital (defined risk = max loss; undefined = Reg-T style `regTCapital` `ENG:438`) `ENG:583`; `score = evP / capital` `ENG:657`.
10. Grades `ENG:596-618`: `fit` (`fitGrade` `ENG:391`), `liquidity` (a failed leg gate 0, slippage over 20% of price 1, every leg tight 3, else 2 `ENG:600-605`), `model` (P-law grade), `edge` (`edgeGrade` `ENG:413`), `event` (`eventGrade` `ENG:423`); `combineGrade` `ENG:430` = minimum of parts, capped at 2 for undefined risk and at 1 for a stale card.
11. `rankStructures` `ENG:829-850`: eligible = grade >= 1, finite `ev.p > 0`, positive under every law (`holdsUnderEveryLaw` `ENG:827`: lowest of `pBand` > 0), finite score; sort by score, grade, `popP`, id; first idea is defined-risk (state-preferred if possible); fill to 3 ideas from distinct families (the first idea may never be undefined-risk). No idea -> `noTrade {code, closest}` with `code` in order `candidates.none` (no structure priced) / `model.none` (no finite real-world EV) / `risk.undefined-only` (eligible but none defined-risk to lead) / `grade.none` (positive-EV structures all grade < 1) / `ev.none-positive` `ENG:846-848`. Structure ids `S1..Sn` are positional (`ENG:999`).
12. Detail (grid, tail, optional curves) only for ideas and the `closest` structure `ENG:1003-1007`; output `{engine, ticker, asOf, spot, liquidity, expiries, families, structures, ideas, noTrade}` `ENG:1008-1018`.

Rate: the card's `engine.rate.r`, else `PRICING_RATE` 0.04 (`PRM:29`) `W:2252-2253`.
16. Coherence gate `W:2254-2268`: `coherence(...)` `BAS:279-301`: counts impossible asks (ask more than $0.01 below intrinsic), tests the strike bracket the `maybe_otm_only` request guarantees, fits one underlying spot to the nearest expiries (grid +-5% then golden section, `fitQuotesAt`). `rebased` when the fit moves the spot by more than `BASIS_TOLERANCE` 0.0025 AND improves the fit >= 3x (`FIT_MIN_GAIN`); `mismatch` only when the fit failed AND (bracket flagged OR >= 2 impossible asks `EVIDENCE_OFF_MARKET`); a thrown check becomes `status: "unchecked"` with a `console.warn` `W:2259-2263`. `mismatch` -> `offMarketChain` `W:2192` (no rows, reason text); otherwise `rankChain(rows, {spot: found.spot, asOf, strategy, rankBy, limit: 120, ticker, readMs, rate})` `PRM:262`: `priceSale` `PRM:111` for each short put / covered call at the bid, foreign roots and impossible quotes dropped, `DEFAULT_GATES` `PRM:241` (spread <= 15%, OI >= 100, premium >= $5, 1..400 DTE), sort by `RANK_KEYS` `PRM:252`, `attachMidIv`, `ivConvention` `PRM:77`, `ivSurface` `PRM:344`.
17. `crossesEarnings` per ranked row `W:2270-2276` (`PRM:544`); `engine: deskEngine(card, Date.now())` `W:2304`.
18. Browser `DK:215-247` `fetchOne` (3 concurrent via `runPool`) -> `price(sym, payload)` `DK:258`: per row `Q.contractFit(input)` `QC:671` (own IV from the quote, shape from the nearest card SVI or flat) -> `Q.labSetup({..., books:[{fit, rows:[row]}], lawCache})` `QC:708` -> `Q.priceStructure(setup, {family: "short-put"|"covered-call", expiry, legs, basis:"natural"})` `ENG:908` -> `r.__eng` (EV, implied and real-world win %, grades). If no fit: `Q.contractDiagnosis` `QC:636` explains the dash. Annualised yield, cushion and collateral stay server-owned (`rankChain`); only win % and EV are priced in the page (52-fe-ticker-desk).

Strategy path (`W:3856-3880`): context mode `buildStrategyContext` `W:2361`; expiry mode `buildStrategyExpiry` `W:2460` with `engine=1`: spot = live `stock-state` close, else `card.engine.spot` `W:2536-2539`; `strategyEngine` `W:2435-2458` runs `runCardEngine({ticker, asOfMs: Date.now(), spot, expiries:[{expiry, rows: bookRows(...)}], rate, facts, state, pLaw, levels, event, atr, fits:true, stale: engineStale(...)})` with every input except the spot and the book read from the card's own block; `lawFrom: "card"` only when the block carries a `pLaw`. The browser then runs `Q.labSetup` / `Q.structureLegs` / `Q.priceStructure` with the same code (flows-strategy.js, full bundle).

### (g) The real-time rail

Client ladder (`CRT`; constants `CRT:6-32`): socket -> `GET /api/rt/snap` every 5 s -> the pages' own heartbeats (`FR:109`) -> `off`.

1. A page script calls `UI.rt.connect({topics, focus})` `CRT:744` (handles are refcounted by `topics|focus`; an identical key returns the same handle `CRT:750-751`); `reconcile` -> `begin` `CRT:683` (reads the `sessionStorage["flows:rt:off"]` memo: a 403/404 within 10 min starts `off`, `CRT:565-577,686-687`; registers visibility/pagehide/pageshow) -> `openSocket` `CRT:546`.
2. `new WebSocket(wss://host/api/rt/ws?k=<topics>&f=<focus>)` `CRT:552`; a 10 s `hello` deadline `CRT:557`; no `WebSocket` -> `startPoll(0)` `CRT:548`.
3. Worker: `route` `W:3889-3891` -> `serveRt` `RTR:16`, gate order: `rtSwitches(env).mode !== "on"` -> 404 `rt_off` even for an anonymous caller `RTR:17-18`; `env.PULSE` missing -> 404 `rt_off` `RTR:19-22`; path not one of ws/snap/status -> 404 `not_found` `RTR:23-24`; non-GET -> 405 `RTR:25`; no Flows session -> 401 `RTR:26-27`; `status` owner-only (403 `forbidden`), others `rtAdmits` (403 `rt_forbidden`) `RTR:28-32`; bad `k` -> 400 `invalid_topic` `RTR:33-34`; `ws`: `Upgrade: websocket` else 426 `RTR:40-42`, `requireSameOrigin` `RTR:43`, `f` against `TICKER_RE` -> 400 `RTR:44-45`; every client `X-RT-*` header and the cookie stripped, `X-RT-User` / `X-RT-Exp` set from the verified session `RTR:48-52`; `stub.fetch("https://pulse.internal/ws?...")` on the single object `pulse:1` (`RT_OBJECT_NAME` `RT:13`, location hint `FLOWS_RT_HINT`) `RTR:35,53`. A non-HttpError throw is 503 `rt_unavailable` + `Retry-After: 5` `RTR:58-61`. `status` comes back from the object and the route appends `worker: {mode, audience, users, hint, binding: true}` `RTR:62-68`. `finalize` copies the 101 with `new Response(response.body, response)` so `webSocket` survives.
4. `Pulse.fetch` `HUB:887`: mode off -> 404 `rt_off` `HUB:889`; `/ws` -> `upgrade` `HUB:900`: requires a valid `X-RT-User` (`MEMBER_NAME`) and numeric `X-RT-Exp` else 401 `HUB:904-908`; `WebSocketPair`, `ctx.acceptWebSocket(server, ["u:"+u])` `HUB:913`, `hub.admit` `HUB:526`: mode check (`bye 4011`), per-user cap `userCap` 3 (`bye 4009`), hub-full 200 sockets (`bye 4012`) `HUB:528-532`; socket state stored with `serializeAttachment({u, exp, k, f})` `HUB:538,553-555`; `start(now)` if not running `HUB:539`; `hello` frame `helloFor` `HUB:508-524` (meta `{transport:"ws", upstream:"rest", mode, audience, topics, hbS:5, cold, phase, session, f}`, `rows` = one snapshot per subscribed topic) and a `closed` frame when outside session `HUB:541-545`; `arm(10)` `HUB:917`; response 101 `HUB:918`.
5. Client `receive` `CRT:518-544`: `bye` -> `onBye` `CRT:526`; `hello` -> `helloed`, `stopPoll`, `setMode("socket")`, `noteEpoch`, apply embedded snapshots through `frame`, arm the 30 s `pulse` (`{t:"p", sq}` laggard report) and send `{t:"sub"}` when topics/focus changed `CRT:527-540`; each message re-arms the silence watchdog (16 s, or `hbS*3.2` s, 100 s when closed) `CRT:431-434,542`.
6. Alarm loop: `Pulse.alarm` `HUB:876` -> `RtHub.tick` `HUB:725`: (i) mode != on -> `shutdown(4011)` `HUB:729`; (ii) `sweep` closes sockets past their cookie `exp` with `bye 4001` and picks the top-8 focus tickers `HUB:600-614`; (iii) no `demand` (no live socket and no `/snap` in the last 60 s) -> `stop()`, return null (no new alarm) `HUB:731`; (iv) not running -> `start` with `notify: "restart"` when sockets exist (hibernation wake) `HUB:732-735`; (v) `ensureRoster` (D1 every 5 min, 3 s timeout) `HUB:736,616`; (vi) `phaseAt` (trading days, 04:00-20:00 ET): outside it broadcast `closed` once per reason+day, `beat(closed)` every 30 s, sleep `min(30 s, time to open)` `HUB:740-750`; (vii) in session: rollover of `phase.session` restarts with `notify:"session"` `HUB:753`, `refreshSession` (prior-close base, gex rotation) `HUB:755`, `refreshNames` `HUB:756`, `await upstream.tick(now)` `HUB:757`; (viii) `evaluate` (degrade/recover) `HUB:760`, `beat` (heartbeat if nothing was broadcast for 5 s) `HUB:761`, return `max(50, 1000 - elapsed)` ms `HUB:762`; `Pulse.alarm` sets the next alarm at `Date.now() + max(25, delay)` `HUB:884`, or after an exception 2 s while demanded `HUB:882`.
7. REST upstream `createRestUpstream` `HUB:57`: `tick` `HUB:196` polls every topic whose `due` has passed and is not in flight (all five topics are always in `plan.topics` `HUB:272`, whatever the sockets subscribed) unless paused by a 429; `poll` `HUB:133`: budget `take` (240 calls per minute default, `HUB:269`), `RT_UPSTREAM[k].rest(args)` `RT:75-96`, `Promise.all(calls.map(call))` with a 4 s abort `HUB:74-101,152`, `RT_REST_SHAPE[k]` (`RT:554`) to a neutral frame, `answered:false` is a failure, then `handlers.onFrame`. Staggered start offsets px 0, gx 250, mk 500, fl 750, nw 1000 ms `HUB:187`.

| topic | cadence | vendor request (`RT_UPSTREAM`, `RT:75-96`) | merge | stored-key twin | class: cadence/live/stale s (`flows-freshness.js:9-11`) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `px` | 5 s | `/api/screener/stocks?ticker=<names>&limit=500` | latest by vendor quote time | `live:strips` | `rt` 5/15/60 |
| `fl` | 5 s | `/api/option-trades/flow-alerts?limit=200&newer_than=<cursor>` | append, dedupe by alert id | `live:alerts` | `rt` |
| `gx` | 1 s | `/api/stock/<name>/spot-exposures` (one name per call, rotation + focus) | latest | `live:gex` | `rtSlow` 10/30/120 |
| `mk` | 10 s | `TIER1_CALLS` (market-tide, sector-etfs): 2 calls | latest | `live:market` | `rtSlow` |
| `nw` | 30 s | `/api/news/headlines?limit=100` | append | `live:news` | `rtNews` 30/75/300 |

Cadences `RT:62-68`; about 98 vendor calls a minute with a viewer (px 12, fl 12, gx 60, mk 12, nw 2) against the 240 budget, zero with no viewer (35-rail).

8. Frames and sequences: `onUpstream` `HUB:414` -> `mergeTopic` -> `emit` `HUB:453-475`: `counter.next(k)` gives one sequence per topic (a shared counter manufactured false gaps); a delta goes to sockets that already hold a snapshot (`st.have`), a snapshot to those that do not. Envelope `{v:1, k, ep, sq, at, snap?, fresh, meta, rows}` (frozen in `RT:21,130-145`); `ctl` frames (`hello`, `hb`, `resync`, `degraded`, `closed`, `bye`) carry `sq` 0. `streamEntry` `RT:171`: a stamped frame (`px`, `gx`, `mk`) is `live` only when the newest vendor timestamp is within `liveS` (+ bar width: gx 60 s, mk 300 s) of the hub's read; otherwise `fresh` with reason `vendor-lag` / `vendor-unstamped` / `vendor-skew`, `stale` past `staleS`.
9. Client frame handling `CRT:338-363`: ignore topics with no refs, oversized (> 2,000 rows) or non-numeric `sq`; epoch change on a non-snapshot = orphan -> `resync` + `ask(k)`; on a snapshot `reset` then adopt; snapshot -> `applySnap` `CRT:241`; `resync` flag holds deltas; `sq === T.sq + 1` -> `applyDelta` `CRT:296`; `sq <= T.sq` duplicate; else gap -> `T.resync = true`, `ask(k)` sends `{t:"rs", k}` at most once per 2.2 s (`RS_GAP_MS` 2,600 minus 400), re-armed every 2.6 s, 5 tries (`RS_TRIES`), then `dead("resync")` `CRT:204-215`. Server `onMessage` `HUB:557-593`: > 20 messages per 10 s -> close 1008; binary/oversize/invalid -> close 1009 (neither is preceded by `ctl.bye`); `sub` re-snapshots changed topics; `p` with a topic more than 10 frames behind -> `bye 4008`; `rs` answered with a snapshot at most every 2 s per topic.
10. Degrade and recovery `evaluate` `HUB:672-705`: a topic is down when a throttle error occurred since the last evaluate, or it has failures and its last success is older than `max(3*cadence, 15 s)`, or the upstream is paused by a 429 past that line; first time (or a changed reason) broadcast `ctl.degraded {reason, k, since, retryAt}`; recovery -> `resync(topics, "recovered")` `HUB:489-506` bumps each topic's counter and re-sends snapshots with the epoch unchanged. 429 handling `HUB:103-116`: pause `max(Retry-After, 5 s * 2^n)` capped 120 s, jittered; other errors back off `min(15 s, cadence * 2^fails)`.
11. Hibernation: the DO keeps no storage rows. `sockState` `HUB:329-341` rebuilds `{u, exp, topics, f}` from the socket attachment; the constructor re-arms an alarm after 50 ms when `ctx.getWebSockets()` is non-empty `HUB:863`; the next tick finds `running === false` and `start(..., {notify:"restart"})` `HUB:732-733`, which sets a new epoch `max(now, ep + 1)` `HUB:377`, clears every socket's `have` set `HUB:381` and broadcasts `ctl.resync {reason:"restart"}` `HUB:383`; clients see the new `ep`, reset and take snapshots. `Pulse.release` `HUB:941-945` stops the hub and deletes the alarm when the last socket closes with no recent `/snap`. A deploy restarts the object the same way.
12. Poll rung `CRT:595-651`: `lost()`/`ended()`/`dead()` `CRT:478-504` -> `fallback()` `CRT:472` -> `startPoll(0)`; `GET /api/rt/snap?k=...` (`credentials: same-origin`, `cache: no-store`, 8 s abort) every 5 s; `RTR:55` -> `Pulse.fetch /snap` `HUB:891-895` -> `hub.snap` `HUB:781-799`: `lastSnapAt = now` (so demand lingers 60 s), `start` if needed, in session with a cold topic `host.wake(10)` + `waitData(ks, 3000)`, else wake in one tick; frames = snapshots + a `closed` and a `degraded` ctl when applicable, headers `X-Fresh-*` of the worst frame (`worstEntry`/`entryHeaders` `RT:192-198`). Client applies them as snapshots, `setMode("poll")`; status in `FINAL = {400, 401, 403, 404}` `CRT:27` -> `goFinal` -> `off` (403/404 memoised 10 min); three consecutive failures -> mode `heartbeat`; a `closed` frame stops polling until `nextOpenAt` `CRT:645`. The socket is probed again after jitter(1, 2, 4, 8 s) then every 60 s `CRT:478-483`; a `bye` whose code is in `KEEP_OFF` (4001, 4003, 4009, 4011, 4012, `CRT:28`) does not retry quickly: `ended()` falls back to the poll rung and re-probes the socket after one jittered 60 s `CRT:492-499`; any other close or error goes through `lost()` and the 1-2-4-8 s ladder; a `hello` ends polling.
13. Hidden tab: after 30 s `hibernate` `CRT:653` closes the socket and stops timers; visible -> `resume` `CRT:660`. `pagehide` closes with 1001 `CRT:690`.
