### (h) The AI budget

Model call sites (the only five; `tests/flows-neuron.mjs:805-807` and `tests/flows-reading-worker.mjs:336-344` scan for zero `env.AI.run(`, four `askModels(meteredAi(env),` in `worker.js`, exactly one `ai: () => cappedAi(` and one `askModels(deps.ai(),` in the reading):

| Site | Where | Wrapper | Output cap / temperature | Cap that applies |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Board summary (cron `15,45 * * * *`) | `W:1405-1408` | `meteredAi(env)` `W:1297` | 1024 / 0.2 | 30,000 neurons / 2,500 calls |
| Neuron, engine path | `W:1580-1581` | `meteredAi` | 500 / 0.1 | same |
| Neuron, legacy prose path (<= 2 attempts) | `W:1611-1613` | `meteredAi` | 1400 / 0.2, reparse 0.05 | same |
| Ask | `W:1935-1938` | `meteredAi` | 1024 / 0.2 | same |
| Reading | `RW:112-118` | `deps.ai()` = `cappedAi({...env, FLOWS_AI_DAILY_CAP_NEURONS: floor(cap * 0.75)}, readSpend)` `W:1711` | 1300 / 0.15 | 22,500 neurons (`READ_BUDGET_SHARE` `RW:11`), calls cap unchanged |

1. Every `ai.run` is inside `askModels` `AI:220-268`: it walks the chain (`FLOWS_ASK_MODEL` `@cf/zai-org/glm-4.7-flash`, then `FLOWS_ASK_FALLBACK_MODEL` `@cf/meta/llama-3.3-70b-instruct-fp8-fast`; `aiChain` `AI:75`, `wrangler.toml:43-46`), builds the model-specific input `modelInput` `AI:7-17` (chat-completions shape with thinking off for `@cf/zai-org/*`, `max_tokens` otherwise), and calls `ai.run(model, input)` where `ai` is the capped wrapper.
2. `cappedAi(env, readSpend)` `AI:151-165` returns `{run}`: it awaits `readSpend()` (a throw becomes `spend = undefined`), computes `budgetVerdict(env, spend)` `AI:130-149` and, if spent, throws `Error("FLOWS_AI_BUDGET_SPENT: <reason>")` BEFORE the binding is touched. `readSpend` is `askSpendStrict` `W:1280` = one D1 batch of two SELECTs (`flows_ai_usage` and `flows_ai_usage_model` for the UTC day `aiDay()` `W:1255`); with no `env.DB` the reader is null and the verdict is "not spent" `AI:139`.
3. `budgetVerdict` order `AI:130-149`: either cap equal to 0 -> spent ("the daily budget is set to zero"); `spend === undefined` (unreadable meter) -> spent; `spend === null` (no store) -> not spent; `neuronsSpent(spend) >= neuronCap` -> spent; `calls >= callCap` -> spent. `neuronsSpent` `AI:122-128` uses the meter's `neurons` when finite, else prices the day's tokens at `AI_WORST_RATES` (26,668 in / 204,805 out per million, the dearest model on the plan, `AI:111`). Caps: `aiCapNeurons` `AI:119` and `aiCapCalls` `AI:120` accept only whole non-negative integers from `FLOWS_AI_DAILY_CAP_NEURONS` (30,000) and `FLOWS_AI_DAILY_CAP_CALLS` (2,500), else the defaults `AI:109-110` (`wrangler.toml:47-48`).
4. Failure mapping `askFailure` `AI:45-68`: message starting `FLOWS_AI_BUDGET_SPENT` -> `budget`; codes 3036 -> `allowance`, 3040 -> `capacity`, 5035 -> `plan`; anything else (5006 matches the regex but has no case) -> `unreachable`. `askModels` stops the chain on `allowance` or `budget` (no dearer fallback after a spent budget) `AI:236`; a thrown model falls through to the next with an `ai failover` log `AI:237-242`. Empty/length stops give guards `unreachable:empty` / `unreachable:length` `AI:217-218,253-266`.
5. Usage recording: after a successful `ai.run`, `askModels` calls `onUsage(model, out && out.usage)` `AI:244-246` (errors swallowed); every site passes `askRecordSpend(env, usage, billedModel)` `W:1299-1322`: `INSERT ... ON CONFLICT` upserts into `flows_ai_usage` (`calls + 1`, token sums) and `flows_ai_usage_model` in ONE batch; a missing `usage` object, a missing DB, or any error returns null and records nothing (calls are therefore counted only after success; budget refusals and thrown models count nothing).
6. Meter shape `spendShape` `AI:167-195`: per-model neurons from `FLOWS_ASK_NEURONS` (`5500,36400`) / `FLOWS_ASK_FALLBACK_NEURONS` (`26668,204805`) via `modelRates` `AI:95`; `neurons: null` when any model's rate is unknown (then the cap prices at worst rates); `remaining` is against the 10,000-neuron free allowance `AI_DAILY_NEURONS` `AI:106`, not against the 30,000 cap. `GET /api/flows/ai-usage` `W:3720` exposes it; the Ask page draws it.
7. What a spent budget does to each surface: Neuron engine path -> `engineFallback` stored with guard `unreachable:budget` (`W:1582`), retried after 5 min (`retryableGuard` `AI:197`, `NEURON_RETRY_MS` `W:1448,1813`); Neuron legacy -> deterministic summary + own ideas, same guard `W:1619`; reading -> deterministic reading, cooldown 30 min (`RW:17-18`) with the provenance sentence from `describeGuard`; Ask -> plain answer, `llmFailure: "budget"` and a note `W:1966`; board summary -> plain summary, `unreachable:budget`, retried on the next 15/45 firing because `retryableGuard` is true `W:1358,1375`.
8. Reading share: because the meter is shared, the reading refuses once the day's TOTAL spend reaches 22,500 neurons, leaving the last 7,500 to the Neuron, the Ask box and the board summary, which refuse at 30,000.
9. Regeneration triggers that spend: `aiCallSignature` hashes the model chain into every stored fingerprint, so changing `FLOWS_ASK_MODEL` or the fallback regenerates every Neuron, board summary and reading on its next read (`AI:82`, `W:1352`, `W:1802`, `RW:38`); manual invalidators are `AI_CALL_EPOCH` `AI:1`, `READING_VERSION` `R:4`, `DOSSIER_VERSION` `D:3`, `NEURON_CONTEXT_VERSION` `N:6`. Throttles on spend: reading floor 45 min `RW:187`, Neuron retry 5 min, cooldown table above, board-summary `intradayFloorMs` `AI:206`.
10. Off switches: `FLOWS_ASK_MODEL` empty -> `aiChain` `[]` -> deterministic everywhere (`W:1925`, `RW:213`, `W:1598`); a cap of `"0"` -> every call refused as spent; `FLOWS_READ_MODE=off` -> reading only `RW:31-34,212`.

### Source versus docs and traps on these paths

| # | Statement in AGENTS.md / DEPLOY.md | Source | Consequence |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | The dossier fingerprint "excludes grades and ages" | `dossierFingerprint` `D:1727-1739` hashes each fact's grade and, for quote/tape/market/breadth/news packets, `round(log2(1 + ageS/1800))`; the bucket flips at about 12 min, 55 min, 2.3 h, 5.2 h, 10.8 h | a live-class packet crossing a bucket can change the reading fingerprint; bounded by the 45-minute floor `RW:187` |
| 2 | The quote (5 s) is a dossier Cache API entry | the dossier writes none (`DW:510` skips `quote`; `FAST_TTL_S.quote` `DW:22` is never read); the quote is cached by `serveQuote` under `flows-live.internal/<T>` with the phase TTL `LW:929-933,946-987` | DEPLOY.md 10.5l's `.../quote/<T>` entry does not exist |
| 3 | `FLOWS_READ_MODE=off` means "no row read and no model call" | true, but `RW:191` assembles the dossier before the mode test `RW:212`, so vendor fan-out (<= 9 calls) still happens for an off reading | `off` saves model spend, not vendor spend |
| 4 | "A server-side close is always preceded by `ctl.bye`" | only `bye()` `HUB:368` (4001, 4008, 4009, 4011, 4012) sends it; flood 1008 `HUB:562`, bad message 1009 `HUB:564` and `Pulse.webSocketMessage` error `HUB:926` close directly | clients treat those as ordinary losses and reconnect with backoff |
| 5 | The page goes `off` on 401, 403 or 404 | `FINAL = {400, 401, 403, 404}` `CRT:27`; 403/404 are memoised 10 min in `sessionStorage["flows:rt:off"]` `CRT:30-32,565-577` | not in AGENTS.md |
| 6 | Reading cooldowns: refused/unparsable/overlong 20, budget/allowance 30, capacity 5, plan 60, empty/length 60 | also `unreachable:unreachable` 5 min and a 10-minute default `RW:20,26` | unlisted guards wait 10 minutes |
| 7 | The Ask box "answers from payloads already published, places no vendor call" (`GUARANTEE` string, `FA:384`, shown by the page and the dock) | for a named ticker `askDossier` `W:1844-1857` assembles the dossier (D1 + Cache API + <= 9 vendor calls through `UW_ONDEMAND`) | the copy is stronger than the route (53-fe-ask-unusual invariant 18) |
| 8 | The rail polls "while at least one socket, or one `/api/rt/snap` request in the last 60 s, exists" (AGENTS.md); read as per-topic demand | `plan.topics` is the full five-topic set `HUB:272`; `demand()` counts sockets and `/snap` readers only `HUB:349` | a `fl`-only page costs the same ~98 calls a minute; `gx` (60 of them) has no page consumer |
| 9 | A reading's usage "is recorded where the cap reads it" (AGENTS.md); read as every call is metered | a response without a `usage` object records nothing `W:1300`, `AI:245` | such a call is invisible to the meter |
| 10 | `AGENTS.md` lists 13 dossier reducers | 11 in `REDUCERS` `DV:342`; earnings is `earningsHistory` inline `DW:273-282`, quote is `quoteExtract` | `DOSSIER_READS` covers 12 routes (no quote) |

Two further small disagreements, found while re-reading the source:

| # | Statement | Source | Consequence |
|---|---|---|---|
| 11 | AGENTS.md gives the dossier `coverage` as `{ ok, partial, withheld, pending }` | `buildDossier` `D:1480-1481` counts five statuses, `{ ok, partial, withheld, unavailable, pending }`, and `readingFor` adds `withheld + unavailable` for the absent shape `RW:167` | a client that sums the four documented counts misses `unavailable` packets |
| 12 | AGENTS.md: "a client closes its own end on [the bye] and does not reconnect on 4009, 4011 or 4012" (read literally) | `ended()` `CRT:492-499` treats 4001, 4003, 4009, 4011 and 4012 alike: poll rung now, one jittered 60 s socket probe later, never the fast 1-2-4-8 s ladder | the page keeps working on `/api/rt/snap` and re-asks for a socket about once a minute |

Traps that bite when changing these paths:

1. `markNeuronGenerating` (`W:1479-1483`) replaces the prior row with an empty `generating` row; a failed regeneration leaves a failure row where a good model row used to be. `writeNeuron` is guarded (`W:1499`) so an older slow generator cannot overwrite a newer claim.
2. Two separate 90 s constants must stay equal and nothing enforces it: `NEURON_GENERATING_MS` `W:1447` (SQL takeover cutoff) and `READ_GENERATING_MS` `RW:9` (display window).
3. `assembleDossier`'s single flight returns the in-flight promise whatever `own`/`now`/`fresh` the second caller passed `DW:317-319`; the reading's `flights` Map `RW:103` is per isolate, so cross-isolate exclusion rests on the D1 claim alone.
4. The reading cooldown test does not compare fingerprints `RW:220-223`: after a refused attempt the page keeps the deterministic reading for the full cooldown even if the dossier changed.
5. A `NEURON_CONTEXT_VERSION` bump invalidates `ticker:` rows (`W:1807`) but not `read:` rows (the `version` column is not checked on read); bump `READING_VERSION` or `DOSSIER_VERSION` for those.
6. `deskEngine` publishes no structures; the desk prices only the sale it ranks. `short-put`, `covered-call` and `collar` carry the `desk` flag and are vetoed `family.desk-only` in `runEngine` unless `scoreFamilies` receives `desk`; `runCardEngine` never passes it, so they never appear among nightly ideas (33-quant-engine trap 9).
7. `ENGINE_VERSION = "q1"` exists twice (`ENG:13`, `flows-quant-world.js:10`); the seed key uses the world copy, the published block the engine copy; bump both.
8. `window.FlowsUI` is replaced, not extended, by `flows-fresh.js` and `flows-rt.js`; a page script that runs before them silently loses streaming.
9. `shared/flows-rt.js` (Worker/Node wire contract) and `assets/js/flows-rt.js` (browser IIFE) are different files that share no code; `Pulse` (the Durable Object) is unrelated to `shared/flows-pulse.js` / the `pulse` nightly key.
10. `RT_UPSTREAM[k].channels` are metadata for a future WebSocket upstream; the hub calls only `start/stop/tick/paused/state` on its upstream (`RT_UPSTREAM_API`), and a seam test forbids REST detail inside the `RtHub` class body (35-rail).
11. Weight ceilings on the ticker (924 B), desk (173 B) and unusual (163 B) pages are nearly full; any growth of `flows-rt.js`, the quant bundles or the page scripts needs a deliberate ceiling change plus the asset-version ritual (increment `assets/version.txt` to the next integer, every `?v=` and `ASSET_VERSION` `FP:1`, the fonts token untouched).

### Tests that pin these paths, and which need workerd

Classification checked against the suites' own imports (`startWorker` / `worker-server` references) and the AGENTS.md "Which suites need the dev server" lists; timings and assertion counts are the ones AGENTS.md reports, not re-measured here. Run server suites with `FLOWS_TEST_SANDBOX=1`; the Chromium suites need `PLAYWRIGHT_BROWSERS_PATH`; `node:sqlite` suites need Node 22.13 or newer and `--disable-warning=ExperimentalWarning` (`tests/package.json` scripts `test:flows-reads`, `test:flows-rt`).

### Flows page to data: lookup path [30-flows-server-core, 11-worker-b, 50-fe-core]

```text
GET /flows/<page>/
  worker.js:3428 (FLOWS_ROUTES at 3409)  anonymous (worker.js:3437) ----> shared/flows-pages.js:328  (form POST /flows/login, worker.js:3350)
        | signed in (flows_session cookie)
        v
  shared/flows-pages.js <name>Page()  ---- head(): base.css, flows.css, route sheet  (shared/flows-pages.js:5)
        |                              shell(): sprite, sidebar, toolbar #fxFresh, main, tab bar, dock  (shared/flows-pages.js:312)
        v
  deferred scripts, document order:
     flows-dock.js -> flows-ui.js -> [flows-fresh.js] -> [flows-rt.js] -> [quant bundle] -> page controller
        |                ^ UI_SCRIPT shared/flows-pages.js:310   flowsDocument shared/flows-pages.js:1029
        v
  controller IIFE reads window.FlowsUI, fetch("/api/flows/...") ---> window.fetch wrapper assets/js/flows-ui.js:1818 (401/403 gate, pill feed)
        |-- heartbeat: GET /api/flows/now every 20/30/60 s  assets/js/flows-fresh.js:122
        '-- rail: WebSocket /api/rt/ws assets/js/flows-rt.js:81, fallback GET /api/rt/snap every 5 s assets/js/flows-rt.js:617
```

1. Route: find the page in the table at the end of this chapter (`FLOWS_ROUTES` entry in `worker.js`, page function in `shared/flows-pages.js`).
2. Assets: the page function names its stylesheet and scripts (`flowsDocument` `scripts`/`styles`, or inline tags); the controller is the last script.
3. Fetch: find the controller in the page sections above (fetch layer rows) to get the exact `/api/flows/<name>` calls.
4. Handler: look the endpoint up in the endpoint index below for the `worker.js` line.
5. Producer: the stored key is written by a `publish("<key>")` stage of `main()` (pipeline main() stages) or by a Tier 2 `put("live:<key>")` (Legs, live tier).
6. Builder: the leg that shapes the payload is in the nightly data legs section; the pure builder is in `shared/` (areas 31, 32).
7. Pin: `flows-payload-shape` fails when a renderer reads a root field the emitted payload lacks; each page also has a render suite in the Tests sections.

### Hop chains between areas [40-pipeline-a, 41-pipeline-b, 42-pipeline-c, 43-legs-live, 45-probes-workflows, 11-worker-b, 50-fe-core, 62-tests-c]

**Nightly key, cron to pixel**

1. Start: cron `.github/workflows/flows-pipeline.yml:5` (DST-gated by `.github/workflows/flows-pipeline.yml:50`), or the Worker `nightlyTick` (`shared/flows-live-worker.js:554`, called at `worker.js:3982`), or the live loop `scripts/flows-legs/starts.mjs:39`.
2. Runner: fixture dry run `.github/workflows/flows-pipeline.yml:78`, then the real run `.github/workflows/flows-pipeline.yml:88` enters `main` `scripts/flows-pipeline.mjs:4675`.
3. Guards: env check `scripts/flows-pipeline.mjs:4684`, `intradayRefusal` `scripts/flows-pipeline.mjs:4700`, `sameSessionGate` `scripts/flows-pipeline.mjs:4708` (skip branch `scripts/flows-pipeline.mjs:4723`).
4. Reads and ranking: vendor `uw` `scripts/flows-pipeline.mjs:533` -> `enrich` `scripts/flows-pipeline.mjs:876` -> `computeFeatures` `scripts/flows-pipeline.mjs:1158` -> `scoreBoard` `scripts/flows-pipeline.mjs:5006`.
5. Legs: `runMarketLegs` `scripts/flows-pipeline.mjs:5256` (market.mjs), `runVolLeg` `scripts/flows-pipeline.mjs:6397`, `runFlowLeg` `scripts/flows-pipeline.mjs:6752`, `buildIndexDossiers` `scripts/flows-pipeline.mjs:6790`, `buildFocusPayload` `scripts/flows-pipeline.mjs:6819`.
6. Write: every key goes through `publish` `scripts/flows-pipeline.mjs:3049` -> `ingestWrites` `scripts/flows-pipeline.mjs:375` -> `ingestHeaders` `scripts/flows-pipeline.mjs:121` -> POST `ingestURL() + "?key=" + encodeURIComponent(key)` `scripts/flows-pipeline.mjs:3070`.
7. Door: Worker `/api/flows/ingest` `worker.js:3454`, key allowlist `INGEST_VIEW_KEY_RE` `worker.js:937`, D1 table `flows_payload` (areas 11-worker-b, 12-config-infra).
8. Check: `runHealthGate` `scripts/flows-pipeline.mjs:7085` -> `healthChecks` `scripts/flows-legs/health.mjs:528`; exit code set at the end of `main`.
9. Read: Worker route in the endpoint index below -> controller fetch (page sections above) -> renderer (`paint*` / `build*` rows).

**Live Tier 2, schedule to pill**

1. Start: cron `.github/workflows/flows-live.yml:20` or Worker `rthTick` dispatch (`shared/flows-live-worker.js:371`) or a loop hand-over `chainDispatch` `scripts/flows-legs/live.mjs:393`; job `.github/workflows/flows-live.yml:64` runs `.github/workflows/flows-live.yml:121`.
2. Entry: `main` returns at `scripts/flows-pipeline.mjs:4677` -> `runLiveMode` `scripts/flows-pipeline.mjs:4602` -> `createWatch` `scripts/flows-pipeline.mjs:4655` -> `runLiveLoop` `scripts/flows-legs/live.mjs:482`.
3. Each slot: `readLiveClock` `scripts/flows-legs/live.mjs:43` -> `liveWindow` `scripts/flows-legs/live.mjs:15` -> `runLive` `scripts/flows-legs/live.mjs:100` -> `uw` (333 ms pace) -> `put` `scripts/flows-legs/live.mjs:200`.
4. Write: `publish` guard `scripts/flows-pipeline.mjs:3050` -> `ingestHeaders` -> `liveCredential` `scripts/flows-pipeline.mjs:102` (OIDC JWT) -> POST to the same ingest door.
5. Watch: `createWatch` tick `scripts/flows-legs/watch.mjs:27` -> `evaluateTier1` / `evaluateTier2` / `evaluateNightly` `scripts/flows-legs/witness.mjs:112` -> `createWitness` `scripts/flows-legs/witness.mjs:296` (GitHub Issues); nightly start `scripts/flows-legs/starts.mjs:17`.
6. Read: `/api/flows/lk` and `/api/flows/now` (endpoint index) -> `FlowsUI.heartbeat` `assets/js/flows-fresh.js:109` -> pill `FlowsUI.freshness` `assets/js/flows-ui.js:1722`; streamed prices ride the rail `FlowsUI.rt.connect` `assets/js/flows-rt.js:744`.

**Change to merge gate**

1. CI trigger `.github/workflows/regression.yml:4`, job `.github/workflows/regression.yml:19` -> `npm ci` `.github/workflows/regression.yml:34` -> `wrangler deploy --dry-run` `.github/workflows/regression.yml:39` -> `npm test` `.github/workflows/regression.yml:44`.
2. `npm test` is the chain `tests/package.json:9`; the first red suite hides every later one; the asset-version diff gate lives in `contracts.mjs` (`tests/contracts.mjs:921`).
3. A new suite needs a `test:*` script and a slot in that chain; a new Flows page needs a `CEILING_KIB` row in `tests/flows-weight.mjs:12`.

## Change playbooks

Citation form: every `path:line [needle]` span was checked with grep/sed against `ba2acfe` (when a needle is present it is a literal substring of that line or range); a bare `:NNN` span continues the file of the nearest preceding full citation in the same sentence. Asset token 240, fonts token 230. Paths are repo-relative; `tests/` suites run from `cd tests`. In every Tests line a suite is tagged with its class from the legend, and the CI chain line gives its 1-based position in the `tests/package.json:9` chain. Where AGENTS.md disagrees with the source (twelve courses, `schemaVersion` 2, the v2 learning API, `live-day.mjs` holding 13 scenarios) the source was followed.

### Legend: suite classes, rituals, chain order

Rituals, referenced by code in every playbook:

| Code | Ritual |
|---|---|
| R-ASSET | Any change under `assets/css`, `assets/js` or `assets/data` (generated payloads, banks and bundles included): (1) increment the integer in `assets/version.txt`; (2) set every local CSS/JS `?v=` in `index.html`, `404.html`, `articles/index.html`, `articles/_template/index.html`, `lab/index.html`, `lab/course.html`, `lab/lesson.html`, `lab/review/index.html`, `lab/placement/index.html`, `lab/challenge/index.html`, and the three `lab/projects/*/index.html` (13 HTML files carry css/js `?v=`; `grep -rlE '\?v=[0-9]+' --include=*.html --include=*.css .` lists them plus the two stylesheets of step 5); (3) `data-asset-version` on `lab/course.html`, `lab/review/index.html`, `lab/placement/index.html` (asserted at `tests/contracts.mjs:335 data-asset-version`; `challenge` and the three project pages carry it too); (4) `export const ASSET_VERSION` at `shared/flows-pages.js:1 ASSET_VERSION` (held equal by `tests/flows-features.mjs:848 ASSET_VERSION === onDisk`); (5) `atmosphere.svg?v=` at `assets/css/base.css:123 atmosphere.svg` and `assets/css/flows.css:11 atmosphere.svg` (the contract regex only scans css, js and woff2, so nothing asserts these two); (6) restore the sixteen woff2 references: `grep -rn 'woff2?v=' --include=*.html --include=*.css .` must show only `assets/fonts-version.txt`; (7) run `contracts.mjs`. The gate is `tests/contracts.mjs:976 browser assets changed without increasing version` against `ASSET_DIFF_BASE` or `origin/main` (`tests/contracts.mjs:921 ASSET_DIFF_BASE`); it is skipped silently when no base resolves |
| R-FONT | A woff2 under `assets/fonts/` changed: set `assets/fonts-version.txt` to the NEW asset version, update the eight `@font-face` URLs in `assets/css/base.css` (first at `assets/css/base.css:7 Inter-latin.woff2`) and the eight Inter preloads in HTML, then R-ASSET for the `base.css` edit. The gate is `tests/contracts.mjs:978` block (`fontsVersionAt`); the token never runs ahead of `assets/version.txt` |
| R-GEN | `node scripts/generate-course-payloads.mjs`, then commit every output: `assets/data/courses/**` (`schemaVersion` 2, per-module files <= 6,144 B gzip), `assets/data/review-bank.json` (`scripts/generate-course-payloads.mjs:268 review-bank.json`), `assets/data/challenge-bank.json` (`:285`), `assets/data/skill-graph.json` (`:135`), `assets/js/review-catalog.js` (`:289`), `assets/js/stage-catalog.js`, `assets/js/lab-suite.bundle.js` (`:316`), `shared/{review-manifest,stage-manifest,skill-manifest,course-points,course-seo}.js` (`:296-312`). Never regenerate `assets/data/stage-id-map-v2.json` (`:98 frozenStageCount`). Regeneration must be a no-op on a clean tree (DEPLOY.md section 2). Then R-ASSET |
| R-QUANT | After any edit to a `shared/flows-quant-*` module reachable from `shared/flows-quant-browser.js` or `shared/flows-quant-read.js`: `node scripts/build-flows-quant-bundle.mjs` (writes `assets/js/flows-quant.bundle.js` and `assets/js/flows-quant-read.bundle.js`; `scripts/build-flows-quant-bundle.mjs:39 --check` verifies), then R-ASSET and R-WEIGHT. `tests/flows-quant-card.mjs:378 buildQuantBundle` fails on a stale bundle, and a wrangler bump that moves esbuild fails it too |
| R-WEIGHT | Per-route script bytes are capped by `tests/flows-weight.mjs:12 CEILING_KIB`; headroom is under 1 KiB on every gated page (ticker 399.1/400, desk 233.8/234, strategy 250.1/251, unusual 203.8/204 KiB), and `assets/js/flows-ui.js` counts on every route. Growth means trimming elsewhere or raising a ceiling in the same diff with a justification; a new `*Page` function with no ceiling fails |
| R-REG | A new suite is registered twice in `tests/package.json`: a `test:<name>` script and `&& npm run test:<name>` in the single chain at `tests/package.json:9 npm run test:contracts`. Nothing enforces the second step, and the chain stops at the first failure, so position matters. Add `--disable-warning=ExperimentalWarning` for `node:sqlite` suites. CI cap is 40 minutes (`.github/workflows/regression.yml:21 timeout-minutes: 40`) |
| R-DRY | Bundle and config validation without deploy: `./tests/node_modules/.bin/wrangler deploy --dry-run --outdir /tmp/anilkaya-dry-run` (CI runs it before `npm test`: `.github/workflows/regression.yml:39 wrangler deploy --dry-run`) |
| R-SMOKE | After a deploy that touches headers, routing, cache or assets: DEPLOY.md section 7 curl smoke tests and a header readback, because dashboard Transform Rules can override `worker.js` and `_headers` after code runs |
| R-NIGHTLY | `node scripts/flows-pipeline.mjs --dry-run` (fake vendors, no secrets, `--emit <prefix>` dumps payloads); also the first half of `test:pipeline` |
| R-COMMENT | Source files carry no comments in any language. Argue the threshold in the commit message. Scans: `tests/flows-legs-contract.mjs:897`, `tests/flows-quant.mjs:901 carries no comments`, `tests/flows-rt-contract.mjs:1427 commented`, `tests/flows-positioning-contract.mjs:911`, `tests/flows-neuron-screen.mjs:305` |
| R-DOCS | DEPLOY.md and AGENTS.md mirror constants; section numbers of DEPLOY.md 10.0 (items 1, 3 and 5), 10.5i and 10.5k are runtime strings in `scripts/flows-legs/health.mjs` (`:619` quotes 10.0 item 1 and 10.5k), and `scripts/flows-legs/witness.mjs` (`:34`, `:42` quote 10.5i, `:74` quotes 10.0 item 3), asserted by `tests/flows-live-contract.mjs`; DEPLOY.md section 9 is quoted only in the message of the missing-asset assertion at `tests/worker-regression.mjs:267`, and 10.5h appears in no runtime string; change both sides together |
| R-ANCHOR | A `startWorker` suite may not hold an ISO date within the next 400 days unless listed in `tests/contracts.mjs:873 const ANCHORED` (scan at `:886-905`); build dates from the clock or shift with `shiftClock` |

### A. Worker, config, infrastructure, runbooks (see 10-worker-a, 11-worker-b, 12-config-infra, 13-docs-runbooks)

#### P01 Change the CSP or the security headers
- **Edit order:** (1) `worker.js:102 const CSP` (HTML only; `connect-src` hard-codes `wss://anilkaya.org` at `worker.js:111 wss://anilkaya.org`, which the rail socket needs) and/or `worker.js:117 const SECURITY_HEADERS` (flat object literal, quoted names and values, no `}` inside); (2) mirror the same names and values, never the CSP, in the `/assets/*` block of `_headers:1 /assets/*` (lines 2-8); (3) `worker.js:3918 function finalize` only if response policy changes: it must keep `worker.js:3919 new Response(response.body, response)`.
- **Refresh:** nothing generated. No asset bump (the Worker is outside `assets/css|js|data`).

## Test-to-module matrix and global invariants

### 1. The `npm test` chain

#### 1.1 Mechanics

- `tests/package.json:9` is one string: 77 `npm run test:*` links joined by `&&`. The 77 `test:*` scripts sit at `:10-86`. Two links are compound: `test:flows` (`:21`, four files) and `test:pipeline` (`:24`, `node ../scripts/flows-pipeline.mjs --dry-run` then the contract). Result: 81 node processes, 80 suite files plus one dry run.
- `tests/` holds 89 `.mjs` files. Exactly 9 have no script and are helpers: `board-shift`, `desk-fixtures`, `dossier-fixtures`, `dossier-harness`, `live-stubs`, `lk-mock`, `reading-archetypes`, `rt-fixtures`, `worker-server`. No test enforces registration: a suite missing from line 9 silently never runs in CI (checked at this commit: 0 defined-but-unchained scripts, 0 unregistered suites).
- No framework. Every suite is an ES module (`"type": "module"`, `package.json:4`) over `node:assert/strict` with local `ok`/`eq`/`deep` counters and one closing summary line. The first thrown assertion exits non-zero. Exceptions to the shape: `contracts.mjs:1211` closes with topic and reference counts (`N curricula, N versioned assets at ?v=..., N font references`), not an assertion counter; `flows-ledger-contract` prints "N checks passed" (`:648`); `flows-legacy-payload` is the one suite that does not stop at the first failure: it collects `[passed, message]` pairs, logs each `FAIL:` with the rendered families, prints a `✓`/`✗` line and ends with `process.exit(failed ? 1 : 0)` (`:381-397`). `devDependencies` are exactly `playwright 1.61.1` and `wrangler 4.110.0` (`package.json:88-91`); `esbuild` (`build-flows-quant-bundle.mjs`) and `miniflare` (`contracts.mjs:908`) are resolved transitively from `tests/node_modules`.
- Node floor `engines.node >=22.13` (`package.json:5-7`) because `node:sqlite` loads without a flag only from 22.13. Seven scripts add `--disable-warning=ExperimentalWarning`: dossier-reads `:13`, rt `:51`, reads `:55`, ledger `:56`, verdict `:57`, readers `:58`, reading-worker `:85`. The sandbox runs v22.22.2.
- CI is `.github/workflows/regression.yml`: triggers push to main, pull_request, dispatch and cron `17 6 * * 1` (`:3-9`); `timeout-minutes: 40` (`:21`); checkout `fetch-depth: 0`; Node 22; `npm ci`; `npx playwright install --with-deps chromium`; `wrangler deploy --dry-run --outdir /tmp/anilkaya-worker-dry-run` (`:38-39`); `npm test` with `ASSET_DIFF_BASE: ${{ github.event.pull_request.base.sha || github.event.before }}` (`:42-43`). CI never sets `FLOWS_TEST_SANDBOX`.
- Class legend used below (computed from the sources: `startWorker(` call or Playwright import):

| Code | Meaning | Suites | Sandbox recipe |
|---|---|---|---|
| N | Node only (no browser, no workerd) | 50 | `cd tests && node X.mjs` |
| C | Chromium with `page.route` stubs or an own static server, no workerd | 13 | set `PLAYWRIGHT_BROWSERS_PATH` (`/opt/pw-browsers` here) |
| W | real `wrangler dev` workerd through `tests/worker-server.mjs` | 4 | `FLOWS_TEST_SANDBOX=1 node X.mjs` |
| W+C | workerd and Chromium | 13 | both of the above |
| +S | imports `node:sqlite` (counting D1 fake) | 7 | add `--disable-warning=ExperimentalWarning` |
| +child | spawns node child processes (pipeline dry run, CLI, self-spawn); `contracts` only shells out to `git` and is kept under N | see rows | none |

- Runtime column: `m` = AGENTS.md measurement (line cited in 1.2 notes), `est` = estimate from 61-tests-b/62-tests-c reading the structure, `n/m` = never measured.

#### 1.3 Which suite hides which

- Rule: a failure at position p means positions p+1..77 never execute (`&&`, `package.json:9`). Inside link 4 the order is features, auth, card-contract, premium; inside link 5 the dry run precedes the contract. A hung suite looks like a red one under `timeout`: confirm `FLOWS_TEST_SANDBOX=1` before reading silence as an assertion failure (AGENTS.md:1017-1027).
- Arithmetic on the 26 measured figures (taking flows-worker at 3.5 min, flows-unusual at 86 s, flows-reads at its 33 s wall figure): about 14 minutes; 54 suites are unmeasured. CI cap is 40 minutes (`regression.yml:21`).

```
 1-3    site gate            contracts, markets, market-ticker
 4-14   Flows pure + Lab data features..premium, pipeline, probe, ws-probe, universe, legs,
                              record, chain-panels, mastery, academy, placement
 15-17  workerd trio         worker (1 boot), flows-worker (6 boots, 2-5 min), rt-server (4 boots, 151 s)
 18-33  Flows UI + Lab UI    rt-client, chain, desk x3, basis, overview, sections, market, ticker,
                              legacy, motion, render, browser(31), unusual, events
 34-47  payload / live / reads  payload-shape, scores, alerts, mint, pulse, freshness, live, rt, starts,
                              reads, readers, readers-render, ledger, verdict
 48-72  pure engines + renders  stock..neuron-screen
 73-77  dossier + reading     dossier, dossier-reads, reading, reading-worker, reading-render  (PRs #146 and #147; the rail suites of #148 sit earlier, at 17, 18 and 41)
```

| Failing position | Hidden behind it | Why it matters |
|---|---|---|
| 1 contracts | all 76 others | only suite that fails on a missing asset-version bump, `_headers` drift, sitemap/course count drift, lab bundle drift, absolute paths, future-dated server fixtures |
| 5 pipeline | 6-77 | the pipeline dry run feeds #27 ticker, #30 render, #32 unusual, #33 events, #34 payload-shape, #40 live, #50 overlay, #56 strip, #70 positioning; a red pipeline change surfaces first as #5 and then as several later suites |
| 15, 16, 17 | 16-77, 17-77, 18-77 | the three workerd suites precede every Flows UI suite; #16 alone costs 2-5 minutes |
| 31 browser | 32-77 | the Lab UI suite sits mid-chain; a Lab regression hides all Flows contracts after it (#32-#77) |
| 43-47 reads/readers/ledger/verdict | 48-77 | the D1-cost and clock suites hide stock, permits, overlay, political, watch, board, weight, strip, strategy, brief, ask, track, warnings, sign, garch, quant*, neuron*, variation, vol, positioning, dossier, reading |
| 72 neuron-screen | 73-77 | the dossier and reading suites (PR #146, #147) run only if every older suite passed |
| 77 flows-reading-render | nothing | last suite; first one to go unrun when anything earlier fails |

- Stale-late-suite effect (AGENTS.md:1037-1042; the 2026-09 `flows-card-render` find, AGENTS.md:1028-1036): a threshold or count in a late suite can be wrong for a long time without reporting; when a long-red suite goes green, expect the ones behind it to say something.
- No suite consumes another suite's output. Order is therefore about cost and blast radius only, with two exceptions: `flows-strip` reuses a leftover `tests/.review-emit` when it already holds `-card-*` files (`flows-strip.mjs:73-80`, a masking trap), and `ANCHORED` dates (section 4) make a late suite fail on a calendar day rather than on a diff.

### 2. Inverted matrix: module to suites

#### 2.1 How the matrix was derived

- Method: for each tracked non-test module, `grep -E "shared/<name>"` (resp. `js/<name>.js`, `scripts/...`) over `tests/*.mjs`, then helper files were separated from suites. Dynamic `import("../x")`, `readFileSync(new URL("../x"))` and `read("x")` all count as "named".
- Columns: **graph** flags show indirect execution. `W` = module is in the import closure of `worker.js` (48 shared modules; executed by the 17 `startWorker` suites and by the six suites that import `worker.js` into Node: dossier-reads, reading-worker, basis, ledger, readers, reads). `P` = in the import closure of `scripts/flows-pipeline.mjs` (45 shared modules plus all 22 `scripts/flows-legs/*.mjs` and `flows-quant-pipeline.mjs`; executed by every dry-run consumer: #5, #27, #30, #32, #33, #34, #40, #50, #56, #70 and the sections/universe/legs suites that import pipeline exports).
- **named by** lists suite files that import, read or scan the module by path. **helper** names a test helper that imports it, so every suite that imports that helper touches it as a side effect (helper consumers are in 3.5). Helper-only links are fixture construction through real shapers, not assertions on the module.
- Browser files have a second tier: **page** = a Chromium suite whose served page links the script (`s/flows-pages.js` page functions, and `lab/*.html`).

### 3. Test infrastructure

#### 3.1 `startWorker` hop by hop (`tests/worker-server.mjs`)

1. `SANDBOX = process.env.FLOWS_TEST_SANDBOX === "1"` (`:14`); `childEnv()` (`:15-19`) always sets `NO_COLOR=1` and, in sandbox mode, `CLOUDFLARE_CF_FETCH_ENABLED=false` and `WRANGLER_SEND_METRICS=false`. `WRANGLER` is `tests/node_modules/wrangler/bin/wrangler.js` (`:11`).
2. `startWorker({extraVars})` (`:155`): free port, `mkdtemp(anilkaya-worker-test-*)` as the persist dir, then `wrangler d1 execute iewt --local --file schema.sql --persist-to <dir> -y` with cwd = repo root (`:162`).
3. Sandbox only: `mkdtemp(anilkaya-worker-tree-*)` then `stageServedTree` (`:139`): `git ls-files -z --cached --others --exclude-standard`, skip any path that starts with `.` and contains `/`, `lstat` must say regular file, copy. Symlinks are never copied (`:163-167`).
4. `armSweep()` (`:173`; `LIVE_GROUPS` `:76`, `armSweep` `:92`) registers SIGKILL sweeps for the process group on exit/SIGINT/SIGTERM/SIGHUP.
5. Spawn `wrangler dev --local --ip 127.0.0.1 --port N --persist-to <dir>` with `--var` set: `GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID:test-client`, `GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET:test-secret`, `SESSION_SECRET`, `FLOWS_PEPPER`, `FLOWS_CREDENTIALS` (PBKDF2 hashes of `test-flows-password` for all 12 `FLOWS_USERNAMES`, `:130`), `FLOWS_SESSION_EPOCH:1` (`:183`, while `wrangler.toml` says "2"), `FLOWS_ASK_MODEL:` and `FLOWS_ASK_FALLBACK_MODEL:` blank (`:185-186`, no model is reachable), then caller `extraVars` (`:187`); `--inspector-port 0 --log-level error --show-interactive-dev-session=false`; `detached: true` (`:194`), cwd = the served tree.
6. Wait for the port (30 s), then one warm-up `fetch("/")` with a 120 s abort (`:200-202`).
7. Return `{baseURL, output(), d1(sql), stop()}` (`:210-220`); `stop()` is SIGTERM, 3 s, SIGKILL on the group, then remove the temp dirs.
8. Suites then sign a cookie (`signSession({sub:"anilkaya", aud:"flows", epoch:"1", exp}, SESSION_SECRET)`) or sign in through the UI, seed with `POST /api/flows/ingest?key=K` and `Authorization: Bearer <FLOWS_INGEST_TOKEN>`, and drive `fetch`, `WebSocket` or Chromium.

#### 3.2 `FLOWS_TEST_SANDBOX` and the symlink trap

- Cause (AGENTS.md:791-828): `wrangler dev` watches the assets directory (= repo root) with a watcher that follows symlinks and has no CLI off switch. The sandbox tree holds loops: `tests/node_modules/node_modules` points at its parent, each worktree's `tests/node_modules` is a symlink into it, and `.claude/worktrees/` holds dozens of worktrees (10 present at mapping time). The crawl used 4.3 GB in 80 s, one run died at the 8 GB heap limit after seven minutes, the proxy stays paused and the port accepts connections without answering.
- Effect: a W suite run without the flag hangs rather than fails; `timeout` then reports a failure that is not an assertion. CI is a fresh checkout without those loops and runs unset.
- Fix in the harness: serve a copy that contains no symlinks (3 above). `git ls-files --cached` lists every tracked file whatever `.gitignore` says (`_headers` is tracked, and `.gitignore:7-8` is `_*` then `!_headers`); `--others --exclude-standard` adds only untracked files that are not ignored, so a new untracked `_*` file would not be served, `tests/.*/` scratch dirs (`.gitignore:16`) and `.claude/` (`.git/info/exclude:7`) are left out, and the dot-directory skip in the copy loop drops any `.x/...` path.
- Measured with the flag (AGENTS.md:808-810): flows-watch-render 12 s, flows-worker-contract 2-5 min; without it the first was still silent at 200 s.

#### 3.3 Counting D1 fakes and rows-read accounting

| fake | file:line | traits | users |
|---|---|---|---|
| `fakeD1()` | `dossier-harness.mjs:11` | `node:sqlite` `:memory:` loaded with `schema.sql` (`:8`); D1 surface `prepare().bind().first/all/run`, `batch`; `latencyMs` 1; every trip logged as `{kind, sqls, args, rows, written}`; rows priced by `EXPLAIN QUERY PLAN` (`:28`); helpers `put`, `live`, `tape`, `rowsRead`, `written`, `fail`, `latency`, `since`, `count` | flows-dossier-reads, flows-reading-worker |
| `fakeD1()` | `flows-reads-contract.mjs:26` | one trip per `first/all/run/batch` after `setTimeout(1)`; `scanned()` `:39`, plan `:41`, `elements()` `:61`; knobs `fail`, `throwSync`, `hangOnce`, `slowOnce`, `latency`, `rowsRead`, `since`, `count` | flows-reads |
| `fakeD1()` | `flows-readers-contract.mjs:19` | same shape without row pricing; `put(id, value)` and `live(...)` seeders | flows-readers |
| `sqliteD1()` | `flows-ledger-contract.mjs:25` | batches in BEGIN/COMMIT/ROLLBACK, `trips[]`, `row(day)` | flows-ledger |
| `sqliteD1()` | `flows-verdict-contract.mjs:19` | async D1 over `node:sqlite` | flows-verdict |
| `tickDb`, `focusDb` | `live-stubs.mjs:120`, `:226` | scripted stand-ins that record statements, no SQL engine | flows-live, flows-worker |
| roster SQL | `flows-rt-contract.mjs:1003` | `DatabaseSync(":memory:")` for the hub's roster read | flows-rt |

- Pricing rule (reads-contract `:39-61`, harness `:28`): a SEARCH costs `max(searches, rows returned)`, a SCAN costs the table cardinality, a `json_each(p.payload, path)` virtual table costs the array length. This is why a new read route needs a `CEILING` row (`flows-reads-contract.mjs:755-771`, census `:795-801`): D1 Free allows 5,000,000 rows read a day (AGENTS.md:60-77).

#### 3.4 Running `worker.js` in Node: shims and seams

- `globalThis.HTMLRewriter ??= class { on() { return this; } transform(r) { return r; } };` is required before any import of the Worker because `worker.js:2724` calls `new HTMLRewriter()`: `dossier-harness.mjs:6`, `flows-ledger-contract.mjs:395,586`, `flows-reads-contract.mjs:24`, `flows-readers-contract.mjs:17`, `flows-basis-contract.mjs:346`. A new top-level use of a Workers-only global in `worker.js` or its closure breaks all six Node importers.
- Fresh module per client: `import("../worker.js?tag=" + (++n))` (`dossier-harness.mjs:176`, `flows-reads-contract.mjs:136`, `flows-readers-contract.mjs:234`, `flows-ledger-contract.mjs:399` `?ledger=1`, `:588` `?ledger=quota`, `flows-basis-contract.mjs:354` `?basis=1`, `flows-dossier-reads.mjs:158` `?dossier=anon`), so isolate memos (clock memo, single-flight maps, `flowsSchemaReady`) start empty.
- Cache API fake: `cacheFake()` (`dossier-harness.mjs:116-134`, response without `max-age` is already expired), `FakeCache` (`flows-reads-contract.mjs:808`, installed `:825`, `:917`), inline `caches.default` (`flows-readers-contract.mjs:217`). Entries keyed `https://flows-lastgood.internal/...`, `flows-dossier.internal/news/<T>` and `/assembled/<T>`.
- Clock: `shiftClock(baseIso)` replaces `globalThis.Date` with an offset subclass that keeps running and returns a restorer (`dossier-harness.mjs:106`, default `NOW_ISO` 2026-10-02T14:30Z; `flows-reads-contract.mjs:122`, `FIXTURE_NOW` 2026-09-25T13:00Z at `:121`). A card two sessions behind the real date is tier `expired`, so any fixture with a fixed session needs the shift. Await `ctx.waitUntil` work (`settle()`) before clearing the cache fake because the 30-second assembled copy is written in the background.
- Vendor: `vendorStub()` (`dossier-harness.mjs:137`) intercepts `fetch` for host `uw.test` only (14 route patterns, controls `refuse/delay/bodies/status/tooLarge/hold`); `UW_BASE=http://uw.test` in `flows-basis-contract`. A different `UW_BASE` goes to the real network.
- Session: `client(D1, extra)` (`dossier-harness.mjs:173`) signs a Flows session for `FLOWS_USERNAMES[0]` ("firatgok") and returns `get(route)` with `settle()`. `flows-reads-contract`'s own `client` (`:133-134`) does the same with `FLOWS_READ_MODE: "off"` in the env, so the Neuron's row counts are not inflated by the reading's dossier trips; only the final reading block (`AI_ENV`, `:1207`) turns it `on`.

#### 3.8 Emit protocol and scratch dirs

- `scripts/flows-pipeline.mjs --dry-run --emit <prefix>` writes one file per published key: `EMIT.replace(/\.json$/, "") + "-" + key.replace(":", "-") + ".json"` (`flows-pipeline.mjs:3056-3059`). Only the first colon is replaced, there is no `mkdir`, and a prefix of `<dir>/` yields `-card-AAPL.json`; `<dir>/p.json` yields `p-card-AAPL.json`. The live suite maps `^p-` and `^live-` back by hand (`flows-live-contract.mjs:1001`).
- Scratch dirs inside `tests/`, ignored by `.gitignore:16` (`tests/.*/`): `.events-emit` (events; wiped at `:29`, removed again in `finally`, `:39`), `.overlay-emit` (overlay; named at `:183`, wiped at `:184`, removed at `:242`), `.ticker-emit` (wiped at `:20`, removed at `:2277`), `.unusual-emit` (wiped at `:24`, removed in `finally`, `:34`), `.review-emit` (strip; never cleaned; one exists in this tree). A killed run leaves them behind. Four other emitters use `os.tmpdir()` `mkdtemp` instead and clean up after themselves: card-render (`flows-render-*`, `:14`), payload-shape (`flows-shape-*`, `:16`), positioning (`flows-positioning-*`, `:851`) and live (`flows-live-*`).

### 4. Global invariants

#### 4.1 Worker invariants 1-7 (AGENTS.md:652-696)

| # | Rule | Enforced at | If violated |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | The finalizer starts with `new Response(response.body, response)` | `worker.js:3919`; `worker-regression.mjs:243-244` (font byte length equals disk; the `?v=` request is asset-first under `wrangler.toml:10`, so by source reading this exercises the edge path; Worker-proxied static files are asserted at `:273-300`) | rebuilding an asset response from a header dictionary corrupts `Content-Encoding` at the edge |
| 2 | Every response `worker.js` serves goes through `finalize` | `worker.js:3990-4014` (route, error mapper and quota branch all call `finalize`); `flows-rt-contract.mjs:1437-1439` pins `path.startsWith("/api/rt/")` inside `route()` | a response outside `route()` ships without the seven headers, the CSP or cache policy; the 101 WebSocket loses its handle |
| 3 | Seven security headers everywhere; CSP on HTML only; `_headers` repeats them verbatim | `worker.js:117-125`, `:3920-3927`; `contracts.mjs:847-869`; `worker-regression.mjs:64-67` | contracts fails on any drift; dashboard Transform Rules can still override after deploy (AGENTS.md:693-695), hence the mandatory live header smoke test |
| 4 | HTML `no-cache`; `/assets/css, js, fonts` immutable even without `?v=`; img, data and the two tokens one hour; API and auth `no-store` (source also makes `/flows` and `/flows/*` pages `no-store`, and leaves a 200 `GET /api/markets` cacheable) | `worker.js:3928-3944`, `_headers`, `contracts.mjs:852-866`, `worker-regression.mjs:215-268` | a missing css/js/font becomes a year-long immutable 404; first forward deploy after a rollback must bump the version (DEPLOY.md section 9) |
| 5 | No `Clear-Site-Data` | `worker-regression.mjs:92` | empties every returning reader's cache of the immutable assets |
| 6 | Every `/lab/<slug>/` gets canonical, title, OG/Twitter, H1, outline, one Course plus BreadcrumbList JSON-LD graph | `worker.js:2651` (`courseStructuredData`), `:2702-2760` (`renderCourse`, HTMLRewriter at `:2724`); `worker-regression.mjs:292-297`, `:340-395` (graph types `["Course","BreadcrumbList"]` `:387`) | un-indexable or duplicate course pages |
| 7 | Malformed, oversized, wrongly signed or expired sessions fail closed as anonymous and never 500 | `shared/session.js:26-39` (`verifySession`: 4096-char cap, try/catch, `exp` check); `contracts.mjs:1086-1094`; `flows-auth-contract.mjs:339` | a bad cookie throws a request-level 500 or authenticates |

| # | Invariant | Enforced at | What breaks if violated |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | Source files carry no comments (reasoning lives in commits and `docs/`) | partial: `flows-quant.mjs:897-904` (`shared/flows-quant-*.js` equal their own `stripComments` and read no clock, randomness or network), `flows-legs-contract.mjs:897` (`l/*`), `flows-positioning-contract.mjs:911-914`, `flows-neuron-screen.mjs:305`, `flows-rt-contract.mjs:1421-1429` (the three rail modules `flows-rt.js`, `flows-rt-hub.js`, `flows-rt-routes.js`, the helper `rt-fixtures.mjs` and the two rail suites), NOT enforced for `worker.js`, `shared/markets.js` (or any other `shared/` module outside the quant, rail, positioning and neuron-screen scans), `assets/js` or `scripts/*.mjs`. `flows-strip.mjs:14` looks like a scan but is not: `stripTree({check:true})` only proves the stripper's output parses and stays idempotent (`:14-26`), and the ticker page renders identically with raw and stripped scripts; a comment added to `assets/js` passes it. #### 4.3 Environment and process traps

| Trap | Evidence | Consequence |
|---|---|---|
| Symlink and worktree loops make `wrangler dev` hang | `worker-server.mjs:14-19`, `:139-167`; AGENTS.md:791-828 (see 3.2) | W suites silent until `timeout`; looks like a red assertion; run with `FLOWS_TEST_SANDBOX=1` |
| Chain order and first failure | `package.json:9`; AGENTS.md:1037-1042 | later suites unreported (1.3) |
| Node floor and `node:sqlite` flag | `package.json:5-7`; seven scripts (`:13,51,55-58,85`); `flows-rt-contract.mjs:34` calls `process.threadCpuUsage()` with no fallback | 22.5-22.12 fail at import with `No such built-in module: node:sqlite`; without the flag the sqlite notice pollutes output |
| Stacked-branch and merge trap on the version gate | `regression.yml:42-43` sets `ASSET_DIFF_BASE` to the PR's base commit; `contracts.mjs:921-927`, `:968-983`; AGENTS.md:723-726 names the merge form (a blanket `?v=<old>` to `?v=<new>` rewrite arriving by merge moves the sixteen woff2 references silently, caught at `contracts.mjs:338-352`). No repository text uses the word "stacked": the following is derived from those lines and not observed here | on a PR whose base is another feature branch the gate compares against that branch tip, not main, so a child must raise the token above its parent's. Two sibling branches that both bump to N+1 merge without a textual conflict (identical line) and the second fails the gate against main's N+1 ("browser assets changed without increasing version"). With no resolvable base the gate is skipped (`if (diffBase)` `:968`). After every merge run `grep -rn 'woff2?v=' --include=*.html --include=*.css .` and reset hits to `assets/fonts-version.txt` |
| Durable Object migration and Workers Builds preview limit | repo facts: `wrangler.toml:33-39` (`PULSE`/`Pulse`, `[[migrations]] tag = "v1"`, `new_sqlite_classes = ["Pulse"]`), `worker.js:38`, pinned by `flows-rt-contract.mjs:1437-1449`; DEPLOY.md:99-100, `:3017-3018` ("`wrangler deploy --dry-run` validates the binding and the migration. The first real deploy applies migration `v1`"); `regression.yml:38-39` runs only the dry run; DEPLOY.md:2985-2996 (moving the class to another Worker needs a new migration, never an edit of `v1`); DEPLOY.md:129 (a preview origin needs its own Google callback), `:1012` (Cache API is a no-op on `workers.dev`, a preview proves nothing about the last-good copy); DEPLOY.md:3015-3016 (raw workerd with in-memory DO storage crashes on an alarm, hence `flows-rt-server` persists storage). External and unverified in this tree (90a-flows-request records it as Cloudflare's design): a Workers Builds build of a non-production branch ends in a version upload, not a deploy; whether that can apply a DO migration is not established by anything in the repository | CI can never prove the migration applies; the first production deploy carrying `v1` is the real test (DEPLOY.md section 10.5n step 3 checks `/api/rt/status`). The Worker degrades safely without the binding: `serveRt` answers 404 `rt_off` (`flows-rt-routes.js:17-22`) and never throws. `wrangler.toml` has no `[env]`, routes or `workers_dev`, so there is no staging definition to test against |
| Dashboard state is invisible to the repo | AGENTS.md:90-106; DEPLOY.md:141-153 | Workers Builds mapping, secrets, domains, Transform Rules need a live header smoke test after every deploy |
| `UW_BASE` is honoured unconditionally by `uwFetch` (`worker.js:2005`) | 12-config-infra trap 26 | never set it as a production var: the vendor key would go to that host |
| Worktree noise | `.git/info/exclude` holds `/.claude/`; 10 worktrees under `.claude/worktrees/` | recursive `grep` finds stale copies of `worker.js`; use `git ls-files` or `git grep` |
| Future-dated fixtures, real clock in workerd | `contracts.mjs:873-906`; `UW_NOW` only pins the vendor read clock | W suites cannot be time-shifted; Node-side suites use `shiftClock` |
| CPU ceilings are timed in-process | `flows-rt-contract.mjs:1157` (25 ms per poll), `flows-quant.mjs` ratio budget, live Tier 1 children | flake on a loaded machine; thread-CPU clock where available, wall clock fallback in `live-stubs.mjs:141-148` |

#### 4.4 Doc versus source disagreements that affect running or editing tests

- AGENTS.md names `placement-contract` among suites that need the dev server: the source runs its own `node:http` server (`placement-contract.mjs:114-150`), class C.
- `regression.mjs` (`test:browser`, #31) calls `startWorker()` yet is in neither AGENTS.md list; it needs `FLOWS_TEST_SANDBOX=1` (13-docs D17).
- AGENTS.md says `flows-card-render` renders through `page.setContent`; no test calls `setContent`, it spawns the dry run and uses `page.route` (60-tests-a).
- AGENTS.md says seven courses, `schemaVersion: 1` and a 14 KiB gzip cap; source has 12 courses, 365 stages, `schemaVersion: 2` (`contracts.mjs:131`) and a 6,144-byte gzip cap per module file (`:150`); the review bank has 106 items (`mastery-contract.mjs:20`), AGENTS.md says 96.
- AGENTS.md says CI runs on push, pull_request and dispatch only; the workflow also has a weekly cron (`regression.yml:8-9`) and `--with-deps` on the Chromium install.
- `tests/flows-reads-contract.mjs` ceilings (hit 4, miss 22 before the response, 34 with background reads, `:1225-1239`) differ from the 3/18/30 quoted in AGENTS.md; the test is the authority.
- `flows-chain-panels` and `flows-chain-contract` both print `flows-chain`; a CI log line does not say which ran.
- AGENTS.md invariant 4 (HTML `no-cache`, API and auth `no-store`) omits two branches of `finalize`: `/flows` and `/flows/*` are `no-store` whatever their content type, and a 200 `GET /api/markets` keeps the cacheable policy (`worker.js:3928-3932`).
- AGENTS.md gives the dry-run output as `/tmp/anilkaya-dry-run`; `regression.yml:39` uses `/tmp/anilkaya-worker-dry-run`. Only the path differs.

## worker.js part A (lines 1-2050)

Snapshot: repo `/home/user/anilkaya.org` at `ba2acfe` (origin/main after PR 148), working tree clean. `worker.js` is 4,015 lines, 186,383 bytes, zero comment lines. Every line number below was taken with `grep -n` / `sed -n` on this commit. "L123" means `worker.js:123`. A symbol "belongs to part A" when its top-level declaration STARTS at or before line 2050; the last such declaration, `cachedTickerInfo`, straddles to line 2080 (the next declaration, `quoteResponse`, starts at 2082 and belongs to part B).

#### D1 lazy-schema fallback chain (L354-435)

Each layer catches ONLY its own "missing table/column" error, creates the object, and re-runs the same statement builder once. Writes are atomic (one `DB.batch`), so a retry never double-applies.

| symbol | location | what | callers |
|---|---|---|---|
| `learningBatch` | :354-372 | `DB.batch([INSERT INTO learning_sync(user_id, generation) VALUES(?,0) ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING, ...buildStatements()])`. The user's statements are therefore `results[1..]` (results[0] is the INSERT). On `no such table: learning_sync` it runs `LEARNING_SYNC_SCHEMA_SQL` and retries | L397, 403, 407, 715, 736, 768, routes L3090, 3138 |
| `ensureMasterySchema` | :374-380 | one batch creating mastery, mastery_attempts and the index | L406 |
| `addDayColumn` / `ensureDayColumns` | :382-389 / :390-393 | `ALTER TABLE <t> ADD COLUMN last_day TEXT` for `mastery` and `skill_mastery`; swallows `duplicate column name` and `no such table` | L391-392, L402 |
| `masteryBatch` | :395-409 | wraps `learningBatch`; on `no such column ... last_day` / `has no column named ... last_day` runs `ensureDayColumns`; on `no such table: mastery[_attempts]` runs `ensureMasterySchema` | L413, 418, 671, route L3273 |
| `placementBatch` | :411-420 | wraps `masteryBatch`; on `no such table: placement` creates it | L428, 433, 700, 833, routes L3199, 3217 |
| `ensureAcademySchema` | :422-424 | batch of the 7 `ACADEMY_SCHEMA_SQL` statements | L432 |
| `academyBatch` | :426-435 | wraps `placementBatch`; on `no such table:` followed by any of progress_v3, skill_mastery, skill_attempts, learning_preferences, project_progress runs `ensureAcademySchema` | L833; routes L2890, 2929, 2982, 3008, 3051 |

#### Wire formats

- Error envelope: `{ "error": { "code", "message" }, ...details }` with `Cache-Control: no-store` (added by `finalize`). `reset_required` adds `generation` to the body AND `X-IEWT-Generation` to the headers (client reads either, `assets/js/auth.js:56`). `store_unreadable` adds `{status:"unavailable", reason:"store"}`. Codes emitted by part A: `method_not_allowed` 405, `forbidden` 403, `account_changed` 409, `service_unavailable` 503, `payload_too_large` 413, `unsupported_media_type` 415, `invalid_json` 400, `reset_required` 409, `store_unreadable` 503, `bad_json` / `no_question` 400, `chain_unconfigured` 503, `chain_rate_limited` 429, `chain_upstream` 502, `chain_too_large` 502.
- `GET /api/bootstrap` -> `{user, progress:{<model>:{done:[idx]}}, stats:{points,streak,last}, mastery:{<itemId>:record}, placement, generation}`; `GET /api/v2/bootstrap` adds `stableProgress:{<courseId>:{done:[stageId]}}`, `skillMastery:{<skillId>:record}`, `preferences:{activePathId,sessionMinutes,weeklyGoalMinutes}`, `projects:{<projectId>:{mode,done:[taskId]}}`. Both carry `X-IEWT-Generation`. Signed out: `{user:null}`.
- Mastery/skill record: `{level 0..5, dueDay, attempts, correct, lastResult: bool|null, lastAttemptId, updatedAt}`.
- `DELETE /api/progress` response is `{ok, progress:{}, stats:{points:0,streak:0,last:null}, mastery:{}, stableProgress:{}, skillMastery:{}, projects:{}, placement:null, generation}`.
- Ingest `?keys=` response `{keys:{<k>:{present, sessionDate, generatedAt, updatedAt, bytes}}}`; `?list=` response `{keys, listed, truncated}`.
- Neuron body: see `neuronShape` (L1545). `status` values: `ok`, `pending`, `absent`, `unavailable`, `unreadable`, `quiet`. `tier`: `priced`, `stand-aside`, `family` (via `neuronTier`), `screen`, `unpriceable`, `expired`, `none`.
- Summary route body = Neuron body + `read` (L1727). Dossier route: `{ticker, tier, code, why, dossier, prompt:{tokensEst,budgetTokens,shed,dropped}, trace:{vendorCalls,calls,pending,queued,stale,wrote}}`.
