### Flows

**1. Every response leaves through the finalizer.** `export default.fetch` (L3990) -> `route()` (L2762) -> `rememberLastGood` (L3994, A:1064) -> `finalize` (L3918): `new Response(response.body, response)`, the 7 `SECURITY_HEADERS`, `Content-Security-Policy: CSP` only for `text/html` (deleted otherwise), `Cache-Control: no-store` for `/api/`, `/auth/`, `/flows` and `/flows/*` (except a 200 `/api/markets`), `no-cache` for other HTML, `immutable` for `?v=` under `/assets/`, one hour for other 200/304 non-JSON, `X-Server-Now` on `/api/flows/*`. Errors: `HttpError` -> (code `store_unreadable` -> `recallLastGood` L1083) else `apiError` (L168); any other throw -> `console.error({message:"request failed",...})` -> `isStoreQuota` -> 503 `store_quota` + `Retry-After` else 500 `internal_error`; all through `finalize`.

**2. Learning hydration (v2).** `assets/js/auth.js:930` `GET /api/v2/bootstrap` (falls back to `/api/bootstrap` L939, then `/api/me` L946) -> route L2867: `requireMethod` -> `requireSessionSecret` (L215) -> `currentUser` (L2638, cookie `session`, `isLearnAudience`) -> signed out `json({user:null})` -> `requireReadOwnerIfPresent` (L208) -> `loadAcademyBootstrapSnapshot` (L886) -> `runBootstrapBatch(academy=true)` (L829) -> `academyBatch` (L426) -> `placementBatch` (L411) -> `masteryBatch` (L395) -> `learningBatch` (L354): one `DB.batch` of [INSERT learning_sync DO NOTHING, derived points, generation, progress, stats, mastery, placement, progress_v3, skill_mastery, learning_preferences, project_progress]; a missing-table error creates that table and the whole batch re-runs -> parse (`results[1..6]`) -> poisoned `stats.last` is healed (UPDATE + second batch) -> `assembleLegacySnapshot` (L861) + `unionStableProgress`/`projectLegacyProgress`/`mergeProjectedSkillMastery` -> `json(snapshot, 200, generationHeaders(g))`.

**3. A learning write (progress PUT, v1).** route L3034: `requireMethod(GET,PUT,DELETE)` -> `requireSessionSecret` -> `currentUser` (401 `unauthorized`) -> `requireSameOrigin` (L183) -> `requireMutationOwner` (L202) -> `mutationGeneration` (L723; bad/missing header -> `loadGeneration` -> `throwResetRequired` 409) -> `readJSON` (L255) -> `normalizeDone` (L274) -> `learningBatch` with `INSERT ... SELECT ... WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM learning_sync WHERE user_id=? AND generation=?) ON CONFLICT DO UPDATE SET done_json = union of old and new integers < course length` + generation re-read -> a missing row or changed generation -> `throwResetRequired`; else `{ok, done, generation}`. The same fence (`generation = ?` inside the INSERT) guards stats, placement, mastery, skill attempts, preferences and projects.

**4. Reset.** `DELETE /api/progress` (L3049-3083): no generation header needed; one `academyBatch` bumps `learning_sync.generation` (`CASE WHEN generation < MAX_SYNC_GENERATION THEN generation+1 ELSE NULL END`), deletes the user's rows from progress, mastery, mastery_attempts, placement, progress_v3, skill_mastery, skill_attempts, project_progress and resets `stats` to 0/0/NULL, and answers with the new generation. `learning_preferences` is deliberately NOT cleared (`worker-regression.mjs:939` "reset must preserve learning preferences"); `users` and `flows_*` are untouched. Any in-flight PUT carrying the old generation then fails its `WHERE EXISTS` and returns 409.

**5. A stored Flows key (board, market, meta, ...).** `/api/flows/<key>` (L3601) -> `requireMethod` -> `currentFlowsUser` (L904, cookie `flows_session`) else 401 -> `readServed(env, key)` (L1099) -> `readFlowsPayload` (L991: `ensureFlowsTables` L2583 -> `NIGHTLY_ROW_SQL` -> `storedFrom` L987) -> `trace.failed` -> `throw storeGone()` (L1036) -> [back in `fetch`, L3996-3998: `recallLastGood`] ; else `passthrough` (L1232: `X-Payload-Updated` + `nightlyFreshHeaders`) -> after `route()` returns, `rememberLastGood` stores it (<= once / 10 min / key / isolate). A missing `card:<T>`/`card-x:`/`hist:` row goes to `absentKey` (L1209): `batchWithClock([ROSTER, LITE, GATE])` -> `scheduledTonight` -> pending; lite card; else `classifyTicker` (L1171) -> `uwFetch('/api/screener/stocks')` -> `quoteCard`; else absent.

**6. Neuron for a ticker.** `GET /api/flows/summary?t=` (L3725) -> `summaryResponse` (L1718) -> `Promise.all([tickerNeuron (L1760), FLOWS_READING.readingSafe])`. `tickerNeuron`: `ensureFlowsTables` -> one `DB.batch([card row, flows_neuron row])` -> `cardWithEngine` (merge card-x) -> store failure -> `neuronShape("unavailable", ..., STORE_GONE)`; no card -> `absentNeuron` (L1669: 5-min cache, screen tier / pending / absent); unreadable / pending card -> shapes; `neuronContextFor` (L1569) -> `FLOWS_NEURON.neuronTier`; a card >= 2 sessions behind the last close -> tier `expired` (no model); no readable feature -> `quiet`; fingerprint = `contextFingerprint | aiCallSignature`; prior row with same fingerprint and `NEURON_CONTEXT_VERSION` (6): `generating` within 90 s -> pending, a stored summary -> served (`applyStaleCap`) unless the guard is retryable and older than 5 min; otherwise `markNeuronGenerating` (L1473) claims, `generateNeuron` (L1590) runs in `ctx.waitUntil` (writes through `writeNeuron` L1492), and the caller gets `pending` ("Neuron is reading this card now") to poll.

**7. Board summary (cron).** `scheduled()` (L3950) job `summary` (`15,45 * * * *`) -> `summaryFiring` (L1423) -> `refreshFlowsSummary` (L1337): one `DB.batch` [brief `updated_at`, `LIVE_BRIEF_STAMP_SQL`, prior `flows_ai_summary` row, `flows_clock`] -> no brief: return; stamp = `brief.updated_at|liveStamp|aiCallSignature`; same `clock.summaryStamp` and a non-retryable guard: return (reads nothing else) -> `readFlowsPayload('brief')` -> `briefWithLive` -> facts; fingerprint equal and not retryable -> `markStamp`, return -> intraday floor (45 min, `intradayFloorMs`) for a billed reply -> no model: write `renderSummaryPlain` -> `askModels(meteredAi(env), chain, ...)` -> `guardAnswer(..., {smallIntegers:false})` -> write model text or the plain text with guard `invented` / `forecast` -> `markStamp` (`clockPatchStatement({summaryStamp})`). Then `summaryFiring` stamps `summaryAt` only if the refresh resolved.

**8. Ask.** `POST /api/flows/ask` (L3780) -> `askQuestion` (L1864) -> `readFlowsPayload('brief')` -> `briefWithLive` (L1324) -> `askAnswer` (L1878): with a subject, adds `FLOWS_NEURON.contextFacts(neuronContextFor(card))` -> `FLOWS_ASK.selectFacts` -> `askDossier` (L1844, up to 10 dossier facts) -> `askSpend` -> plain reading as the base answer -> no model: note + plain; else `askModels(meteredAi(env), chain, ..., {maxTokens:1024, temperature:0.2}, record spend)` -> on `said.failure` compose the note (`FALLBACK_FAILED`, `thrownThenEmptyNote`, `emptyNote`, allowance-vs-meter disagreement) and answer plain; empty -> plain; `guardAnswer` failure -> discard model text, plain answer with `guard`; success -> `{answer, llm:true, model, fallback, guard}`.

**9. Market snapshot.** `GET /api/markets` (L2858) -> `loadMarketSnapshot` (L541) -> `readMarketSnapshot` (L527) -> miss: await `revalidateMarketSnapshot` (L510; `marketRevalidation` single flight, 12 s wait, 3 attempts) -> `startMarketFlight` (L495) -> `refreshMarketSnapshot` (L475: 8 `fetchIndexQuote` in parallel, each tries query1 then query2 for 5 s) -> UPSERT -> payload; hit older than 45 min: same revalidation in `waitUntil`, serve the old payload. Cron: housekeeping job `*/30 * * * *` -> `refreshMarketSnapshotIfDue` (L533, always in the ET session window, else if older than 25 min).

**10. Dossier route.** `/api/flows/dossier?t=` (L3747) -> `ensureFlowsTables` -> `dossierResponse` (L1730) -> `FLOWS_DOSSIER.assembleDossier(env, ctx, T, dossierDeps, {own:true, now})` (one D1 batch of primary-key lookups, vendor fan-out through `uwFetch` and `ondemandAllowed`, Cache API copies) -> prompt rendering at the requested budget -> headers + JSON or `text/plain`.

### Invariants and traps

Source-text scans of `worker.js` (editing these lines breaks CI even when behaviour is unchanged):

- **T1. SECURITY_HEADERS shape.** `tests/contracts.mjs:847` matches `/const SECURITY_HEADERS = \{([^}]*)\}/` and reads `"Name": "value"` pairs (>= 7). The object must stay a flat literal with quoted keys and values and no `}` inside, and `_headers` `/assets/*` must equal it exactly (`contracts.mjs:850-851`; the per-path `Cache-Control` rules are pinned at 852-863 and the no-CSP check at 867); `_headers` may not mention `Content-Security-Policy` and may hold only the `/assets/*`, `css`, `js`, `fonts`, `img`, `data`, `version.txt`, `fonts-version.txt` rules. Edit both files in the same change. Dashboard Transform Rules can still override headers after deploy: run the DEPLOY.md section 7 header smoke test.
- **T2. Finalizer fidelity.** `finalize` must keep `new Response(response.body, response)` (L3919) so `Content-Encoding` and the 101 WebSocket survive; every Worker-served path must return through `route()` so `finalize` sees it (`flows-rt-contract.mjs:1439` pins `path.startsWith("/api/rt/")` inside `route()`).
- **T3. One writer for `flows_payload`.** `flows-alerts-contract.mjs:504-513` counts `INSERT INTO flows_payload` in the whole file and requires every one to sit between `if (path === "/api/flows/ingest")` and `if (path.startsWith("/api/flows/"))`; `refreshFlowsIntraday` must not exist; `flows-live-contract.mjs:731-739` requires the `scheduled` handler (between `async scheduled(event, env, ctx)` and `async fetch(request, env, ctx)`) to contain no `INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE ... flows_payload`. Part A must never write `flows_payload`.
- **T4. No direct model calls.** `flows-neuron.mjs:1094-1098` and `:805-808`: `env.AI.run(` appears 0 times; every `askModels(` is `askModels(meteredAi(env),` (exactly 4 sites at `:807`, `>= 4` and equal counts at `:1095-1097`; currently L1405, 1580, 1611, 1935); `max_tokens` literal absent from worker.js (`maxTokens` camelCase option is fine). `flows-reading-worker.mjs:341`: exactly one `ai: () => cappedAi(` in worker.js (L1711). `meteredAi` refuses when the spend cannot be read (cap fails closed) unless there is no `DB`.
- **T5. Neuron regexes.** `flows-neuron.mjs:603-606` requires `FLOWS_NEURON.guardOptions(ctx)` exactly once and `proseIssue(parsed.summary, "summary")`; `:809-829` pins the reparse block (`if (attempt > 0) { if (said.failure) refused = "unreachable:reparse:" + ...; break;`), `verdict.ok ? "ideas:unparsable" : refused || "ideas:unparsable"`, `guard = refused || "summary:empty";`, `emptyNote(said.attempts)` exactly twice, `thrownThenEmptyNote(said.attempts, first && (FALLBACK_FAILED[first.failed]`, `const meter = afterCall || base.spend;`, `meter.remaining > 0`, `spend: meter, note: say`, `sameCall && (prior.llm || repliedGuard(prior.guard)) && intradayOnly`, `ageMs < intradayFloorMs(prior.llm, prior.guard)) return;` (and no `ageMs < 45 * 60 * 1000`), `prior.fingerprint.endsWith("|" + signature)`; `:980-982` pins `if (ctx.engine) return generateEngineNeuron(`, `FLOWS_NEURON.engineFallback(ctx)`, `FLOWS_NEURON.vetEngineReply(parsed, ctx)` and the literal `{ v: 3, verdict: res.verdict, claims: res.claims, ideas: res.ideas, refused: res.refused }`. Rename or reformat these only together with the test.
- **T6. Summary firing.** `flows-live-contract.mjs:969-979`: `summaryFiring` must read exactly `await refreshFlowsSummary(env, at); if (env.DB) await FLOWS_LIVE.clockPatchStatement(env.DB, { summaryAt: at }, at).run();`; `refreshFlowsSummary`'s body (between `async function refreshFlowsSummary(` and `async function summaryFiring(`) must not mention `summaryAt`, must start with the four-statement `DB.batch` (brief `updated_at`, `LIVE_BRIEF_STAMP_SQL`, ...) and must call `readFlowsPayload(env, "brief")` only after the `if (!retryableGuard(prior.guard, priorAge)) return;` stamp check, so a no-op firing never reads the 118 KB payload.
- **T7. Schema bootstrap text.** `flows-live-contract.mjs:1738-1740` pins `DB.batch([...FLOWS_SCHEMA_SQL, FLOWS_LIVE.CLOCK_COLUMNS_SQL]` and `await FLOWS_LIVE.upgradeClockColumns(env.DB, results && results[FLOWS_SCHEMA_SQL.length]); flowsSchemaReady = true;` (the PRAGMA must stay the last statement of the batch: the upgrade reads its result at index `FLOWS_SCHEMA_SQL.length`, so `FLOWS_SCHEMA_SQL` can grow but nothing may be inserted after it). `flows-dossier-contract.mjs:591` requires `FLOWS_DOSSIER.DOSSIER_SCHEMA_SQL` in worker.js and in sync with schema.sql and migration 0016.
- **T8. Ingest allowlist text.** `flows-legs-contract.mjs:892-894` needs the substring `^universe$|^regime$` inside `INGEST_VIEW_KEY_RE` and the literal `/^(card|card-x|hist):/.exec(key)`; `flows-worker-contract.mjs:2066` needs `|^focus$`; `flows-pipeline-contract.mjs:2248-2249` regex-reads `INGEST_META_KEYS_MAX = <n>;` and requires the pipeline's `LEDGER_PROBE_CHUNK` to be <= it. Adding a key means editing the regex, the pipeline's publish list and `flows-worker-contract.mjs`.
- **T9. Every declared Flows route needs a rows-read ceiling.** `flows-reads-contract.mjs:797-801` greps `path === "/api/flows/<name>"` in worker.js and fails for any route (other than ingest and tape) missing from its `CEILING` table (L755-771). Budget in rows, never `json_each` on a polled route; `LITE_SQL` and `KNOWN_SQL` expand the universe name list with `json_each`. `LITE_SQL` runs only on the cold absent-name paths (`absentKey` L1211, `absentNeuron` L1679; ceiling `names.length + 70` for `summary?t=`), while `KNOWN_SQL` is the tape admission probe (L3680, a route the ceiling table deliberately skips), so neither is on a polled hot path today.
- **T10. Sign-in path.** `flows-live-contract.mjs:2842-2846`: `exp: Date.now() + LAB_SESSION_MS }` and `cookie("session", session, { maxAge: LAB_SESSION_MS / 1000 })` must stay, `await recordSignIn(env.DB, user, Date.now());` must be the only users write and the text `INSERT INTO users` must not appear in worker.js.
- **T11. Route/handler text pins in part B that depend on part-A names:** `if (key === "clock") { requireMethod(request, ["GET"]); await ensureFlowsTables(env); return FLOWS_LIVE.serveIngestClock(env, { json, lab: tokenKind === "nightly" });` after the 401 check (`flows-live-contract.mjs:2192-2194`); ingest 503 on `check.unavailable` within 1,500 characters of `if (path === "/api/flows/ingest")` (`:1468-1470`); cron routing text (`:962-967`).
- **T12. wrangler.toml pins.** `compatibility_date` must not exceed the pinned workerd's supported date (`contracts.mjs`); `run_worker_first = ["/*", "!/assets/*"]` literal; four crons named by weekday NAMES (Cloudflare counts 1 = Sunday); `html_handling = "auto-trailing-slash"`.

Behavioural traps:

- **T13. Lazy-schema ordering.** `results[0]` of every `learningBatch` is the `learning_sync` INSERT. `loadMasterySnapshot`, `loadPlacementSnapshot`, `loadProgressSnapshot`, `loadStatsSnapshot` read `results[1]`...; `runBootstrapBatch` reads `[1]` points, `[2]` generation, `[3]` progress, `[4]` stats, `[5]` mastery, `[6]` placement; `loadAcademyBootstrapSnapshot` reads `[7]`-`[10]`; route handlers index `results[n]` the same way. Reordering `bootstrapLegacyStatements` / `bootstrapAcademyStatements` or inserting a statement silently shifts every consumer.
- **T14. Tri-state day normalizers.** `normalizeDay` / `normalizeActivityDay` return `null` (absent), `undefined` (invalid) or a string; callers test `=== undefined` (stats PUT L3133) or falsiness (mastery, placement). Do not collapse them.
- **T15. Academy fallbacks cover tables, not constraints.** A database predating a column needs an `ALTER` path like `ensureDayColumns`; the `placement` CHECK on `recommended_topic` is seven ids, so adding a placement topic needs a table rebuild migration, not just `PLACEMENT_TOPICS`.
- **T16. `STAGE_KEY_BY_COURSE` keys include the course** (`"ols:ols-line-01"`), while `COURSE_STAGE_BY_ID[...].id` does not; `validSkillItem` indexes `COURSE_STAGE_BY_ID[itemId]` with the prefixed form.
- **T17. Points are derived.** Client-sent totals are ignored; `derivedPointsSelectStatement` binds `JSON.stringify(COURSE_STAGE_POINTS)`, so a new course's weights must be in `shared/course-points.js` (generated) or its progress scores 0.
- **T18. `uwFetch` has no timeout.** It awaits `fetch` with no abort timer (unlike `fetchIndexQuote`); callers cap latency with their own `Promise.race`/deadlines (dossier 2.5 s per source, 3 s total; Tier 1 tick). Its 429 and 5xx errors carry `.upstream` (the vendor status), which only `shared/flows-dossier-worker.js:289` reads.
- **T19. `askQuestion` is unbounded.** It uses `request.json()` directly (no `readJSON`, no 16 KiB cap, no media-type check); only the question text is truncated (400 chars). Not an auth hole (the route is behind the Flows session) but it contradicts the "16 KiB JSON" sentence in AGENTS.md.
- **T20. Last-good copy limits.** Keyed by path and `side`/`t` only, never by cookie or query; proven on local workerd and a Cache API fake only; `caches.default` is per data centre and a no-op on `workers.dev`; `X-Server-Now` is stripped so `finalize` re-stamps it. The kept response must carry a truthy numeric `X-Payload-Updated`: `{status:"pending"}` answers have none and are never kept, while live-overlaid `pulse`, `flowalerts` and `news` responses do carry it (`shared/flows-live-worker.js:1165,1176`) and are kept like a stored row.
- **T21. Three `ctx.waitUntil(cache.put(...))` writes carry no `.catch`.** `cachedTickerInfo` (L2076), `serveCachedVendorRead` (L2177, and its `else await cache.put` at L2178 is bare too) and `cachedIndexSpot` (L2353) are bare, whereas the last-good (L1077), classify (L1193-1194), screen (L1690) and course HTML (L2756) writes, and the `else` branches of the info (L2077) and spot (L2354) writes, swallow errors. `cachedTickerInfo` also never caches a failure.
- **T22. Market negative cache.** A total Yahoo failure rewrites only `updated_at`; the previous good payload keeps being served (and counted as fresh for the next 45 min / 25 min) until a flight succeeds.
- **T23. Classify cache asymmetry.** A cached `{known:false}` is trusted for the full 12 h even in regular hours; only `known:true` rows are re-validated (15 min in RTH). A name listed after midday can read as unknown until the entry expires.
- **T24. Tests run with no model and fixed tokens.** `startWorker()` passes `FLOWS_ASK_MODEL:` and `FLOWS_ASK_FALLBACK_MODEL:` empty, `GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID=test-client`, `SESSION_SECRET=test-session-secret-...`, `FLOWS_SESSION_EPOCH:1`; server suites build D1 only from `schema.sql`, so a table that exists only in a first-use DDL const is not exercised by them except through the fallbacks.
- **T25. Comments.** The repo rule is "source files carry no comments"; `worker.js` has none today and no test scans it, so the first stray `//` would pass CI but violate policy. Reasoning goes in the commit message.
- **T26. Reads that write.** Every `learningBatch` begins with the `INSERT INTO learning_sync ... ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING`, so even a GET (bootstrap, progress, stats, mastery, placement) is a write statement: it creates one row the first time a user is seen and changes nothing afterwards. `loadGeneration` (used by the 409 path) does the same. A read-only role or replica for these routes would break them.

#### Docs vs source (source wins)

1. AGENTS.md "Curriculum and stage contracts" describes seven courses (`ols 20 · iv2sls 31 · did 29 · var 30 · panel 30 · logit 32 · gmm 33`), DEPLOY.md section 7 (line 225, "all seven course paths") repeats the count, and AGENTS.md "Testing and CI" calls the review bank "deterministic 96-item". Source: 12 courses (`shared/course-seo.js` `COURSE_TOPICS`, `shared/course-points.js` 12 keys, `assets/js/course-catalog.js` `TOPIC_META` 12 entries: plus `foundations 32 · mle 32 · forecast 32 · coint 32 · financial 32`), 365 stages in `shared/stage-manifest.js`, 84 skills, 106 review items (`tests/mastery-contract.mjs`), 3 projects (`shared/project-manifest.js`), 252 challenge variants (`tests/academy-contract.mjs`). `PLACEMENT_TOPICS` correctly stays at the original seven.
2. AGENTS.md "API contract" omits `GET /api/markets`, `GET /api/v2/bootstrap` and the four `PUT /api/v2/{progress,attempt,preferences,project}` routes (L2867-3023) and the extra keys on `DELETE /api/progress` (`stableProgress`, `skillMastery`, `projects`). The client prefers v2 (`assets/js/auth.js:930`).
3. AGENTS.md invariant 3 lists jsDelivr and the analytics beacon in the CSP but not `wss://anilkaya.org` in `connect-src` (L111), which the real-time rail needs.
4. AGENTS.md says JSON bodies are streamed with a 16 KiB limit; true for `readJSON`, not for `askQuestion` (T19). Ingest POST has its own 128 KiB cap.
5. AGENTS.md lists `placement-contract` among suites that boot workerd; its source uses its own `http.createServer` server (which answers the bootstrap routes itself) and `conflictPage.route` stubs of `/api/*`, and never imports `worker-server.mjs` (grep: no `startWorker`). It does not exercise `worker.js`; the Worker's placement behaviour is tested in `worker-regression.mjs`.
6. `shared/project-manifest.js` is hand-written (no generator writes it; only `worker.js` and `tests/academy-contract.mjs` import it), unlike `stage-manifest.js` / `skill-manifest.js` (written at `scripts/generate-course-payloads.mjs:299,302`) and absent from the AGENTS.md file map; adding a project means editing it by hand plus the client's project data and `assets/data/projects/provenance.json` (academy-contract requires every dataset id in `PROJECT_BY_ID`).
7. AGENTS.md's file map lists `labActiveAt` under `shared/lab-sign-in.js`; that is the field name of the ingest `clock` body (`shared/flows-live-worker.js:851`, read by `scripts/flows-legs/health.mjs:340`). The module's actual exports are `LAB_SESSION_MS`, `SIGN_IN_SQL`, `LEGACY_SIGN_IN_SQL`, `SIGNED_IN_COLUMN_SQL`, `recordSignIn`, `LAB_ACTIVITY`, `readLabActiveAt`.

### How to change it

**Security headers / CSP.** Edit `CSP` (L102-115) or `SECURITY_HEADERS` (L117-125). For headers, make the identical edit in `_headers` `/assets/*` (same names and values). Run from `tests/`: `node contracts.mjs` (parity regex), `FLOWS_TEST_SANDBOX=1 node worker-regression.mjs` (`assertSecurity` L64, analytics origin L94), `FLOWS_TEST_SANDBOX=1 node flows-rt-server.mjs` if `connect-src` changed. Then `./tests/node_modules/.bin/wrangler deploy --dry-run --outdir /tmp/anilkaya-dry-run` and, after deploy, DEPLOY.md section 7 curl smoke tests plus a check that no dashboard Transform Rule overrides. No `assets/version.txt` bump (worker.js is not under `assets/css|js|data`).

**Add or change a learning-API field/route.** Helpers live at L274-902; the handler in `route()` (L2867-3335). New persisted state: add the table to `schema.sql`, a new `migrations/00NN_*.sql` (and teach `tests/academy-contract.mjs:84-120`, which hard-codes the migration file union `0001+0002+0004+0005+0010+0015+0016`, to include it), a first-use DDL const plus a regex arm in the right `*Batch` wrapper (L354-435, chain order `learning -> mastery -> placement -> academy`), a bootstrap statement at the END of `bootstrapAcademyStatements` (L820) and its parser in `loadAcademyBootstrapSnapshot` (L886), and a clause in the `DELETE /api/progress` batch (L3051-3070) so reset clears it (unless it is a preference, like `learning_preferences`). Writes must use the `INSERT ... SELECT ... WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM learning_sync WHERE user_id=? AND generation=?)` fence and re-check the generation. Client side: `assets/js/auth.js` (sync), `assets/js/storage.js` (envelope; bump `assets/version.txt` and every `?v=` per AGENTS.md "Asset versioning"). Tests: `tests/worker-regression.mjs` (`learningJSON` L77, `academyPut` flows ~L746-840, reset ~L894-990), `tests/contracts.mjs` client fakes (~L515-801), `tests/academy-contract.mjs`, `tests/placement-contract.mjs` if the placement UI is touched.

**Add a course.** Authoring/generator edits are elsewhere (`node scripts/generate-course-payloads.mjs`, commit generated `shared/course-points.js`, `stage-manifest.js`, `skill-manifest.js`, `review-manifest.js`, `course-seo.js`, payloads, `assets/js/review-catalog.js`). Worker impact is automatic through the manifests (`COURSE_STAGE_POINTS`, `STAGE_KEY_BY_COURSE`, derived-points SQL, `REVIEW_ITEM_BY_ID`); only `PLACEMENT_TOPICS` (L306), `PLACEMENT_SCHEMA_SQL` (L76), `schema.sql` and a migration need hand edits if placement may recommend it (CHECK rebuild). Re-run `worker-regression.mjs`, `academy-contract.mjs`, `contracts.mjs`.

**Change the market strip.** Parse rules in `shared/markets.js` (`MARKET_INDICES`, `parseIndexQuote`, `buildSnapshot`, thresholds L77-78); transport in L437-546; cron firing in `scheduled()` L3978. Tests: `node markets-contract.mjs`, `node market-ticker-render.mjs`, `worker-regression.mjs` (L107-200; its Yahoo stub is wired by `extraVars: MARKET_QUOTE_ORIGIN:`). Client `assets/js/market-ticker.js` is under `assets/js` so a change there needs the version bump.

**Add a Flows stored key.** Ingest allowlist `INGEST_VIEW_KEY_RE` (L937; keep T8 substrings), publish side in the pipeline (other area), read route in part B (add to `LAST_GOOD_PATHS` L1041 if it should survive a quota day), a `CEILING` entry in `tests/flows-reads-contract.mjs:755-771` (T9), `tests/flows-worker-contract.mjs` for the ingest/read pair, `tests/flows-payload-shape.mjs` and `flows-weight.mjs` if the payload shape or page weight moves. Honour the one-writer rule (T3).

**Change store-failure behaviour (quota, last-good, store_unreadable).** `STORE_QUOTA_RE` L1030, `secondsToUtcMidnight` L1032, `storeGone` L1036, last-good block L1038-1097, `fetch()` catch L3996-4013. Tests: `flows-reads-contract.mjs:828-880` (needs a fake `caches.default`), `flows-ledger-contract.mjs` (`store_quota`), `flows-worker-contract.mjs`. Update AGENTS.md D1 paragraph and DEPLOY.md 10.4c in the same change.

**Change the Neuron / summary / Ask.** Prompts and vetting live in `shared/flows-neuron.js`, `flows-ask.js`, `flows-ai.js`; the orchestration is L1337-1991. Observe T4-T6 before reformatting; run `node flows-neuron.mjs`, `node flows-ask.mjs`, `node --disable-warning=ExperimentalWarning flows-reads-contract.mjs`, `node --disable-warning=ExperimentalWarning flows-reading-worker.mjs`, `node flows-live-contract.mjs`, `FLOWS_TEST_SANDBOX=1 node flows-ask-render.mjs`. A change of model chain changes `aiCallSignature` and therefore every stored fingerprint (readings regenerate on the next read). New model call sites must use `askModels(meteredAi(env), ...)` and record spend through `askRecordSpend`.

**Change the vendor client.** `uwFetch` (L2003) is shared by Tier 1/focus ticks (`scheduled()` L3962, 3969), the dossier, classify, chain and strategy. Keep the error codes (`chain_*`) and the `.upstream` property; the rail has its own adapter. Tests: `flows-live-contract.mjs`, `flows-worker-contract.mjs`, `flows-dossier-reads.mjs` (round-trip and vendor-call counts, and the `maxBytes` / `chain_too_large` path at L309: the only test of it), `flows-reads-contract.mjs` (rows).

**Add an env var or secret.** Secrets are dashboard bindings; plain config goes in `wrangler.toml [vars]` (a test reads that file in `flows-neuron.mjs`). Server suites pass overrides through `startWorker({ extraVars: ["NAME:value"] })`; in-process suites pass an `env` object to the imported default export. Document it in AGENTS.md/DEPLOY.md.

**Registering or running tests.** A new suite file needs a `test:<name>` script and a link in the `npm test` chain in `tests/package.json` (no automatic discovery; the order matters because the chain stops at the first failure). Suites that import `worker.js` and `node:sqlite` need Node >= 22.13 and `--disable-warning=ExperimentalWarning`. Server suites in the agent sandbox: `cd tests && FLOWS_TEST_SANDBOX=1 node <suite>.mjs`. A suite that calls `startWorker(` may not hold an ISO date within the next 400 days unless it is listed in `ANCHORED` (`tests/contracts.mjs:873`, scan at L886-905), because workerd runs on the real clock and cannot be shifted. Always finish with `./tests/node_modules/.bin/wrangler deploy --dry-run --outdir /tmp/anilkaya-dry-run` from the repo root (CI runs the same dry run, to `/tmp/anilkaya-worker-dry-run`, before `npm test`: `.github/workflows/regression.yml:38-39`).

**Rituals that part-A edits do NOT trigger:** no `assets/version.txt` bump (worker.js and `shared/` are excluded from the static bundle by `.assetsignore`), no generator run, no font-token change. Rituals they DO trigger when a shared manifest or generated file is touched: the generator run and the version bump described in AGENTS.md.

## worker.js part B (lines 2050-4015)

Repository commit `ba2acfe` (origin/main after PR 148; asset version 240, fonts token 230). Every line number below is from `grep -n` / `sed -n` / Read on `/home/user/anilkaya.org/worker.js` (4015 lines, 186,383 bytes) at that commit. Part A (lines 1-2050) is mapped separately; I cite its symbols only where part B calls them.

### Purpose and boundaries

What this slice is: the second half of `worker.js`, the Cloudflare Worker entry module (`wrangler.toml`: `main = "worker.js"`, name `anilkaya`). It holds, in file order:

1. the Flows vendor-read plumbing (quote card, overlays, chain, strategy, SPY index spot, 120 s Cache API vendor-read cache) at 2048-2565;
2. the Flows schema bootstrap and login-throttle helpers at 2567-2636;
3. `currentUser` (Lab session) at 2638, and the course SEO renderer (HTMLRewriter) at 2647-2760;
4. `route()` at 2762-3916, a single 1,155-line chain of `if (path ...)` blocks that is the whole HTTP surface: Google OAuth, Lab learning API (v1 and v2), Flows login and pages, Flows ingest door, `/api/flows/*` read API, the `/api/rt/*` hook, legacy-course redirects, course pages, asset fall-through;
5. `finalize()` at 3918 (the one response-policy chokepoint);
6. `export default { scheduled, fetch }` at 3948-4015 (cron entry and request entry with the error mapper).

What it is not: it does not define `HttpError`, `json`, `apiError`, `redirect`, `requireMethod`, `requireSameOrigin`, `requireMutationOwner`, `requireReadOwnerIfPresent`, `readJSON`, `readBounded`, `learningBatch`/`masteryBatch`/`placementBatch`/`academyBatch`, `readFlowsPayload`/`readServed`/`passthrough`, `lastGood*`, the Neuron/Ask/summary generators, `uwFetch`, `tickerNeuron`, `summaryResponse`, `dossierResponse` (all Part A, lines 148-2046). It contains no Pyodide, no HTML pages (those are `shared/flows-pages.js`), no Tier 1/Tier 2 logic (that is `shared/flows-live-worker.js`; part B only wires the cron entry to it), and no Durable Object code (`Pulse` is re-exported at line 38 from `shared/flows-rt-hub.js`; part B only forwards `/api/rt/*` to `serveRt`).

#### `/api/flows/ingest` (3454-3599)

- Methods GET, POST, DELETE. Credential from `Authorization: Bearer`. `FLOWS_LIVE.looksLikeJwt(offered)` marks a GitHub OIDC token. No `FLOWS_INGEST_TOKEN`, no `FLOWS_LIVE_TOKEN` and no JWT: 503 `unavailable`. `FLOWS_LIVE.tokenKind` compares with `timingSafeEqualStr` (Part A 925): `FLOWS_INGEST_TOKEN` is `nightly`, `FLOWS_LIVE_TOKEN` is `live`. A JWT goes to `FLOWS_LIVE.oidcKind` (verifies against the GitHub JWKS: `GITHUB_OIDC_JWKS` override, 1 h key memo); `check.unavailable` is 503 (so the pipeline retries); no kind: 401.
- `?list=card,card-x,hist` (3473): GET, nightly token only; one `SELECT ... WHERE (id >= 'kind:' AND id < 'kind;') OR ...` statement (`ingestListSql`, one OR-ed range per requested kind), `LIMIT 2001` (`INGEST_LIST_MAX + 1`), answer `ingestListing(rows)` = `{keys, listed, truncated}`; a failed read is `storeGone()` (503 `store_unreadable`).
- `?keys=a,b,...` (3487): GET, nightly token only; at most 96 keys (`INGEST_META_KEYS_MAX`, a hard ceiling the pipeline's `LEDGER_PROBE_CHUNK` must stay under); each must pass `ingestKeyParts(...).valid`; one prepared `SELECT id, updated_at, length(payload), json_extract(sessionDate/generatedAt/status) ... WHERE id IN (?,...)` (`INGEST_META_SQL`, a single `.all()`, not a batch) answered as `{keys: ingestMetadata(asked, rows)}`; more than 96 keys is 400 `too_many_keys`; a failed read is `storeGone()`.
- `?key=clock` (3508): GET only, after the credential check; `FLOWS_LIVE.serveIngestClock(env, { json, lab: tokenKind === "nightly" })` (the nightly token additionally gets `labActiveAt` and the `ledger` view).
- `?key=live:*` (3514): `FLOWS_LIVE.ingestScope(key, method, tokenKind)` (live role: live keys only, never DELETE, plus GET of `board:long|short|watch`, `meta`, `focus`; nightly role: no live write), body <= 128 KiB (`FLOWS_MAX_PAYLOAD_BYTES`), then `FLOWS_LIVE.ingestLive` (key registry cap per key, `checkLiveWrite`, `writeLiveStatement`; `live:heartbeat` also stamps `flows_clock.live_done_at` and a ledger pass).
- Any other key: `ingestKeyParts` (`card|card-x|hist:<TICKER>` or the allowlist regex `INGEST_VIEW_KEY_RE`: boards, dated boards, dated scores, `scoretrack`, `flowalerts`, `pulse`, `political`, `record`, `movers`, `market`, `unusual`, `events`, `sector:trix`, `sector:premium`, `news`, `brief`, `meta`, `universe`, `regime`, `ideas`, `focus`, `roster`) else 400 `invalid_key`. GET returns the stored payload (`passthrough`) or `{key,status:"pending"}`. DELETE (3538) only for dated archive keys or, with the nightly token, card/card-x/hist; 404 JSON `{removed:0,status:"absent"}` if nothing deleted. POST (3551): payload must be valid JSON; dated archive keys (`board:long|short:YYYY-MM-DD`, `scores:YYYY-MM-DD`) go through `archiveWriteAction` (imported from `shared/flows-archive.js` at line 34): identical re-post is `stored:"unchanged"`, a different body or unreadable store is refused with `ARCHIVE_REFUSALS[...]`, creation is `INSERT ... ON CONFLICT(id) DO NOTHING` (a race is `refuse_raced`); the D1 trigger `flows_archive_immutable` (in `LIVE_SCHEMA_SQL`) also aborts any UPDATE of such rows. Every other key is an upsert (`INSERT ... ON CONFLICT(id) DO UPDATE`); key `meta` is written in one `batchWithLedger` batch together with `FLOWS_LIVE.nightlyLedger(db, payload, at)` (the ledger's "nightly landed" statement).

#### Durable Objects, bindings, env vars, secrets

- Bindings (wrangler.toml): `ASSETS` (`directory = "."`, `html_handling = "auto-trailing-slash"`, `not_found_handling = "404-page"`, `run_worker_first = ["/*", "!/assets/*"]`), `DB` (D1 `iewt`, `migrations_dir = "migrations"`), `AI`, `UW_ONDEMAND` ratelimit (namespace 1101, 120 per 60 s; used by `FLOWS_LIVE.ondemandAllowed`), `PULSE` Durable Object class `Pulse` (SQLite-backed, migration `v1`), observability on at head sampling 1. There is no `[limits]` block. Cron triggers: `1-59/5 13-21 * * MON-FRI` (Tier 1), `3-58/5 13-21 * * MON-FRI` (focus), `*/30 * * * *` (housekeeping), `15,45 * * * *` (summary). Weekday is spelled out because Cloudflare numbers weekdays from 1 = Sunday; `tests/flows-live-contract.mjs` and `flows-rt-contract.mjs` (1445-1446) pin the four strings.
- Read in part B directly: `DB`, `ASSETS`, `SESSION_SECRET`, `GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID`, `GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET`, `FLOWS_CREDENTIALS`, `FLOWS_PEPPER`, `FLOWS_INGEST_TOKEN`, `FLOWS_LIVE_TOKEN`, `UW_BASE`, `UW_NOW` (honoured only together with `UW_BASE`).
- Read through the shared modules part B wires: `UW_API_KEY` (uwFetch, 503 `chain_unconfigured` if absent), `FLOWS_SESSION_EPOCH` (plain var), `FLOWS_LIVE_MODE` (`off|worker|actions`, default actions), `GITHUB_DISPATCH_TOKEN` (secret; no token means Tier 1 still runs but dispatches are no-ops), `GITHUB_API_BASE`, `GITHUB_OIDC_JWKS` (test overrides, locked to token.actions.githubusercontent.com or loopback), `FLOWS_LIVE_REPO`, `FLOWS_LIVE_REF`, `FLOWS_LIVE_WORKFLOW` (default `flows-live.yml`), `FLOWS_NIGHTLY_WORKFLOW` (default `flows-pipeline.yml`), `FLOWS_RT_MODE`, `FLOWS_RT_AUDIENCE`, `FLOWS_RT_USERS`, `FLOWS_RT_HINT`, `FLOWS_READ_MODE`, `FLOWS_ASK_MODEL`, `FLOWS_ASK_FALLBACK_MODEL`, `FLOWS_ASK_NEURONS`, `FLOWS_ASK_FALLBACK_NEURONS`, `FLOWS_AI_DAILY_CAP_NEURONS` (30,000), `FLOWS_AI_DAILY_CAP_CALLS` (2,500), `MARKET_QUOTE_ORIGIN` (test stub for Yahoo). Secrets (never in source): `GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID`, `GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET`, `SESSION_SECRET`, `FLOWS_CREDENTIALS`, `FLOWS_PEPPER`, `FLOWS_INGEST_TOKEN`, `GITHUB_DISPATCH_TOKEN`, `UW_API_KEY`; `FLOWS_LIVE_TOKEN` is a retired static live credential kept as an accepted option (the live leg uses OIDC).

| item | value |
|---|---|
| Lab cookie | `session`, HMAC-SHA256 token `base64url(json).base64url(sig)` (`signSession`, `verifySession`: length <= 4096, needs `sub` and numeric future `exp`), `Path=/; HttpOnly; Secure; SameSite=Lax`, Max-Age 30 days (`LAB_SESSION_MS`); claims `{sub:"g_<googleSub>", email, name, aud:"learn", exp}` |
| Flows cookie | `flows_session` (`FLOWS_COOKIE`), 14 days, claims `{sub, aud:"flows", epoch, exp, uep?}`; `verifyFlowsSession` also re-checks the member in `FLOWS_CREDENTIALS` (active, epoch). The static-roster branch (`FLOWS_USERNAMES`) only runs when `members` is null, and `currentFlowsUser` always passes `readMembers(env.FLOWS_CREDENTIALS)`, which is never null (an empty frozen `NO_MEMBERS` when the secret is unset or unparsable), so in the Worker an unset `FLOWS_CREDENTIALS` rejects every existing cookie; the 12-name roster survives in production only as the throttle-bucket list (`throttleBucket`) |
| `oauth_state` | CSRF state cookie, 600 s |
| Flows lockout | 8 failures inside 15 minutes lock the throttle key for 15 minutes (`LOCKOUT`); key = bucket (member name from the static 12-name roster, else shared `*`) + address (IPv6 collapsed to /64) |
| Owner/generation headers | `X-IEWT-Owner` (exact `user.id`), `X-IEWT-Generation` (non-negative safe integer, regex `^(0\|[1-9]\d*)$`), response `X-IEWT-Generation` on every Lab success and on 409 `reset_required` |
| Response policy (`finalize`) | 7 headers from `SECURITY_HEADERS` (117-125); CSP set only when `Content-Type` contains `text/html`, deleted otherwise (CSP string at 102-115; `connect-src` includes `wss://anilkaya.org` for the rail); `/api/*`, `/auth/*`, `/flows`, `/flows/*`: `Cache-Control: no-store` except a 200 GET/HEAD of `/api/markets`; `/api/flows/*` gets `X-Server-Now` unless present; other HTML `no-cache`; 200/304 GET/HEAD with `?v=` under `/assets/` immutable one year (only reachable in local/proxied cases, because the edge serves `/assets/*` itself); other 200/304 non-JSON typed responses `public, max-age=3600` |
| Freshness | `X-Fresh-State`, `X-Fresh-Read-At`, `X-Fresh-Live-Until`, `X-Fresh-Stale-At`, `X-Fresh-Reason`, `X-Fresh-Session`, `X-Fresh-Source`, `X-Fresh-Cadence`, `X-Fresh-Class`, `X-Fresh-Phase`, `X-Fresh-Phase-Ends` (all eleven are written in `shared/flows-freshness.js`; `X-Fresh-Last-Good` is added by `recallLastGood`, Part A 1083), `X-Payload-Updated`, `X-Live-Overlay`, `X-Quote-Ttl`, `X-Tape`, `X-Chain-Cache`, `X-Chain-Age`, `X-Dossier-*`, `X-Server-Now` |

#### Budgets and caps with their numbers

- JSON request bodies: 16 KiB (`MAX_JSON_BYTES`), streamed; Flows login form 4 KiB; ingest payload 128 KiB; rail client message 256 bytes.
- Vendor read caps in this slice: chain: page size 500, at most 2 pages, ranked output limit 120, 120 s cache, 15 s refresh floor; strategy: 500 per page, 2 pages per option type; none of chain, strategy, info or SPY reads is gated by the `UW_ONDEMAND` limiter (they call `uwFetch` directly); the quote, tape, classify and dossier paths are (`FLOWS_LIVE.ondemandAllowed`, 120 per 60 s).
- Tier 1 (`rthTick`): two vendor calls (`/api/market/market-tide?interval_5m=true`, `/api/market/sector-etfs`), 6 s timeout each, `live:market` cap 16 KiB. Focus tick: one `/api/screener/stocks?ticker=<names>&limit=500` call, up to 40 names, `live:focus` cap 16 KiB. Prune: `flows_tape` rows not served for 7 days, `flows_ledger` rows at or before the retention cutoff (`ledgerPruneCutoff`), only in the 03:00-03:30 ET window (`pruneDue` reads `phaseAt(at, null).minutes`, Eastern wall minutes 180 to < 210, so only the 03:00 ET firing of `*/30`, every calendar day including weekends).
- Quote card TTL by phase: rth 5 s, pre/post 30 s, closed 6 h. Tape: lease 20 s, usable 30 min in RTH, wait <= 1.5 s, retention 7 days.
- D1 Free-plan daily caps (account-wide): 100,000 rows written and 5,000,000 rows read; store quota error 7500 maps to `503 store_quota` with `Retry-After` to 00:00 UTC (`isStoreQuota` / `secondsToUtcMidnight`, fetch 4008). Free-plan CPU cap quoted in DEPLOY.md is 10 ms per invocation including cron; summary firing measured 10.5 ms mean, housekeeping 7.6 ms mean (DEPLOY 10.5i).
- Last good copy: 24 h, 22 paths.
- Course edge copy 60 s.

### Flows

**1. Every request**
1. Edge: `/assets/*` answered by the asset layer (headers from `_headers`); everything else invokes `fetch()` (worker.js:3990).
2. `route(request, env, url, ctx)` (2762) walks the `if (path ...)` chain in the order of the route table.
3. On a normal return: `rememberLastGood(request, url, response, ctx)` (3994; Part A 1064, only for 200s that carry a non-zero `X-Payload-Updated` on the 22 nightly read paths, written in `ctx.waitUntil`), then `finalize(...)` (3995).
4. On `HttpError`: if `code === "store_unreadable"`, try `recallLastGood` (3998) and finalize that; else `finalize(apiError(status, code, message, headers, details))` (4000). `details` is spread into the JSON body, which is how `STORE_GONE` adds `status:"unavailable", reason:"store"`.
5. Any other throw: `console.error({message:"request failed", method, path, error})` (4002); if `isStoreQuota(error)` then 503 `store_quota` with `Retry-After`; else 500 `internal_error`. The OAuth callback never reaches this because it catches everything itself.

**2. Lab sign-in** `/auth/google` (2766) -> Google -> `/auth/callback` (2784): state check (2791) -> token exchange (2793) -> userinfo (2808) -> `recordSignIn` (2816, `shared/lab-sign-in.js`: upsert `users`, adds `signed_in_at` on first use, legacy fallback) -> `signSession` (2818) -> redirect `/lab/?auth=ok`. The browser then hydrates through `assets/js/auth.js`, which tries `/api/v2/bootstrap` (auth.js:930) and falls back to `/api/bootstrap` (auth.js:939).

**3. A Lab mutation** (for example `PUT /api/progress`, 3085-3117): `requireMethod` -> `requireSessionSecret` -> `currentUser` (401 if null) -> `requireSameOrigin` -> `requireMutationOwner` (409 `account_changed`) -> `mutationGeneration` (Part A 723; 409 `reset_required` with the current generation when the header is missing or malformed) -> `readJSON` (415/400/413) -> `normalizeDone` -> `learningBatch` (Part A 354; prepends `INSERT INTO learning_sync (user_id, generation) VALUES (?, 0) ON CONFLICT(user_id) DO NOTHING`, so the first builder statement is `results[1]`; `academyBatch` wraps `placementBatch` wraps `masteryBatch` wraps `learningBatch`, so the same prepend applies to every Lab batch) -> compare `learning_sync.generation` and the returned row -> `json({ok:true,...}, 200, generationHeaders(generation))`. First-use schema repair is inside `learningBatch` / `masteryBatch` / `placementBatch` / `academyBatch` (they re-run a `CREATE TABLE` and retry once on `no such table`).

**4. Flows login and page**: `POST /flows/login` (3350) -> `parseCredentials(env.FLOWS_CREDENTIALS)` -> `flowsThrottleKey` -> `flowsLockRecord` -> `isLocked` -> `verifyCredential` -> (`recordFlowsFailure` on miss) / (`clearFlowsFailures` + `signFlowsSession` + 303) on success. Pages: `GET /flows/<page>/` (3428) -> `currentFlowsUser` -> `FLOWS_PAGES.<page>({ username })` or `loginPage()`; the HTML then calls `/api/flows/*` from the browser.

**5. Nightly ingest**: GitHub Actions `scripts/flows-pipeline.mjs` -> `POST /api/flows/ingest?key=<k>` with `Bearer FLOWS_INGEST_TOKEN` -> `tokenKind` = nightly (3463) -> `ingestKeyParts` (3524) -> `ingestScope` (3529) -> `readBounded` 128 KiB (3552, inside the `const payload = ...decode(` that opens at 3551) -> `JSON.parse` check (3555) -> `ensureFlowsTables` (3558) -> archive branch (3560) or upsert (3589-3596; `meta` also writes the ledger row) -> `{ok:true,key,bytes}`.

**6. Live ingest**: Actions `--live` leg (Tier 2) -> same route with a GitHub OIDC JWT -> `oidcKind` (3465; JWKS fetch with 1 h memo) -> `key.startsWith("live:")` (3514) -> `ingestScope` -> `FLOWS_LIVE.ingestLive` (`flows_live` upsert guarded by read time; `live:heartbeat` stamps `live_done_at`).

**7. Cron** (`scheduled`, 3950): `at = event.scheduledTime`; `job = FLOWS_LIVE.cronJob(event.cron, at)` (flows-live-worker.js:75: exact string match to the four wrangler crons, otherwise a clock-based fallback: minute%30==0 housekeeping, minute%30==15 summary, outside weekday 13-21 UTC housekeeping, minute%5==3 focus else rth). Each branch runs under `guard(label, promise)` (3952), a `ctx.waitUntil` that logs a rejection as `{message, error}` and never throws:
- `rth` (3959): `ensureFlowsTables` -> `FLOWS_LIVE.rthTick(env, at, { fetchVendor: uwFetch })` (flows-live-worker.js:371): tier-1 beat + ledger tick in one batch, holiday short circuit, `tier1Reads` -> `shapeMarketLive` -> `writeLiveStatement("live:market")`, workflow dispatch of `flows-live.yml` when due (`origin: "worker"`), watchdog re-dispatch when `live:breadth` is stalled (`origin: "watchdog"`), clock patch + ledger outcome in one batch.
- `focus` (3966): `focusTick` (flows-live-worker.js:504): clock + nightly `focus` groups + held `live:focus` in one batch, one screener call, writes `live:focus` as writer `worker@focus`.
- `summary` (3973): `summaryFiring(env, at)` (Part A 1423): `refreshFlowsSummary` (Part A 1337, board summary into `flows_ai_summary`) then stamps `flows_clock.summary_at` with the scheduled instant.
- else housekeeping (3978-3987): `refreshMarketSnapshotIfDue(env, at)` (Part A 533) and, in a second guard, `ensureFlowsTables` -> `nightlyTick` (flows-live-worker.js:554: dispatch `flows-pipeline.yml` at or after 17:15 ET, again after 18:15 ET if `meta` is behind, log `nightly missing` from 21:00 ET) -> when `pruneDue(at)`: `pruneTape` and `pruneLedger`.
- None of the four writes `flows_payload` (the nightly rows have one writer, the ingest route).

**8. Card read** (`/api/flows/card?t=T`, 3818): `readServed` -> found: `passthrough` (adds `X-Payload-Updated` and nightly `X-Fresh-*`) or, if the JSON contains `"engine":{"status":"split"`, `cardWithEngine` merges `card-x:T` and answers with only `X-Payload-Updated`; not found: `absentKey` (Part A 1209: one `batchWithClock` that always reads the roster row and, for `kind === "card"` only, also the lite universe row and the events gate row; pending if scheduled tonight; `card-x` and `hist` then answer `{status:"absent", why:"not-covered"}`; a card gets the lite card, else the vendor classify, else `absent`).

**9. Chain read** (3835): validate ticker, `strategy` in {csp, cc} else both, `rank` in `RANK_KEYS` else `annualized` -> `serveCachedVendorRead` (cache hit unless `refresh=1` and the hit is >= 15 s old) -> on miss `buildChainPayload`: parallel vendor reads + card -> `printOf` (regular-session price) -> `coherence` (impossible asks, strike bracket, one underlying fitted; `mismatch` yields `offMarketChain`) -> `rankChain` -> earnings flags -> `deskEngine` -> cache put in `ctx.waitUntil` -> `json(payload)` with `X-Chain-Cache: miss`.

**10. Strategy read** (3856): without `expiry`, `buildStrategyContext` (expiry list, SPY index, beta, earnings); with `expiry`, `buildStrategyExpiry` (calls and puts, Greeks, IV convention, and with `engine=1` the repriced engine block over the card).

**11. Summary / dossier / reading** (3725, 3747): `summary?t=T` -> Part A `summaryResponse` (1718) runs `tickerNeuron` (1760) and `FLOWS_READING.readingSafe` (shared/flows-reading-worker.js:242, box 1,500 ms) concurrently and returns `{...neuronBody, read}`; `dossier?t=T` -> `ensureFlowsTables` -> `dossierResponse` (1730) -> `FLOWS_DOSSIER.assembleDossier` (shared/flows-dossier-worker.js:317); model calls go through `cappedAi` (reading at 75% of `FLOWS_AI_DAILY_CAP_NEURONS`).

**12. Rail hook** (3889): `serveRt` (shared/flows-rt-routes.js:16): `rtSwitches(env).mode !== "on"` -> 404 `rt_off` (even anonymous); no `PULSE` binding -> 404 `rt_off`; path must be `/api/rt/ws|snap|status` else 404; method GET else 405; Flows session else 401; `status` owner-only, others `rtAdmits` (403 `forbidden` / `rt_forbidden`); `k` topics validated (400 `invalid_topic`); `ws` additionally needs `Upgrade: websocket` (426), same-origin, optional focus ticker `f`; the request is forwarded to the single named object `pulse:1` (location hint `FLOWS_RT_HINT`) with `X-RT-User`/`X-RT-Exp` set and any client `X-RT-*` and the cookie removed; the `status` answer is re-wrapped with the Worker-side switch view; a stub failure becomes 503 `rt_unavailable` with `Retry-After: 5`. The 101 response passes through `finalize` unchanged except headers.

**13. Course page** (3904): slug match -> `renderCourse` (2702): edge cache hit, else ASSETS fetch of `/lab/course`, HTMLRewriter pass, header strip, cache put (60 s). The same shell file `lab/course.html` is what `COURSE_ASSET_PATH` names; `assets/js/lab-course.js` hydrates `#course`.

**14. Store failure and quota**: a failed D1 read in a nightly read route -> `storeGone()` (Part A 1036: 503 `store_unreadable`, `Retry-After: 30`, body `status:"unavailable", reason:"store"`) -> `fetch` catch -> `recallLastGood` hit gives a stale-stamped 200 from the Cache API, miss gives the 503. An error whose message matches `STORE_QUOTA_RE` (D1 error 7500) anywhere gives `503 store_quota`.

### Invariants and traps

Source-text scans (reformatting these lines breaks CI; evidence in tests):

1. **One writer to `flows_payload`**: every `INSERT INTO flows_payload` in `worker.js` must sit between the markers `if (path === "/api/flows/ingest")` and `if (path.startsWith("/api/flows/"))` (`tests/flows-alerts-contract.mjs:504-512` counts occurrences in the whole file against occurrences in that slice). Currently 2 inserts, both in the ingest route (3578, 3591). The cron handler may not contain `INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE ... flows_payload` (`flows-live-contract.mjs:738-739`, slice from `async scheduled(event, env, ctx)` to `async fetch(request, env, ctx)`); do not reintroduce `refreshFlowsIntraday`.
2. **Ingest ordering and literals**: the 503 for a key-set outage must stay within 1,500 characters of the ingest marker (`if (check.unavailable) {\n throw new HttpError(503,` at 3466-3467; `flows-live-contract.mjs:1468`). The clock route must read exactly `if (key === "clock") { requireMethod(request, ["GET"]); await ensureFlowsTables(env); return FLOWS_LIVE.serveIngestClock(env, { json, lab: tokenKind === "nightly" }); }` and come after the `if (!tokenKind) throw new HttpError(401` line (`flows-live-contract.mjs:2192`). The allowlist must keep the substrings `^universe$|^regime$` (flows-legs-contract:891), `|^focus$` (flows-worker-contract:2066), `/^(card|card-x|hist):/.exec(key)`, `path === "/api/flows/universe" || path === "/api/flows/regime"` and `path === "/api/flows/card-x"`. `INGEST_META_KEYS_MAX` must stay a plain `= <int>;` and be >= the pipeline's `LEDGER_PROBE_CHUNK` (flows-pipeline-contract:2248).
3. **Schema bootstrap literals**: `env.DB.batch([...FLOWS_SCHEMA_SQL, FLOWS_LIVE.CLOCK_COLUMNS_SQL]` and `await FLOWS_LIVE.upgradeClockColumns(env.DB, results && results[FLOWS_SCHEMA_SQL.length]);` immediately followed by `flowsSchemaReady = true;` (flows-live-contract:1738-1740): the PRAGMA must be the last statement of the batch and readiness is set only after the upgrade. `FLOWS_DOSSIER.DOSSIER_SCHEMA_SQL` must remain in `FLOWS_SCHEMA_SQL` (flows-dossier-contract:590), which also holds `schema.sql` and `migrations/0016_flows_dossier_cache.sql` equal.
4. **Lab sign-in literals** (flows-live-contract:2842-2850): `exp: Date.now() + LAB_SESSION_MS }`, `cookie("session", session, { maxAge: LAB_SESSION_MS / 1000 })`, `await recordSignIn(env.DB, user, Date.now());`, and no `INSERT INTO users` anywhere in `worker.js`. The nightly health gate reads sign-in recency.
5. **`SECURITY_HEADERS` literal** (`contracts.mjs:847`): a single object literal of `"Name": "value"` pairs with no `}` inside, at least 7, deep-equal to the `/assets/*` block of `_headers`. Change both together; `_headers` may hold no other rules than the asset ones and no CSP.
6. **Every `/api/flows/<name>` read route needs a rows-read ceiling**: `flows-reads-contract.mjs:797-801` greps `path === "/api/flows/<name>"` out of `worker.js` (regex `[a-z-]+`), excludes only `ingest` and `tape`, and requires each in CEILING (755) or HOME. A new route written with that literal fails until priced.
7. **Rail hook literals**: `path.startsWith("/api/rt/")` inside `route()` and `export { Pulse } from "./shared/flows-rt-hub.js"` (flows-rt-contract:1438-1439). The hook must be placed so `finalize` sees every response (it is: inside `route()`).
8. **No import cycles from `worker.js`** (flows-live-contract:594-596 walks all relative imports; a cycle leaves a `const` in its temporal dead zone and the Worker fails at module evaluation). `shared/flows-focus.js` must stay a leaf.
9. **Model calls** (flows-neuron:804-1093, flows-reading-worker:337): zero `env.AI.run(` in `worker.js`; every `askModels(` is `askModels(meteredAi(env),`; exactly one `ai: () => cappedAi(` (reading deps); exactly one `FLOWS_NEURON.guardOptions(ctx)`. Part A territory, but a new model call site anywhere in the file trips them.
10. **Finalizer rules** (AGENTS Worker invariants 1-3): `finalize` must start with `new Response(response.body, response)`; every response returns through it, including errors; never rebuild an asset response from a header dictionary. No `Clear-Site-Data` (asserted in `worker-regression.mjs`).

Behavioural traps:

11. **Result index offset**: `learningBatch` prepends one statement, so the builder's statement N is `results[N+1]`. The routes depend on it (for example `/api/v2/attempt` reads generation from `results[5]`, `/api/mastery` from `results[5]`, placement DELETE from `results[2]`). Adding or removing a statement in a builder means re-indexing every later `results[...]` use.
12. **Reset does not clear preferences**: the DELETE batch (3051-3070) covers eight tables plus `stats`, not `learning_preferences`. `tests/worker-regression.mjs` and AGENTS describe reset as progress, mastery, attempts and placement; if preferences should be cleared it is a code change plus test change.
13. **HEAD on the Flows API is 405** (`requireMethod(..., ["GET"])` at 3603); HEAD on pages and `/api/markets` is allowed. DEPLOY 10.3 tells operators to use `curl -D- -o /dev/null`, not `-I`.
14. **Anonymous gating differs by surface**: `/flows/<page>/` answers 200 with the login form; `/api/flows/*` answers 401 JSON to an anonymous GET (including unknown sub-routes, since the session gate at 3604 runs before the 404 at 3882; a wrong method is 405 first). `/api/rt/*` orders its checks differently (`shared/flows-rt-routes.js:17-27`): rail off or no `PULSE` binding is 404 `rt_off` even for an anonymous caller, an unknown sub-path is 404 `not_found`, a non-GET is 405, and only then 401.
15. **Chain and strategy are not behind `UW_ONDEMAND`**: only the 120 s cache and the 15 s refresh floor protect the vendor quota. A new route that calls `uwFetch` directly inherits that; the limiter lives in `FLOWS_LIVE.ondemandAllowed`.
16. **`/api/flows/card` merged-split response lacks `X-Fresh-*`** (3832) while the `passthrough` path carries them; the board's `/api/flows/board` answers a read failure with a 200 pending body (with `reason:"read-failed"`) when no last-good exists, whereas `readServed` routes throw 503. Do not assume one shape.
17. **Last-good only covers 22 listed paths** (Part A 1041). Outside them a store outage behaves per route: `/api/flows/brief` (via `readServed`) gets a plain 503 `store_unreadable` with no stale copy, as do `/now` and multi-key `/lk` (thrown from `FLOWS_LIVE.serveNow` / `serveLiveKey`); `/summary` (board scope: `readFlowsSummary` swallows the error and answers the pending body), `/ai-usage` (`askSpend` swallows it), `/ask` (200 with `status:"unreadable"`), `/dossier` (200 with `X-Fresh-State: stale`, `X-Fresh-Reason: store`), `/tape` (pending body) and the vendor-backed `/chain`, `/strategy`, `/live` (the card read is `.catch(() => null)`) do not 503 on that account. A new nightly read route that should degrade gracefully must be added to `LAST_GOOD_PATHS` and use `passthrough` so `X-Payload-Updated` is set.
18. **`ensureFlowsTables` is lazy and per isolate**: the learning routes do not use it (they carry their own first-use DDL); every Flows route that touches live/clock/tape/dossier tables must call it first (readFlowsPayload does). A cron branch that forgets it fails on a fresh database.
19. **`scheduled` must never throw**: all work is inside `guard` (3952), which wraps the promise in `ctx.waitUntil(...catch(log))`. A new branch must go through `guard`; an un-guarded rejection would surface as an unhandled rejection in the invocation instead of a structured log line.
20. **Cron string matters**: `cronJob` matches the exact trigger strings and only falls back to the clock for unknown strings. Changing a trigger in `wrangler.toml` without changing the constants (`RTH_CRON`, `FOCUS_CRON`, `HOUSEKEEPING_CRON`, `SUMMARY_CRON`, flows-live-worker.js:70-73) changes which job runs; Cloudflare weekdays are 1 = Sunday so names (`MON-FRI`) are mandatory. The live tests refuse a numeric weekday.
21. **`UW_NOW` is test-only** (needs `UW_BASE`), used by `chainReadMs`; production reads `Date.now()`. Dated fixtures in the workerd suites depend on it.
22. **Worktree noise**: `/home/user/anilkaya.org/.claude/worktrees/agent-*/` holds stale full copies of `worker.js` and tests (untracked, listed in `.git/info/exclude`). Recursive greps find duplicate hits; use `git ls-files` or exclude `.claude`.
23. **Source carries no comments**: blank lines at 2063, 2066, 2214, 2225 etc. are where comments were stripped. Do not add comments; put the reasoning in the commit message (AGENTS "Commentary").
24. **`/api/me` is 503, not `user:null`, when `SESSION_SECRET` is unset** (`requireSessionSecret` at 2854); `/api/markets` has no auth.
25. **CSP `connect-src` hard-codes `wss://anilkaya.org`** (line 111): the rail socket on another origin (preview, workers.dev) relies on `'self'` matching ws schemes in the browser; a new origin needs a CSP edit (and the finalizer sets CSP only on HTML).

Disagreements between docs and source (source wins):

- AGENTS.md says seven curricula ("ols iv2sls did var panel logit gmm", "four modules each", payload `assets/data/courses/<topic>.json`). Source: `COURSE_TOPICS` has 12 (adds `foundations`, `mle`, `forecast`, `coint`, `financial`), and `renderCourse` preloads `assets/data/courses/<id>/manifest.json` and `<id>/<modules[0].id>.json`; the repo tracks both `<id>.json` and the per-module directory (77 files under `assets/data/courses`).
- AGENTS.md "API contract" lists the v1 endpoints only. Source also serves `/api/markets` (2858), `/api/v2/bootstrap` (2867), `/api/v2/progress` (2877), `/api/v2/attempt` (2915), `/api/v2/preferences` (2972), `/api/v2/project` (2996), and the `DELETE /api/progress` body also carries `stableProgress`, `skillMastery`, `projects` (3072-3082), beyond AGENTS' `{ok, progress, stats, mastery, placement, generation}`.
- AGENTS.md "HTML is `no-cache`": true for `/lab/*` and `/`; every `/flows/*` page, being under the `no-store` branch of `finalize` (3928-3932), is `no-store`.
- AGENTS.md's "Confirmed to need one" list names `placement-contract`. Source: `tests/placement-contract.mjs` starts its own `node:http` static server (`staticServer`, line 114) that answers `/api/v2/bootstrap`, `/api/bootstrap` and `/api/me` with canned JSON and serves files from disk; it contains no reference to `worker`, `wrangler` or `startWorker`, so it needs Chromium but no workerd.
- AGENTS.md describes the Flows API as "behind the Flows session" without the method rule: only `/api/flows/ask` is POST; everything else GET, HEAD refused.

### How to change it

**Add a Flows nightly read route** (`GET /api/flows/<name>` serving a stored key):
1. Add the key to `INGEST_VIEW_KEY_RE` (worker.js:937, Part A) so the pipeline may publish it; add to the pipeline publisher (`scripts/flows-pipeline.mjs` + a leg under `scripts/flows-legs/`).
2. Add the route inside the `path.startsWith("/api/flows/")` block (3601-3883), written as `if (path === "/api/flows/<name>")` using `readServed` and `passthrough` (copy 3683-3688), with a pending shape.
3. Add the path to `LAST_GOOD_PATHS` (Part A 1041) if it should survive a store outage; add the key to `NOW_NIGHTLY_KEYS` (flows-live-worker.js:94) if `/now` should report its age; add its freshness class in `shared/flows-freshness.js` if it has one.
4. Add a CEILING row in `tests/flows-reads-contract.mjs` (755) and, if it is a home read, to `HOME` (186).
5. Run `cd tests && FLOWS_TEST_SANDBOX=1 node flows-worker-contract.mjs`, `node --disable-warning=ExperimentalWarning flows-reads-contract.mjs`, `node flows-live-contract.mjs`, `node flows-legs-contract.mjs` (and `flows-pipeline-contract.mjs` for the pipeline side). No asset-version bump unless a file under `assets/css|js|data` changes.

**Add a gated Flows page** (`/flows/<page>/`): write `<page>Page` in `shared/flows-pages.js` and add it to the `FLOWS_PAGES` object (1041); add the path to `FLOWS_ROUTES` (worker.js:3409) and the slashless form to the redirect list (3444); add nav in `FLOWS_NAV` (flows-pages.js:93) if it should show; page scripts go in `assets/js/` (bump `assets/version.txt` and `ASSET_VERSION` in flows-pages.js:1, which `tests/flows-features.mjs` holds equal). If a reader page should accept `?t=`, add it to `FLOWS_READER_FROM` (3393). Tests: `flows-worker-contract.mjs`, `flows-features.mjs`, plus the page's own render suite.

**Change cron cadence or add a job**: edit `[triggers] crons` in `wrangler.toml`, the constants at `flows-live-worker.js:70-73`, `cronJob` (75), and the branch ladder in `scheduled()` (3958-3987); keep each branch inside `guard`. Update `tests/flows-rt-contract.mjs:1445-1446` (asserts the four strings), `flows-live-contract.mjs`, `flows-freshness-contract.mjs`, and the nightly health gate's cron messages in `scripts/flows-legs/health.mjs`; DEPLOY.md 10.5i and 10.5h list the schedule. After deploy confirm with `wrangler triggers` (DEPLOY 10.5i item 4).

**Change the chain or strategy payload**: edit `buildChainPayload` (2211) or `buildStrategyContext` (2361) / `buildStrategyExpiry` (2460); the pure logic lives in `shared/flows-premium.js` (`rankChain`, `ivSurface`, `deskSmiles`), `flows-basis.js` (`printOf`, `coherence`), `flows-quant-card.js` (`runCardEngine`). If the browser reprices with the same math, rerun `node scripts/build-flows-quant-bundle.mjs` (writes `assets/js/flows-quant.bundle.js` and `flows-quant-read.bundle.js`), bump `assets/version.txt`. Tests: `flows-chain-contract.mjs`, `flows-desk-contract.mjs`, `flows-strategy.mjs` (workerd, `FLOWS_TEST_SANDBOX=1`), `flows-basis-contract.mjs`, `flows-premium-contract.mjs`, `flows-quant-card.mjs`, `flows-desk-client.mjs`, `flows-desk-wiring.mjs`, and the CEILING rows for `/chain` and `/strategy` (3 rows each).

**Add or change a Lab learning endpoint**: add the block in the Lab section of `route()` (2866-3335) following the PUT pattern at 2972-2994: `requireMethod`, `requireSessionSecret`, `currentUser`, `requireSameOrigin`, `requireMutationOwner`, `mutationGeneration`, `readJSON`, validate, `academyBatch` with a generation-guarded `WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM learning_sync WHERE user_id=? AND generation=?)` and a trailing `SELECT generation`, then `throwResetRequired` on mismatch. Remember the `results[N+1]` offset. A new table needs an entry in `ACADEMY_SCHEMA_SQL` (Part A 89), `schema.sql`, a file in `migrations/`, the reset batch (3051-3070) and the bootstrap loaders. Client side: `assets/js/storage.js` and `auth.js` (asset bump). Tests that load the Worker: `worker-regression.mjs`, `regression.mjs`, `contracts.mjs` (header scan only). `academy-contract.mjs`, `mastery-contract.mjs` and `placement-contract.mjs` never load `worker.js` (a case-insensitive grep for "worker" finds nothing in `mastery-contract` and `placement-contract`, and one assertion message at line 82 in `academy-contract`); they cover the shared scheduler and client pages against stubs, so run them for the client half of the change.

**Change response policy / headers**: edit `finalize` (3918) and `SECURITY_HEADERS` (117) / `CSP` (102) together with `_headers` (asset block must equal `SECURITY_HEADERS`); `contracts.mjs:838-866` and `worker-regression.mjs` pin both. After deploy run the header smoke test (DEPLOY section 7) and compare dashboard Transform Rules.

**Change course SEO**: `courseStructuredData` / `courseFallback` / `courseOverview` / `renderCourse` (2651-2760); metadata comes from `shared/course-seo.js`, which `scripts/generate-course-payloads.mjs` writes (run it, commit the generated files, never edit them by hand). Tests: `worker-regression.mjs` (all course variants, canonical, JSON-LD), `regression.mjs`, `contracts.mjs`. The shell `lab/course.html` carries `data-asset-version`; an asset bump changes it.

**Add an ingest key or token role**: key allowlist `INGEST_VIEW_KEY_RE` / `ingestKeyParts` (Part A 937-943) and `FLOWS_LIVE.ingestScope` (flows-live-worker.js:678); live keys are registered in `LIVE_KEYS` (shared/flows-live.js:13, with `maxBytes` and writer); mind the literal scans in invariants 1 and 2. Tests: `flows-worker-contract.mjs` (token matrix), `flows-live-contract.mjs`, `flows-legs-contract.mjs`.

**Work with the rail hook**: only the route line (3889) lives here. Behaviour is in `shared/flows-rt-routes.js`, `flows-rt.js` (wire contract, switches) and `flows-rt-hub.js`; the client is `assets/js/flows-rt.js`. Tests: `flows-rt-contract.mjs` (Node), `flows-rt-server.mjs` (workerd, `FLOWS_TEST_SANDBOX=1`, about 151 s), `flows-rt-client.mjs` (Chromium).

**Running the relevant suites in the agent sandbox**: no-server suites (`flows-reads-contract`, `flows-live-contract`, `flows-legs-contract`, `flows-neuron`, `flows-alerts-contract`, `flows-pipeline-contract`, `flows-rt-contract`, `flows-dossier-contract`, `flows-dossier-reads`, `flows-reading-worker`, `flows-basis-contract`, `flows-ledger-contract`, `contracts`) run with plain `node` (the `node:sqlite` ones with `--disable-warning=ExperimentalWarning`, Node >= 22.13). workerd suites (`worker-regression`, `flows-worker-contract`, `flows-chain-contract`, `flows-desk-contract`, `flows-strategy`, `flows-rt-server`, `flows-overview-contract`, `flows-sections-contract`, `flows-unusual-contract`, `flows-market-contract`, `flows-motion`, the render suites listed above) need `FLOWS_TEST_SANDBOX=1`. Bundle validation: `./tests/node_modules/.bin/wrangler deploy --dry-run --outdir /tmp/anilkaya-worker-dry-run` (CI step in `.github/workflows/regression.yml`). Any new test file must be added to `tests/package.json` `scripts.test` chain (a long `&&` chain; the run stops at the first failure) as well as given its own `test:<name>` script.

## Config, schema, migrations, headers, deploy files

Measured at commit ba2acfe (origin/main after PR 148). asset version `240`, fonts token `230`. Line numbers are from `grep -n` / `sed -n` on that tree. Where source and AGENTS.md / DEPLOY.md / README.md disagree, the source wins and the gap is listed in "Source vs documentation disagreements" at the end of "Invariants and traps".

### Purpose and boundaries

This area is everything that is neither application code nor a test body but still decides what runs, what is stored, what is served and what gates a merge:

- Deployment config: `wrangler.toml` (Worker, static assets, D1, AI, crons, rate limiter, Durable Object, vars).
- Storage definition: `schema.sql` (fresh-database snapshot), `migrations/0001..0016` (history), and the inline `CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS` bootstraps that live in `worker.js` and `shared/*.js` (these three declaration sites must stay in step).
- Edge policy and bundle shape: `_headers`, `.assetsignore`, `.gitignore`, `404.html` neighbour, `CNAME`, `robots.txt`, `sitemap.xml`, `site.webmanifest`.
- Cache-busting tokens: `assets/version.txt`, `assets/fonts-version.txt`.
- CI and scheduled automation: `.github/workflows/*.yml` (five), `tests/package.json` (the 77-link `npm test` chain).
- Repo meta: `README.md`, `LICENSE` (Apache 2.0), `.mcp.json` (Unusual Whales MCP server for Claude Code, `${UW_API_KEY}` expanded from the developer's shell).

Not in this area: `worker.js` and `shared/*.js` logic (other mappers), `scripts/*` (pipeline/probe mappers), `assets/*` content, test bodies. Neighbours that read these files: `worker.js` (env bindings, `SECURITY_HEADERS`, inline DDL), `shared/flows-live-worker.js` (crons, `FLOWS_LIVE_*`, GitHub dispatch, OIDC, clock/ledger/tape tables), `shared/flows-rt-hub.js` (Durable Object class `Pulse`), `shared/flows-ai.js` (AI chain/caps), `tests/contracts.mjs` and friends (parse these files as text).

The repository root IS the Cloudflare static directory (`[assets] directory = "."`), filtered by `.assetsignore`. Approximate served bundle: 183 files, about 7.0 MB (7,028,696 bytes; measured from `git ls-files` minus `.assetsignore`: assets 165 of 171 tracked, because `*.md` drops `assets/fonts/NOTICE.md` and the five authoring files `curriculum.js`, `curriculum-data.js`, `curriculum-questions.js`, `curriculum-academy.js`, `stage-id-map-v2.json` are listed; lab 9, articles 1, root 7 (`404.html`, `LICENSE`, `_headers`, `index.html`, `robots.txt`, `site.webmanifest`, `sitemap.xml`), plus `docs/uw-openapi.yaml`; `docs/flows-audit-2026-09.md` is dropped by `*.md`).

Column lists (type, constraint). NN = NOT NULL.

- `users`: id TEXT PK; email TEXT; name TEXT; created_at INTEGER; signed_in_at INTEGER (added by 0013 or first sign-in).
- `progress`: user_id TEXT NN; model_id TEXT NN; done_json TEXT NN DEFAULT '[]'; updated_at INTEGER; PK(user_id, model_id).
- `stats`: user_id TEXT PK; points INTEGER DEFAULT 0; streak INTEGER DEFAULT 0; last TEXT; updated_at INTEGER. (points is written 0 by reset; reads recompute points from `progress`.)
- `learning_sync`: user_id TEXT PK; generation INTEGER NN DEFAULT 0 CHECK 0..9007199254740991.
- `mastery`: user_id, item_id (PK pair); level INTEGER NN DEFAULT 0 CHECK 0..5; due_day TEXT NN; attempts, correct INTEGER NN DEFAULT 0 CHECK 0..1000000; last_result INTEGER CHECK IN (0,1); last_attempt_id TEXT; last_day TEXT; updated_at INTEGER NN. Column order: schema.sql and the Worker DDL put last_day BEFORE updated_at; 0001 + 0003 gives last_day AFTER updated_at (named-column SQL makes it harmless). Index `mastery_due_by_user (user_id, due_day, item_id)`.
- `mastery_attempts`: user_id, attempt_id (PK pair); item_id TEXT NN; correct, hinted INTEGER NN CHECK IN (0,1); attempt_day TEXT NN; applied INTEGER NN DEFAULT 0 CHECK IN (0,1); received_at INTEGER NN.
- `placement`: user_id TEXT PK; band TEXT NN IN (foundation, applied, advanced); score INTEGER NN 0..15; total INTEGER NN = 15; completed_day TEXT NN; recommended_topic TEXT NN IN (ols, iv2sls, did, var, panel, logit, gmm); updated_at INTEGER NN; table CHECK band/score pairing foundation 0-6, applied 7-11, advanced 12-15. (Only 7 topic ids even though the catalogue now has 12 courses.)
- `progress_v3`: user_id, course_id, stage_id (PK triple); completed_at INTEGER NN; source TEXT NN DEFAULT 'web' IN (web, migration). Index `progress_v3_by_user (user_id, course_id, completed_at)`.
- `skill_mastery`: as mastery with skill_id in place of item_id. `last_day` is absent from 0002 (0003 adds it after updated_at) and present before updated_at in schema.sql and in the Worker DDL (worker.js:92). Index `skill_mastery_due_by_user (user_id, due_day, skill_id)`.
- `skill_attempts`: user_id, attempt_id (PK pair); skill_id, item_id TEXT NN; correct, hinted CHECK IN (0,1); attempt_day TEXT NN; applied DEFAULT 0; received_at INTEGER NN.
- `learning_preferences`: user_id TEXT PK; active_path_id TEXT NN DEFAULT 'complete-core'; session_minutes INTEGER NN DEFAULT 20 IN (10,20,45); weekly_goal_minutes INTEGER NN DEFAULT 120 BETWEEN 30 AND 1200; updated_at INTEGER NN. (Worker allowlist PATH_IDS worker.js:98: complete-core, causal, applied-micro, time-series, markets-risk.)
- `project_progress`: user_id, project_id (PK pair); mode TEXT NN IN (guided, unguided); done_json TEXT NN DEFAULT '[]'; updated_at INTEGER NN.
- `market_snapshot`: id INTEGER PK CHECK id = 1; payload TEXT NN; updated_at INTEGER NN.
- `flows_payload`: id TEXT PK; payload TEXT NN; updated_at INTEGER NN CHECK > 0. Key namespace (ingest allowlist `INGEST_VIEW_KEY_RE` worker.js:937 + `ingestKeyParts` :939): `board:long`, `board:short`, `board:watch`, `board:long:YYYY-MM-DD`, `board:short:YYYY-MM-DD`, `scores:YYYY-MM-DD`, `scoretrack`, `flowalerts`, `pulse`, `political`, `record`, `movers`, `market`, `unusual`, `events`, `sector:trix`, `sector:premium`, `news`, `brief`, `meta`, `universe`, `regime`, `ideas`, `focus`, `roster`, plus `card:<T>`, `card-x:<T>`, `hist:<T>` (ticker regex `FLOWS_TICKER_RE` :933). Dated archive regex `DATED_ARCHIVE_KEY_RE` :935 covers only `board:long|short:DATE` and `scores:DATE`.
- `flows_login_failures`: username TEXT PK (holds the throttle bucket key `bucket|address`, not a raw name); failures INTEGER NN DEFAULT 0 0..1000000; first_at INTEGER NN > 0.
- `flows_ai_usage`: day TEXT PK (UTC `YYYY-MM-DD`); calls, tokens_in, tokens_out INTEGER NN DEFAULT 0 >= 0.
- `flows_ai_usage_model`: day, model (PK pair); calls, tokens_in, tokens_out as above. The cap (`cappedAi` flows-ai.js:151) reads this split; the strict reader refuses the call when it cannot be read.
- `flows_ai_summary`: scope TEXT PK (only `board`); text NN; llm INTEGER NN DEFAULT 0 IN (0,1); model; fingerprint NN; guard; generated_at TEXT NN (ISO).
- `flows_neuron`: scope TEXT PK; version INTEGER NN; fingerprint NN; summary NN; ideas NN (JSON text: array, `{v:3,...}` engine object, or `{v:1,kind:"reading",...}` for `read:` rows); llm INTEGER NN DEFAULT 0; model; guard (`generating` is the claim marker; other values are failure reasons); generated_at TEXT NN.
- `flows_live`: id TEXT PK CHECK GLOB 'live:*'; payload NN; read_at INTEGER NN > 0 (ms); session TEXT NN; cadence_s INTEGER NN > 0; source TEXT NN IN (worker, actions); writer TEXT NN; updated_at INTEGER NN > 0. Keys (flows-live.js:13 `LIVE_KEYS`, byte cap): `live:market` 16 KiB (worker), `live:focus` 16 KiB (worker), `live:breadth` 96 KiB, `live:strips` 64 KiB, `live:strips:series` 112 KiB, `live:alerts` 120 KiB, `live:gex` 64 KiB, `live:vol` 8 KiB, `live:tape` 24 KiB, `live:movers` 8 KiB, `live:news` 32 KiB, `live:heartbeat` 8 KiB (all actions-written except the first two). `LIVE_KEY_RE` flows-live.js:7.
- `flows_tape`: ticker TEXT PK length 1..10; payload TEXT; read_at INTEGER; session TEXT; legs INTEGER NN DEFAULT 0; refreshing_until INTEGER (lease, `tapeLeaseMs` 20 s); last_served INTEGER (touched at most hourly).
- `flows_clock` (singleton, id = 1): id; day TEXT; trading INTEGER; early_close INTEGER; tape_at; tape_moved_at; live_dispatched_at; live_done_at; live_redispatched_at; nightly_day TEXT; nightly_dispatched_at; nightly_redispatched_at; summary_stamp TEXT; updated_at; tier1_at; tier1_ok_at; tier1_why TEXT; closed_probe_at; closed_days TEXT (JSON array text); dispatch_why TEXT; summary_at. camelCase map `CLOCK_COLUMNS` flows-live-worker.js:99. Column order in a production table that was upgraded: 0010's 14, then tier1_at, tier1_ok_at, tier1_why, closed_probe_at, closed_days, dispatch_why, summary_at (tested to equal schema.sql and the Worker DDL, `flows-live-contract.mjs:917-920`).
- `flows_ledger` (PK day TEXT, GLOB date; one row per Eastern session): ticks; t1_last_at, t1_gap_ms, t1_gap_end, t1_ok, t1_fail, t1_ok_at, t1_ok_gap_ms, t1_ok_gap_end; focus_ok, focus_partial, focus_fail, focus_ok_at, focus_gap_ms, focus_gap_end; t2_passes, t2_first_at, t2_last_at, t2_gap_ms, t2_gap_end, t2_calls, t2_failed; stale_ticks, stale_over_s, stale_key; nightly_at, nightly_runs; updated_at NN. All counters INTEGER NN DEFAULT 0.
- `flows_dossier_cache`: ticker TEXT NN length 1..10; kind TEXT NN; fetched_at INTEGER NN > 0; payload TEXT NN length <= 8192; PK(ticker, kind) WITHOUT ROWID. TTLs in `CACHE_TTL_S` flows-dossier-worker.js:18 (identity 24 h, fundamentals 24 h, analysts 6 h, earnings 12 h, positioning 24 h).

Learner reset (`DELETE /api/progress`, worker.js:3049-3083, route at :3034; the ten statements are built at :3052-3069 and run through `academyBatch`, hence one `DB.batch`): increments `learning_sync.generation`, deletes progress, mastery, mastery_attempts, placement, progress_v3, skill_mastery, skill_attempts, project_progress for that user, upserts `stats` to 0/0/NULL. Does NOT touch `users` or `learning_preferences`.

Retention and pruning: `flows_ledger` 30 days and `flows_tape` 7 days unserved, both at the 03:00 Eastern housekeeping firing (`pruneDue` flows-live-worker.js:588; calls at worker.js:3983-3986); dated boards/scores 126 days via the nightly's DELETE on the ingest route; per-ticker keys retired after 3 NYSE sessions unrebuilt (DEPLOY.md 10.4b); attempt ledgers 48 h at write time; login failures pruned at write time.

D1 caps (Workers Free, per UTC day, shared by the account including audits): 100,000 rows written, 5,000,000 rows read. Quota errors map to `503 store_quota` (worker.js:4008); reads on a Flows key fall back to the last good Cache API copy (24 h). Read-row ceilings per route are pinned by `tests/flows-reads-contract.mjs` (EXPLAIN QUERY PLAN accounting); never scan or `json_each` a payload table on a polled route.

#### Cron table (wrangler.toml:26; dispatch by instant in `cronJob` flows-live-worker.js:75, handler worker.js:3950)

| cron string (UTC) | constant | job | what it does |
|---|---|---|---|
| `1-59/5 13-21 * * MON-FRI` | `RTH_CRON` :70 | rth | Tier 1: `rthTick` flows-live-worker.js:371 writes `live:market`, `flows_clock`, ledger; may dispatch Tier 2 workflow |
| `3-58/5 13-21 * * MON-FRI` | `FOCUS_CRON` :71 | focus | `focusTick` :504 writes `live:focus` (cadence 300 s) |
| `*/30 * * * *` | `HOUSEKEEPING_CRON` :72 | housekeeping | `refreshMarketSnapshotIfDue`, `nightlyTick` :554 (dispatch the nightly), at 03:00 ET `pruneTape` + `pruneLedger` |
| `15,45 * * * *` | `SUMMARY_CRON` :73 | summary | `summaryFiring` worker.js:1423: `refreshFlowsSummary`, then stamps `flows_clock.summary_at` |

Unknown/stale trigger strings are routed by minute (minute %30 = 0 housekeeping, %30 = 15 summary, outside Mon-Fri 13-21 housekeeping, %5 = 3 focus, else rth). Cloudflare counts weekdays 1 = Sunday, so weekdays MUST be named (test-pinned). Four crons is within the five a Free account may register.
