#### Headers and cache policy actually served

- Every Worker response (finalizer worker.js:3918): `Strict-Transport-Security: max-age=31536000`, `X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff`, `Referrer-Policy: strict-origin-when-cross-origin`, `X-Frame-Options: DENY`, `Cross-Origin-Opener-Policy: same-origin`, `Permissions-Policy: geolocation=(), microphone=(), camera=(), payment=()`, `X-Permitted-Cross-Domain-Policies: none`. CSP on text/html only.
- `/assets/*` (asset-first, no Worker): the same seven from `_headers:2-8`, no CSP. Cache-Control by path: css/js/fonts `public, max-age=31536000, immutable` (even without `?v=`, and even for a 404 from the asset layer's `404.html`); img, data, `version.txt`, `fonts-version.txt` `public, max-age=3600`.
- Root static files (`/robots.txt`, `/sitemap.xml`, `/site.webmanifest`, `/404.html`, `/LICENSE`): Worker runs first, falls through to `env.ASSETS.fetch` (worker.js:3915), finalizer gives non-HTML 1 hour; `?v=` is never immutable off `/assets/`.
- HTML `no-cache`; `/api/*`, `/auth/*`, `/flows*` `no-store`; `/api/markets` 200 `public, max-age=300` (worker.js:2863).
- No `Clear-Site-Data` anywhere (retired in PR 116).
- Dashboard Transform Rules can still rewrite headers after the fact; DEPLOY.md requires a post-deploy header smoke test.

#### Budgets and caps (actual numbers)

- Workers Free: 10 ms CPU per invocation, 100,000 requests/day (DEPLOY.md 10.0 item 5); D1 100,000 rows written and 5,000,000 rows read per UTC day.
- Workers AI: free 10,000 neurons/day (`AI_DAILY_NEURONS` flows-ai.js:106); Worker-enforced cap 30,000 neurons and 2,500 calls/day; reading share `READ_BUDGET_SHARE` 0.75 (flows-reading-worker.js:11); `AI_INTRADAY_REFRESH_MS` 45 min (flows-ai.js:204).
- Request bodies: JSON 16 KiB (`MAX_JSON_BYTES` worker.js:47); Flows login form 4 KiB (worker.js:911); ingest payload 128 KiB (`FLOWS_MAX_PAYLOAD_BYTES` :923); ingest `keys=` at most 96, `list=` at most 2,000 rows (:945,:953); course data: each per-module file `assets/data/courses/<id>/<module>.json` is capped at 6,144 bytes gzip by `contracts.mjs:150` (AGENTS.md's "14 KiB gzip per course payload" is not asserted anywhere in the source; the monolithic `<id>.json` fallback is uncapped, e.g. `gmm.json` is 41,638 bytes raw, 12,856 gzip); per-page HTML ceilings `CEILING_KIB` in `tests/flows-weight.mjs:12` (ticker 400, overview 265, side/watch 218, desk 234, ask 173, strategy 251, track 164, market 242, unusual 204, events 155, political 144, history 157, login 5).
- Vendor on-demand limiter: 120 per 60 s (`[[ratelimits]]`; `LIVE_BUDGET.ondemandPerMinute` 120). Tier 1: 2 calls, 6 s timeout; Tier 2: 333 ms pace, at most 48 calls (`LIVE_BUDGET` flows-live.js:30). Dossier: 9 vendor calls, 2.5 s per source, 3 s total (`BUDGET` flows-dossier-worker.js:26).
- Sessions: Lab 30 days (`LAB_SESSION_MS`), Flows 14 days (`FLOWS_SESSION_TTL_SECONDS` flows-auth.js:8), OAuth state cookie 600 s.
- CI timeouts: regression 40 min, pipeline build 45, live 355, probe 20, ws-probe 15, keepalive 5.
- Static bundle: about 183 files, 7.0 MB (Cloudflare static-asset limits, not stated in the repo, are 20,000 files and 25 MiB per file on Free).

### Flows

1. Request routing and policy
   - Browser -> Cloudflare edge. `run_worker_first = ["/*", "!/assets/*"]` (wrangler.toml:10).
   - `/assets/*`: asset layer serves from the bundle, headers from `_headers` (no Worker, no CSP, immutable for css/js/fonts). Missing file => `404.html` under the same path policy.
   - everything else: `fetch` worker.js:3990 -> `route` :2762 (auth, api, flows pages, `/api/rt/`, legacy course redirects, `/lab/<slug>/` rewrite via HTMLRewriter `renderCourse` :2702) -> fallthrough `env.ASSETS.fetch` :3915 -> `finalize` :3918. HttpError and unexpected errors also go through `finalize` (:3996-4015); quota errors => 503 `store_quota` (:4008).

2. Cold-isolate schema bootstrap (Flows)
   - any Flows route or cron job -> `ensureFlowsTables` worker.js:2583 -> `startFlowsSchemaFlight` :2569 -> one `env.DB.batch` of the 12 `FLOWS_SCHEMA_SQL` statements plus `PRAGMA table_info(flows_clock)` (13 statements) -> `upgradeClockColumns` flows-live-worker.js:47 (ALTERs only missing columns) -> `flowsSchemaReady = true`. Two attempts, each waits `FLIGHT_WAIT_MS` (flows-live-worker.js:160, 2000 ms) via `settledWithin` (flows-live-worker.js:150). A failure logs `flows schema bootstrap failed` once and every caller still answers.
   - Learning tables are lazy and error-driven: `learningBatch` (worker.js:354) -> on `no such table: learning_sync` create it and retry; `masteryBatch` :395 handles missing mastery tables and `last_day`; `placementBatch` :411; `academyBatch` :426 handles the five academy tables. `users`, `progress`, `stats` are never created at runtime.

3. Provisioning a database
   - fresh/local: `wrangler d1 execute iewt --local --file schema.sql` (misses the four AI tables, which the Worker creates on first Flows use).
   - production: per DEPLOY.md 10.1, `wrangler d1 execute iewt --remote --file=./migrations/NNNN_*.sql` by hand (DEPLOY.md 3, lines 46-91, additionally allows `--remote --file schema.sql`, but only when a `pragma_table_info` inspection proves a whole table is absent) (NOT `d1 migrations apply`, because earlier migrations were applied out of band). Non-idempotent ALTER migrations: 0003, 0011, 0012, 0013, 0014 (their runtime twins swallow `duplicate column`).

4. Scheduled work
   - Cloudflare cron fires -> `scheduled` worker.js:3950 -> `cronJob(event.cron, scheduledTime)` -> rth / focus / summary / housekeeping (table above). Each job runs inside `ctx.waitUntil` with a logging guard; `ensureFlowsTables` first.
   - Tier 1 tick order (`rthTick` flows-live-worker.js:371): `clockPatchStatement(tier1At)` + ledger tick row in one batch (:375-378) -> `FLOWS_LIVE_MODE=off` short-circuit (:380-383, a lone `tier1Why` patch) -> read clock + `flows_live` ages in one batch (:384) -> closed-day/holiday short-circuit (:394-398, another lone patch) -> if due, `tier1Reads` -> `shapeMarketLive` -> `writeLiveStatement(live:market)` is only QUEUED into `statements` (:425, not run yet) -> `dispatchWorkflow(flows-live.yml)` if `liveDispatchDue` (:449, outcome folded into the patch as `dispatchWhy` / `liveDispatchedAt`) -> watchdog re-dispatch if `liveStalled` (:465, `origin: "watchdog"`) -> ONE `batchWithLedger` (:473-474) runs the queued `live:market` write + the clock patch + the ledger outcome together.

5. Nightly publish and live loop (Actions)
   - Worker dispatch (or GitHub cron, or the live loop's own token) -> `flows-pipeline.yml` gate (zone check on the cron string) -> `scripts/flows-pipeline.mjs` -> POST `/api/flows/ingest?key=...` with `FLOWS_INGEST_TOKEN` (worker.js:3454; `tokenKind` flows-live-worker.js:601) -> `flows_payload` upsert (dated keys insert-only) -> `meta` also writes the ledger nightly row (worker.js:3594).
   - `flows-live.yml` (OIDC id-token) -> `scripts/flows-pipeline.mjs --live` -> POST `live:*` keys -> `oidcKind` :664 (JWKS fetched from GitHub, 1 h cache) -> `ingestLive` :695 -> `flows_live` + heartbeat clock patch + ledger pass row.

6. CI gate on a push or PR
   - `regression.yml` -> `npm ci` -> chromium -> `wrangler deploy --dry-run` (validates bindings, DO export, bundling) -> `npm test` (77-link chain; first failure stops) -> `contracts.mjs` compares changed `assets/css|js|data` files against `ASSET_DIFF_BASE` and fails unless `assets/version.txt` increased (fonts: `assets/fonts-version.txt`). Deployment itself is NOT in CI (Workers Builds / manual `wrangler deploy --strict`, external state).

7. Local server tests
   - `startWorker()` (tests/worker-server.mjs:155): `wrangler d1 execute iewt --local --file schema.sql --persist-to <tmp>` -> (with `FLOWS_TEST_SANDBOX=1`) copy git-visible files to a temp tree to avoid symlink-loop watching -> `wrangler dev --local --port <free> --persist-to <tmp>` with `--var` overrides: test Google ids, `SESSION_SECRET`, `FLOWS_PEPPER`, `FLOWS_CREDENTIALS` (hash map for every member), `FLOWS_SESSION_EPOCH:1`, empty `FLOWS_ASK_MODEL` and `FLOWS_ASK_FALLBACK_MODEL` -> warm-up GET `/`. `wrangler.toml` vars still apply for everything not overridden (so rail mode is on, live mode is actions).

8. Asset version bump ritual
   - change under `assets/css|js|data` -> increment `assets/version.txt` -> update every local `?v=` in HTML/CSS, `data-asset-version` on the three shells, `ASSET_VERSION` in `shared/flows-pages.js` -> reset every `woff2?v=` to `assets/fonts-version.txt` -> `node tests/contracts.mjs`.

### Invariants and traps

Each item names the evidence.

1. Three declaration sites must agree for every table: `schema.sql`, a numbered migration, and the inline bootstrap. Name-level parity is pinned only for 0001, 0002, 0004, 0005, 0010, 0015, 0016 (`academy-contract.mjs:114-120`); 0006-0009 (the four AI tables) are deliberately absent from schema.sql and from that test. Column-level parity is pinned for flows_clock (`flows-live-contract.mjs:917-920`), flows_ledger (`flows-ledger-contract.mjs:66-72`), flows_dossier_cache (`flows-dossier-contract.mjs:592-595`) and users (`flows-live-contract.mjs:2889-2894`). Everything else (mastery column order, learning tables) is by convention only.
2. A new migration number is not enough: add the new migration to the `migrationTables` union in `academy-contract.mjs:114-117` (the message even spells the list "0001+0002+0004+0005+0010+0015+0016"), otherwise the size equality at :119 fails.
3. If a table is added to `FLOWS_SCHEMA_SQL` or `LIVE_SCHEMA_SQL`, the cold-start batch grows; `flows-reads-contract.mjs:206` asserts exactly 13 statements (12 DDL + PRAGMA) and the trip count at :216 (14 trips for 13 requests).
4. `PRAGMA table_info(flows_clock)` must stay the LAST statement of the schema batch (`flows-reads-contract.mjs:206`, `results[FLOWS_SCHEMA_SQL.length]` at worker.js:2573).
5. Dated archive rows are immutable by trigger: never `ON CONFLICT DO UPDATE` a `board:<side>:DATE` or `scores:DATE` key. The ingest route first reads the key and asks `archiveWriteAction` (shared/flows-archive.js:1): unreadable => 503 `archive_unreadable`, absent => write, identical => `unchanged`, different => 409 `archive_immutable`; the write itself is `ON CONFLICT(id) DO NOTHING` (worker.js:3577-3580) and a raced insert is 409 `archive_raced`. Republish deletes first (DELETE is allowed, UPDATE aborts with `flows archive rows are immutable`).
6. `flows_live.id` must start `live:` (CHECK GLOB) and `source` must be `worker` or `actions`; writes are last-write-wins by `read_at` (`WHERE excluded.read_at >= flows_live.read_at`, flows-live-worker.js:233). One writer per key (`LIVE_KEYS[...].writer`); the live token writes `live:*` only and cannot DELETE; the nightly token cannot write `live:*`.
7. `ensureFlowsTables` is single-flight per isolate with a bounded wait; do not add per-request DDL elsewhere. Reads inside Flows paths `catch(() => null)` and answer pending/unavailable rather than 500.
8. `users`, `progress`, `stats` have no inline bootstrap: a database missing them fails OAuth sign-in (callback catches and redirects to `/lab/?auth=error`, worker.js:2827-2833) and progress reads. Check production with `pragma_table_info` per DEPLOY.md 3.
9. ALTER migrations are not re-runnable; the Worker's runtime ALTERs swallow `duplicate column name`. `0013` applied after the first post-deploy sign-in fails harmlessly on the duplicate column.
10. Learning writes are generation-fenced inside the SQL (`WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM learning_sync WHERE user_id=? AND generation=?)`); a new learner table that returns data must join the bootstrap statement list (worker.js:806-827) and the reset batch (:3052-3069; the deletes are :3058-3065), and decide whether reset clears it (preferences deliberately survive).
11. `_headers` is held exactly by `contracts.mjs:829-869`: the `/assets/*` block must equal `SECURITY_HEADERS` of worker.js verbatim (parsed from the `const SECURITY_HEADERS = {...}` literal); exactly eight path rules; css/js/fonts immutable 31536000; img/data/version tokens 3600; NO CSP; every direct child of `assets/` (directories as `/assets/<dir>/*`, files as `/assets/<file>`) needs its own Cache-Control rule; at most 100 rules; lines at most 2,000 chars. Adding a directory such as `assets/video/` without a rule fails CI. A second rule matching the same path would JOIN Cache-Control with a comma, which is why the version tokens sit beside `assets/fonts/`, not inside it.
12. `.assetsignore` must not contain `_headers`, `_*`, `*.txt`, `assets/*.txt`, `assets/version.txt`, `assets/fonts-version.txt` (the tokens, `robots.txt` and `_headers` have to ship); it must contain `.*`, `.wrangler/`, `articles/_template/`, `.dev.vars*`, `.env*`, `CNAME`, `scripts/`, and the three curriculum authoring files (`contracts.mjs:1078-1085`). `.gitignore` must keep `!_headers` (its `_*` rule would drop it; `contracts.mjs:832`).
13. `wrangler.toml` is parsed as text by tests, so formatting is load-bearing: `run_worker_first = ["/*", "!/assets/*"]` verbatim; `html_handling = "auto-trailing-slash"` verbatim; `compatibility_date` at most the pinned miniflare's `supportedCompatibilityDate` (a newer date makes every server suite run on an older runtime than production); `crons = [...]` on one line starting at column 0 with exactly four entries, each with 5 fields and weekday NAMES (`flows-live-contract.mjs:983-993`); `[[durable_objects.bindings]]` followed immediately by `name = "PULSE"` then `class_name = "Pulse"`, and `[[migrations]]` followed by `tag = "v1"` then `new_sqlite_classes = ["Pulse"]` (`flows-rt-contract.mjs:1441-1442`); `FLOWS_RT_MODE = "on"`, `FLOWS_RT_AUDIENCE = "owner"`, `FLOWS_LIVE_MODE = "actions"` exact spacing; the fallback model/rates lines exact (`flows-neuron.mjs:800-803`); both daily cap vars present as digit strings; `head_sampling_rate` not 0.
14. The cron strings in `wrangler.toml` must equal the constants in `flows-live-worker.js:70-73`, and the market-hours step (5) must equal the cadence the pages quote (`REFRESH_CADENCE_MINUTES`, `flows-freshness-contract.mjs:270-290`); `live:focus` cadence equals the focus step x 60.
15. Adding a Durable Object class or renaming `Pulse` needs a NEW `[[migrations]]` tag (v2...), never an edit of v1. `Pulse` must stay exported from `worker.js` (line 38; `flows-rt-contract.mjs:1438`).
16. Source files carry no comments in any format: wrangler.toml, SQL, YAML workflows, `.gitignore`, `.assetsignore` were checked and contain none. Reasoning goes in commit messages and `docs/`. Also `contracts.mjs:1096-1113` fails any tracked `*.js`/`*.mjs` containing an absolute `/home/<user>/...` path.
17. Workflow hygiene is test-pinned (`flows-pipeline-contract.mjs:3570-3606`, `flows-starts-contract.mjs:34-48`, `flows-live-contract.mjs:749-760`): only `actions/checkout` and `actions/setup-node`, each pinned to the two SHAs above; `persist-credentials: false` on every checkout; the weekly `keepalive` loop must list exactly the workflows that contain `cron:` (so a new scheduled workflow must be added to the loop in `flows-pipeline.yml:108`, and `flows-ws-probe.yml` has no cron so it is correctly absent); regression's only cron is `17 6 * * 1`; `flows-live.yml` permissions are exactly contents read, id-token write, actions write, issues write and no secret other than `UW_API_KEY` and `FLOWS_INGEST_URL`; the pipeline workflow gained no extra permission; the concurrency group of the live workflow is `flows-live` (drill: `flows-live-drill`).
18. The nightly gate keys on the cron STRING that fired and the New York zone (`30 21 * * 1-5` admitted only under EDT, `30 22 * * 1-5` only under EST; the two backups always run). `flows-starts-contract.mjs` runs the gate under bash.
19. Version tokens: `assets/fonts-version.txt` <= `assets/version.txt` (`contracts.mjs:328-330`); a blanket `?v=` rewrite also hits the 16 woff2 references (8 `@font-face` in `base.css`, 8 Inter preloads) and fails the contract; `grep -rn 'woff2?v=' --include=*.html --include=*.css .` must show only the fonts token. The first forward deploy after any rollback must bump the version, because the asset layer serves a stored immutable 404 for missing css/js/fonts (`worker-regression.mjs:262-267`).
20. `assets/data/*` and `assets/img/*` are 1 hour on purpose (not immutable). The only test that pins that is `contracts.mjs:855-857`, which reads `_headers` as text; `tests/worker-regression.mjs` never asserts a `Cache-Control` for any `/assets/data/*` or `/assets/img/*` response (it fetches `og.png` at :234-238 for status and security headers only). It does pin the other classes at the live edge: css versioned and unversioned immutable (:216-229), a woff2 immutable (:241), the two version tokens 3600 (:249), a missing css/js/font 404 under the immutable policy (:262-267).
21. `sitemap.xml` must equal exactly `/`, `/lab/`, the `COURSE_TOPICS` paths in catalogue order, and the three project pages (`contracts.mjs:268-281`, `worker-regression.mjs:286-291` for the list and `:292-299` for the per-URL 200/canonical/not-noindex loop); no priority/changefreq; every URL must 200, self-canonicalise and not be noindex. Adding a course without a sitemap entry (or vice versa) fails two suites. `robots.txt` is pinned byte for byte (`worker-regression.mjs:276`).
22. Server suites need `FLOWS_TEST_SANDBOX=1` in the agent sandbox, or `wrangler dev` hangs on symlink loops; a silent timeout is not a test failure. Date-bearing literals inside server suites must be built from the clock or listed in `ANCHORED` (`contracts.mjs:873-905`) or CI breaks the day the calendar passes them.
23. `test:pipeline` (2 invocations) and `test:flows` (4) are the only compound scripts (`test:flows-ws-probe` is a single `node flows-ws-probe-contract.mjs`); adding a new suite means adding a `test:<name>` script AND appending `npm run test:<name>` to the `test` line (line 9). Nothing enforces the second step: an un-chained suite silently never runs in CI. CI wall time is capped at 40 minutes (`regression.yml:21`).
24. Secrets that must match in two places: `UW_API_KEY` (Worker secret and GitHub secret), `FLOWS_INGEST_TOKEN` (Worker secret and GitHub secret). A dashboard-added secret is dormant until the Deploy button; `wrangler secret put` deploys at once.
25. `docs/uw-openapi.yaml` is not excluded by `.assetsignore` (only `*.md` is), so by source reading it ships as a public static file; no test asserts it is private (unlike `.wrangler`, `articles/_template/`, `CNAME` at `worker-regression.mjs:269`). Treat as unverified exposure.
26. `UW_BASE` is honoured unconditionally by `uwFetch` (worker.js:2005) with no host allow-list, unlike `MARKET_QUOTE_ORIGIN`, `GITHUB_API_BASE` and `GITHUB_OIDC_JWKS`; never set it as a production var, the vendor key would be sent to that host.
27. `flows-weight.mjs` discovers `*Page` exports and fails a page without a ceiling; relevant when a config or asset change inflates inline HTML.

#### Source vs documentation disagreements (source wins)

- Course count: AGENTS.md ("exactly ols 20 ... gmm 33", seven courses) and README.md ("seven courses and 205 stages") are stale. `assets/js/course-catalog.js:4-91` defines 12 courses in file order (ols :6, iv2sls :13, did :20, var :27, panel :34, logit :41, gmm :48, foundations :55, mle :62, forecast :69, coint :76, financial :83; `TOPIC_META` is assigned at :91 and `LEARNING_PATHS` at :93); `sitemap.xml` has 12 course URLs; `academy-contract.mjs:122` prints "12 courses, 365 stages, 84 skills, 252 challenge variants, 3 verified synthetic snapshots"; `regression.mjs:8` lists 12 topics. `placement.recommended_topic` and the placement bank still use only the original seven ids.
- Course payload shape: AGENTS.md says the generated payload is `schemaVersion: 1` and capped at 14 KiB gzip per course. The files on disk carry `schemaVersion: 2` (`assets/data/courses/ols.json`, `ols/manifest.json`), `contracts.mjs:131` asserts 2, each course is a `manifest.json` plus per-module files (`lab-course.js:33,64` fetch those; `:40` falls back to the monolithic `<id>.json`), and the only gzip cap is 6,144 bytes per module file (`contracts.mjs:150`).
- API surface: AGENTS.md "API contract" omits `/api/v2/bootstrap`, `/api/v2/progress`, `/api/v2/attempt`, `/api/v2/preferences`, `/api/v2/project` (worker.js:2867, 2877, 2915, 2972, 2996) and the tables progress_v3, skill_mastery, skill_attempts, learning_preferences, project_progress; AGENTS.md's file map for `schema.sql` lists only the older tables.
- `placement-contract` is listed by AGENTS.md among suites that need workerd; the source runs it on its own Node `createServer` static server (placement-contract.mjs:114-150) with Chromium, no workerd. `regression.mjs` (test:browser) does use workerd but is missing from AGENTS.md's server list.
- DEPLOY.md 10.1 says `ensureFlowsTables()` "creates both tables"; the bootstrap is now 12 statements plus a PRAGMA (worker.js:132-143, 2572). DEPLOY.md section 4 lists only three required secrets; the code also needs `FLOWS_CREDENTIALS`, `FLOWS_PEPPER`, `FLOWS_INGEST_TOKEN`, `UW_API_KEY` (and optionally `GITHUB_DISPATCH_TOKEN`, legacy `FLOWS_LIVE_TOKEN`).
- AGENTS.md says `schema.sql` provisions the Flows tables "including `flows_live`..." and the learning tables; it does not say the four AI tables (flows_ai_usage, flows_ai_usage_model, flows_ai_summary, flows_neuron) are migration/inline only.
- `.assetsignore` carries stale entries (`flows/`, `functions/`) that match nothing, and `docs/` is not covered.
- DEPLOY.md 10.0 item 5 says four of the five Free-plan crons are registered, and the wrangler file registers exactly four; the repository holds no `[limits]` block.

### How to change it

| change | edit | then run / ritual |
|---|---|---|
| Add a D1 table | (1) new `migrations/00NN_*.sql` with `CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS`; (2) append the same DDL to `schema.sql` (unless you intend it migration/inline-only like the AI tables); (3) inline bootstrap in the owning module and register it: learner tables as a `*_SCHEMA_SQL` constant plus the matching `*Batch` retry in worker.js:354-435; Flows tables in `FLOWS_SCHEMA_SQL` (worker.js:132) or `LIVE_SCHEMA_SQL` (flows-live-worker.js:21) or an exported `*_SCHEMA_SQL` imported into `FLOWS_SCHEMA_SQL`; (4) if per-learner, add to the bootstrap statements (worker.js:806-827) and the reset batch (:3052-3069); (5) add the migration to `academy-contract.mjs:106-117` list and name | `node tests/academy-contract.mjs`, `flows-reads-contract.mjs` (statement count line 206 and trip counts), `flows-live-contract.mjs`, `flows-ledger-contract.mjs` / dossier contract if parity pinned; apply remotely with `wrangler d1 execute iewt --remote --file=./migrations/00NN_*.sql`; update AGENTS.md file map and DEPLOY.md 10.4b key table |
| Add a column | new ALTER migration (non-idempotent), the CREATE in `schema.sql`, the inline CREATE, and a runtime upgrade path if rows must keep working before the migration is applied (pattern: `CLOCK_ADDED_COLUMNS` + `upgradeClockColumns`, or `addDayColumn` worker.js:382, or `recordSignIn` lab-sign-in.js:11) | the column-parity tests above; for flows_clock also `CLOCK_COLUMNS` map flows-live-worker.js:99 |
| Add or change a wrangler var | `wrangler.toml [vars]` (strings only); read it through a helper with a safe default; add a test pin only if the format matters | `flows-neuron.mjs`/`flows-rt-contract.mjs` regexes if you touch pinned lines; document in AGENTS.md |
| Add a secret/binding | `wrangler secret put NAME` (and the GitHub secret if Actions need it); read `env.NAME` guarded for absence (tests run without it); `[[...]]` binding in `wrangler.toml` | `wrangler deploy --dry-run`; DEPLOY.md section 4 |
| Change or add a cron | edit `crons` (keep weekday NAMES, one line, <= 5 total on Free), update constants and `cronJob` in `flows-live-worker.js:70-88`, the scheduled handler worker.js:3950, and the cadence constants in `shared/flows-freshness.js` | `flows-live-contract.mjs`, `flows-freshness-contract.mjs`, `flows-rt-contract.mjs:1445`; after deploy confirm with `wrangler triggers deploy` / dashboard that all registered |
| Change security headers | `SECURITY_HEADERS` worker.js:117 AND `_headers` lines 2-8 (verbatim); CSP only in worker.js:102 | `node tests/contracts.mjs`, `worker-regression.mjs`; live header smoke test (dashboard Transform Rules can override) |
| New `assets/` subdirectory or top-level file | add its `_headers` rule (`/assets/<dir>/*` or `/assets/<file>`), extend the `policy` object expectation in `contracts.mjs:855-857` | contracts |
| Change or add a browser asset | edit under `assets/css`, `assets/js` or `assets/data`; bump `assets/version.txt`; rewrite `?v=` everywhere (including `404.html`, `lab/*.html`, `articles/index.html`, `index.html`), `data-asset-version` on three shells, `ASSET_VERSION` in `shared/flows-pages.js`; restore woff2 refs to the fonts token | `contracts.mjs`, `flows-features.mjs:847`; ship note: a rollback needs a bump too |
| Change a font | edit `assets/fonts/*`; set `assets/fonts-version.txt` to the NEW asset version; update the 8 `@font-face` URLs and Inter preloads; the asset bump follows because `base.css` changes | `contracts.mjs` (reports 16 font references) |
| Add a course / page to the sitemap | `sitemap.xml` entry in catalogue order, `shared/course-seo.js`, `assets/js/course-catalog.js`, generator (`node scripts/generate-course-payloads.mjs`), OG image, and the asset bump | `contracts.mjs`, `worker-regression.mjs`, `academy-contract.mjs` |
| Exclude or include a file from the bundle | `.assetsignore` (do not use `*.txt`, `_*`); add a negative-path assertion beside `worker-regression.mjs:269` if it must stay private (consider `docs/`) | `worker-regression.mjs` |
| Add a test suite | write `tests/<name>.mjs`; add `"test:<name>"` to `tests/package.json` AND append `&& npm run test:<name>` to the `test` line; use `--disable-warning=ExperimentalWarning` if it imports `node:sqlite`; if it calls `startWorker` classify it W and make sure it fits the 40-minute CI cap; record it in AGENTS.md's server/no-server lists | run it alone, then the whole chain order matters (a failure early hides later suites) |
| Rotate or add a GitHub Action | pin by full 40-hex SHA, update ALL five workflows and the allow-list in `flows-pipeline-contract.mjs:3596-3606` | the pipeline contract |
| Add a scheduled workflow | add `cron:` and add its file name to the `for wf in ...` loop in `flows-pipeline.yml:108` (the keepalive test compares the loop to the set of workflows containing `cron:`) | `flows-pipeline-contract.mjs:3570-3586` |
| Change the live workflow | keep permissions exactly four, no new secret, pinned actions, drill input and concurrency expression; the 32 cron lines are only a backup (the loop keeps itself alive) | `flows-starts-contract.mjs`, `flows-live-contract.mjs:749-760,1843` |
| Update the pinned toolchain | `tests/package.json` devDependencies + `npm install` to regenerate `tests/package-lock.json`; then raise `compatibility_date` only up to `supportedCompatibilityDate` | full chain, `wrangler deploy --dry-run` |
| Provision / repair production D1 | follow DEPLOY.md 3 and 10.1: inspect with `pragma_table_info`, apply only the missing migration with `d1 execute --remote --file`; never `migrations apply` | export/backup first for non-idempotent changes |
| Deploy | not automated by this repo: verify Workers Builds (dashboard) or run `wrangler deploy --strict` after green CI; then smoke tests (DEPLOY.md 7) and header readback | rollback: `wrangler versions list` / `wrangler rollback <id>`, then bump the asset version on the next forward deploy |
| Local dev | `cd tests && npm ci`, `./tests/node_modules/.bin/wrangler d1 execute iewt --local --file schema.sql`, `wrangler dev --local`; secrets in git-ignored `.dev.vars` | `FLOWS_TEST_SANDBOX=1` for server suites in the agent sandbox |

## Docs: AGENTS.md, DEPLOY.md, audit, OpenAPI index

Snapshot: commit `ba2acfe` (origin/main after PR #148, 2026-10-03), `assets/version.txt` = 240, `assets/fonts-version.txt` = 230. All line numbers below were taken with `grep -n` / `sed -n` / `Read` on that commit. Where a doc and the source disagree the source wins; every disagreement found is listed in "Invariants and traps" (table D1 to D17).

### Purpose and boundaries

What this area is: the repository's prose and reference data. Five in-scope files.

| File | Lines | Bytes | Kind | Last touched |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `AGENTS.md` | 1,127 | 87,886 | agent handbook (architecture, file map, contracts, test taxonomy) | `ba2acfe` (#148), 2026-10-03 |
| `DEPLOY.md` | 3,108 | 198,592 | operator runbook, decision log and measurement log | `ba2acfe` (#148), 2026-10-03 |
| `docs/flows-audit-2026-09.md` | 461 | 25,585 | one-off integrity audit of the Flows section (evidence date 2026-09-13), historical | `4de4963` (#116) |
| `scripts/flows-probe-list.json` | 209 | 46,542 | DATA: the weekly vendor probe's operation list, documented field names, code-read fields, expected refusals | `df23f6a` (#146), 2026-10-03 |
| `docs/uw-openapi.yaml` | 28,755 | 1,003,359 | the Unusual Whales public OpenAPI 3.0 spec, checked in verbatim | `9c49af3` (#80), 2026-09-05 |

What it is NOT:
- Not executable. The only machine-read members are the probe list (JSON, read by `scripts/flows-probe.mjs` and two suites) and the spec (YAML, read by `tests/gen-dossier-fixtures.py` and hashed by `tests/flows-dossier-contract.mjs`). No test parses `AGENTS.md`, `DEPLOY.md` or the audit as files.
- `.assetsignore` has `*.md`, so the three Markdown files never ship to Cloudflare. It does NOT list `docs/`, so `docs/uw-openapi.yaml` (1 MB) is part of the static bundle (trap D8).
- Not the config source of truth: `wrangler.toml` (58 lines) is. Not the schema source of truth: `schema.sql` (240 lines) + `migrations/0001..0016` + the DDL arrays inside `worker.js` (`MARKET_SNAPSHOT_SCHEMA_SQL` :129, `FLOWS_SCHEMA_SQL` :132-143) are.

Neighbours (other areas map them; this area only records the documentation contract with them):
- `README.md` (191 lines, 9,142 bytes): public readme, overlaps AGENTS.md intro/runtime and repeats the www/GitHub Pages note. Not in scope, but it is the third place that states deployment facts.
- `assets/fonts/NOTICE.md`: font licence note; counts as a "no bump rule" file in `tests/contracts.mjs:964`.
- `worker.js`, `wrangler.toml`, `_headers`, `.assetsignore`, `schema.sql`, `migrations/`, `.github/workflows/*.yml` (flows-live 121 lines, flows-pipeline 115, flows-probe 48, flows-ws-probe 41, regression 44): the things the runbook operates.
- `scripts/flows-probe.mjs` (868 lines), `.github/workflows/flows-probe.yml`, `tests/flows-probe-contract.mjs` (610): the probe that consumes the list.
- `shared/flows-dossier-vendor.js` (`DOSSIER_READS`), `tests/flows-dossier-contract.mjs`, `tests/gen-dossier-fixtures.py` (403), `tests/fixtures-dossier-vendor.json` (1,897): the dossier's contract with the list and the spec.
- `scripts/flows-legs/health.mjs`, `witness.mjs`, `tests/flows-live-contract.mjs`, `tests/worker-regression.mjs`: quote DEPLOY.md section numbers in runtime strings and assertions.
- `.mcp.json`: points an MCP client at `https://unusualwhales.com/public-api/mcp` with `${UW_API_KEY}`; a developer convenience, not part of the app.
- `LICENSE` (201 lines, Apache License 2.0, tracked, not listed in `.assetsignore`, so it ships in the static bundle; mapped in 12-config-infra / 22-site-shell). The other tracked prose-or-data files near this area (`robots.txt` 4 lines, `sitemap.xml` 47 lines, `CNAME`) are site files, not documentation, and are mapped elsewhere.

Trust order to use when two sources disagree: source code > tests > `wrangler.toml`/workflows > AGENTS.md > DEPLOY.md > audit. DEPLOY.md is a dated log: many paragraphs begin "Until 2026-MM-DD ..." and describe a fixed bug, not current behaviour.

#### scripts/flows-probe-list.json structure

| Key | Count | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `version` | 1 | validated by `validateList` (`flows-probe.mjs:186`) |
| `probes[]` | 97 rows | `{ id, tier, op, path, query?, bind? }`; `id` matches `/^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9-]*$/` and is unique; `tier` in {`used`,`1`,`2`} (`TIERS`, :24); `op` = spec operation (starts `/api/`); `path` uses `{t}` (per ticker) or literal; `query` values are strings or arrays of strings |
| `probes[].tier` | 49 `used`, 19 `1`, 29 `2` rows | `used` = operation the code reads (38 ops); `1`/`2` = the "adoption plan" tiers (15 and 26 ops); one tier per op (`flows-probe-contract.mjs:24`); Tier 3 deliberately omitted |
| `probes[].bind` | 1 row (`contract-historic`) | takes `{symbol}` from an earlier probe's `option_symbol`, `maxBy: open_interest`; the source probe must precede it |
| `expect{}` | 70 ops | the field names the SPEC documents (or, for three ops absent from the spec, names observed live on 2026-09-23); drives `specDiff` (:474) "documented names UNSEEN / undocumented" lines; 9 probed ops have no `expect` |
| `reads{}` | 27 ops | the fields the CODE reads; strict mode (`strictVerdict` :724) fails with `DRIFT <id>: <names> did not arrive` when any is missing; names must be distinct (:224) and, per `flows-probe-contract.mjs:515-527`, a subset of `expect` except `SEEN_OUTSIDE_SPEC` (`sector-etfs.last`, `etf-tide.underlying_price`, `spot-exposures.start_time`, flow-alerts `start_time/end_time/iv_start/iv_end`, etf-holdings `type/weight`) |
| `gated{}` | 4 ops | expected refusals: `/api/volatility/vix-term-structure` 403 (needs the `volatility` add-on), `/api/companies/{ticker}/profile` 403, `/api/companies/{ticker}/earnings-estimates` 403 (spec marks both Advanced+), `/api/politician-portfolios/holders/{ticker}` 422 (enterprise-only); values must be 4xx (:230); an expected refusal that starts answering is noted as "the plan changed" (:736) |

Probe tokens (`fillTokens` :135, `dateTokens` :97): `{t}` ticker, `{tickers}` comma list, `{date}` session date (the SPY daily candle read by `SESSION_PROBE` :26, else `sessionGuess` :121), `{date-Nd}` (e.g. `{date-7d}`, `{date-92d}`, `{date-365d}`), `{next-session}`, `{weekly}` (Friday after), `{monthly}` (third Friday at least `MONTHLY_MIN_DAYS` = 14 out), `{monthly2}`, and bound names such as `{symbol}`.

The 97 probe ids by tier are the rows in the file (ids such as `ohlc-1d`, `stock-state`, `option-contracts`, `screener`, `market-tide`, `flow-alerts`, `profile`, `financials`, `analysts-ticker`, `news-ticker`). The last 9 `used` rows were added with the dossier (`profile`, `financials`, `fundamental-breakdown`, `earnings-estimates`, `analysts-ticker`, `institution-ownership`, `short-interest-v2`, `insider-ticker-flow`, `news-ticker`); the dossier's other four operations (`info`, `earnings`, `darkpool-levels`, `stock-state`) were already probed as `used` rows, 13 in all (`OPS` in `tests/gen-dossier-fixtures.py:22-36`).

Edge policy: `/assets/*` never reaches the Worker; `_headers:1-29` supplies the 7 security headers plus `Cache-Control` by path (`css|js|fonts` immutable 1 y; `img|data|version tokens` 1 h). HTML: `no-cache` + CSP from `worker.js`. `/api/*`, `/auth/*`, `/flows*`: `no-store`.

#### D.3 D1 tables and where they are documented

`schema.sql` creates 20 tables, 3 indexes, 1 trigger: `users`, `progress`, `stats`, `learning_sync`, `mastery` (+`mastery_due_by_user`), `mastery_attempts`, `placement`, `progress_v3` (+`progress_v3_by_user`), `skill_mastery` (+`skill_mastery_due_by_user`), `market_snapshot`, `skill_attempts`, `learning_preferences`, `project_progress`, `flows_payload`, `flows_login_failures`, `flows_live`, `flows_tape`, `flows_clock`, `flows_ledger`, `flows_dossier_cache`, trigger `flows_archive_immutable`. The four AI tables `flows_ai_usage`, `flows_ai_usage_model`, `flows_ai_summary`, `flows_neuron` are NOT in `schema.sql`: they come from `migrations/0006..0009` and from `worker.js:136-140` (`ensureFlowsTables` first-use path).

#### D.4 Budgets, caps and numbers the runbook relies on

D1 Free: 100,000 rows written + 5,000,000 rows read a day (reset 00:00 UTC); archive steady state ~270 rows, +3 writes per run; ledger ~350 writes/day; dossier refresh <= 5 writes, 16-19 rows read; reading <= 8 rows written, 3 rows read on a hit / 18 on a miss (30 with the background call); thirteen home reads cost 23 rows. Workers Free: 100,000 requests/day, 10 ms CPU per invocation (Tier 1 about 5 ms cold / under 1 ms warm; focus tick 3-4 ms cold; summary firing 10.5 ms first run). Workers AI: 10,000 free neurons, Worker cap 30,000 neurons / 2,500 calls, reading at 75% = 22,500; typical reading 57 neurons on the primary model (293 on the fallback). Rail: ~98 vendor calls/min with a viewer against a 240 budget (px 12, fl 12, gx 60, mk 12, nw 2); socket bytes ~433 KB/min for five topics, poll rung ~1.6 MB/min. Pipeline: ~3,780 calls (14 minutes) at the focus-era shape, 36-minute deadline, 45-minute runner kill, 1,502 s historic run. Payload caps: `focus` 24 KB, `live:strips` 64 KB (series 112 KB), `live:focus` 16 KB, universe 100 KiB, roster 32 KB, secret `FLOWS_CREDENTIALS` 5 KB. Probe: about 140 calls per Sunday run, 250 ms apart.

#### D.5 Wire formats and headers named by the docs

Error envelope `{ "error": { "code", "message" } }` (AGENTS 287-289); request headers `X-IEWT-Owner`, `X-IEWT-Generation`; response headers `X-Fresh-State`, `X-Fresh-Reason`, `X-Fresh-Last-Good`, `X-Payload-Updated`, `X-Server-Now`, `X-Live-Overlay`, `X-Dossier-{Fingerprint,Tokens,Vendor-Calls,Pending}`; rail envelope `{v,k,ep,sq,at,snap,fresh,meta,rows}` with kinds `px fl gx mk nw ctl`; client messages `sub`, `p`, `rs` (<= 256 B); close codes 1008, 1009, 4001, 4003, 4008, 4009, 4011, 4012; internal cache URLs `https://flows-info.internal/<T>` (worker.js:2049), `https://flows-dossier.internal/{news,levels,quote,assembled}/<T>`.

#### D.6 Vendor plan facts recorded across the docs

Plan of the key is not stated anywhere as a fact; evidence in the repo: `gated` list (volatility add-on missing; politician-portfolios enterprise-only; companies/* Advanced+ expected to refuse until the first strict run proves otherwise, DEPLOY 2788-2795); the socket entitlement question is what `flows-ws-probe.yml` answers (outcome not recorded in the docs); documented request rate: the vendor "documents no rate limit anywhere" / "publishes no rate limits" in DEPLOY 1289, 1360 and 1401 (the spec info block now states 500 req/min for the Startup tier, 14174); the pipeline learned floor stayed <= 150 ms (DEPLOY 1319-1322).

### Flows

Each sequence lists the doc location and the code hop.

1. Release gate (DEPLOY 1-9): clean SHA (`git rev-parse HEAD`) -> `node scripts/generate-course-payloads.mjs` + `git status -- assets/data/courses` empty -> `cd tests && npm ci && npx playwright install chromium && npm test` (77 chained `npm run test:*` scripts, `tests/package.json` "test") -> `wrangler deploy --dry-run --outdir ...` (`regression.yml` does the same on push/PR/Monday) -> deploy by Workers Builds (external) or `wrangler deploy --strict` -> smoke (7) -> manual Lab checks (8) -> rollback path (9).
2. First-time Flows enablement (10.0 -> 10.4): `wrangler d1 execute iewt --remote --file=./migrations/0005_flows.sql` (10.1) -> mint credentials `node scripts/generate-flows-credentials.mjs --mint --out members.json` + `openssl rand -hex 32` -> `wrangler secret put FLOWS_PEPPER | FLOWS_CREDENTIALS | FLOWS_INGEST_TOKEN` (deploys immediately) + same token as GitHub secret (10.2) -> curl `/api/flows/ingest` expects 401 not 503 (609) -> deploy -> gate checks (10.3) -> learning platform check (10.4). Then 10.0 items: `GITHUB_DISPATCH_TOKEN`, `UW_API_KEY` x2, WAF skip rule, OAuth keep-alive.
3. Member lifecycle (10.2a): edit private `members.json` with `--add/--set/--remove` -> `wrangler secret put FLOWS_CREDENTIALS < members.json` -> verify by signing in (303 + `flows_session`) or 401 for ended members. `FLOWS_SESSION_EPOCH` in `[vars]` signs everyone out (needs a deploy).
4. Nightly day (10.5h, 10.5k): 17:15 ET Worker dispatch if `GITHUB_DISPATCH_TOKEN` (`nightlyTick`, flows-live-worker.js:554); else 17:30 ET the Tier 2 loop dispatches `flows-pipeline.yml` with `origin=live-loop` (witness/starts); primary crons `30 21` (EDT) and `30 22` (EST) UTC = 17:30 ET, backups `17 1` and `47 3` UTC (days 2-6); the gate step admits one primary per zone; pipeline refuses 09:30-16:00 ET unless `allow_intraday`; same-session gate -> refresh only `pulse`, `sector:premium`, `news`; health gate last (`scripts/flows-legs/health.mjs`); `meta` lands ~17:45 ET; `nightly missing` log from 21:00 ET; witness `nightly` check at 21:00 ET.
5. Trading day live layer (10.5i): 09:31 ET Tier 1 rolls `flows_clock`; 09:45 probe decides trading/closed (two probes 15 min apart to close); Tier 1 `1-59/5` writes `live:market`; focus tick `3-58/5` writes `live:focus`; Tier 2 loop passes every 5 min 09:31-16:25 writing `live:strips|breadth|gex|alerts|news|movers|heartbeat`; ledger rows ride existing batches; `*/30` housekeeping (market snapshot, nightly dispatch, prune tape/ledger); `15,45` summary firing; 16:25-17:30 15-minute clock ticks; chain hop every 340 minutes.
6. Probe flow: `flows-probe.yml` (Sunday 14:23 UTC, strict) -> `scripts/flows-probe.mjs` -> `loadList()` (validate) -> read SPY daily candles for the session date -> `expandProbes` x tickers -> paced calls (250 ms, 429 retried on `Retry-After`) -> `specDiff` + `reads` check per op -> `strictVerdict` (exit 1 on unexpected refusal or missing read field; `gated` ops expected to refuse).
7. Fixture flow: `docs/uw-openapi.yaml` -> `python3 tests/gen-dossier-fixtures.py` (PyYAML; derefs each of 13 ops' 200 schema; checks names, JSON types, nullability, string-typed numerics; writes `tests/fixtures-dossier-vendor.json` with `specSha256`) -> `tests/flows-dossier-contract.mjs` (sha check :141-142, reducers vs `DOSSIER_READS` :157-182) -> `tests/flows-dossier-reads.mjs` and `tests/dossier-harness.mjs` consume the fixtures.
8. Doc-to-runtime coupling: `scripts/flows-legs/health.mjs` builds `HEALTH:` lines that cite "DEPLOY.md 10.0 item N" -> the nightly goes red -> owner reads DEPLOY section -> acts; `tests/flows-live-contract.mjs` asserts those strings; `witness.mjs` issue bodies cite "DEPLOY.md section 10.5i".
9. Dossier / reading inspection (10.5l, 10.5m): `curl -H "Cookie: <flows session>" /api/flows/dossier?t=NVDA&render=1`; `/api/flows/summary?t=NVDA | jq .read`; `wrangler d1 execute iewt --remote --command "SELECT ... FROM flows_dossier_cache|flows_neuron ..."`.
10. Rail verification (10.5n): `FLOWS_TEST_SANDBOX=1 node tests/flows-rt-server.mjs` -> `wrangler deploy --dry-run` -> after deploy `curl -b <cookie> /api/rt/status` (`running:false` idle) -> browser `new WebSocket("wss://anilkaya.org/api/rt/ws")` receives `hello`.

Runbook command index (DEPLOY line): `git status/rev-parse` 14-15; generator + test + dry-run 27-38; D1 local 53, remote pragma 58-60, remote schema 73; `secret list/put` 117-120; `deploy --strict` 158; smoke curls 183-286; `versions list` / `rollback` 323-324; `secret put GITHUB_DISPATCH_TOKEN` 369, `UW_API_KEY` 409; `PRAGMA table_info(users)` 490; 0005 apply 512; `sqlite_master` check 533; mint 564/568; `openssl rand` 571; `secret put FLOWS_*` 578-580; members 674-686; gate curls 749-772; `/api/me` 782; Tier 1 telemetry SELECT 2125; `flows_live` writer SELECT 2434; `triggers deploy` 2443; `gh workflow run flows-live.yml -f drill=true` 2598 and 2672; `gh workflow run flows-pipeline.yml -f origin=live-loop` 2685; 0016 apply 2714; dossier curls 2768-2769; cache SELECT 2780; summary curl 2872-2873; `flows_neuron` SELECT 2874.

### Invariants and traps

Evidence is the file:line or test that holds the rule.

1. Doc section numbers are runtime strings. Renumbering `DEPLOY.md` 10.0 items, 10.5i, 10.5k or §9 breaks the text in `scripts/flows-legs/health.mjs`, `witness.mjs` and the assertions in `tests/flows-live-contract.mjs:2508-2667,3152`, `tests/worker-regression.mjs:267`. Change both sides together.
2. `tests/flows-probe-contract.mjs:27-29` hard-codes the probe list census: 38 `used`, 15 tier-`1`, 26 tier-`2` operations (one tier per operation, :24), and the summary line at :599 repeats it. Adding or retiering a probe op fails the suite until those numbers move.
3. `reads` entries must be distinct names and, except for the `SEEN_OUTSIDE_SPEC` set (flows-probe-contract.mjs:515-527), must also be in `expect` for the same op (`SEEN_OUTSIDE_SPEC` is defined at :515). `validateList` additionally requires every `expect`/`reads`/`gated` key to name an op that a probe exercises (flows-probe.mjs:214-233) and `bind.from` to be an EARLIER probe (:206).
4. Every `used` operation the dossier reads must appear in `DOSSIER_READS` (`shared/flows-dossier-vendor.js`), have a `reads` list that is a subset of `expect`, and be probed at tier `used` (`tests/flows-dossier-contract.mjs:157-182`). `/api/companies/{ticker}/profile` and `/earnings-estimates` must stay `gated: 403` (:180-181).
5. The spec's sha256 is pinned in `tests/fixtures-dossier-vendor.json:1894` and checked at `tests/flows-dossier-contract.mjs:141-142`. Any edit to `docs/uw-openapi.yaml` (even whitespace) fails that suite until `python3 tests/gen-dossier-fixtures.py` is rerun and the fixture diff read.
6. The spec is a snapshot: it lacks five paths the code calls (interpolated-iv/distribution, term-structure/distribution, option-sentiment, option-sentiment/top, market/daily-report) and `stock_screener` as a socket channel. Never treat "not in the spec" as "unsupported"; the probe list (and DEPLOY.md's 2026-09-23 notes) are the evidence for those.
7. `docs/uw-openapi.yaml` is not listed in `.assetsignore` (only `*.md` is, `tests/contracts.mjs:1078-1084` pins a different set), so it deploys with the static bundle. Run `curl -sI https://anilkaya.org/docs/uw-openapi.yaml` before assuming it is private; add `docs/` to `.assetsignore` if it should not ship (nothing tests for either outcome).
8. Never commit the real contents of `members.json`, secrets, tokens, or dashboard exports: the repository and its Actions logs are public (DEPLOY 622; 473 on `labActiveAt` being kept out of logs). `tests/contracts.mjs:1096-1117` (`HOME_PATH` :1097) scans tracked `*.js`/`*.mjs` for `/home/<user>/...` absolute paths.
9. Commentary rule: source files carry no comments (AGENTS 1058-1080). `tests/contracts.mjs` does not enforce it, but several narrower suites do: `tests/flows-quant.mjs:901` (every `shared/flows-quant-*.js` equals its own `stripComments` output), `tests/flows-legs-contract.mjs:897` (`scripts/flows-legs/*` hold no `//` or `/*`), `tests/flows-neuron-screen.mjs:305`, `tests/flows-positioning-contract.mjs:913`. `scripts/strip-comments.mjs` (165 lines, exports `stripComments` :9 and `stripTree` :116, CLI flag `--check`; a bare run REWRITES `assets/js` in place) is a no-op on this tree only because no comments are left; `tests/flows-strip.mjs` (npm `test:flows-strip`) imports both exports, requires `stripTree({check:true})` to report nothing broken and stripping to be idempotent, and renders emitted cards in Chromium with stripped scripts; `tests/flows-quant.mjs:16` imports `stripComments`. Put reasoning in commit messages and `docs/`. Prose in `DEPLOY.md`/`AGENTS.md` is exempt.
10. The doc-listed test taxonomy matters operationally: a suite that needs workerd HANGS without `FLOWS_TEST_SANDBOX=1` in this sandbox and looks like an assertion failure when wrapped in `timeout` (AGENTS 1017-1027). 17 suites call `startWorker()` from `tests/worker-server.mjs` (`contracts.mjs` only greps for it, `contracts.mjs:891`); `tests/regression.mjs` (npm `test:browser`) is one of them (:3-5) yet is named in neither AGENTS list (D17).
11. `npm test` is one `&&` chain of 77 scripts in `tests/package.json`; it stops at the first failure and hides every later suite (AGENTS 1037-1042). Helpers not in the chain: `board-shift`, `desk-fixtures`, `dossier-fixtures`, `dossier-harness`, `live-stubs`, `lk-mock`, `reading-archetypes`, `rt-fixtures`, `worker-server`.
12. Asset-version discipline (AGENTS 697-747; enforced `tests/contracts.mjs:327-350, 921-985`): any change under `assets/css|js|data` needs `assets/version.txt` increased vs `ASSET_DIFF_BASE`/`origin/main`; fonts under `assets/fonts` need `assets/fonts-version.txt` increased; font URLs carry ONLY the fonts token (sixteen references: eight `@font-face` URLs in `base.css` + eight preloads); a blanket `?v=` rewrite or a merge that brings one is the classic breakage; after a rollback the first forward deploy must bump (DEPLOY 331-345). This repo is at 240/230 now.
13. DEPLOY.md history is not current-state. Examples superseded in code: 10.5a "accepts no limit, page or offset" (see D4); 10.5a 521-call figures (now `CALL_BUDGET` 4,191); "This figure was 403/471" (1355); `FLOWS_SESSION_EPOCH = "1"` example; 10.5g wave-B probe narrative; "four of the five crons the Free plan allows" (DEPLOY 498, inside 10.0 item 5, not 10.5i) is current (`wrangler.toml:26` has four).
14. Operational facts that are easy to get wrong and are documented: Cloudflare weekday numbering (1 = Sunday) means Worker crons write `MON-FRI` by name while GitHub cron uses `1-5` (DEPLOY 1876-1881, `tests/flows-live-contract.mjs` refuses numeric weekdays); `wrangler secret put` deploys but the dashboard does not (593-613); the `FLOWS_CREDENTIALS` secret fails closed on bad JSON and ends every live session (648-656); pepper rotation signs nobody out (728-733); `migrations apply` must not be used (515-526); `0011`/`0012`/`0013`/`0014` ALTERs are not re-runnable (2381-2386, 487-491); the nightly's last step is the health gate and a red run emails the owner (1757); republish repair only works before the next weekday's 09:30 ET (1749-1756).
15. Unproven in production per the docs themselves (do not cite as fact): last-good copy on the production edge (1007-1012); Yahoo `sessionEnd` presence (2093-2098); the first live reading refusal rate (2895-2903); the live vendor's response to a 5 s screener cadence and WebSocket entitlement (3024-3027); `issues: write`, reopen/duplicate-close PATCH semantics, the public-header probe (2668-2702, 2632-2655).

### How to change it

R1. Edit a runbook or handbook paragraph (no code change). Edit `DEPLOY.md` / `AGENTS.md` only. No asset bump, no generator, no test needed (nothing parses them). Before moving or renumbering a DEPLOY section grep `git grep -n 'DEPLOY.md' -- scripts tests shared worker.js` (hits listed in Symbol index A) and update the strings and their assertions together; then run `node tests/flows-live-contract.mjs` and `node tests/worker-regression.mjs` (the latter needs `FLOWS_TEST_SANDBOX=1` in the sandbox). Keep the habit of recording measurements with a date and the suite that produced them.

R2. Document a new Worker route, env var or cron. Order: implement (`worker.js` route near the matching block, `wrangler.toml` `[vars]` or `[triggers]`), add the test, then update AGENTS.md (API contract 282-343 or the relevant Flows section; the file-map row), DEPLOY.md (owner action if a secret; 10.5i/10.5n tables for crons/kill switches) and `docs` only. A new cron string must also satisfy `tests/flows-live-contract.mjs` (no numeric weekdays; `cronJob` routing at `shared/flows-live-worker.js:75`) and the health gate's "which cron is missing" messages in `scripts/flows-legs/health.mjs`.

R3. Add, retier or remove a vendor operation in `scripts/flows-probe-list.json`.
1. Add the `probes[]` row (unique lowercase-hyphen `id`, `tier`, `op` spec path template, `path` with `{t}`/literal, string-valued `query`). 2. Add `expect[op]` from the spec's 200 schema (or the live names for an off-spec op) and, if code reads fields, `reads[op]` (subset of `expect`; otherwise add the field to `SEEN_OUTSIDE_SPEC` in `tests/flows-probe-contract.mjs:515-521`). 3. If the vendor is known to refuse on this plan, add `gated[op] = 4xx`. 4. Update the census in `tests/flows-probe-contract.mjs:27-29` and the summary text at :599. 5. If the dossier reads it: add the reducer + `DOSSIER_READS` entry in `shared/flows-dossier-vendor.js`, the op to `OPS` in `tests/gen-dossier-fixtures.py:22-36`, regenerate fixtures. Run `node tests/flows-probe-contract.mjs`, `node tests/flows-dossier-contract.mjs`, `node scripts/flows-probe.mjs --dry-run --tickers=SPY --filter=<id>`. If the probe list is JSON-invalid, the weekly workflow fails at `loadList`. No asset bump (it is not under `assets/`).

R4. Refresh `docs/uw-openapi.yaml`. Replace the file; run `python3 tests/gen-dossier-fixtures.py` (needs PyYAML; refuses a body that does not conform to the spec); read the fixture diff; rerun `node tests/flows-dossier-contract.mjs` (sha now matches) and `node tests/flows-probe-contract.mjs`; reconcile `expect` lists with changed schemas; re-derive the "paths absent from the spec" list (D6/trap 6); decide on `.assetsignore` (trap 7). Update DEPLOY 1654 date wording if you cite one.

R5. Add a test suite. Create `tests/<name>.mjs`; add `"test:<name>"` to `tests/package.json` AND append `&& npm run test:<name>` at the intended position of the single `test` chain (order matters, trap 11); use `--disable-warning=ExperimentalWarning` if it imports `node:sqlite` (Node >= 22.13); if it boots workerd call `startWorker()` from `tests/worker-server.mjs` and add its fixed dates to the `ANCHORED` table in `tests/contracts.mjs` (the 400-day ISO-date scan at :873-905); run it with and without `FLOWS_TEST_SANDBOX=1`; time it and add it to the right list in AGENTS.md (no-server 834-865 or needs-server 1007-1016) with a measured date; a new Flows page also needs a `CEILING_KIB` entry in `tests/flows-weight.mjs:12-27` (page functions are auto-discovered, an unlisted one fails).

R6. Ship a browser-asset change (touches `assets/css|js|data`). Bump `assets/version.txt` (integer), rewrite every versioned CSS/JS `?v=` in HTML and `ASSET_VERSION` in `shared/flows-pages.js`, then `grep -rn 'woff2?v=' --include=*.html --include=*.css .` and reset any font hit to `assets/fonts-version.txt`; run `node tests/contracts.mjs` (expect "sixteen font references") and `node tests/flows-features.mjs` (holds `ASSET_VERSION` equal to the token). For a font change set `assets/fonts-version.txt` to the new `assets/version.txt` value. Re-run generators first if a `shared/flows-quant-*` module the browser reaches changed: `node scripts/build-flows-quant-bundle.mjs` (writes both quant bundles) and `node scripts/generate-course-payloads.mjs` for course sources (commit all generated outputs).

R7. Change an operational threshold the runbook quotes (deadline, rate floor, call budget, caps). Edit the constant (see Symbol index C), then the owning contract (`tests/flows-pipeline-contract.mjs` holds `rateFloorSurvivesBudget`, the cron-admission walk and the chunk vs `INGEST_META_KEYS_MAX`; `tests/flows-reads-contract.mjs` holds rows-read ceilings; `tests/flows-live-contract.mjs` holds CPU and cron arithmetic; `tests/flows-rt-contract.mjs` holds rail limits), then the DEPLOY paragraph and the dated measurement.

R8. Change what the nightly health gate says or checks. `scripts/flows-legs/health.mjs` (messages cite DEPLOY items), `tests/flows-live-contract.mjs` (2508-2667 and 3152 assert text), `tests/flows-ledger-contract.mjs` (gate vs ledger), DEPLOY 1757-1845. Keep the cited section numbers valid (trap 1).

R9. Rotate or add owner credentials, secrets or members. Follow DEPLOY 10.0 / 10.2 / 10.2a verbatim: secrets only via `wrangler secret put` (deploys), tokens never in repo/CI logs, `UW_API_KEY` in both GitHub and the Worker, `FLOWS_INGEST_TOKEN` byte-identical in both, members via `generate-flows-credentials.mjs` + `FLOWS_CREDENTIALS`. Verify with 10.2's 401-not-503 curl and 10.3's gate block.

R10. Fix stale handbook sections (D1-D3, D5, D12). Read first: `assets/js/course-catalog.js` (TOPIC_META, LEARNING_PATHS), `scripts/generate-course-payloads.mjs` (outputs list at 93, 135, 243-251, 268, 285-316), `tests/contracts.mjs` (budgets 131-153, defaults 44-45), `worker.js:2852-3290` (v1 + v2 routes), `schema.sql` / `migrations/0001..0004`. Update AGENTS.md sections 107-190 (file map), 191-237, 282-343; keep all changed tables in the style of the existing ones; no tests need changing.

R11. Use the audit. Treat `docs/flows-audit-2026-09.md` as read-only history: do not re-fix I-1/I-4 (already fixed); the open items are I-3 (rename or keep `vrp`), I-10 (signal-validation harness: `flows_feature_history` + IC readings, not built), I-7..I-9, I-11..I-13 (verify first). New audits belong in a new dated file under `docs/` (Markdown, so `.assetsignore` keeps it out of the bundle).

R12. Roll back / redeploy ritual. `wrangler versions list` -> `wrangler rollback <id>` -> rerun smoke (DEPLOY 7); the first forward deploy MUST bump `assets/version.txt` (+ `assets/fonts-version.txt` if a font was involved) even with no asset change; a code rollback does not undo D1 migrations or dashboard Transform Rules; remember `FLOWS_RT_MODE="off"` and `FLOWS_LIVE_MODE="off"` are the one-line kill switches (deploy to apply).

## Learning platform: curricula, payloads, manifests, generators, data

### Purpose and boundaries

Snapshot: commit `ba2acfe` (origin/main after PR 148), `assets/version.txt` = 240, `assets/fonts-version.txt` = 230, working tree clean. Every line number below was taken from the real file at this commit. Where AGENTS.md / README.md / DEPLOY.md disagree with source, source wins and the disagreement is listed under "Invariants and traps".

**What this area is.** The content half of the Econometrics Lab: (1) the authored curricula (plain JS objects that never ship to a browser), (2) one deterministic generator that turns them into committed, minified JSON payloads, answer banks, id/point/skill manifests and a concatenated browser bundle, (3) the small runtime catalogues the browser loads (course, skill, stage-id/points, review catalogue, project catalogue), (4) the Worker/test twins under `shared/` (allowlists and scheduler rules the D1 API validates against), and (5) the synthetic capstone datasets with provenance.

**Headline numbers (verified on disk):** 12 courses, 365 stages, 53 module payloads + 12 manifests + 12 aggregate payloads, 84 skills (7 per course), 106 review-bank items, 252 challenge variants (3 per skill), 15 placement questions, 3 capstone projects, 205 frozen legacy stage ids (the original 7 courses), 4,305 total stage points. Stage types across all courses: read 73, code 61, interactive 50, quiz 67, truefalse 16, numeric 8, multi 6, fillblank 9, codechallenge 25, case 25, match 25 (`conceptlab` is a known type with no content).

**What it is not.** Not the course player or runtime (`assets/js/lab-course.js`, `lab-core.js`, `lab-ui.js`, `lab-review.js`, `challenge.js`, `placement.js`, `project.js`), not client persistence/sync (`storage.js`, `auth.js`, `gamify.js`, `mastery.js`), not the Worker/D1 (`worker.js`, `schema.sql`, `migrations/`), not Flows. Those are neighbours; this area is the data and the rules they validate against.

**Neighbours (who consumes this area):**
- `worker.js` imports six generated/hand shared modules (lines 14-19): course-points, course-seo, review-manifest, stage-manifest, skill-manifest, project-manifest. It does NOT import `shared/mastery.js` or `shared/skill-mastery.js` (tests only); the Worker re-implements both rules as SQL.
- `assets/js/lab-suite.bundle.js` (generator output, not in this scope list) concatenates 8 browser files, four of which are this area's catalogues.
- Lab pages: `lab/index.html`, `lab/course.html`, `lab/review/index.html`, `lab/challenge/index.html`, `lab/placement/index.html`, `lab/projects/<id>/index.html`.
- Static copies that must be kept in step by hand: `lab/index.html` (12 `model-card` links, "365 interactive lessons · 84 skills · 12 courses" at line 257), `sitemap.xml` (17 `<loc>`: `/`, `/lab/`, 12 courses, 3 projects).

Legacy 7 = 205 stages = 161 authored base stages + 44 authored question stages from `curriculum-questions.js` (ols 6, iv2sls 6, did 6, var 6, panel 7, logit 7, gmm 6). The five academy courses are fully generated from templates: 6 stages per module (guide read, lab interactive, worked code, codechallenge, case, match) plus a `-checkpoint` quiz in module index >= 3 (so modules 4 and 5 have 7): 3x6 + 2x7 = 32 each.

Learning paths (`course-catalog.js:93-99`, ids mirrored by hand in `worker.js:98` and `storage.js:250`): complete-core = foundations, ols, mle, logit, did, iv2sls, panel, forecast, var, coint, gmm, financial; causal = foundations, ols, did, iv2sls, panel, gmm; applied-micro = foundations, ols, mle, logit, panel, iv2sls, gmm; time-series = foundations, ols, forecast, var, coint, gmm; markets-risk = foundations, ols, mle, forecast, gmm, financial.

Skill taxonomy (`skill-catalog.js:4-113`, 7 per course, id = `<course>.<slug>`): ols: least-squares-geometry, coefficient-interpretation, matrix-estimator, sampling-uncertainty, t-inference, gauss-markov, robust-standard-errors. iv2sls: endogeneity, instrument-relevance, exclusion-restriction, first-stage, two-stage-least-squares, weak-instrument-diagnostics, overidentification. did: counterfactual-trend, two-by-two-did, did-regression, parallel-trends, event-study, staggered-adoption, did-inference. var: var-stationarity, var-lag-selection, var-estimation, var-stability, impulse-responses, forecast-error-variance, granger-forecasting. panel: panel-structure, pooled-bias, within-estimator, fe-inference, random-effects, hausman, dynamic-panel. logit: lpm-limits, binary-links, binary-mle, odds-ratios, marginal-effects, classification, calibration. gmm: moment-conditions, gmm-identification, gmm-criterion, iv-as-gmm, efficient-weighting, j-test, gmm-variance. foundations: probability-models, expectation-variance, law-large-numbers, central-limit-theorem, estimator-properties, monte-carlo, bootstrap. mle: likelihood, score, information, mle-identification, numerical-optimization, mle-robust-inference, model-comparison. forecast: series-transformations, univariate-stationarity, acf-pacf, arma, arima, forecast-diagnostics, rolling-evaluation. coint: unit-roots, spurious-regression, engle-granger, johansen, vecm, kalman-filter, nowcasting. financial: returns, volatility-clustering, garch, value-at-risk, expected-shortfall, factor-models, risk-backtesting. Each seed row is `[slug, title, practice, diagnostic, risk]`; those three sentences are interpolated into guide/case/match/checkpoint stages and the challenge bank.
