### Data and interfaces

#### Static data fetches (asset layer, no Worker invocation)

All under `/assets/*`, served asset-first with `_headers`: `Cache-Control: public, max-age=3600` for `/assets/data/*`, immutable one year for `/assets/js/*` and `/assets/css/*`, plus the seven security headers. The `?v=<assets/version.txt>` query is the only cache-buster. Excluded from the bundle by `.assetsignore`: `assets/js/curriculum.js`, `curriculum-data.js`, `curriculum-questions.js`, `curriculum-academy.js`, `assets/data/stage-id-map-v2.json`, `shared/`, `scripts/`, `tests/`.

| fetch | by | notes |
|---|---|---|
| `GET /assets/data/courses/<id>/manifest.json?v=` | `lab-course.js:33`; preloaded by Worker (`worker.js:2729`, `rel=preload as=fetch crossorigin=anonymous`) | must be ok else fallback to aggregate; payload must have `schemaVersion` 1 or 2, `id === topicId`, modules with stages arrays (:44-46) |
| `GET /assets/data/courses/<id>/<moduleId>.json?v=` | `lab-course.js:64` (`ensureModule`, 15 s timeout); first module also preloaded (`worker.js:2729-2730`) | requires `schemaVersion === 2`, `courseId`, `module.id`; the head preload must be the request that serves the first module (regression.mjs:921 asserts initiator "link") |
| `GET /assets/data/courses/<id>.json?v=` | `lab-course.js:40` | fallback only; regression:909 asserts it is NOT requested when the manifest is valid |
| `GET /assets/data/review-bank.json?v=` | `lab-review.js:87` | `schemaVersion` must be 2 |
| `GET /assets/data/challenge-bank.json?v=` | `challenge.js:55` | `schemaVersion` must be 1 |
| `GET /assets/data/placement-bank.json?v=` | `placement.js:314` | `schemaVersion` 1, exactly 15 questions |
| `GET /assets/data/projects/provenance.json` | `project.js:9` | no `?v=` |
| `GET /assets/data/projects/<name>-synthetic-v1.csv` | Pyodide `open_url` in project starter code | no `?v=` |

#### Worker routes that read these manifests (full gating in the Worker area)

| route | gate | what this area supplies |
|---|---|---|
| `GET/HEAD /lab/<slug>/` (`worker.js:3904-3913`) | public; non-canonical path gets 308 | `COURSE_BY_SLUG`; renders `/lab/course` asset (`COURSE_ASSET_PATH` :40), caches 60 s in `caches.default` (`COURSE_EDGE_TTL_S` :42) |
| legacy `/lab/course`, `/lab/lesson` (+ `.html`, trailing slash) with `?m=<id>` (:3897-3902) | public | `COURSE_BY_ID[m].path` 308, else `/lab/` |
| `GET /api/v2/bootstrap` (:2867) | signed-out `{user:null}`; signed-in snapshot with `stableProgress`, `skillMastery`, `preferences`, `projects` on top of the legacy bootstrap | stage/skill/review/project manifests |
| `PUT /api/v2/progress` (:2877) | session + same-origin + `X-IEWT-Owner` + `X-IEWT-Generation`; body `{courseId, stageId, complete:true}` | `STAGE_KEY_BY_COURSE`; also unions the legacy index into `progress` using `stage.index` |
| `PUT /api/v2/attempt` (:2915) | same gates; body `{skillId, itemId, attemptId, correct, hinted, day}` | `SKILL_BY_ID`, `validSkillItem`; 400 `invalid_skill_attempt` |
| `PUT /api/v2/preferences` (:2972) | same gates | `PATH_IDS` x `SESSION_MINUTES` {10,20,45}, weekly goal 30..1200 |
| `PUT /api/v2/project` (:2996) | same gates; body `{projectId, mode: guided\|unguided, completedTaskIds}` | `PROJECT_BY_ID[...].taskIds`; 400 `invalid_project` |
| `GET/PUT/DELETE /api/progress` (:3034), `/api/stats` (:3120), `/api/placement` (:3182), `/api/mastery` (:3245), `GET /api/bootstrap` (:3024) | learning session; PUT/DELETE need the owner and generation headers | `COURSE_STAGE_POINTS` for allowlist and exact recomputed points; `REVIEW_ITEM_BY_ID` for `itemId` |

#### D1 tables touched through these manifests (`schema.sql`; first-use fallback `ACADEMY_SCHEMA_SQL`, `worker.js:89-97`, `ensureAcademySchema` :422)

`progress` (schema :9; legacy index list per `model_id`), `progress_v3` (:74; PK user, course, stage; stable ids), `stats` (:17), `learning_sync` (:25; generation fence), `mastery` (:31), `mastery_attempts` (:47), `placement` (:59; band/score CHECK), `skill_mastery` (:85), `skill_attempts` (:107), `learning_preferences` (:120), `project_progress` (:128). Migrations: `0001_baseline.sql`, `0002_learning_v3.sql`, `0003_attempt_ordering.sql` (adds `last_day` to mastery and skill_mastery). academy-contract asserts the academy migration stores no code, output, free text or placement answers and that migrations create exactly the tables in `schema.sql`.

#### Budgets and caps (numbers)

| what | value | where enforced |
|---|---|---|
| gzip per MODULE payload | <= 6,144 B (largest today 4,630: gmm/gmm-overid; next panel-random-effects 4,359, iv2sls-diagnostics 4,320) | generator:242 and contracts:150 |
| gzip per manifest | no cap (largest 1,977) | - |
| gzip per aggregate course JSON | no cap (largest gmm 12,856) | AGENTS.md says 14 KiB; not enforced |
| review-bank / challenge-bank gz | 29,400 / 14,978 | no cap |
| stage id regex | `^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9-]{2,95}$` in generator, `{2,127}` in contracts | generator:40, contracts |
| review item id | `^[a-z0-9_-]+:[a-z0-9-]+$` (generator:263); mastery-contract also requires the stage part to end `-NN` or `-checkpoint` | mastery-contract:27 |
| attempt id | `^[A-Za-z0-9._:-]{1,128}$` | Worker, shared twins, auth.js |
| mastery levels / intervals / counts | level 0..5; days 1, 3, 7, 21, 60; attempts and correct <= 1,000,000 | shared twins and Worker SQL |
| attempt ledger TTL | 48 h | `worker.js:127` |
| JSON bodies | 16 KiB | Worker `readJSON` |
| placement | 15 questions; foundation 0-6, applied 7-11, advanced 12-15 | `worker.js:308`, D1 CHECK, `placement.js` |
| course page edge cache | 60 s | `worker.js:42` |
| asset caches | `/assets/js` immutable 1 y, `/assets/data` 1 h | `_headers` |

There are no env vars, secrets, Durable Objects or KV in this area.

### Flows

**1. Authoring to committed artefacts (the only build step; production never generates).**
1. Edit authoring/catalogue source: `curriculum.js` (OLS), `curriculum-data.js` (6 courses, one JSON line), `curriculum-questions.js` (44 questions), `curriculum-academy.js` (5 template courses), or catalogues `course-catalog.js` / `skill-catalog.js`.
2. `node scripts/generate-course-payloads.mjs` loads them via `vm` (generator:14-24), builds the skill graph (:113-135, writes `skill-graph.json`), normalizes every stage (:156) with ids from the frozen map (:137), enforces gates (:245, :257, :259, :242, :284), then writes:
   `assets/data/courses/<id>/<module>.json`, `assets/data/courses/<id>/manifest.json`, `assets/data/courses/<id>.json`, `assets/data/skill-graph.json`, `assets/data/review-bank.json`, `assets/data/challenge-bank.json`, `assets/js/review-catalog.js`, `assets/js/stage-catalog.js`, `shared/review-manifest.js`, `shared/stage-manifest.js`, `shared/skill-manifest.js`, `shared/course-points.js`, `shared/course-seo.js`, `assets/js/lab-suite.bundle.js`. (`stage-id-map-v2.json` only if absent.)
3. Bump `assets/version.txt` and every `?v=` reference (see recipes), run contracts, commit all of the above together. DEPLOY.md §2 expects a re-run to be a no-op (`test -z "$(git status --short -- assets/data/courses)"`).

**2. A learner opens a course.**
`GET /lab/ordinary-least-squares/` -> `worker.js:3904-3907` (`COURSE_BY_SLUG`) -> `renderCourse` :2702 (cache lookup :2705-2709, fetch `/lab/course` asset :2716, HTMLRewriter: preloads manifest + first module :2729-2730, title/meta/OG/JSON-LD, fallback H1 and outline from `course-seo.js` helpers `courseFallback`/`courseOverview`, `worker.js:2744-2745`, cache put with 60 s TTL :2756) -> `lab/course.html` loads `lab-core.js`, `lab-suite.bundle.js` (TOPIC_META, SKILL_CATALOG, COURSE_STAGE_IDS/POINTS, schedulers, storage, gamify, auth), `lab-fx.js`, `lab-course.js` -> `lab-course.js:8` resolves meta by slug -> fetches `manifest.json` (:33) -> stages array built from manifest entries (:53-55) -> `ensureModule(mi)` (:58-75) lazily fetches the module payload and splices real stages into the same indexes -> stage dispatch `buildWork` (:198-209) renders by type.

**3. Completing a stage.**
`mark(i)` (`lab-course.js:84-106`): sets index `i` in `IEWTStorage.progress` -> points from `COURSE_STAGE_POINTS[topic][i]` (generated) -> `Gamify.award` -> `Auth.pushProgress(topic, [...done])` (legacy index route `PUT /api/progress`) and `Auth.pushStableProgress(topic, stageId)` (`auth.js:865`, `PUT /api/v2/progress` `{courseId, stageId, complete:true}`) -> Worker validates against `STAGE_KEY_BY_COURSE` (:2877-2913), inserts `progress_v3` and unions the same stage's `stage.index` into `progress.done_json` bounded by `COURSE_STAGE_POINTS[course].length`. Points are never accepted from the client: `derivedPointsSelectStatement` (`worker.js:752-763`) runs `json_each` over the bound `JSON.stringify(COURSE_STAGE_POINTS)` joined to `progress.done_json`, so points depend only on the legacy INDEX table, not on `progress_v3`.

**4. Skill attempts from graded stages.**
`recordSkills(st, correct, hinted)` (`lab-course.js:211-214`) calls `Auth.recordSkillAttempt(skillId, st.variantId || st.id, ...)` (`auth.js:636`) -> local `SkillMasteryScheduler.apply` (assets/js/skill-mastery.js:10) + outbox -> `PUT /api/v2/attempt` (`auth.js:664`) -> `worker.js:2915`; `validSkillItem` (:662). See trap 14.

**5. Daily Mastery Review.**
`lab/review/index.html` -> `lab-review.js:83` `loadBank()` fetches `review-bank.json` (:87) -> `window.MasteryScheduler.selectSession(bank, mastery, progress, today, 5)` (`lab-review.js:576`; only items whose stage is completed) -> grading in the browser -> `Auth.recordMasteryAttempt(itemId, ...)` (`auth.js:588`) -> `PUT /api/mastery` (`worker.js:3245-3335`, `itemId` must be in `REVIEW_ITEM_BY_ID`, SQL upsert mirrors `shared/mastery.js`). The Lab home counts due items from `window.REVIEW_ITEMS` (`lab-ui.js:65`) without downloading the bank.

**6. Skill challenge.**
`lab/challenge/index.html` -> `challenge.js:55` fetches `challenge-bank.json` -> `choose()` uses `SKILL_CATALOG` and `SkillMasteryScheduler.selectWeakestSkills` (:14; course mode takes the first 12 skills of the course) -> `Auth.recordSkillAttempt(skillId, "<skillId>:vN")` -> `PUT /api/v2/attempt` (valid via the `:v1..v3` rule).

**7. Placement.**
`lab/placement/index.html` loads `storage.js`, `auth.js`, `placement.js` only (no catalogues) -> `placement.js:314` bank -> 15 answers scored in the browser -> `PUT /api/placement` with the five-field summary `{band, score, total, completedDay, recommendedTopic}` -> `normalizePlacement` (`worker.js:308`). Individual answers never leave the browser.

**8. Capstone project.**
`lab/projects/<id>/index.html` loads `lab-core.js`, `lab-suite.bundle.js`, `project-catalog.js`, `project.js` -> `PROJECT_BY_ID[id]` (catalogue) + `provenance.json` -> Pyodide reads the CSV with `open_url` -> task checkboxes -> `Auth.saveProject` -> `PUT /api/v2/project` -> `PROJECT_BY_ID[...].taskIds` (Worker allowlist).

### Invariants and traps

**Docs versus source (source wins).**
1. AGENTS.md / README.md describe 7 curricula, 205 stages, "TOPIC_META contains exactly ols 20 ... gmm 33", four modules each. Source: 12 courses, 365 stages (`course-catalog.js:4-89`; contracts.mjs:153), five academy courses have 5 modules.
2. AGENTS.md / README.md say payloads carry `schemaVersion: 1`. Source: course aggregates, manifests and modules are `schemaVersion: 2` (generator:219, 239, 247); review-bank is 2; challenge-bank, skill-graph, placement-bank, stage-id-map are 1.
3. AGENTS.md says "caps every course payload at 14 KiB gzip". Source: cap is 6,144 B gzip per MODULE (generator:242, contracts:150); aggregates and manifests are uncapped.
4. AGENTS.md says the browser scoring manifest lives in `course-catalog.js`. Source: it is generated `stage-catalog.js` (`COURSE_STAGE_POINTS`); `course-catalog.js` has no points.
5. AGENTS.md says "deterministic 96-item review artefacts". Source: 106 (96 legacy + 10 academy checkpoint quizzes); mastery-contract.mjs:20 asserts 106.
6. AGENTS.md says the course page "loads only the selected course payload". Source: manifest + lazily each module (`lab-course.js:33-76`); the aggregate is a fallback only.
7. AGENTS.md reward table and stage-schema list omit `conceptlab`, `codechallenge`, `case`, `match`, and the added fields `id, skillIds, estimatedMinutes, difficulty, prerequisiteStageIds, variantId` (generator:156-170).
8. AGENTS.md API contract and file map omit `/api/v2/*`, `skill-catalog`, `skill-mastery`, `stage-catalog` (it appears only in the Commentary list of generated files, AGENTS.md:1064-1068, together with `stage-manifest` and `skill-manifest`), `project-catalog`, `curriculum-academy`, `challenge-bank`, `skill-graph`, `stage-id-map-v2`, projects data, `shared/skill-*`, `shared/project-manifest`, `lab/challenge`, `lab/projects`.
9. AGENTS.md lists `placement-contract` among suites that need workerd; source shows its own `node:http` server and Playwright stubs, no `startWorker` (placement-contract.mjs:4, 115). `regression.mjs` and `worker-regression.mjs` do call `startWorker`.
10. AGENTS.md says contracts prove "exact generated per-course payloads". Source: contracts check counts, ids, points, module outline, schema fields, gz budget, executable-cell imports (136 cells + 3 projects = 139, contracts.mjs:156-177), never that payload bodies equal what the generator would emit from the authored sources.

**Hard rules (break CI or production).**
1. Any change under `assets/js/`, `assets/css/` or `assets/data/` (regenerated payloads, banks, catalogues, `stage-id-map-v2.json`) requires bumping `assets/version.txt` and every `?v=` reference; contracts.mjs:968-976 fails otherwise (diff against `ASSET_DIFF_BASE`, default `origin/main`). `/assets/data/*` is cached 1 h by URL, so without a bump readers see stale payloads. After a bump `grep -rn 'woff2?v=' --include=*.html --include=*.css .` must still show `assets/fonts-version.txt`.
2. `lab-suite.bundle.js` embeds `course-catalog.js`, `skill-catalog.js`, `stage-catalog.js`, `mastery.js`, `skill-mastery.js`, `storage.js`, `gamify.js`, `auth.js` verbatim; contracts asserts each source (trimmed) is a substring. Editing ANY of those eight files without re-running the generator fails contracts. Never edit the bundle, the manifests, `stage-catalog.js`, `review-catalog.js`, `course-points.js`, `course-seo.js` or any `assets/data/courses/**` file by hand.
3. The generator hard-codes totals: 12 courses (:257), 365 stages (:259), 84 skills and 252 challenge variants (:284), 205 frozen stages (:91, :98). Tests hard-code them too: contracts `topicIds` (:36-41), 365 (:153), 84 (:212), 205 (:215), 139 executable cells (:177); mastery-contract 106 (:20); academy-contract 84, 365, 252, 3 projects. A new course or stage touches all of them.
4. `stage-id-map-v2.json` is frozen. Deleting it makes the generator rebuild from current payloads of ALL 12 topics and then throw (365 is not 205); never regenerate it. The legacy 7 courses have NO `id` in their authoring sources, so ids come from the map by (course, module, fingerprint). Renaming a legacy stage title or type, or reordering stages that share a fingerprint (several "Check" quizzes), can hand a frozen id to a different stage (:137-146 falls back to moduleIndex, then first unused) and silently remap `progress_v3`. Give such a stage an explicit `id` equal to its frozen id, and never reuse one.
5. A NEW stage in a legacy course has no frozen id: stableId throws unless you supply an explicit `id` matching `^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9-]{2,95}$`. It also shifts every later flattened index, and legacy progress/points are stored BY INDEX (`progress.done_json`, `COURSE_STAGE_POINTS[course][i]`), so only append at the end of the LAST module (or ship a progress migration). Update `stages` in `course-catalog.js`.
6. The module-level gate throws mid-run: files written before the failure (earlier modules, earlier courses, `skill-graph.json`) stay modified. After a failed run, fix the source and rerun to completion, or `git checkout` the generated paths.
7. Module gz budget 6,144 B: biggest module has about 1.5 KB headroom (gmm-overid 4,630). Split a module (new module id, update `modules` in course-catalog and the `courses` rows/authored `modules`) instead of lifting the limit.
8. Review-bank text is plain text: `plainText` strips tags and decodes only a fixed entity set (unknown named entities stay literal, e.g. `&minus;`). Lesson HTML keeps its markup. Review ids must end `-NN` or `-checkpoint` (mastery-contract:27), so an academy graded stage that is a review type must be named `<base>-checkpoint`.
9. `review-catalog.js` must stay answer-free (academy-contract regex on `answer|answers|accept`); the generator maps only 8 fields (:287). Never add grading keys there.
10. `shared/mastery.js` and `shared/skill-mastery.js` are test twins, not imported by the Worker. The live rules are SQL in `worker.js` (review: :3282-3301; skill: :2936-2949) and JS in `assets/js/mastery.js` / `skill-mastery.js`. Changing a rule means editing all three places; only the interval table and a few vectors are tested (mastery-contract, academy-contract). The review and skill rules differ (wrong answer: level 0 versus level-1; hinted-correct: `min(level,1)` versus unchanged).
11. Hand-mirrored lists with NO parity test: project ids and task ids in `assets/js/project-catalog.js` / `shared/project-manifest.js` / `assets/js/lab-ui.js:7-11` (a third copy, the `PROJECTS` array with a `tasks` id list per project, rendered at `lab-ui.js:226` and `:231`) plus the ids alone in `assets/js/storage.js:238` (`PROJECT_IDS`); learning path ids in `course-catalog.js:94-98` / `worker.js:98` / `storage.js:250`; placement topics (7 legacy ids only; the five academy courses cannot be a recommended placement topic) in `worker.js:306`, `assets/js/auth.js:217`, `assets/js/storage.js:261`, `placement.js:8` (`TOPIC_ORDER`, also the `APPLIED_ROUTES`/`ADVANCED_ROUTES` tables at :27-45 and `recommendedTopicFor` :155-160) and the D1 CHECK on `recommended_topic` (`schema.sql:65`, `migrations/0001_baseline.sql:63`). Only `placement-bank.json` topics versus `TOPIC_ORDER` is tested (placement-contract.mjs:36). A mismatch fails only at runtime (400 `invalid_project`, `invalid_preferences`, silently dropped placement, or a D1 CHECK failure).
12. Course slugs must not collide with other `/lab/<x>/` pages (`review`, `placement`, `challenge`, `projects`, `course`, `lesson`): `worker.js:3904` serves any matching slug itself.
13. Lab index and SEO statics: contracts requires `lab/index.html` `model-card` links to equal `COURSE_TOPICS` paths in order, the Lab JSON-LD to contain each canonical URL, `sitemap.xml` to list exactly `/`, `/lab/`, the 12 courses, 3 projects, no `priority/changefreq`. New course = edit those statics and the summary strings (`lab/index.html:257, 281`). OG images: only the legacy 7 have `og-<id>.png` (generator:307); the others use `/assets/img/og.png`.
14. SUSPECTED LATENT MISMATCH (read from source, not run): `lab-course.js:211-214` sends skill attempts with `itemId = st.variantId || st.id` (for example `ols-line-04-core`), but `validSkillItem` (`worker.js:662-668`) accepts only `<skillId>:v1..v3`, `<course>:<stage>` review ids or `<course>:<stage>` stage keys. Such an id matches none, so the Worker would answer 400 `invalid_skill_attempt`, and `auth.js:253-256` `isPoison` drops it from the outbox: course-stage skill mastery would stay local, only challenge-bank attempts would persist server-side. Verify against `skill_attempts`/`skill_mastery` rows before relying on it.
15. Python cells are scanned: every `code`, `interactive` (params substituted) and `codechallenge` (starter + tests) cell, plus the 3 project cells, must import only packages `Lab.packagesFor` maps (`lab-core.js`), with NumPy first and the exact package set (contracts.mjs:156-210, count 139 at :177). A new import (for example `sklearn`) fails contracts until the lazy loader supports it.
16. Interactive stages: each `params[].name` must match `^\w+$`, `min < max`, `step > 0`, `value` within bounds, and `{{name}}` must appear in `template`. `fillblank` prompts need exactly one `___`. `codechallenge` needs `starter`, `tests` containing `assert`, and >= 2 `hints`; `case` >= 2 steps; `match` >= 3 pairs (contracts.mjs:76-122).
17. Academy courses share templates: all five foundations modules reuse the `sampling` code and challenge templates, mle uses `likelihood`, forecast and the first two coint modules use `ar`, the other coint modules `kalman`, financial `frontier`/`garch`. Editing a template changes many stages; the 25 concept labs are unique per module.
18. Skill seeds feed generated text: editing a `practice/diagnostic/risk` string in `skill-catalog.js` rewrites guide, case, match and checkpoint stages plus the challenge bank (all regenerated).
19. Authoring load order: generator runs questions before academy; contracts runs academy before questions. Both are fine today because they touch disjoint courses; a questions entry for an academy course would be order-dependent.
20. `curriculum-data.js` is a single 159 KB line. Edit it with a script (parse the JSON inside `Object.assign(window.CURRICULUM, ...)`, mutate, stringify, keep the wrapper); never reflow it by hand.
21. Source files carry no comments (AGENTS.md rule); put reasoning in the commit message. `scripts/strip-comments.mjs` is a no-op.
22. `scripts/generate-project-data.mjs` has no test, doc or CI hook. Rerunning it rewrites the CSVs and provenance from seed 20260715 (deterministic, but `generatedAt` is a literal string); do it only when the datasets intentionally change, and then also bump the asset version (it is under `assets/data/`).

### How to change it

Always finish with: bump version (recipe 13), `cd tests && node contracts.mjs && node mastery-contract.mjs && node academy-contract.mjs` (no server, no node_modules needed for these three), then the heavier suites that touch the area: `node placement-contract.mjs` (Chromium, own http server), `FLOWS_TEST_SANDBOX=1 node worker-regression.mjs`, `FLOWS_TEST_SANDBOX=1 node regression.mjs` (both start workerd). `npm test` order puts contracts first (index 0), then mastery (11), academy (12), placement (13), worker (14), browser (30); the run stops at the first failure.

1. **Fix wording, code or a question in a legacy course (ols, iv2sls, did, var, panel, logit, gmm).** OLS base stages: `assets/js/curriculum.js` (template literals). The other six: `assets/js/curriculum-data.js` via a script edit. Authored questions: `assets/js/curriculum-questions.js` (`ITEMS[course]`). Keep stage order, count and types unchanged. Run `node scripts/generate-course-payloads.mjs`, check `git status` shows only that course's module/aggregate/manifest, `review-bank.json` (+ `review-catalog.js`/`review-manifest.js` if a question changed), possibly `stage-catalog.js`/`lab-suite.bundle.js`; bump version.
2. **Change a stage in an academy course (foundations, mle, forecast, coint, financial).** Prose and decision text derive from `skill-catalog.js` seeds and the `courses` row (`curriculum-academy.js:629-680`: title, summary, lesson); code from `codeTemplates` (:8) and `challengeTemplates` (:64); the interactive from `conceptLabs["<course>-<module>-lab"]` (:140). Regenerate and bump.
3. **Add a question stage to a legacy course.** Add an object to `curriculum-questions.js` `ITEMS[course]` with `moduleIndex` = the LAST module (so indexes of existing stages do not move), an explicit `id` (`^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9-]{2,95}$`, unique per course; suffix `-NN` for review-id compatibility), and `points` if non-default. Then: `course-catalog.js` `stages` +1 for that course; regenerate; update the hard-coded totals in generator (:259 365, :91/:98 stay 205 because the frozen map is not extended), contracts (:153), academy-contract (365), mastery-contract (106 if a review type), `lab/index.html:257`. Existing signed-in progress is index-based, so an end-of-last-module append is the only safe insertion.
4. **Add a stage to an academy module.** `moduleFor` (`curriculum-academy.js:686`) emits a fixed 6/7-stage shape; extend it there (new `stageMeta` with a unique `<base>-<suffix>` id, `skillIds`, difficulty), update `stages`/`modules` in `course-catalog.js` (each academy module count feeds `meta.stages`), regenerate, then the same total/count updates as recipe 3. Academy ids are explicit, so no frozen-map step is needed.
5. **Add a whole new course.**
   (a) `course-catalog.js`: add a `topics` entry (id, slug, `num`, title, level, `stages`, `modules`, blurb, tags, prerequisites, outcomes) and place it in the `LEARNING_PATHS` lists you want (:94-98).
   (b) `skill-catalog.js`: add 7 seed rows under `seeds[<id>]`.
   (c) Authoring: new `courses` entry plus `conceptLabs` per module in `curriculum-academy.js`, or a new key in `curriculum-data.js` with explicit stage ids (no frozen ids exist for it, so every stage needs `id`).
   (d) Generator constants: :257 (courses), :259 (stages), :284 (skills 7n, challenge variants 21n); `imageById` (:307) only if it gets its own `og-<id>.png`.
   (e) Tests: contracts `topicIds` (:36-41), 365 (:153), skills 84 (:212), executable cell count (:177); academy-contract (84, 365, 252, log line); mastery-contract 106; regression/worker-regression only if they enumerate courses.
   (f) Statics: `lab/index.html` model-card (order = `COURSE_TOPICS` order) and summary strings (:257, :281), Lab JSON-LD, `sitemap.xml`; AGENTS.md/README.md.
   (g) Only legacy topics can be placement recommendations (`worker.js:306`, `auth.js:217`, `storage.js:261`, `placement.js` `TOPIC_ORDER`/route tables, and the D1 CHECK at `schema.sql:65`); leave alone unless the diagnostic is redesigned.
   Then regenerate (the Worker picks up `course-seo.js`, `stage-manifest.js`, `review-manifest.js`, `skill-manifest.js`, `course-points.js` automatically on deploy), bump version, run the full suite.
6. **Change rewards.** Defaults in generator `DEFAULT_POINTS` (:29); per-stage override via authored `points`. Regenerate: `stage-catalog.js`, `course-points.js`, `stage-manifest.js`, manifests. Contracts compares the authored/default vector with both manifests, so the test's own `defaults` table (contracts.mjs:45) must change too, and `lab-course.js:78-81` `DEFAULT_POINTS` (fallback only). Totals for existing learners change retroactively (server recomputes from the manifest).
7. **Change skills (add/rename/remove).** Edit `skill-catalog.js` seeds, adjust any authored `skillIds` and `defaultSkillIds` impact, change gates (:284), regenerate (`skill-graph.json`, `challenge-bank.json`, `skill-manifest.js`, stage manifests), academy-contract numbers. Renaming a skill id orphans stored `skill_mastery` rows; there is no migration.
8. **Change learning paths.** `course-catalog.js:93-99`; if a path id changes, also `worker.js:98` `PATH_IDS`, `storage.js:250`, and `lab-ui.js` consumers. No test links these.
9. **Placement diagnostic.** Edit `assets/data/placement-bank.json` by hand (it is authored): keep 15 questions, 3 per type (choice, boolean, multi, numeric, fill), 5 per band, topics within the 7 legacy ids, prompt <= 220 chars, explanation >= 60 chars (placement-contract.mjs:38-39), required answer fields per type (contracts.mjs:240-266). Band thresholds (<= 6, <= 11) live in `placement.js:136-143` (`bandForScore`), `worker.js:308-318` (line 314), `storage.js:269`, `auth.js:224` and the D1 CHECK (`schema.sql:59-72`, `migrations/0001_baseline.sql`); change all five together. Bump version.
10. **Capstone projects.** Add/rename: `assets/js/project-catalog.js`, `shared/project-manifest.js`, `assets/js/storage.js:238` `PROJECT_IDS`, `assets/js/lab-ui.js:7-11` `PROJECTS` (title, blurb and task-id list shown on the Lab home), a `lab/projects/<id>/index.html` (copy an existing one; carries `data-asset-version`), `sitemap.xml` (contracts lists exactly three project URLs), the executable-cell count in contracts (136 stages + N projects), and for data `scripts/generate-project-data.mjs` (new dataset entry; it writes CSV + provenance; academy-contract verifies sha256 and row counts and that every provenance id exists in the Worker allowlist). Bump version.
11. **Mastery rules or intervals.** Review items: `shared/mastery.js`, `assets/js/mastery.js`, `worker.js:3282-3301` SQL (`CASE` ladder 1, 3, 7, 21, 60 and the level rule). Skills: `shared/skill-mastery.js`, `assets/js/skill-mastery.js`, `worker.js:2936-2949`. Run mastery-contract (parity via vm) and academy-contract; `FLOWS_TEST_SANDBOX=1 node worker-regression.mjs` exercises the SQL (lines 663-800 there). Both browser files are inside `lab-suite.bundle.js`: regenerate and bump.
12. **Course SEO text or metadata.** Title, slug, `num`, blurb, level: `course-catalog.js` (a changed `title` must ALSO be changed in the authored course `title`: `curriculum.js:4`, the matching key in `curriculum-data.js`, or the `courses[]` entry in `curriculum-academy.js`, because contracts.mjs:56 asserts authored `course.title === seo.name === meta.title`; module titles and summaries come only from the authored sources, not the catalogue) -> regenerate (`course-seo.js`, which the Worker uses for title, description, OG, JSON-LD, outline) -> keep `lab/index.html` card text/links in sync (contracts compares slug, number, title, blurb, level and module title/summary against authored curricula, :52-64). Changing a slug also changes canonical URLs, sitemap and every internal link; legacy `?m=<id>` redirects resolve via `COURSE_BY_ID`.
13. **Asset version ritual.** Increment the integer in `assets/version.txt`; set every local CSS/JS `?v=` in HTML, each lab page's `data-asset-version` (lab/course.html, review, placement, challenge, three project pages), and `ASSET_VERSION` in `shared/flows-pages.js:1` to the same integer; leave `assets/fonts-version.txt` alone and re-check with `grep -rn 'woff2?v=' --include=*.html --include=*.css .` (16 font references must show the fonts token); run contracts. A regeneration that changes nothing needs no bump, which is why DEPLOY.md §2 insists on a clean `git status` after `node scripts/generate-course-payloads.mjs`.
14. **Module too big (gz > 6,144).** Split the module in the authoring source (new module id, adjust `modules` in `course-catalog.js`, the SEO outline updates automatically), regenerate; module ids change the URLs under `assets/data/courses/<id>/` and the Worker preload of the first module (`worker.js:2730` uses `meta.modules[0].id`).

## Learning platform: pages, runtime JS, auth/storage/sync, css

Snapshot: commit ba2acfe (origin/main after PR 148), `assets/version.txt` = 240, `assets/fonts-version.txt` = 230. Every line number below was taken with grep -n / sed -n / Read on that tree. "Source wins" notes where AGENTS.md disagrees are collected at the end of "Data and interfaces".

### Purpose and boundaries

**What this area is.** The browser half of the Econometrics Lab, which the UI now brands "Quant Econometrics Academy" (lab/index.html:256 kicker, challenge page title). It is framework-free, IIFE-based vanilla JS plus three stylesheets, served as static files by the Cloudflare asset layer, with the Worker rewriting only `/lab/<course-slug>/`. It owns:

- 9 HTML surfaces: the academy dashboard `/lab/`, the course player shell `/lab/course.html` (served at 12 canonical `/lab/<slug>/` URLs), the placement diagnostic, the Daily Mastery Review, the Mastery Challenge, 3 capstone project pages, and one dead legacy redirect page (`lesson.html`).
- The Pyodide/statsmodels runtime (`lab-core.js`) and the in-browser Python editor.
- Owner-scoped localStorage persistence (`storage.js`, the only file allowed to say `localStorage`).
- The account/sync client (`auth.js`): bootstrap hydration, serialized owner-fenced synchronization, idempotent attempt outboxes, server-first reset.
- Points/streak (`gamify.js`), the two spaced-repetition schedulers (`mastery.js` for review items, `skill-mastery.js` for skills), the placement/review/challenge/project page controllers, the dashboard (`lab-ui.js`), motion (`lab-fx.js`).
- `shared/session.js` (HMAC session cookie, also used by Flows) and `shared/lab-sign-in.js` (Lab session lifetime, `users` upsert, `labActiveAt`).
- `lab-suite.bundle.js`, a generated byte-for-byte concatenation of 8 source files (course-catalog, skill-catalog, stage-catalog, mastery, skill-mastery, storage, gamify, auth) that most Lab pages load instead of the individual files.

**What it is not.**
- Not the Worker routing/API implementation (worker.js:2702 renderCourse, 2762 route, 2766-3335 auth + learning API; other part file). This file records only the wire contract the client depends on.
- Not the curriculum authoring sources (`assets/js/curriculum*.js`, excluded from the static bundle by `.assetsignore`), nor `scripts/generate-course-payloads.mjs` (writes the bundle and every payload; line refs below), nor the payload JSON (`assets/data/**`).
- Not Flows. There is no code coupling: none of `assets/js/flows-*.js`, `nav.js`, `market-*.js`, `particles.js`, `year.js`, `index.html`, `404.html`, `articles/` references `Auth`, `IEWTStorage`, `Gamify` or any Lab global (grep verified empty). The only runtime links to Flows are `shared/session.js` (shared cookie/HMAC helpers, `flows_session` cookie) and `shared/lab-sign-in.js` `readLabActiveAt` (consumed by the Flows nightly health gate).

**Neighbours (cross-area edges).**
- worker.js: serves `/auth/*`, `/api/me|bootstrap|v2/*|progress|stats|mastery|placement`, rewrites course HTML (`renderCourse` 2702, route 3904), finalizer (3918) sets HTML CSP + `no-cache`.
- `shared/review-manifest.js` (`REVIEW_ITEM_BY_ID`, `REVIEW_ITEMS`, `REVIEW_ITEM_IDS`, `hasReviewItem`; 33,991 bytes), `shared/stage-manifest.js` (`COURSE_STAGE_BY_ID` keyed `<course>:<stageId>`, `COURSE_STAGE_IDS`, `stageKey`; 114,642 bytes), `shared/skill-manifest.js` (`SKILL_BY_ID`, `SKILL_IDS`; 8,805 bytes), all imported by worker.js:16-18 and generated by `generate-course-payloads.mjs` :296/:299/:302; `shared/course-points.js` (`COURSE_STAGE_POINTS`, `pointsForProgress`), `shared/course-seo.js` (`SITE_ORIGIN`, `COURSE_TOPICS`, `COURSE_BY_ID`, `COURSE_BY_SLUG`; generated :305/:312) (generated, server allowlists), `shared/mastery.js`, `shared/skill-mastery.js` (server-compatible scheduler contracts used by tests), `shared/project-manifest.js` (hand-written Worker project allowlist), `shared/flows-auth.js` (`LEARN_AUDIENCE`, `isLearnAudience`).
- D1: `schema.sql`, `migrations/0001_baseline.sql`, `0002_learning_v3.sql`, `0003_attempt_ordering.sql`, `0013_users_signed_in_at.sql`.
- Assets: `assets/data/**` (course payloads, banks, projects), `assets/js/curriculum*.js` and `course-catalog.js` / `skill-catalog.js` / `project-catalog.js` (hand-authored catalogs consumed by generator and tests), `assets/css/base.css` (tokens, `.btn`, `.toast`, `.visually-hidden`), `assets/js/nav.js`.
- CI: `.github/workflows/regression.yml` runs `wrangler deploy --dry-run` then `npm test` (Node 22, Chromium, `ASSET_DIFF_BASE` set for the version-bump check; the schedule `17 6 * * 1` reruns it weekly).
- Flows health gate: `shared/flows-live-worker.js:845` `serveIngestClock` -> `scripts/flows-legs/health.mjs:336` `labCheck` (worker.js:3511 passes `lab: tokenKind === "nightly"`) (warn 120 d, fail 150 d, Google-gone 180 d since the last Lab Google sign-in).

---

### Data and interfaces

#### 1. Page to asset load map

| page | scripts (all `defer`, `?v=240`) | css | data fetched at runtime |
|---|---|---|---|
| /lab/ | nav, lab-suite.bundle, review-catalog, lab-ui | base, lab | none (plus Auth bootstrap) |
| /lab/<slug>/ | nav, lab-core, lab-suite.bundle, lab-fx, lab-course | base, lab | `/assets/data/courses/<id>/manifest.json?v=`, `/assets/data/courses/<id>/<moduleId>.json?v=` (first module preloaded by Worker `<link rel=preload as=fetch>`), fallback `<id>.json`; jsDelivr Pyodide on first run |
| /lab/placement/ | nav, **storage, auth**, placement | base, placement | `/assets/data/placement-bank.json?v=` (prefetched at init when no saved result) |
| /lab/review/ | nav, lab-suite.bundle, lab-review | base, review | `/assets/data/review-bank.json?v=` (106 items, schemaVersion 2, includes answers) |
| /lab/challenge/ | nav, lab-suite.bundle, challenge | base, review | `/assets/data/challenge-bank.json?v=` (252 items = 84 skills x 3, schemaVersion 1, includes answers) |
| /lab/projects/<id>/ | nav, lab-core, lab-suite.bundle, project-catalog, project | base, lab | `/assets/data/projects/provenance.json`; CSV `/assets/data/projects/{macro,fx,factors}-synthetic-v1.csv` fetched by Python `open_url` and by the download link |
| /lab/lesson.html | lesson-redirect | none | none |

Payload shapes (verified by reading the committed files): aggregate `<id>.json` = `{id,title,schemaVersion:2,modules[]}`; `<id>/manifest.json` = `{schemaVersion:2,id,title,totalStages,modules:[{id,title,summary,stageCount,stages:[{id,index,moduleId,moduleIndex,type,title,skillIds,estimatedMinutes,difficulty,points}]}]}`; `<id>/<moduleId>.json` = `{schemaVersion:2,courseId,module:{id,title,summary,stages:[full stage]}}`. Committed: 12 courses, 4-5 modules each (the 7 legacy courses 4, the 5 newer ones 5; 12 manifests, 365 stages total) (read 73, code 61, interactive 50, codechallenge 25, case 25, match 25, quiz 67, fillblank 9, truefalse 16, numeric 8, multi 6; the `conceptlab` type is supported by the player but has 0 stages). Graded stages carry `variantId = <stageId>-core`.

#### 2. localStorage keys (all access through `IEWTStorage`; owner encoded with `encodeURIComponent`, e.g. `user%3Ag_123`)

| key | envelope | content | cleared by `resetLearning` |
|---|---|---|---|
| `iewt:progress`, `iewt:gamify` | raw JSON, anonymous only | legacy mirrors of the anonymous v2 values (written by `writeScoped`, removed on claim) | yes (anonymous) |
| `iewt:progress:v2:<owner>` | `{version:2,owner,value}` | `{ [courseId]: { done: [stageIndex...] } }` | yes |
| `iewt:gamify:v2:<owner>` | v2 | `{points,streak,last}` | yes |
| `iewt:mastery:v2:<owner>` | v2 | `{ [itemId "course:stageId"]: record }` | yes |
| `iewt:mastery-outbox:v2:<owner>` | v2 | `[ {attemptId,itemId,correct,hinted,day} ]` (<= 500) | yes |
| `iewt:placement:v2:<owner>` | v2 | `{band,score,total,completedDay,recommendedTopic}` or null | yes |
| `iewt:sync:v2:<owner>` | `{version:2,owner,generation}` | reset generation | rewritten with the new generation |
| `iewt:progress:v3:<owner>` | `{version:3,...}` | stable progress `{ [courseId]: { done: [stageId...] } }` | yes |
| `iewt:skill-mastery:v3:<owner>` | v3 | `{ [skillId]: record }` | yes |
| `iewt:skill-outbox:v3:<owner>` | v3 | `[ {attemptId,skillId,itemId,correct,hinted,day} ]` | yes |
| `iewt:projects:v3:<owner>` | v3 | `{ [projectId]: {mode,done[]} }` | yes |
| `iewt:preferences:v3:<owner>` | v3 | `{activePathId,sessionMinutes,weeklyGoalMinutes}` | **no** (preserved) |
| `iewt:activeOwner` | raw string | `anonymous` or `user:<id>`; only written with `announce:true` | no |
| `iewt:guideW` / `iewt:splitW` | raw string | guide column % (25-72); `splitW` is the legacy key, migrated and removed on read | no |

Mastery/skill record: `{level 0-5, dueDay 'YYYY-MM-DD', attempts, correct, lastResult bool|null, lastAttemptId, updatedAt}`.

#### 4. Window globals defined by this area

`TOPIC_META`, `TOPIC_BY_ID`, `LEARNING_PATHS`, `COURSE_SKILLS`, `SKILL_CATALOG`, `SKILL_BY_ID`, `COURSE_STAGE_IDS`, `COURSE_STAGE_POINTS` (bundle 1-3); `MasteryScheduler`, `SkillMasteryScheduler`, `IEWTStorage`, `Gamify`, `Auth`, `toast` (bundle 4-8); `Lab` (lab-core), `FX` (lab-fx), `REVIEW_ITEMS` (review-catalog), `PROJECT_CATALOG`, `PROJECT_BY_ID` (project-catalog). `globalThis.__IEWTPlacementTest` only when `document` is undefined. AGENTS.md's global allowlist omits `SkillMasteryScheduler`, `SKILL_CATALOG`, `SKILL_BY_ID`, `COURSE_SKILLS`, `COURSE_STAGE_IDS`, `PROJECT_CATALOG`, `PROJECT_BY_ID`; no test enforces the allowlist.

#### 5. Worker endpoints called by each client module (all same-origin)

| endpoint | method | called from | gates and headers | worker.js |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `/auth/google` | GET (navigation) | `Auth.signIn` | none; sets `oauth_state` cookie (600 s) then redirects to Google | 2766 |
| `/auth/callback` | GET (redirect from Google) | browser | state cookie must equal `state`; token exchange; `recordSignIn`; sets `session` cookie (30 d, HttpOnly, Secure, SameSite=Lax); 302 to `/lab/?auth=ok` or `/lab/?auth=error` | 2784 |
| `/auth/logout` | POST | `Auth.signOut` | same-origin; if a valid session exists `X-IEWT-Owner` must equal user id; clears cookie; JSON `{ok:true}` | 2836 |
| `/api/me` | GET | `initialPayload` third fallback | optional session; `{user: {...}}` or `{user: null}` | 2852 |
| `/api/v2/bootstrap` | GET | `initialPayload` (first try, no owner header) | optional session; signed-out `{user:null}` | 2867 |
| `/api/bootstrap` | GET | fallback on 404/405 | same | 3024 |
| `/api/progress` | GET / PUT / DELETE | GET only via legacy path (`pullAll` normally uses bootstrap payload); PUT `pushProgress` and `pullAll`; DELETE `resetProgress` | session; PUT/DELETE: same-origin + `X-IEWT-Owner`; PUT needs `X-IEWT-Generation`; DELETE does not | 3034 |
| `/api/stats` | GET / PUT | `pullAll`, `pushStats` | PUT: owner + generation | 3120 |
| `/api/mastery` | GET / PUT | `pullAll`, `flushMasteryOutbox`, `recordMasteryAttempt` | PUT: owner + generation; `itemId` must be in `REVIEW_ITEM_BY_ID` | 3245 |
| `/api/placement` | GET / PUT / DELETE | `pullAll`, `savePlacement`, `clearPlacement` | PUT/DELETE: owner + generation | 3182 |
| `/api/v2/progress` | PUT | `pushStableProgress`, `pullAcademyState` | owner + generation; body `{courseId,stageId,complete:true}` validated against `STAGE_KEY_BY_COURSE`; GET => 405 | 2877 |
| `/api/v2/attempt` | PUT | `recordSkillAttempt`, `flushSkillOutbox` | owner + generation; body `{skillId,itemId,attemptId,correct,hinted,day}`; `validSkillItem` (worker.js:662) | 2915 |
| `/api/v2/preferences` | PUT | `savePreferences`, `pullAcademyState` | owner + generation | 2972 |
| `/api/v2/project` | PUT | `saveProject`, `pullAcademyState` | owner + generation; body `{projectId,mode,completedTaskIds}` | 2996 |
| `/assets/data/**` | GET | lab-course, lab-review, placement, challenge, project | asset layer, `Cache-Control: public, max-age=3600` (`_headers`) | none |

Client call matrix by module: auth.js => every `/api/*` and `/auth/*` row; lab-course.js => `Auth.pushProgress`, `pushStableProgress`, `recordMasteryAttempt`, `recordSkillAttempt` and (via Gamify) `pushStats`; lab-review.js => `recordMasteryAttempt`; challenge.js => `recordSkillAttempt`; placement.js => `savePlacement`, `clearPlacement`; project.js => `saveProject`; lab-ui.js => `savePreferences`, `resetProgress`, `signIn`, `signOut`; gamify.js => `pushStats`.

Common server rules (worker.js): JSON bodies `Content-Type: application/json` required (415), 16 KiB cap (`MAX_JSON_BYTES`, line 47), `requireSameOrigin` 183 (Origin and `Sec-Fetch-Site: same-origin`), `requireMutationOwner` 202 (409 `account_changed`), `requireReadOwnerIfPresent` 208, missing/stale `X-IEWT-Generation` => 409 `reset_required` with current generation in body and `X-IEWT-Generation` response header (`mutationGeneration` 723, `throwResetRequired` 344). `finalize` (3918): all `/api/*` and `/auth/*` `Cache-Control: no-store`; HTML gets CSP + `no-cache`.

#### 6. Wire formats

- Bootstrap v2 (signed in): `{user:{id,email,name}, progress, stats:{points,streak,last}, mastery, placement|null, generation, stableProgress, skillMastery, preferences, projects}` (worker.js:886-902). v1 bootstrap = just the first six keys, `{user, progress, stats, mastery, placement, generation}` (`assembleLegacySnapshot` 861-880, `runBootstrapBatch` 829, `loadBootstrapSnapshot` 882; route `/api/bootstrap` 3024); v2 adds `bootstrapAcademyStatements` (820-827) to the same batch. `stableProgress` is the union of `progress_v3` rows and the legacy index progress projected to stage ids; `skillMastery` merges `skill_mastery` rows with item mastery projected through `REVIEW_ITEM_BY_ID[...].skillIds`.
- PUT /api/progress `{model, done:[indexes]}` => `{ok,done,generation}`. PUT /api/stats `{streak,last}` => `{ok,stats,generation}`. PUT /api/mastery `{itemId,attemptId,correct,hinted,day}` => `{ok,record,duplicate,generation}`; same attempt id with different data => 409 `attempt_conflict`. PUT /api/v2/attempt => `{ok,record,duplicate,generation}`. PUT /api/placement (5 fields) => `{ok,placement,generation}`. PUT /api/v2/progress => `{ok,courseId,done:[stageIds],generation}`. PUT /api/v2/preferences => `{ok,preferences,generation}`. PUT /api/v2/project => `{ok,project,generation}`.
- DELETE /api/progress => `{ok,progress:{},stats:{points:0,streak:0,last:null},mastery:{},stableProgress:{},skillMastery:{},projects:{},placement:null,generation}` (generation incremented in one D1 batch; deletes progress, mastery, mastery_attempts, placement, progress_v3, skill_mastery, skill_attempts, project_progress; resets stats; **keeps learning_preferences**).
- Errors: `{error:{code,message}}` with codes seen by the client: `unauthorized`, `account_changed`, `reset_required` (+`generation`), `forbidden`, `invalid_*`, `attempt_conflict`, `payload_too_large`, `unsupported_media_type`, `method_not_allowed`.
- Session token: `base64url(JSON{sub:"g_<googleSub>",email,name,aud:"learn",exp}) + "." + base64url(HMAC-SHA256(body))`, <= 4096 chars; `verifySession` requires string `sub` and `Date.now() < exp`; `isLearnAudience` (flows-auth.js:179) accepts a missing `aud` (legacy) or `"learn"`, so `flows` audience tokens never authenticate the Lab.

#### 7. D1 tables touched by the Lab

`users` (id, email, name, created_at, signed_in_at), `progress` (user_id, model_id, done_json, updated_at), `stats` (points, streak, last, updated_at), `learning_sync` (user_id PK, generation 0..2^53-1), `mastery` + `mastery_attempts`, `placement` (CHECKs: band/score bands, total = 15, recommended_topic in 7 legacy ids), `progress_v3` (user_id, course_id, stage_id, completed_at, source web|migration), `skill_mastery` (+ `last_day`), `skill_attempts`, `learning_preferences` (session_minutes in {10,20,45}, weekly 30-1200), `project_progress`. Declared in `schema.sql` and migrations 0001/0002/0003/0013; the Worker also creates missing tables on first use (`LEARNING_SYNC_SCHEMA_SQL` worker.js:50, mastery 56-75, `PLACEMENT_SCHEMA_SQL` 76-88, `ACADEMY_SCHEMA_SQL` 89, retry wrappers `learningBatch` 354 / `masteryBatch` 395 / `placementBatch` 411 / `academyBatch` 426). Attempt ledgers are pruned per write after `ATTEMPT_LEDGER_TTL_MS = 48 h` (worker.js:127). Points are never stored client-trusted: `stats.points` is recomputed from `progress` by `derivedPointsSelectStatement` (752). `academy-contract.mjs` requires migrations to create exactly the tables in `schema.sql`.

#### 8. Caches, env, secrets, cookies

- Worker course HTML edge cache: Cache API key `origin + meta.path`, `max-age=60` (`COURSE_EDGE_TTL_S`, worker.js:42; written in `renderCourse` 2752-2757). Browser: HTML `no-cache`, `/assets/{css,js,fonts}/*` immutable 1 y, `/assets/data/*` 1 h (`_headers`).
- Secrets/bindings used: `SESSION_SECRET` (HMAC), `GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID`, `GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET`, `DB` (D1 `iewt`), `ASSETS`. Cookies: `session` (Lab, 30 d = `LAB_SESSION_MS`), `oauth_state` (10 min). Missing secrets => 503 `service_unavailable`; the client treats any bootstrap failure as `offline` and keeps working locally.
- Test env: `FLOWS_TEST_SANDBOX=1` for server suites; `ASSET_DIFF_BASE` for the bump check; `PLAYWRIGHT_BROWSERS_PATH` for browser suites.

#### 9. Caps and budgets (actual numbers)

Course module payload <= 6,144 bytes gzip each (contracts.mjs:150); 365 stages (:153); 84 skills (:212); 139 executable cells (136 stages + 3 projects, :177); legacy stage freeze 205 (`stage-id-map-v2.json`); review bank 106 items; challenge bank 252; placement 15 (5 types x 3, 3 difficulties x 5); review session <= 5; challenge 6 (or 12 in course mode); intervals 1/3/7/21/60 d; levels 0-5; counts <= 1,000,000; streak <= 100,000; outbox <= 500 events; mastery map <= 1000 entries in storage; JSON body <= 16 KiB; session 30 d; module fetch timeout 15 s; module prefetch delay 1 s; guide width 25-72 % (default 38); FX particles <= 700; edge HTML TTL 60 s; attempt ledger 48 h; Lab sign-in health: warn 120 d, fail 150 d, gone 180 d.

#### 10. AGENTS.md / DEPLOY.md versus source (source wins)

1. AGENTS.md says `TOPIC_META` has exactly 7 courses (ols 20 ... gmm 33). Source has 12 (`foundations` 32, `mle` 32, `forecast` 32, `coint` 32, `financial` 32 added, 5 modules each); total 365; `lab/index.html` text says "365 interactive lessons, 84 skills, 12 courses".
2. AGENTS.md says course payloads are `assets/data/courses/<topic>.json`, `schemaVersion: 1`, capped at 14 KiB gzip. Source: per-course directory with `manifest.json` + one JSON per module (schemaVersion 2, <= 6 KiB gzip each) plus the aggregate `<id>.json` (schemaVersion 2) kept as client fallback.
3. AGENTS.md says "96-item" review bank; source has 106 (mastery-contract.mjs:20).
4. AGENTS.md API contract lacks `/api/v2/bootstrap`, `/api/v2/progress|attempt|preferences|project`, the `progress_v3`/`skill_*`/`learning_preferences`/`project_progress` tables, and the extended DELETE response.
5. AGENTS.md persistence list lacks the v3 envelopes (stable progress, skill mastery/outbox, preferences, projects) and says reset preserves only `iewt:guideW`; source also preserves preferences.
6. AGENTS.md file map omits lab/challenge, lab/projects/*, challenge.js, project.js, skill-mastery.js, lesson-redirect.js, lab-suite.bundle.js (it only mentions it in the comment list), skill/stage/project catalogs, challenge-bank, skill-graph, stage-id-map-v2, project CSVs/provenance, project-manifest.js.
7. AGENTS.md says `lab/index.html` carries the "daily-review entry point"; the CTA now points to `/lab/challenge/` and `/lab/review/` is orphaned.
8. AGENTS.md lists `placement-contract` under suites that need workerd; source shows it uses its own `node:http` static server plus Chromium (no `startWorker`).
9. DEPLOY.md has no section for the v2 learning API or the Lab bundle.

### Flows

**F1. Course page load** (`/lab/ordinary-least-squares/`)
1. Browser GET -> worker.js:3904 `courseMatch` -> 3912 `renderCourse` (2702): Cache API hit returns; else `env.ASSETS.fetch(origin + "/lab/course")` (2716), HTMLRewriter (2724-2746): reads `<html data-asset-version>`, prepends `<link rel=preload as=fetch>` for `manifest.json?v=` and the first module, sets title/meta/canonical/OG/Twitter, JSON-LD `#courseStructuredData`, fills `#course` with `courseFallback` (2674) and `#courseOverview` with `courseOverview`.
2. Deferred scripts run in order: lab-core.js (defines `Lab`), bundle (catalogs, storage, gamify, auth - `Auth.init` fires `GET /api/v2/bootstrap` immediately), lab-fx.js, lab-course.js.
3. lab-course.js:6-16 resolves `meta` from `TOPIC_META` by slug; 29-49 fetch manifest (fallback aggregate); 53-56 flatten stages; 620-629 start index from `#sN` or first unfinished; `render(start)` (510) awaits `ensureModule` (58) for that module, builds the stage (`buildWork` 198), paints nav/progress.
4. Navigation `go(i)` (551): inert + `FX.pageTurn` + `render`; crossing into an unloaded module shows "Loading module..." after 500 ms; failure toasts and keeps the reader on the previous stage.

**F2. Completing a stage (signed in)**
1. Graded stage Check / code Run success / interactive Launch / read "Next" => `mark(i, el)` (lab-course.js:84).
2. `store.setProgress` (legacy indexes), `paintProgress`, `paintNext`.
3. Points: `COURSE_STAGE_POINTS[topic][i]` -> stage `points` -> default table; `Gamify.award(pts)` (gamify.js:41) recomputes exact points from progress, bumps streak (`FX.streakUp`), writes, paints, `Auth.pushStats` (auth.js:894 -> PUT `/api/stats`).
4. `Auth.pushProgress(topic, [...done])` (auth.js:837 -> `mergeLocalProgress`, PUT `/api/progress`) and `Auth.pushStableProgress(topic, stageId)` (865 -> PUT `/api/v2/progress`), each through `enqueue`.
5. For question stages the Check handler also calls `Auth.recordMasteryAttempt("<course>:<stageId>", {correct,hinted})` (lab-course.js:431 -> PUT `/api/mastery`) and `recordSkillAttempt` per `skillIds` (see trap 2).
6. Signed out (or offline): no network at all. Steps 2-3 run; `pushProgress` and `pushStats` return false at once (`!backend || !user`); `pushStableProgress` still writes the stage id into the local `stableProgress` envelope (auth.js:869-874) and returns true at 875 before any enqueue; `recordMasteryAttempt` / `recordSkillAttempt` still write the local record and queue the outbox event, returning `synced: false` (auth.js:601-611, 648-657). That anonymous outbox is flushed later only if `bindOwner` claims the anonymous scope into a brand-new account scope on first sign-in (storage.js:354-387); a returning account scope keeps it isolated.

**F3. Page-load hydration (`init`, auth.js:954)**
1. `initialPayload` (927): `/api/v2/bootstrap` -> `/api/bootstrap` -> `/api/me` (fallback only on 404/405).
2. Validate `user`; `accountScopeExisted = store.hasOwnerState(user.id)` (967, **before** binding); `store.bindOwner(user.id, {claimAnonymous:true, announce:true})` - a brand-new account scope on this browser claims anonymous learning state (storage.js:354-386).
3. status `syncing`; `pullAll(epoch, owner, payload)` (396) serialized through `enqueue`:
   a. progress: `acceptGeneration` (newer server generation => local reset to it), union local+remote per course, `setProgress`, PUT `/api/progress` for models with local-only indexes (parallel).
   b. stats: uses the bootstrap payload (or `GET /api/stats` when bootstrap is absent or progress was just uploaded); `Gamify.merge(remote, {progressComplete})`; PUT `/api/stats` when local `last`/`streak` differ.
   c. mastery: `store.setMastery(remote)` (server record replaces local), then `flushMasteryOutbox` (sequential PUT `/api/mastery`; poison 4xx dropped; stop on transient error).
   d. placement: PUT local result when no remote or `local.completedDay >= remote.completedDay`, else adopt remote.
   e. `pullAcademyState` (293; skipped when the payload lacks `stableProgress`): PUT `/api/v2/progress` per local-only stage; `setSkillMastery(remote)` then `flushSkillOutbox`; preferences: adopt remote if the account scope already existed locally, **else PUT local preferences**; projects: union by project, PUT `/api/v2/project` for differences.
   f. emit `iewt:synced`; status `ready`; `resolveReady`; emit `iewt:auth-ready`.
4. Any exception in `init` => `backend=false`, anonymous owner (`announce:false`), status `offline`; the app keeps working on local state.

**F4. Reset (`Auth.resetProgress`, auth.js:523; UI lab-ui.js:314/330)**
Dialog confirm => `resetting=true`, epoch++, status `resetting`, `iewt:reset-state starting` => signed in: `DELETE /api/progress` (owner header, no generation) => server batch increments `learning_sync.generation` => `store.resetLearning(owner,{generation})` + `Gamify.reset({storageAlreadyCleared:true})` => `iewt:progress-reset`, `iewt:synced {reset:true}` => dialog closes, `renderAll`. Signed out: local only. Failure leaves local data intact and the dialog open with an inline error. Escape is blocked while the DELETE is pending (lab-ui.js:389).

**F5. Review item attempt** (lab-review.js:419 `persistPending`)
Submit => `pending={correct,answer,hinted,attemptId}` (UUID) => `Auth.recordMasteryAttempt` (auth.js:588): wait `ready` if checking/syncing; validate; `MasteryScheduler.apply` locally; `queueMasteryAttempt`; emit `iewt:mastery-state`; if signed in, enqueue PUT `/api/mastery` with the stored generation; server response replaces the local record and removes the outbox entry; on failure the UI shows "could not be saved" and retries the same attempt id.

**F6. Mastery challenge** (challenge.js)
`init` (52) fetch bank -> `choose` (10) -> `render` (25) -> submit => `Auth.recordSkillAttempt(item.skillId, item.id, ...)` -> `iewt:skill-state` -> feedback text "Saved to your account." only when `result.synced`.

**F7. Placement** (placement.js)
`init` (795) render intro, prefetch bank when no saved result => Start => `loadBank` -> 15 questions (answers in `session` memory) => `finishDiagnostic` (686): `grade`, `renderResults`, `persistResult` => `Auth.savePlacement` => local `setPlacement` + PUT `/api/placement` when signed in. Dashboard reads `store.placement()` for the "diagnostic route" resume card.

**F8. Python run** (lab-core.js:215 `run`)
`packagesFor(code)` => `getPyodide(packages)` (first call loads `https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/pyodide/v0.26.4/full/pyodide.js` then `loadPyodide({packages})`) => `prepare` loads missing packages and runs one-time setup (numpy alias, pandas alias, Matplotlib theme + `_grab_figs`) => `runPythonAsync(code)`; on a recognizable missing-module/NameError it loads exactly the missing set and retries once => stdout streamed to `.cell__out`, `colorize`, `FX.ignite`, figures via `_grab_figs()` PNG base64 => `onRun` (e.g. `mark`).

**F9. Sign-in / sign-out**
Sign-in: `Auth.signIn` => `location.href='/auth/google'` => Google => `/auth/callback` (worker.js:2784) => `recordSignIn` (shared/lab-sign-in.js:11) => `signSession({sub,email,name,aud:'learn',exp})` => cookie => `/lab/?auth=ok` => F3. Sign-out: `Auth.signOut` (auth.js:813): POST `/auth/logout` with owner header; on success `user=null`, `bindOwner(null,{claimAnonymous:false,announce:true})`, `location.href='/lab/'`. Cross-tab: another tab changing `iewt:activeOwner` => `iewt:owner-external` => this tab drops to anonymous with status `account-changed`.

**F10. Generated bundle pipeline**
Edit `assets/js/{storage,auth,gamify,mastery,skill-mastery,course-catalog,skill-catalog}.js` or curricula => `node scripts/generate-course-payloads.mjs` => rewrites `stage-catalog.js` (:293), `review-catalog.js` (:289), `shared/{review,stage,skill}-manifest.js` (:296/299/302), `course-points.js` (:305), `course-seo.js` (:312), `assets/data/**` (:93, 135, 243-251, 268, 285) and `lab-suite.bundle.js` (:314-316) => bump `assets/version.txt` + every `?v=` / `data-asset-version` => contracts.

### Invariants and traps

1. **Bundle must equal its sources.** contracts.mjs:294-297 asserts `labBundle.includes(read(src).trim())` for all 8 members. Editing a member without running the generator fails CI; hand-editing the bundle is overwritten. The bundle has no banner (no-comment rule).
2. **Skill attempts from the course player are rejected by the Worker (found by simulation, not covered by any test).** `recordSkills` (lab-course.js:211-214) sends `itemId = st.variantId || st.id`, e.g. `ols-line-04-core`. `validSkillItem` (worker.js:662) accepts only `<skillId>:v1|v2|v3`, a key of `REVIEW_ITEM_BY_ID` (`course:stageId`) or of `COURSE_STAGE_BY_ID` (`course:stageId`). Running the Worker's function against the committed manifests and every graded stage payload: 0 of 191 (skill, variantId) pairs are accepted. Effect for signed-in users: PUT `/api/v2/attempt` => 400 `invalid_skill_attempt`, event stays in the skill outbox, then `isPoison` drops it at the next `flushSkillOutbox`, and `pullAcademyState` first replaces local skill mastery with the server copy (`setSkillMastery(payload.skillMastery)`, auth.js:319). Only challenge-page attempts (`<skill>:v1..3`) and item mastery projected through `REVIEW_ITEM_BY_ID` reach the server. Tests send only `<skill>:v1` (worker-regression.mjs:755) or stub the API (regression.mjs).
3. **First sign-in on a new browser overwrites server preferences.** `accountScopeExisted` is false when no local key exists for the account, so `pullAcademyState` (auth.js:326-335) PUTs the local (default or claimed-anonymous) preferences instead of adopting `payload.preferences`; the Worker upsert overwrites. Observed in code, not tested.
4. **The placement page runs storage.js + auth.js without the bundle** (required by contracts.mjs:303-309 and placement-contract.mjs:97: no lab-core, no course-catalog, no Pyodide). Consequences, verified by running storage.js in a vm: `window.COURSE_STAGE_IDS` is undefined there, so `cleanStableProgress` returns `{}` and `stableProgress()` rewrites the stored stable-progress envelope to `{}` (re-run in a vm with a fake `localStorage`: a seeded `{ols:{done:["ols-line-01"]}}` became `{}`). At script load the active owner is still `anonymous`, so auth.js:11 (`store.stableProgress()`) clears `iewt:progress:v3:anonymous`; for a signed-in visit `pullAcademyState` (auth.js:300, `mergeStableProgress(remote, store.stableProgress())`) clears `iewt:progress:v3:<owner>` the same way and `setStableProgress(merged)` stores `{}` again, so no stage id is PUT from that page. `topicLimit` falls back to 10000 (storage.js:130). Legacy index progress is untouched and the stable mirror is rebuilt by `stableFromLegacy` / bootstrap on the next bundle page, so loss is self-healing, but any new `clean*` function that depends on a catalog must tolerate a missing catalog. `placement.js` itself must not contain the strings `localStorage` or `Gamify` and must not call `.setProgress/.setGamify/.setMastery` (placement-contract.mjs:94-96).
5. **Only storage.js (and the generated bundle) may contain `localStorage`** (contracts.mjs:358). All other code uses `IEWTStorage`; do not even mention the word.
6. **Init ordering contracts**: lab-ui.js must contain `document.readyState === "loading"` and end with `\n  init();\n})();`; gamify.js must contain `\n  Gamify.paint();\n` (contracts.mjs:915-919).
7. **Owner fencing**: every mutation closes over `(owner, epoch)` and re-checks `current()` after each await; `enqueue` serializes all server calls. Any new mutation must follow `recordMasteryAttempt`'s pattern: local write first, outbox queue, then `enqueue` with `store.syncGeneration(owner)`, `acceptGeneration`, `handleGenerationConflict`, `isPoison` handling. `resetting` blocks new mutations (throws "Learning data is being reset").
8. **Generation fence**: PUT without a numeric `X-IEWT-Generation` or with a stale one is 409 `reset_required`; only `DELETE /api/progress` is exempt. A delayed pre-reset write cannot resurrect data. The client must send the *owner's* stored generation (`store.syncGeneration(owner)`), never a cached value from another owner.
9. **Points are derived, never trusted**: client `Gamify.read` rewrites points to `max(derived, remotePointFloor)`; server recomputes from `progress`. Do not add a client path that stores points directly (regression.mjs:1555-1560).
10. **Progress is index-based** (`progress:v2`) beside stable ids (`progress:v3`). Reordering or inserting stages shifts meaning of stored indexes; append only, or ship a migration. `assets/data/stage-id-map-v2.json` freezes the legacy 205 stages (asserted by contracts.mjs:215 `frozenStageCount === 205` and by the generator at generate-course-payloads.mjs:98, which throws on any other value; academy-contract.mjs does not assert it; the file is in `.assetsignore`, never served).
11. **Duplicated allowlists must change together**: project ids/tasks in `project-catalog.js`, `lab-ui.js:7` `PROJECTS`, `storage.js:238` `PROJECT_IDS`, `shared/project-manifest.js` (hand-written); path ids in `course-catalog.js` `LEARNING_PATHS`, `storage.js:250`, `worker.js:98`; placement bands/topics in `storage.js:260`, `auth.js:216`, `placement.js:7-8`, `worker.js:305`, and `schema.sql` / `PLACEMENT_SCHEMA_SQL` CHECKs (7 legacy topics only; the 5 newer courses can never be a placement recommendation).
12. **Scheduler divergence is intentional**: items (`mastery.js` / `shared/mastery.js`, worker SQL at 3281-3306) reset to level 0 on wrong and cap hinted-correct at level 1; skills (`skill-mastery.js` / `shared/skill-mastery.js`, SQL at 2935-2954) step down by 1 and leave level unchanged on hinted-correct. Browser and server twins are held equal by mastery-contract.mjs and academy-contract.mjs; change both or CI fails.
13. **Review and challenge banks contain answers**; `review-catalog.js` (the answer-free list the dashboard loads) must stay answer-free (academy-contract.mjs:55-56). `review-catalog.js` (25 KB) is loaded by lab/index.html but only the dead `reviewQueue` reads `REVIEW_ITEMS` - candidate for removal (weight), would need the contracts/mastery-contract adjustments.
14. **`lab/review/` is orphaned but live and tested** (no inbound link, not in sitemap); `lab/lesson.html` is unreachable (308 first). Do not delete without updating contracts.mjs:284, 300-304 and regression.mjs PAGES.
15. **Versioning ritual**: any change under `assets/css`, `assets/js`, `assets/data` requires `assets/version.txt` increment and every `?v=` and `data-asset-version` (lab/index.html 6 refs, course.html 7 + attr, placement 6 + attr, review 5 + attr, challenge 5 + attr, each project 7 + attr, lesson.html 1) plus `ASSET_VERSION` in `shared/flows-pages.js:1`. Fonts keep `fonts-version.txt` (preload `?v=230`). The Worker preload for course manifest/module reads `data-asset-version` from course.html; a mismatch breaks the "first module served by preload" assertion (regression.mjs:921).
16. **Course page performance contracts** (regression.mjs 879-1330): manifest fetched exactly once; aggregate `<id>.json` not fetched when manifest is valid; no other course/module payload fetched; no authoring bundle scripts; next module prefetched only when crossing a boundary; skeleton must not shift (CLS < 0.05); stage inert while next module loads; a reading is never auto-completed by display or keyboard navigation (1198, 1320-1328).
17. **Layout/a11y contracts** (regression.mjs): no horizontal overflow at 320/390/768/1440 (172); dashboard "Today" fits the first viewport and 44 px targets (210-223); `--ink-faint` contrast >= 4.5 (412); splitter is an ARIA `separator` with `aria-valuenow` and keyboard Arrow/Home/End (1486-1496); quiz fieldset+legend (1352-1355); heading levels never skip (1468); 44x44 targets incl. range, numeric, blank, splitter (1393-1418); boot status is a non-empty `role=status` naming the packages (1574-1576).
18. **`:has(#reviewLive)` CSS** (review.css:510-532) hides the review brief on phones; the challenge page has no `#reviewLive` and must keep its brief (regression.mjs:515). Do not rename review ids without checking challenge.
19. **Pyodide**: version pinned in `PYODIDE_VERSION`; CSP must allow `https://cdn.jsdelivr.net` for `script-src` and `connect-src`, `'wasm-unsafe-eval' 'unsafe-eval'`, `worker-src 'self' blob:` (worker.js `CSP` block 102-115; script-src 110, connect-src 111, worker-src 112). `packagesFor` must resolve every import of all 139 executable cells to the exact package set (contracts.mjs:155-210); NumPy always loads first; statsmodels pulls scipy + pandas. Tests replace `window.loadPyodide` with a fake, so keep the `if (!window.loadPyodide)` branch (lab-core.js:165).
20. **Placement privacy**: only the 5-field summary persists and reaches D1; answers never leave `session` memory; server rejects `total != 15` or band/score mismatch (worker.js:308).
21. **Reset semantics**: server-first for signed in; preferences and guide width survive; `Gamify.reset({storageAlreadyCleared:true})` must follow `resetLearning` or points repaint from stale storage.
22. **Project and challenge pages do not wait for `Auth.whenReady()`**: project.js reads `IEWTStorage.projects()` once at load and never listens to `iewt:synced`; challenge.js selects from local skill mastery immediately. For a signed-in user on first load these can show or use pre-hydration state.
23. **Reads write**: every `store.progress()/gamify()/mastery()/...` call re-writes the envelope (`writeScoped` in the getter), so getters are not free and can trigger a quota failure path (`dirty` memory fallback) on a read.
24. **Sandbox/test rules**: browser/server suites that boot workerd (`worker-regression`, `regression`) need `FLOWS_TEST_SANDBOX=1` in the agent sandbox; `contracts`, `mastery-contract`, `academy-contract` need no server; `placement-contract` needs Chromium and its own static server. `tests/flows-strip.mjs` does NOT enforce the no-comment rule for the Lab files: it asserts that `scripts/strip-comments.mjs` re-parses every `assets/js/*.js` (`stripTree({check:true})`, line 14) and that stripping twice equals stripping once (lines 17-25); no assertion fails when a comment is present in `assets/js` (comment-free is enforced only by AGENTS.md convention and, for other modules, by per-file scans such as flows-quant.mjs:901); contracts.mjs:1099-1114 rejects any committed JS containing an absolute `/home/<user>/...` path.
25. **Cross-tab**: `iewt:activeOwner` is the only cross-tab signal. `bindOwner(..., {announce:true})` writes it (successful init, sign-out); the offline init path and the owner-external handler pass `announce:false`. `resetLearning`'s own `announce` option is unrelated: it only decides whether `iewt:storage-reset` is emitted.
26. **Silent OAuth failure**: `/auth/callback` redirects to `/lab/?auth=ok` or `/lab/?auth=error`, but no client module reads the `auth` query parameter (grep of assets/js lab files empty), so a failed sign-in shows nothing beyond the signed-out state.

---

### How to change it

**Add or change course content (stages, questions, skills).**
Edit `assets/js/curriculum.js` / `curriculum-data.js` / `curriculum-questions.js` / `curriculum-academy.js` (authoring sources, not shipped). Run `node scripts/generate-course-payloads.mjs`. Commit all regenerated outputs: `assets/data/courses/**`, `review-bank.json`, `challenge-bank.json`, `skill-graph.json`, `assets/js/{review-catalog,stage-catalog,lab-suite.bundle}.js`, `shared/{review-manifest,stage-manifest,skill-manifest,course-points,course-seo}.js`. Append stages only (progress is index-based); keep module gzip <= 6 KiB. Bump version ritual (trap 15). Run: `node tests/contracts.mjs`, `academy-contract.mjs`, `mastery-contract.mjs`, then (sandbox) `FLOWS_TEST_SANDBOX=1 node tests/worker-regression.mjs` and `regression.mjs`. If counts change update literals in contracts.mjs (:153 365, :177 139, :212 84), academy-contract (:16 84, :17 365, :49 252, :59 84) and mastery-contract (:20 106), regression.mjs `TOPICS`/`SLUGS` (:8-22).

**Add a whole course.** `course-catalog.js` (TOPIC_META + paths), `skill-catalog.js` seeds, authoring source + generator, static `lab/index.html` card and JSON-LD entry (contracts.mjs:289-293 compares static links to `COURSE_TOPICS`), `sitemap.xml`, `LEARNING_PATHS` if routed; `placement` keeps its 7 legacy topics. Update `lab/index.html` counts text and regression `TOPICS`.

**Change the dashboard (lab-ui.js / lab/index.html / lab.css).** DOM ids are a contract between lab/index.html and lab-ui.js (list in File table). Keep the static `#labGrid` cards (no-JS and SEO; contracts require exactly the canonical links) and keep `init();` as the final statement. Layout-shift tests (regression.mjs 479-515) and Today-fits-viewport (190-229) must stay green; the `@media (scripting: enabled)` skeleton heights (lab.css:1634-1647) reserve space for async-rendered blocks. Bump asset version.

**Change the course player (lab-course.js / course.html).** Stage types are dispatched in `buildWork` (198); adding a type also needs generator `KNOWN_TYPES`/`DEFAULT_POINTS`/`DEFAULT_MINUTES` (generate-course-payloads.mjs:28-38), `contracts.mjs` `defaults` (:45) and per-type asserts (:60-120), `shared/course-points.js` via the generator, and `lab.css`. Keep `go()`/`render()` sequence guards (`renderSeq`, `turnSeq`). The Worker's preloads and fallback markup are in worker.js `renderCourse` (2702), `courseFallback` (2674), `courseOverview`.

**Change Python/Pyodide behaviour (lab-core.js).** Version: `PYODIDE_VERSION` (line 4) and verify package availability for it. Packages: `PACKAGES/LABELS/MODULES/GLOBALS` (45-48) and `packagesFor`; run `node tests/contracts.mjs` (scan over all executable cells) and the browser Python blocks (regression.mjs 248-325, 1500-1785). Theme/figures: `SETUP.matplotlib` (10-43).

**Change storage / sync / auth (storage.js, auth.js, gamify.js, mastery.js, skill-mastery.js).**
1. Edit the source file, then run `node scripts/generate-course-payloads.mjs` to rebuild the bundle (placement still loads storage.js and auth.js directly, so the code must work with no catalogs).
2. New persisted kind: add key prefix in `KEYS` (6), `scopedKey` (83), `v3Kind` if v3, `cleanFor`/`emptyFor`, getter/setter pair and export (634), `hasScopedState` (327), `bindOwner` claim + removal lists (355-386), `resetLearning` (548); decide whether reset clears it (preferences do not).
3. New server call: add the route to worker.js (follow `/api/v2/preferences` at 2972: `requireMethod`, `requireSessionSecret`, `currentUser`, `requireSameOrigin`, `requireMutationOwner`, `mutationGeneration`, `academyBatch` with `WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM learning_sync WHERE user_id=? AND generation=?)` fence), the table in `schema.sql`, a new `migrations/00NN_*.sql`, `ACADEMY_SCHEMA_SQL` (89), the DELETE batch (3051-3070), bootstrap statements (820-827, 886-902), and the client function in auth.js (copy `savePreferences` 680 or `recordSkillAttempt` 636 for idempotent attempts) + hydration in `pullAcademyState` + `Auth` export.
4. Tests: `contracts.mjs` vm harness 430-820, `worker-regression.mjs` (academy block ~740-940, generation fences 560-590), `regression.mjs` stubs (~100-120, 770-790, 850-870, 1800), `academy-contract.mjs` (migrations == schema.sql tables).
5. If you change schedulers also change `shared/mastery.js` / `shared/skill-mastery.js` and the SQL at worker.js 2935-2954 / 3281-3306.

**Fix the skill-attempt item id mismatch (trap 2).** Either change `recordSkills` (lab-course.js:213) to send `topic.id + ":" + st.id` (valid `COURSE_STAGE_BY_ID` key for the skill) or extend `validSkillItem` (worker.js:662) to accept `variantId`s; add a worker-regression case using the real stage id; bump asset version if the client changes.

**Change the review / challenge / placement pages.** Review: `lab-review.js` + review.css + `lab/review/index.html`; bank comes from the generator (`review-bank.json`, schemaVersion 2). Challenge: `challenge.js`, bank from generator (:285). Placement: edit `assets/data/placement-bank.json` (15 items: 3 per type, 5 per difficulty, 7 topics; validated by `normalizeBank` placement.js:106 and contracts.mjs:217-266) and routes in `placement.js` (27-45); server contract fixed at total 15 (worker.js:308, schema CHECK). Run `node tests/placement-contract.mjs` (needs Chromium) and `contracts.mjs`.

**Add or change a project.** `project-catalog.js` (tasks, Python code), dataset CSV + `assets/data/projects/provenance.json` (sha256 and rowCount checked by academy-contract.mjs:73-84), `lab/projects/<id>/index.html` (copy an existing page, set `data-project-id`), `lab-ui.js:7` `PROJECTS`, `storage.js:238` `PROJECT_IDS`, `shared/project-manifest.js`, `sitemap.xml`, `contracts.mjs:274-276` URL list, `regression.mjs` PAGES (:24) and project blocks (327-358). Remember code runs locally; only mode and task ids sync.

**Change styling.** Tokens/`.btn`/`.toast` live in `base.css`; Lab surfaces in `lab.css` (regions listed above), review + challenge in `review.css`, placement in `placement.css`. Never introduce comments (AGENTS.md rule; no Lab test fails on a comment, `tests/flows-strip.mjs` only checks that the stripper parses and is idempotent over `assets/js`). Keep 16 px min inputs and 44 px coarse targets. Bump the asset version.

**Change the session/sign-in layer (shared/session.js, shared/lab-sign-in.js).** Token format changes must stay backward compatible with both `learn` and `flows` audiences (shared helpers); `contracts.mjs:1088-1094` and `flows-auth-contract.mjs` cover them. `LAB_SESSION_MS` also feeds the cookie `Max-Age` (worker.js:2824) and `LAB_ACTIVITY` lag windows; `recordSignIn` must keep the lazy `signed_in_at` ALTER path (flows-worker-contract.mjs 2026-2060, migration 0013).

**Run order for a Lab-only change.** `cd tests && node contracts.mjs && node mastery-contract.mjs && node academy-contract.mjs && node placement-contract.mjs`, then in the agent sandbox `FLOWS_TEST_SANDBOX=1 node worker-regression.mjs` and `FLOWS_TEST_SANDBOX=1 node regression.mjs` (Chromium via `PLAYWRIGHT_BROWSERS_PATH`). The `npm test` chain in `tests/package.json` registers these as `test:contracts`, `test:mastery`, `test:academy`, `test:placement`, `test:worker`, `test:browser`; a new suite must be added both as a script and into the `test` chain string.
