## Site shell: landing, articles, nav, ticker, assets, build scripts

Snapshot: commit `ba2acfe` (origin/main after PR 148), `assets/version.txt` = `240`, `assets/fonts-version.txt` = `230` (both single-line files, no trailing space). Every line number below was taken with `grep -n` / `sed -n` / the Read tool on that tree. Source beat docs wherever they disagreed; disagreements are listed under "Invariants and traps" (T-codes).

### Purpose and boundaries

**What it is.** The static, framework-free public shell of anilkaya.org: the landing page (`/`, particle-field hero, eight-city market-open board, indices ticker, data disclaimer), the Articles section (an empty index plus a private template), the 404 page, the shared design system (`base.css`: fonts, tokens, topbar, pill nav, buttons), the five shell scripts (`nav.js` shared by every pill page, `year.js` for the articles footer, and `particles.js`, `market-clock.js`, `market-ticker.js` for the landing only), the image/font inventory, the `shared/markets.js` Yahoo parser that backs the landing ticker, the asset-versioning scheme that every HTML page and the Worker-rendered Flows pages depend on, and four one-off or dev scripts under `scripts/` (`strip-comments.mjs`, `optimize-og-images.py`, `prune-dead-css.py`, `render-preview.mjs`) plus the one fixtures file `render-preview.mjs` reads.

**What it is not.**
- Not the Lab (`lab/**`, `assets/js/lab-*.js`, `lab.css`, course payloads) -- another area. The Lab pages do share this area's `base.css`, `nav.js`, the pill markup, the font preload and the `?v=` / `data-asset-version` scheme, so a bump or nav change touches them.
- Not Flows (`/flows/**`, `shared/flows-*.js`, `flows*.css`). Flows pages are Worker-rendered strings (`shared/flows-pages.js`), load `base.css` and `flows.css`, and carry `ASSET_VERSION` (`flows-pages.js:1`). `nav.js` is loaded by exactly one Flows page, `loginPage` (`flows-pages.js:352`, which renders its own `.pill` via `sitePill()` at `:82`); `nav.js`'s `railFocus()` targets `.flows-rail`, a class present on the 13 authenticated Flows pages, none of which load `nav.js` (verified by rendering every `*Page()` in Node), so `railFocus()` is effectively dead code today.
- Not the Worker (`worker.js`). This area owns the *inputs* the Worker serves (HTML, `_headers`, `/api/markets` payload parser) but the routing, CSP, finaliser, cron and D1 plumbing are documented in the Worker areas. The few Worker hops that matter to this area are mapped under "Flows" with exact lines.

**Neighbours / seams.**
- `worker.js` (serves every non-`/assets/*` path first, then `env.ASSETS.fetch` -> these HTML files; `/api/markets`; `scheduled()` housekeeping cron refreshes the market snapshot).
- `_headers` + `wrangler.toml [assets]` + `.assetsignore` + `.gitignore` (edge policy for `/assets/*`, what ships in the static bundle).
- `shared/flows-pages.js` (`ASSET_VERSION`, `v()`; hand-copied site nav `fx-site`), `shared/flows-freshness.js` (`isRefreshWindow`, used by the market refresh), `shared/flows-live-worker.js` (`HOUSEKEEPING_CRON`, `settledWithin`, `flightAbandoned`).
- `shared/course-seo.js` + `scripts/generate-course-payloads.mjs:307,312` (choose which `og-*.png` a course gets).
- Adjacent root files that belong to the shell but sit outside the file list: `site.webmanifest` (name, `start_url`, one `favicon.svg` icon, `theme_color #0a0a08`, `background_color #060604`), `robots.txt` (`Allow: /` + sitemap line, exact bytes pinned by `worker-regression.mjs:273-276`), `sitemap.xml` (17 `<loc>`: `/`, `/lab/`, 12 course pages, 3 project pages; pinned exactly by `contracts.mjs:268-277`; `/articles/` must stay out, `:279-280`).

### Data and interfaces

**HTTP surface touched by this area** (all through `worker.js` `fetch` -> `route` -> `finalize`, except `/assets/*`):

| route | method / gate | behaviour | headers |
|---|---|---|---|
| `/`, `/articles/`, `/404` (unknown paths), `/robots.txt`, `/sitemap.xml`, `/site.webmanifest` | GET/HEAD, public | `route()` ends with `env.ASSETS.fetch(request)` (`worker.js:3915`); `html_handling = "auto-trailing-slash"` | `finalize` (`:3918`): the 7 `SECURITY_HEADERS` (`:117-125`); HTML gets the CSP (`:102-115`) and `Cache-Control: no-cache`; a non-HTML 200/304 without `?v=` gets `public, max-age=3600`; `?v=` only matters under `/assets/` and the Worker never sees those |
| `/assets/css|js|fonts/*` | edge, asset-first, no Worker | `_headers` | security headers + `public, max-age=31536000, immutable` by path (query string ignored); a missing file = asset-layer `404.html` under that same immutable policy, no CSP |
| `/assets/img/*`, `/assets/data/*`, `/assets/version.txt`, `/assets/fonts-version.txt` | edge | `_headers` | `public, max-age=3600` |
| `GET|HEAD /api/markets` | public, no session (`worker.js:2858-2865`), other methods 405 | returns the stored snapshot string verbatim | `Content-Type: application/json; charset=utf-8`, `Cache-Control: public, max-age=300` (the one `/api/` response `finalize` does not force to `no-store`, `:3931-3932`, only for GET/HEAD 200) |

**CSP consequences for the shell** (`worker.js:102-115`): `default-src 'self'`; `script-src 'self' 'wasm-unsafe-eval' 'unsafe-eval' https://cdn.jsdelivr.net https://static.cloudflareinsights.com` (no inline script; JSON-LD `type=application/ld+json` is a data block and is fine); `style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'`; `img-src 'self' data: blob:` (the grain texture is a `data:` SVG in `home.css:47`); `font-src 'self'`; `connect-src 'self' wss://anilkaya.org https://cdn.jsdelivr.net https://cloudflareinsights.com`; `frame-ancestors 'none'`; `form-action 'self'`; `upgrade-insecure-requests`.

**D1.** One table touched: `market_snapshot(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY CHECK (id = 1), payload TEXT NOT NULL, updated_at INTEGER NOT NULL)`, defined in `schema.sql:101-105` and `migrations/0004_market_snapshot.sql`, with a lazy `CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS` fallback (`worker.js:129,437-446`). Reads: 1 row per `/api/markets` hit (+1 per out-of-window housekeeping firing). Writes: 1 row per refresh (upsert), plus the failure path `ON CONFLICT DO UPDATE SET updated_at` only (payload and its inner `updatedAt` untouched, so a failed refresh never re-stamps old quotes as new). With no existing row, a total failure inserts `{"quotes":[],"updatedAt":now}`.

**Snapshot wire format** (payload JSON): `{ "quotes": [ { key, label, city, currency, price, changePct|null, prevClose|null, prevDay|null, asOf(ms)|null, asOfDay("YYYY-MM-DD")|null, sessionEnd(ms)|null } x up to 8 ], "updatedAt": <ms the quotes were fetched> }`. A row stored before the base fix lacks `asOfDay`; the strip then prints a dash instead of a percentage (`market-ticker.js:39`).

**Env / secrets.** Only `MARKET_QUOTE_ORIGIN` (test-only, loopback `http://127.0.0.1|localhost:<port>` or ignored; set via `startWorker({extraVars})` in `worker-regression.mjs:34` and `flows-reads-contract.mjs:337,377`). No secrets. Yahoo is unauthenticated; request URL `<origin>/v8/finance/chart/<encodeURIComponent(yahoo)>?range=5d&interval=1d`, UA `Mozilla/5.0 (compatible; anilkaya.org market board)`.

**Cron.** `wrangler.toml:26`: `["1-59/5 13-21 * * MON-FRI", "3-58/5 13-21 * * MON-FRI", "*/30 * * * *", "15,45 * * * *"]`. The market snapshot is refreshed by the `*/30` firing (`HOUSEKEEPING_CRON`, `flows-live-worker.js:72`): `scheduled()` returns early for the `rth`, `focus` and `summary` jobs, so only the housekeeping job reaches `worker.js:3978` (`cronJob` for an unrecognised cron string, `flows-live-worker.js:80-87`: minute % 30 == 0 is housekeeping (`:84`), minute % 30 == 15 is `summary` (`:85`), anything outside Mon-Fri 13:00-21:59 UTC is housekeeping (`:86`), the rest is `focus` at minute % 5 == 3 else `rth`).

**Budgets / numbers.**
- Yahoo: 8 requests per refresh (one per index, parallel), up to 16 if the first origin fails (each origin 5,000 ms abort); `revalidate` makes up to 3 attempts, each waiting at most `MARKET_FLIGHT_WAIT_MS = 2*5000+2000 = 12,000 ms` (`worker.js:491`).
- Refresh frequency: `isRefreshWindow` (Mon-Fri, 09:15-16:15 ET inclusive, `flows-freshness.js:39-40,83`) refreshes on every firing without reading the row; outside it, the row is read and refreshed when older than 25 min (`MARKET_CRON_STALE_MS`), which the 30-min cadence always exceeds (asserted `< cadence` by `flows-freshness-contract.mjs:296`), so effectively every `*/30` firing refreshes: about 48 x 8 = 384 Yahoo calls a day.
- Reader path: a stored row is served at once; older than 45 min (`MARKET_STALE_MS`) triggers `keepAlive(ctx, revalidate...)` (`ctx.waitUntil`) single-flight per isolate; only an empty table makes the first reader wait (inline fetch; when the vendor answers or fails fast it settles in about 10 s at worst, two origins at 5 s each; a flight that hangs is abandoned at 12 s and retried, so the worst case is 3 x 12 s = 36 s; empty `{quotes:[],updatedAt}` if everything is dead).
- Client: `/api/markets` every 300,000 ms (`market-ticker.js:101`), browser cache 300 s; `market-clock` renders every 30,000 ms (`:127`); ticker scroll speed 55 px/s, min duration 18 s (`:75`).
- Page weight: `particles.js` 12,070 B is the heaviest shell script; `home.css` 12,491 B; `base.css` 10,813 B. Flows pages count only the files they link (`tests/flows-weight.mjs` ceilings in KiB of JS: loginPage 5; it links `nav.js` 2,415 B).
- Share cards: 8 PNG, 271-301 KB each, palette mode.

**Asset-versioning mechanism, end to end.**

1. *Tokens.* `assets/version.txt` (`240`) versions `assets/css/**`, `assets/js/**`, `assets/data/**`. `assets/fonts-version.txt` (`230`) versions `assets/fonts/*.woff2`. Rule: fonts token <= asset token (`contracts.mjs:329-330`); it equals the asset version at which a font last changed. The fonts token lives beside `version.txt`, not under `assets/fonts/`, so `_headers`' `/assets/fonts/*` immutable rule does not also match it (two matching rules join their `Cache-Control` with a comma rather than replacing). Both tokens ship in the static bundle with the one-hour rule (`.assetsignore` must not drop them; `contracts.mjs:331-334`); no page ever fetches them, they exist for ops checks (DEPLOY.md curls them) and are served `text/plain` (`worker-regression.mjs:245-253`).
2. *References.* At this commit: 66 `?v=240` CSS/JS references across `index.html` (6), `404.html` (1), `articles/index.html` (4), `articles/_template/index.html` (4), `lab/index.html` (6), `lab/course.html` (7), `lab/placement/index.html` (6), `lab/review/index.html` (5), `lab/challenge/index.html` (5), `lab/lesson.html` (1), three `lab/projects/*/index.html` (7 each); 16 woff2 `?v=230` references (8 in `base.css:7,18,29,36,43,50,58,69`, 8 Inter preloads at `index.html:30`, `404.html:11`, `articles/index.html:27`, `articles/_template/index.html:21`, `lab/index.html:27`, `lab/course.html:28`, `lab/placement/index.html:29`, `lab/review/index.html:29`). Not scanned by the contract but carrying the asset token: `base.css:123` and `flows.css:11` (`atmosphere.svg?v=240`).
3. *`data-asset-version`.* `<html data-asset-version="240">` on `lab/course.html`, `lab/review/index.html`, `lab/placement/index.html`, `lab/challenge/index.html`, and the three project pages (7 files; `lab/index.html` and `lab/lesson.html` do not carry it). Consumers: the Worker (`worker.js:2723-2730`, `renderCourse` prepends the `manifest.json` and first-module preloads with `?v=<attr>`), and the browser (`lab-course.js:32,62`, `lab-review.js:85`, `challenge.js:54`, `placement.js:312` build their data URLs from `document.documentElement.dataset.assetVersion`). Contract asserts equality for three of the seven (course, review, placement; `contracts.mjs:335-337`).
4. *Worker-rendered Flows pages.* `export const ASSET_VERSION = "240"` (`flows-pages.js:1`), applied by `v()` (`:3`) to every CSS/JS href those pages emit; equality with `version.txt` asserted at `flows-features.mjs:846-849`. Flows pages emit no font preloads (fonts arrive through `base.css`).
5. *Cache policy.* By path in `_headers` (query ignored): css/js/fonts immutable one year; img/data/tokens one hour. Consequences: unversioned `/assets/css/base.css` is also immutable (`worker-regression.mjs:227-233`); missing `/assets/css|js|fonts/*` is a one-year-immutable 404 (`:260-267`), which is why DEPLOY.md section 9 makes the first deploy after a rollback bump the version. The `finalize` branch for `?v=` under `/assets/` (`worker.js:3939-3941`) is now unreachable for real `/assets/*` traffic (asset-first), kept for any path the Worker still proxies.
6. *Enforcement (CI).* `tests/contracts.mjs`: token format `:325-328`; ordering `:329-330`; `.assetsignore` does not hide tokens `:331-334`; `data-asset-version` equality `:335-337`; reference scan over `articles/**/*.html`, `lab/**/*.html`, `index.html`, `404.html` and `base.css` with regex `["'(](/assets/[^"')?#]+\.(css|js|woff2))(?:\?v=(\d+))?` (`:338-352`: every ref must carry the right token and the file must exist; `referenceCount >= 40`, `fontReferenceCount >= 16`, `:353-354`; summary line `:1211`); `_headers` parity with `SECURITY_HEADERS`, exact rule set, one rule per `assets/` child, no CSP, <= 100 rules, lines <= 2,000 chars (`:829-869`; `_headers` read `:829`, `.assetsignore`/`.gitignore` guards `:830-833`, SECURITY_HEADERS parity `:850-851`, policy table `:854`, one-rule-per-child `:866`, no CSP `:867`, rule-count cap `:869`); classification `isBrowserAsset = /^assets\/(?:css|js|data)\//` and `isFontAsset = /^assets\/fonts\/(?!.*\.(?:md|txt)$)/` (`:956-957`, so `assets/img/**`, `*.txt`, `NOTICE.md` need no bump); diff gate (`:921-983`; the `if (diffBase)` block is `:968-983`): base = `ASSET_DIFF_BASE` env (CI sets it to the PR base or push `before` SHA, `regression.yml:43`, with `fetch-depth: 0`), else `git rev-parse origin/main`, else `HEAD^` when that is all zeros; if any changed or untracked file is a browser asset, `version` must exceed the base's; if any is a font, `fonts-version` must exceed the base's. With no resolvable base the gate is skipped silently.

**Fonts and licensing summary.** Inter (UI body, `--font-ui`) -- licence file missing (T10). JetBrains Mono -- OFL 1.1 shipped. Latin Modern -- GFL, notice only. Repo code Apache-2.0.

### Flows

**F1. First paint of `/` (reader, apex).**
1. Edge matches `run_worker_first = ["/*","!/assets/*"]` (`wrangler.toml:10`) -> `worker.js:3990 fetch` -> `route` (`:2762`); none of the auth/api/flows/course branches match -> `env.ASSETS.fetch(request)` (`:3915`) returns `index.html`; `finalize` (`:3918`) adds the 7 security headers, the CSP (HTML) and `Cache-Control: no-cache`.
2. Browser parses `index.html`: preload `Inter-latin.woff2?v=230` (`:30`); `base.css?v=240` (@font-face declarations, tokens, `--site-ground` with `atmosphere.svg?v=240`); `home.css?v=240`; four `defer` scripts. All `/assets/*` requests are answered by the edge with `_headers` policy, never by the Worker.
3. After parse (`DOMContentLoaded`, or immediately if parsing is done): `nav.js init` (`:59`) -> `setup(.pill)` -> equal widths, indicator on the `is-active` link; `particles.js init` (`:271`) -> `resize`, `seed`, listeners, 1 s watchdog, `start`; `market-clock.js` builds 8 cards and starts its 30 s interval (`:133`); `market-ticker.js` runs `start()` (`:107`), which calls `load()` (`:100`) and arms the 5 min interval.
4. `market-ticker.js:86` GET `/api/markets` -> `route` `:2858` -> `loadMarketSnapshot` (`:541`) -> `readMarketSnapshot` (`:527`, D1 `SELECT payload, updated_at FROM market_snapshot WHERE id=1`) -> row served verbatim (stale-while-revalidate: `> 45 min` also starts `revalidateMarketSnapshot` under `ctx.waitUntil`) -> `Cache-Control: public, max-age=300`.
5. `render()` (`market-ticker.js:62`) -> mount un-hidden -> marquee duration set in `requestAnimationFrame`.

**F2. Snapshot refresh by cron (every 30 minutes).**
Cloudflare cron `*/30 * * * *` -> `scheduled()` (`worker.js:3950`) -> `FLOWS_LIVE.cronJob` (`flows-live-worker.js:75`) is `"housekeeping"` -> `guard("market refresh failed", refreshMarketSnapshotIfDue(env, at))` (`:3978`) -> `isRefreshWindow(new Date(at))` (`flows-freshness.js:83`); in window `row = null`, else `readMarketSnapshot` -> `marketRefreshDue(age, inWindow)` (`markets.js:80`) -> `revalidateMarketSnapshot` (`:510`) -> `startMarketFlight` (`:495`) -> `refreshMarketSnapshot` (`:475`) -> 8 x `fetchIndexQuote` (`:453`; origin query1 then query2, 5 s abort each) -> `parseIndexQuote` (`markets.js:18`) -> `buildSnapshot` (`:71`) -> `INSERT ... ON CONFLICT(id) DO UPDATE` via `marketOp` (`:437`). If every quote fails: the flight settles on a fallback, `updated_at` is re-dated, `payload` kept (`:495-508`). The same housekeeping firing then dispatches the nightly (`:3980-3987`), out of this area.

**F3. Cold start with no snapshot.** `loadMarketSnapshot` finds no row -> returns `keepAlive(ctx, revalidateMarketSnapshot(env))` (`:543`), i.e. the reader waits for the inline fetch of all 8 indices. `revalidateMarketSnapshot` (`:510-525`) joins or starts the one flight and waits at most 12 s for it; a flight that never settles is dropped and a fresh one started, for up to 3 attempts in all (`for (attempt < 3)`, `:513`), then answers `{quotes:[],updatedAt}`. Each abandonment logs one `flight abandoned` line with `flight: "market"` (`flows-live-worker.js:172`); `flows-reads-contract.mjs:329-388` pins the one-abandonment-then-retry case (two scenarios: the retry fails fast, so empty snapshot after about 12 s; the retry succeeds, `recovered: true`), not the 3-attempt ceiling.

**F4. Ticker label decision (`stampOf`, `market-ticker.js:23`).** quote time `at = q.asOf`; `end = q.sessionEnd`; `closed = end > 0 ? at >= end - 5 min : (fetchLag > 25 min || now - at > 60 min)`; `when` = `HH:MM` in Istanbul if the quote is from today (Istanbul date), else the weekday if under 6 days old (plus ` HH:MM` when not closed), else `Mon D`; the printed text is `Close ` + `when` when closed, `when` alone otherwise (so `Close 23:38` for a close struck today, `Close Fri` for a close under six days old, `Close Sep 25` past six days). Pinned by `market-ticker-render.mjs` (`:62`, `:64`, `:66`, `:83`, `:111`, `:116`).

**F5. Asset version bump (any change to `assets/css|js|data`).**
1. Edit the file(s). 2. `assets/version.txt` -> N+1. 3. Rewrite `?v=240` to `?v=241` in every static HTML (index, 404, articles x2, lab x9: index, course, placement, review, challenge, lesson, three projects), `base.css:123` and `flows.css:11` (atmosphere), the seven `data-asset-version` attributes, and `ASSET_VERSION` at `shared/flows-pages.js:1`. Do NOT touch the 16 woff2 `?v=230` references. 4. `grep -rn 'woff2?v=' --include=*.html --include=*.css . | grep -v '\.claude/worktrees'` must show only `230`. 5. Run `node contracts.mjs` and `node flows-features.mjs` (needs `ASSET_DIFF_BASE`/`origin/main` for the diff gate). A blanket `sed 's/?v=240/?v=241/g'` is safe today only because fonts are at 230; if the two tokens ever coincide it silently moves the fonts (T4).

**F6. Font change.** Replace the woff2, set `assets/fonts-version.txt` to the *new* `assets/version.txt` value, update the 16 `?v=` woff2 references, and bump `version.txt` too (because `base.css` changes). Contract: `contracts.mjs:978-981`.

**F7. Course share-card path.** `generate-course-payloads.mjs:307` picks `/assets/img/og-<id>.png` for 7 ids, `/assets/img/og.png` otherwise -> `shared/course-seo.js` `COURSE_TOPICS[].image` (written at `:312`) -> `renderCourse` (`worker.js:2702`) sets `og:image` and `twitter:image` to `SITE_ORIGIN + meta.image` through `HTMLRewriter` (`worker.js:2739,2742`).

**F8. 404 paths.** Unknown page path: Worker -> `env.ASSETS.fetch` -> asset-layer `404.html` with status 404 -> `finalize` adds CSP + `no-cache` (`worker-regression.mjs:254-256`). Missing `/assets/...` file: edge only -> `404.html` body, status 404, `_headers` policy (immutable under css/js/fonts), no CSP (`:260-267`).

### Invariants and traps

- **T1. Comment-free tree.** Source files carry no comments (AGENTS.md "Commentary"). Every in-scope file complies (verified: no `/*` or `<!--` outside strings). Enforcement is partial: `flows-quant.mjs:901` for `shared/flows-quant-*.js`, per-module scans in other Flows suites; nothing asserts it for `assets/js/*.js` or `shared/markets.js`. `strip-comments.mjs --check` currently measures a 1-byte delta over 48 files. Argue in the commit message, not inline.
- **T2. Any edit under `assets/css`, `assets/js`, `assets/data` requires the asset-version bump**, or `contracts.mjs:973-976` fails ("browser assets changed without increasing version"). That includes `nav.js`, `particles.js`, `year.js`, both market scripts, `base.css`, `home.css`, `article.css`. Edits under `assets/img` and `assets/fonts/*.md|*.txt` need none; a woff2 change needs the *fonts* token to increase (`:978-981`).
- **T3. Fonts token never runs ahead of the asset token** (`contracts.mjs:329-330`) and the 16 woff2 refs must equal it exactly; the scan fails on the first stray with file name and expected token (`:348-349`). `fontReferenceCount >= 16` (`:354`).
- **T4. Blanket `?v=` rewrites and merges** carry the fonts along when the tokens are equal (right after a font change). Always grep `woff2?v=` afterwards (AGENTS.md "Asset versioning", DEPLOY.md section 7).
- **T5. `_headers` is exact.** It must hold only the asset rules; every directory or file directly under `assets/` needs its own `Cache-Control` rule (a new `assets/video/` or `assets/foo.txt` fails `contracts.mjs:866` until `_headers` gets a line); the `/assets/*` block must equal `worker.js` `SECURITY_HEADERS` (`:850-851`); no CSP; `.gitignore` must keep `!_headers` (its `_*` rule would drop it) and `.assetsignore` must not list it (`:830-833`).
- **T6. `atmosphere.svg?v=240`** in `base.css:123` and `flows.css:11` rides the asset token but is invisible to the contract's regex (only css|js|woff2). A manual bump that skips them leaves a stale query on a one-hour-cached image; harmless for caching but a drift.
- **T7. The pill nav markup is hand-copied** into 11 HTML files (`index`, `articles/index`, `articles/_template`, `lab/index`, `lab/course`, `lab/placement`, `lab/review`, `lab/challenge`, three `lab/projects/*`) plus `sitePill()` (`flows-pages.js:82`, which carries only a `Home` link, no four-destination copy) and the Flows sidebar `fx-site` nav (`:148-150`, four links, Flows marked `aria-current="true"`). The four-link markup is not uniform: the `.lab-full`/`.lab-short` label swap exists in 7 of the 11 (`index`, `articles/index`, `articles/_template`, `lab/index`, `lab/course`, `lab/placement`, `lab/review`), while `lab/challenge` (21 lines) and the three `lab/projects/*` pages (9 to 11 lines) are compact files whose header is one line (brand plus pill, no `.topbar__social` LinkedIn button) with a plain `Lab` label and no swap. Adding or renaming a destination means editing all of them; `nav.js` assumes `a.is-active` in `.pill` (falls back to the first link, as on `loginPage`), the `.lab-full/.lab-short` swap at 50rem (`base.css:290-293`, `.lab-short` hidden by default at `:268`) and px-equalised widths (so long labels widen every tab; `regression.mjs:1366` pins equality and `:175-197` pins no clipping at 320 px).
- **T8. `home` is a fixed, non-scrolling viewport.** `.home` is `100svh; overflow: hidden` and the foot, board and ticker are `position: fixed` stacked at `bottom: 2rem / 3.4rem (5.4rem under 520px wide) / 0`; z-order: canvas 0, grain 1, vignette 2, board and ticker 6, hero 10, foot 11, topbar 100, toast 200. Content added to the hero must fit short viewports; the board hides under 720px height, the byline under 600, the whole foot and ticker under 480.
- **T9. Latin Modern is dead weight.** `base.css:24-51` declares four LM faces and `--font-serif` (`:92`), but no CSS rule in the repo uses `font-family: "Latin Modern"` or `var(--font-serif)` (`flows.css` forbids it, `contracts.mjs:1062`). `NOTICE.md` and the contract messages ("the Academy's prose is set in Latin Modern") and the template's copy ("set in Latin Modern") are stale; the page body is Inter. The woff2 files (about 128 KB) are shipped and cached but never requested. Source wins; do not rely on the docs here.
- **T10. No Inter licence file.** `assets/fonts/` has OFL text for JetBrains Mono and a GFL note for Latin Modern but nothing for Inter-latin/greek (`NOTICE.md` never mentions Inter). Inter is normally OFL 1.1; the redistribution notice is absent at this commit.
- **T11. Course count drift.** AGENTS.md says `TOPIC_META` holds seven courses (`ols 20 ... gmm 33`) and "all seven" Lab suites; source holds 12 (`COURSE_TOPICS` ids `ols,iv2sls,did,var,panel,logit,gmm,foundations,mle,forecast,coint,financial`), the sitemap lists 12 course URLs, `articles/index.html:85` says "twelve". Only the first seven have dedicated OG cards (`generate-course-payloads.mjs:307`).
- **T12. Articles are deliberately dormant.** `articles/index.html` is `noindex,follow` and absent from `sitemap.xml`; `contracts.mjs:279-280` fail if either changes. Publishing the first article is a contract edit (see recipe), not only a content edit. `.post-list` CSS exists but no markup uses it.
- **T13. `nav.js railFocus` is dead.** The only Flows page loading `nav.js` is `loginPage`, which has no `.flows-rail`; the authenticated pages centre the rail elsewhere (`flows-ui.js:1944` touches `.flows-rail a.is-on`). `render-preview.mjs` still lists `nav.js` in its inline set, which is a no-op for pages without the tag.
- **T14. The two city lists are separate.** `MARKETS` (`market-clock.js:14`, hours, zones, flags) and `MARKET_INDICES` (`markets.js:1`, Yahoo symbols) describe the same eight cities by name only; no test ties them, and they already disagree on Tokyo: `market-clock.js:19` closes at 15:00 while the Yahoo fixture in `markets-contract.mjs:118` treats Tokyo's close as 15:30 (06:30 UTC). Market hours ignore holidays by design and the disclaimer (`index.html:127-129`) says so.
- **T15. `/api/markets` is public and cacheable** and the only unauthenticated, non-`no-store` API response. Do not add per-user data to it. It must keep answering a stored snapshot immediately (readers never wait unless the table is empty); `worker-regression.mjs:146-212` pins single flight, stale-at-once, failure re-dating, window behaviour.
- **T16. `chartPreviousClose` is deliberately ignored** (with `range=5d` it is the close before the first bar: S&P showed -1.27% against a true -0.26% on 2026-09-29). Do not "simplify" `parseIndexQuote` back to it; `markets-contract.mjs` and `worker-regression.mjs:120-124` fail.
- **T17. Yahoo's `currentTradingPeriod.regular.end` (`sessionEnd`) was never read from this sandbox** (Yahoo blocked here, DEPLOY.md around the "landing ticker measures against the previous session" bullet); first production snapshot must be inspected for eight non-null `sessionEnd`s, otherwise the strip falls back to the 25-minute and 60-minute heuristics.
- **T18. CSP has no inline-script allowance.** Shell pages must put JS in `assets/js` with the `?v=` token; inline `<style>` is allowed (as in `404.html`). External fonts, images or scripts (other than jsDelivr and the Cloudflare beacon) are blocked.
- **T19. `localStorage` is forbidden outside `storage.js`** (`contracts.mjs`: `assets/js` scan) -- the shell scripts use none.
- **T20. `flows-motion.mjs:90` scans `base.css` media queries** with the Flows sheets: no px width may appear as both a min and a max (in either unit). `base.css` uses max-widths 50rem (800), 40rem (640), 30rem (480), 25rem (400).
- **T21. `scripts/prune-dead-css.py`** hard-codes this sandbox's absolute paths and a vanished scratchpad (see file table); **`scripts/optimize-og-images.py`** needs Pillow (absent here); **`scripts/strip-comments.mjs`** writes in place without `--check`. None of the three is in CI or `npm test`.
- **T22. Worktree noise.** `.claude/worktrees/*` holds stale copies of the whole repo (not in `git ls-files`); repo-wide `grep` hits them. Exclude `.claude` or use `git grep`.
- **T23. `render-preview.mjs` is untested glue** over `FLOWS_PAGES.sidePage|overviewPage|marketPage|tickerPage` and `TICKER_PANEL_KEYS` (`shared/flows-panels.js:114`); renaming those exports breaks it silently. It also strips `flows-dock.js` from pages by regex (`:34`).

| change | edit | then |
|---|---|---|
| **Change landing copy or layout** | `index.html` (h1 `:102`, lede `:103`, CTA `:105`, hint `:106`, footer `:113-136`), `home.css` (`.hero*` `:63-157`, `.home-foot` `:159`) | Keep the ids `marketBoard`, `marketTicker`, `marketDisclaimer` and the disclaimer phrases (`worker-regression.mjs:89-105` asserts "information and educational purposes only", "investment, financial, legal, or tax advice", "accept no liability"); bump asset version (F5); `node worker-regression.mjs` (with `FLOWS_TEST_SANDBOX=1`) and `node regression.mjs` (320..2048 px overflow and topbar checks). |
| **Add/rename a nav destination** | all 11 `.pill` HTML pages, `shared/flows-pages.js:82` (`sitePill`) and `:148-150` (`fx-site`), `home`/`lab` copies; styles `base.css:231-312` if widths change | bump version; `node regression.mjs` (`:175-197`, `:1366`), `node flows-weight.mjs`, `node contracts.mjs`. |
| **Tune the particle field** | `particles.js` constants `:9-31`, `COUNT` `:18` | bump version; manual check with `?fxdebug`, `?srcover`, `?boost`; reduced-motion path is `calm` (`:15`). No unit test. |
| **Add a market / change an index** | `shared/markets.js:1-10` (`MARKET_INDICES`: key, label, city, Yahoo symbol, currency) AND `market-clock.js:14-23` (`MARKETS`) AND the board copy if the count changes; `worker-regression.mjs` quote stub serves any symbol so counts follow `MARKET_INDICES.length` | bump version (client script changed); `node markets-contract.mjs` (`buildSnapshot` order test), `node market-ticker-render.mjs`, `node worker-regression.mjs`, `node flows-reads-contract.mjs`. Old stored snapshots keep the old set until the next cron firing (<= 30 min). |
| **Change change%/base/close logic** | `shared/markets.js:18-69` (parser) and/or `market-ticker.js:23-56` (labels) | Add a case to `markets-contract.mjs` (dated bars, `NEW_YORK` meta) and the rendered expectation in `market-ticker-render.mjs`; update the `worker-regression.mjs:107-128` expectations if payload fields change; add the field to the DEPLOY.md bullet; bump version for the script change. Never read `chartPreviousClose` (T16). |
| **Change refresh cadence / staleness** | `markets.js:77-78`, `worker.js:533-545`, `wrangler.toml:26` | Keep `MARKET_CRON_STALE_MS < cron cadence` and `MARKET_STALE_MS === 45 min` (`flows-freshness-contract.mjs:296-309`); run `node flows-freshness-contract.mjs`, `node worker-regression.mjs`. |
| **Publish the first article** | copy `articles/_template/index.html` to `articles/<slug>/index.html`; set title, canonical, `og:*`, add `og:image`, JSON-LD `Article`; list it in `articles/index.html` with the `.post-list` markup (replace `.post-empty`); flip `robots` to `index,follow`; add the URL to `sitemap.xml` | Update `contracts.mjs:268-280` (the exact sitemap list and the two "empty articles" assertions); `lab`-style `?v=` refs are auto-checked by the scan (`articles/**` is in `documents`); `.assetsignore` already excludes only `_template`. Run `node contracts.mjs`, `node worker-regression.mjs` (sitemap `:285`), `node regression.mjs`. |
| **Change a share card or add one** | replace/add `assets/img/og-*.png` at 1200x630, then `python3 scripts/optimize-og-images.py` (needs Pillow) so the colour type byte is 3; to give a course its own card edit the id list at `scripts/generate-course-payloads.mjs:307` and run `node scripts/generate-course-payloads.mjs`, commit `shared/course-seo.js` | `node contracts.mjs`. No version bump (images are outside the rule). |
| **Change fonts** | replace woff2, keep `unicode-range` coverage (U+2212 in Inter-latin and JBM-latin; U+038E-03A1 in Inter-greek; valid ranges), update `NOTICE.md` and add the missing Inter licence if touching Inter | F6: fonts token = new asset version, update the 16 `?v=` refs, bump asset version; `node contracts.mjs` (`:978-1075`), `node worker-regression.mjs:234-244`. Use re-subsetting from upstream, never hand-edit woff2. |
| **Add a design token / base component** | `base.css:74-136` (tokens), `:209-361` (components) | Remember Flows and Lab load `base.css` too; `node flows-motion.mjs` (width queries), `node flows-weight.mjs`, `node regression.mjs`; bump version. |
| **Add a new `assets/` subdirectory or root file** | create it, then add its `Cache-Control` rule to `_headers` | `contracts.mjs:866` demands one rule per child; extend `policy` (`:854-857`) in the test too. |
| **Change security headers** | `worker.js:117-125` AND `_headers` `/assets/*` block, identical | `contracts.mjs:851`; header smoke test per DEPLOY.md section 7 (dashboard Transform Rules can override both). |

## Flows server core: freshness, ledger, live layer, auth, pages, archive

Snapshot: commit `ba2acfe` (origin/main after PR #148), asset version `240`, fonts token `230`. All line numbers below were taken with `grep -n` / `Read` on that tree. Source files carry no comments, so everything here is read from code; where source and AGENTS.md / DEPLOY.md disagree the source wins and the disagreement is listed in "Invariants and traps" (section "Source versus docs").

### Purpose and boundaries

**What this area is.** The pure, Worker-importable modules that make the signed-in Flows product work on the server side, plus the two "clock/ledger" modules the pipeline also imports:

| Concern | Module(s) | One-line role |
|---|---|---|
| Time and freshness | `shared/flows-freshness.js` | The one Eastern-time clock, NYSE phase/trading-day logic, the freshness class table, the `X-Fresh-*` header vocabulary, and the due-tests for the Worker's crons (Tier 1, dispatch, watchdog, nightly). |
| Operations ledger | `shared/flows-ledger.js` | Per-day D1 table `flows_ledger`: gap/outcome counters for Tier 1, focus tick, Tier 2 passes and the nightly landing, plus its served view and the "worst stale key" probe. |
| Live layer (pure) | `shared/flows-live.js` | The `live:*` key registry (`LIVE_KEYS`), byte caps, budgets, silence vocabulary, every shaper/merger that turns vendor bodies into live payloads, the strip column contract (`STRIP_FIELDS`), the overlay merge rules, and write validation (`checkLiveWrite`). No I/O. |
| Live layer (Worker) | `shared/flows-live-worker.js` | D1 access and all Worker-side live behaviour: Tier 1 tick, focus tick, nightly dispatch tick, GitHub workflow dispatch, watchdog, clock memo/flights, ingest scoping and `live:*` writes, GitHub-OIDC JWKS cache, `/api/flows/lk`, `/now`, quote and tape services, overlays, ledger/prune plumbing. |
| Machine credential | `shared/flows-oidc.js` | GitHub Actions OIDC claim policy, pure JWT decode/verify (RS256), runner-side token request. |
| Member credential | `shared/flows-auth.js` | Member model (name, hash, end date, epoch), PBKDF2 hashing, signed `flows_session` cookie claims, login throttle/lockout arithmetic. |
| Page shells | `shared/flows-pages.js` | Server-rendered HTML for the 14 signed-in Flows routes (13 page functions; `sidePage` serves both Bullish and Bearish) plus the login page: sprite, sidebar, toolbar, tab bar, Ask dock, per-page asset list. |
| Small leaf modules | `flows-archive.js`, `flows-permits.js`, `flows-overlay.js`, `flows-market.js`, `flows-universe.js`, `flows-panels.js` | Immutable-archive decision table; vendor-call permit queue (pipeline); score-to-price date join (card builder); market-wide aggregate (nightly `market` payload); screened-universe selection and the retire/roster ledger (pipeline); server-side ticker panel registry (Neuron). |

**What it is not.** It is not the HTTP router (`worker.js`: 4,015 lines, owns `route()`, `finalize()`, the cron entrypoint `scheduled()`, `ensureFlowsTables`, the ingest route, all other `/api/flows/*` handlers), not the nightly pipeline (`scripts/flows-pipeline.mjs` and `scripts/flows-legs/*`: Tier 2 `--live` leg, witness, starts, health gate), not the real-time rail (`shared/flows-rt*.js`), not the Neuron/dossier/reading layer, not the client JavaScript/CSS under `assets/` (it only names those files in page shells), not the Lab (learning) side except through two shared primitives (`shared/session.js` signing, `shared/lab-sign-in.js` `readLabActiveAt`).

**Two words that are easy to misread.** In this repo "permit" is only the pipeline's vendor-request spacing queue (`makePermitQueue`), not an access permission. Access control is the **member model** in `flows-auth.js` (members are keys of the `FLOWS_CREDENTIALS` secret). "market" names five different things: `shared/flows-market.js` (nightly aggregate), the nightly `market` payload, the `live:market` Tier 1 key, `/flows/market/` (`marketPage`) and `assets/js/flows-market.js` (that page's client). "overlay" also means two things: `flows-overlay.js` (score-to-price join inside cards) versus the live overlays in `flows-live-worker.js` (`overlayPulse/overlayFlowalerts/overlayNews`, the `X-Live-Overlay` header).

**Neighbours.** Callers: `worker.js` (imports `flows-auth`, `flows-pages`, `flows-freshness`, `flows-live-worker` as `FLOWS_LIVE`, `flows-live`, `flows-archive`; re-exports `Pulse`), `scripts/flows-pipeline.mjs` (oidc, market, universe, permits, freshness), `scripts/flows-legs/*` (live, health, witness, watch, starts, focus, live-fake, live-world-fake, live-day), `shared/flows-rt*.js`, `shared/flows-dossier-worker.js`, `shared/flows-card.js`, `shared/flows-neuron.js`, `shared/flows-ask.js`, `scripts/generate-flows-credentials.mjs`. Callees: `shared/session.js`, `shared/flows-quant-time.js` (NYSE holiday and early-close rules), `shared/flows-alerts.js` (alert build/merge for live:alerts and tape), `shared/flows-focus.js` (focus roster), `shared/lab-sign-in.js`. Storage: D1 binding `DB` (`schema.sql`, `migrations/0005`, `0010`-`0016`), Cache API (`caches.default`), rate-limit binding `UW_ONDEMAND`. External: Unusual Whales REST (vendor), GitHub REST (workflow dispatch) and GitHub's OIDC JWKS.

#### Budgets and caps that matter here

- D1 on Workers Free: 100,000 rows written and 5,000,000 rows read per UTC day, shared account-wide. The ledger adds about 350 writes a weekday; Tier 1's read batch reads the 12 `flows_live` age rows each tick. Every `/api/flows/*` read route has a rows-read ceiling in `tests/flows-reads-contract.mjs` (CEILING list ~:755-776: for example `lk?k=market` 1, six-key home read 6, `now?n=...` 4, `pulse` 3, `live?t=` 2, summary 20, dossier 20) and the suite fails for any declared route without one.
- Workers Free CPU cap 10 ms per invocation: Tier 1 deliberately reads only two small feeds (the 390-row one-minute feeds moved to Tier 2 on 2026-09-24); the focus tick is held under 6 ms cold by `flows-live-contract`; the summary firing was split into its own cron for CPU reasons.
- Store quota: `STORE_QUOTA_RE` in worker.js:1030 turns D1 error 7500 into `503 store_quota` with `Retry-After` to 00:00 UTC; nightly views fall back to a 24-hour last-good Cache API copy (`LAST_GOOD_*`, worker.js:1038+) stamped `X-Fresh-State: stale`, `X-Fresh-Reason: store`. Live keys (`lk`, `now`) and the brief are not covered by that fallback.

#### Wire formats

- **Freshness headers** (from `freshHeaders`): `X-Fresh-State` live/fresh/closed/stale/pending; `X-Fresh-Reason`; `X-Fresh-Class`; `X-Fresh-Read-At`, `X-Fresh-Live-Until`, `X-Fresh-Stale-At`, `X-Fresh-Phase-Ends` (ISO or empty); `X-Fresh-Source`; `X-Fresh-Cadence`; `X-Fresh-Session`; `X-Fresh-Phase`; `X-Server-Now` (ms). Worker adds `X-Fresh-Throttled`, `X-Fresh-Last-Good`, `X-Live-Overlay` (`live:alerts`/`live:market`/`live:news`; on `/api/flows/brief` a comma list such as `live:market,live:alerts`), `X-Payload-Updated` (ms), `X-Tape` (fresh, stale-refreshing, stale-leased, refreshed, waited, stale-failed, stale-throttled, stale-unconfigured, unknown, and on a pending body the reason: unconfigured, throttled, unreadable, leased), `X-Tape-Legs`, `X-Quote-Ttl`, `X-Chain-Cache` (hit, miss, throttled), `X-Chain-Age`. The client parses them in `assets/js/flows-fresh.js` (`fromHeaders`), it hard-codes no thresholds.
- **`/api/flows/lk`**: one key returns the stored payload itself plus headers; several return `{serverNow, phase{phase,session,trading,endsAt}, keys: {<asked name>: {status:"ok"/"pending", payload, updatedAt, fresh{state,reason,klass,cadenceS,source,session,updatedAt,readAt,liveUntil,staleAt}}}}` with aggregate headers = worst state, earliest read/live-until/stale-at.
- **`/api/flows/now`**: `{serverNow, tier1{at,okAt,why}, clock{day,trading,earlyClose,closedDays}, expected, phase, keys{<id>: entry}, quote?}`. It never carries `labActiveAt`.
- **Ingest `clock` key** (nightly or live credential): `{key:"clock", clock{day,trading,earlyClose,closedDays,tier1,dispatchWhy,summaryAt}}`; nightly token only adds `labActiveAt` and `ledger{retainDays, days[]}`.
- **Session cookie** `flows_session`: `HttpOnly; Secure; SameSite=Lax; Path=/; Max-Age=1209600`, value `base64url(JSON{sub,aud:"flows",epoch,exp,uep?}).base64url(HMAC-SHA256)`.
- **Ingest results**: `{ok, key, bytes, stored: written/older-than-held}` for live; `stored: created/unchanged` for dated archive; errors `invalid_key` 400, `invalid_payload` 400, `invalid_fresh` 400, `too_large` 413, `wrong_writer` 403, `live_token_scope` 403, `nightly_token_scope` 403, `archive_immutable` 409, `archive_raced` 409, `archive_unreadable` 503.

### Flows

**Flow 1. Tier 1 tick (Worker cron `1-59/5 13-21 * * MON-FRI`)**
1. `worker.js:3950 scheduled()` computes `at` from `event.scheduledTime`, `FLOWS_LIVE.cronJob` (:3958) returns `rth`, `ensureFlowsTables` (:2583), `FLOWS_LIVE.rthTick(env, at, {fetchVendor: uwFetch})` (:3962).
2. `flows-live-worker.js:371 rthTick`: stamp `tier1_at` via `clockPatchStatement` (:375) batched with `ledgerTickStatement` (:377) through `batchWithLedger`; `telemetry` = whether that write succeeded.
3. `liveMode(env) === "off"`: write `tier1_why = "off"` and return (:380).
4. One D1 batch reads `flows_clock` and all `flows_live` age rows (:384); `normalizeClock`; `closedToday` and `verdictReprobeDue` (:392-397); a closed day without a re-probe writes `tier1_why = "holiday"` and returns.
5. If `reprobe || tier1Due(at, clock)` (:403): needs `UW_API_KEY`, else `why = "error:no-key"`; otherwise `tier1Reads` (:281, two calls, 6 s timeout each) then `sessionStatePatch` (:299, day roll, `verdictPatch` closed-day/open verdict, tape instants, early-close mark) then `shapeMarketLive` (flows-live.js:403) then, unless the reprobe still shows closed, `anyAnswered` (else `no-feed-answered`), cap check (else `over-cap`), `writeLiveStatement` for `live:market` and `patch.tier1OkAt` (:425-430).
6. `tier1_why` recorded when anything was due (:440); outcome ledger statement (:443-446) with `worstStale(liveRows, at, merged)`; `TIER1_FAILURES` (:289) decides `t1_fail`.
7. `liveDispatchDue(at, merged)` (:447); if due `dispatchWorkflow(env, "flows-live.yml", {tick, origin:"worker"})` (:449); records `dispatch_why`, `live_dispatched_at`.
8. Watchdog: `liveStalled(at, breadthReadAt, merged)` (:457) logs `live layer stalled`; if a token exists, no re-dispatch in the last 45 min and this tick did not already dispatch, dispatches with `origin: "watchdog"` and sets `live_redispatched_at` and `live_dispatched_at`.
9. Final `clockPatchStatement` + live write + ledger statement in one batch (:473-474), then `memoClock` (:475).

**Flow 2. Focus tick (`3-58/5 13-21 * * MON-FRI`)**: worker.js:3969 to `focusTick` (:504): batch read of clock, nightly `focus` groups/closes (`FOCUS_NIGHTLY_SQL`) and the held `live:focus` row's priced names (`FOCUS_HELD_SQL`); `focusDue` (:484) = Tier 1's due-test on a trading day; plan names with `focusStripNames` (cap 40); one `/api/screener/stocks` call; `priorCloseBase` from the nightly closes; `shapeStrips(... key:"live:focus", base)`; refuses to write when unusable, over cap, or when it would lose a name the held same-session row (still inside the 11-minute live window) priced (`partial`); `batchWithLedger` writes `live:focus` plus `ledgerFocusStatement`.

**Flow 3. Housekeeping and nightly dispatch (`*/30 * * * *`)**: worker.js:3978 `refreshMarketSnapshotIfDue`; :3982 `nightlyTick` (flows-live-worker.js:554): batch read clock and `meta.sessionDate`; `nightlyDispatchDue`; logs `nightly missing` from 21:00 ET when meta is behind; dispatches `flows-pipeline.yml` with `{origin:"worker"}`; on success patches `nightlyDay`/`nightlyDispatchedAt` (first) or `nightlyRedispatchedAt` (retry after 18:15 ET); then at ET 03:00-03:30 (`pruneDue` :588) `pruneTape` and `pruneLedger`. The Tier 2 loop independently dispatches the nightly at 17:30 ET (`scripts/flows-legs/starts.mjs` `NIGHTLY`), so two starters exist.

**Flow 4. Tier 2 write path (GitHub Actions `flows-live.yml`, `--live`)**
1. Workflow (`id-token: write`) runs `node scripts/flows-pipeline.mjs --live`; the leg (`scripts/flows-legs/live.mjs` `runLive`) reads boards and `focus` from the Worker (live credential may GET `NIGHTLY_READ_KEYS` and `clock`), makes up to about 41 vendor calls, shapes with `flows-live.js` functions and `put()`s each key (cap pre-check against `LIVE_KEYS[key].maxBytes`), heartbeat last.
2. Credential: `actionsIdToken` (flows-oidc.js:136) with audience `LIVE_OIDC.audience`; `FLOWS_LIVE_TOKEN` is used instead only if set (local runs).
3. `POST /api/flows/ingest?key=live:...`: worker.js:3454; `looksLikeJwt` (:3458); `tokenKind` (static compare, :3463) else `oidcKind` (:3465): `verifyLiveOidc` against `jwksKeys`; `unavailable` gives 503 so the pipeline retries.
4. `key.startsWith("live:")` (:3514): `ingestScope` (live may not DELETE; nightly may not write live), `ensureFlowsTables`, body read bounded to 128 KiB, `ingestLive` (flows-live-worker.js:695): `Object.hasOwn(LIVE_KEYS)` else 400; `text.length > maxBytes` gives 413; `checkLiveWrite(..., {source:"actions"})`; `writeLiveStatement` (monotonic); for `live:heartbeat` also `clockPatchStatement({liveDoneAt: now})` and `heartbeatLedger` appended via `batchWithLedger`.
5. The Worker next sees it through lk/now and, for `live:breadth`, through the watchdog's `breadthReadAt`.

**Flow 5. Reader path for a live key**: browser `GET /api/flows/lk?k=market,breadth` (worker.js:3661) after `currentFlowsUser`; `ensureFlowsTables`; `serveLiveKey` (flows-live-worker.js:785): `liveParams` (max 8); single key `batchWithClock(SELECT ... WHERE id = ?)` then `liveResponse` (row payload + `freshHeaders(liveMeta(row), now, clock)`); several keys `readLiveRows` then `liveEnvelope` (:755). A failed batch behaves differently by shape: the multi-key read throws 503 `store_unreadable` (no last-good fallback for live keys), but the single-key read cannot tell a failed batch from a missing row and answers 200 `{key, status: "pending"}` with pending headers.

**Flow 6. Overlay path (`pulse`, `flowalerts`, `news`)**: worker.js:3652 to `readWithOverlay` (:2097) to `readOverlayRows(db, key, OVERLAID[key], now)` (flows-live-worker.js:1184; one batch: nightly row, live row, clock if due) to `overlayPulse` (:1158; `pulseWithLive` flows-live.js:1273 needs live tide `ok`, not older than the nightly session, newer `readAt`, and keeps a nightly river over a lone live point), `overlayFlowalerts` (:1153; `liveAlertsWin`: live session strictly newer than the nightly's) or `overlayNews` (:1169; `liveNewsWins`: newer session, or same session and newer read; `newsWithLive`). A null overlay falls through to `passthrough(stored)` with nightly headers. Responses carry `X-Live-Overlay`.

**Flow 7. Heartbeat (`/api/flows/now`)**: `serveNow` (flows-live-worker.js:871) validates `k` against live keys and `n` against `NOW_NIGHTLY_KEYS` or `card:<T>`; one batch (live ages, nightly metadata via `json_extract`, clock if due); each key becomes an `entryOf(freshHeaders(...).fresh)`; adds `tier1`, `clock`, `expected` nightly session, `phase`; optional `t` runs the quote service.

**Flow 8. Quote and tape**: `/api/flows/live?t=` (worker.js:3756) to `quoteResponse` (:2082) to `serveQuote` (:946): `cachedClock`, TTL by phase, Cache API hit within TTL returns with `X-Chain-Cache: hit`; limiter refusal returns the stale entry with `X-Fresh-Throttled`; otherwise `buildLivePayload` (`/api/stock/<T>/stock-state`) and a `waitUntil` cache put. `/api/flows/tape?t=` (:3672) to `serveTape` (:1068): batch of tape row (+ admission check `KNOWN_SQL`), fresh if inside `tapeTtlMs`; otherwise claim a 20 s lease with `UPDATE ... WHERE refreshing_until IS NULL OR < now`; winner refreshes one leg (`prem` then `gex`, older leg first) in `waitUntil` while serving the stale row, or inline when nothing usable exists; losers wait up to 1.5 s then answer `waited` or `pending`.

**Flow 9. Sign-in and page render**: `POST /flows/login` (worker.js:3350): `requireSameOrigin`; secrets present; `parseCredentials` (members or null); form read (4 KiB); `flowsThrottleKey` (:2600) = bucket + `|` + normalised address; `flowsLockRecord` (:2604) + `isLocked`; `verifyCredential` (flows-auth.js:137); failure to `recordFlowsFailure` (:2614; also deletes rows older than the window) and a 401 login page; success clears the failure row (unless the bucket is the shared `*`), `signFlowsSession(..., memberOf(credentials, verified).epoch)`, cookie, 303. Page request: `Object.hasOwn(FLOWS_ROUTES, path)` (:3428) then `currentFlowsUser` (:904) = `getCookie` + `verifyFlowsSession(token, SESSION_SECRET, sessionEpoch(env), readMembers(FLOWS_CREDENTIALS))` then the page function (Home also loads the board summary) or `loginPage()`.

**Flow 10. Dated archive write**: nightly token `POST /api/flows/ingest?key=board:long:2026-10-02` (worker.js:3560): `DATED_ARCHIVE_KEY_RE` (:935) matches; `readFlowsPayload` with a failure trace; `archiveWriteAction({readable, exists, same})`; `unchanged` returns `stored: "unchanged"`; refusals map through `ARCHIVE_REFUSALS`; otherwise `INSERT ... ON CONFLICT(id) DO NOTHING` and zero changes means `refuse_raced` (409). The SQLite trigger is the storage-level backstop for anything that tries `UPDATE`.

**Flow 11. Ledger lifecycle**: writers (Flows 1, 2, 4, nightly `meta` write at worker.js:3594) all append one statement to a batch they already issue; `batchWithLedger` degrades to the core statements if the ledger statement throws. Reader: nightly pipeline `GET ingest?key=clock` with the nightly token returns `ledger`; `scripts/flows-legs/health.mjs` `ledgerChecks` compares `gapMs` with `LEDGER_LIMITS`. Retention: `pruneLedger` at ET 03:00-03:30, rows older than 30 days.

**Flow 12. OIDC verification**: bearer shaped like a JWT, 8,192 chars max, then `claimsProblem` (all policy claims), then `jwksKeys` (module-global memo per URL, 1 h TTL), `kid` lookup with one forced refresh, then WebCrypto RSASSA-PKCS1-v1_5 verify; any failure is a 401, an unavailable key set is a 503.

### Invariants and traps

**Time and freshness**
- Worker cron weekdays must be written by NAME (`MON-FRI`): Cloudflare numbers weekdays 1 = Sunday; numeric `1-5` ran Sunday to Thursday and Tier 1 never ticked on Friday 2026-09-25. Held by `tests/flows-live-contract.mjs`:988. The GitHub workflow files use standard numeric cron.
- The cron strings in `wrangler.toml` must equal `RTH_CRON`, `FOCUS_CRON`, `HOUSEKEEPING_CRON`, `SUMMARY_CRON` and the focus ticks must fall between Tier 1's: `tests/flows-freshness-contract.mjs`:270-290 (also asserts `REFRESH_CADENCE_MINUTES` equals the Tier 1 step and `live:focus.cadenceS` equals the focus step). A deploy that leaves old triggers never runs the focus tick; `cronJob`'s minute-based fallback is deliberately shaped so no job runs at another's minutes (`flows-live-contract`:925-960).
- An undecided day (`flows_clock.trading` NULL) is a TRADING day; only an explicit `0` closes it (`Number(null)` is 0 and once silenced Tier 1 for a day). A closed verdict needs two agreeing probes at least 15 minutes apart; one probe is provisional. `tests/flows-verdict-contract.mjs` sweeps a recovering vendor.
- `nyseHolidays` / `nyseEarlyCloses` live in `shared/flows-quant-time.js` (rule-based, with a `SPECIAL_CLOSURES` list for one-off closures such as 2025-01-09). A new exchange rule or one-off closure is edited there, then `flows-freshness-contract` (it holds the published 2026-2028 schedule and proves the Eastern arithmetic equals the IANA zone at every half hour over a rolling YEAR_NOW-1 to YEAR_NOW+6 window).
- The nightly is due at 21:00 ET (close + 5 h) on every session including early closes; do not shrink `FRESH_CLASSES.nightly.graceS` (the 20:08 ET landing made the older 3 h grace false-alarm every evening).
- `FRESH_CLASSES` is pinned verbatim by `flows-live-contract`:55-61 (every cadence/live/stale number). `LEDGER_LIMITS` and the witness thresholds (`WITNESS.tier1StaleMs`, `tier2StaleMs`) are derived from it, so changing a class moves three subsystems at once.
- `rt*` classes apply their windows in pre-market and post-market (`extended: true`); other classes are RTH-only and outside it become `closed`/`session-final` only when the read covers the last close less one cadence, else `stale`/`missed-close`.
- `isRefreshWindow` (09:15-16:15 ET weekdays) is not holiday aware; it gates only the landing-page market snapshot refresh.

**Live layer**
- One writer per `live:*` key. Worker writes only `live:market` and `live:focus` (`writeLiveStatement`, never through ingest); Actions writes the other ten through ingest. `flows-live-contract`:68-70 asserts exactly those two are `writer: "worker"`.
- The live credential may write `live:*` only, read only `NIGHTLY_READ_KEYS` plus live keys, and never DELETE; the nightly credential may not write live keys. `--live` mode in `scripts/flows-pipeline.mjs` throws before the network for any non-live key and uses a live credential only (scanned by `flows-live-contract`:742-745; :750 also asserts the live workflow file mentions no ingest, live or dispatch token).
- `shared/flows-live-worker.js` must never contain `INSERT [OR IGNORE] INTO / UPDATE / DELETE FROM flows_payload` text (regex scan, `flows-live-contract`:732-737; the trigger DDL `BEFORE UPDATE ON flows_payload` is fine). The scheduled handler must write no nightly row either.
- Source-text scans that pin formatting: `serveIngestClock` must keep the literal `const body = { key: "clock", clock: ingestClockView(clock) };` and `serveNow` the line `    clock: clockView(clock),` (`flows-live-contract`:2189-2192); `serveNow` must stay between `export async function serveNow(` and `export function quoteTtlS(` and mention no `labActiveAt` (:2897-2899); the ingest route must serve `key === "clock"` only after the `if (!tokenKind) throw new HttpError(401` line and for GET only. `mergeLiveAlerts` must keep the `if (!(alerts.status === "ok" && alerts.rows.length)) { return { write: null` empty-read guard and call `buildFlowAlerts` with `stageComplete: false` (`flows-alerts-contract`:477-485, 556+).
- `labActiveAt` and the ledger never ride the public `/api/flows/now` or the live-token clock view; only the nightly token gets them.
- `writeLiveStatement` refuses to move a row backwards (`WHERE excluded.read_at >= flows_live.read_at`); the ingest answer then says `stored: "older-than-held"` (status 200).
- Tier 1 CPU: do not add feeds to Tier 1; the three 390-row feeds were moved to Tier 2 because ~10 ms of CPU killed the tick silently before its D1 write. `flows-live-contract` times cold and warm ticks in child processes on the thread CPU clock (cold under 6 ms for focus).
- A partial read never replaces a fuller held row: `focusTick` withholds a write that would lose a name the same-session held row priced while that row is inside its 11-minute live window.
- `live:alerts` is written only when a pass finds a new alert, so its age is not a liveness signal; the pill counts only keys whose heartbeat is the right measure.
- A day change is always against a dated close: `priorCloseBase` (flows-live.js:671) offers nightly closes only from sources whose `sessionDate` is the trading day before the live session, and `shapeStrips` (flows-live.js:699, the `declined` test at :738) then drops the whole fill (`prevFill.declined = "disagrees"`) when the vendor's own `prev_close` disagrees with the nightly close by more than 0.05% (`FILL_AGREE.tol`) on more than 10% of the names it could check (`minChecked` 5, `share` 0.9). `priorCloseBase` itself does no agreement test.
- `ensureFlowsTables` is a single-flight bootstrap using a module global (`flowsSchemaReady`) and the clock memo, `clockFlight`, `jwksMemo` are isolate-global; tests that import `worker.js` into Node must reset or reuse them deliberately (`resetJwksMemo`, `memoClock`).
- `clockPatchStatement` silently ignores keys not in `CLOCK_COLUMNS`; `batchWithClock` returns `{results: null}` (not throws) when the batch fails: callers must handle null.
- Three DDL copies must agree: `schema.sql`, `migrations/*.sql` and the Worker's first-use strings. `flows-live-contract`:889-920 compares `flows_live`, `flows_tape` and `flows_clock` column lists (order included, `flows_clock` = migration 0010 columns then `CLOCK_ADDED_COLUMNS`); `flows-ledger-contract`:64-67 compares `LEDGER_SCHEMA_SQL` with `schema.sql`; `tests/academy-contract.mjs`:118-120 requires migrations 0001+0002+0004+0005+0010+0015+0016 to create exactly the tables in `schema.sql` (a new table adds its migration number there). `flows-reads-contract`:206 asserts the schema batch has 13 statements (a new Flows table changes it).
- A `CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS` never replaces an existing trigger: changing the archive GLOB needs a `DROP TRIGGER` migration, not an edit of the DDL strings.
- `LIVE_KEY_RE` allows only letters in each segment; key names with digits or hyphens will fail `liveKeyFromParam`, `checkLiveWrite` and the pipeline's `publish()` guard (`/^live:[a-z]+(?::[a-z]+)?$/` is duplicated in `scripts/flows-pipeline.mjs` and scanned by the contract).
- `/api/flows/lk` and `/now` are not covered by the last-good Cache API fallback; a D1 outage answers 503 `store_unreadable` on `now` and on a multi-key `lk`, but a single-key `lk` answers 200 `pending` (`serveLiveKey` reads `results` as null and falls through to the pending branch).
- Every new `/api/flows/<name>` route needs a rows-read ceiling in `tests/flows-reads-contract.mjs` or the suite fails; nightly-served names also belong in `LAST_GOOD_PATHS` (worker.js:1041) to be covered by the 24 h fallback.

**Auth and members**
- A missing or unparsable `FLOWS_CREDENTIALS` fails closed: `readMembers` returns the frozen empty `NO_MEMBERS` (truthy), `verifyFlowsSession` then refuses every session; sign-in answers 503. It never falls back to `FLOWS_USERNAMES` in production (the legacy branch runs only when `members` is null, which the Worker never passes).
- Failures are uniform (same 401 page for unknown, mistyped, ended or revoked); unknown users still pay for a PBKDF2 derivation against a decoy so timing does not reveal membership; guessed names share one throttle counter per address (IPv6 collapsed to /64) and never key a row.
- 10,000 PBKDF2 iterations is a CPU-cap constraint; raising it risks the Workers Free 10 ms cap on sign-in. The salt, the NUL separator and the pepper placement are part of every stored hash: changing `deriveHash` invalidates every member.
- Rotating `FLOWS_PEPPER` or passwords signs nobody out; only raising a member's `epoch` (claim `uep`), removing the member, ending `until`, or bumping `FLOWS_SESSION_EPOCH` does. `FLOWS_SESSION_EPOCH` is a `[vars]` entry (currently "2").
- The Lab cookie `session` and the Flows cookie `flows_session` share `SESSION_SECRET`; separation is the `aud` claim (`isLearnAudience` for Lab, `aud === "flows"` for Flows), asserted bidirectionally in `flows-auth-contract`.
- `members` limit: 5,000 bytes as a Cloudflare secret (`MEMBER_SECRET_MAX_BYTES`), enforced by the mint script, not the Worker.
- `LOCKOUT.lockSeconds` is unused; a lock simply lasts until 15 minutes after `first_at`.

**Pages**
- `ASSET_VERSION` here, `assets/version.txt` and every `?v=` must move together (`flows-features`:845-849, `contracts.mjs`). Pages emit only CSS/JS at the asset version; font URLs live in `base.css`, not here.
- Every script/CSS a page emits must exist on disk (`flows-features`:842-871) and every page function gets a per-route JS ceiling in `flows-weight.mjs` (a `*Page` export without a ceiling, or a ceiling for a removed page, fails).
- Script order on the ticker page is a contract: `flows-ui` before `flows-fresh` before `flows-quant-read.bundle` before `flows-ticker`; the dock script is emitted before `flows-ui.js` on every page except Ask.
- The login page returns status 200 for a signed-out visit to any gated Flows route (no redirect), and its HTML is `no-store` and CSP-covered by `finalize()`. Username and summary text are escaped; other interpolations in the file are static strings.
- Shared chrome (`shell`, `sidebar`, `toolbar`, `tabbar`, `dock`) is served on every signed-in page, so any wording there reaches the unusual page too (`flows-pages.js` holds no HTML comments at this commit; the test message still names the old helpers `rail()` and `topbar()`); `contracts.mjs`:1190-1211 scans the unusual page's full HTML for banned transaction wording outside its refusal prose.
- The shell must keep emitting `/assets/js/flows-dock.js` (it owns the `?` key): `contracts.mjs`:1120-1155 reads `shared/flows-pages.js` as `SHELL`, asserts the dock script is still emitted, and fails if any script a page (or any static HTML that loads the dock) shares with the dock binds a bare printable key at document level. A new page script that listens for a plain key on `document` trips it.
- `neuronMark` (flows-pages.js:200) is dead code; `FLOWS_PAGES` is the Worker's page bag.

**Archive, permits, universe, panels, overlay**
- Dated boards are the record the accuracy claims are computed from. `board:long:<day>`, `board:short:<day>`, `scores:<day>` rows are insert-once (`ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING`), compared byte-for-byte on a repeat write (`unchanged`), otherwise 409; unreadable existing row is 503 and never overwritten. `board:watch` is not archived.
- `DATED_ARCHIVE_KEY_RE` (worker.js:935) and the trigger GLOBs (live-worker.js:33-36, `schema.sql`:226, `0010`) describe the same two families and must change together.
- `makePermitQueue.defer(ms)` returns only the increment it added so a coalesced 429 volley is not double-charged; `enter()` releases are idempotent.
- `shared/flows-panels.js` is not browser-facing any more; its registry is held against three other artefacts by `flows-ticker-contract`:177-211: the `PANEL_MOD` map in `assets/js/flows-ticker.js`, the module ids that page builds, and the pipeline's `const shed = [` ladder (which may name only registry panels and never a sentinel). Registry ids must be unique, `question` longer than 8 chars, `title` longer than 2.
- `SELECTION_EPOCH` marks a break in board comparability; bumping it changes how the record scorer splits cohorts. `NDX_100` is a dated fallback constant (`NDX_AS_OF`); `NDX_STALE_DAYS` triggers a pipeline warning only.
- `joinScoreToPrice` joins by session date, never by array position; a missing score stays a gap (null), never zero.

**Source versus docs (disagreements found)**
- AGENTS.md's file map has no rows for `shared/flows-auth.js`, `shared/flows-pages.js` (named only for `ASSET_VERSION`), `flows-archive.js`, `flows-permits.js`, `flows-overlay.js`, `flows-market.js`, `flows-universe.js` or `shared/flows-panels.js` (only test names appear in the suite list). Its `flows-live-worker.js` row omits the focus tick, nightly dispatch tick, clock memo/flights, JWKS cache, ingest clock/ledger views and prunes (covered in DEPLOY 10.5i).
- AGENTS.md's "`flows-panels.js` ... deleted" refers to the browser file `assets/js/flows-panels.js`; `shared/flows-panels.js` still exists and is live (Neuron evidence). Most of its fields (`id`, `span`, `tier`, `question`, `blurb`, `hash`, groups) have no runtime reader.
- Declared-but-unused values: `LIVE_BUDGET.ondemandPerMinute` (the real limit is wrangler's `UW_ONDEMAND`), `LIVE_BUDGET.tier2MaxCalls` (tests only), `LOCKOUT.lockSeconds`, `FLOWS_LIVE_MODE = "worker"` (same as `actions`), `lastCompletedSession` (tests only), `scoreRowFor` (tests only).
- DEPLOY 10.4c says the thirteen home reads cost 23 rows; the test only asserts `home <= 30`.
- `FLOWS_USERNAMES` still has a 12-name count assertion in `flows-auth-contract`:25 although production grants nothing from it.

### How to change it

**Change a freshness threshold or add a class.** Edit `FRESH_CLASSES` (flows-freshness.js:3). Then update the pinned table in `tests/flows-live-contract.mjs`:55-61, the live key `cadenceS` it implies (`LIVE_KEYS` reads the table; `checkLiveWrite` requires `fresh.cadenceS` to match, so a leg that stamps a different cadence is refused), `LEDGER_LIMITS` and `WITNESS` derive automatically but their test messages quote minutes (grep 25/45 in `flows-ledger-contract`, `flows-starts-contract`, `flows-live-contract`), DEPLOY.md 10.5i text and AGENTS.md. Run `flows-freshness`, `flows-live`, `flows-ledger`, `flows-starts`, `flows-verdict`, `flows-readers`, `flows-rt`. Client needs no code change (it reads headers) unless the pill copy quotes minutes.

**Change a Worker cron or its cadence.** Edit `wrangler.toml` `[triggers].crons` and the matching `*_CRON` constant (flows-live-worker.js:70-73) and, for Tier 1/focus, `FRESH_CLASSES.market.cadenceS` and `REFRESH_CADENCE_MINUTES`. Keep weekdays as names. Run `flows-freshness-contract`, `flows-live-contract`, `flows-worker-contract` (cron `tick` helper :1666), `worker-regression` (imports only `HOUSEKEEPING_CRON` and `SUMMARY_CRON`, :10, and fires them through the real scheduled handler at :196-211; the Tier 1 and focus strings are pinned by `flows-live-contract`:980-990 and `flows-freshness-contract`:270-290). After deploy: `wrangler triggers deploy` if the dashboard shows old triggers; the nightly health gate names a missing cron.

**Add or change a live key.** (1) `LIVE_KEYS` entry (flows-live.js:13; letters-only key; `maxBytes` under 120 KiB; `writer` worker or actions; `klass`). (2) A pure shaper in flows-live.js that stamps `freshEnvelope` with the registry cadence/source. (3) Actions writer: add the call and `put("live:...")` in `scripts/flows-legs/live.mjs` (watch the 48-call budget and `LIVE_BUDGET.tier2PaceMs`); Worker writer: add to `rthTick`/`focusTick`-style code with `writeLiveStatement`. (4) Readers: `/api/flows/lk` and `/now` serve any registered key automatically; add the name to the page's `UI.heartbeat({keys})` and loader in `assets/js/*` if a page uses it (bump `assets/version.txt` and `ASSET_VERSION`). (5) Nightly-class overlay of the same data needs `OVERLAID` (worker.js:2095), an `overlay*` function and `live*Wins` rule. (6) Tests: `flows-live-contract` (registry, shape, caps, one-writer), `flows-freshness-contract`, `flows-payload-shape`:872, health/witness only if a gate should watch it (`scripts/flows-legs/health.mjs`, `witness.mjs`). Update DEPLOY 10.5i.

**Change what Tier 1 or the focus tick reads or writes.** `rthTick` (flows-live-worker.js:371) / `focusTick` (:504); vendor calls are `TIER1_CALLS` (flows-live.js:81) and `FOCUS_READ` (:482). Keep CPU low (see traps); run `flows-live-contract` (it includes CPU-budget child processes), `flows-verdict-contract`, `flows-ledger-contract`, `flows-reads-contract`.

**Add a column to `flows_clock`.** New migration (`ALTER TABLE flows_clock ADD COLUMN ...`, one statement per line), add the column at the END of the `flows_clock` block in `schema.sql`, append to `CLOCK_ADDED_COLUMNS` (flows-live-worker.js:39) and add the camelCase mapping to `CLOCK_COLUMNS` (:99), expose it in `normalizeClock` consumers/views if needed. Tests that pin the order: `flows-live-contract`:896-920 and :1746-1753. That block reads migrations `0010`, `0011`, `0012` and `0014` by file name (`clockMigration`, `verdictMigration`, `summaryMigration`, :885-888) and sums their `ALTER` lines into `added` (:900), asserting each such migration holds nothing but ALTERs, so a new column's migration must be added to that read list as well. No new table, so `academy-contract` is unaffected.

**Add a Flows D1 table.** Migration `NNNN_*.sql` (IF NOT EXISTS), `schema.sql`, a DDL string added to `FLOWS_SCHEMA_SQL` (worker.js:132) or `LIVE_SCHEMA_SQL`, add the migration number to the list in `tests/academy-contract.mjs`:118-120, update the 13-statement assertion in `flows-reads-contract`:206, add the table to `tests/dossier-harness.mjs`-style fakes if used, and price any new read in rows.

**Add or change a ledger counter.** Edit `LEDGER_SCHEMA_SQL`, the statement builder, `ledgerRowView`, `schema.sql` (+ a migration; an `ALTER` is needed for existing production), the health gate reader `ledgerChecks` in `scripts/flows-legs/health.mjs`. Tests: `flows-ledger-contract` (DDL parity, real-SQLite behaviour), `flows-live-contract` (health text), `flows-verdict-contract`. Remember each writer must append to a batch that already exists (zero extra round trips is tested).

**Change the Tier 2 credential or OIDC policy.** `LIVE_OIDC` (flows-oidc.js:3) must match `.github/workflows/flows-live.yml` (file name and `main` ref are inside `workflowRef`, `ref`), the audience must match `actionsIdToken`'s default used by `scripts/flows-pipeline.mjs`:75-110, and the repository ids are GitHub's numeric ids. Tests: `flows-live-contract` (`O.*`, lifetime/skew), `flows-worker-contract`:1635-1790 (needs `FLOWS_TEST_SANDBOX=1` in the sandbox). Production keeps `GITHUB_OIDC_JWKS` and `FLOWS_LIVE_TOKEN` unset.

**Add, renew or revoke a member.** No code change and no deploy: `node scripts/generate-flows-credentials.mjs --add|--set|--remove ... --from members.json --out members.json`, then `wrangler secret put FLOWS_CREDENTIALS < members.json` (DEPLOY 10.2a). To sign everyone out raise `FLOWS_SESSION_EPOCH` in `wrangler.toml` and deploy. Code changes to the member model: `flows-auth.js` with `flows-auth-contract` (494), `flows-mint-contract`, and `flows-worker-contract` login sections; both the mint script and the Worker use `memberRecord`, so keep them in step.

**Add or change a Flows page.**
1. Page function in `flows-pages.js` (use `flowsDocument` for new pages), export it from `FLOWS_PAGES` (1041), add the nav item to `FLOWS_NAV` (93) and, for mobile, to `TABS` (119).
2. Route in `FLOWS_ROUTES` (worker.js:3409) and the bare-path 308 list (:3444-3451).
3. Client assets under `assets/js/` and `assets/css/`; bump `assets/version.txt`, `ASSET_VERSION`, every `?v=` reference; run `grep -rn 'woff2?v=' --include=*.html --include=*.css .` to restore font tokens after a blanket rewrite.
4. A ceiling in `CEILING_KIB` (`tests/flows-weight.mjs`:12) or the suite fails.
5. Tests: `flows-features` (assets exist, version), `flows-weight`, the page's own render/contract suite, `flows-worker-contract` route tests, `contracts.mjs`. New `/api/flows/*` calls need a ceiling in `flows-reads-contract`; register any new suite in `tests/package.json` (add the `test:*` script and append it to the `test` chain; mind that the chain stops at the first failure and ordering hides later suites).
6. Update the inline copy blocks (`#dkCopy`, `#ftCopy`, `#sgCopy`) only together with the client and test that quote them.

**Add or remove a script/CSS on an existing page.** Edit its `scripts`/`styles` array (or the explicit `<script>` lines for overview/side/watch/market/events/unusual/political); keep ticker order; run `flows-weight` and `flows-features`; if a page's JS grows past its ceiling, raising the ceiling is a deliberate diff.

**Change archive behaviour.** Decision logic in `archiveWriteAction`/`ARCHIVE_REFUSALS` (flows-archive.js) and the ingest branch (worker.js:3560-3592); key family in `DATED_ARCHIVE_KEY_RE` (worker.js:935), `INGEST_VIEW_KEY_RE`, the pipeline's sweep and the trigger (needs a DROP/CREATE migration). Tests: `flows-worker-contract` (archive sections), `flows-pipeline-contract`, `flows-live-contract`:889-896. DELETE is allowed only for dated archive keys (and card/card-x/hist for the nightly token).

**Change the pipeline's vendor pacing.** `makePermitQueue` (flows-permits.js) semantics are pinned by `flows-permits-contract` (213); the rate controller and queue wiring are in `scripts/flows-pipeline.mjs` (:144 `RATE`, :368/:375 queues, :551-592 request loop).

**Change universe selection, market aggregate or roster.** `flows-universe.js` / `flows-market.js` are consumed only by the pipeline; run `flows-universe-contract` (no server) and, for the aggregate, `flows-market-contract` (workerd) plus `flows-pipeline-contract` and `flows-payload-shape`. Refresh `NDX_100`/`NDX_AS_OF` when the QQQ holdings read starts failing (the pipeline warns after `NDX_STALE_DAYS`). Bump `SELECTION_EPOCH` only to declare boards non-comparable.

**Add a ticker card panel.** Add the spec to `TICKER_PANELS` (flows-panels.js:1) in the right group, publish it from the card builder (`shared/flows-card.js`), place it in `PANEL_MOD` in `assets/js/flows-ticker.js`, name it in the pipeline's `shed` ladder if it can be dropped to fit bytes, and update the Neuron's figure keys in `flows-neuron.js` if its evidence should read it. Tests: `flows-ticker-contract`, `flows-neuron`, `flows-card-contract`. The generated or card payload size budgets (`flows-weight` for JS, payload byte caps in the pipeline) may need attention.

**Test-running notes for this area.** No workerd needed: `flows-freshness`, `flows-live`, `flows-ledger`, `flows-verdict`, `flows-reads`, `flows-readers`, `flows-starts`, `flows-auth`, `flows-mint`, `flows-permits`, `flows-overlay`, `flows-universe`, `flows-weight`, `flows-features`, `flows-ticker-contract`, `flows-rt-contract`, `flows-rt-client` (Chromium). `flows-ledger`, `flows-verdict`, `flows-reads`, `flows-readers`, `flows-dossier-reads`, `flows-reading-worker` need Node 22.13+ and `--disable-warning=ExperimentalWarning` (they use `node:sqlite`; the npm scripts already do). Need workerd (`FLOWS_TEST_SANDBOX=1 node <suite>` in the agent sandbox): `flows-worker-contract`, `worker-regression`, `flows-market-contract`, `flows-rt-server`. Run from `tests/` after `npm ci`; Chromium suites need `PLAYWRIGHT_BROWSERS_PATH`.

## Flows payload builders A: card, cross, regime, features, alerts, scores

Snapshot: `/home/user/anilkaya.org` at `ba2acfe` (origin/main after PR 148, asset version 240, fonts token 230). Ten pure ES modules under `shared/` (5,911 lines in all): none touches `process`, `fetch`, `env`, `Date.now`, `Math.random` or `structuredClone` (only `Intl.DateTimeFormat` in `flows-cross.js:106` and `flows-catalysts.js:187`), none carries comments, and none is bundled into the browser (`flows-quant-browser.js` / the two `flows-quant*.bundle.js` files import none of them). Every line number below came from `grep -n` / `sed -n` on this commit. "L123" in prose means line 123 of the file under discussion.

### Purpose and boundaries

What this area is: the **pure payload builders** the nightly pipeline (`scripts/flows-pipeline.mjs`, GitHub Actions) and a few Worker/live paths call to turn vendor rows (Unusual Whales REST rows) into the JSON documents stored in D1 `flows_payload` / `flows_live` and served under `/api/flows/*`. Builders take plain rows and options, return plain JSON, never throw on absent input (they return `{status:"unavailable"|"quiet"|"thin", reason}` instead), and never turn a null into a zero ("a gap is not a zero" is the repository's central rule here).

| Module | Builds | Stored key (D1 id) |
|---|---|---|
| `flows-card.js` | the per-name **card**: 23 panels plus score, conviction, regime block | `card:<T>` (and the pipeline later attaches `engine`, `x.vol`, `readPx`, `gate`) |
| `flows-cross.js` | the **universe** column store, the numeric/date helpers every leg shares, `SILENCE` vocabulary | `universe` |
| `flows-regime.js` | shapers for the **regime** payload (0DTE, tides, fund flows, implied correlation, group flow, vol curve, options pulse, daily report) | `regime` (assembled in `scripts/flows-legs/regime.mjs`) |
| `flows-features.js` | score maths and per-name features (robust z, neutralisation, gamma ladder/crossings, path signature, Greek term structures, conviction, hysteresis) | no key of its own; feeds `board:*` rows, `scores:*` and every card |
| `flows-warnings.js` | cross-payload contradiction checks | rides inside `brief` (`warnings`, `warningsChecked`, `warningsQuestions`) |
| `flows-brief.js` | the three-session briefing (today / yesterday / next) | `brief` (with `silences`, `facts` from `flows-ask.js`) |
| `flows-alerts.js` | vendor flow-alert rows, the session **record** merge, the movers contract band | `flowalerts` (nightly), `live:alerts` (live layer), `movers.premium.byContract` |
| `flows-catalysts.js` | earnings history, earnings/economic/FDA calendars, reaction gauge | `events` additions (macro, fda, earningsCalendar, history) and `card-x:<T>.earnings` |
| `flows-scores.js` | dated score archive rows and the pooled score trace | `scores:YYYY-MM-DD` and `scoretrack` |
| `flows-focus.js` | focus roster constants, NDX-10 derivation, strip planner (a **leaf**) | roster for the `focus` payload built in `scripts/flows-legs/focus.mjs` |

What this area is not: the options engine (`flows-quant-*`, `flows-variation.js`, `flows-neuron*.js`: the card calls `variation()` and `bookLevels()` and reads `regimeState` downstream but does not own them), the chain panels (`flows-chain.js` builds `ivSurface/skewTerm/topContracts/aggressor`; the card only wraps them), the stock-level shapers (`flows-stock.js`: darkpool, OI change, vol context), the live layer (`flows-live.js`, `flows-live-worker.js`, `flows-rt*.js`: they call `buildFlowAlerts`/`mergeAlerts`/`alertRow`/`focusStripNames`), the Worker routes (`worker.js`: only passes the stored JSON through), the pipeline orchestration (`scripts/flows-pipeline.mjs`, legs), the dossier/reading layer (reads `UNIVERSE_COLUMNS`, `earningsHistory`, `sessionsBetween`), and every browser renderer (`assets/js/flows-*.js`).

Neighbours (who feeds these modules and who reads their output):
- Producers: `scripts/flows-pipeline.mjs` (7,126 lines) and `scripts/flows-legs/{universe,regime,market,events,ownership,focus,index-dossier,card-x,vol}.mjs`.
- Storage and serving: `worker.js` ingest (`/api/flows/ingest`, L3454) and read routes (L3601-3860), `schema.sql` (`flows_payload`, `flows_live`, immutability trigger `flows_archive_immutable`).
- Consumers of the payload shapes: `assets/js/flows-ticker.js` (card panels), `flows-board.js` / `flows-history.js` / `flows-track.js` (scoretrack), `flows-market.js` (regime, universe), `flows-events.js` (events), `flows-unusual.js` (flowalerts), `flows-ask.js` (brief), `flows-overview.js` (focus); Worker SQL in `worker.js` (`LITE_SQL` L1106) and `shared/flows-dossier-worker.js` (`DOSSIER_SQL` L64); `shared/flows-neuron-screen.js`, `flows-neuron-coverage.js`, `flows-dossier.js`.
