### Data and interfaces

#### Payloads these modules produce

**`card:<T>`** (D1 `flows_payload.id`; `buildCard` L1541). Top level: `v` (3), `ticker`, `depth` (`board` default; `cross-section` when `unfetched`; pipeline overrides to `focus` at `flows-pipeline.mjs:6524`; `index`/`fund` set by `buildIndexDossiers`, `index-dossier.mjs:66`), `nm`, `sector`, `generatedAt`, `sessionDate`, `score`, `conviction`, `fam` (F, P, D, O, V sub-scores), `weights`, `conv{agreement,breadth,coverage,persistence,weights,gate}`, `quality{otmShare,vegaTilt}`, `regime{label,labelFrom,labelValue,flowGamma,flowGross,flowLabel,bookGammaRaw,bookShare,crossingSide,spotGammaShare,crossings,crossingSeparation,bandMin,bandMax,bookGamma}` or null, `strikeSumCrossing`, `zeroGamma`, `atr`, `panels{}`. The pipeline later adds `readPx` (`readPxOf`, `flows-pipeline.mjs:1140`), `x.vol` (`attachVol`, `flows-legs/vol.mjs:295`), `gate{earnings,dte}` with `score`/`conviction` nulled (`markGate`, `flows-pipeline.mjs:3368`), and the `engine` block (`QP.attachEngine`; may spill to `card-x:<T>` with `engine.status:"split"`; Worker merges at `worker.js:1011-1036`).

Panels (key: builder, input, notes): `gamma` buildGammaProfile (strike rows, <=500 per page, <=60 bars); `surface` buildSurface (expiry-strike rows; 21 strikes x 8 expiries); `levels` buildLevels (+ `.zeroGamma` from quant, `.book` from `bookLevels`); `scoreOverlay` scoreOverlayPanel; `premiumTrack` premiumTrackPanel; `ivSurface`, `skewTerm`, `topContracts`, `aggressor` chainPanel (from `flows-chain.buildChainPanels`); `path` buildPath (tick rows); `calendar` buildCalendar (<=10 rows); `vanna`, `charm`, `deltaExposure` greekPanel (<=12 expiries); `displacement`; `pricedMove` (10 sessions); `context` (42 closes, 252 candles, sma50, garch, breaks); `congress` (<=12); `marketRank` buildMarketCross; `darkpool`, `oiDeltas` via `flows-stock` shapers; `volContext` via `buildVolContext`; `variation` (added after construction). Every panel is `{status:"ok"|"unavailable"|"quiet"|..., reason?, lead?{say,n}, ...}`.

Caps on a card: pipeline body cap 100 KiB (`flows-pipeline.mjs:6546`); shed order at L6529: topContracts, aggressor, ivSurface, skewTerm, darkpool, oiDeltas, volContext, marketRank (8 panels; replaced by `{status:"unavailable", reason}`); index/fund cards shed the same plus `surface` (`INDEX_CARD_SHED`, `index-dossier.mjs:19`, budget `INDEX_CARD_BUDGET_BYTES` 100 KiB); cross-section cards do not shed (throw if over 100 KiB, `flows-pipeline.mjs:6721`); the engine attach cap is `QUANT_PIPELINE_LINES.INGEST_CAP` 128 KiB (`flows-quant-pipeline.mjs:19`) which equals the Worker's `FLOWS_MAX_PAYLOAD_BYTES` 128 KiB (`worker.js:923`).

**`universe`** (`buildUniverse` L446 via `flows-legs/universe.mjs:247`). Fields: `v` 1, `generatedAt`, `sessionDate`, `fresh` (`freshStamp`, `flows-legs/common.mjs:33`), `status` ok/unavailable, `reason`, `screened`, `n`, `harvest{calls,pages,limit,truncated,repeated,errors,dated,rows,source,complete}`, `order` "marketcap desc, then ticker", `t[]` (tickers), `sectors[]`, `sec[]` (sector index per name), `sectorTilt[]` (pct), `units{key:[unit,scale]}`, `cols{key:int[]}` (aligned to `t`), `counts`, `pct{iv30,ts,vrp,gexAdv,si: int 0-100[]}`, `pctRule`, `shock{key,unit:"z",scale:10,rule,v[]}`, `shed[]`, `budgetBytes`, `bytes`. Over budget after shedding every column of prio > 1: `{status:"unavailable", reason:"over_budget", shed, budgetBytes, overBytes, ...}` with no `t`/`cols` (`flows-cross.js:537-547`). Budget 100 KiB (`UNIVERSE_BUDGET_BYTES`); AGENTS.md records, for 670 synthetic names, 96,158 bytes without the dealer and implied-move columns, 108,249 with them unbudgeted and 100,505 after the shedder drops adx, dGamma and gexRatio (the run's `shed` list is the measurement that counts).

The 35 columns, as `key unit x scale (prio)`: px usd x100 (1); chg fraction x1e4 (1); mcap usd x1e-8 (2); iv30 vol x1e3 (1); ivp pct100 x1 (1); ts fraction x1e3 (1); fs fraction x1e3 (2); dIv1d vol x1e3 (1); dIv1w vol x1e3 (2); dIv1m vol x1e3 (4); rv20 vol x1e3 (2); vrp vol x1e3 (1); vrpPost vol x1e3 (4); erq ratio x100 (2); gexAdv fraction x1e4 (1); gexRatio ratio x100 (5); dDelta fraction x1e4 (2); dGamma fraction x1e6 (5); dVega fraction x1e6 (3); si fraction x1e4 (2); ins3m fraction x1e6 (4); ed sessions x1 (2); rsi index100 x1 (3); adx index100 x1 (5); bb fraction x100 (4); atr fraction x1e3 (3); sma50 fraction x1e3 (4); rvol ratio x10 (3); tilt fraction x100 (2); secDiv fraction x100 (3); dex fraction x100 (2); vanna fraction x1e4 (3); charm fraction x10 (4); im5 fraction x1e3 (3); im30 fraction x1e3 (2). Shed order when over budget: highest prio first, later array index first (adx, dGamma, gexRatio, then charm, sma50, bb, ins3m, vrpPost, dIv1m, ...); prio <= 1 columns are never shed.

**`regime`** (assembled by `assembleRegime`, `flows-legs/regime.mjs:61`, called from `flows-legs/market.mjs:49`). Fields: `v` 1, `generatedAt`, `sessionDate`, `fresh`, `status`, `calls`, `volCurve{status, source, vendor{status,...}, byIndex{SPY,QQQ,IWM}, rule}` (vendor `/api/volatility/vix-term-structure` is read but "unshaped"; the screener curve is the fallback), `zeroDte`, `sectors{rows[11]}`, `etfTide{byEtf{SPY,QQQ,IWM}}`, `fundFlows{byEtf}`, `impliedCorrelation{byIndex{SPY,QQQ}}`, `groups{rows[8]}`, `optionsPulse`, `dailyReport` (catalysts removed, handed to events), `shed[]`, `bytes`. The vol leg re-publishes the same key adding `volRadar` and merging `fresh` (`flows-legs/vol.mjs:395-404, 457`, `samePrior` by session). Shed order past 60 KiB: `sectors.path`, `etfTide.path`, `zeroDte.weeklyPath`; nothing is refused (Worker cap 128 KiB). `REGIME_CALLS` = 1 + 4 + 1 + 11 + 3 + 3 + 2 + 8 + 1 = 34 (`regime.mjs:19`); `MARKET_LEG_CALLS` (`market.mjs:21`) is a modelled total used by the legs contract only; the pipeline's call model is the separate `CALL_COST` / `callModel` table (`flows-pipeline.mjs:151-196`, trap 11).

**`events` additions / `card-x:<T>.earnings`** (`assembleCatalysts`, `flows-legs/events.mjs:88`). Additions merged into `events` at `flows-pipeline.mjs:5333`: `macro` (economic calendar after the session close, cap 40), `fda` (cap 60, 120-day horizon), `earningsCalendar{tonight, sessions[], reaction, failed}`, `catalysts` (daily-report catalysts, cap 40), `history{T: historyDigest}`, `historyRule`, `additionsBudget{budgetBytes 65536, shed, bytes}`; per-name `earningsHistory` + `impliedNext`, `ratioToday`, `vendorRatio` go to `card-x:<T>.earnings` (`cardX.add(t, "earnings", e)`, pipeline:5269). Calendar plan: 3 anchor reads + 5 upcoming sessions x 2 routes (`calendarPlan`, `events.mjs:45`), `FDA_LIMIT` 200, `CALENDAR_SHED_CAPS` [20, 10, 5].

**`flowalerts`** (nightly, `flows-pipeline.mjs:6034-6053`): `{v: 2, generatedAt, sessionDate, readAt, readDay, refreshed:"nightly", rows, seen, unusable, shed, cap, coverage, status, notes, record{...}, vendorLimit: 200, vendorTruncated, readLimit, readTruncated}`. The live layer writes `live:alerts` in `flows_live` via `mergeLiveAlerts` (`flows-live.js:1131`; `v: 2`, `refreshed:"intraday"`, `fresh`, `cursor`, `pages`; budget `LIVE_BUDGET.alertLimit` 200 x `alertPages` 5 = readLimit 1000, `alertsPerTape` 20). The Worker overlays `live:alerts` on `/api/flows/flowalerts` (`OVERLAID`, `worker.js:2095`, `overlayFlowalerts` `flows-live-worker.js:1153`). Real-time rail `fl` frames reuse `alertRow`/`alertKey` (`flows-rt.js:468-470`, max 200 per frame).

**`scores:YYYY-MM-DD`** (`flows-pipeline.mjs:5190-5198`): `{v: 2, generatedAt, sessionDate, deadBand, selectionEpoch, rows:[{t,s,q?,p?}], status}`; dated key is insert-if-absent and immutable (trigger `flows_archive_immutable`, `schema.sql:226-232`; Worker `DATED_ARCHIVE_KEY_RE` L935). **`scoretrack`** (`flows-pipeline.mjs:5463-5467`): `{v: 2, generatedAt, sessionDate, archive{probed,failed,abandoned}, windowSessions 42, deadBand, epoch, sessions[], names[], namesSeen, namesShed, shedBy, namesBytes, change, sources, status, notes}`; rebuilt from the archive every run (DEPLOY.md 10.5f).

**`focus`** (`flows-legs/focus.mjs:32`, published `flows-pipeline.mjs:6824`): `{v: 1, sessionDate, generatedAt, readAt, fresh, fields[17], groups[5] (gold, silver, copper, mag7, ndx10), status, rows{T:{17 fields + type?, name?}}, closes{T: <=22}, missing[], basis, backfill?, shed?{closes[]}, bytes}`; 24 KiB cap sheds closes only (from the last-listed ticker backwards), never rows.

**`brief`** (`flows-pipeline.mjs:6972-7012`): `{generatedAt, sessionDate, today, yesterday, next, notes, silences (from flows-ask.buildFactIndex), warnings[], warningsChecked, warningsQuestions, facts[] (per-name card facts shed by `shedCardFacts`), namesIndexed}`; byte budget `BRIEF_BYTE_BUDGET` 120 KiB (pipeline:6988). Worker `/api/flows/brief` adds `session` (briefAge) and the live overlay header `X-Live-Overlay` (`worker.js:3764-3778`).

#### Routes, auth, tables

All reads are `GET`, behind the Flows session (`currentFlowsUser`, defined `worker.js:904`, called once for the whole `/api/flows/` block at `worker.js:3604`; anonymous -> JSON 401 `unauthorized`), JSON, `no-store`, with `X-Fresh-*` headers from the stored row (`nightlyFreshHeaders`, `worker.js:1000`):

| Route | Handler | Payload |
|---|---|---|
| `/api/flows/card?t=`, `/card-x?t=`, `/hist?t=` | `worker.js:3818` | `card:T` (split-engine merged when payload contains `"engine":{"status":"split"`), absent names -> `absentKey` (lite card from `universe` via `LITE_SQL` L1106) |
| `/api/flows/universe`, `/regime`, `/ideas`, `/focus`, `/roster` | `worker.js:3712` | the stored key; `{status:"pending"}` when absent |
| `/api/flows/scoretrack` | `worker.js:3638` | `scoretrack` |
| `/api/flows/flowalerts` (+ pulse, news) | `worker.js:3652` | nightly row overlaid with live |
| `/api/flows/events` | `worker.js:3631` | `events` (with catalysts additions) |
| `/api/flows/brief` | `worker.js:3764` | `brief` + `briefWithLive` (`worker.js:1324`, `FLOWS_ASK.refreshIntradayFacts`) |
| `POST /api/flows/ask` | `worker.js:3780` | answers from the same `brief` index |
| `POST/GET/DELETE /api/flows/ingest?key=` | `worker.js:3454` | write path for every key above; token kinds nightly (`FLOWS_INGEST_TOKEN`) or live (OIDC / `FLOWS_LIVE_TOKEN`); allowlist `INGEST_VIEW_KEY_RE` L937 (board, scores:date, scoretrack, flowalerts, pulse, political, record, movers, market, unusual, events, sector:trix, sector:premium, news, brief, meta, universe, regime, ideas, focus, roster) plus a `card:<T>`, `card-x:<T>` or `hist:<T>` key; body <= `FLOWS_MAX_PAYLOAD_BYTES` 128 KiB (L923); key validity is `ingestKeyParts` L939 (`INGEST_VIEW_KEY_RE`, or a `card:`/`card-x:`/`hist:` prefix with a ticker that passes `FLOWS_TICKER_RE` L933); the same route also serves `?list=card,card-x,hist` (nightly token only, `INGEST_LIST_MAX` 2,000), `?keys=a,b` (metadata, `INGEST_META_KEYS_MAX` 96), `key=clock` and `key=live:*` (live layer); only a dated archive key or, for the nightly token, a ticker key can be DELETEd. Read routes' stale-read fallback is `LAST_GOOD_PATHS` L1041 |

D1 tables: `flows_payload (id, payload, updated_at)` (nightly views; the only table these builders reach), `flows_live` (`live:alerts`, `live:strips`, ...), `flows_tape`; archive immutability trigger `flows_archive_immutable` covers `board:(long|short):date` and `scores:date` only. Worker rows-read budget matters for universe: `LITE_SQL` expands `json_each(p.payload,'$.t')` (about n rows) and the dossier SQL finds a name by counting commas in the compact `t` string (`DOSSIER_SQL.universe`, `flows-dossier-worker.js:70-78`).

Env vars and secrets touching this area: none are read by the ten modules. Pipeline run: `UW_API_KEY`, `FLOWS_UW_BASE_URL`, `FLOWS_UW_TIMEOUT_MS`, `FLOWS_INGEST_URL`, `FLOWS_INGEST_TOKEN`, `FLOWS_REPUBLISH_SESSION`, `FLOWS_ALLOW_INTRADAY`, `GITHUB_ACTIONS`; Worker: `FLOWS_INGEST_TOKEN`, `FLOWS_LIVE_TOKEN`, `UW_API_KEY`.

Caps and budgets (actual numbers): card 100 KiB (pipeline) / 128 KiB (engine + Worker); universe 100 KiB; regime 60 KiB; events additions 64 KiB; focus 24 KiB; brief 120 KiB; scoretrack 96 KiB and 500 names and 42 sessions; alert record 180 rows and 96 KiB; single-read alerts 60 rows; vendor alert limit 200 per page; movers band 8 rows; gamma bars 60; calendar rows 10; surface 21 x 8; greek term rows 12; congress 12; candles 252; closes 42 (card) / 22 (focus); universe percentile columns 5; regime calls 34; warnings checks 13.

Client consumers (fields they depend on): `assets/js/flows-ticker.js` reads `card.panels.*` (the `P.<panel>` reads run L66-2618, plus `card.panels.pricedMove` at L2893) and pins `RICHNESS_LINE` (`const RICHNESS_LINE = 0.1;` at L265); `flows-market.js:1074-1356` reads `regime.sectors/zeroDte/groups/volRadar` and `universe.cols.chg`; `flows-board.js:1359-1469`, `flows-history.js:495`, `flows-track.js:739` read `scoretrack`; `flows-unusual.js:899` reads `flowalerts`; `flows-ask.js:880,701-703` reads `brief` (`warnings`, `warningsChecked`, `warningsQuestions`, `next.isForecast`); `flows-overview.js:2109` reads `focus`.

### Flows

**Nightly build order** (`scripts/flows-pipeline.mjs`):

1. Per-name features: `computeFeatures` L1158 calls `flowPurity`, `positioningQuality`, `aggressorGamma`, `bookDisplacement`, `pathSignature`, `gammaDecayCalendar`, `openInterestGammaBook`, `realizedVol` (all `flows-features.js`) and returns the feature record every later builder reads.
2. Score: `scoreBoard` L1414 (called L5006): `robustZ(winsorize(...))` per signal, family blend weighted by `effectiveBreadth`/`crossFamilyRedundancy`, `qualityGate`, `neutralize` on log market cap and sector, `boundedScore(…, SCORE_SCALE)`, `conviction`; `partitionSides` L1537 (L5015) splits by dead band 1; `applyHysteresis` (called in `toRows`, L2446) keeps incumbents with entry rank `UNIVERSE.boardSize` = 50 and exit rank `round(50 * 1.4)` = 70 (L2448; `UNIVERSE` at L130, `boardSize` L139), not the module's 25/35 defaults.
3. Boards: `publish("board:long|short")` L5149, `board:watch` L5168.
4. `scores:<session>`: `scoresRows(sides)` L5190 -> `publish` L5198.
5. Market legs (`runMarketLegs` L5256 -> `flows-legs/market.mjs`): `harvestScreener` -> `readRegime` (34 calls) -> `assembleRegime` -> `universePayload` -> `buildUniverse`; ownership; `readCatalysts` -> `assembleCatalysts`. `universe` and `regime` are published one at a time (L5274-5279) so a refused universe cannot take the regime down (`flows-legs-contract.mjs:901-902`).
6. `events` (with `marketLegs.eventsAdditions`) L5322.
7. `scoretrack`: archive walk -> `boardsToScoreRows` (L5457) + `scoresRows` (L5460) -> `buildScoreTrack` (L5463), premium Map split off, `publish("scoretrack")` L5467, premium map kept for cards (`scoreTrackPremium`).
8. `flowalerts`: `buildFlowAlerts` (L6034) -> `nightlyAlerts` (L6035, reads the held record via `readHeldAlerts`) -> `publish("flowalerts")` L6053 only when `night.alerts` is set; `alertBand` fills `movers.premium.byContract` and re-publishes `movers` (L6097-6099).
9. `marketCross = indexMarketCross({oiChange, darkpool, limits, tickers, sessionDate})` L6360.
10. Cards: for each deep/board/focus name `buildCard` L6494 (+ shed loop L6529-6556, engine attach, `publish("card-x:")`/`publish("card:")` L6585-6586); cross-section cards `buildCard` L6690 (throws if the body is over 100 KiB, check L6721 / throw L6722) -> `publish` L6724. The index/fund dossiers come later, in step 12 (`buildIndexDossiers` L6790 using `indexDossierDeps` L4265 / `buildCard` L4312).
11. `publishVol` L6750 (adds `volRadar` into `regime` and writes `card-x:<T>` vol panels), then `runFlowLeg` (L6752, `flows-legs/flow.mjs`, outside this part).
12. `focus` and the index/fund dossiers, in this order: `ndxMembership` L4827, `ndx10` L4828 and `focusDeepSet` L4829 (all before the roster), `focusTickers`/`focusGroups` L6764, `readFocusRows` L6765, fund-row retry, then `buildIndexDossiers` L6790 (its `deps` at L6789), then `buildFocusPayload` L6819 (`focusCloses` L6821), `publish("focus")` L6824.
13. `meta` L6928, then `brief`: `buildFactIndex` -> `assess(assessStoreFrom(publishedStore))` L6980 -> `buildBrief(briefStoreFrom(publishedStore))` L6992 -> `shedCardFacts` to 120 KiB -> `publish("brief")` L7012.

**Card at read time**: browser `flows-ticker.js:2921-2941` fetches `/api/flows/card`, `/summary`, `/card-x`, `/hist` -> Worker `worker.js:3818` -> `readServed` -> `passthrough` (or `cardWithEngine` merge when the engine is split) -> panels rendered client-side. Stale store fallback: `recallLastGood` (L1083; the covered paths are `LAST_GOOD_PATHS`, L1041, which includes `card`, `card-x` and `hist`).

**Live alerts**: GitHub Actions `--live` leg -> `mergeLiveAlerts` (`flows-live.js:1131`) -> `buildFlowAlerts(rawRows, {stageOf, stageComplete:false, cap: rawRows.length || 1})` (`flows-live.js:1143-1147`) -> `mergeAlerts(held, alerts, {at, sessionDate})` -> `put("live:alerts")` once, only if `merged.write` (`flows-legs/live.mjs`) -> Worker overlay on read. Rail: `shapeFl` (`flows-rt.js:460`) -> `fl` frames.

**Focus roster to live strips**: `focusStripNames(payload, max)` L161 is called by the Worker focus tick (`flows-live-worker.js:492`, max `LIVE_BUDGET.stripFocusMax` 40), the rail (`flows-rt.js:674`) and the Actions leg (`flows-legs/live.mjs:68`), all with the same names and order; with no focus payload they fall back to `FOCUS_STRIP_FALLBACK` L157.

**Brief at read time**: `briefWithLive` (`worker.js:1324`) -> `FLOWS_LIVE.liveBriefFeeds` -> `FLOWS_ASK.refreshIntradayFacts` (replaces the `alerts` fact via `briefAlertsFact`) -> response with `session` age.

### Invariants and traps

1. **`flows-focus.js` must import nothing** (leaf). Held by `tests/flows-universe-contract.mjs:237-239` and `tests/flows-live-contract.mjs:573-574`; `flows-live.js` must not import it (`flows-live-contract.mjs:575`), `flows-live-worker.js` and `scripts/flows-legs/live.mjs` must (L578-579). The payload builder lives in `scripts/flows-legs/focus.mjs` precisely because it needs `flows-live.js` strip fields.
2. **Two `MAG7` lists**: `flows-focus.js:7` and `flows-regime.js:28` must stay equal (`flows-universe-contract.mjs:148`).
3. **Two different `greekFlowTotals`**: `flows-features.js:264` (sums for purity/quality, shape `{dirNet,dirAbs,otmAbs,vegaAbs,totalAbs,rows,silence}`) and `flows-regime.js:171` (group sums). Do not import the wrong one. Likewise four unrelated `num` helpers: `flows-features.num` (fallback 0), `flows-brief.num` (strict, null), `flows-alerts`/`flows-scores` local `num(v, d=null)`; `flows-card.numOrNull` is the looser sibling of `flows-cross.vnum`, not a duplicate: `numOrNull(true)` is 1 and `numOrNull(" ")` is 0 (it only maps null, undefined, "" and non-finite to null), whereas `vnum` returns null for booleans and blank strings. The local `num(v, d=null)` of alerts and scores has the same looseness (`Number(" ")` is 0).
4. **`buildScoreTrack` returns a `premium` Map** (`flows-scores.js:276`). The pipeline destructures it off (`flows-pipeline.mjs:5463`); publishing the raw return would serialise it as `{}` and silently empty the cards' `premiumTrack`.
5. **`scoresRows` must stay byte-deterministic** (sorted by ticker, rounded `q` x1e4 and `p`): the dated `scores:` key is immutable and a rerun must write identical bytes (DEPLOY.md 10.5f; trigger `schema.sql:226`). A new field changes bytes only for future sessions, but never reorder or reformat existing fields.
6. **A gap is not a zero**: score series use `null`; any fixture for this surface must contain a real `0` next to a gap (DEPLOY.md 10.5f; `tests/flows-scores-contract.mjs`). Same rule across the area (`numOrNull` and `vnum` return null, and `ownZ` returns a `reason` with `z: null`, never 0).
7. **Universe payload is consumed by SQL, not only by JS**: `LITE_SQL` (`worker.js:1106`) uses `$.t`, `$.cols`, `$.pct`, `$.units`, `$.sec`, `$.sectors`, `$.n`; `DOSSIER_SQL.universe` (`flows-dossier-worker.js:70-78`) builds `json_extract` per column key from `UNIVERSE_COLUMNS` and finds the row index by counting commas before `"TICKER"` in the stringified `t`, so `t` must remain a compact JSON array of plain tickers (JSON.stringify output) and the column arrays must stay index-aligned with `t`. Renaming a column key, changing a `scale`, or reordering `t` breaks the lite card, the dossier and `flows-neuron-screen.js` (keys `charm, dDelta, dex, ed, gexAdv, im30, im5, iv30, ivp, rv20, si, tilt, ts, vanna, vrp`, percentiles `gexAdv`, `si`).
8. **Over-budget universe is refused, not truncated**: after shedding all prio > 1 columns the payload becomes `status:"unavailable", reason:"over_budget"` and loses `t`/`cols`; every consumer must treat that as a silence (`flows-cross.js:537-547`). Shedding keeps prio 1 columns (px, chg, iv30, ivp, ts, dIv1d, vrp, gexAdv).
9. **`sessionsToEarnings` returns null for a same-day pre-market reporter** (`flows-cross.js:323-328`): the report already happened, so it must not read as 0 sessions away.
10. **`regime` has two writers in one run**: market legs (`flows-pipeline.mjs:5276`) then `publishVol` (`flows-legs/vol.mjs:457`, `samePrior` keyed on `sessionDate`). Order matters; if the market legs failed, the vol write publishes a regime holding only `volRadar` + `v`/`fresh` (base null). The republished `v` is `VOL_SCHEMA_VERSION` (`shared/flows-vol.js:1`), a separate constant from `REGIME_SCHEMA_VERSION` (both are 1 today). `regime.catalysts` does not exist: `assembleRegime` removes it and hands it to `events`.
11. **Three separate call counts, only one of them tested against the leg.** `REGIME_CALLS` (`regime.mjs:19`) must equal the reads `readRegime` makes: `flows-legs-contract.mjs:660` asserts `raw.calls === REGIME_CALLS`. `MARKET_LEG_CALLS` (`market.mjs:21`, built from `REGIME_CALLS`) is imported only by `flows-legs-contract.mjs`, which merely bounds it (`> 0` and `< 400`, L723); the pipeline does not import it. The pipeline's own call model is a hand-entered table: `CALL_COST` (L151, with `marketFixed: 1 + 33 + 15`), `NOMINAL_SHAPE` (L175), `callModel` (L177) and `CALL_BUDGET` (L196), pinned by `flows-pipeline-contract.mjs:4339-4346` and compared with the real attempts at L7039-7052, where an overrun only prints a `BUDGET:` warning. Adding a vendor read to a leg means editing `REGIME_CALLS` (or the leg's own count) and `CALL_COST` by hand; nothing derives one from the other.
12. **Look-ahead guards**: `earningsHistory` masks post-earnings moves whose window ends after the session (`flows-catalysts.js:70-74`; `known` is L71, the `masked++` count L72, the nulling L73); `fundFlowSummary`/`putCallHistory` drop rows dated after `sessionDate` (regime L219, L251); `shapeEconomicCalendar` drops events up to the 16:00 ET close of the session. Re-runs of an earlier session must not see the future.
13. **`liveExpiry` is strict** (`flows-features.js:518`): with an `asOf`, an expiry on `asOf` is already expired (d > 0 required), while an unparseable expiry or `asOf` counts as live. Calendar, OI gamma book, max pain row, expiry share and greek term structures all depend on it; changing it moves half the card.
14. **Card panel `lead`s are `{say, n}` and `n` pins every numeral in `say`** (`panelLead`, L33). The same rule is enforced for warnings and brief facts (`tests/flows-warnings.mjs` summary line; `tests/flows-brief.mjs`) because the Ask guard checks numerals against `n`; a sentence with an unpinned number fails CI. Briefing text may not use future tense (`briefNext` sets `isForecast:false`; verb scan in `flows-brief.mjs`).
15. **Card contract pins** (`tests/flows-card-contract.mjs`): `CARD_SCHEMA_VERSION === 3` (L303); no card field named `gammaFlip` (L313; `strikeSumCrossing` is the name); `SPOT_EXPOSURE_PAGE === 500` and the pipeline must request `limit: SPOT_EXPOSURE_PAGE` verbatim (regex at L1487-1490); `RICHNESS_LINE` (0.1) must equal `STATE_LINES.VRP_RELATIVE` in `flows-neuron.js` and the copy `const RICHNESS_LINE` in `assets/js/flows-ticker.js:265` (pinned by `flows-card-contract.mjs:664-668`), and every "Band" row the page prints must use the derived band; renderer legacy floor is card schema < 2 (`flows-legacy-payload.mjs`, `fixtures-flows-v1-card.json`).
16. **Two card shed lists must stay in step**: pipeline L6529 (8 panels) and `INDEX_CARD_SHED` (9, adds `surface`); cross-section cards have none. A new large panel needs an entry in both lists or an explicit decision.
17. **Alert identity is `alertKey`** (NUL-separated, window-start based). Changing how `spanStart`/`rule` are derived re-keys rows already held in D1 `flowalerts` / `live:alerts` and double-counts them across the deploy. The live merge declares its stage map partial (`stageComplete:false`, asserted in `flows-alerts-contract.mjs:~555-575`) so unmapped names publish `st:null`, never `"foreign"`.
18. **One writer per key**: the Worker no longer rewrites `flowalerts`, `pulse` or `brief`; every `INSERT INTO flows_payload` in `worker.js` sits inside the ingest route and `refreshFlowsIntraday` must not exist (`flows-alerts-contract.mjs:504-511`). The nightly may only publish `flowalerts` when it has rows or no record exists; an empty read never replaces the day's record (`nightlyAlerts` mode `kept`).
19. **`mergeAlerts` resets** the record on `cold`, `undated`, `session-boundary`; `everEntered` keeps counting entries even when the ceiling sheds rows (so the running count stays honest).
20. **Warnings can only fire from payloads that exist**: `null` = "cannot run" (counts nothing), `[]` = "ran and clean"; `checked` vs `questions` (13) is published and rendered by the client. Do not return `[]` for a check that could not run.
21. **Docs disagree with source** (source wins): `DEPLOY.md:1847-1852` still says the Worker's intraday refresh stamps `readDay` on `flowalerts`/`pulse` and merges at 16:15 ET; the code has no such writer and DEPLOY.md:1660 itself says the Worker no longer rewrites them. `DEPLOY.md` 10.5f describes score rows as `{t, s}` only; source also writes `q` and `p` (`flows-scores.js:81-94`). `AGENTS.md` file map does not list `flows-card`, `flows-features`, `flows-regime`, `flows-alerts`, `flows-brief`, `flows-warnings`, `flows-catalysts`, `flows-scores` (only their tests appear).
22. **Dead or test-only exports** (safe to leave, not safe to assume wired): `buildCohort`, `COHORT_*`, `POLARITY`/`polarityOf`, `pickMaxPain` (card); `robustZFused`, `vanDerWaerden`, `invNorm`, `calibrateScoreScale`, `gammaCrossings` (features, used by tests and internally); the card has no `cohort` panel.
23. **No comments in source** (AGENTS "Commentary"); argue in the commit message. `flows-legs-contract.mjs:897` scans `scripts/flows-legs/*` for `//` or `/*`; `flows-quant.mjs:901` and `flows-neuron-screen.mjs:305` scan their own modules.
24. **Universe/dossier/regime SQL coupling for regime**: `DOSSIER_SQL.regime` (`flows-dossier-worker.js:79-86`) reads `$.etfTide.byEtf.<T>.{status,net,date}`, `$.zeroDte.{status,share}`, `$.volCurve.byIndex.SPY.{status,ts,fs,shape}`, `$.impliedCorrelation.byIndex.SPY.{status,rho}`; and `DOSSIER_SQL.events` reads `$.macro` and finds `{"t":"<T>"` inside `$.rows`. Renaming those paths silently blanks dossier packets.

### How to change it

**Add or change a card panel** (`shared/flows-card.js`)
1. Write the builder (return `ok(...)`, `unavailable(reason)` or `quiet(reason)`; add a `lead` via `panelLead(say, n)` with every numeral in `n`) and call it in `buildCard` inside the `panels: {` object (L1638-1704; the whole `card` literal is L1581-1705, `variation` is attached after it at L1706).
2. If the panel can be large, add it to the shed list at `scripts/flows-pipeline.mjs:6529` and to `INDEX_CARD_SHED` (`scripts/flows-legs/index-dossier.mjs:19`).
3. If the pipeline supplies a new input, thread it through all three `buildCard` call sites (L6494, L6690, and the `card:` hook L4312 inside `indexDossierDeps` L4265) and the `unfetched` handling for cross-section cards.
4. Renderer: `assets/js/flows-ticker.js` (panel consumers L66-2618, then L2893) and, for score history, `flows-track.js`. Any `assets/js|css|data` change requires incrementing `assets/version.txt`, updating every `?v=` and `ASSET_VERSION` in `shared/flows-pages.js`, and re-running `grep -rn 'woff2?v='` (AGENTS "Asset versioning"); mind the page weight ceiling in `tests/flows-weight.mjs` (`tickerPage` 400 KiB).
5. Only bump `CARD_SCHEMA_VERSION` for a breaking rename, and update the pinned message at `tests/flows-card-contract.mjs:301-306` and the legacy floor logic.
6. Tests: `cd tests && node flows-card-contract.mjs && node flows-features.mjs && node flows-chain-panels.mjs && node flows-card-render.mjs && node flows-ticker-contract.mjs && node flows-payload-shape.mjs && node flows-legacy-payload.mjs` and `node ../scripts/flows-pipeline.mjs --dry-run && node flows-pipeline-contract.mjs`; also `flows-neuron.mjs` and `flows-ask.mjs` if `regimeState` or card facts read the field.

**Add a universe column** (`shared/flows-cross.js`)
1. Append a spec to `UNIVERSE_COLUMNS` L344 (`key`, `unit`, integer-friendly `scale`, `prio` 1-5, `get(row, ctx)` returning a finite number or null). Append at the end unless you accept moving shed order (ties shed later index first).
2. Add the key to `UNIVERSE_PERCENTILES` L423 only if a percentile is wanted (the Worker's `DOSSIER_SQL.universe` and `decodeUniverse` pick both lists up automatically from the exports).
3. Check bytes: the run prints `shed` and `bytes` (`market.mjs` log); keep the 670-name payload under 100 KiB or accept shedding a lower-prio column. Never give a new column prio 1 unless the payload still fits without shedding anything else.
4. Consumers needing the value: `shared/flows-neuron-screen.js` (`v("key")`, 15 keys today), the dossier (`shared/flows-dossier-worker.js` `decodeUniverse` L118 decodes every `UNIVERSE_COLUMNS` key into `h.universe.u`, which `shared/flows-dossier.js` reads; `flows-dossier-vendor.js` does not touch the universe), the browser (`flows-market.js`, `flows-board.js`).
5. Tests: `node flows-legs-contract.mjs` (formula against a known answer; "each new key inside its byte budget"), `node flows-universe-contract.mjs`, `node flows-neuron-screen.mjs`, `node --disable-warning=ExperimentalWarning flows-dossier-reads.mjs` (the dossier statement count/rows read is asserted), `node flows-dossier-contract.mjs`, `node flows-pipeline-contract.mjs`.

**Change regime content** (`shared/flows-regime.js` + `scripts/flows-legs/regime.mjs`)
Add the vendor read to `readRegime` (L22) and to the call count `REGIME_CALLS` (L19), shape it in `flows-regime.js`, assemble it in `assembleRegime` (L61) with `statusOf`/`silenceOf` silences, add a shed rule if it is large (budget 60 KiB), and keep dossier SQL paths intact (trap 24). Client: `assets/js/flows-market.js` (asset version ritual). Tests: `flows-legs-contract.mjs` (uses `tests/fixtures-flows-legs-probe.json`), `flows-pipeline-contract.mjs`, `flows-market-contract.mjs`.

**Add an events/catalyst feed** (`shared/flows-catalysts.js` + `scripts/flows-legs/events.mjs`)
Add the shaper in `flows-catalysts.js`, read it in `readCatalysts` (L59), assemble in `assembleCatalysts` (L88), and keep `EVENTS_ADDITIONS_BUDGET_BYTES` (64 KiB) through `fitEventsAdditions` (L16: add a trim rule). Client `assets/js/flows-events.js`. Tests: `flows-events-contract.mjs`, `flows-legs-contract.mjs`, `flows-dossier-contract.mjs` (if `earningsHistory` output changes).

**Change the flow-alert row or record** (`shared/flows-alerts.js`)
Row fields: `alertRow` L72 (keep `alertKey` inputs stable, trap 17). Record ceilings: `MERGED_ALERT_ROWS`/`MERGED_ALERT_BYTES`. Callers to re-check: `flows-live.js:1131-1210` (live merge and tape alerts), `flows-rt.js:460` (rail rows), pipeline L6034-6099, movers band (`alertBand`). Client: `assets/js/flows-unusual.js`, `flows-overview.js`. Tests: `flows-alerts-contract.mjs`, `flows-live-contract.mjs`, `flows-rt-contract.mjs`, `flows-warnings.mjs` (ceiling checks read `vendorLimit`, `vendorTruncated`, `record.reads`), `flows-ask.mjs`, `flows-brief.mjs`.

**Change the score archive or track** (`shared/flows-scores.js`)
Keep `scoresRows` deterministic; extend `buildScoreTrack` fields additively (clients: `flows-board.js`, `flows-history.js`, `flows-track.js`; cards consume `scoreHistory`). Caps `TRACK_SESSIONS`/`TRACK_MAX_NAMES`/`TRACK_MAX_BYTES`. Selection epoch (`SELECTION_EPOCH` = "2026-08-26", `shared/flows-universe.js:56`) marks `preEpoch` sessions. Tests: `flows-scores-contract.mjs`, `flows-overview-contract.mjs`, `flows-card-contract.mjs` (score overlay/premium track panels), `flows-track-render.mjs`.

**Add a brief fact or a warning** (`shared/flows-brief.js`, `shared/flows-warnings.js`)
Fact: add `fact("id", say, n, lead?)` in `briefToday/Yesterday/Next` (pin every numeral in `n`, no future tense); if it reads a new key, add it to `BRIEF_SLOTS` and make sure `flows-ask.js:buildFactIndex` (L732) still produces its silences. Warning: write a `check*` returning `null`/`[]`/warnings, push it onto `CHECKS` (L391; `questions` is published), add the slot to `KEY` if it reads a new key, and add a crafted-contradiction plus crafted-agreement fixture in `tests/flows-warnings.mjs`. The brief budget (120 KiB) and `shedCardFacts` are used in the pipeline (`BRIEF_BYTE_BUDGET` L6988, `shedCardFacts` imported L6989 and called L7003); `shedCardFacts` itself is defined at `flows-ask.js:673`. Client: `assets/js/flows-ask.js`. Tests: `flows-brief.mjs`, `flows-warnings.mjs`, `flows-ask.mjs`, `flows-ask-render.mjs`, `flows-alerts-contract.mjs`.

**Change the focus roster** (`shared/flows-focus.js`)
Edit `FOCUS_METALS`, `FOCUS_FUNDS`, `FOCUS_MINERS`, `MAG7` (and the regime module's `MAG7`, trap 2). Effects: deep set (`focusDeepSet`), index-dossier funds, vendor-call model, live strip names (`stripFocusMax` 40), roster. Keep the file import-free. Tests: `flows-universe-contract.mjs` (expects 12 metal tickers + 7 + 3 = 22 listed names and 24 KB cap), `flows-payload-shape.mjs` (five groups), `flows-live-contract.mjs`, `flows-rt-contract.mjs`, `flows-worker-contract.mjs` (needs `FLOWS_TEST_SANDBOX=1` in the sandbox), `flows-pipeline-contract.mjs`, and `node ../scripts/flows-pipeline.mjs --dry-run`.

**Change score maths or a feature** (`shared/flows-features.js` + `scoreBoard` in the pipeline)
The score changes meaning historically: the dated `scores:` archive and `scoretrack` mix pools across a change, which is what `SELECTION_EPOCH` (`shared/flows-universe.js`) and `preEpoch` mark; decide whether to move the epoch. Keep `SCORE_SCALE` and `CONVICTION_WEIGHTS` consistent with `card.conv.weights`. Tests: `flows-features.mjs` (prints `flows-features: N assertions`), `flows-record-contract.mjs` (IC), `flows-variation.mjs`, `flows-events-contract.mjs` (`horizonMove`), `flows-pipeline-contract.mjs`.

**General rituals for this area**
- Shared-module changes need no asset version bump (only `assets/css|js|data` do); the generated bundles (`flows-quant*.bundle.js`) are unaffected because no module in scope is reachable from `flows-quant-browser.js`.
- New suites go into the `tests/package.json` `test` chain and into the AGENTS "Which suites need the dev server" list. Most suites named above run with no server, but five need workerd (set `FLOWS_TEST_SANDBOX=1` in the agent sandbox): `flows-legacy-payload`, `flows-market-contract`, `flows-overview-contract`, `flows-worker-contract`, `flows-ask-render`.
- Dry-run the whole nightly with `node scripts/flows-pipeline.mjs --dry-run` (fake vendors in `scripts/flows-legs/*-fake.mjs`) after any builder change; it runs inside `npm run test:pipeline`.
- Remember `Object.create(null)` `publishedStore` semantics: `briefStoreFrom`/`assessStoreFrom` use `Object.hasOwn`, so keep that pattern when adding a slot.

## Flows payload builders B: events, political, record, ownership, unusual, chain, vol, positioning

### Purpose and boundaries

Commit ba2acfe. Line numbers below were taken with grep -n / sed -n on the files at this commit. Scope: twelve pure-ES-module files under `shared/` (`flows-events.js`, `flows-political.js`, `flows-record.js`, `flows-ownership.js`, `flows-unusual.js`, `flows-stock.js`, `flows-chain.js`, `flows-positioning.js`, `flows-vol.js`, `flows-variation.js`, `flows-garch.js`, `flows-pulse.js`). Every file was read in full.

What this area is: the pure, I/O-free builders that turn raw vendor (Unusual Whales, "UW") rows and the nightly's in-memory state into the JSON bodies the Flows product stores and serves. Each module is a leaf of data shaping: input = vendor rows or screener rows plus a `sessionDate`; output = a payload fragment with explicit `status` (`ok | quiet | unavailable | unreadable | stale | pending`), caps with counted `shed`, a `reason`/`why` code instead of a zero for every absent number, and unit labels.

Which stored keys each module produces (all stored in D1 `flows_payload`, served by `GET /api/flows/<name>`):

| Module | Builds | Stored key / location | Producer (the only runtime caller) |
|---|---|---|---|
| `flows-events.js` | the earnings calendar rows | `events` (plus `macro`, `fda`, `earningsCalendar` additions spread in by `scripts/flows-legs/market.mjs`) | `scripts/flows-pipeline.mjs:5314` -> publish `5322` |
| `flows-pulse.js` | seven market-wide feeds | `pulse` | `publishPulse` `pipeline.mjs:4083` (publish `4128`) |
| `flows-political.js` | congressional disclosure rankings | `political` | `pipeline.mjs:6238` -> publish `6247` |
| `flows-record.js` | forward-return scoring of the dated archive + per-feature IC table | `record` | `pipeline.mjs:5362` and `5370` -> publish `5376` |
| `flows-ownership.js` | short interest, borrow, short-volume ratio, insider tape, squeeze pressure | sections `short` and `insiders` inside `card-x:<T>` | `scripts/flows-legs/ownership.mjs` (called by `market.mjs:81`) -> `pipeline.mjs:5265-5268` `cardX.add` -> `publishCardX` `pipeline.mjs:6835` |
| `flows-unusual.js` | unusual-contract rows, name ranking, OI-basis diagnostics | `unusual` (rows are built inside `buildChainPanels`, ranked in the pipeline) | `pipeline.mjs:5896-5900` -> publish `5908` |
| `flows-stock.js` | per-name dark-pool, OI-delta, IV term structure, IV-rank panels | `card:<T>`.panels.`darkpool`/`oiDeltas`/`volContext` | via `shared/flows-card.js:1693-1703` |
| `flows-chain.js` | the option-chain panels (IV surface, skew/term scalars, top contracts, aggressor ladder, unusual rows, OI basis) | `card:<T>`.panels.`ivSurface`/`skewTerm`/`topContracts`/`aggressor` (via flows-card), board-row scalars `skew/term/atmIv/skewDays`, and `unusual` rows | `pipeline.mjs:5641` (nightly chain leg), `pipeline.mjs:4309` (index/fund chain) |
| `flows-positioning.js` | per-name positioning/flow sections (GEX history, volume history, vendor levels, flow by expiry/strike, NOPE, intraday gamma path, OI walls, contract lifelines, dark-pool shelves, alert tape, multi-leg) + session-print cutters | `card-x:<T>` sections and `hist:<T>` packed series | `scripts/flows-legs/flow.mjs` (`flowLeg`), `pipeline.mjs:6463`/`4111` (`sessionPrints`) |
| `flows-vol.js` | volatility panels (cone, RV, VRP, term, skew, IV dynamics, anomaly, sentiment, character), radar, card summary | `card-x:<T>` panels, `card.x.vol` summary, and `regime`.`volRadar` | `scripts/flows-legs/vol.mjs` (`runVolLeg`, `publishVol`) |
| `flows-variation.js` | the dealer-hedging ("variation") model: gamma/vanna/charm channels in dollars, convention and unit probes, score-variance decomposition | `card:<T>`.panels.`variation`; board-row `row.variation`; board `variation` meta | `flows-card.js:1706` (`buildVariation` def `:1732`), `pipeline.mjs:5090` (`boardVariation`), `pipeline.mjs:1481` |
| `flows-garch.js` | GARCH(1,1) with Hansen skewed-t, Nelder-Mead, Ljung-Box | `features.garch` -> `card.panels.context.garch` | `pipeline.mjs:1267` (`fitGarch`), `scripts/flows-quant-pipeline.mjs:96` (`refitGarch` with an earnings mask) |

What this area is NOT:
- Not the Worker routing/serving code (`worker.js`), the ingest route, or D1 schema (areas 10/11/30). Only `flows-positioning.js` (`readExpiryBreakdown`, `worker.js:35`/`2378`), `flows-variation.js` (via `flows-neuron.js` and `flows-positioning.js`) and `flows-vol.js` (via `flows-basis.js:6`) end up in the Worker bundle. Everything else here runs only in the GitHub Actions nightly (Node) and in tests.
- Not the nightly orchestrator (`scripts/flows-pipeline.mjs`, 7,126 lines) nor its legs (`scripts/flows-legs/*.mjs`); those are the callers (area 31/33).
- Not `shared/flows-card.js` (card assembly; imports `flows-stock`, `flows-variation`, `flows-unusual`, `flows-pulse` and is imported by `flows-chain.js` and the pipeline only), `flows-features.js`, `flows-premium.js`, `flows-cross.js`, `flows-universe.js`, `flows-quant-*` (neighbours, other areas).
- Name collision, do not confuse: `shared/flows-pulse.js` is the NIGHTLY market-pulse payload builder. The real-time rail's Durable Object class `Pulse` lives in `shared/flows-rt-hub.js` and is unrelated. Likewise `shared/flows-chain.js` (chain panels, tested by `tests/flows-chain-panels.mjs`) is unrelated to the Worker's `GET /api/flows/chain` strategy route (`worker.js:3835`, tested by `tests/flows-chain-contract.mjs`, which drives the route over workerd and imports none of this area's modules; the route's logic is `flows-basis.js`, not `flows-chain.js`).

Neighbours by data flow: `flows-features.js` (`horizonMove` -> events; `gammaFlip` -> positioning), `flows-premium.js` (`parseOptionSymbol`, `ivConvention`, `priceSale`, `ivSurface`, `SURFACE_MAX_EXPIRIES = 8` at `flows-premium.js:328`, `SURFACE_MAX_ROWS = 17` at `:330`), `flows-freshness.js` (`isTradingDay`, `REFRESH_CADENCE_MINUTES`), `flows-cross.js` (shared helpers/`SILENCE` for ownership), `flows-quant-bs.js` (Black-Scholes greeks, normal cdf/pdf for variation), `flows-quant-card.js` (`quoteImpliedVols`, `QUOTE_IV_BASIS` for chain), `flows-card.js` (`panelLead`, `saidMagnitude` for chain).

Design contract common to all twelve (checked by tests, repeat in every change): a null/absent vendor field is withheld under its own key with a reason, never coerced to 0 (`Number(null) === 0` was a real bug; fixtures must contain a real zero beside a gap); caps record counted `shed`; vendor prose-claims are bounded (no "print/trade/sweep/whale/smart money" on contract aggregates; "dealer-signed under the vendor's convention"); rebuilds are byte-identical (sorted, deterministic); no comments in source (reasoning lives in commits and DEPLOY.md).

Neighbour files that the above talk to and that a change here usually also touches: `scripts/flows-pipeline.mjs` (consumer), `scripts/flows-legs/{flow,vol,ownership,market,events,card-x}.mjs`, `shared/flows-card.js`, `shared/flows-ask.js`, `shared/flows-brief.js`, `shared/flows-dossier.js`, `shared/flows-dossier-worker.js`, `shared/flows-live.js` (`pulseWithLive`), `assets/js/flows-{events,political,unusual,history,market,ticker}.js`.

### Symbol index

Only non-trivial symbols; one-line numeric helpers (`num`, `str`, `round`, `numOrNull`, `fin`, `flag`, `sum`, `usd`, `sig`) are private per file and deliberately duplicated (no shared helper module in this area).

#### flows-garch.js

`fitGarch(closes, dates, {minReturns 60, mask})` (170) returns `{status:"unavailable", reason}` or `{status:"ok", dist:"skewt", method, n, mean, robustSd, cap, capped, omega, alpha, beta, nu, lambda, persistence, longRunVol, lastVol, nextVol, avg21Vol, logLik, sigma2Next, masked, ljungBox, grade 1..3, why[], converged, reason?, returns, dates, condVol, ewma}`. Procedure: percent log returns -> median/MAD winsorisation at 6 robust sd -> variance targeting -> three Nelder-Mead starts on a penalised likelihood (prior pulls persistence to 0.95, ARCH share to 0.1) -> grade 3 only if converged, no parameter on a bound, `alpha >= 0.01` and Ljung-Box p > 0.05. `mask` (Set or array of ISO dates) removes earnings-reaction days from the likelihood (`pipeline` passes it only through `QP.refitGarch`). `garchAverageVariance` (162) gives the 21-session average variance used for `avg21Vol`.

`chainPerDeep 1.4`, `readsPerDeep 7`, `volPerDeep 8`, `volPerCross 2`, `volPerDossier 10`, `volRadar 4`, `flowPerDeep 12.2`, `flowPerCross 3`, `flowAlertPages 12`, `ownershipPerDeep 2`, `shortBatch 50`, `insiderBatch 25`, `earningsPerName 1`. `NOMINAL_SHAPE = {enriched 180, deep 72, cross 110, dossiers 12, earnings 95}`; `CALL_OVERRUN_MARGIN 0.10`. Chain leg stops at `DEADLINE_MS - CHAIN_RESERVE_MS` (`pipeline.mjs:5576`; `DEADLINE_MS` 36 min at `:256`, `CHAIN_RESERVE_MS` 6 min at `:353`). Flow-leg constants: `ALERT_BATCH 10`, `ALERT_LIMIT 200`, `ALERT_MAX_PAGES 8`, `ALERT_CLOSE_SLACK_MS 5 min`, `MULTI_LIMIT 500`, `MULTI_MAX_OFFSET 500`, `LIFELINES 3`, `LIFE_LIMIT 60`, `NOPE_KEEP 252`.

Env vars/secrets touched by the callers: the pipeline reads `UW_API_KEY` (vendor), `FLOWS_INGEST_TOKEN` and `FLOWS_INGEST_URL` (publish), `FLOWS_UW_BASE_URL`, `FLOWS_UW_TIMEOUT_MS`, `FLOWS_ALLOW_INTRADAY`, `FLOWS_REPUBLISH_SESSION`, and for `--live` `FLOWS_LIVE_TOKEN` or the Actions OIDC request vars; the Worker accepts the ingest token or the OIDC credential for writes. This area's modules read no env vars themselves (pure functions). Test-only switches: `FLOWS_TEST_SANDBOX=1`, `PLAYWRIGHT_BROWSERS_PATH`.

Wire formats that cross a module boundary: the stored `fresh` stamp `{v:1, readAt, vendorAt, source, cadenceS, session, writer}` (`freshStamp`, positioning.js:1213 and `freshEnvelope`, vol.mjs:344); the packed series `{s, x}` (`packSeries`); the `{__failed: code}` marker (`failedRead`) for a failed vendor read inside `rows` params; `silence(status, why)` sections; `nw` flag on unusual rows; `p` (1 = truncated chain) on unusual rows.

### Flows

1. Nightly run (`.github/workflows/flows-pipeline.yml`: crons `30 21 * * 1-5`, `30 22 * * 1-5`, `17 1 * * 2-6`, `47 3 * * 2-6`, plus dispatch) -> `scripts/flows-pipeline.mjs` main (session date: `resolveSessionDate` called at `:4695`, defined `:937`; `sameSessionGate` called at `:4708`, defined `:1756`). If the session is already archived (`gate.skip`, `:4723`) only `publishPulse`, `publishSectorPremium`, `publishNews` re-run; events/record/political/unusual/cards are untouched.
2. Order of this area's work inside one full run (line numbers in `pipeline.mjs`):
   `fitGarch` per enriched name inside the features builder `:1267` -> `measureVariationProbes` `:1288`/`:4994` (convention probe, `K_c`, unit family -> `variationRun`) -> boards get `row.variation = variationSummary(variation(featuresVariationInput(e), variationOptions(variationRun)))` (`boardVariation` closure `:5086-5096`, assigned per board row at `:5100`) -> archive walk starts `:5152` -> market legs `:5256` (ownership batches -> `ownershipParts` -> `cardX.add(t,"short"|"insiders")` `:5265-5268`) -> `buildEvents(withTilt, {gateOrigin, sessionDate, stageOf, featuresOf, scoreOf})` `:5314` -> `publish("events")` `:5322` -> record: `buildRecordCloses` `:2182`, `recordCalendar` `:2209`, `scoreSessions` `:5362`, `icTable` `:5370` -> `publish("record")` `:5376` -> chain leg `:5544-5800`: per board/focus name read up to 3 pages of 500 (`readPage` `:5585`), `mergeChainPages`, `buildChainPanels` `:5641`; a truncated chain triggers one single-expiry read at `nearestProbeExpiry` and re-runs `buildChainPanels(..., {requestedExpiry})` to recover scalars `:5650-5692`; `vannaProbeSample` `:5722` (defined `:1333`) -> `vannaScale(vannaSamples)` `:5849` -> `republishWithChain` `:5865` (rewrites `board:*` rows with skew/term/atm and refreshed `variation`) -> unusual: `rankUnusual(pooled)` `:5896`, `poolOiBasis` `:5897`, `rankUnusualNames(withTilt)` `:5900`, `markNewContracts` `:5906`, `publish("unusual")` `:5908` -> `publishPulse` `:6118` (seven reads -> `sessionPrints` on darkpool `:4111` -> `buildPulse` `:4113` -> `publish("pulse")` `:4128`) -> political: ladder `:6150-6205`, holders `:6212-6235` (`holdersRefusal` `:2785` skips the holders route for `HOLDERS_RETRY_DAYS` 7 after a plan refusal), `buildPolitical(raws)` `:6238`, `publish("political")` `:6247` -> sector premium, news -> vol leg `runVolLeg` `:6397` -> per-name cards `:6494 buildCard({... chain, darkpool, oiDeltas, termStructure, ivRank, variation: variationOptions(variationRun)})` -> `attachVol(card, volLeg, ticker, {ivRank})` `:6526` -> `publish("card-x:"+t, engineOut.extra)` `:6585`, `publish("card:"+t)` `:6586` -> `publishVol` `:6750` -> `runFlowLeg` `:6752` -> `publishCardX` `:6835`.
3. Card assembly (`shared/flows-card.js`): `buildCard` `:1541` -> `putMultipliers(variationOpts.probe)` `:1559`, chain panels via `chainPanel(chain, key, ...)` `:1661-1664`, `stockPanel(darkpool, shapeStockDarkpool, ...)` `:1693`, `buildVolContext(termStructure, ivRank, {sessionDate})` `:1702`, `card.panels.variation = buildVariation(card, {expiries, options})` (call `:1706`, def `:1732`) (try/catch -> `unavailable` panel), then `card.regime.bookGamma = variation.inputs.gammaBook`.
4. Flow leg (`scripts/flows-legs/flow.mjs`): `runFlowLeg` `:411` -> `flowLeg` `:208`: alert batches of 10 tickers (`readAlertBatch` `:45`, up to 8 pages of 200, windowed to the session) -> per deep name `deepName` `:291` fires ten reads in parallel (`greek-exposure`, `options-volume`, `gex-levels`, `flow-per-expiry`, `flow-per-strike`, `nope`, `spot-exposures`, `darkpool price-levels`, multi-leg, prior `hist:`), up to 3 lifeline reads -> sections via `gexHistory volumeHistory gexLevels flowExpiry flowStrike nopeSection gexPath darkpoolLevels alertsTape multiLeg` -> `emit` `:261` -> `composeCardX` `:173` (shed in `SHED_ORDER` until the flow sections fit 48 KiB, then the whole card 100 KiB) -> `publish("card-x:"+t)` then `publish("hist:"+t)` (`buildHist` `:107`); cross-section names get `crossName` `:354` (gex, volume, oiWalls only).
5. Vol leg (`scripts/flows-legs/vol.mjs`): `volNames` `:72` (depth deep/carded/index/fund) -> `runVolLeg` `:227` -> `readName` `:124` (phase 1 reads per `VOL_DEPTH_READS`; candles via `repairCandles` -> `regularSessionRows` -> `toBars`; skew reads `pickMonthlyExpiry`) -> panel builders -> radar (4 reads) -> `publishVol` `:435`: `cardXPayload` `:364` sheds `sentiment.history, character.history, anomaly.history, vrp.series, skew.series` until <= 100 KiB, then `card-x:<T>` and `regime`; `attachVol` `:295` writes the compact `card.x.vol = volSummary(...)`.
6. Ownership: `market.mjs:69-87` `readShortInterest`, `readInsiders` (batches), `readDeepOwnership` (`/api/shorts/{t}/data?newer_than=sessionDate-12d`, `/volume-and-ratio`) -> `ownershipParts` (`ownership.mjs:32`) -> per name `{short{status, interest, siScreener, borrow, volume, squeeze}, insiders}`.
7. Read path: browser page -> `GET /api/flows/<events|unusual|political|record|pulse>` -> `readServed` -> JSON; client scripts `assets/js/flows-events.js:639`, `flows-unusual.js:921`, `flows-political.js:523`, `flows-history.js:709`, `flows-market.js:1456` (pulse), `flows-overview.js:2109`; per-name pages call `/api/flows/card-x?t=` (positioning and volatility panels) in `assets/js/flows-ticker.js`.
8. Dossier read of the events row (`shared/flows-dossier-worker.js:87-90`): D1 locates the row of a ticker by counting the occurrences of `{"t":"` in the serialised `$.rows` text before `{"t":"<TICKER>"` and then `json_extract(payload, '$.rows[n]')`.

### Invariants and traps

1. `eventRow` key order: `t` MUST stay the first key and rows must serialise compactly. The dossier SQL (`flows-dossier-worker.js:87-90`) finds a ticker's events row by string position (`instr(r, '{"t":"TICKER"')`, then counts `{"t":"` in the prefix, dividing by 6 characters). A new nested object whose first key is `t` inside an events row, or reordered keys, silently returns the wrong row. Evidence: `flows-dossier-worker.js:89`; guarded by `tests/flows-dossier-reads.mjs:63-72` (runs `DOSSIER_SQL.events` against a real SQLite) and `:473` (a 200-row events table through `eventRow`).
2. Two clocks, never mix: prices describe `sessionDate`; day counts (`dte`, `sdte`, the 12-day gate, the 21-day window) count from `gateOrigin = nextTradingDay(sessionDate)` (`pipeline.mjs:4704`). `EARNINGS_GATE_DAYS = 12` (`pipeline.mjs:200`) and `eventRow.dte` must stay the gate's own number (`daysToEarnings`, `pipeline.mjs:729`); `flows-events-contract.mjs` builds the boundary both ways. `sdte === 0` (report on the first session) yields `ev: null`, not zero (`flows-events.js:64`). The events cap is on the date-sorted list, so a bound cap ENDS the table early (`capBound`, `lastShownDate`); `announce` stays withheld because 44 calls would buy one column.
3. `events` payload is not only `buildEvents`: the pipeline spreads `marketLegs.eventsAdditions` after it (`pipeline.mjs:5333`), capped separately at 64 KiB; the ingest cap is 128 KiB and an "all additions plus 200 rows" payload is pinned under it (`flows-legs-contract.mjs:740-745`). DEPLOY.md 10.5e's "zero vendor calls" is true of the rows, not of the whole key.
4. Null is not zero. Every builder uses `null`+reason. The classic defect is `Number(null) === 0`: the guards are `num` in `flows-political.js:1-5` (null, undefined and "" return the default) and `fin` in `flows-record.js:2` (`Number.isFinite`), and the tests that name the defect as a past scar include `flows-scores-contract.mjs:349` (the score archive, not in this area), `flows-brief.mjs:82` and `flows-card-contract.mjs:953`. Fixtures need a real zero beside a gap. Open political bands have NO midpoint (`parseBand` open branch 92-96, `valueBand` 121); `rankBuyers` tracks `openFloor` separately and never adds a floor to `bought`.
5. Pulse/Political feed lists: `PULSE_FEEDS` has 7 and `POLITICAL_FEEDS` has 4 (`clusters` is absent, `holders` present). Only the pipeline's logs (`pipeline.mjs:4118,4137-4139`, `6264-6268`), `buildPulse` and the contract tests (`flows-pulse-contract.mjs:155`, `flows-political-contract.mjs:396`) iterate those lists. `flows-ask.js` does NOT import them: `blockCensus` (`flows-ask.js:456`) counts every top-level payload key whose value is an object with a string `status`, which on a built payload is 8 for `pulse` (the 7 feeds plus `totalsHistory`) and 5 for `political` (`buyers assets clusters recent holders`, so `clusters` is counted there), feeding `pulseFacts` (`:423`, `answeredFeeds/feedCount`) and `politicalFacts` (`:392`, `answeredBlocks/blockCount`). Adding a block therefore means updating the lists where they apply AND every test that names a count (`flows-pulse-contract.mjs`, `flows-political-contract.mjs`, `flows-ask.mjs`, which asserts `answeredFeeds` at `:356`). Pulse tide points `{t, callPrem, putPrem, vol}` are rebuilt by `pulseWithLive` (`shared/flows-live.js:1285`, function at `:1273`); changing `shapeTide`'s row keys without changing that function breaks the overlay.
6. Unusual page vocabulary: the page may not say print/trade/block/sweep/order/bought/sold/paid/whale/smart money/institutional. `flows-unusual-contract.mjs:602` scans the payload `basis`, `volumeAsOfReason` and `coverage.ivBasis` with an allow-list of exactly four sentences (`basis.aggr` "counted each print against the side of the book", `basis.unit` "counter, not a trade" and "no sweep flag", `basis.refusals` "No smart money"); a dead allow-list entry fails the suite. The aggr sentence lives in `flows-chain.js:508-509` (`buildTopContracts.relation`), the others in `UNUSUAL_NOTES` (`:324`, `:358`). `UA_BANNED_CLAIMS` omits `order`; the test's regex includes it. The regex has the `g` flag: use `new RegExp(UA_BANNED_CLAIMS.source, "ig")` or reset `lastIndex` (as `contracts.mjs:1199`, `flows-worker-contract.mjs:294` do).
7. Unusual date refusal: the contract counter endpoint takes no date and carries no as-of; `volumeAsOf` stays `null` with a reason and `sessionDate` is legal only for `dte` (`dteAnchor: "sessionDate"`). `p` (truncated chain) rides per row because the feed mixes names. `markNewContracts` (`pipeline.mjs:2508`) sets `nw` to `null` on every row when the prior feed is absent or unreadable (`prior.status` `unavailable`), empty (`quiet`), the same session (`same-session`) or a later one (`ahead`); when both session dates parse and the prior is strictly earlier it marks 1/0 (`prior.status` `ok`); and when either date is missing or unparseable it STILL marks 1/0 and says `prior.status: "undated"`.
8. Chain truncation rule: a full 500-row last page is an arbitrary subset (no documented ordering), so `skew`, `skew30`, `term`, `atmIv` are withheld unless a single-expiry request answered it (`flows-chain.js:705-718`). `ATM_IV_CEILING = 3.0` (300% annualised, `flows-chain.js:56`, read only at `:357`, `:362` and `:369`) is a separate constant that backstops the percent-convention test in `flows-premium.js`: `ivConvention` divides by 100 only when a chain's median IV exceeds `IV_PERCENT_THRESHOLD = 5` (`flows-premium.js:69`, tested at `:92`; `IV_PERCENT_CEILING = 500` at `:71`), and `ivSurface`'s own percent tripwire tests that same threshold (`:373`), so a chain genuinely quoting 3.5-5.0 as a fraction passes both; the ceiling publishes such an ATM as unavailable with its measured value instead. Keep `ATM_IV_CEILING` below `IV_PERCENT_THRESHOLD` (reasoning: commit 9c49af3). `preferOutOfTheMoney` exists because without the OTM filter put and call tie at every strike and the skew became a confident zero (DEPLOY.md ~1232).
9. Dependency direction: `flows-chain.js` imports `flows-card.js` (and `flows-quant-card.js`); `flows-card.js` imports `flows-stock/variation/unusual/pulse`; `flows-positioning.js` imports `flows-variation.js`. Do not make `flows-card.js` import `flows-chain.js` (cycle). `flows-card.js` is imported only by `flows-chain.js` and the pipeline, so none of `flows-stock/pulse/unusual/chain` is in the Worker bundle; `flows-positioning`, `flows-variation` (through `flows-neuron.js`) and `flows-vol` (through `flows-basis.js`) are, so edits to those three also change Worker CPU/size and the `worker-regression`/`flows-reads` budgets.
10. GARCH: `fitGarch` output is consumed by `flows-card.js:1576,1676` (`avg21Vol`, `grade`), `flows-neuron.js:515,997`, `flows-variation.js sessionSigma` (requires `dist === "skewt"`, so an old-law fit is rejected), `flows-vol.js buildVrpPanel` (`avg21Vol`, `converged`, `alpha`), and `flows-quant-world.js` imports `skewtConstants/skewtDensity/lnGamma/garchAverageVariance`. It is NOT in the browser quant bundles (`assets/js/flows-quant*.bundle.js` entries `flows-quant-browser.js`, `flows-quant-read.js` do not reach it), so changing `flows-garch.js` does not require `scripts/build-flows-quant-bundle.mjs`. The prior (persistence 0.95/sd 1.0, share 0.1/sd 0.7) is part of the model identity; changing it changes every published vol.
11. Variation: all dollar scalings go through `unit.used` (`share` vs `pct$`) and `scale.used` for vanna/charm; `charm` also needs `K_c` ok. Silences, not zeros: `variation()` returns `unavailable` with a `silences[]` code for no-spot / no-sigma / no-gamma, `vanna`/`charm` silent unless the probe settled the put sign and `vannaScale.status === "agree"`. `VARIATION_VOTES = false` keeps the model out of the Neuron's votes (`flows-neuron.js:3`); flipping it changes Neuron output. Board rows use only the gamma channel (`sdBasis "gamma"`), deep cards can show `"gamma+vanna"`.
12. Positioning: all section builders are total (never throw) and return `silence(status, why)` with `why` from `FLOW_CODES`; `flows-payload-shape.mjs:692` fails on a code or unit outside `FLOW_CODES`/`UNITS`. `gate()` rules: `undefined` -> `unread`; `{__failed}` -> that code; wrong envelope -> `unreadable malformed`. Session windows use `Intl.DateTimeFormat` with `America/New_York` at module load (`NY_PARTS`, `:122`), fine in Node and workerd. `hist:<T>` packing loses precision on purpose (`packSeries`, 4 significant digits); do not unpack for equality tests.
13. Vol: percentile fields are fractions 0-1 (`parsePct` rejects anything outside, counted `pctOutOfRange`); IV outside `[0.005, 5]` is dropped (`plausibleIv`); `rowsOf`/`bodyPanel` treat non-list as `unreadable-body`; nothing dated after `sessionDate` may enter any history (`cutAfter`). `volSummary` is the only vol object stored on every card (`card.x.vol`); full panels are only in `card-x`. Keep `VOL_PANELS` (`vol.mjs:25`), `VOL_DEPTH_READS` (`:10`) and `SHED_ORDER` (`:27`) in step with new panels.
14. Record: scoring never mixes epochs (`SELECTION_EPOCH` splits current from prior), never scores an exit dated after the last completed session (`unclosed`), counts lost/delisted/split names as `lost` rather than zero, and `hit` is pooled over names not averaged over session rates. A price from an archived board is used as a close only if the archive was written between that session's close and the next open (`closedPriceWindow` defined `pipeline.mjs:1019`, applied `:2194`). `icTable` ranks a feature only from `3*k` scored sessions.
15. Ownership: borrow `fee/rebate` are FRACTIONS (vendor percent / 100); availability >= 10,000,000 reads as a cap (`availCensored`); short interest older than 45 days is `stale` and excluded from squeeze pressure; only deep names carry borrow and short-volume; insider codes other than P/S are counted in `otherCodes` and ignored; `sessionsSince` has no caller.
16. Dead or test-only exports (safe to refactor but check tests first). Referenced by tests only: `rvEstimators` (`flows-vol-contract.mjs:4,26`), `describeFlowAlerts` (`flows-unusual-contract.mjs:11,390-439`; DEPLOY.md 10.5d still describes a `flow-alerts:` probe, but the pipeline's flow-alerts leg now builds the counter feed with `nightlyAlerts` from `flows-alerts.js`), `UA_BANNED_CLAIMS` (`flows-worker-contract.mjs:5`, `contracts.mjs:1192`, `flows-unusual-contract.mjs:11`), `eventRow` (production reaches it only through `buildEvents`; the dossier tests import it). Referenced nowhere outside their own definition, not even by a test: `CONE_TENORS` (`flows-vol.js:5`), `TERM_MIN_DAYS` (`flows-chain.js:53`), `sessionsSince` (`flows-ownership.js:244`).
17. Comment policy: these files carry no comments; do not add any. Put reasoning in the commit message or DEPLOY.md. Generated files are not touched by this area (no generator step).
18. Name collisions to avoid mistakes: `flows-pulse.js` (nightly) vs `Pulse` DO (`flows-rt-hub.js`); `flows-chain.js` (panels, `flows-chain-panels.mjs`) vs `GET /api/flows/chain` (Worker, `flows-chain-contract.mjs`); `unwrapRows` exists in `flows-pulse.js:14` and `flows-political.js:8` (identical), imported as `unwrapVendorRows` by the pipeline from the political module; `vnum`/`isoDay`/`daysBetween`/`median` are re-implemented separately in positioning, vol, variation, cross; `rowsOf` exists in positioning (`rowsOf(body, rule)`: `object`, `chains`, default array-or-`{data:[]}`) and vol (`rowsOf(body)`, no rule argument, array-or-`{data:[]}` only; its second reader is `compositeOf`, the `{data:{history,latest}}` envelope) with different semantics.
19. Docs vs source disagreements found: (a) DEPLOY.md 10.5d (lines 1501-1519) describes a bounded `flow-alerts:` probe, one call per run whose ten outcomes are logged as a line (it never names `describeFlowAlerts`, whose `line` strings carry those outcomes, `flows-unusual.js:174-247`); no production code calls `describeFlowAlerts`, and the pipeline's own `flow-alerts:` log lines (`pipeline.mjs:6070-6107`) come from the `nightlyAlerts` leg instead. (b) DEPLOY.md 10.5e says events costs zero vendor calls; the key now also carries vendor-read `macro/fda/earningsCalendar` additions. (c) The ban list has three spellings: DEPLOY.md 10.5d (about line 1473) names `print, trade, block, sweep, order, bought, sold, paid` (no `whale`, `smart money`, `institutional`); `UA_BANNED_CLAIMS` (`flows-unusual.js:10-11`) has those minus `order` plus `whale`, `smart money`, `institutional`; the unusual test's `BAN` (`flows-unusual-contract.mjs:602`) is the union (it adds `order` back). (d) AGENTS.md's file map does not list any of these twelve modules; the Confirmed-no-server list covers `flows-events-contract`, `flows-political-contract`, `flows-record-contract`, `flows-garch`, `flows-pulse-contract`, `flows-stock-contract`, `flows-chain-panels`, `flows-variation`, `flows-vol-contract`, `flows-positioning-contract`, `flows-legs-contract`; `flows-unusual-contract` and `flows-political-render` appear under needs-a-server (`flows-events-contract` needs Chromium only).

### How to change it

General ritual for any change in this area: edit the pure module, then the producer if the shape changes, then every consumer of the field (grep the key name across `shared/ assets/js/ scripts/ worker.js tests/`), then run the owning suite plus `flows-payload-shape.mjs`, `flows-pipeline-contract.mjs` (123 s) and the Node dry run (`node scripts/flows-pipeline.mjs --dry-run`, part of `npm run test:pipeline`). Commit-message reasoning replaces comments. If a client file under `assets/js|css|data` changes (e.g. `flows-events.js`), bump `assets/version.txt`, update every `?v=` reference and `ASSET_VERSION` in `shared/flows-pages.js`, re-check `grep -rn 'woff2?v=' --include=*.html --include=*.css .` against `assets/fonts-version.txt`, and mind the page weight ceilings in `tests/flows-weight.mjs` (KiB: events 155, political 144, unusual 204, history 157, market 242, ticker 400). A new test file must be registered both as `test:<name>` and in the `npm test` chain in `tests/package.json` (the chain stops at the first failure, so position matters); positions today: `flows-legs` 8, `flows-record` 9, `flows-chain-panels` 10, `flows-unusual` 31, `flows-events` 32, `flows-pulse` 37, `flows-stock` 47, `flows-political` 50, `flows-political-render` 51, `flows-garch` 63, `flows-variation` 67, `flows-vol` 68, `flows-positioning` 69 (0-indexed over the 77 `&&` segments).

|---|---|---|

| Change the window, cap or the gate | `EVENT_WINDOW_DAYS` / `EVENT_ROWS` (`flows-events.js:12-14`); the gate is `EARNINGS_GATE_DAYS` (`pipeline.mjs:200`) and also drives the composite filter at `:4865` | `flows-events-contract`, `flows-pipeline-contract` (gate arithmetic both directions), DEPLOY.md 10.5e |
| Add a pulse feed | shaper + `PULSE_CAPS` + `PULSE_FEEDS` + `SHAPERS` (`flows-pulse.js`); request in `PULSE_FETCHES` (`pipeline.mjs:4087`); dry-run `fakePulseRaws` (`:3798`); client `assets/js/flows-market.js`; no edit in `flows-ask.js`, whose census (`pulseFacts` `:423`, `blockCensus` `:456`) counts the new status-bearing key by itself, so only the counts the `flows-ask` test names change | `flows-pulse-contract`, `flows-ask`, `flows-live-contract` (if tide shape moves), `flows-payload-shape` |

## Options engine and premium desk

### Purpose and boundaries

**What it is.** One body of pure, I/O-free, comment-free ES modules that prices listed options and ranks option structures. The same source runs in three places: (1) the nightly pipeline (Node, GitHub Actions) builds the per-name `engine` block of every deep card; (2) the Worker (V8, `worker.js`) re-runs the full engine (`runCardEngine`) only for `/api/flows/strategy?engine=1`; for `/api/flows/chain` it runs the premium/basis modules (`printOf`, `coherence`, `rankChain`) and merely forwards the card's engine inputs (`deskEngine`: rate, pLaw, event, facts, levels, state, `deskSmiles`) so the browser can price each ranked sale with `FlowsQuant`; (3) the browser runs generated esbuild bundles (`FlowsQuant` global) so the Premium desk, the Strategy lab and the ticker dossier price and draw with the very same code. Beside the engine sit the two Premium-desk server modules: `flows-premium.js` (sale pricing, gates, ranking, IV surface, earnings gate, buying-power sizing, `deskSmiles`) and `flows-basis.js` (which spot is a legal spot, and whether the chain and spot belong to the same moment).

**Layering (acyclic, verified by imports).**
`bs` <- `smile` <- `density` <- `structures` <- `engine` <- `card` <- (`browser`, `read`); `time` is a leaf used by `engine`, `card`, `premium`, `basis`, `pipeline`, `freshness`, `universe`, `worker.js`; `world` imports `bs`, `density` and `shared/flows-garch.js` and is imported only by `scripts/flows-quant-pipeline.mjs` (never by a browser bundle); `premium` imports `bs`, `time`; `basis` imports `premium`, `bs`, `time`, `flows-vol.js`.

**What it is not.**
- Not the Neuron (`shared/flows-neuron.js` reads `card.engine`, imports only `STRUCTURE_BY_ID`, `AFFINITY`, `BUCKET_LINES`) and not the dossier/reading layer (`flows-dossier*.js`, `flows-reading*.js` read `card.engine.facts` ids as `options.engine.<factId>`).
- Not the GARCH fit (`shared/flows-garch.js`: `fitGarch`, `skewtConstants`, `skewtDensity`, `lnGamma`, `GARCH_EWMA_LAMBDA`; engine consumes its result, world re-exports/uses its helpers).
- Not the desk UI (`assets/js/flows-desk.js`), Strategy lab UI (`assets/js/flows-strategy.js`), ticker dossier (`assets/js/flows-ticker.js`), the chain panels (`shared/flows-chain.js`, which borrows only `parseOptionSymbol`, `ivConvention`, `priceSale`, `ivSurface`, `SURFACE_MAX_EXPIRIES` and `SURFACE_MAX_ROWS` from premium (import block :1-4) and `quoteImpliedVols`, `QUOTE_IV_BASIS` from quant-card (:8)), nor the nightly orchestration (`scripts/flows-pipeline.mjs`) beyond the hooks listed in Flows.
- No D1 writes, no Durable Object, no secrets inside these modules. All state lives in the callers (`flows_payload` rows `card:T`, `card-x:T`, `ideas`).

**Neighbours / cross-area edges.**
- `worker.js` imports `bookRows, runCardEngine, engineState, engineStale, QUANT_CARD_VERSION` (worker.js:12), `rankChain, RANK_KEYS, crossesEarnings, numOrNull, parseOptionSymbol, ivConvention, ivSurface, deskSmiles, hasNoEarnings, optionRoot, PRICING_RATE, DEFAULT_GATES` (worker.js:22-25), `stateOf, printOf, coherence` (worker.js:26), `etDayOf` (worker.js:27).
- `scripts/flows-pipeline.mjs` imports `parseOptionSymbol` (:41), `black76` (:42), `* as QP from ./flows-quant-pipeline.mjs` (:45).
- `scripts/flows-quant-pipeline.mjs` imports `fitGarch` (flows-garch.js) and `openInterestGammaBook` (flows-features.js:644).
- `shared/flows-basis.js` imports `regularSessionRows`, `candleDay` from `shared/flows-vol.js` (:248, :258).
- Premium helpers are shared widely: `parseOptionSymbol` by flows-alerts, flows-card, flows-chain, flows-positioning, flows-pulse, flows-stock, flows-unusual; `daysToExpiry`, `SHARES_PER_CONTRACT` by flows-unusual. `bookLevels` (quant-card) by flows-card.js:20 only (flows-positioning.js:446 defines its own `bookLevels`, imports only flows-features/flows-variation/flows-premium, and does not import quant-card). Calendar: `nyseHolidays` and `nyseEarlyCloses` by flows-freshness.js:1, `nyseHolidays` alone by flows-universe.js:1. `normCdf/normPdf/bsmGreeks` by flows-variation.js:1.
- Pages that load the bundles: `deskPage` (`/flows/desk/`, flows-pages.js:468, scripts :474), `strategyPage` (`/flows/strategy/`, :909, scripts :915), `tickerPage` (`/flows/ticker/`, :781, scripts :789 loads the READ bundle).

**Doc gap.** AGENTS.md has no file-map row for any `shared/flows-quant-*.js`, `shared/flows-premium.js`, `scripts/flows-quant-pipeline.mjs` or `scripts/build-flows-quant-bundle.mjs`; the only prose is AGENTS.md lines about the generated bundles (~1070-1076), the `FlowsQuant` global (~1101-1102), the rows at 152 (desk-client/desk-fixtures tests), 162 (the one file-map row in scope: `shared/flows-basis.js` with its contract test) and 188 (the quant-audit tests) and test-timing notes (~959-1003). DEPLOY.md has no section on the engine, the desk, or the bundles (only passing mentions at 406, 1223, 2130-2142, 2723). This part file is the first complete description.

Reading the table: `desk` families (3, 4, 19) are vetoed `family.desk-only` unless `scoreFamilies` is given `desk`; `dir: state` families (15, 17, 18) take their direction from the Neuron state and are vetoed `dir.none` when the state has none; `liq.tier-c` vetoes n 11..22; `eventVeto` vetoes `event.inside` for any family with `vol: short` or `premium: credit` unless it is `eventCrush` (iron-fly) in crush mode; only 16 and 17 are multi-expiry and are built by `engine.buildMulti`, the other 20 by `buildLegs` cases; `no-position` is skipped by `scoreFamilies` and never priced.

### Data and interfaces

**HTTP routes (all GET, Flows-session gated).** The gate is `path.startsWith("/api/flows/")` at worker.js:3601: `requireMethod` GET (POST only for `/api/flows/ask`, :3603), then `currentFlowsUser` else JSON 401 `unauthorized` (:3604-3605). Owner/members audience is the Flows credential system, not the Lab session.

| route | worker.js | params | cache | vendor reads | D1 reads | response |

Error codes thrown on these routes: `invalid_ticker` 400, `invalid_expiry` 400, `chain_empty` 404, `chain_no_spot` 502, `chain_unconfigured` 503 (no `UW_API_KEY`), `chain_upstream` 502, `chain_rate_limited` 429, `chain_too_large` 502, `store_unreadable` 503 (+ `Retry-After: 30`). `buildChainPayload` swallows a failed `coherence` (status `"unchecked"`, `console.warn` JSON at :2260) and a failed `info`/`stock-state` read.

**Payload rows (D1 `flows_payload`, id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, payload TEXT, updated_at; worker.js:133).** This area produces content for `card:<T>` (field `engine`), `card-x:<T>` (engine block only when split; shape `{ticker, sessionDate, generatedAt, engine}`; the same key is also written by the vol/flow/ownership/earnings legs through `scripts/flows-legs/card-x.mjs` `composeCardXPayload` which spreads the prior same-session payload so `engine` survives), and `ideas` (`ideasPayload` flows-pipeline.mjs:2373 from `leadIdea`). Limits: `FLOWS_MAX_PAYLOAD_BYTES` 128 KiB (worker.js:923); card panels shed to 100 KiB before the engine is attached (flows-pipeline.mjs: `shed` list :6529, loop :6545-6554, hard refusal when still over :6556); `attachEngine` splits at `INGEST_CAP` 128*1024; `CARD_X_BUDGET_BYTES` 100 KiB applies to the leg-composed card-x. No schema or migration belongs to this area.

**Engine block (`card.engine`, built by `compactEngine` card.js:498).** `{v:1, engine:"q1", asOf, spot, atr, rate{r, method, n}, assumptions{exercise:"european", carry:"continuous", drift:"forward", equityPremium:0, intraday:"time-uniform"}, liquidity{tier, medianRelSpread}, expiries[{expiry, dte, sessions, hSessions, T, forward{F, D, r, qImpl, pairs, method}, smile{...}}], facts[], state, levels, event, zeroGamma, pLaw{model, drift, grade, why, knots[{h, edges[65], means[64]}], params, ewmaVol, coneMedianVol, vol}, structures[<=5], ideas[<=3 ids], noTrade{code, closest}|null, priced, families[<=8]}` or the pointer `{status:"split", key:"card-x:T", bytes}`; with `fits:true` also `asOfMs`, `stale`, `fits[]`. A structure carries `{id (S1..Sn, positional), family, risk, dir, expiry, dte, sessions, hSessions, T, legs[], price{mid, natural, fill, model}, maxProfit, maxLoss, profitUnbounded, lossUnbounded, maxProfitAt, maxLossAt, breakevens, capital{kind, value}, carry, world{drift, premium, exercise, why}, greeks, prob{popQ, popP, pMaxProfitQ/P, pMaxLossQ/P, touchShortQ[]}, ev{q, p, pNatural, edge, pBand}, tail{var5P, cvar5P}|null, grade, gradeParts{fit, liquidity, model, edge, event}, gradeWhy[], score, rules[], engine:"q1", grid?, curves?}`.

**noTrade codes** (set by `rankStructures`, engine.js:846-848; human text is the `TIER_WHY` table, `shared/flows-neuron.js:825-837`): `candidates.none` (no candidate priced), `model.none` (no structure has a finite real-world EV), `risk.undefined-only` (eligible structures exist but none defined-risk to lead), `grade.none` (positive-EV structures all grade < 1), `ev.none-positive` (no positive real-world EV that holds under every law). The Neuron adds `chain.absent`, `engine.absent` (flows-neuron.js:855), `engine.unreadable` (emitted by `neuronTier` at flows-neuron.js:851 for a card whose engine block is `unreadable`, `unavailable` or `split`) and `ideas.none` (the fallback code at flows-neuron.js:844-845 when the engine returned no `noTrade` code); both are also keys of `TIER_WHY` (:830, :836). The screen tier adds `event.window`, `premium.conflict`, `table.no-side`, `state.undetermined`, `screen.no-inputs` (flows-neuron-screen.js:270-279).

**Engine reason / grade codes** (strings in structures' `gradeWhy`, `world.why`, `rules`, vetoes): fit.* (`fit.few-quotes`, `fit.ssvi-failed`, `fit.unrepairable`, `fit.out-of-spread`, `fit.one-sided`, `fit.flat`, `fit.in-spread`, `fit.repaired`, `fit.contract-iv(.wide/.far)`, `fit.card-shape`), liq.* (`liq.one-sided`, `liq.spread`, `liq.oi`, `liq.slippage`, `liq.not-tight`, veto `liq.tier-c`), model.* (`model.none`, `model.ewma`, `world.event-missing`), edge.* (`edge.none`, `edge.sign-flips`, `edge.small`), event.* (`event.smooth-slice`, `event.few-moves`, `event.q-equals-p`, veto `event.inside`), caps (`risk.undefined`, `card.stale`), vetoes (`state.avoid`, `family.desk-only`, `state.undetermined`, `dir.none`, `dir.against`, `expiry.none`), snap rules (`wall.call`, `wall.put`, `wall.target`, `flip.beyond`, `band.one-sigma`, `level.magnet`, `level.maxPain`, `rnd.median`).

**Env / secrets.** `UW_API_KEY` (Worker secret + GitHub Actions secret; absent -> `chain_unconfigured` 503). `UW_BASE` (test only: redirects the vendor; default `https://api.unusualwhales.com`, worker.js `UW_BASE_DEFAULT`). `UW_NOW` (test only, ISO instant, honoured by `chainReadMs` :2184 only when `UW_BASE` is also set; `deskEngine` still uses `Date.now()`). `DRY_RUN` (pipeline). No `wrangler.toml` var belongs to this area.

**Key numbers.** Quote pipeline: tick .05, spread <= 60% of mid, vega >= 1% of ATM vega, both-sides band 2% in log-moneyness. Candidates: <= 24 (MAX_CANDIDATES), 5 families (TOP_FAMILIES), 3 ideas (TOP_IDEAS), 5 structures published (PUBLISH_STRUCTURES). Fill model: mid + 25% of (natural - mid). Slippage budget 20% of price. Law: 64 bins, 9 horizons, 32,768 Sobol paths (power of two required), 10 Sobol dimensions, seed `ticker|sessionDate|q1`. Pricing rate fallback 4%. IV convention divisor rule: median > 5 means percent. Desk gates 15% spread, OI >= 100, premium >= $5, 1..400 DTE; chain returns <= 120 ranked rows (`limit: 120`). Payload cap 128 KiB. Free-tier CPU: coherence on a 1000-contract chain < 8 ms median (flows-basis-contract.mjs:342); engine fit + 24 structures on a 400-quote expiry < 1.2x a same-process reference workload at median and < 2x at p95 (flows-quant.mjs:913, :916; idle machines read 0.70-0.81).
