| adapters | 776-905 | `transport` 776, `feeds(k)` 778 (mode socket/poll, synced, not resync/cold, rows held, last frame within `GRACE[k]`), `ixOf` 785, `strips` 790 (a `live:strips`-shaped body with `__rt:true`, `__verdict:[state, staleAt, skew]`, `__ff`, `fresh.writer:"rt"`), `quote` 816 (`source:"rt"`, null for stale/pending), `gex` 834, `mergeTide`/`market` 839/854 (stream tide points appended to the polled series; sector rows), `alerts` 885, `news` 890, `fresh` 892, `status` 894, `measure` 903 |
| install | 907-911 | `window.FlowsUI = Object.freeze(Object.assign({}, window.FlowsUI, { rt: Object.freeze(api) }))`; the file returns early if `FlowsUI` is missing or `FlowsUI.rt` exists |

### Data and interfaces

**Routes (all through `route()` in `worker.js:3889`, all `GET`, all `no-store` via `finalize()`, JSON errors in the project envelope `{error:{code,message}}`).**

| route | method/gate | behaviour |
|---|---|---|
| `GET /api/rt/ws` | Upgrade websocket; Flows session (`flows_session` cookie via `currentFlowsUser`); audience gate (`rtAdmits`); `requireSameOrigin` (Origin and `Sec-Fetch-Site`); optional `k` (topics), `f` (focus ticker, validated against `TICKER_RE` -> 400 `invalid_ticker`) | strips every client `X-RT-*` header and `Cookie`, sets `X-RT-User` = username and `X-RT-Exp` = session exp (ms), `stub.fetch` to `https://pulse.internal/ws`; the DO accepts the pair via `ctx.acceptWebSocket(server, ["u:"+u])`, calls `hub.admit`, arms an alarm in 10 ms, returns `101` with `webSocket`. No Upgrade header -> 426 `upgrade_required`. |
| `GET /api/rt/snap?k=px,fl,..` | Flows session + audience; unknown topic -> 400 `invalid_topic` | DO `/snap`: wakes the hub, waits up to 3 s for a cold topic in session, returns a JSON array of snapshot envelopes (plus a `closed` and a `degraded` ctl frame when applicable) with the `X-Fresh-*` headers of the worst frame and `X-Server-Now`. |
| `GET /api/rt/status` | Flows session + **owner only** (`rtIsOwner`, even when audience is `members`) | DO `/status` JSON plus `worker:{mode,audience,users,hint,binding:true}`; DO failure -> 503 `rt_unavailable` with `Retry-After: 5`. |

Error order inside `serveRt` (:16-64; the owner-only status wrapper is :62-68 and the function ends at :69): mode off -> 404 `rt_off` (even for anonymous callers) -> missing/invalid `PULSE` binding -> 404 `rt_off` -> unknown path under `/api/rt/` -> 404 `not_found` -> non-GET -> 405 `method_not_allowed` + `Allow: GET` -> no session 401 `unauthorized` -> status non-owner 403 `forbidden` / others non-admitted 403 `rt_forbidden` -> bad `k` 400 `invalid_topic` -> (ws only) 426, cross-origin 403 `forbidden`, bad `f` 400 -> DO call; any non-HttpError throw is 503 `rt_unavailable` + `Retry-After: 5`. Inside the DO (`Pulse.fetch` :887) mode off again answers 404 `rt_off`; `/ws` without verified headers 401; unknown DO path 404.

**Durable Object.** One class `Pulse` (SQLite-backed, migration `v1`, no `script_name`), one named instance `pulse:1`, location hint `FLOWS_RT_HINT` (`enam`, honoured at first `get()`). Uses only `ctx.getWebSockets`, `ctx.acceptWebSocket`, `ctx.setWebSocketAutoResponse` (`"ping"` -> `"pong"`, no wake; nothing in this repo sends it), `ctx.storage.getAlarm/setAlarm/deleteAlarm`, and per-socket `serializeAttachment({u, exp, k, f})`. No DO storage rows are written. Hibernation: the in-memory hub is lost; the constructor re-arms an alarm if `ctx.getWebSockets()` is non-empty, the next `tick()` finds `running === false`, calls `start(now, {notify: "restart"})` (new epoch `max(now, ep+1)`, counters reset, `ctl.resync{reason:"restart"}` broadcast), and `sockState` reads topics/focus/user/exp back from the attachment.

**D1 (read-only, hub only).** Every 5 minutes while demanded (and at hub start; first failure retried only after the next 5-minute window because an empty roster is installed): `flows_clock` (`SELECT * ... id = 1`), `flows_payload` ids `board:long|short|watch` (`json_extract` + `json_each` over `$.rows` for `t,s,px`; `RT_BOARDS_SQL` :220), `flows_payload` id `focus` (`FOCUS_NIGHTLY_SQL`). One `batch()` round trip, 3 statements, 3 s timeout (`Promise.race`). No writes of any kind (test-enforced). The rows-read cost of this batch is not covered by `tests/flows-reads-contract.mjs` (that suite counts Worker routes); it falls under the 5,000,000 rows/day D1 free-tier read cap noted in AGENTS.md.

**Caches.** None: no Cache API, no KV, no `caches.default`; all state is DO memory. The page-side memo is `sessionStorage["flows:rt:off"]`.

**Env / vars / secrets.**

| name | kind | values | effect |
|---|---|---|---|
| `FLOWS_RT_MODE` | `[vars]` (`on`) | `on` else off | off: routes answer 404 `rt_off`, DO `tick()` calls `shutdown(4011,"rt-off")`, `Pulse.fetch` answers 404 `rt_off` |
| `FLOWS_RT_AUDIENCE` | `[vars]` (`owner`) | `members` else owner | who may open `/ws` and read `/snap`; `/status` always owner-only |
| `FLOWS_RT_USERS` | `[vars]` (`anilkaya`) | comma list; each `^[a-z0-9_.-]{3,32}$` lowercased; empty string admits nobody; absent -> `anilkaya` | "owner" set (Flows has no owner concept) |
| `FLOWS_RT_HINT` | `[vars]` (`enam`) | one of `wnam enam sam weur eeur apac oc afr me` else none | DO location hint |
| `FLOWS_RT_CALLS_PER_MIN` | optional | 10..1200, default 240 | vendor-call budget (`hubConfig` :34); the per-minute ceiling handed to `createBudget` is `round(callsPerMinute / scale)` (`flows-rt-hub.js:269`); the ring itself is fixed at 60 one-second slots |
| `FLOWS_RT_USER_CAP` | optional | 1..10, default 3 | sockets per user (4009 beyond) |
| `UW_API_KEY` | secret | vendor Bearer token | empty key makes every poll fail with `no-key`; shared with the rest of the Worker |
| `UW_BASE`, `UW_NOW`, `FLOWS_RT_SCALE` | test only | URL; ISO instant; 0.05..1 | honoured only while `UW_BASE` is a non-empty string (`hubConfig` :23-25); `UW_NOW` pins the hub clock (advances with real time), `FLOWS_RT_SCALE` scales every cadence, deadline, linger, backoff and the budget |
| bindings | `PULSE` DO, `DB` D1 (read), `ASSETS` (irrelevant) | | `AI`, `UW_ONDEMAND` are never touched |

**Headers.** Upgrade request headers consumed by the DO: `X-RT-User`, `X-RT-Exp` (set only by `serveRt`). `/snap` responds with `X-Fresh-State, -Reason, -Class, -Read-At, -Source ("hub"), -Cadence, -Session, -Live-Until, -Stale-At, -Phase, -Phase-Ends`, `X-Server-Now`. `finalize()` adds the seven security headers and `Cache-Control: no-store`; CSP applies to HTML only and carries `connect-src 'self' wss://anilkaya.org ...` (`worker.js:111`).

**Wire format (frozen in `shared/flows-rt.js`; client codes against exactly this).**

- Envelope: `{"v":1,"k":"px|fl|gx|mk|nw|ctl","ep":<epoch ms, new on every hub (re)start>,"sq":<per-topic sequence, +1 per frame within an epoch>,"at":<hub send ms>,"snap":true (snapshots only),"fresh":<streamEntry shape>,"meta":{},"rows":[]}`. `ctl` frames add `"t"`, have `sq: 0` and no `fresh`. `snap` frames carry the topic's current `sq`, so the next delta is `sq + 1`. Every successful poll emits one frame (rows may be `[]`) because the frame is what refreshes `fresh`.
- Control frames (`t`): `hello` (meta `{transport:"ws", upstream:"rest", mode, audience, topics, hbS:5, cold, phase, session, f}`, `rows` = one snapshot per subscribed topic), `hb` (meta `{upstream: up|down|closed, phase, sockets, degraded, topics:{k:{sq, readAt, lagMs, fresh}}}`, every 5 s of silence, every 30 s when closed), `resync` (meta `{reason: restart|session|recovered, k[]}`), `degraded` (meta `{reason, k[], since, retryAt}`; once per episode/reason change), `closed` (meta = `closedInfo`: `{phase, reason: weekend|holiday|overnight|no-clock, day, lastClosed, nextOpenAt, nextRthOpenAt}`; once per closed reason+day), `bye` (meta `{reason, code}`, final).
- Rows: `px` `[ticker, qt, ...23 strip values]` (`meta.cols` on snapshots; latest wins by vendor quote time; changed rows only; `qa` not a change; snapshot recomputes `qa` against the read time); `fl` = the `live:alerts` row plus `id` and `ts`, ascending, appended and deduped by alert id, at most 200 a frame, meta `{cursor, read, unusable, dropped, truncated}`; `gx` `[ticker, atMs, px, gOi, gVol, gDir, flow(0|1), lagS]`, one name a frame; `mk` objects with `id` (`tide` plus one per sector ETF, the `live:market` sector rows; the tide row `{id,status,date,t,ncp,npp,net,nv}`), `nw` the nightly news row plus `id` and `ts`, at most 60 held.
- Snapshot-only meta: px adds `cols`, `missing`, `prevFill`; gx adds `cols`; a cold topic snapshot is `{rows:[], meta:{cold:true}, fresh:{state:"pending",reason:"unpublished",klass}}`.
- Client to server (<=256 bytes, text only): `{"t":"sub","k":[...],"f":"NVDA"}` (f optional; null/"" clears), `{"t":"p","sq":{px:n}}` (laggard report), `{"t":"rs","k":"px"}` (resync; server ignores repeats inside 2 s per topic).
- Close codes: 1008 flood (more than 20 messages in 10 s), 1009 bad message (binary, >256 B, bad JSON/shape/type, extra keys), 4001 session expired, 4003 audience (defined, unused), 4008 laggard (client more than 10 frames behind on any subscribed topic with data), 4009 per-user cap, 4011 rail off, 4012 hub full (200 sockets). `bye` precedes only 4001, 4008, 4009, 4011, 4012 (see traps).
- Freshness: classes `rt` live 15 s / stale 60 s, `rtSlow` 30/120, `rtNews` 75/300 (`flows-freshness.js:9-11`; extended hours use the same windows). For stamped topics (`px`, `gx`, `mk`) a frame is `live` only when the newest vendor timestamp is within `liveS + barS` (gx 60 s bar, mk 300 s bar) of the hub's read; event topics (`fl`, `nw`) are live by the success of the poll.

**Budgets and caps (actual numbers, `RT_LIMITS` :32-60).** `userSockets` 3, `sockets` 200, `laggardFrames` 10, `snapLingerMs` 60,000, `snapWaitMs` 3,000, `hbMs` 5,000, `closedHbMs` 30,000, `closedTickMs` 30,000, `tickMs` 1,000, `rsMinGapMs` 2,000, `messageBurst` 20 per `messageWindowMs` 10,000, `focusMax` 8, `gexFocusEvery` 4, `rosterMs` 300,000, `callsPerMinute` 240, `callTimeoutMs` 4,000, `degradeAfterMs` 15,000, `failCapMs` 15,000, `pause429MaxMs` 120,000, `pause429BaseMs` 5,000, `flowOverlapMs` 30,000, `flowLimit` 200, `seenMax` 1,000, `newsLimit` 100, `lagSamples` 256, `ringMax` 200 (declared but unused: merges use `RT_TOPICS.*.rowMax`). Row caps: px 200, fl 200, gx 64, mk 16, nw 60. Degrade line per topic: `max(3*cadence, 15 s)*scale` (px/fl/gx 15 s, mk 30 s, nw 90 s). Poll cadence: px 5 s, fl 5 s, gx 1 s, mk 10 s (two calls), nw 30 s -> about 98 vendor calls/min with a viewer (px 12, fl 12, gx 60, mk 12, nw 2) against the 240 budget; zero with no viewer. Polling window: 04:00-20:00 ET on trading days only (`phaseAt`/`inSession`; outside it the hub sends `closed` once per reason and polls nothing). Client: `ROWS_MAX` 2,000 rows per frame, ring fl 200 / nw 60, `SEEN_MAX` 1,000, `GRACE` px 20 s / fl 20 s / gx 30 s / mk 40 s / nw 120 s. Documented (DEPLOY.md 3090-3101, not re-measured): px frame 32,042 B for 157 rows, 433 KB/min on the socket for all topics, snapshot 134 KB (81 KB of it fl), receive path 0.8-1.0 ms per px frame. Weight (static): `flows-rt.js` is 32,860 B and is counted in the six pages' JS ceilings in `tests/flows-weight.mjs` (see traps).

### Flows

**1. Page load to first paint of a streamed value (socket rung).**
1. `shared/flows-pages.js` emits `flows-ui.js`, (`flows-fresh.js`), `flows-rt.js`, page script, all `defer`, in that order.
2. `flows-rt.js:911` installs `FlowsUI.rt`. A page script (e.g. `flows-board.js:1458 streamPrices`) calls `UI.rt.connect({topics:["px"]})` -> `connect` :744 -> `S.refs.px++` -> `reconcile` :718 -> `begin` :683 (reads the `flows:rt:off` memo; registers visibility/pagehide/pageshow; `openSocket` :546) and `rt.on("px", fn)` registers the listener (`on` :736).
3. Browser `new WebSocket("wss://host/api/rt/ws?k=px[&f=T]")` -> Cloudflare -> `worker.js fetch` -> `route()` :3889 -> `serveRt` (flows-rt-routes.js:16): switches, binding, method, session, audience, topics, Upgrade, same-origin, focus; headers scrubbed; `stub.fetch("https://pulse.internal/ws?...")`.
4. `Pulse.fetch` :887 -> `upgrade` :900 -> `WebSocketPair`, `ctx.acceptWebSocket(server, ["u:<user>"])`, `hub.admit` :526 (mode on; per-user cap -> `bye 4009`; hub-full -> `bye 4012`; creates socket state, `persist` attachment, `start` the hub if not running, sends `hello` :508, and a `closed` frame if outside session) -> `arm(10)` -> `101`. `finalize()` copies the response (`new Response(response.body, response)`) so the socket survives and gets the security headers.
5. Client `receive` :518: `hello` -> `S.helloed`, `stopPoll`, `setMode("socket")` -> `paintFeed` -> pill shows `Feed: Socket`; the embedded snapshots go through `frame` -> `topicFrame` -> `applySnap` -> `queue` -> rAF `flush` -> page listener -> `UI.rt.strips()` -> `takeLive`.
6. Alarm loop (see flow 3) produces `emit` deltas; client `applyDelta` at `sq + 1`; `register` feeds the freshness pill; `pulse` every 30 s sends `{t:"p"}`; `watch` drops a silent socket after 16 s.

**2. Poll rung.** Socket failed, `bye` with a `KEEP_OFF` code, or the hello did not arrive in 10 s -> `lost()`/`ended()` -> `fallback()` -> `startPoll(0)` -> `pollOnce` :609 -> `fetch("/api/rt/snap?k=...")` -> `serveRt` -> `Pulse.fetch /snap` -> `hub.snap(ks)` :781 (`lastSnapAt = now`, `start` if needed, `host.wake(10)` + `waitData(ks, 3000)` when in session and a topic is cold, else wake in one tick) -> array of snapshots (+ closed/degraded ctl) with `X-Fresh-*` -> client applies them as snapshots (`setMode("poll")`), re-arms in 5 s; `closed` frame stops polling until `nextOpenAt`. The socket is probed again at ~1, 2, 4, 8 s (jittered), then once a minute; a `hello` ends polling. Three consecutive poll failures -> mode `heartbeat` (the pages' own `UI.heartbeat` REST reads only). 400/401/403/404 -> `goFinal` -> mode `off` (403/404 memoised 10 min in `sessionStorage`).

**3. Hub alarm loop (`Pulse.alarm` :876 -> `RtHub.tick` :725).**
1. mode != on -> `shutdown(4011, "rt-off")`, return null (no new alarm).
2. `sweep` :600: closes sockets whose `exp <= Date.now()` with `bye 4001 session-expired`; counts sockets; `pickFocus` of their `f` values (top 8).
3. no `demand` (no live socket and last `/snap` older than 60 s*scale) -> `stop()` (upstream stopped, state reset, waiters released), return null; `Pulse.alarm` then sets no alarm (and `release()` deletes it on last close).
4. not running -> `start` (notify `restart` if sockets exist).
5. `ensureRoster` (D1 every 5 min, 3 s timeout) then `phaseAt(now, this.clock)`; outside 04:00-20:00 ET trading phases -> broadcast `closed` once per reason:day, `beat(closed)` every 30 s, return `min(30 s*scale, time to open)`.
6. In session: session rollover (`this.session !== phase.session`) -> `start` with `resync` reason `session`; `refreshSession` (prior-close base from nightly sources, gex rotation by 15-minute tick); `refreshNames` (roster plus focus -> `setPxNames`); `await upstream.tick(now)`.
7. `createRestUpstream.tick` :196: every topic whose `due` has passed and is not in flight runs `poll(k, at)` in parallel unless paused by a 429; `poll` takes budget, makes the REST call(s) (px one call with up to ~168 names; fl `newer_than` cursor; gx one name a call from `gexPick`; mk two calls; nw one), shapes with `RT_REST_SHAPE`, and calls `handlers.onFrame`.
8. `RtHub.onUpstream` :414 -> `mergeTopic` -> update `readAt/vendorAt/meta/full`, lag stats -> `emit(k, rows)` :453: increments the topic counter, sends the delta to sockets that already hold a snapshot, a snapshot to those that do not (`st.have`).
9. After the upstream: still demanded? -> `evaluate` :672 (degrade/recover), `beat` :707 (hb if nothing was broadcast for 5 s*scale), return `max(50, 1000*scale - elapsed)` ms; `Pulse.alarm` sets the next alarm at `Date.now() + max(25, delay)`.

**4. Gap and resync.** Client sees `f.sq > T.sq + 1` -> `T.resync = true`, deltas held, `ask(k)` sends `{t:"rs",k}` (server `onMessage` :588-:591 answers a snapshot if >=2 s*scale since the last `rs` for that topic) every 2.6 s up to 5 tries then `dead` (socket dropped and ladder restarts). A heartbeat reporting `h.sq > T.sq` does the same. A new epoch (hub restart, session rollover) arrives as a snapshot with a different `ep` -> `reset(k)` and adoption; a delta in an unknown epoch is an orphan -> resync.

**5. Degrade and recovery.** `evaluate` (:672) marks a topic down when `forceThrottle` is set (any throttled error since the last evaluate marks every topic down at once), or when `fails>0` and the topic's last success (or the hub start) is older than its degrade line or an episode is already open, or when the upstream is paused by a 429 and the topic is past that same condition; `forceThrottle` is cleared on every evaluate. First time (or reason change) broadcasts `ctl.degraded`; on recovery `resync(topics, "recovered")` bumps each recovered topic's counter and re-sends snapshots to subscribers, epoch unchanged (`Pulse` never restarted).

**6. Close paths.** Client `pagehide` -> `stopSocket(1001)`; hidden 30 s -> `hibernate`. Server: `Pulse.webSocketClose` -> `hub.onClose` + `ws.close(code)` + `release()` (stops hub and deletes alarm when no demand); `webSocketError` same; kill switch off -> `shutdown(4011)` at next tick; `onMessage` errors close 1008/1009 without `bye`.

### Invariants and traps

**Hard CI-enforced rules (evidence in `tests/flows-rt-contract.mjs:1421-1447` unless noted).**
- The rail files (`shared/flows-rt.js`, `flows-rt-hub.js`, `flows-rt-routes.js`, `tests/rt-fixtures.mjs`, `tests/flows-rt-contract.mjs`, `tests/flows-rt-server.mjs`) contain zero comment lines (line starting `//` or any `/*`). Repo-wide rule too (AGENTS.md "Commentary").
- Those three shared files: no `INSERT|UPDATE|DELETE|REPLACE|DROP|ALTER|CREATE` (after stripping the word `Update`), no `env.AI` or `.run(` anywhere, no `UW_ONDEMAND`, no `console.log/warn/info/debug` (only structured `console.error` via `logOnce`).
- The comment scan (contract :1422-:1429) rejects any line matching `^\s*//` **or containing `/*` anywhere**, so a glob or path string such as `"/api/rt/*"` or `"**/*"` inside `shared/flows-rt*.js`, `tests/rt-fixtures.mjs`, `tests/flows-rt-contract.mjs` or `tests/flows-rt-server.mjs` fails CI even though it is not a comment (`tests/flows-rt-client.mjs` and `assets/js/flows-rt.js` are not in that file list; the client suite itself uses `page.route("**/*", ...)`).
- Seam (contract :1245-:1324): inside the `RtHub` class body (`export class RtHub` to `export function createHub`) the strings `fetch`, `/api/`, `newer_than`, `Authorization`, `Retry-After`, `http_4`, `http_5`, `cfg.base`, `cfg.key`, `interval_5m`, `up.raw`, `screener`, `spot-exposures` must not appear; the `Pulse` class body must not contain `fetchImpl` or `/api/`. Any REST detail belongs in `createRestUpstream`.
- Worker wiring asserted by regex: `worker.js` has `export { Pulse } from "./shared/flows-rt-hub.js"` and `path.startsWith("/api/rt/")`; `wrangler.toml` has exactly the binding block `[[durable_objects.bindings]]\nname = "PULSE"\nclass_name = "Pulse"`, the `[[migrations]] tag = "v1" new_sqlite_classes = ["Pulse"]` block, `FLOWS_RT_MODE = "on"`, `FLOWS_RT_AUDIENCE = "owner"`, the four unchanged crons, `FLOWS_LIVE_MODE = "actions"`, and no `head_sampling_rate = 0`.
- Frozen contract constants: `RT_TOPICS`, `RT_LIMITS`, `RT_CLOSE` and `RT_ROW_FIELDS` are asserted frozen (contract :43-:45; the `RT_LIMITS` and `RT_CLOSE` values are not pinned there, they are exercised by behaviour: 4008, 1009, 1008, 4009, 4001, 4011 close codes in the hub blocks), `RT_UPSTREAM` is asserted frozen with its channels, scopes and `rest` builders in the seam block (:1246-:1254, with `RT_UPSTREAM_API.methods` and `.frame`). The exact lists (`RT_TOPIC_KEYS`, `RT_KINDS`, `RT_CTL`, `RT_ENVELOPE_KEYS`), cadences `[5000,5000,1000,10000,30000]`, classes `[rt,rt,rtSlow,rtSlow,rtNews]`, 25 px columns and the gx column list are asserted (contract :39-:51); each `RT_TOPICS[k].key` must exist in `LIVE_KEYS` (:52-:54); `FRESH_CLASSES.rt/rtSlow/rtNews` windows are asserted at :68 and again in `tests/flows-freshness-contract.mjs:76-91`. Changing any of these asserted lists without updating the test fails the suite.
- Row parity: the rail's rows equal the stored live-key shapers' rows value for value (contract :250-:392; the roster plan equals Tier 2's plan at :394-:421 and again in the roster block); `streamEntry` has exactly the keys `entryOf()` writes for a stored key (:108).
- One sequence counter per topic (a shared counter manufactured false gaps).

**Behavioural traps.**
- **Docs vs source (source wins).** (1) AGENTS.md says "A server-side close is always preceded by `ctl.bye`". In code only `bye()` (4001, 4008, 4009, 4011, 4012; hub :368) sends it; flood (1008, hub :562), bad message (1009, hub :564) and `Pulse.webSocketMessage` error (1008 `"error"`, hub :926) call `closeSocket`/`ws.close` directly with no `bye`, and the client treats them as ordinary losses (`ended` -> `lost`, reconnect with backoff). Tests assert the 1008/1009 codes only. (2) AGENTS.md says the page goes `off` when the rail answers "401, 403 or 404"; the client's `FINAL` also includes 400 (flows-rt.js:27, DEPLOY.md 3041 agrees) and AGENTS.md omits the 10-minute `sessionStorage["flows:rt:off"]` memo (403/404 only; 401 is not memoised so a later sign-in works), which DEPLOY.md documents. This `sessionStorage` use is outside `IEWTStorage` (the AGENTS.md storage rule governs Lab learning data; Flows pages do not load `storage.js`). (3) `RT_CLOSE.audience` (4003) is defined and the client lists it in `KEEP_OFF`, but the server never sends it: the audience gate is an HTTP 403 before the upgrade. (4) The `"ping"`->`"pong"` auto-response is installed, but the only client heartbeat is the JSON `{"t":"p"}` every 30 s, which does wake the object (by design: it carries the sequence report).
- **`window.FlowsUI` is replaced, not mutated.** `flows-fresh.js:175` and `flows-rt.js:911` each assign a new frozen object. Page scripts capture `const UI = window.FlowsUI` at load, so `flows-rt.js` (and `flows-fresh.js`) must precede the page script in `shared/flows-pages.js`; if the order slips, `UI.rt` is `undefined` and every `UI.rt && ...` guard silently disables streaming with no error. Board pages deliberately lack `flows-fresh.js`; the client then uses its own `stateOf`.
- **Two files are called `flows-rt.js`.** `shared/flows-rt.js` is the Worker/Node ESM wire contract (kept out of the static bundle by the `shared/` line of `.assetsignore`), `assets/js/flows-rt.js` is the browser IIFE served from `/assets/js/`. They share no code: the client re-declares `TICKER`, `FIELDS`, the cadence-dependent `GRACE` and the close codes it cares about, and codes only against the envelope.
- **Name collision.** `Pulse` (Durable Object) vs `flows-pulse.js`/`buildPulse`/`overlayPulse`/the `pulse` nightly key (market breadth/tide payload). Grep for `Pulse` returns both; they share nothing.
- **Token/roster coupling.** `flows-rt-hub.js` imports `flows-live-worker.js` (a large module: ledger, OIDC, tick code) only for `normalizeClock` and `FOCUS_NIGHTLY_SQL`, and `flows-live.js` for the shapers; a change to a `shapeStrips`/`shapeGexSeries`/`shapeMarketLive`/`alertRow` signature or to `STRIP_FIELDS` order ripples straight into the rail (px rows are `[t, qt, ...STRIP_FIELDS]`; client `FIELDS` at flows-rt.js:7-8 is a hard-coded fallback copy of the 23 names and must be edited with `STRIP_FIELDS`; snapshots carry the authoritative `meta.cols`).
- **Polling is not per-topic demand, and `gx` has no page consumer.** `RtHub.plan.topics` is always the full `RT_TOPIC_KEYS` set (hub :272), `demand()` counts sockets and snapshot readers only (:349), and `createRestUpstream.tick` polls every topic in `ORDER` whose `due` has passed. One viewer of the unusual page (subscribed to `fl` alone) therefore costs the same ~98 vendor calls a minute as one on the home page; the subscription only decides which sockets receive `emit` frames (`st.topics.has(k)`, hub :462). No page script in `assets/js/` calls `connect` with `gx` or reads `UI.rt.gex()` (the 60 calls a minute of gx run for no browser consumer today), and `connect()` with no `topics` would subscribe to all five.
- **px change detection differs by side.** Server `rowSame` compares values from index 2 and ignores `qa`; client `sameRow` (:174) compares from index 1 (so includes `qt`) up to but excluding the last column. Harmless, but do not "align" them without reading both test files.
- **Session `exp` is checked only on the 1 s sweep.** A revoked or disabled member keeps an open socket until the cookie's own `exp` (ms), because the DO only compares `st.exp <= Date.now()` (hub :607); the live membership check runs at upgrade time (`currentFlowsUser`) and at each `/snap`.
- **Roster failure is sticky for 5 minutes.** `ensureRoster` stamps `rosterAt` before it reads, so a D1 error (or the 3 s `roster timeout`) is retried only after the next 5-minute window. If a roster was already held the last good one stays; only a hub with no roster yet installs an empty one (`applyRoster({clock:null, boards:{}, focus:null})`, so names fall back to the constant focus fallback plus indices and the clock is null). The `!this.roster && this.rosterAt && now - this.rosterAt < 30000` early return (`flows-rt-hub.js:618`) is effectively unreachable for that reason; `status().roster.error` shows why; logged once a minute per key.
- **Restart loses everything.** A Worker deploy restarts the DO (new epoch, sockets dropped, clients reconnect with jitter); deploy outside 04:00-20:00 ET on trading days (DEPLOY.md 2938-2941). A hibernation wake sends `resync reason restart` and rebuilds each socket's `have` set empty so the next emit is a snapshot.
- **Local workerd quirk.** A server-initiated close of a socket that has never sent a client message is acknowledged on the wire but never raises `close` in the client in local workerd; clients must act on `ctl.bye` (`flows-rt.js:526`, `onBye`), which is why `bye` exists. Raw workerd with in-memory DO storage crashes when an alarm fires, so `tests/worker-server.mjs` persists storage (`--persist-to`).
- **Test-only time/scale knobs are inert in production** (`UW_BASE` unset), and `UW_NOW` only pins the hub clock; the module-level `T0 = Date.now()` is taken at isolate load.
- **Cost of an off rail.** With `FLOWS_RT_MODE` off the first page load of a tab still costs one refused upgrade (404) and one 404 snapshot and two console error lines, then the memo silences other pages for 10 minutes.
- **Nothing in the repo exercises the live vendor.** DEPLOY.md 3024-3027: the real quote-time lag, edge-to-object latency and real-idle hibernation are unproven; all suites use the fake vendor.
- **Weight ceilings are nearly full.** Measured (read-only, `PAGES[*Page]` script sizes at this commit) versus `CEILING_KIB` in `tests/flows-weight.mjs:12-27`: tickerPage 399.1k/400, overviewPage 264.4k/265, marketPage 241.5k/242, sidePage 217.8k/218, watchPage 217.8k/218, unusualPage 203.8k/204. Any growth of `flows-rt.js`, of a hooked page script or of the quant-read bundle on those pages trips `flows-weight` unless the ceiling is raised deliberately in the same commit (the test says a ceiling "is a decision and should look like one in the diff").
- **Asset ritual.** Any edit under `assets/js/` bumps `assets/version.txt` (currently 240), every `?v=` reference and `ASSET_VERSION` in `shared/flows-pages.js:1` (held equal by `tests/flows-features.mjs`); after a blanket `?v=` rewrite re-check the 16 woff2 references against `assets/fonts-version.txt` (230).
- **Dev server in the sandbox.** `flows-rt-server` needs `FLOWS_TEST_SANDBOX=1` or it hangs on the watcher crawl (AGENTS.md "Which suites need the dev server"). `flows-rt` (contract) needs Node >= 22.13 for `node:sqlite` and `--disable-warning=ExperimentalWarning`.
- **Unused-by-production exports** that tests depend on: `checkFrame`, `createSeq`, `applyPx/Flow/Gex/Market/News`, `snapshotPx/Flow/Gex/Market/News`, `RT_UPSTREAM_API`, `RT_CTL`, `RT_CLIENT_TYPES`, `hubConfig`, `rtClock`, `loadRosterFromD1`, `RT_BOARDS_SQL`, `rtTopics`. Deleting them as "dead code" breaks the suites.

### How to change it

**Run order for any rail change.** (1) `cd tests && node --disable-warning=ExperimentalWarning flows-rt-contract.mjs` (about 20 s, 1,118 assertions as documented 2026-10-03). (2) `FLOWS_TEST_SANDBOX=1 node flows-rt-server.mjs` (about 151 s, 158 assertions; four workerd boots, the last at real cadence). (3) `node flows-rt-client.mjs` with `PLAYWRIGHT_BROWSERS_PATH` set (about 80 s, 260 checks; `RT_ONLY=<regex of merge|gap|ctl|silent|bye|backoff|poll|off|fresh|notlive|hidden|refs|pollclose|board|home|unusual|market|ticker|hub|closedpoll|heartbeat>` runs a subset, `RT_ONLY=measure` prints the receive-path/bytes numbers DEPLOY.md quotes). (4) `node flows-weight.mjs`, `node flows-features.mjs`, `node contracts.mjs` after any client/page change; (5) `./tests/node_modules/.bin/wrangler deploy --dry-run --outdir /tmp/anilkaya-dry-run` for binding/migration validation. In CI the rail suites run inside `npm test` (`tests/package.json:9` chain: `test:flows-rt-server` and `test:flows-rt-client` follow `test:flows-worker`; `test:flows-rt` follows `test:flows-live`); the chain stops at the first failure, so a red suite earlier hides these.

Never put a secret in vars. DEPLOY.md 10.5n table and AGENTS.md "Real-time rail" describe the values. |

## Nightly pipeline scripts/flows-pipeline.mjs lines 1-2400

Snapshot: commit ba2acfe (origin/main after PR 148), asset version 240, fonts token 230. Every line number below is from `grep -n` / `sed -n` on `scripts/flows-pipeline.mjs` at that commit (7,126 lines in all; this part owns declarations that START in lines 1-2400; `retireSession` starts at 2389 and ends at 2414, so it is mine; `plainRedispatchSaid` 2416, `ensureArchived` 2423 and everything after belong to the next part).

### Purpose and boundaries

What this slice is. The first third of the single-file Flows batch job. The file is an ESM executable (shebang line 1) that GitHub Actions runs as `node scripts/flows-pipeline.mjs` (nightly ranked run), `node scripts/flows-pipeline.mjs --dry-run` (synthetic fixtures, no network) and `node scripts/flows-pipeline.mjs --live` (the Tier 2 live layer, `runLiveMode` at 4602). It is referenced by 22 test files (10 import it, the rest spawn it with `--dry-run` or scan its source text; a 23rd, `flows-overview-contract`, only names it inside a message string at line 1420, and `scripts/render-preview.mjs:535` names it in a skip message); `main()` runs only when the file is the entry script (`invokedDirectly`, 7118-7126), and 66 names are exposed for tests through the trailing `export { ... }` at 7096-7116, on top of 104 inline `export` declarations in the file (69 of them inside 1-2400). Importing it has no network side effect.

This slice contains, in file order (lines are real):

| Lines | Region | One-line job |
|---|---|---|

| 77-128 | CLI flags, ingest URL, live credential, `ingestHeaders` | the only place the bearer for the ingest route is chosen |
| 130-256 | `UNIVERSE`, `RATE`, `CALL_COST`/`callModel`/`CALL_BUDGET`, session/cadence constants, `deepNames`, rate-controller maths, `DEADLINE_MS` | every tunable that sizes a run |

What it is NOT. It has no HTTP server, no D1/KV/DO access (the pipeline never touches Cloudflare storage directly: GitHub has no Cloudflare token by design, DEPLOY.md 10.5b), no browser code, no model/AI call. It holds none of the Worker's scoring or reading logic. The write path (`publish` 3049, `retire` 2970, `pruneArchive` 2995, `PUBLISH_RETRY*` 3021-3043), the fixtures (`mulberry` 3134, `fake*` from 3166), the `main()` orchestration (4675), `runLiveMode` (4602), and the end-of-run summary/health gate (7020-7090) are in the other two parts.

`uw()` contract (533-621): attempt loop `0..RATE.maxRetries` (5 attempts). Each attempt: `permits.acquire()` (adds to `stats.permitWaitMs`), `stats.calls++`, `fetch`. Network error → `stepRateController("error")`, retry (in `--live` the second timeout of one call throws: `timeouts > LIVE_VENDOR.timeoutRetries` with `timeoutRetries` = 1; any error on the last attempt throws). HTTP 429 → `Retry-After` seconds (cap 30 s) else `min(delay*4, 5000)`, floor raised, `permits.defer(wait)`, `sleep(wait)`, retry (the 429 consumes an attempt). HTTP ≥ 500 → "error" step and retry, throws `"<path> -> HTTP <status>"` on the last attempt. Any other non-ok status (404, 422, …) throws immediately with no retry. Success: "ok" step, `body` returned as-is when `envelope: true`, else `Array.isArray(body) ? body : body.data || []` (a non-array `data` object is returned as an object). Nearly every caller wraps it in `.catch(() => [])`, so a vendor error and an empty answer look alike downstream.

**Ingest route consumption** (`worker.js:3454`, `INGEST_META_KEYS_MAX = 96` at `worker.js:945`):

| request (this slice) | line | auth | answer handled |
|---|---|---|---|
| `GET ?key=<k>` | 1858 | nightly bearer (or live credential in `--live`) | 200 JSON body = the stored payload; 200 `{key, status:"pending"}` = never written (→ `absent`); non-ok → failed; 403 classified into Worker JSON 403 (`final`) vs edge/Cloudflare block (retryable) |
| `GET ?keys=a,b,…` | 1906 | nightly only (the live token gets 403 `live_token_scope`) | `{keys: {key: {present, sessionDate, generatedAt, updatedAt, bytes}}}`; ≤ 96 keys per request (the pipeline's `LEDGER_PROBE_CHUNK` must stay ≤ this, fpc 2250) |
| `GET ?list=card,card-x,hist` | 1922 | nightly only | same `{keys}` shape for the whole kind |
| POST/DELETE `?key=` | 3070 / 2979 | (other part) | |

Keys read in this slice: `board:long`, `board:short`, `board:<side>:<YYYY-MM-DD>`, `scores:<YYYY-MM-DD>` (memory, gate, archive walk, republish), plus whatever callers pass through `readStored` (`roster`, `unusual`, `political`, `live:*`, `flowalerts`). All fetches use `redirect: "error"` (1860, 1908, 1924, 2982, 3074): a redirect from the apex (e.g. the www/GitHub Pages hybrid) fails loudly instead of dropping the Authorization header.

**Caches, DO, D1:** none touched here. State is module memory: `stats`, `delayMs`, `delayFloorMs`, `permits`, `ingestWrites`, `liveBearer`/`liveMinting`, `edgeRefusals`, `publishRetrySpentMs` (3024), `tickFieldsReported`, `greekFieldsReported`.

**Wire/shape contracts defined here**
- Read result: `{payload, status}` | `{payload:null, absent:true, status}` | `{payload:null, failed:true, status, detail?, refusal?, final?, recovered?}`. `recovered: n` marks a read that succeeded on retry n.
- Board memory result: `{status, rows, incumbents, named, sessionDate, note, source, key}`.
- Same-session gate result: `{mode, skip, generatedAt, note}`.
- `boardRow` columns (above); board payload wrapper is built in main (5111-5148): `v: 2, side, generatedAt, sessionDate, rows, gateOrigin, gateDays, memory{status,sessionDate,named,incumbents,source,note}, universe, enriched, scored, dispersion, deadBand, neutral, cleared, shed, horizonSessions, weights, scoreVariance, variation, shareClasses, deep, deepRule, selection, selectionEpoch, status`.
- `edgeSnapshot()` → `refusalTally()` shape (from `scripts/flows-legs/health.mjs:106`) plus `retrySpentMs`.

### Flows

**1. Where this slice sits in a nightly run** (`main()` at 4675; hops that enter 1-2400):
1. `main` → `runLiveMode()` if `--live` (4677) else check `UW_API_KEY` + `FLOWS_INGEST_TOKEN` (4684) → `resolveSessionDate()` 937 → `intradayRefusal(sessionDate,{allow})` 973 (4700; throws when inside 09:30-16:00 ET without `FLOWS_ALLOW_INTRADAY`).
2. `sessionArchiveKeys` 2384 + `readStored` 1953 for the three keys (4707) → `sameSessionGate` 1756 (4708). `skip` → only `pulse`, `sector:premium`, `news` refresh (4723-4739; `partial` also prints the repair line and sets exit code 1) and return.
3. `verifyDating` 804 (4742) → screener harvest via `flows-legs/universe.mjs` or, if unusable, `sweepScreenerBand` 768 per cap band (4791).
4. Universe rows filtered with `eligible` 623 / `screenerTilt` 656 / `gatedWorthEnriching` 648 (4856-4893); picks enriched with `runPooled` 424 + `poolWidth(2)` 398 (4913-4941): `enrich` 876 → `computeFeatures` 1158 (4927-4935). Completeness < 80% throws (4960). Liquidity floor on `features.dollarVolume` (4970).
5. `measureVariationProbes` 1288 (4994) → `collapseShareClasses` 1551 (4997) → `scoreBoard` 1414 (5006) → `partitionSides` 1537 (5015) → `resolveBoardMemory` 1717 (5032) → `sessionRow` 1130 (5041) → if `gate.mode === "republish"` `retireSession` 2389 (5044) → `toRows` (2444, next part) → `boardRow` 2237 (via toRows) → `publish("board:<side>")` (5149).
6. `collectDatedBoards` 2024 starts as a background promise (5152) alongside `pruneArchive` (5159) and the early `roster` read; later `buildRecordCloses` 2182, `buildRecordBreaks` 2217, `recordCalendar` 2209 feed `scoreSessions`/`icTable` (5354-5371).
7. Chain leg bounded by `stats.startedAt + DEADLINE_MS − CHAIN_RESERVE_MS` (5576-5581), then `republishWithChain` 2313 (5865) writes dated key first and live key second; `archiveDatedBoards` 2284 (5870) only when no chain scalars exist.
8. Vol leg gets `repairCandles` and a pooled runner stopped by the deadline (6397-6402); cards lane `runPooled(cardTickers, …, {stopEarly: Date.now() > deadline})` → `foldCardOutcomes` 448 (6611).
9. End: `ensureArchived` (2423, next part; 6885) repairs missing session keys; `callModel` budget line (7039); `describeFloorVerdict` 483 (7082); `runHealthGate({read: readStored, edge: edgeSnapshot, …})` (7085); `process.exitCode = 1` on any failure.

**2. One vendor call** (`uw` 533):
`uw(path, params)` → build URL 534-545 → loop 549 → `permits.acquire()` 551 (spacing = current `delayMs`, ≤ 6 in flight) → `fetch` 557 (+ `AbortSignal.timeout` only in `--live`) → 429: `stepRateController("limited")` 589 → `permits.defer(wait)` 592 → `sleep(wait)` 594 → next attempt; 5xx/network: `stepRateController("error")` 568/600; ok: `stepRateController("ok")` 608 → `response.json()` 612 → unwrap 617-618.

**3. One store read** (`readStored` 1953):
`readStored(key, options)` → dry run short-circuit 1954 → `readWithRetries(() => readStoredOnce(key), key, options)` 1955 → `readStoredOnce` 1855: `fetch(ingestURL()+"?key=", {redirect:"error", headers: await ingestHeaders()})` 1857-1863 → status 403: `noteRefusal` 1845 (`refusalOf` → `tallyRefusal` into `edgeRefusals`) → failed (`final` if Worker JSON 403) 1864-1867; other non-ok: `noteAnswer` 1838 → failed 1868-1871; 200: JSON, `status:"pending"` → absent 1874 → payload 1877 → on a retryable failure `publishRetryDelay` (3037) → `pause(wait)` → once again, success after a retry is returned with `recovered: n` 1935-1950.

**4. Live credential** (`--live` only): `ingestHeaders` 121-127 → `liveCredential()` 102: `FLOWS_LIVE_TOKEN` short-circuit 103 → cache hit when same request URL and `exp − now > 60 s` 105 → else single-flight `actionsIdToken(env,{audience})` 108 (`shared/flows-oidc.js:136`, throws "needs `permissions: id-token: write`" when the env is missing) → cache `{token, exp: jwtExpiry(token), url}` 110. `runLiveMode` itself never calls it (lazy, pinned by `flows-live-contract` ~1520) so an out-of-window run depends on no token service.

**5. Memory and gate before ranking** (4707-4740 and 5028-5058): `readStored` ×3 → `sameSessionGate` → (`skip` | `republish` | `fresh/unverified` continue) … later `resolveBoardMemory(side)` → `reader("board:"+side)` 1720 → `readBoardMemory` 1637 → if status ∈ {unavailable, same-session, ahead} walk `priorWeekdays(sessionDate, 10)` reading `board:<side>:<day>` 1734-1745 → first `ok`/`quiet` archived board wins (`source: "archive"`).

**6. Republish** (`FLOWS_REPUBLISH_SESSION=1`): gate mode `republish` → `retireSession` 2389: order = `board:long:<d>`, `board:short:<d>`, then `scores:<d>`; `remove = retire` (2970, DELETE) with transient retries on the shared 90 s budget; first refused key stops the loop (`kept` lists the rest) and main throws before ranking anything (5048-5056).

**7. Archive for the record** (`collectDatedBoards` 2024 → `buildRecordCloses` 2182): for each weekday back to 126 calendar days read `scores:`, `board:long:`, `board:short:`; boards whose `generatedAt` is outside `closedPriceWindow` are NOT used for closes (counted in `boardPxRefused`); candle closes (cut at the session) overwrite board prices.

### Invariants and traps

Source-scan pins in tests (breaking the text breaks CI even if behaviour is right):
1. **One User-Agent literal, one header builder.** `anilkaya-flows-pipeline/1` appears exactly once (line 90); `function ingestHeaders(` exists; every `ingestURL() + "?key|keys|list="` site (count 5: read 1858, probe 1906, list 1922, delete 2979, write 3070) has `headers: await ingestHeaders(` within 900 chars and no inline `Authorization: "Bearer " + process.env.FLOWS_INGEST_TOKEN` (`tests/flows-pipeline-contract.mjs:2231-2265`). A Promise passed as `headers` silently sends no Authorization, so the `await` matters.
2. **Exact counts** in `tests/flows-live-contract.mjs` (~2732-2770): `ingestURL() + "?key="` ×3; `refusal = response.status === 403 ? await noteRefusal(response) : null;` ×4 (lines 1864, 1885, 2986, 3081); `await noteAnswer(null);` immediately followed by `return { payload: null, failed: true, status: 0` or `{ ok: false, status: 0` ×2 (1879, 2990); `noteAnswer` must keep its first line `if (response && !retriedStatus(response.status)) return null;`; `edgeSnapshot` must read exactly `return { ...structuredClone(edgeRefusals), retrySpentMs: publishRetrySpentMs };`. A new ingest request needs those counts raised in the test, not a copy-pasted block.
3. **Credential isolation.** The text between `export function liveCredentialSource` and `async function ingestHeaders` must not contain `FLOWS_INGEST_TOKEN`; `ingestHeaders` must keep `LIVE_MODE ? await liveCredential() : process.env.FLOWS_INGEST_TOKEN`; `publish` throws in `--live` for any key not matching `^live:[a-z]+(?::[a-z]+)?$` (3050); `runLiveMode` must not call `liveCredential(` (flows-live-contract ~1520). The live job holds no shared secret, only OIDC.
4. **`uw()` wire format is shared with the probe.** `BASE` stays the single-line `const BASE = process.env.X || "https://…"` form; `uw` body keeps `Authorization: "Bearer " + process.env.UW_API_KEY`, `Accept: "application/json"`, no `User-Agent`, `url.searchParams.append(k, String(item))` and `.set(k, String(v))` (`tests/flows-probe-contract.mjs:141-157`). The nightly client sends no `signal` (outside `--live` `vendorTimeoutMs()` is 0, `flows-starts-contract` ~968).
5. **Rate relation.** `RATE.floorCeilingMs × CALL_BUDGET < DEADLINE_MS − CHAIN_RESERVE_MS`. Raising `floorCeilingMs` (400), `CALL_BUDGET` (via `CALL_COST`/`NOMINAL_SHAPE`) or lowering `DEADLINE_MS` can fail fpc 2076-2083. The floor ceiling must stay strictly below `maxDelayMs` (5000) (fpc 2068). DEPLOY.md 10.5c (line 1438) says "Do not raise that ceiling on intuition"; DEPLOY.md 10.5b (line 1313) says it was 750 ms until 2026-09-25.
6. **`CALL_BUDGET` is derived, not a literal** (fpc 4346 requires `CALL_BUDGET === callModel(NOMINAL_SHAPE).total` and `CALL_COST.dossier === 13`) and must cover the focus-era shape `{175,70,105,12,90}` (fpc 4343).
7. **Candle cut at the session.** `sessionCandles` must run before any feature reads candles; the vendor does not honour `end_date` (evidence in DEPLOY.md 10.5h: 166 cards carried a partial 2026-09-22 bar). `fpc 3654` forbids `put(row.ticker, sessionDate, row.close)` (a screener price written as a close).
8. **Board memory reads no clock.** The body of `readBoardMemory` must contain no `Date.now(`, `new Date(`, `easternNow(`; the source must keep the literal call `readBoardMemory(read, sessionDate)` with the run's stamped `sessionDate`, never `easternNow().date` (fpc 2728-2737). That call lives in `resolveBoardMemory` (1721), not in main; main only passes its own `sessionDate` into `resolveBoardMemory(side, sessionDate, …)` (5032).
9. **Congress input rule.** The card lanes call `congressRows(ticker, congressState)` exactly 3 times; the old `congressRead === "ok" ? [] : null` expression must not reappear (fpc 4102-4107).
10. **Dry-run first.** CI and `npm run test:pipeline` run `node scripts/flows-pipeline.mjs --dry-run` before the contract suite; many other suites run it with `--emit` and parse the output, so a thrown error in any path of the dry run turns several suites red at once (flows-payload-shape, flows-card-render, flows-ticker-contract, flows-overlay-contract, flows-positioning-contract, flows-strip, flows-unusual-contract, flows-events-contract).
11. **Comment-free tree.** `scripts/flows-pipeline.mjs` has zero `//` comment lines (AGENTS.md "Commentary"); blank lines inside blocks are where comments were stripped. Reasoning goes in commit messages and `docs/`, not inline.
12. **No import cycle.** Legs and shared modules must not import `scripts/flows-pipeline.mjs` (the cycle scan in `flows-live-contract` walks it); legs get `uw`/`publish`/`readStored` by injection.

Behavioural traps:
13. **Silent empties.** Almost every `uw()` call is `.catch(() => [])`; a 4xx (non-429) throws immediately and becomes "no data". The only safety nets are `enrich`'s required-input check (876-927: greek-flow, strikes and session-cut candles) and main's 80% completeness gate (4960). Do not add retry-on-4xx to `uw`.
14. **A 429 consumes one of the 5 attempts.** A sustained refusal fails names, not just slows them. A 5xx/network error doubles the delay but never raises the floor (fpc 2072-2074).
15. **`isWeekday` and `intradayRefusal` know no holidays.** A weekday holiday between 09:30 and 16:00 ET is refused without `allow_intraday`; `nextWeekday`/`closedPriceWindow` treat a holiday as a normal weekday.
16. **`DEEP_RULE` has a hard-coded "50"** (line 217-221) separate from `DEEP_NAMES` and from `UNIVERSE.boardSize`; changing the constant does not change the published sentence.
17. **`DEADLINE_MS` is measured from module load** (`stats.startedAt` is set at import, line 358), not from `main()`; tests that import the module and call deadline-dependent code share that clock.
18. **`FAMILIES` (1400) is unused; family `P` has no signed column** (`familyCols.P = []`, 1437) so the published `fam.P` is always null and positioning enters only through `pDisp` horizon-only in `scoreVariance`. Do not treat the 5-family comment in older docs as live weighting.
19. **`selectExtremes` (2227) has no production caller**; test-only. `variationOptions` and `describeGammaRange` are used only by later parts.
20. **Archive immutability.** Dated keys `board:<side>:<d>` and `scores:<d>` are immutable at the Worker (a second different write answers 409; `archiveDatedBoards`/`republishWithChain` turn 409 into a "keeps the first" log line). Three paths delete: `retireSession` 2389 for `republish_session` (scores last), `pruneArchive` 2995 for dated keys past 126 days (calls `retire` at 3003, stops after 3 straight refusals), and the roster retire step `retireAndRoster` (`remove = retire`, 4456) for card, card-x and hist keys. The Worker also answers 503 when the existing dated key cannot be read (`shared/flows-archive.js` 18). `BOARD_SCHEMA_VERSION` bump would zero the 126-day retained record (DEPLOY.md 10.5a), so do not bump it for a presentation change.
21. **Read retries share one 90 s budget.** `readWithRetries` charges `publishRetrySpentMs` unless a private `budget` object is given (the roster read and the ledger probes do, so they cannot starve the meta/brief publishes); `resetPublishRetryBudget()` (3028) is called at the start of each live pass.
22. **A `?keys=` or `?list=` answer without a `keys` object is a failure**, not "everything absent" (1897-1899): reading it as absent would retire nothing and forget everything.
23. **403 handling splits two meanings:** Worker JSON 403 (`refusal.kind === "worker"`, e.g. `live_token_scope`) is `final`/not retried; Cloudflare/edge blocks are retried and tallied by kind. `READ_RETRYABLE` includes 403 and 0.
24. **`stepRateController` initial floor is 60 ms**, so the first 429 jumps the floor to 150 ms (the `minStepMs`), not 90 ms; the DEPLOY.md narrative "×1.5 per 429" is correct only after the first step.
25. **Doc/source differences noticed.** DEPLOY.md 10.5a (call-count prose near "THE CHAIN LEG IS THE LAST VENDOR SPEND") still says the chain leg "refuses to start past the 30-minute deadline" (DEPLOY.md 1218) and that sector TRIX is "skipped entirely past the 30-minute deadline" (DEPLOY.md 1346); the source deadline is 36 minutes (256): the chain leg refuses to start past `startedAt + DEADLINE_MS` (5571) and its mid-leg cut-off is start+30 min (5576), and the sector:trix gate is the full 36 minutes (5489). DEPLOY.md 10.5b example log lines (learned floor 240 ms, 408 calls) are historical. DEPLOY.md 10.5a says the record scorer makes "~270 archive reads", which matches 126 calendar days × 3 keys minus weekends.

Rituals that apply to any change in this file:
- No asset version bump is needed for `scripts/` changes (the browser never loads it); bump only when you also touch `assets/css|js|data`.
- No generator run (`generate-course-payloads.mjs`) is involved.
- Run order for a local check (no server needed; all are in the "confirmed to run with no server" list): `node scripts/flows-pipeline.mjs --dry-run` (about a minute), `cd tests && node flows-pipeline-contract.mjs` (about 123 s per AGENTS.md), `node flows-features.mjs`, `node flows-garch.mjs`, `node flows-universe-contract.mjs`, `node flows-live-contract.mjs`, `node flows-starts-contract.mjs`, `node flows-probe-contract.mjs`. Never `wrangler dev` for this file.
- The suites are registered in `tests/package.json` (`test:pipeline` line 24 runs the dry run then the contract); a new test file needs a `test:*` script and an entry in the chained `test` script (long `&&` list) plus a line in AGENTS.md's "no server" list.
- Update DEPLOY.md 10.5a/b/c/h when a number in "Budgets and caps" moves; the repo treats DEPLOY.md as the operator-facing mirror of these constants.

## Nightly pipeline scripts/flows-pipeline.mjs lines 2400-4800

Commit `ba2acfe` (origin/main after PR 148, asset version 240, fonts token 230). The file is 7,126 lines, comment-free, one ES module. Line numbers below are from `grep -n` / `sed -n` at this commit.

### Purpose and boundaries

This slice is the middle third of the nightly Flows pipeline (`node scripts/flows-pipeline.mjs`, GitHub Actions workflow `flows-pipeline.yml`: primary crons `30 21 * * 1-5` (runs only while Eastern is EDT) and `30 22 * * 1-5` (only while EST), so 17:30 ET each weekday, plus backup crons `17 1 * * 2-6` and `47 3 * * 2-6` that the same-session gate turns into a one-minute refresh when the session is already archived; when the zone gate lets a firing through, the `--dry-run` step at line 78 precedes the real run at 88, and the real run is skipped only for a manual dispatch with `dry_run` set). It holds, in order:

1. **Board and side-feed shapers** (2444-2941): `toRows`, `toWatchRows`, the unusual-contract "first appearance" marker (`markNewContracts`, `priorNote`), the sector TRIX shaper, the sector option-lean shaper (`sectorLean`), the political-holders refusal memory, the news shaper (`shapeNews`), the movers band, and `summarize`.
2. **Archive housekeeping and the publish transport** (2943-3132): dated-key helpers, the 126-day prune (`pruneKeys`, `retire`, `pruneArchive`), the retry/backoff state machine and `publish()`, the only function that writes to the Worker's ingest route for the nightly and for `--live`.
3. **The dry-run world** (3134-4079; `fakeEnrichment` is the last, 3975-4079): 24 deterministic synthetic fixture builders (`fake*`) (screener, focus rows, chains, surfaces, enrichment, pulse, political, news, flow alerts, OI ladders) seeded with `mulberry`, plus `DRY_SESSION_DATE = "2026-08-24"`. CI runs `--dry-run` before every real nightly and many test suites read its emitted payloads.
4. **Three nightly side-feed publishers** (4081-4263): `publishPulse`, `publishSectorPremium`, `publishNews`; also run on the same-session "unranked refresh" path.
5. **Index/fund dossier wiring** (4265-4327): `indexDossierDeps`, the dependency bag handed to `scripts/flows-legs/index-dossier.mjs`.
6. **The retire ledger and roster** (4329-4600): metadata probe, per-key bootstrap, store listing, retire plan execution, and the `roster` write (`retireAndRoster`), plus the dry-run roster doubles.
7. **Entry points** (4579-4800): `runWitnessDrill`, `runLiveMode` (the `--live` Tier 2 entry), and the first 125 lines of `main()` (declared at 4675; its body runs to 7094).

What it is not:

- Not lines 1-2400 (owned by "pipeline A"): arg parsing (77-82), `ingestURL`/`ingestHeaders`/`liveCredential` (86-128), `UNIVERSE`, `RATE`, `CALL_COST`/`callModel`/`CALL_BUDGET` (130-196), the permit queues `permits`/`ingestWrites` (368-381), `runPooled`/`poolWidth` (398-446), `uw()` (533), screener harvest/sweep, `enrich` (876), feature maths (`computeFeatures` 1158), board memory, `sameSessionGate` (1756), `readStored`/`probeStored`/`listStored` and edge-refusal tallies (1822-1968), `boardRow` (2237), `archiveDatedBoards` (2284), `republishWithChain` (2313), and `retireSession` (2389-2414, which straddles the boundary and is documented by A).
- Not lines 4800-7126 (owned by "pipeline C"): the body of `main()` after the screener (enrichment, scoring, all board/market/record/card/vol/flow/focus legs, brief, meta, health gate), the bottom `export { ... }` block (7096-7116) and the `invokedDirectly` bootstrap (7118-7126). This file documents `main()`'s first 125 lines in detail and gives a line-anchored skeleton of the rest in "Flows" so cross-references resolve.
- Not the leg modules in `scripts/flows-legs/*` (market, universe, vol, flow, card-x, focus, health, live, watch, index-dossier, fake-vendor, ...) or the `shared/*` builders it calls. Those are separate areas; this file only records the contracts this slice depends on.
- Not the Worker side of ingest (`worker.js` 3454-3591) except where its contract is a hard limit for this slice.

| `POST ?key=<k>` JSON body <= 128 KiB | `publish` (3070) | Bearer `FLOWS_INGEST_TOKEN` (nightly) or, for `live:*` keys with `--live`, `liveCredential()` (static `FLOWS_LIVE_TOKEN` or GitHub OIDC JWT). Non-archive keys UPSERT; dated archive keys (`board:long\|short:<d>`, `scores:<d>`) are create-only: identical payload -> `{stored:"unchanged"}`, different -> 409 `archive_immutable`, unreadable -> 503 `archive_unreadable`, race -> 409 `archive_raced` (`shared/flows-archive.js` `ARCHIVE_REFUSALS`). A `meta` write also writes the nightly ledger (`FLOWS_LIVE.nightlyLedger`). |

| `GET ?keys=a,b,...` (nightly token only, GET only, <= 96 keys, each passes the single-key allowlist) | `probeStoredOnce` (1906), `probeLedgerMetadata` | `{keys:{<k>:{present, sessionDate, generatedAt, updatedAt, bytes}}}`; rows whose payload `status` is `pending` report `present:false`. Over the cap -> 400 `too_many_keys`. |
| `GET ?list=card,card-x,hist` (nightly token only) | `listStoredOnce` (1922), `retireAndRoster` | `{keys:{<k>:{present:true, sessionDate, generatedAt, updatedAt}}, listed, truncated}`, cut at 2,000 rows (primary-key prefix ranges, ~580 rows read). |
| `DELETE ?key=<k>` | `retire` (2978) | Allowed for dated archive keys, and (nightly token only) `card:`/`card-x:`/`hist:` keys; never view keys (`board:long`, `universe`, `focus`, `roster`, ...). 404 `{status:"absent"}` when nothing was removed. |

All five call sites build the URL as `ingestURL() + "?key=" | "?keys=" | "?list="` and headers through `await ingestHeaders(...)`; `User-Agent: anilkaya-flows-pipeline/1 (+https://github.com/anilkaya001/anilkaya.org)` (90); `redirect: "error"`. Default ingest URL `https://anilkaya.org/api/flows/ingest` (override `FLOWS_INGEST_URL`).

**Exit codes**: any thrown error -> `pipeline failed: <message>` and `process.exit(1)` (7122-7126). `process.exitCode = 1` without throwing on: partial archive in the refresh path (4737), ARCHIVE LOST (6909), live failure verdict (`settle`, 4643), dry-live-day problems (4622), witness drill failure (4585), health gate failures (7093).

**Headers**: only the ingest request headers above (`Authorization`, `User-Agent`, `Content-Type: application/json` on POST). The slice reads `Retry-After`, `cf-ray`, `server` from responses (through `storeQuotaWait`, `noteRefusal`, error text).

### Flows

**F1. Process entry.** `7118` `invokedDirectly` (argv[1] equals this module) -> `7122 main()` -> `4675`. Imported by tests it does not run. Module-level `DRY_RUN`, `LIVE_MODE`, `EMIT` are computed at import from `process.argv` (77-82), so tests that import the module run in non-dry mode unless they pass `--dry-run`; they point `FLOWS_INGEST_URL` at a loopback server and stub `fetch`.

**F2. `main()` preamble (4675-4742).**
1. `LIVE_MODE` -> `return runLiveMode()` (4677).
2. Non-dry: require `UW_API_KEY` and `FLOWS_INGEST_TOKEN` (4684-4691); log the ingest URL.
3. `sessionDate = DRY_RUN ? DRY_SESSION_DATE : await resolveSessionDate()` (4695; A scope 937).
4. Non-dry: `intradayRefusal(sessionDate, {allow: FLOWS_ALLOW_INTRADAY==="1"})` throws on refusal before any vendor read beyond the session probe (4698-4702; pinned by test 3486).
5. `gateOrigin = nextTradingDay(sessionDate, null) || today` (4704) for earnings days.
6. Read the three archive keys via `readStored` (non-dry, 4706-4707), `sameSessionGate({sessionDate, archive, republish})` (4708) -> modes `archived`, `partial`, `republish`, `unverified`, `fresh`.
7. Gate skip (4723-4740): re-run only `publishPulse` (4725), `publishSectorPremium` (4726), `publishNews` (4727) with `generatedAt = now`; log "unranked refresh done"; on `partial` warn ARCHIVE INCOMPLETE + `republishRepair` and `exitCode = 1`; return. This is the cheap backup-cron path (~1 minute).
8. Otherwise `verifyDating` (4742), `CAP_BANDS = capBands({min: UNIVERSE.minMarketCap, max: 4e12, ratio: 1.3})` (4749), screener harvest or cap-band sweep (4761-4824; dry: `fakeScreener(420) + fakeFocusRows()`, `makeFakeVendor` as `vendor` 4769-4770), then holdings/NDX/guarantee (4826+; C scope).

**F3. Skeleton of the rest of `main` (owned by C; line anchors for orientation).** enrichment pool 4916; `board:long/short` publish 5149 (`toRows` 5064); archive walk and prune start 5152-5162 (`pruneArchive` 5159), early roster read 5163; `board:watch` 5168 (`toWatchRows` 5167); `scores:<d>` 5198; `market` 5209; `movers` 5242 (`buildMovers` 5226); market legs 5256 (`universe`, `regime` published one at a time, ownership, earnings); `events` 5322; `record` 5376; `scoretrack` 5467; `sector:trix` 5510 (`sectorTrix` 5508, deadline-guarded); chains + quant pass 5544-5860; `republishWithChain` 5865 + `archiveDatedBoards` 5870; `unusual` 5908 (`markNewContracts` 5906, `priorNote` 5931); `flowalerts` 6053 and the movers band re-publish 6099; `publishPulse` 6118; `political` 6247 (`holdersRefusal` 6214); `publishSectorPremium` 6274; `publishNews` 6276; congress tape 6289-6360; `marketCross` 6360; vol leg 6397; cards 6586 (`markGate` 6525), `ideas` 6620, cross-section cards 6724 (`markGate` 6717); `publishVol` 6750, `runFlowLeg` 6752; focus rows 6765; index/fund dossiers 6789-6800 (`indexDossierDeps` 6789); `focus` 6824; `card-x` 6835; `retireAndRoster` 6847; await prune 6881; `ensureArchived` 6885; neuron coverage 6917; `meta` 6928; `brief` 7012; dry live ticks 7019; `runHealthGate` 7085.

**F4. Dry-run world.** `--dry-run` -> `DRY_RUN=true`: `retire` only logs (2971); `publish` records `publishedStore`/`landedKeys` and logs "[dry-run] key: N rows, B bytes" with optional file emission `EMIT.replace(/\.json$/,"") + "-" + key.replace(":","-") + ".json"` (3056-3063; only the FIRST colon is replaced, so `board:long:2026-08-24` becomes `...-board-long:2026-08-24.json`); `readStored`/`probeStored`/`listStored` return absent/failed (1954, 1959, 1966); vendor calls go to `makeFakeVendor` (main legs) or to the in-file `fake*` (chains 5587, cards 6434, pulse 4099, sector ETFs 4149, news 4219, flow alerts 6015, political 6136, congress 6300, treasury 5832, enrichment 4922, index dossiers 4270-4304); prior-state doubles stand in for the stored boards (`fakePriorBoard` 5031), unusual feed (`fakePriorUnusual` 5903) and roster (`dryRosterReader/Probe/List` 6857-6863). After the leg list, `main` also runs `dryLiveTicks` (7019). In `--live --dry-run`, `runLiveMode` runs `dryLiveTicks` and `dryLiveDay` (4618-4624).

**F5. `publish(key, payload)` (3049-3132).**
1. `LIVE_MODE` and key not `^live:[a-z]+(?::[a-z]+)?$` -> throw before anything else (3050).
2. `publishedStore[key] = payload` (3054); `body = JSON.stringify(payload)`.
3. `EMIT || DRY_RUN`: optional file write; log; `landedKeys.add(key)`; return (3056-3064).
4. Loop `attempt = 0..`: `await ingestWrites.acquire()` (400 ms spacing) -> `fetch(ingestURL()+"?key=", {method:"POST", redirect:"error", headers: await ingestHeaders({json:true}), body})` (3068-3079).
5. `refusal = status===403 ? await noteRefusal(response) : null`; `heard = refusal || await noteAnswer(response)` (3081-3082; both tally into `edgeRefusals`).
6. If not ok and `storeQuotaWait(response, heard.text, {firstAt: quotaFirstAt})` returns a wait (503 with Worker code `store_quota` and `Retry-After`): set `quotaFirstAt`, warn, `ingestWrites.defer(wait)`, `sleep(wait)`, `attempt--`, continue (3083-3095).
7. Else if status in `PUBLISH_RETRYABLE` and not a Worker-issued refusal (`refusal.kind === "worker"` is final), `wait = publishRetryDelay(attempt, {spentMs: publishRetrySpentMs})`; if non-null: add to `publishRetrySpentMs`, warn, `defer`, `sleep`, continue (3096-3112).
8. Break. If still not ok: throw an `Error("ingest <key> -> HTTP s (server: ..., cf-ray: ...) body: ...")` with `.status` set (3116-3129); `main` catches per leg or lets `ensureArchived` map 409 -> `held`.
9. Success: `landedKeys.add(key)`, log "published key: ...".

**F6. Prune and retire.** `main:5159` -> `pruneArchive(sessionDate)` (2995) -> `pruneKeys` (2954: 90 keys at days 127-156 back) -> `retire(key)` (2970) one at a time through `ingestWrites`; 404 = miss; 3 consecutive refusals -> `abandoned`; result awaited at `main:6881` (null when the sweep threw). `retireSession` (2389; A scope) deletes the three session keys for `republish_session`, scores last, stopping at the first refusal (`main:5044`).

**F7. `retireAndRoster` (4454-4535), called at `main:6847`.**
1. Invalid `sessionDate` -> log and return `null` (4458-4461).
2. `priorLedger(prior.payload, {sessionDate})` -> `known` (key -> session day), `complete`, `why` (`absent`, `no-ledger`, `ledger-<x>`, `undated`, `gap-N` where N > 1 session behind).
3. `prior.failed` -> `ledger = "unread"`, `known` emptied, nothing will be retired tonight (4465-4468). Else if not `complete` -> `bootstrapLedger` over candidates plus known tickers (4470) -> `ledger = "bootstrap"` or `"bootstrap-partial"` when capped or any key unanswered; union into `known` (4472-4474).
4. If `lister` and the prior read did not fail: `lister()` (`?list=card,card-x,hist`) adds every present key the ledger and `landed` do not name, aged with the rest; a failed listing changes nothing and is logged (4476-4494).
5. `retirePlan({sessionDate, known, landed, exempt})` -> `retire[]` (age > 3 sessions, not exempt, not rebuilt tonight), `held`, `kept` (4495).
6. Delete loop with `remove` (default `retire`): ok -> removed, 404 -> absent (both counted as gone), refusal -> `held[key]` kept for tomorrow; after 3 consecutive refusals the rest are held (4499-4506).
7. `buildRoster({sessionDate, generatedAt, depth, landed, held, retired: gone, ledger})`; if `!fits` write a slim roster with `held:{}` and `ledger:"dropped"`; `write("roster", ...)` inside try; on failure `written=false`, logged (4512-4527).
8. Returns `{retired, absent, refused, held, heldKeys, ledger, bytes, written, rostered}`; `main` feeds `heldKeys` to `neuronCoverage` and the numbers to `runHealthGate` (`rosterWritten` is false when the call threw, `main:6869`).

`probeLedgerMetadata` (4352): asked list = for each ticker (sorted, unique, passing `rosterKeyTicker`) the keys `card:T`, `card-x:T`, `hist:T` not in `landed`; stop when charged keys (non-`hist:`) would exceed 2,400 (`capped`); chunks of 96; stops on `failed >= 25` or past deadline; first non-200/unshaped answer returns `{fallback:{status, said, code}}` so `bootstrapLedger` re-reads key by key (`probe` loop 4417-4435; `hist:` only where `card`/`card-x` is present or landed); later bad chunks add the chunk size to `failed`. Day known for a present key = `probeDayOf(answer)`.

**F8. Side-feed publishers.** `publishPulse` (4083): build `PULSE_FETCHES` (4087-4096); DRY -> `fakePulseRaws(tickers)` else sequential `uw()` per feed, error -> `{__failed}` (4098-4108); `raws.darkpool = sessionPrints(raws.darkpool, sessionDate, {limit: 100})` (4111); `crossRaws` set before `buildPulse` (4112-4113); `pulse.totalsHistory = totalsHistory(unwrap(...))` (DRY uses `makeFakeVendor(...)("/api/market/total-options-volume", {limit: 252})` instead of `raws.totals`, 4115-4117); log rows that returned but shaped to nothing (4118-4127); `publish("pulse", {...})` (4128); any exception is a warning and the function still returns `crossRaws` (4140-4143). `publishSectorPremium` (4146) and `publishNews` (4216) follow the same try/catch shape and return nothing. Each is called once on a ranked run (`main:6118,6274,6276`) and once on the same-session refresh path (`main:4725-4727`), never both in one process.

**F9. Index/fund dossier deps (4265-4327).** `enrich(ticker, spot, row)`: live `(await enrich(ticker, spot, sessionDate, dating)).raw`, dry `fakeEnrichment(ticker, spot, 9000 + tickerSeed(ticker), num(row.iv30d)||null)` with `sessionCandles`. `features(raw, ticker, spot, row)` -> `computeFeatures({...raw, ticker, spot, sessionDate, tilt: screenerTilt(row)})`. `perName(ticker, spot, raw)`: expiries from `raw.expiries` strictly after the session, sorted, first `SURFACE_EXPIRIES`; six reads in `Promise.all` each `.catch(() => [] | null)` (dry: the fakes); darkpool cut to the session with `sessionRows(..., easternDayOf(executed_at), sessionDate)`, IV rank cut with `{through:true}`. `chain(ticker, spot)`: one `/option-contracts` page (`limit CHAIN_PAGE_SIZE`) -> `buildChainPanels(rows, {spot, asOf: sessionDate, ticker, complete:false, pages:1})` or null. `card({ticker,row,raw,features,reads,chain,depth})`: `buildCard` with `scoreHistory:null`, `weights:null`, `congress: congressRows(ticker, congressState)`, `marketCross`, `variation: variationOptions(variationRun)`; then `card.readPx = readPxOf({row, features}, screenerReadAt)` and `attachVol(card, volLeg, ticker)`. Consumer: `buildIndexDossiers` (index-dossier.mjs) calls enrich -> features -> perName -> chain -> card, sheds panels to 100 KiB, publishes `card:<T>`.

**F10. `runLiveMode` (4602-4673).**
