### Data and interfaces

**Ingest reads the legs make** (all `GET <FLOWS_INGEST_URL or https://anilkaya.org/api/flows/ingest>?key=<key>`; pipeline `readStoredOnce` at pipeline.mjs:1855, `redirect:"error"`; `readStored` at 1953 adds retries):

| Reader | Keys read | Credential |
|---|---|---|
| `runLive` (via `readStored`) | `live:heartbeat`, `board:long`, `board:short`, `board:watch`, `focus`, `live:alerts`, `live:strips:series`, `live:gex` | OIDC JWT (aud `https://anilkaya.org/api/flows/ingest#live`, only from `flows-live.yml@refs/heads/main`) or `FLOWS_LIVE_TOKEN` |
| loop clock refresh (`readLiveClock` over `readStoredOnce`, single try) | `clock` | same |
| `createWatch` (single try, 10 s deadline each) | `live:market`, `live:focus` (Tier 1 window), `live:breadth` (Tier 2 window), `meta` (first tick, nightly open, or weekday evening after 17:30 ET until landed) | same |
| `runHealthGate` (retrying `readStored`) | `clock`, `live:market`, `live:focus`, `live:heartbeat`, `live:strips:series` | nightly `FLOWS_INGEST_TOKEN` (the only token whose `clock` answer carries `labActiveAt` and `ledger`) |

The live credential may read: `clock`, any `live:*`, and `NIGHTLY_READ_KEYS` = `board:long`, `board:short`, `board:watch`, `meta`, `focus` (shared/flows-live-worker.js:90, `ingestScope` 678). It may write `live:*` only, never delete. `live:market` and `live:focus` have writer `worker` and the ingest refuses them from the Actions credential, so Tier 2 never publishes them. A missing row answers `{key, status:"pending"}` with 200; `readStoredOnce` maps that to `{payload:null, absent:true}`, `normalizeRead` to `{pending:true}`. The Worker answers pending for a failed D1 read as well as for a missing row.

**Ingest clock body** (`serveIngestClock`, flows-live-worker.js:845; `ingestClockView` ~829): `{key:"clock", clock:{day, trading(0|1|null), earlyClose(0|1|null), closedDays[], tier1:{at, okAt, why}, dispatchWhy, summaryAt}}`; for the nightly token also `labActiveAt` (ISO or null) and `ledger:{retainDays, days:[{day, ticks, tier1{lastAt,gapMs,gapEndAt,ok,fail,okAt,okGapMs,okGapEndAt}, focus{ok,partial,fail,okAt,gapMs,gapEndAt}, tier2{passes,firstAt,lastAt,gapMs,gapEndAt,calls,failedCalls}, stale{ticks,overS,key}, nightly{at,runs}, updatedAt}]}`. `tier1.why` values the legs read: `written`, `off`, `error:...` (`error:no-key`), others. `dispatchWhy` values: `sent`, `refused:<status>`, `unreachable`, `no-token`.

**Vendor reads in one Tier 2 pass** (`uw(path, params, {envelope:true})`, paced 333 ms, 20 s deadline with one retry in `--live`; max 41 calls against `LIVE_BUDGET.tier2MaxCalls` 48): 11 `/api/market/<sector>/sector-tide`, 4 `/api/market/<SPY|QQQ|IWM|DIA>/etf-tide`, 2 `/api/net-flow/expiry` (`zero_dte`, `weekly`; `moneyness all`, `tide_type all`), 1 `/api/screener/stocks` (`ticker=<names joined>`, `limit=500`; the Worker's focus tick makes the identical request and `flows-live-contract:3245` matches the source text character for character), up to 5 `/api/option-trades/flow-alerts` pages (`limit 200`, `newer_than`, `older_than` cursor), 14 `/api/stock/<T>/spot-exposures` (SPY, QQQ + 6 fixed + 6 rotating names), `/api/market/total-options-volume` (`limit 2`), `/api/market/top-net-impact` (`limit 20`), `/api/darkpool/recent` (`date`, `order_by premium`, `limit 200`), `/api/news/headlines` (`limit 100`).

**Tier 2 keys published** (publish order in `runLive`; each key's cap is `LIVE_KEYS[key].maxBytes`, over-cap payloads are dropped with an error line, never truncated): `live:breadth` 96 KiB (live.mjs:233), `live:strips` 64 KiB (261), `live:strips:series` 112 KiB (266), `live:vol` 8 KiB (267), `live:movers` 8 KiB (268), `live:alerts` 120 KiB (273, only if `merged.write`), `live:gex` 64 KiB (282), `live:tape` 24 KiB (286), `live:news` 32 KiB (292, only when the pipeline hands a `shapeNews`), `live:heartbeat` 8 KiB (311). A key whose reads all failed is not published (`put(..., {answered:false})`, line 200), so its held row keeps its own read time and goes stale on its own clock. The heartbeat is always written.

**Heartbeat body** (`live:heartbeat`): `{v:1, key, session, fresh:{readAt, source:"actions", cadenceS, session, writer}, run:{origin, startedAt, finishedAt, durationMs, calls, failedCalls, keys{key:bytes|null}, errors[], notes[<=20], names, focus{n,source}, gex{fixed,rotating,index,all}, alerts{mode,read,pages}, quoteLag, quoteAhead, prevFill}}`. The health gate reads `run.calls`, `run.failedCalls`, `run.finishedAt`, `run.prevFill`; the Worker's ledger counts it as a Tier 2 pass.

**Focus payload** (nightly key `focus`, built by `buildFocusPayload`): `{v:1, sessionDate, generatedAt, readAt, fresh{v,readAt,vendorAt,source:"nightly",cadenceS:0,session,writer:"flows-pipeline"}, fields[17], groups[{id,label,kind,lead?,tickers[],source?}], status:"ok"|"unavailable", rows{T:{...17 fields, type?, name?}}, closes{T:[<=22]}, missing[], basis{px,read[]}, backfill?{from,readAt,tickers,why}, reason?, detail?, shed?{closes[]}, bytes}`. Cap 24 KiB (`FOCUS_BUDGET_BYTES`). Readers: Worker route `/api/flows/focus` (worker.js:3712), the Worker's focus tick (`json_each(payload,'$.closes')` at flows-live-worker.js:498 for the day-change base), `boardPlan` here, and `assets/js/flows-overview.js` (Home).

**GitHub REST** (token = job `GITHUB_TOKEN`; 15 s `AbortSignal.timeout`; API base must be `https://api.github.com`, or `http://127.0.0.1|localhost:<port>` for tests):

| Call | Where | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `POST /repos/<repo>/actions/workflows/flows-live.yml/dispatches` `{ref:"main", inputs:{tick, origin:"chain"}}` | `chainDispatch` default | Hand-over to the next loop (204 = sent) |
| `POST /repos/<repo>/actions/workflows/flows-pipeline.yml/dispatches` `{ref:"main", inputs:{origin:"live-loop"}}` | `createNightlyStart.step` | Nightly start. Inputs carry `origin` only: `tick` is not declared by the nightly workflow and GitHub answers an undeclared input 422 |
| `GET /repos/<repo>/issues?state=open&sort=updated&direction=desc&per_page=100` | reporter `list` | Adopt only issues authored by `github-actions[bot]`, not PRs, titled `^\[flows-witness:([a-z0-9-]+)\]` |
| `POST /issues`, `POST /issues/<n>/comments`, `PATCH /issues/<n>` `{state:"closed", state_reason:"completed"|"not_planned"}` or `{state:"open", state_reason:"reopened"}` | reporter | Alert lifecycle |

**Environment variables and secrets** (none are read by the legs directly except where noted; the pipeline passes `process.env`):

| Name | Used by | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `GITHUB_TOKEN` | `githubTarget` (live.mjs:366) | Job token; `permissions` of `flows-live.yml`: contents read, id-token write, actions write, issues write |
| `GITHUB_REPOSITORY`, `GITHUB_API_URL` | `githubTarget` | repo regex `^[A-Za-z0-9_.-]+/[A-Za-z0-9_.-]+$` |
| `GITHUB_REPOSITORY_OWNER`, `GITHUB_SERVER_URL`, `GITHUB_RUN_ID` | `ownerHandle`, `runUrl` (witness.mjs:248, 255) | issue-body mention and run link |
| `GITHUB_ACTIONS` | pipeline.mjs:7086 (`annotate`) | turns warnings into `::warning` annotations |
| `FLOWS_LIVE_LOOP`, `FLOWS_LIVE_KEEP`, `FLOWS_LIVE_DRILL`, `FLOWS_LIVE_FORCE`, `FLOWS_LIVE_ORIGIN` | pipeline.mjs `runLiveMode` | `LOOP !== "1"` or `FORCE` means a single pass; `KEEP === "1"` builds the watch (kept-alive loop); `DRILL === "1"` (not dry) runs only the drill; origin is `schedule`, the dispatch input, or `manual` |
| `FLOWS_LIVE_TOKEN` | `liveCredentialSource` / `liveCredential` (pipeline.mjs:96-103) | Local override; otherwise the GitHub OIDC token is minted lazily |
| `UW_API_KEY` | `uw` (pipeline.mjs:533) | Only repository secret the live job needs besides `FLOWS_INGEST_URL` |
| `FLOWS_UW_TIMEOUT_MS` | pipeline `vendorTimeoutMs` (525) | 100-60000, default 20000; only in `--live` |
| `FLOWS_INGEST_URL` | `ingestURL` (pipeline.mjs:86) | default `https://anilkaya.org/api/flows/ingest` |
| `FLOWS_INGEST_TOKEN` | nightly `ingestHeaders` (pipeline.mjs:121) | health gate and nightly writes; never used in `--live` |
| `ACTIONS_ID_TOKEN_REQUEST_URL/TOKEN` | `liveCredential` | OIDC mint |

Worker-side vars the legs mirror: `GITHUB_DISPATCH_TOKEN` (Worker secret; absent means `dispatchWhy "no-token"`, a note and not a failure), `FLOWS_LIVE_MODE` (`off` shows as `tier1.why "off"` and every legs check skips), `FLOWS_LIVE_REPO/REF/WORKFLOW`, `FLOWS_NIGHTLY_WORKFLOW` in wrangler.toml:50-54. Crons in wrangler.toml:26: `1-59/5 13-21 * * MON-FRI` (Tier 1), `3-58/5 13-21 * * MON-FRI` (focus), `*/30 * * * *` (housekeeping, Worker nightly dispatch from 17:15 ET, `PHASE_MINUTES.nightlyAfter`), `15,45 * * * *` (summary).

**Workflow `flows-live.yml`**: 32 cron starters at :17 and :47 of every UTC hour 05-20, Monday-Friday; `workflow_dispatch` inputs `tick`, `origin` (worker, watchdog, chain, manual), `drill`; `concurrency` group `flows-live` (`flows-live-drill` for a drill), `cancel-in-progress: false`; `timeout-minutes: 355`; every action pinned to a commit SHA; sparse checkout of `scripts` and `shared`. `flows-pipeline.yml` gate step treats any non-schedule event as "proceed" (`Dispatched by: live-loop`).

**Budgets, caps and thresholds** (actual numbers):

| Thing | Value | Where |
|---|---|---|
| Loop slot / idle tick | 5 min / 15 min | `LIVE_LOOP.slotMs`, `idleMs` live.mjs:349-353 |
| Loop budget per run | 340 min (`workflow timeout-minutes` 355; test requires budget + 10 min <= timeout and timeout < 360) | live.mjs:350; flows-live-contract ~766-775 |
| First pass after open | open + 60 s = 09:31:00 ET | `openLagMs`, `nextOpenAt` live.mjs:425 |
| Pre-open wait (legacy loop only) | up to 240 min | `preOpenWaitMs` |
| Chain retry waits | 15 s, 45 s (3 attempts) | `chainRetryMs` |
| GitHub call deadline / clock read deadline / watch read deadline | 15 s / 10 s / 10 s | `githubTimeoutMs`, `clockDeadlineMs`, `WITNESS.readDeadlineMs` |
| Tier 1 stale line (witness) | 25 min = `FRESH_CLASSES.market.staleS` | witness.mjs:9 |
| Tier 2 stale line (witness) | 45 min = `FRESH_CLASSES.breadth.staleS` | witness.mjs:10 |
| Witness confirm (ticks) | tier1 2, tier2 2, nightly 1 (2 when `meta` is pending), chain 1, probe 3 | witness.mjs:11 |
| Witness recover (healthy ticks) | tier1 3, tier2 3, nightly 1, chain 1, probe 3, drill 1 (default) | witness.mjs:12 |
| Reminder comment / reopen window / retry-open gap | 6 h / 6 h / 15 min | `renotifyMs`, `reopenWithinMs`, `retryOpenMs` |
| Windows | Tier 1 witness: open to close + 10 min. Tier 2 witness: open + 45 min to close + 25 min. Pass window: open to close + 25 min (early close 13:00 + 25 min) | watch.mjs:15-25, `liveWindow` |
| Nightly start | first 17:30 ET (3 tries on 5-min slots), one retry from 18:15 ET and at least 30 min after the last attempt (`retryGapMs`), transient retries every 30 min to 20:30 ET, never a third send; at most 3 + 1 + 6 = 10 dispatch calls a day (a permanent refusal stops at 4) | starts.mjs:6-37 |
| Nightly due line (witness) | 21:00 ET = 16:00 close + 5 h `FRESH_CLASSES.nightly.graceS` | `expectedNightlySession` |
| Weekday request cost of the whole watch | asserted: <= 410 ingest reads, `live:market` == `live:focus` <= 82, `meta` <= 10, breadth 70-76, <= 12 GitHub calls, exactly 85 Tier 2 passes (the per-key counts clock 158 / market 81 / focus 81 / breadth 75 / meta 9 are not asserted anywhere in source: the test prints its own counts in its message, and this map did not run the test, so treat them as approximate) | flows-starts-contract:801-816 (message at 810) |
| Saturday cost | <= 110 reads, only `clock` and `meta`, no pass, GitHub calls only the chain (and the open-issue listing) | flows-starts-contract:817-822; dry day expects exactly 2 GitHub calls |
| Health gate | settle 10 min after close; final-read 10 min before close (15:50 ET); last pass finished within 30 min of the close; summary cron age 75 min; edge 403 count 24; retry budget 60 s of the 90 s; 5xx burst 5; Neuron/engine coverage 70%; Lab sign-in warn 120 / fail 150 / gone 180 days | health.mjs:9, 328 |
| Quota wait | up to 20 min per run, +30 s margin, 60 s lag steps within 10 min after 00:00 UTC | health.mjs:290 |
| Focus payload | 24 KiB, 22 closes, name 40 chars, 17 fields | shared/flows-focus.js:19-27 |
| Tier 2 key caps | breadth 96 KiB, strips 64 KiB, series 112 KiB, alerts 120 KiB, gex 64 KiB, vol 8 KiB, tape 24 KiB, movers 8 KiB, news 32 KiB, heartbeat 8 KiB | shared/flows-live.js:13-26 (`LIVE_KEYS`; `live:market` and `live:focus` at 14-15 are the Worker's 16 KiB keys) |
| Strip names | 160 max, 40 focus names, index SPY QQQ IWM first; gex 2 index + 6 fixed + 6 rotating; alert pages 5 x 200; heartbeat skip 8 min (first pass of a hop only) | `LIVE_BUDGET` |

**Witness check catalogue** (verdict inputs and meaning):

| Id | Breach test | Status words returned |
|---|---|---|
| `tier1` | any of {Tier 1's last tick, `live:market.fresh.readAt`, `live:focus.fresh.readAt`} older than 25 min, each counted from max(value, open); unwritten-today counts from the open | `ok`, `pending` (not all written since open yet and none late), `breach`, `skip` (off, non-trading, outside window), `inconclusive` (no clock, no signal, or a failed read with no late signal) |
| `tier2` | `live:breadth.fresh.readAt` older than 45 min counted from max(value, open) | same; `inconclusive` when unreadable; agrees minute by minute with the Worker's `liveStalled` (freshness.js:410) |
| `nightly` | `meta.sessionDate` older than `expectedNightlySession(at, clock)`; `meta` pending breaches with `confirm: 2` | `ok`, `breach`, `skip` (no session due), `inconclusive` (meta unreadable) |
| `chain` | raised directly by `chainFailed` when the budget exit could not dispatch a successor | cleared by `witness.clear("chain")` on the first tick of the next loop |
| `probe` | `!(view || any read not failed)` on a tick | `ok` or `breach` only |
| `drill` | raised and cleared by `witnessDrill` | n/a |

**Health-gate catalogue** (`healthChecks`; "F" failure turns the run red, "W" warning, "N" note). Rows are in the order the families run, except that the clock block is split in the source: its summary-cron lines come first, then the Tier-1-off early return, then `ledgerChecks` (health.mjs:589), then the rest of the clock block (sameDay, `error:`, last tick, dispatch lines):

| Source | Condition | Level |
|---|---|---|
| `edgeFailures` | `edge403 >= 24` or `retrySpentMs >= 60000` or 5xx burst `>= 5`; one line per refusal kind with its remedy, plus per-status lines (1027 daily limit, 429, 408, `store_quota`, 5xx, no answer, no cf-ray) | F |
| `edgeNote` | always, `edge: N ingest answer(s) of HTTP 403 [...]` | N |
| `runChecks` | cards failed; cards skipped past deadline; roster not written; roster shorter than planned | F |
| `neuronChecks` | ledger does not add up; names missing; absent screen inputs (W); readable share < 70% (W); engine built < 70% of expected (W) | F/W/N |
| `labCheck` | Lab sign-in age >= 150 days (F), >= 120 (W), else note; null/unreadable/old-Worker are notes | F/W/N |
| `ledgerChecks` | ledger holds days but none for the session (F; absent ledger or empty ledger are notes); Tier 1 cron gap > 25 min; Tier 1 write gap > 25 min while ticking; focus gap > 25 min; no Tier 2 pass; Tier 2 gap > 45 min; passes < 70% of expected (W); worst stale lapse (W); previous trading day's nightly never landed (F, checked from the next session's run); only the five `flag()` lines (Tier 1 cron gap, Tier 1 write gap, focus gap, no Tier 2 pass, Tier 2 gap) are downgraded to W, with a "ledger began this session" suffix, when the ledger holds a single day (the missing-row failure is not). Skipped entirely when `tier1.why` is `off` | F/W/N |
| clock block | clock unreadable; summary cron never completed or older than 75 min; Tier 1 off (returns early); clock never rolled to the session; holiday verdict on a printed session; `tier1.why` starting `error:`; last tick before the close; GitHub dispatch refused (`refused:4xx`); `no-token` is a note | F/N |
| `live:market`, `live:focus` | unreadable; never written; last read before close - 10 min (15:50 ET; 12:50 early close); focus failure names the focus cron | F |
| `live:heartbeat` | unreadable; absent; other session; last pass answered no vendor call; finished earlier than close - 30 min | F |
| notes | day-change fill from `run.prevFill`, quote-lag spread from `live:strips:series.lag` | N |

`applies:false` paths: no valid `sessionDate`; run is for another day than today (only held-ledger checks run); the session closed less than 10 min ago. A `FLOWS_LIVE_MODE=off` Worker returns `applies:true, why:"live-off"` (health.mjs:587) after the summary-cron lines, so neither `ledgerChecks` nor the Tier 1, focus and heartbeat checks run.

### Flows

**Flow A. One kept-alive hop of the live workflow** (the system's heartbeat; ~340 min per run, chained)

1. GitHub starts `flows-live.yml` (a :17/:47 cron, or a `workflow_dispatch` from the previous hop, the Worker watchdog, a human, or a drill). Concurrency group allows one run and one pending.
2. Step "Read the live layer" runs `node scripts/flows-pipeline.mjs --live` (`LIVE_MODE` true) -> `runLiveMode` (pipeline.mjs:4602). A drill (`FLOWS_LIVE_DRILL=1`, not dry) short-circuits to `runWitnessDrill` (4579) -> `witnessDrill` (watch.mjs:83) and exits non-zero on failure.
3. It requires `UW_API_KEY` and a live credential source (OIDC or `FLOWS_LIVE_TOKEN`), raises `delayFloorMs`/`delayMs` to 333 ms (4615-4616), and defines `readClock` (4634: `readLiveClock(readStoredOnce, {seen})`, storing `clockBody`) and `settle` (4635-4646: `liveRunVerdict`, prints the witness line, sets `process.exitCode = 1` on failure).
4. `FLOWS_LIVE_LOOP !== "1"` or `FLOWS_LIVE_FORCE=1`: one `runLive` and exit. Else `watch = KEEP ? createWatch({readOnce: readStoredOnce, latestClock: () => clockBody, env}) : null` (4653-4656) and `runLiveLoop({readClock, watch, pass, chain})` (4657). `pass` calls `resetPublishRetryBudget()` then `runLive({..., skipRecent: first, clock})`; `chain` is `chainWithRetry(() => chainDispatch({env, at}))` under KEEP.
5. `runLiveLoop` (live.mjs:482) with a watch returns `keepLoop` (live.mjs:431). Per iteration: `refresh()` reads the clock under a 10 s deadline and keeps the last good clock (488-492); `here = window(now(), clock)` (liveWindow); if `here.run` push `await pass({first, index, clock})` (exceptions become `{errored, threw}` and the loop goes on); if `here.wait` log the provisional-closure wait; then `watch.tick({at, clock, first: ticks === 0, inSession, passes})` (exceptions are caught and logged); `busy = here.run || here.wait || beat.busy`; `wake = nextSlot(t, busy ? 5 min : 15 min)`; if the next open is known (`nextOpenAt` live.mjs:425 returns the next session's 09:30 plus the 60 s `openLagMs`, only outside the `rth` phase) and `wake` would reach the 09:30 open or later then `wake` becomes that value, 09:31:00 ET sharp (467); if `wake - startedAt > 340 min` then `chain({at})`, `watch.chainFailed` when not sent, and return `{exit:"budget", keep:true, watch: summary}`; else `sleep(wake - now())`.
6. After the loop: `settle(loop)` (pipeline 4635) and the workflow ends; the next hop was already dispatched in step 5 (or the 32 crons restart a loop within hours).

**Flow B. One Tier 2 pass (`runLive`, live.mjs:100-319)**

1. `liveWindow(startedAt, clock)` (105); outside the window and not forced: log and return `{skipped: why}` (107-109).
2. Reads `live:heartbeat`; if the last run finished under 8 min ago, and `skipRecent`, return `{skipped:"recent"}` (114-119). Only the first pass of a hop passes `skipRecent: true`.
3. `readStored` for the three boards and `focus` (121-123), `boardPlan` (124) for names/ranking/stages, `priorCloseBase(nightlySources({boards, focus}), session, clock)` (125-128) for the day-change base, `gexRotation` with `tick = floor((startedAt - open) / 15 min)` (129-130).
4. Vendor reads (153-194): sector and ETF tides in parallel, the two net-flow reads, the strip, the alerts pages sequentially (cursor from `oldestCreated`), gex per name in parallel, then totals, net impact, darkpool, news in parallel. Failed reads become `{__failed: msg}` and count in `ledger.failed`.
5. Shape and publish through `put` (200): breadth (225-234), strips with quote-lag, ahead and prevFill notes (236-261), strips series (263-266), vol, movers (267-268), alerts via `mergeLiveAlerts` (270-274, `live:alerts` written only when `merged.write`), gex (276-283), tape (285-286), news if `shapeNews` is a function (288-297). Each `put` refuses an unanswered key and an over-cap payload.
6. Heartbeat last (299-315): `run` summary including `keys` bytes, `errors`, `notes`; returns `{run, published, bytes}` which `passOutcome` turns into `{answered, landed, errored}` for the loop and `liveRunVerdict`.

**Flow C. One watch tick (`createWatch(...).tick`, watch.mjs:35)**

1. `first`: `witness.start()` (witness.mjs:469, which awaits `seed` at 328: it lists open issues and adopts bot-authored `[flows-witness:*]` ones) then `witness.clear("chain", {at})`, which comments `Recovered at ...` and closes a chain issue left by the previous hop.
2. `view = witnessView(latestClock())` (the clock body the loop's own refresh just read: no second clock read); `wclock = view ? view.clock : clock`; `p = phaseAt(at, wclock)`; `inTier1 = tier1Window`, `inTier2 = tier2Window`; `wantMeta = first || witness.isOpen("nightly") || (trading && minutes >= 17:30 && !landedToday)`.
3. `Promise.all` of the reads (`live:market`, `live:focus` if Tier 1; `live:breadth` if Tier 2; `meta` if wanted), each through `withDeadline(readOnce(key), 10 s)` and `normalizeRead`.
4. `metaSession` = string when `meta` ok, `null` when pending, `undefined` when failed or unread; a landed session is memoised in `state.landed` so a later failed read during the same day does not reopen the question (watch.mjs:54-56).
5. `nightly.step({at, clock: wclock, metaSession})` (starts.mjs:43) decides and sends the nightly dispatch (Flow D).
6. Evaluate: `evaluateTier1`, `evaluateTier2`, `evaluateNightly` for the reads taken, plus `probe` always (`seen = view || any read not failed`).
7. `witness.apply(results, {at, dispatches: nightly.attempts()})` (witness.mjs:472); returns `{busy: step.busy, results, step}` (busy keeps the 5-min cadence from 17:30 until `meta` lands).

**Flow D. Nightly start from the loop** (`createNightlyStart.step`, starts.mjs:43)

1. New Eastern day resets `{attempts: [], landedNoted: false}` (45-49).
2. `nightlyStartDue` (17-37): trading day, `minutes >= 1050`, `meta` not at today's session; first three tries on consecutive slots until one is accepted; after a send, a second send at/after 18:15 ET and >= 30 min after the last attempt; transient refusals (5xx/429/408/no answer) are retried every 30 min until 20:30 ET; never a third send.
3. Due: `chainDispatch({workflow:"flows-pipeline.yml", inputs:{origin:"live-loop"}})`; record `{at, sent, status, why}`; sent logs `starts: dispatch of flows-pipeline.yml (<why>) at HH:MM ET — sent (HTTP 204)`, a refusal warns with an `::warning title=Nightly start` annotation.
4. When `meta` shows the session, `busy` falls to false; the one `starts: the <day> nightly has landed (meta holds <session>) at HH:MM ET` log line is written only if this loop itself sent at least one dispatch that Eastern day (`st.attempts.some(a => a.sent)`, starts.mjs:62), so a nightly started by the Worker or by hand lands silently.
5. The nightly then runs `flows-pipeline.yml` (gate step proceeds for `workflow_dispatch`), lands about 17:45 ET, writes `meta`; the Worker also dispatches at 17:15 ET if `GITHUB_DISPATCH_TOKEN` exists (`nightlyDispatchDue`, freshness.js:419), and whichever arrives second is a one-minute same-session refresh.

**Flow E. Witness issue lifecycle (`createWitness`, witness.mjs:296)**

- `apply` (472): per result, `breach` -> `okStreak = 0`, `streak++` (`since` set on the first), `raise` when already raised or `streak >= confirm`; `ok` -> `settle`; `skip` or `pending` -> streaks reset; `inconclusive` (and anything else) changes nothing.
- `raise` (416): first time per episode logs a `::error` annotation and remembers the id in `breached` (feeds `liveRunVerdict`, so the run turns red); `notify` (364): no-op without a token; `seed()` once; with no adopted issue and not within 15 min of the last attempt: if a previous open's answer never arrived (`uncertain`) refresh and adopt; else reopen the last-closed issue of this id if closed less than 6 h ago (comment with the new body); else open a new `[flows-witness:<id>] <title>`; with an adopted issue: close duplicates, comment a reminder every 6 h.
- `settle` (456): `okStreak++`; at the recover count (or when a recovery comment was already posted) `recover` (428): comment `Recovered at HH:MM ET`, close extras, close the issue as completed, remember `lastClosed`.
- Hops lose memory: a fresh loop adopts open bot issues on its first tick; a re-breach after a hop opens a new issue.

**Flow F. Nightly health gate (end of `flows-pipeline.yml`)**

1. Nightly publishes everything; read/write helpers tally every ingest 403 through `noteRefusal` -> `refusalOf` + `tallyRefusal` (pipeline.mjs:1845) and every other retried answer through `noteAnswer` -> `tallyAnswer` (`noteAnswer` is declared at 1838, its `tallyAnswer` call at 1841); a 503 `store_quota` is waited out via `storeQuotaWait` (3083).
2. pipeline.mjs:7085 `runHealthGate({sessionDate, read: readStored, dry: DRY_RUN, edge: edgeSnapshot, annotate: GITHUB_ACTIONS === "true", night:{cardsFailed, deadlineSkipped, planned, rostered, rosterWritten, enriched, neuron}})`.
3. `runHealthGate` (686): dry run skips store reads and only evaluates `runChecks` + `neuronChecks`. Live: five sequential `safe()` reads (a thrown read becomes `{failed:true,status:0}`), `edge()` snapshot after those reads, `healthChecks`, logs `health gate: checked|live checks skipped — <why>; N failure(s)` (em dash; `, N warning(s)` appended when there are warnings), notes indented, warnings (as `::warning title=Neuron coverage|Lab sign-in::...` when annotating), failures via `warn`.
4. pipeline.mjs:7093: `if (health.failures.length) process.exitCode = 1`.

**Flow G. Focus payload at nightly** (pipeline.mjs:6819): `buildFocusPayload({ndx, rows: focusRead.rows, read: focusRead, sessionDate, generatedAt, readAt, closesOf: focusCloses(featuresFor.get(t), sessionDate), backfill: held, backfillFrom:"harvest", backfillReadAt})` then `publish("focus", payload)`; a thrown error only warns (`focus: <message>`).

**Flow H. Dry runs.** `node scripts/flows-pipeline.mjs --live --dry-run [--emit prefix]` (pipeline.mjs:4617-4623): `dryLiveTicks` publishes the ten Tier 2 keys twice (to `publishedStore`/emit files) from the fake vendor, then `dryLiveDay({})` runs the 13 scenarios and sets `exitCode = 1` if any `problems`. The nightly dry run (`--dry-run`, run by `npm run test:pipeline` and by `flows-pipeline.yml` before the real run) calls `runHealthGate({dry:true})` with the run facts.

### Invariants and traps

Each item: rule, then evidence.

1. **No comments in any leg file.** `tests/flows-legs-contract.mjs:896-897` reads every file in `scripts/flows-legs/` and fails on any `//` or `/*` after stripping `https?://\S+`. Regex literals must escape slashes (`\/\/`), and no string may contain a bare `//` other than a URL. Rationale lives in commit messages (repo rule).
2. **No import cycle.** `flows-live-contract.mjs:586-596` walks static imports from `worker.js` and `scripts/flows-pipeline.mjs`. In this area the DAG is `live-fake` -> shared; `live` -> `live-fake`; `health` -> `live`; `witness` -> `live`, `health`; `starts` -> `live`, `health`, `witness`; `watch` -> `live`, `health`, `witness`, `starts`; `live-day` -> `live`, `health`, `watch`, `live-world-fake`. `live.mjs` must never import `health`, `witness`, `starts` or `watch` (this is why `etTime` lives in `health.mjs` yet `live.mjs` formats no ET times).
3. **`live.mjs` imports `live-fake.mjs` in production code** (line 9) for `dryLiveTicks`. `live-fake.mjs` must not import `live.mjs`. It is also a fixture for ten test files, so any change to a fake body shape ripples into rail, client, ledger and Worker suites.
4. **Tier 2 publishes live:* keys only, and `put("live:alerts"` appears once, behind `if (merged.write)`.** Source scans: `flows-live-contract:733-742` (`put("<key>"` regex requires >= 10 puts, all `live:`), `flows-alerts-contract:498-503` and `808-812` (single `put("live:alerts"`, guarded line must read exactly `if (merged.write) await put("live:alerts", merged.write);`). Pipeline `publish` (function at 3049, guard at 3050) throws on any non-`live:` key in `--live`.
5. **The strip read's text is shared with the Worker.** `flows-live-contract:3245` requires `read("/api/screener/stocks", { ticker: plan.names.join(","), limit: 500 })` verbatim in live.mjs (line 163) to match `FOCUS_READ` (`shared/flows-live-worker.js:482`, `{path:"/api/screener/stocks", limit:500}`, used at 519). Both planners import the one `focusStripNames` from `shared/flows-focus.js` (`flows-live-contract:570-581`); `shared/flows-focus.js` must stay a leaf (imports nothing), and `shared/flows-live.js` must not import it.
6. **Roster parity with the real-time rail.** `tests/flows-rt-contract.mjs:398-404` and `1030-1040` require the hub's `rosterPlan` to equal `boardPlan` (names, ranked, deep, stage). Changing `boardPlan`, `stripNames` or `focusStripNames` ordering means changing `shared/flows-rt*.js` too.
7. **No data without an answer.** A key whose reads all failed is not published (live.mjs:200-205); a run in which no call answered publishes only its heartbeat (`flows-live-contract:1076-1085`). `liveRunVerdict` is red when every ran pass answered nothing or landed nothing, so a "published" key with no read behind it would hide a dead vendor from the Worker's watchdog and the witness.
8. **Witness lines equal the readers' lines.** `WITNESS.tier1StaleMs` and `tier2StaleMs` are read from `FRESH_CLASSES` (witness.mjs:9-10), asserted equal by `flows-starts-contract:217,278`; the Tier 2 verdict agrees with the Worker's `liveStalled` on every minute from 10:16 and every lag to an hour (`flows-starts-contract:296-304`). `LEDGER_LIMITS` (shared/flows-ledger.js:7) uses the same classes. Change the class, not the witness.
9. **`inconclusive` changes nothing.** A failed read is never a verdict; only `probe` counts failed reads (confirm 3). `pending` for `meta` needs two ticks because the Worker returns pending for a failed D1 read too. Do not add a branch in `apply` for `inconclusive`.
10. **Only issues authored by `github-actions[bot]` are adopted** (`WITNESS.author`, witness.mjs:219); the repository is public, anyone can open a look-alike. A drill/real issue authored by another login would make every hop blind to its predecessor's issues (DEPLOY 10.5k item 6).
11. **The nightly dispatch sends `inputs:{origin:"live-loop"}` only.** `flows-pipeline.yml` does not declare `tick`; an undeclared input is HTTP 422 (a permanent refusal capped at 4 calls). `flows-starts-contract:74-98` pins the body.
12. **17:30 and 18:15 ET must be multiples of both the 5-min slot and the 15-min idle tick** (`flows-starts-contract:192-195`), so a loop ticking on the epoch grid lands exactly on them in any whole-quarter-hour zone; no special wake exists for them.
13. **Request-cost ceilings are tests.** A weekday must cost the Worker <= 410 ingest reads and GitHub <= 12 calls, `kinds["live:market"] === kinds["live:focus"] <= 82`, `meta <= 10`, breadth 70-76 reads; a Saturday reads only `clock` and `meta`, <= 110 reads, and the dry weekend scenario demands exactly 2 GitHub calls (`flows-starts-contract:801-822`, `live-day.mjs:226`). Adding a read to `watch.tick` or a GitHub call outside the open-issue listing, chain and nightly dispatch breaks them.
14. **Exact text is asserted.** `HEALTH:` / `WARNING:` lines, `starts:` log lines, `witness:` log lines, issue titles and bodies are matched by regex or equality in `flows-live-contract` (2402-2735, 3031-3070), `flows-ledger-contract` (446-644), `flows-legs-contract` (317-337) and `flows-starts-contract`. Rewording is a test change.
15. **`HEALTH.focusCron` and `HEALTH.summaryCron` must equal the Worker's `FOCUS_CRON` and `SUMMARY_CRON`** character for character (`flows-live-contract:2444`, `2462`), which must equal `wrangler.toml:26`. Weekdays in Worker crons are by name (`MON-FRI`) because Cloudflare counts Sunday as 1; `flows-live-contract:989` refuses numeric weekdays. GitHub Actions crons in the workflows use numeric `1-5` (Monday-Friday).
16. **`QUOTA_WAIT` must stay a mutable plain object**; `flows-pipeline-contract:363-397` overwrites `marginMs`, `lagStepMs`, `now`. `storeQuotaWait` reads `QUOTA_WAIT.now()` as a default argument.
17. **Only the nightly token sees `labActiveAt` and `ledger`** (worker.js:3511 passes `lab: tokenKind === "nightly"`). The live loop's `witnessView(...).ledger` is therefore normally null; nothing uses it anyway.
18. **`readLiveClock` returns `sessionClock(body)` without `closedDays`.** The loop's window therefore relies on today's `trading` flag, while the watch's `view.clock` (from `witnessView`) keeps up to 20 `closedDays` for `expectedNightlySession`/`phaseAt` on other days. Not a bug today; do not feed the loop's clock into a multi-day computation.
19. **Mutable module-free state lives in closures, not modules** (`createWitness`, `createNightlyStart`, `createWatch`); exceptions from `watch.tick` and from a pass are caught by the loop so one bad tick never ends the hop (`flows-starts-contract:745-779`, `flows-live-contract:2163`).
20. **The live path is lazy about credentials**: `runLiveMode` body must not call `liveCredential(` (`flows-live-contract:1521-1523`); `ingestHeaders` mints on first ingest call so a skipped pass never needs GitHub's token service.
21. **Workflow facts held by tests**: permissions block exactly `contents: read`, `id-token: write`, `actions: write`, `issues: write`; no secret beyond `UW_API_KEY` and `FLOWS_INGEST_URL`; exactly two `uses:` both pinned to 40-hex SHAs; 32 cron lines at :17/:47 UTC 05-20 `1-5` (`flows-starts-contract:36-62`, `flows-live-contract:748-790`); drill group separate. The nightly workflow must not gain `issues:` and keeps one `actions: write`.
22. **`runHealthGate` annotates every non-Neuron warning with the title `Lab sign-in`** (health.mjs:711: the title test is only `/^WARNING: Neuron/`), so ledger warnings ("Tier 2 made N pass(es)...", "... min past its stale line") appear under that title in the Actions UI. Cosmetic; tests do not pin it.
23. **`common.mjs` `sequential` has no importer**; `LEG_WRITER` is used only as a default. `common.rowsOf` and `shared/flows-live.js:rowsOf` differ (the latter is used by `live.mjs`).
24. **Docs versus source disagreements** (source wins):
    - AGENTS.md file map says `live-day.mjs` runs "the eight dry days"; `DRY_SCENARIOS` has 13 (live-day.mjs:38-244; `flows-starts-contract` compares `dayLines.length === DRY_SCENARIOS.length`).
    - AGENTS.md's one row for `focus.mjs`, `health.mjs` reads "The nightly `focus` and `roster` payload builders; the nightly health gate and its repair messages". Neither file builds a roster: `focus.mjs` builds only `focus`; the roster is `buildRoster` (`shared/flows-universe.js:177`, imported at pipeline.mjs:49, called at pipeline.mjs:4512); `health.mjs` builds no payload at all, it is the gate (the row's second clause is right for it).
    - DEPLOY.md 10.5k lists five witness checks; `WITNESS_CHECKS` has six (adds `drill`).
    - DEPLOY.md 10.5k says the `ledger` is parsed into the witness's view "and is not yet used": confirmed (also unused: `summaryAtMs`, `dispatchWhy`, `tier1.okAtMs`).
    - `flows-starts-contract:173` says "at most nine calls" while the bound it asserts is `firstTries + 1 + softRetries` = 10 (the all-503 drive makes 8 because the 20:45 slot is past 20:30).
    - AGENTS.md says issues "closed after three healthy ticks": true for tier1, tier2, probe; nightly, chain and drill clear after one.
25. **Test ordering.** `npm test` stops at the first failure; in `tests/package.json` the order is `test:pipeline` (nightly dry run) -> `flows-universe` -> `flows-legs` -> ... -> `flows-alerts` -> `flows-live` -> `flows-rt` -> `flows-starts` -> `flows-reads` -> ... -> `flows-ledger` -> `flows-verdict`. A red early suite hides everything behind it.

### How to change it

Commands (all in this area's suites need no dev server; run from `tests/`; the node:sqlite ones need Node >= 22.13 and `--disable-warning=ExperimentalWarning`): `node flows-starts-contract.mjs` (about 4 s), `node flows-live-contract.mjs`, `node flows-legs-contract.mjs`, `node --disable-warning=ExperimentalWarning flows-ledger-contract.mjs`, `node --disable-warning=ExperimentalWarning flows-verdict-contract.mjs`, `node flows-universe-contract.mjs`, `node flows-alerts-contract.mjs`, `node ../scripts/flows-pipeline.mjs --dry-run && node flows-pipeline-contract.mjs`, `node ../scripts/flows-pipeline.mjs --live --dry-run` (prints the 13 dry days; exit 1 on a PROBLEM). `flows-worker-contract` and `flows-rt-server` need `FLOWS_TEST_SANDBOX=1` in the sandbox. No asset version bump, generator run or weight ceiling applies to files in `scripts/` (they are not served); a bump is needed only if the change also touches `assets/css|js|data` (for example `assets/js/flows-overview.js` reading the focus payload).

1. **Change a witness threshold or message.** Thresholds derive from `FRESH_CLASSES` (`shared/flows-freshness.js:3`): edit there if the readers' lines move (then `LEDGER_LIMITS`, `WITNESS`, `liveStalled` all follow). Counts: `WITNESS.confirm`/`recover` (witness.mjs:11-12). Text: `WITNESS_CHECKS` (28) and `issueBody` (264). Run `flows-starts`, `flows-freshness`, `flows-live`, `flows-ledger`. Update DEPLOY.md 10.5k tables and AGENTS.md.
2. **Add a witness check.** (a) entry in `WITNESS_CHECKS` and counts in `WITNESS.confirm/recover`; (b) a pure `evaluateX` beside the others; (c) a read in `createWatch.tick` (watch.mjs:48-53) under its own window predicate, and a push to `results` (59-61); (d) if the key is not in `NIGHTLY_READ_KEYS` or `live:*`, the live credential cannot read it: extend `shared/flows-live-worker.js:90`; (e) re-check the cost ceilings (invariant 13) and add a dry-day scenario in `live-day.mjs` using a new `fakeWorld` option; (f) DEPLOY.md 10.5k table. Tests: `flows-starts-contract`, plus `flows-live-contract`'s worker-side reads if the Worker changes.
3. **Change the nightly start (time, retry, caps).** Edit `NIGHTLY` (starts.mjs:6) and `nightlyStartDue` (17); keep invariant 12; keep `inputs` equal to `{origin:"live-loop"}` unless the nightly workflow declares more (`flows-pipeline.yml` `on.workflow_dispatch.inputs`). Update the hard-coded expectations in `live-day.mjs` scenarios 1, 3, 4, 5 (17:30, 18:15, four refused attempts, `503,503,503,503,0,0,204`) and the drive tables in `flows-starts-contract:113-204`. The Worker's own start (`PHASE_MINUTES.nightlyAfter` 17:15, `nightlyRetry` 18:15 in freshness.js:22-23, `nightlyDispatchDue` 419) is separate; keep the two consistent per DEPLOY 10.5k.
4. **Change loop cadence or budget.** `LIVE_LOOP` (live.mjs:348). `budgetMs + 10 min <= timeout-minutes` and `< 360` (workflow); the dry-day budgets are in `live-day.mjs`; the whole-day tests assume 5/15 min and 340 min. The workflow's cron list is pinned by tests (invariant 21). Re-run `flows-starts`, `flows-live`, `flows-verdict`.
5. **Add, drop or change a Tier 2 key or vendor read.** (a) `runLive` (add the read in the right parallel group, shape it, `put` it); (b) `shared/flows-live.js` `LIVE_KEYS` (cap, class, writer `actions`, `reads` count) and the shaper; (c) route in `fakeLiveVendor` (live-fake.mjs:319-351) or the dry run throws "no fake for this route"; (d) check `LIVE_BUDGET.tier2MaxCalls` 48 (`flows-live-contract:1013` asserts the dry ticks stay inside it); (e) the `--live --dry-run --emit` test requires exactly the set of `actions`-writer keys (`flows-live-contract:998-1003`) and that each is within its cap and carries the `actions` fresh envelope; (f) Worker side if readers change (`/api/flows/lk`, `now`, overlays) and the client freshness table; (g) DEPLOY.md 10.5i.
6. **Change strip/gex/focus planning.** `boardPlan` (live.mjs:72), `stripNames` (flows-live.js:630), `focusStripNames` (flows-focus.js:161), `gexRotation` (flows-live.js:1010). Mirror in the Worker's `focusTick` names (`flows-live-worker.js`, `W.focusNames`, `flows-live-contract:3209`) and the rail's `rosterPlan` (invariant 6).
7. **Change a HEALTH check or threshold.** Edit `health.mjs` (`HEALTH` at 9, `healthChecks` at 528, `ledgerChecks` 456, `neuronChecks` 418, `runChecks` 395, `labCheck` 336, `edgeFailures` 306). If it consumes a new clock/ledger field, add it Worker-side (`ingestClockView` / `ledgerRowView` in shared/flows-ledger.js:113) first. Update the exact-text asserts in `flows-live-contract` (2400-2735, 3031-3070), `flows-ledger-contract` (446-640) and `flows-legs-contract` (317-337); DEPLOY.md 10.0, 10.5h; the run facts come from `night` in pipeline.mjs:7087-7092.
8. **New edge refusal kind or remedy.** `refusalOf` (79), `tallyRefusal` (136), `edgeRemedy` (179), `blockRemedy` (162), `statusRemedies` (232). Counting happens in pipeline.mjs (`noteRefusal` 1845, `noteAnswer` 1838, four 403 classification sites asserted by `flows-live-contract:2745-2751`). Tests: `flows-live-contract` 2573-2700, `flows-pipeline-contract` 3995.
9. **Change the focus payload.** `focus.mjs` (shape, shedding) + `shared/flows-focus.js` (`FOCUS_FIELDS`, `FOCUS_BUDGET_BYTES`, groups) + pipeline.mjs:6800-6830 (inputs) + consumers: `worker.js` `/api/flows/focus` (3712) and the focus tick's `json_extract`/`json_each` reads (flows-live-worker.js:498), `assets/js/flows-overview.js` (client; bump `assets/version.txt` and every `?v=` per AGENTS.md if you edit it). `FOCUS_FIELDS` must stay a subset of `STRIP_FIELDS` (`flows-universe-contract`). Tests: `flows-universe-contract`, `flows-live-contract`, `flows-pipeline-contract` (focus key 1496-1572), render/overview suites if the client changes.
10. **Add a dry day.** Append to `DRY_SCENARIOS` (live-day.mjs:38) with `world()` (use `fakeWorld` options in live-world-fake.mjs:68), `budgetMs` and `expect(r, w)` returning a list of problems; extend `fakeWorld`/`fakeGithub` for new faults. `flows-starts-contract` asserts the CLI prints one `live day (dry run):` line per scenario and no `PROBLEM`, so the count follows automatically; add a named assertion at `flows-starts-contract:596-640` if the scenario matters. Each scenario adds virtual-clock work to `flows-live-contract` and `flows-starts-contract` (both spawn the CLI).
11. **Touch the GitHub plumbing.** `githubTarget`/`githubHeaders`/`githubSignal`/`chainDispatch`/`chainWithRetry` (live.mjs:365-421) and `createIssueReporter` (witness.mjs:194). Tests spawn local HTTP servers (`http://127.0.0.1:<port>` is the one allowed non-GitHub base) and the fake fetch in `live-world-fake.mjs`. Keep `Accept`, API version and UA stable.
12. **Edit a fake.** `live-fake.mjs` bodies are consumed by ten suites; run `flows-live`, `flows-ledger`, `flows-verdict`, `flows-readers`, `flows-rt`, `flows-rt-client`, plus the server ones (`flows-rt-server`, `flows-worker-contract`) with `FLOWS_TEST_SANDBOX=1`. Keep bodies deterministic (seeded by name and session).
13. **Add a new test file for this area.** Create `tests/<name>.mjs`, add `"test:<name>"` to `tests/package.json` and append `&& npm run test:<name>` to the long `test` chain; list it in AGENTS.md's file map and, once measured, in the "no server" list. Use `--disable-warning=ExperimentalWarning` if it imports `node:sqlite`.
14. **Update documentation after any change.** AGENTS.md rows for `witness/starts/watch`, `live/live-fake`, `live-world-fake/live-day`, `focus/health`; DEPLOY.md 10.5i (live layer), 10.5k (starts and witness), 10.0 (owner actions), 10.5h (health gate). Reasoning belongs in the commit message, not in source comments.

## Pipeline legs: vol, flow, universe, regime, events, market, ownership, card-x

Commit ba2acfe (origin/main after PR 148; asset version 240, fonts token 230). All line numbers are from `grep -n` / `sed -n` at this commit. Source wins over docs; disagreements are listed at the end of "Invariants and traps".

### Purpose and boundaries

**What it is.** Twelve plain ES modules in `scripts/flows-legs/` that run only inside the nightly Flows pipeline (`scripts/flows-pipeline.mjs`, GitHub Actions workflow `.github/workflows/flows-pipeline.yml`, Node 22, 45-minute job timeout, internal `DEADLINE_MS` = 36 min at pipeline:256). They are the vendor-read orchestration, payload composition and byte-budget layer for the part of the nightly that sits beside the board/card core: the cross-section `universe`, the market `regime`, the `events` calendar additions, per-name ownership and earnings history, the volatility leg (vol panels), the positioning/flow leg, the index and fund dossiers, and the shared `card-x:<T>` / `hist:<T>` store keys. `scripts/` is in `.assetsignore`, is never bundled into the Worker and never served; only `shared/*` modules reach `worker.js`.

**Shape of every module.** No `process.env`, no `fetch`, no `fs`, no clock of their own except `new Date()` defaults (`vol.mjs:229`, `flow.mjs:213`, `universe.mjs:29,103`, `market.mjs:36`) and `Date.now()` in `flow.mjs:230` / `common.mjs:55`. All I/O is injected by the pipeline: `uw(path, params, {envelope})` (the vendor client, `scripts/flows-pipeline.mjs:533`), `publish(key, payload)` (pipeline:3049), `stored(key)` (reads the in-process `publishedStore`, pipeline:3045), `readStored(key)` (GET of an ingest key, pipeline:1953), `pool`/`runPooled` (pipeline:424), `deadline` (absolute ms epoch), `log`, `now`. The only internal import outside the 12 files is `./common.mjs` (read/rowsOf/silenceOf/freshStamp/makeCallMeter/sequential/chunks/pastDeadline, owned by a neighbouring area; `common.mjs:1` imports `vendorGate` from `shared/flows-regime.js`). Shaping math (every formula) lives in `shared/flows-vol.js`, `flows-positioning.js`, `flows-regime.js`, `flows-cross.js`, `flows-catalysts.js`, `flows-ownership.js`; the legs only decide which routes to read, with which params, in which order and pool width, and how the results are stitched, shed to a byte cap and published.

**Nightly outputs (ingest keys, all via `POST /api/flows/ingest?key=`):** `universe`, `regime` (market part + vol `volRadar`), `events` (rows from the pipeline + `eventsAdditions` from here), `card-x:<T>` (up to four merged writers), `hist:<T>`, and `card:<T>` for the three index ETFs and nine focus funds.

**Not in this area:** the live layer and its helpers (`live.mjs`, `live-fake.mjs`, `focus.mjs`, `health.mjs`, `watch.mjs`, `witness.mjs`, `starts.mjs`, `live-day.mjs`, `live-world-fake.mjs`); the pipeline body and `uw`/`publish`/`runPooled`; the ingest door, read routes and rewriting in `worker.js`; the `shared/*` shapers; the ticker/events/market/overview clients that paint these payloads; the options engine (`flows-quant-pipeline.mjs` `attachEngine`, the `card-x` writer outside this area, which writes first, before the three writers here).

### Data and interfaces

**Vendor routes read (Unusual Whales REST; base `FLOWS_UW_BASE_URL` default `https://api.unusualwhales.com`, `Authorization: Bearer UW_API_KEY`).** `uw` returns `body.data` (or the array) unless `{envelope:true}`; array params are appended as repeated keys; it retries 5xx/network up to `RATE.maxRetries`, backs off on 429, and throws `Error("<path> -> HTTP <status>")` (pipeline:533-621).

|---|---|---|
| universe | `/api/screener/stocks` harvest (`min_underlying_price 5`, `min_volume 1000`, `min_oi 5000`, `min_marketcap 1e9` from pipeline `UNIVERSE`; `order=marketcap`, `order_direction=desc`, `limit 500`, `offset=<page index>`, `date`); by ticker (`ticker=A,B`, `limit 500`) for missing members, focus rows, SPY/QQQ/IWM; `/api/etfs/QQQ/holdings`; `/api/short_screener` (`tickers`, `limit 500`, `min_market_date`, `max_market_date`); `/api/insider/transactions` (`ticker_symbol`, `form_types[]=4`, `transaction_codes[]=P,S`, `start_date`, `end_date`, `limit 500`, `page`) | harvest <= 4 pages; short ceil(carded/50); insider ceil(carded/25) x <= 3 pages |
| regime | `/api/volatility/vix-term-structure` (`history_days 90`; currently HTTP 403, published as `plan_gated`/`volatility_scope_required`), `/api/net-flow/expiry` x4, `/api/market/daily-report` (`limit 25`), `/api/market/<sector>/sector-tide` x11, `/api/market/<SPY|QQQ|IWM>/etf-tide` x3, `/api/etfs/<SPY|QQQ|IWM>/in-outflow` x3 (`start_date` = session-400d), `/api/etfs/<SPY|QQQ>/holdings` x2 (QQQ served from the prefetched read), `/api/group-flow/<group>/greek-flow` x8, `/api/options-pulse/total` | `REGIME_CALLS` = 34, strictly sequential |
| events | `/api/market/economic-calendar`, `/api/market/fda-calendar` (`target_date_min..max` = session..+120d, `limit 200`), `/api/earnings/<premarket|afterhours>` (`date`, `limit 100`) x13, `/api/earnings/<T>` for deep names plus window names | 2 + 13 + earnings names (<= 50 deep + <= 60 window, deduped) |

**Store keys these legs write** (all go to D1 table `flows_payload (id, payload, updated_at)` through the Worker ingest door; the legs never touch D1 directly):

| Key | Writer(s) in order | Cap / budget | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `universe` | `runMarketLegs` -> pipeline:5274 | `UNIVERSE_BUDGET_BYTES` 100 KiB (columns shed by `prio`, else `status:"unavailable"`, `reason:"over_budget"`) | built from eligible harvest rows; carries `harvest` block and `fresh` |
| `regime` | 1) pipeline:5274 market part, 2) `publishVol` adds `volRadar` | 60 KiB for the market part (`REGIME_BUDGET_BYTES`); `volRadar` is added after that check | second writer spreads the same-session prior from `publishedStore` |
| `events` | pipeline `publish("events", {...rows, ...eventsAdditions})` at :5322 (spread at :5333) | additions <= 64 KiB (`EVENTS_ADDITIONS_BUDGET_BYTES`) so the whole key stays under the 128 KiB ingest cap with ~32 KiB of rows | additions keys: macro, fda, earningsCalendar, catalysts, history, historyRule, additionsBudget |
| `card-x:<T>` | 1) options engine split (`{ticker, sessionDate, generatedAt, engine}`, pipeline:6585 via `attachEngine` in `flows-quant-pipeline.mjs:230-238`), 2) `publishVol`, 3) `runFlowLeg`, 4) `publishCardX` | each composed result <= 100 KiB by the leg's own rule; Worker hard cap 128 KiB | every writer spreads the same-session prior; see traps |
| `hist:<T>` | `runFlowLeg` only | 16 KiB (`HIST_CAP`) | one-year gex/volume series + NOPE closes; the only memory of past NOPE closes |
| `card:<SPY,QQQ,IWM, 9 funds>` | `buildIndexDossiers` | 100 KiB (`INDEX_CARD_BUDGET_BYTES`) | depth `index` or `fund` |

Read by the leg: `hist:<T>` through `readStored` (ingest GET with the nightly token; per-key `{payload, absent, failed, status}`), once per carded name (flow.mjs:240-243).

**Read routes that serve these payloads** (Flows session, `Cache-Control: no-store`, also in the Worker's last-good cache set `LAST_GOOD_PATHS` worker.js:1041): `GET /api/flows/universe`, `/api/flows/regime` (worker.js:3712, `{status:"pending"}` when absent), `/api/flows/card-x?t=`, `/api/flows/hist?t=`, `/api/flows/card?t=` (worker.js:3818; ticker regex `FLOWS_TICKER_RE`; a card whose `engine.status === "split"` is re-joined from `card-x:<T>` only when `x.sessionDate === card.sessionDate`, worker.js:1011-1025), `/api/flows/events`.

**Ingest constraints.** `POST /api/flows/ingest?key=<k>` with nightly token (`FLOWS_INGEST_TOKEN`) or live credential; keys must match `INGEST_VIEW_KEY_RE` (includes `universe`, `regime`, `events`, `focus`, `roster`) or `^(card|card-x|hist):<TICKER>$`; body <= `FLOWS_MAX_PAYLOAD_BYTES` = 128 KiB (413 otherwise); non-dated keys are upsert-overwrites (`ON CONFLICT(id) DO UPDATE`).

**Env vars / secrets touched indirectly (none read inside these 12 files):** `UW_API_KEY`, `FLOWS_UW_BASE_URL`, `FLOWS_INGEST_TOKEN`, `FLOWS_INGEST_URL` (default `https://anilkaya.org/api/flows/ingest`), `FLOWS_ALLOW_INTRADAY`, `FLOWS_REPUBLISH_SESSION` (workflow inputs), `FLOWS_UW_TIMEOUT_MS` (live mode only). The legs also run unchanged in `--dry-run`, which swaps in the three fakes and `--emit <path>` writes `<path>-<key with ":" -> "-">.json` files (pipeline:3056-3061).

**Freshness envelope.** Every payload carries `fresh = {v:1, readAt, vendorAt, source:"nightly", cadenceS:0, session, writer:"flows-pipeline"}` (`common.mjs:33`, `vol.mjs:344`, `shared/flows-positioning.js:1213`). Merging rule everywhere: `readAt` = oldest (min), `vendorAt` = newest (max).

**Wire shapes (compact).**
- Vol dossier `card-x:<T>`: `{v:1, ticker, scope: deep|carded|index|fund, sessionDate, generatedAt, fresh, cone, rv, vrp, term, skew, ivDyn, anomaly, sentiment, character, why:{code: sentence}}`; each panel `{status: ok|quiet|unavailable|unreadable, code?, silent{field: code}, ...}`; shed fields set to null and listed in `panel.shed`.
- Card summary `card.x.vol = volSummary(panels)`: `{v, asOf, iv30, iv30Pct, richCheap, view, coneShape, slope30_90, rv21, rv21Pct, yz21, gap63, vrp{...}, skew{...}, term{...}, ivDyn{...}, votes{...}, status{...}}`; grep finds no browser or Worker reader of `x.vol` at this commit.
- Flow `card-x:<T>`: `{v:1, ticker, sessionDate, generatedAt, depth: deep|cross, fresh, <sections>, flowShed:[]}`; every section is `{status: ok|stale|quiet|unavailable|unreadable, why?, gaps?, u?, ...}` with `why` codes from `FLOW_CODES` and units from `UNITS` (`shared/flows-positioning.js:34,69`).
- `hist:<T>`: `{v, ticker, sessionDate, generatedAt, fresh, d0, dd[], gex{asOf,g,c,v}, volume{asOf,np,bb,vol,pc,oi}, nope{asOf,...packed}, u{...}, trimmed}`.
- Ownership/earnings `card-x` parts: `short{status, interest, siScreener, borrow, volume, squeeze}`, `insiders{...,complete?}`, `earnings{status, ..., impliedNext, ratioToday, vendorRatio}`, plus `shed:[]`, `bytes`.
- Regime: `{v, generatedAt, sessionDate, fresh, status, calls, volCurve, zeroDte, sectors, etfTide, fundFlows, impliedCorrelation, groups, optionsPulse, dailyReport, shed, bytes, [volRadar]}`.
- Universe: columnar (`t[]`, `cols{key:[int...]}`, `units{key:[unit,scale]}`, `pct`, `shock`, `harvest`, `shed`, `bytes`) from `shared/flows-cross.js:446`.

**Silence vocabulary.** `SILENCE` (`shared/flows-cross.js:9`): absent, unreadable, plan_gated, not_read, stale, too_few, unit_unverified, low_coverage, degenerate. Vol uses `VOL_WHY` codes (`shared/flows-vol.js:33`); flow uses `FLOW_CODES` (`shared/flows-positioning.js:34`). The three families do not share one mapping. The universe, regime, events and ownership legs speak `SILENCE` reasons through `silenceOf` (`common.mjs`) and `batchSilence` (`universe.mjs:123`): a read skipped at the deadline is `not_read`, a 403 or 422 is `plan_gated`, any other failure is `unreadable`. The vol leg publishes panels as `{status: "unavailable", code}` with `deadline` (skipped), `read-failed` (5xx, 429, network) or `refused` (every other 4xx, 403 and 422 included), and `{status: "unreadable", code: "unreadable-body"}` for a body that could not be shaped. The flow leg's `failedRead` codes are `deadline`, `failed`, `refused` (4xx except 408 and 429) and `malformed`, published as section `status: "unavailable"` with that `why`. Nothing is ever published as zero for an absent input.

**Fake vendors (dry run and tests).** Hash: FNV-1a (2166136261 / 16777619); PRNG: mulberry32 constant 0x6D2B79F5. They mirror probe-verified vendor behaviour: string-typed numerics, screener `offset` as page index, VIX route 403, `days`/`delta`/`timespan`/`timeframe` whitelists returning 422, `has_more` and `si` envelopes, regular/pre/post candle rows.

### Flows

**A. Nightly order of the legs (scripts/flows-pipeline.mjs line numbers):**

1. Dating and screener: `harvestScreener(uw, {filters, date})` :4762 (non-dry). Accepted only when rows exist and not truncated/repeated/errored (:4766-4767); otherwise the pipeline's cap-band sweep builds `universeSource` (:4777-4815). DRY_RUN: `vendor = makeFakeVendor({sessionDate, screenerRows})` :4770.
2. `readHoldings(vendor)` :4826 -> NDX membership and NDX 10; `fetchMissingMembers(vendor, guaranteed, held, {date})` :4847 -> one by-ticker screener call for guaranteed names the harvest missed; `universe = screener.filter(eligibleFor)` (:4857); refuses `< 50` names (:4859).
3. Pulse: `totalsHistory(...)` :4115 (DRY_RUN reads `makeFakeVendor(...)("/api/market/total-options-volume")` :4116).
4. Boards, scoring, enrichment (pipeline body, out of scope). `byCard` :4977, `deepTickers` :5083 (`deepSet` + focus carded), `onBoard` :6280, `crossSectionTickers` :6285.
5. `cardX = makeCardXStore()` :5253; `runMarketLegs({uw: withPrefetched(vendor, Map[[holdings.path, holdings]]), harvest: harvest || universeSource, eligible: eligibleFor, cardedTickers: [...byCard.keys()], deepTickers, windowTickers: windowTickersOf(...), deadline, pool: runPooled, width: poolWidth(2).width, stats})` :5256-5265. Inside `market.mjs:26`:
   - use handed harvest or `harvestScreener` -> `eligibleRows` (:35-38)
   - `readIndexRows` SPY/QQQ/IWM :45
   - `readRegime` :48 (34 sequential reads) -> `assembleRegime` :49 -> `{regime, catalysts: reportCatalysts}`
   - `universePayload(eligibleRows, ...)` :60
   - `readShortInterest` :69, `readInsiders` :70
   - `readDeepOwnership` :80 -> `ownershipParts` :81
   - `readCatalysts` :91 (econ, fda, 13 calendar, earnings per deep+window name) -> `assembleCatalysts` :92
6. Pipeline fills the store: `cardX.add(t, "short"|"insiders", ...)` :5265-5268, `cardX.add(t, "earnings", e)` :5269.
7. Publish `universe` then `regime`, one try/catch each (:5274-5280). Later `publish("events", {...events, ...marketLegs.eventsAdditions})` (the publish call is :5322, the `eventsAdditions` spread :5333).
8. Vol: `volNames({deep: [...onBoard.entries()], crossSection, byTicker, funds: FOCUS_FUNDS minus indices})` :6395; `runVolLeg({uw: DRY_RUN ? fakeVolVendor : uw, names, sessionDate, repair: repairCandles, pool})` :6397-6401 (pool width 4). Failure is caught (:6403) and every card then carries `x.vol` as `read-failed`.
9. Card pass `runPooled(cardTickers, ...)` :6417: for each deep card `attachVol(card, volLeg, ticker, {ivRank: rankCut.raw})` :6526 (patches ivDyn + character vote), options engine may split to `publish("card-x:T", engineOut.extra)` :6585, then `publish("card:T")`.
10. Cross-section cards :6676-6748 (`extraTickers = crossSectionTickers` :6676, `runPooled(extraTickers, ...)` :6686, each card refused above 100 KiB at :6721, `publish("card:T")` :6724): `attachVol(card, volLeg, ticker)` :6718 (no ivRank; `ivDyn` stays `not-read`).
11. `publishVol(volLeg, {publish, stored, ...})` :6750 -> `card-x:<T>` for EVERY entry in the vol roster (deep, carded, SPY/QQQ/IWM, funds) composed with `stored("card-x:T")`, then `regime` composed with `stored("regime")` adding `volRadar`.
12. `runFlowLeg({uw, readStored, publish, stored, runPooled, deadline, sessionDate, generatedAt, deep: cardTickers (with enrichment), cross: crossSectionTickers, featuresOf, strikesOf, cardOf, variation, width: poolWidth(3).width})` :6752. Flow internals: `flowLeg` (flow.mjs:208): alert batches (10 names per call, pooled) -> per deep name `deepName` (8 reads + multi-leg + prior hist + lifeline contracts chosen from the already-published card's `panels.oiDeltas.rows`) -> sections -> `emit`: `composeCardX` (with `stored("card-x:T")`) -> `publish("card-x:T")` -> `publish("hist:T")` unless the prior hist could not be read back. Cross names: 3 reads.
13. Focus rows `readFocusRows` :6765 (+ re-read of lost funds :6777); `dossierRoster` :6786; `buildIndexDossiers({tickers, depthOf, indexRows, deadline, ...indexDossierDeps(...)})` :6790 -> `card:SPY|QQQ|IWM|GLD|IAU|SLV|CPER|COPX|GDX|GDXJ|SIL|SILJ`; `indexDossierDeps.card` calls `attachVol(card, volLeg, ticker)` :4323. `buildFocusPayload` :6819 -> `focus`.
14. `publishCardX(cardX, publish, {readAt: marketLegs.readAt, stored})` :6835 -> final composition of `short`, `insiders`, `earnings` into each ticker's `card-x`.
15. `retireAndRoster` (:4454, outside scope) treats `card`, `card-x`, `hist` as ticker key kinds.
16. End: `callModel(shape)` compares vendor calls to the model :7039.

**B. card-x merge chain for one ticker (order matters, each step reads `publishedStore`, which `publish()` fills BEFORE the POST at pipeline:3054):**

```
engine extra  {ticker, sessionDate, generatedAt, engine}   (only if the card exceeded the card cap; pipeline:6585)
   -> publishVol:  {...prior, v, ticker, scope, sessionDate, generatedAt, fresh, 9 vol panels, why}      vol.mjs:364
   -> runFlowLeg:  {...prior, ...base(v,ticker,sessionDate,generatedAt,depth,fresh), fresh merged, ...sections, flowShed}   flow.mjs:173
   -> publishCardX:{...base, ...own(short, insiders, earnings, shed, fresh), fresh merged, shed unioned, bytes}              card-x.mjs:62
```
Each step applies `samePrior` (prior kept only if `prior.sessionDate === sessionDate`).

**C. Per-name vol read (vol.mjs:124):** phase 1 `Promise.all(kinds minus rr25/rr10 [+ candles])` -> `regularSessionRows` -> `repair` (`repairCandles`, pipeline:1088; returns `{candles, breaks}`) -> `toBars` -> `buildRvPanel` -> cone (needs rolling RV) / term (needs earnings) -> `pickMonthlyExpiry(listedExpiries + term expiries)` -> phase 2 `rr25` + `rr10` in parallel -> `buildSkewPanel` -> vrp (needs cone iv30, bars, garch) -> ivDyn (index/fund only) -> anomaly (needs cone view) -> sentiment (needs `lean`) -> character (needs ivDyn half-life) -> ex-event adjustments (`exEventSlope`, `exEventVol`) -> entry `{ticker, depth, readAt (oldest read), vendorAt (newest updated_at), reads{kind: "ok"|code}, panels{...}}`.

**D. Failure and deadline propagation:** vendor error -> `read()`/`call` records `{ok:false, status, gated}` or `{error:{code,http}}` -> panel/silence record; deadline -> `pastDeadline(deadline)` returns a skipped read (`not_read`) or the pool's `stopEarly` leaves `attempted[i]=false` (vol: `deadlineEntry`; flow: `alert batch failedRead("deadline")`, skipped counter). Leg-level throw: `runMarketLegs` caught by pipeline (:5271), `runVolLeg` caught (:6403), `runFlowLeg` swallows internally (flow.mjs:411-419).

### Invariants and traps

1. **No comments, anywhere in `scripts/flows-legs`.** `tests/flows-legs-contract.mjs:896-897` reads every file in that directory and fails on `//` or `/*` (after stripping `http(s)://` URLs, so even a `//` inside a regex or string fails); `tests/flows-positioning-contract.mjs:911-914` repeats it for `flow.mjs`, `flow-fake.mjs`, `shared/flows-positioning.js`. Put reasoning in the commit message.
2. **card-x:<T> has up to four writers composed through the in-process `publishedStore`.** Order is engine split (pipeline:6585) -> `publishVol` (:6750) -> `runFlowLeg` (:6752) -> `publishCardX` (:6835). A new or reordered writer must (a) spread the same-session prior, (b) keep `engine` and `sessionDate` intact (the Worker re-joins a split engine only when `x.sessionDate === card.sessionDate`, worker.js:1011-1025), (c) merge `fresh` with min readAt / max vendorAt, (d) stay under 100 KiB (Worker rejects > 128 KiB with 413, worker.js:923). `publish()` stores the payload in `publishedStore` before the POST, so a failed POST still seeds the next writer; a payload a writer refuses to publish (vol `!fits`, card-x `over`) does not.
3. **Name collisions to avoid:** `cardXPayload` exists twice with different signatures (`vol.mjs:364` takes an entry, `card-x.mjs:30` takes ticker + parts); `mergeFresh` exists three times (`vol.mjs:352` and `card-x.mjs:54` spread `b`; `flow.mjs:165` does not); the 100 KiB cap is written four times (`vol.mjs:23`, `flow.mjs:18`, `card-x.mjs:6`, `index-dossier.mjs:17`) and `INDEX_TICKERS`/`VOL_INDEX_NAMES` are two copies of the same list. `v` and `bytes` are overwritten by the last writer (all `v` are 1 today).
4. **`regime` has two writers.** Market legs publish it (pipeline:5274); `publishVol` re-publishes with `volRadar` added and the prior spread only when it is from the same session (`vol.mjs:360-404`). If the market legs failed, the second write is a stub with `volRadar` and no `status`/sections (the vol test composes a prior at flows-vol-contract:725-728). The 60 KiB regime budget is checked before `volRadar` is added.
5. **Universe and regime publish separately** (try/catch per key, pipeline:5274-5280) so a refused `universe` cannot take `regime` and card-x with it; `tests/flows-legs-contract.mjs:899-902` greps the pipeline source for `try { await publish(key, marketLegs[key]); }` and for `harvest: harvest || universeSource`. If the harvest is refused the sweep rows must be handed in or the market legs would harvest again.
6. **Vendor error text is a contract.** `vendorGate` (`shared/flows-regime.js:424`), `errorCode` (`vol.mjs:100`) and `readCode` (`shared/flows-positioning.js:195`) parse `HTTP nnn` out of the thrown message that `uw` builds (`"<path> -> HTTP <status>"`). The three parsers classify differently: `vendorGate` marks only 403 and 422 as gated (`plan_gated` in `silenceOf`/`batchSilence`); vol `errorCode` calls every 4xx except 429 `refused` (so 403 and 422 are `refused` there, not `plan_gated`); flow `readCode` calls every 4xx except 408 and 429 `refused`, everything else `failed`. Every fake must throw the same shape.
7. **Envelope rules.** `uw` drops everything but `data` unless `{envelope:true}`. `volume-and-ratio` (rows under `si`), insider transactions (`has_more`), QQQ holdings and all 34 regime reads (`regime.mjs:31-55`) pass `{ envelope: true }`, as do every vol read (`vol.mjs:237`) and every flow read (`flow.mjs:224`). The catalyst reads (economic and FDA calendars, the 13 earnings-calendar routes, per-ticker `/api/earnings/<T>`, `events.mjs:68-80`), the screener harvest and by-ticker reads, `/api/short_screener` and `/api/shorts/<T>/data` do not: they take the unwrapped `data`. `tests/flows-legs-contract.mjs:903-904` regex-checks that `volume-and-ratio` is read with `{ envelope: true }`. `withPrefetched` only intercepts calls with empty params and a cached read, and returns the envelope or the unwrapped shape according to `opts.envelope`.
8. **Screener `offset` is a PAGE INDEX** (probe 2026-09-23; `universe.mjs:36-37,57`; asserted legs-contract:580 "offset is a page index: 0, then 1"). Treating it as a row offset makes pages repeat, flagged `repeated`, and the pipeline then discards the harvest. The ceiling is 2,000 rows.
9. **Unread is never zero.** Every unreadable batch/name carries a silence (`batchSilence`, `silenceOf`, `failedRead`); deadline skips are `not_read`, not `unreadable` (legs-contract:617-618, 758-766). Keep it that way when adding reads.
10. **Deadline is an absolute ms epoch** (`stats.startedAt + DEADLINE_MS` = 36 min; job timeout 45 min). Legs that loop must check `pastDeadline(deadline)` or pass a `stopEarly` to the pool.
11. **Vol `deep` names have no ivRank read.** `VOL_DEPTH_READS.deep` lacks `ivRank`; the card pass patches `ivDyn` and re-casts `character` via `attachVol(..., {ivRank})` (pipeline:6526), and this must happen BEFORE `publishVol` (:6750) or `card-x` carries `ivDyn: unavailable/input-absent`. Cross-section ("carded") names get no ivRank, term or skew at all. Index and fund depths read ivRank inside the leg and are skipped by the patch (`isFundDepth`, vol.mjs:307), and are excluded from `crossSectionPercentiles` and the radar's `carded` overlap (vol.mjs:268,289).
12. **`attachVol` mutates the leg's shared entry**; `cardXPayload` clones (`structuredClone`, vol.mjs:366) so later patches are included only if they happen before publish.
13. **hist:<T> is the only memory of NOPE closes.** The `nope` read is one session's minute series (the fake returns 390 minute rows), and only the day's close is kept per session. If the prior hist cannot be read back (`readPrior` failed) the leg still publishes `card-x` but does NOT rewrite `hist:<T>` and the NOPE z becomes `history-unread` (flow.mjs:240-243,275-280; positioning-contract:788-806). Never replace an unreadable history with a one-point series.
14. **Alert paging stops on a repeated cursor** (`next === olderThan`) and records `coverFromM` when incomplete; do not widen `ALERT_MAX_PAGES` without recosting `CALL_COST.flowAlertPages` (12).
15. **Lifeline contracts need the card to be published first.** `cardOf` reads `publishedStore["card:T"].panels.oiDeltas` (pipeline:6761); the flow leg must run after the card pass.
16. **`composeCardX` can publish an over-cap payload.** After shedding every ok/stale section it still returns the payload; `emit` publishes it (flow.mjs:173-197, 261-289). The Worker's 128 KiB limit is the final guard (error counted in `published.failed`).
17. **Byte budgets protect neighbouring keys.** Events additions are capped so `events` stays below 128 KiB in earnings season (legs-contract:726-751 builds the busiest week and asserts `< 128 KiB` at :745); universe columns shed by `prio` and a payload still over 100 KiB degrades to `unavailable/over_budget`, which the health gate reports through the Neuron coverage ledger (health.mjs:420-445).
18. **Call model is separate from the leg code.** `MARKET_LEG_CALLS` (263) is a standalone formula; `REGIME_CALLS` is derived from the constant lists; `CALL_COST`/`callModel` (pipeline:151-198) and `tests/flows-pipeline-contract.mjs:4339-4346` (covers focus-era shape; `CALL_COST.dossier === 13`) must be updated by hand when a leg's call count changes, or the end-of-run `BUDGET:` warning misfires.
19. **Dry-run coverage is asserted.** `flows-positioning-contract.mjs` spawns `node scripts/flows-pipeline.mjs --dry-run --emit <tmp>` and requires the fakes to exercise flowExpiry ok+unavailable, flowStrike ok+unavailable, dpLevels ok+quiet, a gexPath with `flowFilled === false`, a NOPE z beside a `short-history` gap, and a truncated multi-leg; it also checks every card-x <= `FLOW_LEG.CARD_X_CAP`, hist <= 16 KiB, a card-x/hist for every non-index/fund card, and that card-x without a card is an index/fund (vol) or ownership-only entry. Changing a fake's hash/seed/failAt moduli or a route path silently removes that coverage and fails CI.
20. **Index and fund dossiers skip rather than fabricate.** A row with no `close` (hidden periscope) or `close <= 0` is skipped before any vendor call (index-dossier.mjs:54-59); `buildIndexDossiers` isolates exceptions per ticker (failed list) and refuses a card still over 100 KiB after shedding.
21. **Depth strings are shared literals:** `"index"` / `"fund"` appear in `vol.mjs:17`, `index-dossier.mjs:4-8`, the pipeline roster `depth` map, `cardTier` and the ticker client (`isIndex`). `tests/flows-pipeline-contract.mjs:1470-1482` asserts the index lane is exactly SPY/QQQ/IWM and the fund lane equals `FOCUS_FUNDS`.
22. **Determinism.** Fakes are seeded from ticker hashes and take no clock; legs take `now`/`deadline` as parameters in tests. Real `Date.now()` appears only in `flow.mjs:230` and `common.mjs:55`.

**Doc versus source disagreements:**
- AGENTS.md's file map names `live.mjs`, `witness.mjs`, `starts.mjs`, `watch.mjs`, `focus.mjs`, `health.mjs` and the live fakes, but none of the twelve files in this area; the nightly legs are documented only in DEPLOY.md (card-x/hist table :799; funds, focus and call model :1100-1200).
- DEPLOY.md's call model says market legs are "49 fixed"; source `CALL_COST.marketFixed` is `1 + 33 + 15` (pipeline:155) while the legs make 1 index read + `REGIME_CALLS` 34 + economic 1 + FDA 1 + 13 calendar = 50 fixed reads (the model is one low, harmless under the +10% margin).
- DEPLOY.md says the vol leg costs "10 per dossier"; this is right only because index/fund names carry no candles in `volNames` and the leg reads `/ohlc/1d` itself (9 kinds + candles).

### How to change it

**Add or change a vol panel or route**
1. Builder and silence codes in `shared/flows-vol.js` (add the code to `VOL_WHY` :33 if it is a new silence; extend `volSummary` :1222 if the card summary needs it).
2. `vol.mjs`: `VOL_DEPTH_READS` (:10) per depth, `volRequest` (:34) or `radarRequest` (:54), assembly in `readName` (:124) and the `panels` object (:211), `VOL_PANELS` (:25) if a new panel (drives `deadlineEntry`/`brokenEntry`), `SHED_ORDER` (:27) if large.
3. `vol-fake.mjs`: add the route to the `fakeVolVendor` router (:313), keep the 422 whitelists in step, add a profile flag if a failure arm is needed.
4. Client: `assets/js/flows-ticker.js` reads `X.<panel>` (cone/rv/term/skew/vrp around :1997-2095); a client edit needs the asset-version ritual (increment `assets/version.txt`, update every `?v=` and `ASSET_VERSION` in `shared/flows-pages.js`, keep the 16 font `?v=` at `assets/fonts-version.txt`, run `tests/contracts.mjs`, `flows-weight`).
5. Call model: `CALL_COST.volPerDeep|volPerCross|volPerDossier` (pipeline:163-165) and the `flows-pipeline-contract` assertions (:4339-4346); `scripts/flows-probe-list.json` and `tests/fixtures-vol-probe.json` for the real-shape sample.
6. Run (no server): `cd tests && node flows-vol-contract.mjs && node flows-legs-contract.mjs && npm run test:pipeline`.

**Add or change a flow/positioning section**
1. Builder in `shared/flows-positioning.js` (new `why` codes into `FLOW_CODES` :34, new units into `UNITS` :69; `checkSection` in positioning-contract requires declared codes and units and that every null field says why in `gaps`).
2. `flow.mjs`: read in `deepName` (:291) or `crossName` (:354), add to `sections`, then to `DEEP_SECTIONS`/`CROSS_SECTIONS` (:26,:31) and, if big, `SHED_ORDER` (:33). Budgets: `FLOW_LEG` (:9).
3. `flow-fake.mjs`: add the route to the router (:335) and, if a failure arm is wanted, a `failAt` modulus not colliding with the existing ones.
4. Client section renderer in `assets/js/flows-ticker.js` (`X.<section>`; asset-version ritual). Call model: `CALL_COST.flowPerDeep|flowPerCross`.
5. Run: `cd tests && node flows-positioning-contract.mjs` (this also spawns the full pipeline dry run) and `npm run test:pipeline`.

**Change universe harvest, filters or columns**
- Filters live in pipeline `UNIVERSE` (:130) and `screenerFilters` (:4754); harvest page size/cap in `universe.mjs:4,6`; by-ticker reads in `screenerByTicker` (:81).
- Columns, units, scale and priority in `shared/flows-cross.js` `UNIVERSE_COLUMNS` (:344) and `UNIVERSE_BUDGET_BYTES` (:5); the dry-run row fields come from `augmentScreenerRow` (fake-vendor.mjs:39) and must supply any new vendor field.
- Downstream readers to re-check: `shared/flows-neuron-screen.js`, `shared/flows-neuron-coverage.js`, the Worker lookups in worker.js:1106-1158 (`LITE_SQL` 1106, `GATE_SQL` 1115, `ROSTER_SQL` 1119, `KNOWN_SQL` 1122, `liteOf` 1139, `liteCard` 1155) and `shared/flows-dossier-worker.js:77-78`, the Neuron health checks (`health.mjs:420-445`).
- Run: `node flows-legs-contract.mjs`, `node flows-universe-contract.mjs`, `node flows-neuron-screen.mjs`, `npm run test:pipeline`.

**Add a regime feed or change the regime**
- `regime.mjs`: add the read in `readRegime` (:22; keep it sequential and through `get` so the deadline guard applies), bump `REGIME_CALLS` (:19) arithmetic (legs-contract asserts equality with calls made), add the section in `assembleRegime` (:61), add the key to the `parts` list (:230) so `status` counts it, and decide its shed order (:218-227) against `REGIME_BUDGET_BYTES` (60 KiB, `shared/flows-regime.js:7`).
- Shaper in `shared/flows-regime.js`; fake handler in `fake-vendor.mjs` (before `vendor` at :466); `CALL_COST.marketFixed` (pipeline:155) and the `MARKET_LEG_CALLS` terms (market.mjs:21-24).
- Readers: `assets/js/flows-market.js` (:1459), `flows-overview.js` (:2129, :1021, :1077). Run `node flows-legs-contract.mjs` and the Chromium suites that paint them.

**Change the events calendar, FDA window or earnings history**
- `shared/flows-catalysts.js` (`CALENDAR_SESSIONS` :10, `FDA_HORIZON_DAYS` :16, shapers), `events.mjs` (`calendarPlan` :45, `FDA_LIMIT` :8, `fitEventsAdditions` :16 and its caps), `market.mjs` window constants (:11,:13). Keep `EVENTS_ADDITIONS_BUDGET_BYTES` consistent with the 128 KiB ingest cap and the events rows (~32 KiB). The legs-contract busiest-week block (:726-751) and `calendarPlan(S).length === 13` (:724) will need updating with a deliberate change. Client: `assets/js/flows-events.js` (:109-435).

**Change ownership (short, insiders, borrow, squeeze)**
- Batch constants in `universe.mjs:10-22`, deep reads in `ownership.mjs:12`, assembly in `ownershipParts` (:32), shapers in `shared/flows-ownership.js`, shed order in `card-x.mjs:8-13`.
- Field names read elsewhere: `X.short`, `X.insiders` in `assets/js/flows-ticker.js` (:2261-2295), and the dossier worker's skip rules (`shared/flows-dossier-worker.js:256-259` look at `cardX.earnings`, `cardX.short.interest.shares`, `cardX.insiders.status`) and `shared/flows-dossier.js:1157-1257`: renaming these fields silently re-enables vendor fan-out.

**Add a new `card-x` writer or key**
- Follow invariant 2. Register the key in `INGEST_VIEW_KEY_RE` (worker.js:937) if it is not a ticker key; ticker kinds are `card|card-x|hist` (`ingestKeyParts` :939, `INGEST_LIST_KINDS` :952, `ROSTER_KEY_KINDS` in `shared/flows-universe.js:91`, `LEDGER_LIST_KINDS` pipeline:1963; retire/roster logic in `retireAndRoster` pipeline:4454). Add the read route to `LAST_GOOD_PATHS` (worker.js:1041) if it should have a last-good copy.

**Change the index or fund roster**
- `shared/flows-focus.js` (`FOCUS_FUNDS` :9), `INDEX_TICKERS` (universe.mjs:8) and `VOL_INDEX_NAMES` (vol.mjs:8) together; `FAKE_FUNDS`, `FAKE_ETF_NAMES` and `fakeIndexRow` (fake-vendor.mjs:21-35,100) for the dry run; `dossierRoster` consumers (pipeline:6786); expectations in `flows-pipeline-contract.mjs:1470-1482` and `CALL_COST.dossier`.

**Change a pool width, the deadline or retry behaviour**
- Pool widths are chosen at the call sites in the pipeline (`poolWidth(n)`, :398; vol 4 at :6401, flow 3 at :6762, market 2 at :5262); the flow leg clamps to `FLOW_LEG.POOL_MAX` (3). `DEADLINE_MS` (:256) and workflow `timeout-minutes: 45` (`.github/workflows/flows-pipeline.yml`) must move together.

**General rituals**
- `scripts/` changes need no asset-version bump unless `assets/css|js|data` also changed. Generated files are untouched by these modules.
- New test suites must be added both as a `test:<name>` script and into the `test` chain string in `tests/package.json:9`; these legs are covered by `test:flows-legs`, `test:flows-vol`, `test:flows-positioning`, `test:pipeline`. All four run with no workerd (`FLOWS_TEST_SANDBOX=1` is not needed); Node >= 22.13 per `tests/package.json` `engines`.
- The nightly can be exercised end to end without secrets: `node scripts/flows-pipeline.mjs --dry-run` (add `--emit <base>` to dump every payload to files). CI also runs it before the live run (`flows-pipeline.yml` "Verify the pipeline runs against fixtures").
- Do not write comments into any `scripts/flows-legs/*.mjs` file (invariant 1). Explain thresholds and caps in the commit message.
