## Probes and GitHub Actions workflows

Commit `ba2acfe` (origin/main after PR 148; asset version 240, fonts token 230). Line numbers come from `grep -n` / `sed -n` on that tree. Scope: `scripts/flows-probe.mjs`, `scripts/flows-ws-probe.mjs`, the five files under `.github/workflows/`, plus the data file the REST probe is driven by (`scripts/flows-probe-list.json`, adjacent, listed because every probe change lands there).

### Purpose and boundaries

**What this area is.** The CI/automation shell of the repository. Five workflows are the only things that run on GitHub, and `.github/` holds nothing else (no dependabot, CODEOWNERS or templates):

| Workflow | Job in one line | Vendor key? | Ingest credential |
|---|---|---|---|
| `regression.yml` | Whole test battery (`npm test`, 77 chained scripts) + `wrangler deploy --dry-run` on push to main, every PR, dispatch and weekly | no | none |
| `flows-pipeline.yml` | The nightly Flows publish (`node scripts/flows-pipeline.mjs`), its fixture dry run, and the weekly `keepalive` job | `UW_API_KEY` | `FLOWS_INGEST_TOKEN` (shared secret, nightly kind) |
| `flows-live.yml` | The Tier 2 live loop (`node scripts/flows-pipeline.mjs --live`): a self-chaining, 340-minute, never-finished job that also dispatches the nightly and runs the witness | `UW_API_KEY` | none: a GitHub OIDC token minted per run |
| `flows-probe.yml` | Weekly strict schema/plan monitor of the Unusual Whales REST API (`scripts/flows-probe.mjs`) | `UW_API_KEY` | none |
| `flows-ws-probe.yml` | Dispatch-only entitlement/latency probe of the vendor WebSocket (`scripts/flows-ws-probe.mjs`) | `UW_API_KEY` | none |

**What it is not.** It does not contain the pipeline, the live leg, the witness, the nightly start logic or the health gate (those are `scripts/flows-pipeline.mjs` and `scripts/flows-legs/*`, other areas), nor the Worker side of the same loop (`shared/flows-live-worker.js` dispatches the same two workflows from Cloudflare crons; `worker.js` ingest route verifies the OIDC token via `shared/flows-oidc.js`). It does not deploy anything: there is no deploy workflow in this repository. Production deploys come from Cloudflare Workers Builds (AGENTS.md "External deployment state"); the only deploy-shaped CI step is `wrangler deploy --dry-run` in `regression.yml:38-39`.

**Neighbours.**
- Upstream callers: GitHub schedules (cron lines in four of the five files), the Worker crons (`wrangler.toml:26`), the live loop itself (self-dispatch and nightly dispatch), humans (`gh workflow run`).
- Downstream: `scripts/flows-pipeline.mjs` (`--dry-run`, plain, `--live`, with env `FLOWS_LIVE_DRILL`, `FLOWS_LIVE_LOOP`, `FLOWS_LIVE_KEEP`), `scripts/flows-legs/{live,watch,witness,starts}.mjs`, `shared/flows-oidc.js` (`actionsIdToken`), Worker `GET|POST|DELETE /api/flows/ingest` (`worker.js:3454`, `requireMethod` at 3456), `tests/package.json` (`npm test`).
- Contract coupling: `tests/flows-probe-contract.mjs` also reads `scripts/flows-pipeline.mjs` source text and two workflow files; `tests/flows-dossier-contract.mjs` reads `scripts/flows-probe-list.json`; `tests/flows-live-contract.mjs`, `tests/flows-starts-contract.mjs`, `tests/flows-pipeline-contract.mjs` regex over the workflow YAML text (see Invariants).

Common to all five: `actions/checkout@fbc6f3992d24b796d5a048ff273f7fcc4a7b6c09` and `actions/setup-node@a0853c24544627f65ddf259abe73b1d18a591444` (v5 tags, SHA-pinned), `node-version: 22`, `persist-credentials: false`. `regression.yml` additionally: `fetch-depth: 0`, `cache: npm`, `cache-dependency-path: tests/package-lock.json`.

**What the workflows do to the outside world.** Nightly: `POST`s its payload keys (boards, cards, scores, brief, meta, focus, archive rows, ...) to Worker `/api/flows/ingest?key=` with `Authorization: Bearer $FLOWS_INGEST_TOKEN` and `User-Agent: anilkaya-flows-pipeline/1 ...` (`flows-pipeline.mjs:90,121-128`, `publish` `:3049`, fetch method `POST` `:3072`); it also does single-key reads/lists through the same route (`readStored`). Live: same route, bearer = OIDC JWT, and `publish()` throws for any key not matching `^live:[a-z]+(?::[a-z]+)?$` (`:3050`); reads one key at a time (`clock`, `live:*`, `board:*`, `meta`, `focus`). GitHub API calls from the job: workflow dispatches (`POST /repos/<repo>/actions/workflows/<file>/dispatches`, 204 = sent, 15 s timeout, `live.mjs:393-408`), Issues (list/open/comment/close/reopen, `witness.mjs:194-244`), `gh api .../actions/runs/$GITHUB_RUN_ID`, and the keepalive `PUT .../enable`.

**Dispatch input contracts (422 trap).** `flows-live.yml` declares `tick`, `origin`, `drill`; `flows-pipeline.yml` declares `dry_run`, `allow_intraday`, `republish_session`, `origin` only. The loop's chain body is `{ref:"main", inputs:{tick, origin:"chain"}}` (`live.mjs:401`); the nightly dispatch from the loop sends only `{origin:"live-loop"}` (`starts.mjs:6-16`, `chainDispatch(..., inputs)`), and the Worker sends `{tick, origin:"worker"|"watchdog"}` to live and `{origin:"worker"}` to the nightly (`flows-live-worker.js:449,465,571`). Passing `tick` to the nightly would be answered 422.

**Budgets, caps, windows (actual numbers)**

| number | where | value |
|---|---|---|
| live job timeout | `flows-live.yml:66` | 355 min (GitHub cap 360) |
| loop budget | `LIVE_LOOP.budgetMs` `live.mjs:350` | 340 min; test requires budget + 10 min <= timeout |
| loop slot / idle tick / pre-open wait / open lag | `live.mjs:349-353` (`slotMs` 349, `budgetMs` 350, `preOpenWaitMs` 351, `openLagMs` 352, `idleMs` 353) | 5 min / 15 min / 240 min (non-keep only) / 60 s (wakes 09:31 ET) |
| chain retry delays | `live.mjs:354` | 15 s, 45 s |
| GitHub call deadline / clock-read deadline | `live.mjs:355-356` | 15 s / 10 s |
| nightly start (loop) | `starts.mjs:6-16` (`NIGHTLY`) | first at 17:30 ET (3 tries), retry at >=18:15 ET and >=30 min after the last, soft retries 6 until 20:30 ET for transient refusals, permanent refusals capped at 4 calls, never a third send |
| nightly job timeout / pipeline deadline | `flows-pipeline.yml:39` / `flows-pipeline.mjs:256` | 45 min / 36 min |
| Worker live dispatch | `freshness.js:392`, `LIVE_CLOCK` `:27-37` | weekdays, 09:30 to close+16 min, `minutes % 15 == 1`, skip for 10 min after a send unless done; watchdog after breadth is >45 min stale (once per 45 min) |
| Worker nightly dispatch | `freshness.js:419`, `PHASE_MINUTES` `:16-25` | trading day, >=17:15 ET (in practice the `*/30` housekeeping cron: 17:30 ET), once per day then once at >=18:15 if still not landed |
| witness | `witness.mjs:8-19` | stale lines 25 min (tier1) / 45 min (tier2), confirm 2/2/1/2(pending)/1/3, recover 3/3/1/1/3, renotify 6 h, reopen within 6 h, read deadline 10 s, list max 100 issues, author `github-actions[bot]` |
| probe volume | dry run, default tickers | 97 list probes -> 155 expanded probes + 1 `session:SPY` call = 156 calls per strict run; >=250 ms apart (>=39 s), per-call 30 s timeout; job cap 20 min |
| ws-probe worst case | `run` 183 | 3 handshakes (<=10 s each) + 11 channels x `seconds` + joins 4 x max(6, seconds/2) + connections (n=2..4, >=3 s settle, 8 s join timeout); at `seconds=60` all parts is about 14 min against a 15 min cap |
| keepalive | `flows-pipeline.yml:103` | acts on schedule events that fall on a New York Monday (four firings qualify: 21:30 and 22:30 UTC Monday, 01:17 and 03:47 UTC Tuesday) |

**Probe list schema (`scripts/flows-probe-list.json`).** `probes[]`: `{id, tier: used|1|2, op, path, query?, bind?}`; tokens `{t}` (per ticker, expands each probe once per ticker), `{tickers}` (CSV), `{date}`, `{date-Nd}`, `{next-session}`, `{weekly}`, `{monthly}`, `{monthly2}`; `bind: {name: {from, field, maxBy?}}` (value taken from an earlier probe's rows; probe is skipped, not called, when absent). `expect[op]`: names the OpenAPI spec (`docs/uw-openapi.yaml`) documents for the 200 response -> `unseen`/`undocumented` diff. `reads[op]`: names the code actually reads (strict mode fails with `DRIFT` when one does not arrive). `gated[op]`: HTTP 4xx the current plan is expected to answer: `/api/volatility/vix-term-structure` 403, `/api/companies/{ticker}/profile` 403, `/api/companies/{ticker}/earnings-estimates` 403, `/api/politician-portfolios/holders/{ticker}` 422. By tier: 49 probes / 38 ops `used`, 19 / 15 ops `1`, 29 / 26 ops `2` (test-held at `flows-probe-contract.mjs:27-29`; one tier per op, `:24`).

**Probe output formats.** REST probe prints human lines: `== <id>  [tier]  <status>  <ms> ms  <bytes>`, `GET <relative url>`, `limits ...`, `envelope ...  rows N at <where>`, `fields <set>  K keys over n of m sampled` then `key:type` tokens, `spec ...`, `sample {...}` (first row, up to 700 chars, **verbatim values**), then `== summary ...` and a final `== exit 0|1` line. The repository is public (DEPLOY.md, billing note), so the weekly strict run puts one sample row per probe into public logs. The WS probe prints one JSON object per line (`probe`: start / handshake-* / channel / concurrent-connections / joins-per-connection / done) with key names and numbers only.

**Exit codes.** `flows-probe`: 0 informational; 1 when nothing answered ok/empty (key, plan or network broken) or, in strict mode, any `FAIL`/`DRIFT`; 2 usage (bad flag/ticker/date, no key on a live run, filter matching nothing). `flows-ws-probe`: 2 without `UW_API_KEY`, else 0 whatever the vendor says (informational; the workflow only goes red if the script crashes).

**Not in D1 / DO / caches.** These workflows touch no D1 tables, Durable Objects or caches directly; D1 is reached only through the Worker ingest route. The only state they keep is GitHub's own (workflow enable flag, Issues titled `[flows-witness:<id>] ...`, run history).

### Flows

**1. Nightly (flows-pipeline.yml)**
```
trigger: cron 30 21 / 30 22 (Mon-Fri), 17 1 / 47 3 (Tue-Sat)   OR  workflow_dispatch(dry_run, allow_intraday, republish_session, origin)
   |                                                              (dispatchers: Worker nightlyTick (:554) {origin:"worker"} dispatch at flows-live-worker.js:571;
   |                                                               live loop {origin:"live-loop"} starts.mjs:6-16, live.mjs:393; humans)
   v concurrency group flows-pipeline (queue, never cancel)
build job (45 min):
  1 checkout (:41) -> setup-node 22 (:45)
  2 gate (:49-74): TZ=America/New_York %Z -> EDT|EST
       event != schedule                        -> run=true  ("Dispatched by: $ORIGIN")
       FIRED == '30 21 * * 1-5' and EDT          -> run=true
       FIRED == '30 22 * * 1-5' and EST          -> run=true
       FIRED == '17 1 * * 2-6' or '47 3 * * 2-6' -> run=true (backups; same-session gate makes them ~1 min refreshes)
       else                                      -> run=false (other zone's primary)
  3 dry run (:76-78): node scripts/flows-pipeline.mjs --dry-run         (runs whenever run=true)
  4 publish (:80-88) unless dispatch with dry_run: node scripts/flows-pipeline.mjs
       main() flows-pipeline.mjs:4675 -> resolveSessionDate (:937) -> intradayRefusal (:973, FLOWS_ALLOW_INTRADAY) -> sameSessionGate (:1756, FLOWS_REPUBLISH_SESSION)
       -> legs -> publish() (:3049) POST FLOWS_INGEST_URL?key=...  -> runHealthGate (:7085) -> process.exitCode=1 if health.failures (:7093)
keepalive job (parallel, schedule only, :90-115): on a New York Monday PUT .../workflows/{pipeline,live,probe,regression}.yml/enable; red unless all 204
```

**2. Live loop (flows-live.yml), what starts it and how it chains**
```
STARTERS (any of these may start a run; the flows-live concurrency group allows one running + one pending, a newer pending replaces an older one):
  a. 32 GitHub crons (flows-live.yml:20-51)               origin "schedule"   (measured: 6 runs delivered for 63 slots, 2026-09-23 to 09-25, none before 17:50 UTC, DEPLOY.md 10.0 item 1; backup only)
  b. Worker rthTick (cron 1-59/5 13-21 MON-FRI, wrangler.toml:26) -> liveDispatchDue (freshness.js:392)
        -> dispatchWorkflow flows-live.yml {tick, origin:"worker"}     (needs Worker secret GITHUB_DISPATCH_TOKEN, flows-live-worker.js:449)
     watchdog: liveStalled (freshness.js:410) -> {origin:"watchdog"}   (flows-live-worker.js:465)
  c. the previous loop at its 340-minute budget -> chainWithRetry(chainDispatch) {tick, origin:"chain"}  (pipeline :4668-4670, live.mjs:410/393)
  d. humans: gh workflow run flows-live.yml [-f origin=manual] [-f drill=true]

RUN (flows-live.yml job `live`, 355 min):
  if UW_API_KEY secret is empty -> notice only, job green, nothing else runs (:70-73)
  checkout (sparse: scripts, shared) -> setup-node -> "Say who dispatched" log (:88-109) -> `node scripts/flows-pipeline.mjs --live` (:121)
  flows-pipeline.mjs main() (:4675) -> LIVE_MODE -> runLiveMode (:4602):
     FLOWS_LIVE_DRILL=1            -> runWitnessDrill (:4579) -> witnessDrill (watch.mjs:83): open + comment + close one issue, exit
     missing UW_API_KEY or no credential source -> throw (refuses FLOWS_INGEST_TOKEN on purpose)
     FLOWS_LIVE_LOOP != 1 or FORCE -> one runLive pass (live.mjs:100)
     LOOP=1 + KEEP=1 (production) -> runLiveLoop (live.mjs:482) with watch = createWatch (watch.mjs:27) -> keepLoop (live.mjs:431):
        forever:  refresh clock (ingest GET key=clock, 10 s deadline; live.mjs:43)
                  liveWindow (live.mjs:15): run (09:30 .. close+25 min on a trading day) -> pass() = runLive (publishes live:* keys only)
                  watch.tick (watch.mjs:35): first tick opens the witness and clears the "chain" issue; reads live:market / live:focus (Tier 1 window: open to close+10 min),
                      live:breadth (Tier 2 window: open+45 min to close+25), meta (first tick; from 17:30 ET until landed; while a nightly issue is open);
                      evaluateTier1/Tier2/Nightly (witness.mjs:112/148/173) + probe check; nightly.step (starts.mjs:43, inside createNightlyStart :39) dispatches flows-pipeline.yml
                      {origin:"live-loop"} at 17:30 ET when meta still holds the previous session; witness.apply -> issues [flows-witness:<id>]
                  sleep to nextSlot (5 min if busy, 15 min idle); wakes at 09:31 ET sharp on the next session morning
                  if (wake - start) > 340 min -> chain({at}) -> exit "budget"; a refused chain raises the "chain" issue (watch.chainFailed)
  settle (:4635): liveRunVerdict (live.mjs:329) -> process.exitCode=1 if every pass dead, or budget exit with refused chain, or a confirmed witness lapse
```
Cooperation: the Worker's 17:30 ET nightly dispatch and the loop's 17:30 ET dispatch coincide; whichever lands second finds the session archived and is a ~1 minute same-session refresh of pulse, sector:premium and news (DEPLOY.md 10.5k).

**3. Weekly vendor probe (flows-probe.yml)**
```
cron 23 14 * * 0 (strict) | dispatch(tickers, filter, strict)
  checkout (full) -> setup-node -> env FLOWS_PROBE_* -> node scripts/flows-probe.mjs
  main (:848): parseArgs (:162, env) -> loadList (:237) -> runProbe (:742):
     expandProbes (:241) -> selectProbes (:273) -> session: --date | dry-run/undated -> sessionGuess (:121) | SPY candles call -> sessionFromCandles (:126)
     dateTokens (:97) -> finalizeProbe (:288) -> for each probe: bind values (pickBound :322) -> callVendor (:591, paced 250 ms, 429 retry) -> analyse (:532) -> renderBlock (:650)
     renderSummary (:697) -> exitCode (:718) -> strictVerdict (:724) when strict
  process.exitCode: 0 / 1 / 2 ; a red scheduled run emails the repository owner (the actor is the schedule owner)
```

**4. Socket probe (flows-ws-probe.yml)**: dispatch -> `run()` (`flows-ws-probe.mjs:183`) -> handshakes (query token, bearer, Origin) -> one `session()` per channel -> `holdConnections` 2..4 -> `session()` with 1/10/30/60 `price:<T>` joins -> `done`. Used to answer "may this key open the socket, join which channels, how far behind". The real-time rail's `RT_UPSTREAM` table (`shared/flows-rt.js:75`) names the vendor channels the hub would use (px `price:<T>` and `stock_screener`, fl `flow-alerts`, gx `gex:<T>`, mk `market_tide`/`net_flow:<T>`, nw `news`; the probe's `quotes:SPY`, `trading_halts`, `option_trades:SPY` and `interval_flow` channels have no topic); the WebSocket upstream is not implemented (AGENTS.md "Real-time rail").

**5. CI (regression.yml)**
```
push main | PR | dispatch | cron 17 6 * * 1
  checkout fetch-depth 0 -> setup-node 22 (npm cache keyed on tests/package-lock.json)
  cd tests; npm ci -> npx playwright install --with-deps chromium
  ./tests/node_modules/.bin/wrangler deploy --dry-run --outdir /tmp/anilkaya-worker-dry-run   (bundle + config validation, no deploy)
  cd tests; ASSET_DIFF_BASE=<PR base sha | push "before"> npm test   -> 77 scripts chained with && (first failure stops the run)
```
Position of the probe suites in `npm test` (`tests/package.json:9`): script 6 `test:flows-probe`, 7 `test:flows-ws-probe`; `test:pipeline` (5) runs `node ../scripts/flows-pipeline.mjs --dry-run && node flows-pipeline-contract.mjs`; `test:flows-live` is 40, `test:flows-starts` 42. CI leaves `FLOWS_TEST_SANDBOX` unset (the sandbox variable matters only for agent sessions).

### Invariants and traps

Held by tests (editing the YAML text in these ways breaks CI):

1. **Action pins.** Every `uses:` in every workflow must be exactly `actions/checkout@fbc6f3992d24b796d5a048ff273f7fcc4a7b6c09` or `actions/setup-node@a0853c24544627f65ddf259abe73b1d18a591444` (hard-coded at `tests/flows-pipeline-contract.mjs:3600`, applied to `fs.readdirSync(.github/workflows)` so a new file is covered too; the same loop also asserts `uses.length > 0`, so a workflow with no `uses:` step fails it). `flows-live-contract.mjs:762` also demands 40-hex pins; `flows-probe-contract.mjs:585-588` demands the probe's two actions be the pipeline's. `id-token: write` lets any step mint the live credential, which is why no moving tag is allowed. Bumping a pin means editing five YAMLs and `flows-pipeline-contract.mjs:3600`.
2. **No stored credential after checkout.** `persist-credentials: false` under every checkout; the regex at `flows-pipeline-contract.mjs:3604-3605` needs `with:` followed by 10-space-indented lines (indentation changes break it) and tolerates one `if:` line between `uses` and `with` (live uses it).
3. **`flows-live.yml` grants.** The `permissions:` block must read exactly `contents: read` / `id-token: write` / `actions: write` / `issues: write` followed by a blank line (regexes at `flows-live-contract.mjs:750-752` and `flows-starts-contract.mjs:34-36`). The file must not contain the strings `FLOWS_INGEST_TOKEN`, `FLOWS_LIVE_TOKEN` or `GITHUB_DISPATCH_TOKEN` (not even in a name), and no `secrets.*` other than `UW_API_KEY` and `FLOWS_INGEST_URL`. `FLOWS_LIVE_LOOP: "1"` and `FLOWS_LIVE_KEEP: "1"` (quoted) and `GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}` are regex-matched. The `LIVE_READY` expression is regex-matched verbatim.
4. **Exactly 32 live crons**, deep-equal to `hourly(5, 20, [17, 47])` all `* * 1-5` (GitHub weekdays 0 = Sunday), each line unique so `github.event.schedule` names one slot (`flows-live-contract.mjs:774`; the 7/8-landings-before-09:31 coverage proof at `:794-815` and the minute-by-minute simulation at `:~1843-1900` also depend on this set).
5. **Concurrency + timeout.** `group: ${{ inputs.drill && 'flows-live-drill' || 'flows-live' }}` / `cancel-in-progress: false`, `timeout-minutes < 360` and `LIVE_LOOP.budgetMs + 10 min <= timeout`. The drill must not share the loop's group: it would queue behind a 340-minute loop and be replaced by the next hop (`flows-starts-contract.mjs:42-47`).
6. **The "Say who dispatched this run" step** is sliced out of the YAML by its exact header text (`      - name: Say who dispatched this run` to `      - name: Read the live layer`) and executed under bash with a stub `gh` (`flows-live-contract.mjs:816-880`): keep exactly one `${{ github.event.schedule }}` (as `FIRED`), the line `cron that fired: '${FIRED:-none}'`, `GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}`, the `gh api "repos/$GITHUB_REPOSITORY/actions/runs/$GITHUB_RUN_ID" --jq .created_at` call, the messages `GitHub created this run at ...` / `The run's created_at could not be read ...`, and the `|| created=""` fallback after the `gh api` call (the step has no `exit 0`; the test's stub `gh` fails when `FAKE_CREATED` is empty and asserts the step still exits 0 and prints the "could not be read" line). Renaming either step name breaks the slice.
7. **`flows-pipeline.yml` schedule and gate.** crons deep-equal `["30 21 * * 1-5", "30 22 * * 1-5", "17 1 * * 2-6", "47 3 * * 2-6"]`; the gate step is extracted by its name `Resolve whether this firing is the intended one` and run under bash with `ZONE` forced (`flows-pipeline-contract.mjs:3503-3526`); the regexes `[ "$FIRED" = "<cron>" ] && [ "$ZONE" = "EDT|EST" ]` and `[ "$FIRED" = "..." ] || [ "$FIRED" = "..." ]` are parsed to prove, for every weekday 2026-2030 including DST switches, exactly one admitted firing lands 17:15-18:00 ET and all others are backups after 20:00 ET. `PIPELINE_CADENCE` (`flows-pipeline.mjs:209`) must mention "after the close" and "21:30 UTC". The gate keys on the cron STRING, never wall time, so a firing GitHub delivers hours late still runs once. `EVENT`/`FIRED` come through env, never interpolated into the script. `origin` input must keep the text "live-loop" in its description (`flows-starts-contract.mjs:53-54`) and the gate must proceed for a dispatch with `ORIGIN=live-loop` ("Dispatched by: live-loop").
8. **Keepalive.** `actions: write` appears exactly once in `flows-pipeline.yml`, on the `keepalive` job; that job has no `uses:` or checkout; `for wf in ...; do` must list exactly the workflow files that contain the text `cron:` (today `flows-pipeline.yml flows-live.yml flows-probe.yml regression.yml`; `flows-ws-probe.yml` has no cron and is correctly absent). Adding a cron to any workflow without adding it here fails `flows-pipeline-contract.mjs:3570-3585`. `build` keeps only `contents: read`; the nightly workflow must not gain `issues:`.
9. **Regression schedule.** `regression.yml` crons deep-equal `["17 6 * * 1"]` and `on` must keep `push: branches: [main]` and `pull_request:` (`flows-pipeline-contract.mjs:3590-3595`). The weekly run exists so a fixture date overtaken by the real clock fails within a week.
10. **Probe workflow.** crons deep-equal `["23 14 * * 0"]`; no `push`/`pull_request` in `on`; `FLOWS_PROBE_STRICT` expression regex-matched; `permissions:\n  contents: read\n`; `timeout-minutes: 20`; `node-version: 22`; inputs only via `env:`; the only `run:` line is `node scripts/flows-probe.mjs` (no `${{ }}` interpolated into shell) (`flows-probe-contract.mjs:571-597`).
11. **Probe parity with the pipeline.** `flows-probe-contract.mjs:135-157` greps `scripts/flows-pipeline.mjs` source: `const BASE = process.env.<NAME> || "<url>"` (line 84) must still match `BASE_ENV`/`DEFAULT_BASE`; the body of `async function uw(` (`:533`, read up to the first `\n}\n`) must still contain `Authorization: "Bearer " + process.env.UW_API_KEY`, `Accept: "application/json"`, no `User-Agent`, and `url.searchParams.append(k, String(item))` / `url.searchParams.set(k, String(v))`. Refactoring `uw()` breaks the probe test.
12. **Probe list invariants.** Counts of operations per tier (38/15/26); one tier per op; `reads` names must be documented in `expect` unless listed in `SEEN_OUTSIDE_SPEC` in the test (`last` for sector-etfs, `underlying_price` for etf-tide, `start_time` for spot-exposures, flow-alert `start_time end_time iv_start iv_end`, ETF holdings `type weight`); strict `reads` must cover every screener field in `shared/flows-live.js` `STRIP_FIELDS`, the tide fields (`timestamp net_call_premium net_put_premium net_volume`) on four tide ops, and the spot-gamma fields; the `gated` map is deep-equal asserted (`flows-probe-contract.mjs:528`); `tests/flows-dossier-contract.mjs:160-182` requires each `DOSSIER_READS` op (`shared/flows-dossier-vendor.js:14`) to appear in `probe.reads` and `expect`, be probed at tier `used`, and requires `profile` and `earnings-estimates` to be `gated` 403.
13. **WS probe safety.** Output never contains the token (raw or URL-encoded), only key names of payloads; channel record count equals `CHANNELS.length`; acks stop at the vendor cap (contract with a fake that speaks the protocol by hand).

Not held by any test (watch for these):

14. **Sparse checkout in the live job** (`flows-live.yml:79-81`: `scripts`, `shared`). Everything the `--live` path imports must live under those two directories. Today `flows-pipeline.mjs`, `scripts/flows-legs/*` and `shared/*` import only each other (checked: no `../assets`, `../docs` or `../worker` import). A new import of `assets/`, `docs/` or a root file in the pipeline or any module it reaches breaks Tier 2 in Actions and passes every local suite. The nightly and probe workflows check out the full tree.
15. **OIDC identity is hard-coded.** `shared/flows-oidc.js:3-18`: `workflowRef = anilkaya001/anilkaya.org/.github/workflows/flows-live.yml@refs/heads/main`, `ref refs/heads/main`, `repositoryId 1284743712`, `ownerId 107927045`, events `schedule`/`workflow_dispatch`, runner `github-hosted`, audience `https://anilkaya.org/api/flows/ingest#live`. Consequences: renaming or moving `flows-live.yml`, renaming/transferring the repository, dispatching the workflow from another branch (`gh workflow run --ref feature`), using a self-hosted runner, or turning the file into a reusable workflow makes the ingest route refuse the token (the Worker contract proves a `feature` ref is refused, `flows-worker-contract.mjs:1729-1730`). The nightly does not use OIDC.
16. **Workflow file names are also config.** `flows-live.yml` / `flows-pipeline.yml` appear in `wrangler.toml:53-54` (`FLOWS_LIVE_WORKFLOW`, `FLOWS_NIGHTLY_WORKFLOW`), Worker defaults (`flows-live-worker.js:449,465,571`), `LIVE_LOOP.workflow` (`live.mjs:357`), `NIGHTLY.workflow` (`starts.mjs:7`), `flows-pipeline.yml:108`, witness remedy text (`witness.mjs:50,58-59,288`), `health.mjs:29` and the fake world (`live-world-fake.mjs:22,98`, `live-day.mjs:33-34`).
17. **`UW_API_KEY` empty = green no-op.** Without the secret `flows-live` succeeds doing nothing (even a `drill` dispatch, because every real step is gated on `LIVE_READY`). `flows-probe` and `flows-ws-probe` instead fail (exit 2 / "UW_API_KEY is not set").
18. **The `tick` and `origin` inputs are informational.** `tick` is only logged; `origin` of `flows-pipeline.yml` is only echoed by the gate (it is not passed to the script); `FLOWS_LIVE_ORIGIN` is recorded by `runLive`.
19. **Dispatch from `GITHUB_TOKEN` works only for `workflow_dispatch`** (the documented exception to the no-recursion rule); the chain and the nightly start rely on it. Failure shows as `[flows-witness:chain]` or `nightly` issues. Do not swap the job token for a PAT: the issue author would no longer be `github-actions[bot]` and every hop becomes blind to its predecessor's issues.
20. **Strict probe goes red on vendor flakes.** In strict mode a 5xx, a network error or a 429 that survives three retries is a `FAIL`; only the four `gated` ops are forgiven, and only at exactly their status. An empty answer is not drift; a skipped bound probe is not a failure. Dates: the session falls back to `sessionGuess` (no holiday calendar), so after a market holiday `{date}` can name a non-session and dated probes return empty (informational, not a failure).
21. **Public log exposure.** The REST probe prints a verbatim first row per probe that returned rows (up to 156 per run, redacted for the key only). The WS probe was written to avoid values for the same reason.
22. **Run-time envelope of the ws-probe.** `seconds=60` with every part runs roughly 14 minutes of a 15-minute cap; use `only=` for long listens.
23. **Doc drift found in this pass (source wins).** (a) DEPLOY.md 10.5j and the probe contract message say "about 140 calls"; at this commit the dry run lists 155 probes plus the session call = 156. (b) AGENTS.md "Testing and CI" says CI runs "on pushes to main, on pull requests, and by manual dispatch"; `regression.yml:8-9` also has the Monday 06:17 UTC cron (DEPLOY.md 10.5j has it right). (c) AGENTS.md's file map has rows for neither `scripts/flows-probe.mjs`, `scripts/flows-probe-list.json` nor any workflow except the ws probe; this part file is the map for them. (d) DEPLOY.md 10.0 item 1 says the Worker dispatches the nightly "at 17:15 ET"; the code gates on >=17:15 ET but is only invoked by the `*/30` housekeeping cron (`worker.js:3978-3987`, `cronJob` `flows-live-worker.js:75`, `HOUSEKEEPING_CRON` `:72`), so the first possible Worker dispatch is 17:30 ET and the retry 18:30 ET. (e) AGENTS.md describes `--live --dry-run` as running "eight dry days"; `scripts/flows-legs/live-day.mjs` holds 13 `DRY_SCENARIOS`.
24. **Cost/terms note (DEPLOY.md 10.5k).** `FLOWS_LIVE_KEEP=1` keeps one runner busy 24/7 by design (five hops a day). Removing the line from `flows-live.yml` returns to the session-only loop with the 32 crons as the only starters; the witness, the loop's nightly start and the idle clock ticks go with it. Hosted minutes are free because the repository is public.

### How to change it

**Add or change a vendor route in the weekly probe**
1. Edit `scripts/flows-probe-list.json`: add to `probes` (id `[a-z0-9-]+`, unique; `tier` `used` if the code reads it, else `1`/`2`; `op` = the spec's path template; `path` using `{t}` for per-ticker; `query` values strings or string arrays; optional `bind` from an earlier probe), add `expect[op]` (documented 200-response names from `docs/uw-openapi.yaml`), add `reads[op]` if code reads fields, `gated[op]` if the plan refuses it (4xx).
2. Update the hard-coded counts in `tests/flows-probe-contract.mjs:27-29` (38 used / 15 tier-1 / 26 tier-2 ops), the `gated` deep-equal (`:528`), and the `✓ flows-probe` summary string (`:599`) if numbers change. If the route feeds the dossier, also add it to `VENDOR_ROUTES` (`shared/flows-dossier.js:380`) and `DOSSIER_READS` (`shared/flows-dossier-vendor.js:14`), plus a reducer, and run `tests/flows-dossier-contract.mjs`.
3. Cost: each `{t}` probe adds 2 calls/week at default tickers. No version bump (nothing under `assets/`).
4. Run: `cd tests && node flows-probe-contract.mjs && node flows-dossier-contract.mjs`; dry run `node scripts/flows-probe.mjs --dry-run --filter <id>` (no key needed, no network).

**Change probe behaviour** (date tokens, pacing, strictness)
- New date token: add the name to `DATE_TOKEN` (`flows-probe.mjs:40`) and `dateTokens` (`:97`), and note `fillTokens` (`:135`) handles `{date-Nd}` generically.
- Pace/retry: constants `flows-probe.mjs:15,18-20`; tests assert the 250 ms gap and Retry-After handling.
- Strict rules: `strictVerdict` (`:724`) and the exit lines (`:836-840`); tests in the strict block (`flows-probe-contract.mjs:~465-535`).
- Never print a value that could contain the key without passing `redact`; keep `emit` as the single output path (`:753`).

**Change the weekly schedule or inputs of the probe**: `flows-probe.yml:5` (and update the deep-equal at `flows-probe-contract.mjs:574-575`); keep inputs flowing through `env:` only.

**Add a channel or step to the socket probe**: `CHANNELS` / `JOIN_STEPS` / `CONNECTION_STEPS` (`flows-ws-probe.mjs:15,25,26`); update `tests/flows-ws-probe-contract.mjs` expectations (`joins.map(acksOk)` `[1,10,30,30]` with the fake's cap of 30, per-channel record count); make the fake vendor refuse/accept as needed; check the worst-case runtime vs `timeout-minutes: 15`.

**Change when the nightly runs**: `flows-pipeline.yml:5-8` and the gate branches (`:62-70`); then `tests/flows-pipeline-contract.mjs:3498-3560` (cron list, admitted pairs, five-year DST loop) and `PIPELINE_CADENCE` (`flows-pipeline.mjs:209`); the Worker/loop constants that must agree: `PHASE_MINUTES.nightlyAfter/nightlyRetry` (`shared/flows-freshness.js:16-25`) and `NIGHTLY` (`starts.mjs:6`); doc DEPLOY.md 10.5h/10.5k.

**Change the live starters or the loop budget**: crons `flows-live.yml:20-51` (keep 32 unique `M H * * 1-5`, M-minutes 17 mod 30); `LIVE_LOOP` (`live.mjs:348`); `timeout-minutes` (`:66`) must stay under 360 and >= budget + 10; Worker side `LIVE_CLOCK`/`liveDispatchDue` (`freshness.js:27,392`) and `RTH_CRON`/`FOCUS_CRON` (`flows-live-worker.js:70-73`, `wrangler.toml:26`, which must stay in sync as strings). Run `cd tests && node flows-live-contract.mjs && node flows-starts-contract.mjs && node flows-freshness-contract.mjs` (no server needed; `npm run test:flows-live`, `test:flows-starts`). Update DEPLOY.md 10.5i / 10.5k tables by hand.

**Change what the live job may do (permissions, secrets, env)**: edit `flows-live.yml:53-57,111-121`; the two regexes in `flows-live-contract.mjs:750-752` and `flows-starts-contract.mjs:34-45` encode the allowed set; adding a secret is deliberately blocked by test and by design (OIDC is the credential).

**Add a new scheduled workflow**: new file under `.github/workflows/` using only the two pinned actions, `contents: read` (grant more per job only), `persist-credentials: false`, Node 22, inputs via `env:`; add its filename to the keepalive `for wf in` list (`flows-pipeline.yml:108`) since the test derives the expected list from files containing `cron:`; if it needs a contract, add `test:<name>` to `tests/package.json` and append `npm run test:<name>` to the `test` chain (script 6/7 are the probes; the chain stops at the first failure so put cheap, no-server suites early); list it in AGENTS.md's "no server" list if it needs none. Off-the-hour minute numbers (`:17`, `:23`, `:47`) are used on purpose, away from GitHub's load peak.

**Bump the checkout / setup-node pin**: replace in all five YAMLs, in `tests/flows-pipeline-contract.mjs:3600`; the other tests only check shape (40-hex) or equality with the pipeline file. Dry-run still `./tests/node_modules/.bin/wrangler deploy --dry-run --outdir /tmp/x` is only config validation and is unaffected.

**Rename a workflow file or the repository**: update every item in trap 15/16 together (OIDC policy first, because renaming `flows-live.yml` invalidates live auth until the Worker is redeployed with the new `workflowRef`), then tests `flows-live-contract.mjs:1327-1337`, `flows-worker-contract.mjs:1729-1730,1902,1935`, `flows-starts-contract.mjs`.

**Change CI itself (`regression.yml`)**: keep `fetch-depth: 0` (the asset-version contract diffs against `ASSET_DIFF_BASE`, `tests/contracts.mjs:921-983`; on a push to a new branch `github.event.before` is all zeros and the test falls back to `HEAD^`), the 40-minute cap (suite total is long: server suites boot workerd; `flows-rt-server` alone is about 150 s), and the dry-run bundle step before `npm test`. A new suite goes in `tests/package.json`, not in the YAML. In an agent sandbox run server suites with `FLOWS_TEST_SANDBOX=1` (AGENTS.md); CI does not set it.

**Run something by hand**: `gh workflow run flows-probe.yml -f strict=true -f filter=profile -f tickers=NVDA`; `gh workflow run flows-ws-probe.yml -f seconds=12 -f only=channels`; `gh workflow run flows-live.yml -f drill=true` (proves the alert channel; needs `UW_API_KEY` set); `gh workflow run flows-pipeline.yml -f republish_session=true` or `-f origin=live-loop` (weekend dispatch is a same-session refresh); `gh workflow run flows-live.yml` restarts a broken chain and closes the `chain` issue on the next loop. Local: `node scripts/flows-probe.mjs --dry-run`, `node scripts/flows-pipeline.mjs --dry-run` and `--live --dry-run` (the latter runs `dryLiveTicks` and then the 13 virtual-clock scenarios of `scripts/flows-legs/live-day.mjs` `DRY_SCENARIOS` against the fake GitHub/Worker world; AGENTS.md says "eight dry days", the source now holds 13; it never touches the network); none of these needs a secret.

**Tests to run for any edit in this area** (no server needed unless noted): `node flows-probe-contract.mjs`, `node flows-ws-probe-contract.mjs`, `node flows-pipeline-contract.mjs` (about 123 s, covers every workflow-text assertion for the nightly, keepalive, regression and pins), `node flows-live-contract.mjs`, `node flows-starts-contract.mjs` (about 4 s), `node flows-dossier-contract.mjs` (probe list), and `node flows-worker-contract.mjs` (workerd, needs `FLOWS_TEST_SANDBOX=1` in the sandbox) when OIDC or Worker dispatch changes.

## Flows frontend core: ui, fresh, dock, cursor, board, history

Snapshot: commit `ba2acfe` (origin/main after PR #148), asset version `240`, fonts token `230`. Every line number below was taken with `Read`/`grep -n` on that tree. Every file in scope is comment-free (zero `//` or `/*` comments, checked by grep), so behaviour comes from code; AGENTS.md and DEPLOY.md were cross-checked and the disagreements are listed under "Invariants and traps".

### Purpose and boundaries

**What it is.** The shared browser foundation of the Flows section (`/flows/*`, gated by the Flows session cookie) plus the two route controllers that only this foundation serves:

| Piece | Role |
|---|---|
| `flows-ui.js` | The `window.FlowsUI` global: DOM builders (`h`, `s`, `glyph`), formatters (`F`), state vocabulary (`STATES`), info popover, metric/chip/list/module primitives, the SVG chart library (`FlowsUI.chart`), the **freshness pill** (`FlowsUI.freshness`), the **shell** (sidebar drawer, hero-title swap, Cmd/Ctrl-K name palette), and a **global `window.fetch` wrapper** that applies the 401/403 gate and feeds the pill. |
| `flows-fresh.js` | Adds `freshFrom`, `liveBody`, `heartbeatInterval`, `heartbeat` to FlowsUI by re-publishing a new frozen object. Loaded only on pages that poll (home, market, unusual, ticker). |
| `flows-dock.js` | The "Ask" side dock: tab button, `?` shortcut, lazy load of `flows-ask.js` + `flows-ask.css`. Emitted on every shell page except `/flows/ask/`. |
| `flows-cursor.js` | `window.FlowsCursor.attach(svg, spec)` crosshair/readout for SVG charts. **Orphaned**: no page emits it (see traps). |
| `flows-board.js` | Controller for `/flows/long/`, `/flows/short/`, `/flows/watch/`: ranked table, sort/filter, hero chips, sector treemap, live price overlay (poll + `FlowsUI.rt` stream). |
| `flows-history.js` | Controller for `/flows/history/`: track-record page (hit rate and long-minus-short spread with confidence intervals, per-session timeline, signal IC table). |
| `flows.css` | Design tokens, sidebar/topbar/tabbar/dock shell, every `ui-*` primitive, chart classes, popover, palette; plus a large dead legacy block. |
| `flows-boards.css` | Board table/map styling (`bd-*`). `flows-feeds.css`: unusual/events/political styling (`fd-*`, `fu-*`, `fe-*`, `pl-*`). |

**What it is not.** Not the HTML (emitted by `shared/flows-pages.js`, area 30), not the data (routes in `worker.js`, payload builders in areas 31/32), not the real-time rail (`flows-rt.js` attaches `FlowsUI.rt`, area 35), not the other page controllers (`flows-overview.js`, `flows-market.js`, `flows-ticker.js`, `flows-events.js`, `flows-unusual.js`, `flows-political.js`, `flows-track.js`, `flows-desk.js`, `flows-strategy.js`, `flows-ask.js`), which all consume FlowsUI. `flows-history.js` is styled by `assets/css/flows-record.css` (303 lines, not in this scope; classes `rc-*`, `rf-*`, `rt-*`, `rs-*`, `rec-*`).

**Neighbours and load order** (all `defer`, so execution order = document order; emitted by `shared/flows-pages.js`): `flows-dock.js` (inside `dock()` :185-198, before the others) then `flows-ui.js` (`UI_SCRIPT` :310) then `flows-fresh.js` (if the page has it) then `flows-rt.js` (if present) then the page controller. Stylesheets: `base.css` (:17), `flows.css` (:18), then the route sheet from the `styles` param (:19) of `head()` (:5-20). `sidePage`/`watchPage` (:452, :618) load `flows-boards.css` + `flows-ui.js` + `flows-rt.js` + `flows-board.js` and **no** `flows-fresh.js`; `historyPage` (:835) loads `flows-record.css` + `flows-ui.js` + `flows-history.js` (no fresh, no rt). Unusual/events/political load `flows-feeds.css` (`FEEDS_CSS` :683).

Page-to-file map (measured by rendering each page function):

| Page function | JS emitted (in order) | CSS emitted |
|---|---|---|
| `sidePage` (`/flows/long/`, `/flows/short/`), `watchPage` (`/flows/watch/`) | dock, ui, rt, board | base, flows, flows-boards |
| `historyPage` (`/flows/history/`) | dock, ui, history | base, flows, flows-record |
| `unusualPage` | dock, ui, fresh, rt, unusual | base, flows, flows-feeds |
| `eventsPage` / `politicalPage` | dock, ui, events / political | base, flows, flows-feeds |
| `overviewPage` / `marketPage` | dock, ui, fresh, rt, overview / market | base, flows, flows-home / flows-market |
| `tickerPage` | dock, ui, fresh, rt, quant-read bundle, ticker | base, flows, flows-ticker |
| `trackPage` | dock, ui, track | base, flows, flows-record |
| `deskPage` / `strategyPage` | dock, ui, quant bundle, desk / strategy | base, flows, flows-tools |
| `askPage` | ui, ask (no dock) | base, flows, flows-ask |
| `loginPage` | nav.js only | base, flows (body class `flows-body`) |

**CSS class prefixes** (to find the right sheet fast): `ui-` shared primitives (flows.css 1947-2612); `fx-` shell (sidebar `fx-side`, topbar `fx-bar`, tabs `fx-tabs`, search, scrim); `rail-` sidebar rows; `ak-dock-` the dock; `bd-` board (flows-boards.css), `fb-count`, `c-approach`, `c-toband`; `fd-` shared feed shell, `fu-` unusual, `fe-` events, `pl-` political (flows-feeds.css); `hm-`, `mk-`, `ft-`, `dk-`, `tl-`, `rec-`/`rc-`/`rf-`/`rt-`/`rs-` belong to other sheets (home, market, ticker, desk/strategy, record); state modifiers `is-*`, tone via `data-tone`, state via `data-state`, emptiness via `data-empty`.

**Response headers read**: `X-Payload-Updated` (ms epoch of the stored write; board :1326, history :713, pill `observe` :1761); `X-Fresh-State`, `X-Fresh-Stale-At`, `X-Server-Now` (board `getJson` :1327); the full `X-Fresh-*` set in `fromHeaders` (fresh.js:27-48); `cf-mitigated` and `content-type` on 403 (ui.js:1812-1813).

**Client storage**: none of the Lab `IEWTStorage` keys. Flows uses `sessionStorage["flows:gate"]` and the cookie `flows_gate=<ms>; Max-Age=600; Path=/flows; SameSite=Lax` (ui.js:1782-1790, both in try/catch; the server never reads this cookie). Board state lives in the URL only (`?sort=`, `?dir=`, `?view=map`; `history.replaceState` :535).

### Flows

**A. Boot of any Flows page**
1. `worker.js:3409-3427` (`FLOWS_ROUTES`) maps the route to a page function in `shared/flows-pages.js`; HTML links `base.css`, `flows.css`, route sheet, then deferred scripts in the order given above.
2. `flows-dock.js` runs first: binds tab, `?`, Esc; calls `setOpen(false,false)` (:96).
3. `flows-ui.js` runs: builds constants, formatters, then installs the `window.fetch` wrapper (:1817-1828), publishes `window.FlowsUI` (:2018), and calls `initShell()` (:2036; `readyState` is not `loading` for deferred scripts).
4. `initShell` (:1914): drawer, hero observer, title mirror, search triggers, pill click, 800 ms `/api/flows/meta` fallback, 6 s settle, 30 s repaint.
5. `flows-fresh.js` (if present) re-publishes FlowsUI; `flows-rt.js` re-publishes again with `rt`; the controller reads `window.FlowsUI` last.

**B. Freshness pill**
1. A controller calls `UI.freshness({sessionDate, generatedAt, updatedAt, source[, primary]})` :1722, or `({readAt, live:true, source})` for a price read, or `({ff, source})` for a server verdict.
2. `freshness()` updates `FRESH` (newest session wins unless a `primary` source set one; `sources` map; `ffs` map; `readAt/live`) and calls `paintFresh()` :1706.
3. `freshState()` :1664: `m = market()`; `S = primary || sessionDate || nightly`; `behind = S < m.expected`; if the expectation is only the local guess, `confirmExpected()` asks `/api/flows/now` once (60 s throttle, skipped while a keyed heartbeat answered within 390 s) and `behind` is held false while pending; state is `stale` if behind or any registered `ff` is stale; else `live` (a live read < 3 min old and market open), `fresh` (open), `closed`, or `pending` before anything settles.
4. `paintFresh` writes the label (`Live`, `Stale`, `Today`, a day like `Sep 24`, `Session`, `Closed`, `Open`), glyph (from `STATES`) and a11y name; it is a no-op when state, label and `data-feed` are unchanged.
5. Other inputs: the fetch wrapper (`/api/flows/now` responses mirror into `SRV`; `/api/flows/meta` sets `FRESH.nightly`; `observe` dates unannotated pages); `heartbeat` registers one `ff` per key (fresh.js:152); `flows-rt.js` registers `rt:<topic>` entries and calls `freshness.transport(label)` / `freshness.drop(source)`; a 30 s interval repaints so time alone can turn the pill stale.
6. Click: `openInfo(fresh, freshDetails())` :1995 shows lead sentence, `Expected/Market/Built/Written/Price read/Feed/Payloads` facts and the older-payload list.

**C. Board lifecycle** (`flows-board.js`)
1. IIFE guards :4-25 then `render()` :1551 to :1463: status "Loading...", `aria-busy` on the body, `Promise.all([board, scoretrack(watch only), ideas(side only)])` through `getJson` :1318.
2. If `payload.rows` is empty, `scored > 0`, the payload is not pending and (on the watch page) `neutral === 0`: quiet silence (`showSilence` :1214) with `UI.staleness` banner and return (:1483-1501).
3. If pending or empty: unreadable/pending/unavailable silence (:1503-1520) and return.
4. Else: `clearSilence`; `railCount`; `UI.freshness(...source:"board")` :1479; ideas joined by ticker when sessions match; `st.horizon`, `st.knowsDeep`, `st.hasIdea`; `mem.rows = memoryState(rows)`; `readMemoryBlock`; `edgeOrder` for watch; `readUrl` then `writeUrl`; `buildHeader` (segmented List/Map on side boards), `buildTools`, status sentence, `paintHead`, `paintRows(false)`, `paintHero`, `setView`, `setStale(UI.staleness(...))`, then `loadExtras()` :1357.
5. `loadExtras`: side boards fetch `scoretrack` (then `refresh(["strip"])`) and `universe` (then `buildSortOptions` and `refresh(["vrpP","siP"])`); then `getJson("/api/flows/lk?k=strips").then(takeLive)` and `streamPrices()` :1458.
6. `takeLive(live)` :1400 (polled body or `UI.rt.strips()` frame): ignore a polled body while the stream feeds `px` (re-poll 60 s); require `live.session > payload.sessionDate`; register `UI.freshness({ff:{stateAt}, source:"strips"})`; if the verdict has lapsed restore every held row (`Object.assign(row, was)`) and re-poll in 60 s; otherwise copy `px` and `chg` into rows (remember originals in `held`, set `__live`, `__streamed`), re-poll at `max(60, cadenceS||300)` seconds capped to the stale line, register `readAt`, `refresh(["t","px"], true, touched)` (updates only the price cell and the name's aria-label), flash for streamed ticks.
7. User actions: header buttons `toggleSort` :572, select `setSort` :561, search input `paintRows(false)`, Map/List `setView` :975 (map mounts `UI.chart.mount(plot, drawMap)` on first use :1206), Clear button, info buttons through `UI.info`.

**D. History lifecycle** (`flows-history.js`)
1. Guards :4-14; fetch `/api/flows/record` :709; build `rows = horizonRows(payload.horizons)`, `sessions = sessionRows(payload.sessions)`, `meta`.
2. `UI.freshness({... source:"record"})` :725; `statusSaid` -> `#recStatus`; `wireAbout`; `staleSaid` -> `#recHeadState` stale button.
3. `app.replaceChildren(chips, hit card, spread card, sessions card, signals card)` :734; `paintHit`/`paintSpread` (:739-740) fill the chart hosts after insertion (`ciChart` via `UI.chart.mount`).
4. Sessions card: `timeline` draws in `requestAnimationFrame` :604, `pick(i)` renders `sessionDetail` which lazily loads `scoretrack` and redraws that session's board names.

**E. 401 / 403 gate** (ui.js:1781-1828)
1. Wrapper sees an `/api/flows/*` response. 401: if the last redirect was < 10 min ago (`gateAt()` from sessionStorage, else the `flows_gate` cookie) show `#fxGate` ("Signed out, sign in", link `/flows/login/`, hides `#fxFresh`); otherwise record the time and `location.replace("/flows/")`. Either way the caller gets a promise that never resolves (`HANG`), and from then on every `/api/flows/*` call returns `HANG` while the gate is `out`.
2. 403 with `cf-mitigated` or a non-JSON body and no gate: show `#fxGate[data-state=off]` ("Unavailable") with the edge reason in the popover; a later OK response clears it (`showGate(null)`).
3. Board `getJson` :1320 and history :711 contain their own 401 redirect, unreachable while the wrapper is installed.

**F. Info popover**: `UI.info(build)` stores the builder and returns an id -> button carries `data-info`; document click :400 -> `openInfo` :378 builds content, sets `anchor-name`, `showPopover`; outside pointerdown or Escape -> `closeInfo`; the `toggle` handler restores focus to the trigger.

**G. Chart mount**: `UI.chart.line(host, o)` -> `mount(host, draw)` :699 (releases old listeners, adds `.ui-chart`, hidden width probe, `ResizeObserver`) -> RO callback sets width -> `repaint` :686 (skips when width unchanged) -> `draw(host, w, animate && moving())` -> `svgRoot` + elements + `scrub` :814. `handle.redraw()` forces repaint; `handle.destroy()` aborts listeners and empties the host.

**H. Dock**: tab click or `?` -> `setOpen(true,true)` :53 -> `ensureRenderer()` (first time: stylesheet + script) -> script `onload` focuses `#askQ` if still open.

**I. Palette**: `#fxSearch` click, `[data-fx-search]` click, or Cmd/Ctrl-K -> `closeDrawer(false)` + `openPalette()` :1870 -> `paletteRows()` fetches boards/scoretrack/roster once -> typed query ranks and lists up to 40 -> Enter or click navigates to `/flows/ticker/?t=`.

### Invariants and traps

1. **Weight ceilings are almost exhausted.** `tests/flows-weight.mjs:12-27` (`CEILING_KIB`) caps the uncompressed bytes of all `<script src>` per route; measured at this commit (bytes spare to the ceiling): unusual 163, desk 173, side/watch 190, events 241, history 277, political 365, market 503, overview 609, track 727, ask 903, ticker 924, strategy 938. `flows-ui.js` (107,833 B) and `flows-dock.js` (3,007 B) are on every route above except ask (no dock), so a single 200-byte addition to `flows-ui.js` breaks `flows-weight` on unusual, desk and the boards at once. Fix by moving code out, or by raising a ceiling deliberately (the test says raising must look like a decision in the diff).
2. **Sign rule (`tests/flows-sign.mjs`)**: no ternary whose test compares with zero as `< 0 ?`, `<= 0 ?`, `> 0 ?` or `>= 0 ?` (the scan regex is `(?:<=?|>=?)\s*0\s*\?`) followed within 260 chars by both a positive marker (`"+"`, `is-pos`, `"pos"`, `is-up`) and a negative marker (`MINUS`, `is-neg`, `"neg"`, `is-down`) unless it also has a flat arm (`is-zero/is-flat/is-neutral`) or two zero compares. Applies to every `assets/js/flows-*.js`, no allow-list. The `tone` helper line (ui.js:262) is parsed by the test as `const tone = ...;` on one line containing `num(v) === null ? "flat"` and arms `"up" "down" "flat"`; keep it single-line. The test also needs at least 5 neutral CSS rules (`.x.is-flat {}` or `[data-tone="flat"]`) across `flows*.css` and none may use `--up/--down/--flow-up/--flow-down/--up-mark/--down-mark`; there are 7 now and one (`.fm-rank.is-flat`) lives in the dead legacy block. Every `data-tone` literal the ticker emits needs a `[data-tone="x"] { --tone: }` rule (flows.css 2029-2035).
3. **`SHAPES` format** (ui.js:1526-1550) is parsed by `flows-payload-shape.mjs:673-674` with `/^\s*"([a-z ]+)":/gm`: keys stay quoted, lowercase, one per line, more than 10 of them, and an `ideas` row's `structure` (pipeline) must be one of them.
4. **Function names in `flows-board.js` are pinned** by `flows-payload-shape.mjs:75-82`: `render`, `sideHero`, `sideStatus`, `readMemoryBlock`, `statusFacts`, `watchHero`, `watchStatus`, `takeTrack` must remain `function name(` at two-space indent (scope ends at the next `\n  function `), reading the payload through variables named `payload`, `p`, `track`. Every root field read through those names must exist in the pipeline's emitted payload (or be self-assigned, or a `__x` annotation). The board must keep the strings `/api/flows/ideas` and `ideas.sessionDate === payload.sessionDate` (payload-shape:684-685). For `flows-history.js` the **whole file** is scanned (`payload.<field>`, `fn: null`, line :41): adding a `payload.newField` read without publishing it in the `record` payload (shared/flows-record.js, area 32) fails the suite; renaming `payload` makes the scan vacuous and fails its binding check.
5. **FlowsUI is frozen and re-published.** `flows-fresh.js:175` and `flows-rt.js:911` each assign a NEW frozen object (`Object.assign({}, old, extras)`). A module that copies `window.FlowsUI` before they run misses `freshFrom`/`heartbeat`/`rt`; this is why script order matters and why `pendingNow` reads `window.FlowsUI.heartbeat` lazily (ui.js:1636). `freshness` is a shared function object, so its sub-methods survive. Keep the pattern when adding a helper file (`flows-live-contract:1150-1161` proves it against a frozen object).
6. **Global fetch monkeypatch** (ui.js:1817-1828) applies only to URLs containing `/api/flows/` (it does not cover `/api/rt/*`). On 401 the returned promise never settles; anything awaiting it simply stops, so code after a 401 must not be relied on for cleanup. A `Request` object input works (`input.url`).
7. **Tests execute these files outside a browser.** `flows-freshness-contract.mjs:340-364` runs `flows-ui.js` in a `vm` with a stub `document` offering only `addEventListener`, `removeEventListener`, `getElementById` (null), `querySelector` (null), `documentElement`, `hidden`, plus `matchMedia`, `fetch`, `URL`, `AbortController`, timers; `flows-live-contract:1141-1146` and `flows-rt-contract:134-140` run `flows-fresh.js` with an even smaller context (`window.FlowsUI = {}`, `Date`, timers; live-contract gives `document` only `hidden`, `addEventListener` and `removeEventListener`, rt-contract gives it `hidden` alone plus `console`, so `heartbeat()` cannot run there). So: top-level code in `flows-ui.js` must not require `document.body`, `document.styleSheets`, `createElement`, etc. before `initShell` bails (it returns when `#fxBar` is absent); `flows-fresh.js` stays ES5 (`var`, no `??`, no arrow functions), uses `AbortController` and never `AbortSignal.timeout` (asserted at live-contract:1280; Safari < 16), and must tolerate being loaded into a bare `FlowsUI`.
8. **`flows.css` contracts (`tests/contracts.mjs`)**: the `--font-text` value is regex-pinned (:1049), `--font-figure` and `--font-ui` must resolve through it (:1052, :1055), flows.css must never contain `var(--font-mono)` or `var(--font-serif)` (:1059, :1062); no file `assets/js/flows-*.js` may contain the character `σ` (loop :1066-1075); the document-key scan (:1119-1155; its failure text still says "flows-dock.js's header", a header comment that was removed in #116) requires `flows-dock.js` to contain `document.addEventListener("keydown"` and fails if any OTHER file with a literal `document.addEventListener("key…` also tests `.key === "<single printable>"` while sharing a document with the dock (flows-ui.js dodges the regex only because it registers through `onDoc(...)` :157; do not "tidy" that into a literal `document.addEventListener("keydown"` next to a bare-key test).
9. **Route sheets use tokens only**: `flows-boards.css` and `flows-feeds.css` contain zero hex or `rgba(` literals (the ticker contract enforces this for the ticker sheet, :1525). Any `ui-*` class a ticker module emits must have a rule in flows.css (`flows-ticker-contract:1522-1524`), so deleting a `.ui-*` rule can break that suite.
10. **Version rule.** Anything under `assets/css|js|data` changed means `assets/version.txt` must increase (`contracts.mjs:927-975`) and `ASSET_VERSION` in `shared/flows-pages.js:1` must equal it (`flows-features.mjs:846-849`). `flows.css:11` carries `atmosphere.svg?v=240`; `contracts.mjs:344` only scans `css|js|woff2` references in lab/articles/index/404/base.css, so nothing asserts that token, but PR #148 moved it with the bump. The font token (`assets/fonts-version.txt`) must NOT move on an asset bump (AGENTS.md grep ritual).
11. **Dead and orphaned code** (verified by whole-repo grep): `assets/js/flows-cursor.js` (no page emits it; only `scripts/render-preview.mjs:119,131,192` names it; `flows-ticker-contract:236` asserts the ticker page does not link it; `window.FlowsCursor` is a global missing from AGENTS.md's allowlist; its CSS is flows.css 1197-1247); `.flows-body[data-theme="light"]` (flows.css 165-194, nothing in the repo sets `data-theme`; pages declare `<meta name="color-scheme" content="dark">`); the legacy class block listed in the CSS map; `neuronMark()` in shared/flows-pages.js:200 (never called) which is the only emitter of `.ak-nn*`; `--n` set on `#bdTable` (board :616) is read by no table rule; board classes `bd-hl` and `c-faded` have no CSS rule; `CHARTS` (ui.js:674) is written but never iterated. Deleting any of these needs the sign and ticker tests re-read (`.fm-rank.is-flat` counts toward the 5-rule minimum) and an asset-version bump.
12. **Duplicated logic**: stale thresholds (30 h / 4 days) exist in `flows-ui.js:29-30` AND `flows-history.js:17-18` with a differently worded message; `isNum`, `signed`, `pct` in history are local copies with different edge behaviour (history `isNum` is `Number(v)` after rejecting `null/undefined/""`, so `isNum(" ")` is 0 and `isNum(true)` is 1, where `FlowsUI.isNum` gives null for both; `FlowsUI.num` accepts only real finite numbers).
13. **`h()` vs `s()`**: `h` drops `false`; `s` writes `false` as the string `"false"`; both treat `class` differently (`h` uses `className`, `s` uses `setAttribute("class")` so on SVG elements pass `class` through `s`, and `style` objects are applied with `style.setProperty`). `glyph()` renders nothing (silently) if the symbol id is missing from the page sprite; sector glyphs exist only on board pages.
14. **Info registry eviction**: once `INFO` holds more than 600 builders, `info()` deletes every id except the one it is returning that is not currently referenced by a `[data-info]` node, so builders registered earlier for buttons not yet attached are lost (ui.js:311-314; the new id is spared by `k !== id`). Build-and-attach in the same tick when creating many.
15. **Dock sizing mismatch**: at >= 60rem `body.has-dock-open > .flows-main` reserves `min(30rem, 92vw)` + gutter (flows.css:1345, i.e. 480 px) while the panel is `min(420px, 100vw)` (:1891). The 60 px difference is intentional or not, it is real; change both together. `flows-dock.js` itself carries no comment; the claim that `?` is free on dock routes lives only in the `contracts.mjs` failure text: any new bare-key shortcut on a dock page conflicts (scan above).
16. **Docs vs source**: AGENTS.md's file map lists none of `flows-dock.js`, `flows-cursor.js`, `flows-board.js`, `flows-history.js`, `flows-ui.js` (only mentioned in prose), `flows.css`, `flows-boards.css`, `flows-feeds.css`; AGENTS.md "Design and accessibility invariants" says tokens live in `base.css` and typography is Latin Modern, which is true of the Lab; Flows pages set their own tokens in `flows.css` (system SF stack, Inter fallback) and use `base.css` only for legacy aliases (`--bg --ink --space-* --measure --pad --ease`, `.visually-hidden`, `.topbar`, `.btn--gold`). DEPLOY.md §10 pill text ("the page pill dates itself by `/api/flows/now` `expected`; the weekday fallback uses 21:00 ET and asks the server before showing a stale it computed alone", "worst case over sources that carry a server verdict", "board live dots timed against `X-Server-Now`") matches ui.js:1620-1623, 1641-1677 and board :1409-1419.
17. **Pill semantics that tests pin** (flows-freshness-contract:331-570): expected session flips at exactly 21:00 ET (`mins >= 1260`, ui.js:1621); a keyed heartbeat suppresses the pill's own `/now` for 390 s; the pill asks the server at most once per 60 s and again only when the local calendar moves on; a `primary` source dates the page over newer non-primary ones; sources that only carry a session date can never turn the pill stale on their own (they list as "N of M payloads are older"); reader-facing names collapse `board?side=*`, `lk?k=market`, `live:` prefixes (`named` :1658); the lead sentence for stale-by-lapse reads `Past the server's stale line: A, B.` with U+2019.
18. **Reduced motion has two halves**: JS `moving()` gates view-transitions, roll, FLIP and chart animation; CSS zeroes every `--dur-*` except `--dur-fade`, which becomes 120ms (flows.css:196-216), and zeroes `--stagger`, `--rise`, `--word`, `--lift`, `--decor`. `flows-motion.mjs` asserts a board row neither lifts on hover nor receives a `transform` when motion is reduced; keep `.bd-row.is-flip` transition removable (flows-boards.css:472-474).
19. **Accessibility invariants the tests hold**: 44 px touch targets via `::after` hit areas (`.ui-info`, `.ui-state`, `.bd-hs`, `.fu-toggle`, `.fd-pill`), inputs `font-size: 16px` on coarse pointers (flows.css:1375-1379, boards 87/107), no horizontal overflow at 320 px on all gated routes (`flows-motion`), board header buttons carry `aria-sort`, board rows are one anchor across the row via `.bd-open::after { inset: 0 }`.
20. **Comment rule**: all nine files are comment-free; new code must stay so (reasoning goes in the commit message).

## Flows frontend: overview, market, events, political

Snapshot: commit `ba2acfe` (origin/main after PR #148), asset version `240`, fonts token `230`. Every line number below was taken from `grep -n` / `sed -n` / `Read` on the files at that commit. All seven in-scope files were read in full.

### Purpose and boundaries

**What this area is.** Four page controllers and three route stylesheets of the members-only Flows section (options-flow intelligence behind the `flows_session` cookie). Each controller is one vanilla IIFE with no imports and no module system. It captures `window.FlowsUI` once at start, fetches JSON from `/api/flows/*`, and builds DOM exclusively with `FlowsUI.h()` / `FlowsUI.s()` / `FlowsUI.chart.*` (no `innerHTML`, no `insertAdjacentHTML`, no `eval`, no browser storage, no `setInterval`; verified by grep). Every user-visible sentence that is longer than a label lives behind a `(i)` disclosure (`UI.info`) or a `title`/`aria-label`.

| Route (HTML) | Page fn (`shared/flows-pages.js`) | Controller | Stylesheet(s) after `base.css` + `flows.css` | Scripts emitted, in order |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `/flows/` Home ("Session") | `overviewPage` :363 | `assets/js/flows-overview.js` | `flows-home.css` | dock, `flows-ui.js`, `flows-fresh.js`, `flows-rt.js`, `flows-overview.js` |
| `/flows/market/` | `marketPage` :639 | `assets/js/flows-market.js` | `flows-market.css` | dock, ui, fresh, rt, market |
| `/flows/events/` | `eventsPage` :697 | `assets/js/flows-events.js` | `flows-feeds.css` (not `flows-record.css`) | dock, ui, events (no fresh, no rt) |
| `/flows/political/` | `politicalPage` :863 | `assets/js/flows-political.js` | `flows-feeds.css` (not `flows-record.css`) | dock, ui, political (no fresh, no rt) |

**What it is NOT (neighbours that own the rest).**
- Server HTML shell, nav, glyph sprite, module markup, script/style ordering, `ASSET_VERSION`: `shared/flows-pages.js` (other area). The controllers hard-depend on the element IDs it emits (listed under Per-page anatomy).
- Shared UI library `assets/js/flows-ui.js` (2037 lines, defines `window.FlowsUI`: `h`, `s`, `F`, `chart.*`, `info`, `freshness`, `staleness`, global `fetch` wrapper, 401/403 gate, shell): other area. `assets/js/flows-fresh.js` (176 lines: `heartbeat`, `freshFrom`, `liveBody`) and `assets/js/flows-rt.js` (912 lines: `FlowsUI.rt`): other areas. All three replace `window.FlowsUI` with a new frozen object, so script order in the page matters.
- Other controllers: `flows-board.js` (long/short/watch), `flows-ticker.js`, `flows-unusual.js`, `flows-track.js`, `flows-history.js`, `flows-desk.js`, `flows-strategy.js`, `flows-ask.js`.
- Producers of every payload the pages read: `scripts/flows-pipeline.mjs` (nightly `publish(key, payload)` :3049), `shared/flows-{market,events,political,scores,regime,pulse,focus,catalysts}.js`, the live layer (`shared/flows-live*.js`, Actions `--live` leg), the Pulse rail (`shared/flows-rt*.js`). The Worker routes that serve them: `worker.js` :3601-3718 (this area only consumes).

**Correction to the area brief: `assets/css/flows-record.css` is not used by any of the four controllers.** It is the stylesheet of the Track page (`trackPage` :724 -> `flows-track.js`, classes `st-*`, `sc-*`) and the History page (`historyPage` :835 -> `flows-history.js`, classes `rec-*`, `rc-*`, `rt-*`, `rs-*`, `rf-*`). Verified: none of the four in-scope JS files emits a class with any of those prefixes, and no HTML but `trackPage`/`historyPage` links it. The events and political pages are styled by `assets/css/flows-feeds.css` (527 lines, classes `fd-*` shell, `fu-*` shared list/chart bits also used by Unusual, `fe-*` events, `pl-*` political), which is NOT in this area's file list; its structure is outlined in the File table notes.

**Doc vs source.** `AGENTS.md` has no file-map rows for any of these seven files (only their test suites are named, in its server/no-server lists at lines 843-844 and 1007-1011, and `DEPLOY.md` never names these files; it touches the pages only through the Home heartbeat/focus and pill semantics at ~:1971 and ~:2364-2370, the events calendar's purpose in section 10.5e (`/flows/events/`, :1521-1606) and the rail's browser half at ~:3028-3047); those test classifications match the source (`startWorker(` present in overview, market, political-render; absent in events, political, record). `AGENTS.md` says the rt rail client is on "the boards, the home page, the market page, the unusual page and the ticker": the source agrees, and events/political do NOT load `flows-rt.js` or `flows-fresh.js`, so they never heartbeat or stream.

### Symbol index

Conventions used by all four controllers: `h(tag, attrs, ...kids)` skips `null`/`false` attrs, maps `class`, `text`, `style` (object -> `style.setProperty`, so custom properties and kebab-case names only), `onX` listeners; children are flattened 4 deep and strings become text nodes (`flows-ui.js` :159-177). `glyph(name)` draws `<use href="#g-name">` from the sprite in `shared/flows-pages.js` :21-65; an unknown name draws nothing. `UI.info(build)` registers a lazy builder under id `iN` (map pruned past 600 entries to the ids still present as `[data-info]`, `flows-ui.js` :308-316) and returns the id for `data-info`; builder returns `{title, lead, facts[[k,v]], notes[], sections[{title,lines}], node, state, asOf}`.

Home endpoints at load (13 requests, 2127-2129): `GET /api/flows/board?side=long`, `board?side=short`, `lk?k=market,vol,breadth,strips,strips:series,focus` (one envelope), and `/api/flows/` + `board?side=watch`, `market`, `flowalerts`, `events`, `scoretrack`, `sector-premium`, `news`, `pulse`, `regime` (404 -> pending), `focus`. Every request: `credentials: same-origin`, `Accept: application/json`, 15 s abort, failure -> `null`.
Home heartbeat: `UI.heartbeat({keys:["market","breadth","strips","focus","news"], nightly:["pulse","focus"], page:"overview"})` -> `GET /api/flows/now?k=market,breadth,strips,focus,news&n=pulse,focus`. `onChange(changed)` regex-routes the changed ids (`strips`, `^focus` nightly, `:focus` live, `market`, `breadth`, `pulse`, `news`) to refetches of `/api/flows/focus`, `/pulse`, `/news` and `lk?k=<changed live keys>` (adds `strips:series` with `strips`). `onBeat` re-renders time-based pills. rt: `connect({topics:["px","mk","nw"]})`; `px` -> `FOCUS.strips = UI.rt.strips()`, first frame `paintFocus()` then `patchFocus(ids)`; `mk` -> `S.liveMkt = UI.rt.market(S.liveMkt)` + `hero()`; `nw` -> `mergeNews` + `paintNews`. A polled `strips` read does not overwrite a streamed one while `UI.rt.feeds("px")` is true (2113).
Home freshness wiring: every single-resource REST read goes through `stampUpdated` (registers its `X-Fresh-*` verdict under `source = url after "flows/"`, except overlay responses); the multi-key `lk` envelope read (`loadLive` with 2+ keys, :2032) bypasses it and each key's `__ff` comes from `UI.liveBody` instead (the heartbeat separately registers every `/now` key under `source = key`, `flows-fresh.js` :152); boards also register `{sessionDate, generatedAt, updatedAt, source:"boards"}` (2213); a live tide registers `{readAt, live:true, source:"live:market"}` (1003); staleness notes use `UI.staleness` (30 h write age, or session > 4 days old) -> `#flowsStale`, `#hmStale` pill, `body.is-stale`.

Market endpoints (9 requests, 1452-1461): `market`, `sectors`, `movers`, `pulse`, `board?side=long`, `board?side=short`, `regime` (soon), `universe` (soon), `lk?k=market,breadth,vol`. No timeout. Heartbeat `UI.heartbeat({keys:["market","breadth"], nightly:["pulse"], page:"market"})`: `onChange` only reacts to `live:market` / `live:breadth` (re-reads them and repaints sector tides, expiry, ETFs, tide); a changed nightly `pulse` is registered with the pill but triggers no repaint (page reload needed). rt: `connect({topics:["mk"]})`; on `mk` replaces `live` with `UI.rt.market(live)` and repaints ETFs and tide. Freshness: `UI.freshness({sessionDate, generatedAt, updatedAt: X-Payload-Updated, source:"market"})`; `UI.staleness(m, ..., {subject:"This market level"})`; individual cards add dated/stale marks (`staleMark`) against `UI.freshness.market().expected`.

**Events `/flows/events/`**: modules `#evWeekCard/#evWeek`, `#evEarnCard/#evEarn`, `#evMacroCard/#evMacro`, `#evFdaCard/#evFda`, `#evReactCard/#evReact`, chips `#evChips`, header `#evMeta`, `#evAboutSlot`, `#evAbout` (hidden source of the About disclosure), `#evStatus`. Endpoints: `GET /api/flows/events` once; then up to 40 `GET /api/flows/card-x?t=T` (4 concurrent lanes). No heartbeat, no rt, no abort timeout. Freshness: `UI.freshness({sessionDate, generatedAt, updatedAt, source:"events"})` plus local `stale()` (30 h / 4-day gate lag rules) -> "Nd old" pill in `#evMeta`. Rail badge `events` set from `inWindow`.

**Political `/flows/political/`**: modules `#plBuyersCard/#plBuyers`, `#plAssetsCard/#plAssets`, `#plRecentCard/#plRecent`, `#plHoldersCard/#plHolders`, chips `#plChips`, `#plMeta`, `#plAboutSlot`, `#plAbout`, `#plStatus`. Endpoint: `GET /api/flows/political` once. No heartbeat, no rt, no timeout. Freshness: `UI.freshness({sessionDate, generatedAt, updatedAt, source:"political"})` only.

**DOM builder patterns.** (1) Painters are idempotent functions of (host, payload): clear host (`replaceChildren`), then `append`. (2) Silence is a first-class output: `hush/emptyLine/silence` print a typed block (pending / quiet-empty / unavailable / unreadable-or-withheld) with a "Why" disclosure; a measured zero is never conflated with a missing value (`DASH` U+2014 for null, `MINUS` U+2212 for negatives). (3) Disclosures: `infoInto(sectionId, label, builder)` replaces the module's `.ui-info` button; builders are lazy closures over the payload. (4) Rows are `<a>` (to `/flows/ticker/?t=`) only when a detail card exists, else `div role=listitem`. (5) Lists use `UI.list(rows, {visible, label})` which hides rows past `visible` behind an "All N" toggle; tables inside disclosures use local `table()`. (6) Charts: `C.line` (hero river, tides, term structure), `C.sparkline`, `C.mount` + `C.svgRoot` + `C.scrub` (spine, paired bars), `C.heatmap` (seasonality), `C.gauge` (expiry), `C.bars` (advancers). (7) Segmented controls via `UI.segmented(label, items, onPick, start)` in the module head slot (`#cc*Seg`, `#mk*Seg`). (8) Silent-state vocabulary shared across pages: `FlowsUI.STATES` (live, fresh, closed, stale, pending, quiet, withheld, unavailable).

#### Routes consumed (all `GET`, Flows session required)

Auth gate for every `/api/flows/*` route (`worker.js` :3601-3605): `requireMethod` GET (POST for `/ask`), `currentFlowsUser` -> JSON `401 {error:{code:"unauthorized"}}` without a valid `flows_session` cookie (HMAC session; `aud` flows). HTML pages return the login page (200) when signed out (:3430-3437). Payload rows live in D1 `flows_payload(id, payload, updated_at)`, live rows in `flows_live`; the Worker serves stored text verbatim (`passthrough`, :1232) with `X-Payload-Updated` (ms) and `X-Fresh-*`.

| Route | Stored key / source | Handler | Used by | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `/api/flows/board?side=long\|short\|watch` | `board:<side>` | worker.js :3607 | Home (all three), Market (long, short) | store failure -> `recallLastGood` copy or `{status:"pending", reason:"read-failed"}` |
| `/api/flows/market` | `market` | :3624 | Home, Market | |
| `/api/flows/events` | `events` | :3631 | Home, Events | |
| `/api/flows/scoretrack` | `scoretrack` | :3638 | Home | |
| `/api/flows/flowalerts`, `/pulse`, `/news` | `flowalerts`, `pulse`, `news` + live overlay (`live:alerts`, `live:market`, `live:news`) | :3652 via `readWithOverlay` (:2097) | Home (alerts, news, pulse), Market (pulse) | overlay sets `X-Live-Overlay`; store down and no overlay -> 503 `store_quota`/store error |
| `/api/flows/lk?k=a,b,...` | `flows_live` ids `live:<k>` | :3661 -> `serveLiveKey` (`shared/flows-live-worker.js` :785) | Home, Market | up to `LK_MAX_KEYS = 8` (`parseList`, deduped; an unrecognised key is silently dropped); one key -> bare body with `X-Fresh-*` (an unwritten key answers 200 `{key, status:"pending"}`); several -> envelope `{serverNow, phase, keys:{<k exactly as sent, e.g. "market", "strips:series">:{status:"ok", payload, updatedAt, fresh} or {status:"pending", fresh}}}` (`liveEnvelope` :755), consumed through `UI.liveBody(env, k)`; 400 `invalid_key` only when NO requested key is valid; multi-key store failure -> 503 `store_unreadable` |
| `/api/flows/now?k=&n=&t=` | live rows + `NOW_NIGHTLY_KEYS` (:94) | :3666 -> `serveNow` (:871) | `UI.heartbeat` (Home, Market) | returns freshness metadata (`serverNow`, `tier1`, `clock`, `expected`, `phase`, `keys`; `keys` are `live:<k>` ids for the `k=` list and the bare names for `n=`, which is why Home's `onChange` can tell `/:focus/` live from `/^focus/` nightly; `n` accepts `NOW_NIGHTLY_KEYS` or `card:<T>`) plus a `quote` only when `t` is a ticker (the route passes `quoteResponse` to `serveNow`; neither Home nor Market sends `t`, so they get metadata only) |

D1 tables touched by this area: none directly (read-only through the Worker). Secrets/env: none in the frontend; Worker side `SESSION_SECRET`, `FLOWS_CREDENTIALS`, `FLOWS_PEPPER`; rail switches `FLOWS_RT_MODE`, `FLOWS_RT_AUDIENCE`, `FLOWS_RT_USERS`. Browser storage: none used by these controllers (the only persisted choice is `?lead=` in the URL via `history.replaceState`, overview.js :1942-1944); `flows-ui.js` itself uses `sessionStorage` key `flows:gate` and cookie `flows_gate` for the signed-out gate.

#### Headers and wire formats the controllers read

- `X-Payload-Updated` (ms epoch of the D1 row) -> `body.__updatedAt`.
- `X-Fresh-State|Reason|Class|Read-At|Source|Cadence|Session|Live-Until|Stale-At|Phase|Phase-Ends|Throttled`, `X-Server-Now`, `X-Live-Overlay` -> `UI.freshFrom(response)` (`flows-fresh.js` `fromHeaders` :27, `wrap` :62, `freshFrom` :86) -> `__ff` with `stateAt()` (`live`/`fresh`/`closed`/`stale`/`pending`, skew-corrected).
- Client-set private fields on bodies: `__updatedAt`, `__ff`, `__route`, `__unreadable`, `__path`, `__reason`, and Home-only `__bull`, `__bear`, `__moves` (within these four files `__ff` and `__route` are assigned only in overview.js and `__unreadable`, `__path`, `__reason` only in market.js; `__rt` is NOT set by any of them, it is set by the `flows-rt.js` adapters `strips()` :790 (`__rt` at :810) and `market()` :854 (`__rt` at :880, which also sets `__ff`) and read by `flows-board.js` :1403). The payload-shape scan whitelists any `x.__name =` assignment found in the file (`flows-payload-shape.mjs` :158).
