### Flows

**F1. Home cold load (signed in).**
1. `GET /flows/` -> `worker.js` :3409 `FLOWS_ROUTES["/flows/"]` -> `currentFlowsUser` :3430 -> `readFlowsSummary(env,"board")` :3433 -> `overviewPage` `shared/flows-pages.js` :363 (Neuron verdict server-rendered :265).
2. Browser loads CSS (`base`, `flows`, `flows-home`) and defers scripts in order: `flows-dock.js`, `flows-ui.js` (defines/freezes `FlowsUI`, wraps `window.fetch` :1818), `flows-fresh.js` (re-freezes with `heartbeat/freshFrom/liveBody`, :175), `flows-rt.js` (adds `rt`, :911), `flows-overview.js`.
3. `overview.js` :1-22 boot guards; :788 `titleFor(null)`; :1723 `leadOn()` sets `#hmLeaders[data-lead]` from `?lead=`.
4. :2126-2130 fires 13 requests in parallel (see Data); each promise stores into `R[k]`.
5. :2210 P.b (both boards in) -> freshness registration, `lists()` :2168 (rows + counts + `drawStrips`), Neuron wiring, status line, rail counts, meta, stale notes.
6. Other `when(...)` blocks fire as their keys land: focus `requestAnimationFrame(() => setTimeout(paintFocus))` (:2246-2249, deliberately a later task than the boards), market (:2251), verdict chips (:2255), hero + volatility (:2256), change list (:2262), strips + spine (:2266), alerts (:2277), events (:2288), lean (:2300), news (:2301), watch (:2303).
7. :2310 once every promise settled -> `live(lk.vol)` :2098 -> `stream()` :1824 (rt connect px/mk/nw) -> `UI.heartbeat` :2101.

**F2. Home steady state.** Heartbeat beat -> `GET /api/flows/now?...` -> `flows-fresh.js` compares `updatedAt` per key -> `onChange(changed)` (overview.js :2104) -> refetch only the changed region(s) -> repaint: focus keys -> `paintFocus`; `live:market`/`live:breadth`/`pulse` -> `hero()`; `live:breadth` -> `paintVol`; `live:news` or `news` -> `paintNews(mergeNews(...))`. In parallel the rt socket (or `/api/rt/snap` every 5 s) calls `rt.on` handlers (:1827-1841) with sub-5 s data.

**F3. Hero tide selection.** `hero()` :937 -> `tideOf(S)` :874: candidate A = `liveSeries(lk.market.tide)` (only if its session >= pulse's); candidate B = `pulseSeries(pulse)`; pick the first with >= 2 points, else the first that exists; 0DTE series (`zeroOf` :859, and only when the chosen tide is itself live) from `live:breadth.dte.zero` then `live:market.zeroDte` (bucketed on 5-minute marks, `onBuckets` :832), else regime `np0` as a last-value-only; `heroState` :895 yields the pill (Live / Updated / Stale / Closed / Last session) using `tide.ff.stateAt()` and `UI.freshness.market()`; `paintHero` :939 draws number + capsule + legs + `C.line`.

**F4. Focus (metals, leaders).** `FOCUS` is filled from `when(["focus","lk"])` :2246 and from heartbeat/rt. `paintFocus` :1950 -> `paintMetals`/`paintLeaders` -> `focusSilent` :1875 -> `focusRows` :1734 (live row per name only if newer than nightly and complete for the module) -> builders `link/netCell/chgOf/sparkIn` -> `whenPill` :1851.

**F5. Market load.** `GET /flows/market/` (:3414) -> `marketPage` :639 -> scripts ui, fresh, rt, market. `market.js` :1452 `Promise.all` of 9 reads (`optional` wrapper: no read can reject) -> :1471-1500 level cards or a level-wide silence -> painters :1514-1530 -> `UI.heartbeat` :1531 (live market/breadth) and `UI.rt.connect(["mk"])` :1549.

**F6. Events load.** `GET /flows/events/` -> `eventsPage` :697 -> `flows-events.js` :638 `wireInfos` (buttons exist before data) -> `fetch /api/flows/events` :639 -> `stale` 660 -> `renderStatus`, `paintMeta`, `paintChips`, `paintWeek`, `paintEarnings(…, true)` (queues card-x lanes), `paintMacro`, `paintFda`, `paintReact`, `wireInfos`. Card-x results repaint earnings every 4 completions and re-run `paintWeek` at the end.

**F7. Political load.** `GET /flows/political/` -> `politicalPage` :863 -> `flows-political.js` :522 -> `get("/api/flows/political")` :523 -> `paintStatus`, `paintMeta`, `paintChips`, `paintBuyers`, `mountAssets`, `paintRecent`, `paintHolders`, `wireInfos`.

**F8. Where the data comes from (cross-area).** Nightly: `scripts/flows-pipeline.mjs` `publish(key, payload)` :3049 (POST `/api/flows/ingest?key=<k>` with bearer/OIDC) -> `worker.js` :3454-3598 upsert into `flows_payload` (:3589-3598; dated archive keys are insert-only :3560-3587) -> routes :3601-3718 -> controllers. Publish sites: `pulse` :4128, `sector:premium` :4165, `news` :4234, `market` :5209, `movers` :5242, `universe`/`regime` :5274-5280 (loop), `events` :5322, `scoretrack` :5467, `sector:trix` :5510, `flowalerts` :6053, `political` :6247, `focus` :6824. Intraday: Worker Tier 1 tick and the Actions `--live` leg write `flows_live` (`live:*`, registry `shared/flows-live.js` :13); the Pulse DO streams `px/fl/gx/mk/nw` frames (`shared/flows-rt-hub.js`).

### Invariants and traps

1. **Weight ceilings are nearly exhausted.** `tests/flows-weight.mjs` fails a route when its emitted scripts exceed `CEILING_KIB`; measured headroom is 609 B (Home), 503 B (Market), 241 B (Events), 365 B (Political). Any net growth in these four JS files, in `flows-ui.js` (counted by every route), `flows-fresh.js`, `flows-rt.js` or `flows-dock.js` forces either trimming or a deliberate ceiling raise in the test file ("raising the ceiling is a decision and should look like one in the diff"). Markup/CSS growth does not count.
2. **Function names and anchors are test contracts.** `tests/flows-payload-shape.mjs` :33-83 (`SURFACES`, with `OPTIONAL` at :85) locates `function paintSectors(`, `paintMovers`, `paintTape`, `paintTilt`, `paintBreadth`, `paintPulse` (market.js), `paintChanged`, `paintAlerts`, `paintEvents`, `paintWatch`, `readTrack`, `paintVerdict`, `boardsRead`, `renderSpine` (overview.js) by name (scope ends at the next `\n  function ` at two-space indent) and the anchors `const poolCount = (payload)` (to `\n  };`) and `const when = (keys, fn)` by text. Renaming or reindenting them, or renaming their payload parameter (`payload`, `sectors`, `movers`, `m`, `pulse`, `market`, `alerts`, `long`, `short`, `lng`, `sht`, `events`), fails the suite. For `flows-events.js` (var `payload`) and `flows-political.js` (var `p`) the WHOLE file is scanned: every `payload.X` / `p.X` root read must be a key the dry-run pipeline emits (or be a `x.__name =` assignment). A new field read must exist in the producer first.
3. **`sectors.rows` is banned in `paintSectors`; it must read `sectors.sectors`, test `status === "pending"`, and place the sentence "No sector carried enough history" after `if (!measured.length)`** (`flows-payload-shape.mjs` :221-251; the ordering assertion is :246-250).
4. **`flows-market.js` keeps no cadence constant.** `flows-market-contract.mjs` :143-160 requires no `REFRESH_CADENCE_MINUTES` in the file, the exact signature `function pulseStamp(readAt, refreshed, cadenceMinutes)` and the call `pulseStamp(pulse.readAt, pulse.refreshed, pulse.cadenceMinutes)`.
5. **Home prose budget.** `flows-overview-contract.mjs` :3157-3172: inside `.hm-grid` no visible text node (outside svg, `.visually-hidden`, `.hm-verdict`, `.hm-news-h`, `[hidden]`) may exceed six words; at least 15 `[data-info]` disclosures must exist; every class present in `#hmLean` and `#hmNews` (and their popovers) must have a rule in `flows.css` or `flows-home.css` (:3175-3203). Put sentences into `UI.info` builders, not into the DOM.
6. **Reserved heights and layout shift.** `#ccMetals`, `#ccLeaders`, `#ccBull`, `#ccBear` carry `min-height` values (flows-home.css :212-219, :281-284, :293) that the test requires to be >= drawn height - 8 - wrapped-row growth at 1440 px; cumulative layout shift of a full fill must be < 0.1; the focus modules must fill in a LATER task than the boards (`requestAnimationFrame` + `setTimeout`, overview.js :2248); `?lead=ndx10` must reserve the ten-row height before data arrives because `leadOn()` (:1722-1723) sets `data-lead` at script start. Changing row heights or module order requires re-measuring these.
7. **Nothing is stored in the browser.** The Home test asserts the plain Home link opens on Mag 7 and only `?lead=` persists the choice (overview-contract :3429-3433, with the reload/shared-link case at :3434-3435 and the ten-row reserve at :3436-3441). Do not add `localStorage`/`sessionStorage`/`IEWTStorage` here.
8. **No `innerHTML`.** Vendor strings (headlines, firm names, rules) reach the DOM only as text nodes; the Home test keeps "vendor strings stay characters". Keep using `h()`.
9. **Duplicated helpers drift.** There is no shared module: `usd/usdS/toneOf/cap1/clock/nyMinutes/hourTicks/infoInto/headMark/table/KIND/POP/disclose` exist separately in overview.js and market.js (political has its own `usd`/`num`; events uses `F.*`). They are NOT identical: overview `pct(v)` multiplies by 100 and signs it ("+" and U+2212, 2 dp default), market `pct(v)` multiplies by 100 with no "+" and an ASCII hyphen for negatives (1 dp default); market `KIND` adds `opening`/`stale`; overview `table(label, heads, rows)` takes row objects `{cells, attrs}` and draws every body cell as `<td>`, market `table` takes plain cell arrays and draws the first cell as `<th scope="row">`; events `cardKey` keeps `.` and `-`, political `cardKey` strips them. A format change must be applied per file deliberately.
10. **Script order is load-bearing.** `FlowsUI` is `Object.freeze`d and each of `flows-fresh.js` and `flows-rt.js` replaces `window.FlowsUI` with a new object. A controller captures `const UI = window.FlowsUI` once, so it must run after them (`defer` order in `shared/flows-pages.js` :401-404, :675-678). Home/Market guard with `typeof UI.heartbeat === "function"` and `UI.rt &&`; a reordering degrades silently to no heartbeat/no stream instead of failing loudly. A helper added to `flows-ui.js` must be added to the `Object.freeze({...})` export list (:2018-2033).
11. **Fetch semantics differ per page.** Home never throws (null on any failure, 15 s abort) and shows "unreadable" silences. Market `get()` throws on non-OK and `optional()` wraps into `{__unreadable:true}`; no timeout. Events/Political throw to a catch and use `failEverywhere`/`idle`; no timeout. A hung request on the last three leaves "Loading" forever. 401: the global wrapper in `flows-ui.js` :1818-1829 returns a never-settling promise for a 401 and redirects (or, within 10 minutes of a previous redirect, shows a signed-out bar instead of looping; `gate()` :1804-1815, `HANG` :1816), so the per-page `r.status === 401` branches are belt-and-braces.
12. **Market ignores nightly `pulse` heartbeat changes.** `onChange` (market.js :1533-1547) only handles `live:market`/`live:breadth`; a republished nightly pulse updates the freshness pill but not the Volume/OI/Insiders/Dark/Season cards until reload.
13. **Events and Political are one-shot pages.** No heartbeat, no rt, no re-fetch; freshness pill only reflects their single `UI.freshness` call. Do not assume the "worst-case pill" logic covers them.
14. **`flows-record.css` is not Political's stylesheet** (see Purpose). Editing it to restyle Political/Events does nothing; use `flows-feeds.css` (prefix `pl-`, `fe-`). `fd-*`/`fu-*` there are shared with `flows-unusual.js`.
15. **CSS width queries.** `flows-motion.mjs` :86-111 fails if any pixel/rem width appears as both a `min-width` and a `max-width` in an `@media` across `base.css` and every `flows*.css`; write the max as `X.98`/`X.99` (home.css uses `767.98px`/`768px`). `@container` queries are not scanned.
16. **Polarity and neutral colours.** `flows-sign.mjs` (:115-163): `rc-dot` (flows-record.css) must keep `is-pos`/`is-neg`/`is-flat` rules; any `.is-flat` rule or `[data-tone="flat"]` rule must not use `--up`, `--down`, `--up-mark`, `--down-mark`, `--flow-up`, `--flow-down` (the market bars `.mk-bar.is-flat`/`.mk-seg.is-flat` use `--label-3`).
17. **Glyph and character rules.** Glyph names must exist in `GLYPHS` (`shared/flows-pages.js` :21-65); `contracts.mjs` forbids the character sigma in any `assets/js/flows-*.js`; `contracts.mjs` asserts no `var(--font-mono)` / `var(--font-serif)` in `flows.css` (the route sheets in this area use neither; keep it that way); source files carry no comments (verified: none in the seven files).
18. **Rail badge slots are exactly `events`, `long`, `short`, `watch`** (`flows-motion.mjs` :294-302); `setRailCount` silently no-ops for any other key.
19. **Client-only state keys are implicit.** Events `S.fail` and `S.staleText` are set outside the `S` initialiser (:610-634); Home `drawn[]`/`strips[]` accumulate for the life of the page (no teardown). Not bugs today, but easy to break when adding a re-render path (Home `lists()` is called once).
20. **Stale dev tool.** `scripts/render-preview.mjs` (not run by CI, `scripts/` is in `.assetsignore`) still probes `.cc-region`, `.fd-card`; no current renderer emits them. Do not treat it as a check.
21. **Date anchoring.** Server suites may not hold ISO dates in the next 400 days unless anchored; `contracts.mjs` :873-892 lists `flows-market-contract.mjs` (2026-10-16, 2026-10-30) and `flows-overview-contract.mjs` (2026-10-16). A new fixture date near those must be added to that map with a reason.
22. **Legacy `cc-` prefix.** The old "command center" prefix survives on Home: element IDs (`ccBull`, `ccVerdict`, ...) are the controller's mount contract, `cc-open`, `cc-t`, `cc-dim`, `cc-date`, `cc-ln-*`, `cc-nw*`, `cc-cross`, `cc-ern`, `cc-old` have CSS in `flows-home.css`, while `cc-flat`, `cc-score`, `cc-trk` are emitted but unstyled hooks (tests and `data-ticker` selectors). Do not rename IDs without updating `shared/flows-pages.js` and the contract selectors (`#ccBull`, `#ccLean .hm-cell`, `#ccNews .hm-news-open`, ...).

### How to change it

Every change under `assets/css/`, `assets/js/` or `assets/data/` needs the ritual: (1) increment `assets/version.txt` (now 240); (2) set `ASSET_VERSION` in `shared/flows-pages.js` line 1 to the same value (all Flows `?v=` URLs derive from it via `v()` :3; `tests/flows-features.mjs` :846-849 holds equality); (3) leave `assets/fonts-version.txt` (230) alone; (4) run the suites below. Source files carry no comments: put the reasoning in the commit message.

Test commands (from `tests/`; Chromium suites need `PLAYWRIGHT_BROWSERS_PATH` set; workerd suites in the agent sandbox need `FLOWS_TEST_SANDBOX=1`):
- Server (workerd + Chromium): `FLOWS_TEST_SANDBOX=1 node flows-overview-contract.mjs`, `... flows-market-contract.mjs`, `... flows-political-render.mjs`, `... flows-worker-contract.mjs`, `... flows-motion.mjs`.
- No server: `node flows-events-contract.mjs` (Chromium; runs the pipeline dry-run), `node flows-political-contract.mjs`, `node flows-payload-shape.mjs` (runs the pipeline dry-run), `node flows-weight.mjs`, `node flows-sign.mjs`, `node flows-readers-render.mjs`, `node flows-rt-client.mjs`, `node contracts.mjs`, `node flows-track-render.mjs` (for record CSS).
- Chain order in `tests/package.json` `test` (fail-fast): contracts 0, flows-record 9, flows-overview 23, flows-market 25, flows-motion 28, flows-events 32, flows-payload-shape 33, flows-political 50, flows-political-render 51, flows-weight 54, flows-sign 62. A new suite must be registered in that chain and in the AGENTS.md lists.

## Flows frontend: ticker, strategy, desk, track

Snapshot: commit `ba2acfe` (origin/main after PR #148), asset version `240`, fonts token `230`. All line numbers below were taken with `grep -n` / `Read` on that tree. All six in-scope files are comment-free (zero comment lines, checked by grep), so behaviour comes from code. AGENTS.md and DEPLOY.md were cross-checked; disagreements are in "Invariants and traps".

### Purpose and boundaries

**What it is.** Four route controllers of the gated Flows section (`/flows/*`, Flows session cookie `flows_session`) and the two stylesheets that are specific to three of them. Each controller is a framework-free IIFE that draws into server-rendered shells from `shared/flows-pages.js` using only `window.FlowsUI` (and, for pricing, `window.FlowsQuant`).

| Page | URL | Controller | Stylesheet (after `base.css`, `flows.css`) | Page function (shared/flows-pages.js) | Role |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Ticker dossier | `/flows/ticker/?t=SYM` | `flows-ticker.js` (2,975 lines) | `flows-ticker.css` (`ft-*`) | `tickerPage` :781 | One name's dossier: hero (price, chips, price+priced-move cone), Neuron verdict + idea cards + model-written "reading", ten data modules, or a lite screen page, or a picker. Read-only over nightly payloads, no pricing of its own. |
| Strategy lab | `/flows/strategy/?t=SYM&s=&expiry=&basis=&legs=` | `flows-strategy.js` (1,511) | `flows-tools.css` (`tl-*`; the `sg*` names are element ids and copy hooks only, no `sg-*` rule exists) | `strategyPage` :909 | Price any listed structure (22 engine families or custom legs) on the fitted smile, in the browser, with the same engine the Worker runs; drag strikes; payoff, odds, greeks, scenarios, legs. |
| Premium desk | `/flows/desk/?t=A,B&strategy=&rank=&bp=&surface=` | `flows-desk.js` (1,029) | `flows-tools.css` (`dk-*`, `desk-*`, `ivs-*`, shares `tl-*`) | `deskPage` :468 | Rank cash-secured puts / buy-write covered calls across up to 20 symbols on a risk/yield frontier, size to a buying power, IV smile heat-grid. |
| Score track | `/flows/track/?t=SYM` | `flows-track.js` (777) | **`flows-record.css`** (`st-*`; not in this scope, 303 lines) | `trackPage` :724 | Every name's daily score as a strip per session; per-name chart, outcomes (hit rate with Wilson intervals) and calibration (Spearman). |

**What it is not.** Not the HTML shells (area 30, `shared/flows-pages.js`: `deskPage` :468, `trackPage` :724, `tickerPage` :781, `strategyPage` :909, wrapper `flowsDocument` :1029), not the data (routes in `worker.js`, nightly payloads built by `scripts/flows-pipeline.mjs`), not the UI foundation (`flows-ui.js`, `flows-fresh.js`, `flows-rt.js` - area 50 part file), not the engine (`shared/flows-quant-*.js`, area 33; the browser gets it as the generated `assets/js/flows-quant.bundle.js` 67,082 B and `assets/js/flows-quant-read.bundle.js` 15,791 B). `flows-record.css` (styles Track and History, `st-*` rule block from line 188) is outside this scope but is the only stylesheet the Track page loads; `flows-tools.css` is **not** loaded by Track.

**Neighbours.**
- `window.FlowsUI` (flows-ui.js) is the only UI dependency: `MINUS DASH MID h s F glyph num clamp tone cap cssVar isNum chart (mount svgRoot lin niceTicks pathOf monoPath vGrad clipRect spread marker scrub part line sparkline bars diverging heatmap gauge payoff LEVELS) STATES depths stateOf worst partial info infoButton stateButton openInfo closeInfo announce roll metric updateMetric metrics gaugeChip chips segmented tag capsule key legend robustness silent dash listRow list tile split moduleCard freshness staleness reduced`, plus `freshFrom heartbeat` (flows-fresh.js, ticker only) and `rt` (flows-rt.js, ticker only; `connect/on/quote`). Export block flows-ui.js :2018-2033.
- Page load order (emitted by `flowsDocument` :1029-1039; the dock script is emitted inside `shell()` before `UI_SCRIPT`): ticker = dock, ui, **fresh, rt, quant-read.bundle, ticker**; desk = dock, ui, **quant.bundle, desk**; strategy = dock, ui, **quant.bundle, strategy**; track = dock, ui, **track**. All `defer`, so document order is execution order. Every script URL carries `?v=` = `ASSET_VERSION` (shared/flows-pages.js :1).
- Global namespace: the quant bundle defines `var FlowsQuant` (esbuild IIFE, `globalName: "FlowsQuant"`, scripts/build-flows-quant-bundle.mjs). The ticker loads the **read build** (7 names: `sliceVolK riskNeutralCdf riskNeutralQuantile lawIntervalsProb QUANT_CARD_VERSION sliceFromSummary lawAtSessions`; entry `shared/flows-quant-read.js`, 4 lines). Strategy and desk load the **full build** (entry `shared/flows-quant-browser.js`, 12 lines).
- Server counterparts: `/api/flows/*` routes in worker.js (see Data and interfaces).

| `m-screen` | Screen | [12, 12] | 2 | `buildScreen` :2690 (lite pages only) | none | `card.u` (grouped Volatility / Dealers / Flow / Trend) |

Outside the grid: `#ftHero` (price, flags, chips `#ftChips`, hero chart `#ftHc`), `#ftVerdict` (Neuron verdict + `.ft-ideas` + `.ft-read` reading), `#ftPicker` (names).

Strategy (`#sgGrid`, `.ui-grid`): `sgPayoffM` Payoff (span 8, index 0); a `ui-span-4 tl-col` holding `sgOddsM` Odds (index 1) and `sgGreeksM` Greeks (index 3); `sgScenM` Scenarios (span 7, index 2, vol -5/Flat/+5 segmented); `sgLegsM` Legs (span 5, index 4, Mid/Fill/Natural segmented + "Add leg"). Above the grid: `#sgPick` structure tiles (Direction segmented, 22 tiles) + expiry chips.

Desk (`#dkGrid`, `.ui-grid`): `dkFrontierM` Frontier (span 8; axis segmented "Net delta" / "Win % (implied)"), `dkSizingM` Sizing (span 4; buying power input, plan, next-best), `dkLinesM` Lines (span 12; rank select, 12 rows + "All n"), `deskSurface` Smile (span 12; symbol select; hidden until a selected symbol has `ivSurface`). Controls card above: `#deskEntry` (add symbols), `#deskList` chips, `#dkFilters` (Sell Puts/Calls/Both, tenor, All names, Refresh, Remove all).

Track (`#stTrack`, `.ui-grid.st-grid`): `.st-chips` (Scored, Moved, Cleared, Faded, Flipped gauge chips), `stName` (open-link title, metrics, tags, `#stChart`), `stOutcomes` (horizon 1d/5d/10d; hit meter), `stCalib` (scatter), `stNames` (filter, order Now-or-Last/Move/Cross/Run as `has.*` allows, paged list).

### Data and interfaces

**How the Neuron, reading, dossier and quant bundles are used here.**
- Neuron (`/api/flows/summary`): ticker only. `STATE.neuron` drives the verdict line (`summary` first sentence via `headline` :25), meta chips (direction capsule from `stanceOf` :913, stale caveat, `verdictWord`, robustness, time), expandable body (`context.state` rows via `stateMeta` :928, `screen` facts via `screenMeta` :956, `provenance`, `refused`), and the idea row: `tier === "expired"` -> no ideas (:1075, :1124); `neuron.screen` -> `screenIdea` (:957, "Not priced"); `card.engine` present -> `engineIdeaCard` for up to 3 of `neuron.ideas` ids (order) else `engine.ideas`, or `standAside` when `engine.noTrade`; no engine -> `legacyIdeaCard`. `status === "pending"` polls (`awaitNeuron`). When the Neuron is unavailable the page reads its own `cardRead` (:945) from the card and says so in the source line.
- Reading (`neuron.read`): ticker only, `readingBlock` :1016 / `paintReading` :1052. States `ready | generating | fallback | absent | unavailable`; the label is "Model wording" (generated) or "Deterministic reading"; cite chips carry the fact label, display, age ("as of ..., N before the dossier was read") and are marked quoted when `untrusted`; character tags; "What the model saw" link to `/api/flows/dossier?t=<T>&render=1`. No client-side check of the model's words (the Worker vets them); the client only escapes by building text nodes (`h()`), so model text never reaches `innerHTML` (flows-reading-render asserts this).
- Dossier (`/api/flows/dossier`): not fetched as JSON by any of the four controllers; only linked (:1046). Inside these files "dossier" mostly means the page itself or the nightly companion `card-x` ("the name's dossier").
- Quant bundles: ticker uses the read build in two places only: `worldsData` :1199 (`FQ.sliceFromSummary`, `lawAtSessions`, `riskNeutralCdf`, `riskNeutralQuantile`, `lawIntervalsProb`) and `smileSeries` :1969 (`FQ.sliceVolK`, `sliceFromSummary`); it prices nothing. Strategy uses the full build: `STRUCTURES DELTA_TARGETS structureLegs familyDirection bookRows labSetup priceStructure expiryProfile payoffValue`. Desk uses `closeUtcMs contractFit contractDiagnosis labSetup priceStructure codeText`. Track uses none. If the bundle is missing, strategy shows `T("no-q")` and desk rows get the `why-q` dash reason.

**Client-side wire formats the controllers rely on** (fields as read in code; the shape scan keeps some honest):
- Ticker card: `ticker nm sector type depth sessionDate generatedAt v score conviction conv{agreement,coverage,persistence,breadth,gate,weights} fam{F,P,D,V,O} regime{label,labelFrom,bookGamma,flowGamma,netGamma,crossings,crossingSide,flipSide,crossingSeparation,flipSeparation,spotGammaShare,bandMin,bandMax} gate{earnings} atr gammaFlip zeroGamma strikeSumCrossing quality{otmShare,vegaTilt} readPx lite u pct rank n why panels{gamma,surface,levels,calendar,displacement,variation,vanna,charm,deltaExposure,ivSurface,skewTerm,volContext,pricedMove,aggressor,path,premiumTrack,topContracts,oiDeltas,darkpool,congress,marketRank,context,scoreOverlay} engine{asOf,spot,atr,rate,facts,state,pLaw,levels,event,expiries[{expiry,dte,sessions,smile,forward}],structures[...],ideas,noTrade,priced,families,stale}`.
- card-x sections read: `gex gexLevels gexPath flowExpiry flowStrike alerts multiLeg nope short insiders earnings term cone rv vrp skew ivDyn anomaly character contracts dpLevels` plus top-level `status`, `why`, `off`, `reason`. hist: `d0 dd gex.g volume.np`.
- Scoretrack payload: `{v, generatedAt, sessionDate, status, windowSessions, deadBand, epoch, namesSeen, namesShed, shedBy, archive{probed,failed,abandoned}, sources{full,boardsOnly}, sessions[{d,source scores|boards,names,preEpoch}], names[{t,s[] (null = not scored),n,last,lastAt,d1{v,gap,qv,cross},run,ext{hi,hiAt,lo,loAt}}], change{status,session,prior,comparable,consecutive,moved,held,current,entered,left,crossings{cleared,faded,flipped}}, notes{score,gaps,change,crossing,run,saturation,backfill,epoch,window}}`.
- Chain row fields the desk reads: `symbol ticker expiry type strike strategy days bid ask mid spread premium collateral yieldOnCollateral annualized annualizedGross breakeven cushionSigmas capSigmas assignedReturn moneyness iv ivMid ivTraded oi oiChange volume intrinsic crossesEarnings opposite`.

**Budgets and caps in these files.** Ticker: live quote trusted for 3 min (:317); neuron poll 5000+i*3500 ms for i<=6 (:2855-2862); reading poll 4000+i*2500 ms for i<=9 (:2866-2874); tape retry 3 x 5 s (:2843); heartbeat 20 s ticker / 60 s extended (flows-fresh.js :8); tape refetch every 3rd RTH beat (:2916); idle `meta` fetch with 1.2 s fallback (:2963-2968); picker shows 12 rows (:2789); `WORLD_CELLS = 40` (:1198); 3 ideas max (:720). Strategy: 30 s hero age repaint (:1506), resize debounce 120 ms (:1505), qty cap 999 (:87 URL legs, :1047 stepper). Desk: 20 symbols, 3 concurrent fetches, 12 rows shown, 30 s age tick, 300 s stale-quote line, 250 ms rank debounce, `MAX_BUYING_POWER 1e11`. Track: 24/80 rows per page, horizons 1/5/10.

**Route JavaScript weight ceilings (tests/flows-weight.mjs :12-27) against measured bytes** (sum of every emitted `<script src>` file, KiB = 1024):

| Page | Ceiling | Measured bytes | Headroom |
|---|---|---|---|
| tickerPage | 400 KiB (409,600) | 408,676 = dock 3,007 + ui 107,833 + fresh 7,336 + rt 32,860 + quant-read 15,791 + ticker 241,849 | **924 B** |
| deskPage | 234 KiB (239,616) | 239,443 = dock 3,007 + ui 107,833 + quant 67,082 + desk 61,521 | **173 B** |
| strategyPage | 251 KiB (257,024) | 256,086 = dock + ui + quant + strategy 78,164 | **938 B** |
| trackPage | 164 KiB (167,936) | 167,209 = dock + ui + track 56,369 | **727 B** |

`flows-ui.js` (107,833 B) is in all four, so any growth there spends all four budgets.

**Storage, env, secrets.** The four controllers use no `localStorage`/`sessionStorage`/`IEWTStorage` (grep: none); state lives in the URL (`history.replaceState`) and memory. They read no env var. Server-side inputs behind their routes: `SESSION_SECRET`, `FLOWS_CREDENTIALS`, `UW_API_KEY` (vendor), `UW_BASE` + `UW_NOW` (test-only: `chainReadMs` worker.js :2184 pins the chain read clock only while `UW_BASE` is set), `FLOWS_READ_MODE`, `FLOWS_AI_DAILY_CAP_*` (model calls on the summary route), `FLOWS_RT_*` (rail). D1 binding `DB` tables touched through the routes: `flows_payload`, `flows_neuron`, `flows_clock`, `flows_live`, `flows_ai_usage*`, `flows_dossier_cache`.

### Flows

**1. Ticker page load (`start`, :2933).**
1. `readTicker` (:2743) validates `?t=`; none -> `noTicker` (:2821): hero hidden, `namesFor` (:2774) fetches `/api/flows/board?side=long`, `...short`, `/api/flows/roster`, shows `showPicker` (:2779) built from the roster depth map or carded board rows.
2. With a ticker: hero `.is-loading`; start `summary`, `card-x`, `hist` as `soft(getJSON(...))` promises (:2939), then `await getJSON(api("card"))` (:2941); a throw -> `silentHero` + status text (:2941-2946).
3. `card.status` set and not `"ok"`, or neither `panels` nor `lite` present (:2948) -> `absentCard` (:2811): `WHY[...]` reason word from `#ftCopy` (`wh-unknown|gated|retired|not-covered|store|pending`), picker excluding the ticker.
4. `fetchTape` (:2949) and `paintFreshness(card)` (:694, registers `{sessionDate, generatedAt, source:"card", primary:true}`); `await` the three companion promises; `STATE.cardX = joined(cx, card)`, `STATE.hist = joined(hist, card)` (:2954-2955); `document.title = "<T> · Flows"`.
5. Lite card -> `paintLite` (:2711: hero, `liteChips`, `liteRanks`, `buildScreen`, `buildEvents` if card-x has earnings, `buildLiteFlow` if tape, verdict if the Neuron has a `tier`). Otherwise `paintAll` (:2638): `renderHero` (:352) -> `renderVerdict` (:1060: `renderVerdictCard` :1065 then `paintReading` :1052) -> `renderModules` (:2627, ten builders) -> `paintFreshness`.
6. `jumpToHash` (:2877); then, for a non-lite card only (:2960): if `neuron.status === "pending"` -> `awaitNeuron` (:2852) polls `/api/flows/summary` (settles to "unavailable" after 7 tries, on `ok` re-renders verdict and `buildWorlds`, chains into `awaitReading` if `read.status === "generating"`); else if `readPending` -> `awaitReading` (:2865, up to 10 polls, repaints only the `.ft-read` block).
7. Idle, non-lite card only (`requestIdleCallback`, timeout 3 s, :2963-2968): `/api/flows/meta` -> `STATE.meta` -> `renderFlags` (second stale state if the boards were built by a later run).
8. `startLive(t)` (:2905): `streamQuote` (`UI.rt.connect({topics:["px"],focus:t})`; `rt.on("px")` -> `UI.rt.quote(t)` -> `takeQuote`) and `UI.heartbeat({ticker:t, page:"ticker", nightly:["card:"+t]})` (`nightly: []` and an `onChange` that returns early for a lite card): `onBeat` records `STATE.phase`/`lastClosed`, fetches tape on every 3rd RTH beat or on leaving RTH; `onQuote` -> `takeQuote` (:2887: `paintPrice`, `paintFreshness`, redraw hero chart when live/not-live flips); `onChange(["card:T"])` refetches card, summary, card-x, hist and calls `paintAll` again.

**2. Price line (`paintPrice` :406).** `pricePoint` (:320) -> mode: `live` (RTH and quote < 3 min old), `close` (vendor close for lite/behind cards, with day), `read` (quote or `card.readPx` shown beside the session close with delta), `none`. A string signature skips repaints; `UI.roll` animates digits; `#ftLast` template swapped only when the mode changes (focus restored to the info button).

**3. Strategy page.** `readURL` (:96) -> `paint()` (hero, tiles, grid silence) -> `loadContext` (:152) `GET /api/flows/strategy?t=` -> `pickExpiry` (:186) -> `ensureBooks` -> `loadBook` (:217) `GET ...&expiry=&engine=1` (one per needed expiry; back expiry for calendar/diagonal; every leg expiry for URL legs) -> `rebuild` (:241) -> `Q.labSetup` (engine fit + facts + law + levels + `Q.bookRows`) -> default family (engine idea 1, else closest no-trade, else put credit spread) -> `buildLegs` (:283, `Q.structureLegs`) -> `price` (:340: `modelFree` :318 + `Q.priceStructure`) -> `paint` -> `showModules`/`fillModules` (:807). Edits: tile click `choose` (:644), expiry chip `setExpiry` (:664), drag `startDrag` (:1320) -> `snapTo` -> `setStrike` (:1309: `price`, `fillModules(true)`, `writeURL`), leg buttons `bump/flip/removeLeg/addLeg` -> `toCustom` -> `reprice` (:1064), basis segmented control `price(); paint()`.

**4. Desk page.** `readURL` (:111) -> `ensureModules` (:339) -> `renderChips` -> `render` -> `add(initial)` (:906) -> `runPool` (:282, 3 workers) -> `fetchOne` (:215) `GET /api/flows/chain` -> `price` (:258: per row `Q.contractFit` -> `Q.labSetup` -> `Q.priceStructure`, covered call = stock + short call, short put alone, basis natural) -> `renderChips`, `render` (:377) -> `rowsNow` (:306: sizing, sort) -> `renderPlan`, `renderList`, `drawScatter` (frontier), `renderSurface`. Side change (`setSide` :984) discards all payloads and refetches; rank change (`onRank` :997) refetches only symbols whose payload is a truncated slice ranked by something else.

**5. Track page.** `get("/api/flows/scoretrack")` (:739) -> branches (pending silent card; unreadable; empty; ok) -> `prepare` (:67) -> `wireBasis` -> staleness chip (`UI.staleness`) -> `build` (:721) + `renderList` (:166) -> `select` (:563): `paintName` immediately (score-only chart), lazy `GET /api/flows/card?t=` -> `closesOf` (:223) -> `paintOutcomes` (:488: `outcomes` :244, `hitMeter` :436, `calibChart` :385) and `paintName` again with the close line.

**6. Where a displayed number comes from** (quick locator): ticker verdict words = `/api/flows/summary` (`summary`, `verdictWord`, `provenance`); ideas = `card.engine.structures` selected by `neuron.ideas` or `engine.ideas`; reading = `summary.read`; Two worlds densities = `card.engine.expiries[i].smile`/`forward` + `engine.pLaw` priced in the browser by the read bundle; hero cone = `panels.pricedMove` (`impliedHigh/Low`, `realizedHigh/Low`, `sessions`); Signal = `card.score/conv/fam` + `panels.scoreOverlay`; Flow session path = `/api/flows/tape` (`prem`) else `panels.path`; strategy odds/greeks = browser `Q.priceStructure` on `book.engine` from the Worker; desk win %/EV = browser `Q.priceStructure` per row from the chain payload's `engine` block; desk annualised yield/cushion/collateral = server `rankChain` (shared/flows-premium.js :262).

### Invariants and traps

**Weight (CI).**
- Four near-full ceilings (see table): ticker 924 B, desk 173 B, strategy 938 B, track 727 B of headroom. Any growth in these controllers, `flows-ui.js`, `flows-fresh.js`, `flows-rt.js`, `flows-dock.js` or either quant bundle fails `tests/flows-weight.mjs` :88. Raising a ceiling (:12-27) is a decision to make in the diff, not a fix.
- The ticker may not defer scripts: `flows-weight.mjs` :132 fails on `createElement("script")` or `import(`; it must also link no `flows-panels.js`, `flows-drawers.js`, `flows-cursor.js` (flows-ticker-contract :236).

**Asset ritual.** Any edit under `assets/js`, `assets/css` or `assets/data` needs `assets/version.txt` bumped and every `?v=` updated (`shared/flows-pages.js` :1 `ASSET_VERSION` plus the 15 other files that carry `?v=240`: `assets/css/base.css`, `assets/css/flows.css`, `404.html`, `index.html`, `articles/index.html`, `articles/_template/index.html`, `lab/index.html`, `lab/course.html`, `lab/lesson.html`, `lab/review/index.html`, `lab/placement/index.html`, `lab/challenge/index.html`, and three `lab/projects/*/index.html`). `tests/contracts.mjs` :968-983 (`if (diffBase)`; `assetVersionAt` :935, `isBrowserAsset` :956) compares against the diff base; `flows-features.mjs` pins `ASSET_VERSION` equal to `assets/version.txt`. A blanket `?v=<old>` rewrite also hits the sixteen woff2 references: reset them to `assets/fonts-version.txt` (230) afterwards.

**FlowsUI is re-frozen, not extended.** `window.FlowsUI` is an `Object.freeze`d object (flows-ui.js :2018). `flows-fresh.js` and `flows-rt.js` each replace it, in the last statement before the closing `})();`, with a new frozen object (`Object.freeze(Object.assign({}, UI, api))` in flows-fresh.js, `Object.freeze(Object.assign({}, window.FlowsUI, { rt: Object.freeze(api) }))` in flows-rt.js), so a controller that reads `window.FlowsUI` once at start sees `freshFrom`, `heartbeat` and `rt` only if it loads after them. The ticker does (dock, ui, fresh, rt, quant-read, ticker). Strategy, desk and track load neither and read none of the three (grep: no `heartbeat`, `UI.rt` or `freshFrom` in them); adding a live feed to one of them means adding the script tags in `shared/flows-pages.js` and spending that page's weight budget.

**Quant bundles are generated.** Never edit `assets/js/flows-quant.bundle.js` / `flows-quant-read.bundle.js`; run `node scripts/build-flows-quant-bundle.mjs` after touching any reachable `shared/flows-quant-*` module (tests/flows-quant-card.mjs :372-380 fails if the committed full bundle differs from what the generator builds, and :488-502 does the same for the read bundle, requires the read build under a third of the full build, and requires every `FQ.<name>` the ticker calls to be a function of the read build and the read build to carry no `repriceStructure`/`priceStructure`). Adding an `FQ.x` call to flows-ticker.js means exporting `x` from `shared/flows-quant-read.js` too.

**Test-only exposure in flows-desk.js.** Lines 8-54 must stay DOM-free: the file is run in a bare `vm` with no `document`, where it exposes `__FlowsDeskTest` and returns (:51-54). Touching `document`/`window` above that line breaks flows-desk-client's first block. `sizeRow` must stay byte-compatible with `sizeToBuyingPower` (flows-desk-contract.mjs :586-619).

**Silent-copy trap.** `T(key)` returns `""` when the `data-k` is missing from the hidden copy stores (`#ftCopy` shared/flows-pages.js :804-830, `#sgCopy` :972-1023, `#dkCopy` :498-614) and no test pins the keys. A key check run for this map (script in the scratchpad) found every literal and prefixed key (`fc-`, `wh-`, `rm-`, `c-`, `earn-`) present at this commit. A rename in `flows-pages.js` without updating the controller degrades to blank sentences without any error.

**Text-pattern scans over flows-ticker.js** (rename-sensitive; all indent-sensitive):
- flows-payload-shape :189-195 slices `  function payoffPoints(`, `ideaFacts(`, `legRow(`, `engineIdeaCard(`, `standAside(` up to the next `\n  function ` and checks every `eng./st./pr./ev./l./f.<field>` read exists on the emitted engine block; :263-270 requires `  function feedSection(` (:264) and the literal `    const mr = P.marketRank;` (:268); :512-517 requires `hedgeGridChart` and `buildHedging`.
- flows-ticker-contract :177-182 requires `const PANEL_MOD = {`, a `mod({ id: "m-xxx"` literal for exactly the ten modules `m-worlds m-signal m-gamma m-hedge m-vol m-flow m-tape m-events m-pos m-context` plus `m-screen`, and that every `TICKER_PANELS` key (shared/flows-panels.js :1) is mapped in `PANEL_MOD` to a built module or `ftHero`; :194 requires `scoreOverlay` between `function renderHeroChart` and `function breaksOf`; :542 slices `  function changeFrom(join) {`; :1705 slices `  function clipTo(pts, a, b) {`; :1735 requires `STALE_LEAD` text to be the server's.
- flows-card-contract :665-672 pins `const RICHNESS_LINE = 0.1;` to `STATE_LINES.VRP_RELATIVE` (flows-neuron.js) and requires every `["Band", ...]` row to be `richnessBand(pm)`.
- flows-card-render :36-39 forbids a class string glued to a conditional without a space (`class: "ft-x" + (c ? "is-y" : "z")` needs `"ft-x "`).
- flows-reading-render :117 slices the source between `const READ_LISTS` and `function renderVerdictCard`; :255 filters console errors named `flows-ticker: buildGamma failed` / `buildFlow failed`.
- flows-sign sweeps every `assets/js/flows-*.js`: a `x < 0 ? ... : ...` ternary whose window carries a positive marker (`"+"`, `is-pos`) and a negative one (`MINUS`, `is-neg`) without a third zero arm or two zero comparisons is a violation (zero must not be drawn as positive); it also requires every `data-tone` literal the ticker emits to have a rule in `flows.css`.
- flows-ticker-contract :1518-1526: every `ft-*` class present in the rendered DOM (non-SVG) must have a rule in `flows-ticker.css` (except `ft-lg*/ft-md*` which need span rules), every `ui-*` class must exist in `flows.css`/ticker css or be a hook `flows-ui.js` queries; no raw hex colours in the ticker stylesheet; `@container` must appear; no inline `<style>`, no `adoptedStyleSheets`/`insertRule`.

**Server-suite date trap.** `tests/contracts.mjs` :872-907 (`ANCHORED` :873, the assertion :899) fails any `startWorker` suite holding an ISO date within the next 400 days that is not anchored (workerd runs on the real clock). `flows-strategy.mjs` builds its dates from the clock; `flows-desk-contract.mjs` is anchored only for `2026-10-16`, `2026-11-05`, `2026-11-20`, `2026-12-18` (today is 2026-10-04, the first anchor is 12 days away: those are fixture labels, not priced).

**Behavioural invariants worth keeping.**
- A number with no source is a dash, never zero; every unavailable value carries a reason via `ST(...)`/`UI.silent`/`UI.dash`. Gaps in the score track are drawn as a dot, not a zero bar (`strip` :149, `trackChart` :321).
- `liveQuote` (:313) refuses a quote outside RTH or older than 3 min; a live price is never printed beside a nightly change (`pricePoint` :323 takes `prev` from the quote).
- Grades are capped at 1 when the card describes an earlier session than the last close (`vettedGrade` :768-773, `STALE_LEAD`).
- A desk chain whose quotes disagree with the print (`basis.status === "mismatch"`) is excluded from ranking and announced (`rowsNow` :314, `basisLines` :419); a rebased chain is priced against the implied spot and says so.
- The desk never recomputes `annualized`, `collateral`, `premium` (server-owned, `shared/flows-premium.js`); it prices only Win % and EV in the browser, so those two columns can legitimately be dashes where the card carries no GARCH law (`T("law-card")`) or no smile near the expiry (flat fit).
- Strategy `custom` legs are not repriced from URL prices; a link carries contracts and signed quantities only (`T("legs-link")`, `writeURL` :123).
- The page never writes a stylesheet, never touches storage, and ids on the pages (`ftHero`, `sgPayoffM`, `dkFrontierM`, `stName`, ...) plus metric slot labels (`slot("Max loss")`, `data-slot`) and aria-labels such as "About payoff" are used as hooks by flows-strategy.mjs, flows-ticker-contract, flows-track-render and flows-desk-client; renaming them is a test change.

**Observed oddities (not fixed, not tested unless stated).**
- `flows-track.js` uses the id `stCalib` twice: the Calibration module card (`UI.moduleCard({id:"stCalib"})` :730) and the inner chart div (`id: "stCalib"` :540). `paintOutcomes` finds the inner one through `cb.querySelector("#stCalib")` (:542), but `document.getElementById("stCalib")` returns the section.
- Dotted/hyphenated tickers (e.g. `BRK.B`) are accepted by `TICKER_RE`/`FLOWS_TICKER_RE`, but strategy `parseLeg` (:81-94) requires the OCC root to match `[A-Z0-9]+` and equal `st.t`, so a `legs=` URL for such a ticker does not parse (the stock leg `SYM@n` still does). The server route for `BRK.B` is exercised by flows-basis-contract :596 but not the legs round trip.
- Ticker URLs carry `&s=signal&from=...` from the board redirects (worker.js :3404-3405) and from tests, but `flows-ticker.js` ignores both; only `t` and the hash matter.
- `flows-ticker.js` sets `STATE.lastClosed` and `STATE.tapeLive` outside the `STATE` literal (:2914, :2847); both read as `undefined` until the first heartbeat/tape.
- AGENTS.md's File map has no rows for these four controllers or `flows-ticker.css` / `flows-tools.css` (they appear only inside test rows and prose); `docs/flows-audit-2026-09.md` :211-232 still cites `flows-strategy.js` findings from before the rewrite. DEPLOY.md has no section for these four pages themselves. It touches them only indirectly: `/flows/ticker/?t=PRU` at :925, the premium desk at :1223 and :1255, "the ticker page" at :1732, :2356, :2744 and :2822, and the data the Track page draws (the `scores:` and `scoretrack` keys) in section 10.5f at :1607.

**Ritual checklist for any edit in this area.**
1. `assets/version.txt` +1; `ASSET_VERSION` in `shared/flows-pages.js` :1; every other `?v=` (grep `'?v=240'`); then `grep -rn 'woff2?v=' --include=*.html --include=*.css .` and reset to `assets/fonts-version.txt`.
2. If a `shared/flows-quant-*` module changed: `node scripts/build-flows-quant-bundle.mjs` (both bundles).
3. Browser-only suites (no workerd): `cd tests && node flows-ticker-contract.mjs; node flows-card-contract.mjs; node flows-card-render.mjs; node flows-desk-client.mjs; node flows-desk-wiring.mjs; node flows-track-render.mjs; node flows-payload-shape.mjs; node flows-sign.mjs; node flows-weight.mjs; node flows-quant-card.mjs; node flows-reading-render.mjs` (set `PLAYWRIGHT_BROWSERS_PATH`). Server suites need `FLOWS_TEST_SANDBOX=1`: `flows-strategy`, `flows-desk-contract`, `flows-chain-contract`, `flows-worker-contract`, `flows-motion`, `flows-legacy-payload`. Do not run them for a mapping-only task.
4. Chain registration: all of the above are already in `tests/package.json` `test` (the single `&&` chain at line 9: `test:flows-desk`, `test:flows-desk-client`, `test:flows-desk-wiring`, `test:flows-ticker`, `test:flows-strategy`, `test:flows-track-render`, `test:flows-weight`, `test:flows-sign`, `test:flows-payload-shape`, `test:flows`, `test:flows-render`); a new suite must be added both as `test:<name>` and into that chain.
5. Source files carry no comments: put reasoning in the commit message, not in the code.

## Flows frontend: ask and unusual

Commit ba2acfe (origin/main after #148), asset version 240 (`assets/version.txt`), fonts token 230. Every line number below was taken with `grep -n` or `sed -n` at this commit.

### Purpose and boundaries

**What it is.** Two vanilla-JS IIFE page controllers, one stylesheet, and the cross-page table of every Flows page.

- `assets/js/flows-ask.js` (885 lines) is the Ask box. It runs in two modes chosen by `#askApp[data-mode="dock"]` (`DOCKED`, :10). Undocked it is the whole `/flows/ask/` page: greeting line, question box, answer card, the three-region briefing (`Since`, `Today`, `Next`) and the consistency-check card. Docked it is only the question box inside the right-hand rail that `flows-dock.js` opens on every other gated Flows page. It draws what the Worker's `/api/flows/ask`, `/brief`, `/summary` and `/ai-usage` routes return and computes no market figure itself; the wording rule "every figure is quoted from a payload" is in the copy (`GUARANTEE`, :384) and in `shared/flows-ask.js` `guardAnswer` (:1173).
- `assets/js/flows-unusual.js` (1000 lines) is the controller of `/flows/unusual/`. It joins two nightly or live payloads, `flowalerts` (the vendor's flagged windows, with the intraday record and the live `fl` stream) and `unusual` (volume-over-open-interest contract counter plus a volume-surprise name panel), into five module cards: Timeline (SVG bubble chart), Names, Urgency, Volume over OI, Surprise. It also draws the chip row, a side filter and a "Both feeds" join toggle.
- `assets/css/flows-ask.css` (344 lines) styles only the `ak-*` classes of the Ask controller. The dock chrome (`.ak-dock*`) and the neuron mark (`.ak-nn*`) are in `assets/css/flows.css`, not here (flows.css:1858-1945, :1118-1131, :1194). The unusual page's classes (`fu-*`, `fd-*`) are in `assets/css/flows-feeds.css` (527 lines; `fd-*` shared with Events and Political).
- `shared/flows-pages.js` (1046 lines) is the server-side HTML builder for every Flows page. This area owns only the page table (see "All Flows pages" under Data and interfaces); the file itself is mapped by area 30.

**What it is not / neighbours.**

**assets/css/flows-ask.css**: see File table; the major blocks are listed there. Container queries: `compose` (:21-22, :35), `answer` (:165-166, :184), `mod` (:337, declared in flows.css:1962).

### Data and interfaces

**Routes this area calls** (all GET unless noted; all behind the Flows session cookie `flows_session`; the `/api/flows/` prefix gate is worker.js:3601-3605: 401 JSON `unauthorized` when anonymous, method must be GET, or POST for `/api/flows/ask`)

| route | worker.js | used by | notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `POST /api/flows/ask` body `{question, subject}` | :3780, `askQuestion` :1864, `askSubject` :1859, `askAnswer` :1878 | Ask (page and dock) | `question` trimmed and cut to `ASK_QUESTION_MAX = 400` chars (:1245), empty gives 400 `no_question`, bad JSON 400 `bad_json`. `subject` accepted only if `^[A-Z][A-Z0-9.\-]{0,9}$` after upper-casing, else null. No `Origin` check in the route. GET gives 405. Reads D1 `flows_payload` id `brief` (+ live overlay) and `card:<subject>`; when a ticker is named in the question (`askTicker` worker.js:1836: only when the question contains at least one lowercase letter, the first all-caps 2-5 character token `\b[A-Z][A-Z0-9]{0,4}\b` not in `ASK_NOT_TICKERS` (:1834); an all-caps question falls back to `subject`) or supplied as `subject`, `askDossier` (:1844) also assembles the per-name dossier (`flows_dossier_cache` rows, Cache API entries and up to nine vendor calls, `askDossierFor` in shared/flows-reading-worker.js:252), failing soft to no extra facts. |
| `GET /api/flows/ai-usage` | :3720, `askSpend` :1259 | Ask meter | `{spend}` from D1 `flows_ai_usage` and `flows_ai_usage_model` for the UTC day (`aiDay` :1255). |
| `GET /api/flows/summary` (no `t`) | :3725 | Ask greeting (undocked only) | `{status, scope:"board", summary, llm, model, guard, generatedAt, provenance}`; pending envelope has `summary: null`. |
| `GET /api/flows/brief` | :3764 | Ask briefing (undocked only) | Stored `brief` + `briefWithLive` overlay (:1324) + `session: briefAge(...)`; headers `X-Payload-Updated`, `X-Fresh-*`, `X-Live-Overlay`. Pending shape `{status:"pending", today:null, yesterday:null, next:null, facts:[], silences}`. |
| `GET /api/flows/flowalerts` | :3652, `readWithOverlay` :2097 (`OVERLAID` :2095) | Unusual | Nightly record overlaid with `live:alerts` when present; `X-Live-Overlay` header. Pending `{status:"pending"}`. |
| `GET /api/flows/unusual` | :3690 | Unusual | `readServed("unusual")`, passthrough with `X-Payload-Updated` and `X-Fresh-*`; pending `{status:"pending"}`. |
| `GET /api/flows/card-x?t=T` | :3818 | Unusual Urgency | One call per board name, 3 lanes, at most 6 names; needs `alerts` (`status`, `asOf`, `n`, `complete`, `sweepShare`, `urgency`) or `scope`. |
| `GET /api/flows/now?k=alerts&n=flowalerts,unusual&...` | `serveNow` shared/flows-live-worker.js:871 | Unusual via `UI.heartbeat` | Returns changed keys `live:alerts`, `flowalerts`, `unusual`. |
| `GET /api/rt/ws`, `/api/rt/snap` | rail (area 35) | Unusual via `UI.rt.connect({topics:["fl"]})` | The rail's `fl` topic; the page behaves as before when the rail is `off`. |

Anonymous page requests do not 401: a gated page path renders `loginPage()` with status 200 at the same URL (worker.js:3428-3442). A page controller that gets 401 from an API call does `location.replace("/flows/")`.

**Payload fields the controllers read** (a field read that is missing from the emitted payload fails `tests/flows-payload-shape.mjs` for flows-unusual.js)

| payload | read by | fields |
|---|---|---|
| `brief` (`GET /api/flows/brief`) | flows-ask.js | `status`, `sessionDate`, `generatedAt`, `refreshedAt`, `session {stale, say}` (the payload also carries `expected`, which this client does not read), `today`, `yesterday`, `next` (each `{facts[], silences[], session or prior or origin, gateDays, isForecast}`), `facts[]` (`id`, `say`, `n`, `source`, `at`, `lead {label, keys[], unit, den{key,word}}`), `silences {pending, unreadable, quiet}` (`silenceList` iterates `SILENCE_ORDER` :181, those three buckets only; the payload built by `shared/flows-ask.js` :701-704 also has an `unavailable` bucket, which this client never draws), `warnings[] ({id, severity, say, sources})`, `warningsChecked`, `warningsQuestions`, `notes {measured, scope, silence, filings}`. |
| ask answer (`POST`) | flows-ask.js | `status` (`pending` or `unreadable`), `answer`, `llm`, `llmFailure`, `llmReason`, `llmCode`, `llmCalls`, `model`, `note`, `why`, `guard {ok, rejected[], numerals[], reason}`, `facts[]`, `silences`, `subject`, `subjectApplied`, `withheld`, `capped`, `session`, `spend`. Of these, the Worker's `askAnswer` (worker.js:1910-1990) sends `answer`, `llm` (a boolean), `guard`, `why`, `capped`, `withheld`, `subject`, `subjectApplied`, `facts`, `silences`, `model`, `note`, `spend`, `session`, and `llmFailure` only when the model call failed (:1965); `llmReason`, `llmCode` and `llmCalls` are read defensively by `llmBlock` (:222) and no route sends them, and the client ignores the `invented`, `forecast` and `mislabeled` members of the Worker's guard result (`guardAnswer`, shared/flows-ask.js:1173-1224). The Worker also sends `fallback`, `neuronFacts`, `dossierFacts`, `briefUpdatedAt`, `spendDisagrees`, which this client does not read. |
| `spend` | flows-ask.js `spendMeter` | `day`, `calls`, `tokensIn`, `tokensOut`, `allowanceNeurons` (10,000, the free daily allowance), `neurons`, `remaining`. The meter shows the free allowance, not the 30,000-neuron site cap. |
| `flowalerts` | flows-unusual.js | `status`, `rows[]` (`t`, `oc`, `cp`, `k`, `exp`, `prem`, `askPrem`, `sweep`, `opening`, `floor`, `spanStart`, `firstAt`, `rule`, `st`), `seen`, `shed`, `sessionDate`, `readAt`, `record {date, reads, everEntered, firstReadAt}`, `coverage {calls, puts}`, `notes {unit, selection, sides, flags, record, refusals}`, `vendorLimit`, `vendorTruncated`, `readLimit`, `readTruncated`, `generatedAt`. |
| `unusual` | flows-unusual.js | `status`, `sessionDate`, `generatedAt`, `readAt`, `namesSeen`, `namesTruncated`, `dteAnchor`, `volumeAsOfReason`, `coverage[] ({t})`, `contracts {rows[], shown, eligible, capBound}` (row: `t`, `cp`, `k`, `expiry`, `vol`, `oi`, `vor`, `doi`, `lift`, `nlo`, `nhi`, `st`), `names {rows[] ({t, sc, sp, st, chg, putCallRatio}), ranked, universe, unranked, shown, earningsGated}`, `basis {...}`. |
| `card-x:T` | flows-unusual.js `paintUrgency` | `status`, `scope` (`deep` or `carded`), `alerts {status, why, asOf, n, complete, sweepShare, urgency}`. |

**D1 tables touched (by the routes, not by the controllers).** `flows_payload` (ids `brief`, `unusual`, `flowalerts`, `card:T`, `card-x:T`), `flows_live` (`live:alerts`, `live:market` overlays), `flows_ai_usage (day PK, calls, tokens_in, tokens_out)`, `flows_ai_usage_model (day, model PK, same counters)` (migrations/0006, 0009; created again by `ensureFlowsTables`, worker.js:136-137), `flows_ai_summary` (board summary), `flows_clock`. Written by this area's routes: only `flows_ai_usage*` via `askRecordSpend` (worker.js:1299) after a model call.

**Caches and storage.** The controllers use no `localStorage`, no cookies of their own, no service worker. `FlowsUI` keeps an in-memory `INFO` popover registry swept at 600 entries (flows-ui.js:306-316). The Worker does not cache the `/api/flows/ask` response itself (`no-store`), but for a named ticker `askDossier` (worker.js:1844) goes through the dossier's own stores (`flows_dossier_cache` rows, Cache API entries for news, dark-pool levels and the quote, and the 30-second assembled copy); `/api/flows/brief` and the others are D1 reads.

**Env vars and secrets** (wrangler.toml [vars] unless noted): `FLOWS_ASK_MODEL = "@cf/zai-org/glm-4.7-flash"` (:43), `FLOWS_ASK_NEURONS = "5500,36400"` (:44), `FLOWS_ASK_FALLBACK_MODEL = "@cf/meta/llama-3.3-70b-instruct-fp8-fast"` (:45), `FLOWS_ASK_FALLBACK_NEURONS = "26668,204805"` (:46), `FLOWS_AI_DAILY_CAP_NEURONS = "30000"` (:47), `FLOWS_AI_DAILY_CAP_CALLS = "2500"` (:48), `FLOWS_READ_MODE` (:49, affects the dossier reading, not this page), binding `AI` (Workers AI), binding `DB` (D1 `iewt`), secrets `SESSION_SECRET`, `FLOWS_CREDENTIALS`, `FLOWS_PEPPER`, `FLOWS_INGEST_TOKEN` (write path for tests and pipeline). `UW_API_KEY` is never touched by the Unusual page (it costs zero vendor calls, DEPLOY.md 10.5d). Ask touches it only indirectly: for a named ticker `askDossier` (worker.js:1844) assembles the dossier through `dossierDeps` (:1696), whose vendor reads go through `uwFetch` (:2003, `Authorization: Bearer env.UW_API_KEY` at :2012); with no ticker (`askTicker` null) or no `env.DB` it returns no facts and calls nothing.

**Wire formats.** Ask request: `Content-Type: application/json`, body `{"question": "...", "subject": "NVDA" or null}`. Errors use the platform shape `{error:{code, message}}` and the client quotes `error.message` verbatim (flows-ask.js:810-814, held by tests/flows-ask-render.mjs). Streamed alert rows (`fl` topic) are `flowalerts` rows plus `id` and `ts`; the client deletes both fields and re-keys with `alertKey`.

**DOM contract (ids other code or tests find).** Server-rendered by `askPage` (flows-pages.js:887-907): `#fxTitle`, `#askHeadState`, `#askAbout` (button), `#askStatus` (role=status), `#askApp.ak-app`. Dock (flows-pages.js:185-198): `#askDock[data-src][data-css]`, `#askDockPanel`, `#askStatus`, `#askApp[data-mode="dock"]`, `#askDockTab`. Created by flows-ask.js: `#askBox`, `#askQ`, `#askForm`, `#askHint`, `#askExamples`, `#askOnPage`, `#askMeter`, `#askGreet`, `#askAnswer`, `#askBrief`, `#askChecksSlot`, `#askMore`, `#askChecks`, `#askYesterday`, `#askToday`, `#askNext`; classes `.ak-a`, `.ak-fact`, `.ak-example`, `.ak-ask-go`, `.ak-warns`, `.ak-region`. Server-rendered by `unusualPage` (flows-pages.js:746-779): `#uaStatus`, `#uaAbout` (hidden source of the About popover), `#uaChips`, `#uaFilters`, `#uaFilterNote`, `#uaMeta`, `#uaAboutSlot`, cards `#uaTimelineCard`, `#uaNamesCard`, `#uaUrgencyCard`, `#uaFeedCard`, `#uaSurpriseCard` with bodies `#uaTimeline`, `#uaNames`, `#uaUrgency`, `#uaFeed`, `#uaSurprise`. Tests select `.fu-b`, `.fu-crow[data-both]`, `.fu-nrow`, `.fu-toggle`, `.ui-seg-i`.

Page routing rules (worker.js): the table above is `FLOWS_ROUTES` (:3409-3427); GET and HEAD only; anonymous gets the login page with 200 (:3435-3437); `/flows/<name>` without the slash for the 13 listed names gets 308 to the slash form (:3444-3452); `/flows` gets 308 (:3337); `?t=` on `/flows/`, `/flows/long/`, `/flows/short/`, `/flows/watch/` gets a 302 to `/flows/ticker/?t=...&s=signal&from=<page>` (:3393-3407); any other `/flows/*` path throws `HttpError(404, "not_found")` (:3885-3887). There is no `/flows/overview/` route. The Ask dock (and so the lazy pull of `flows-ask.js` and `flows-ask.css`) is present on the 13 gated routes other than `/flows/ask/`, which is 12 page functions because `sidePage` serves both `/flows/long/` and `/flows/short/`; the weight test measures only `<script src>` tags, so the 68 KiB renderer is not counted against any dock route.

### Flows

**1. Load `/flows/ask/` (undocked).**
1. Worker `FLOWS_ROUTES["/flows/ask/"]` (worker.js:3419) gives `askPage` (flows-pages.js:887): head with `flows-ask.css`, `<div id="askApp" class="ak-app">`, scripts `flows-ui.js`, `flows-ask.js`.
2. `flows-ask.js` :4-6 exits silently if `FlowsUI` or `#askApp` is missing; builds the composer (:386-413) with grid layout; `paintExamples([])` :456.
3. `ON_PAGE` :455 reads `?t=` and shows the hint (:457).
4. Three requests start: `ai-usage` (:859) paints the meter; `summary` (:866) paints the greeting (first sentence, regex :873); `brief` (:880) calls `paintBrief` (:750).
5. `paintBrief` calls `UI.freshness({sessionDate, generatedAt, source:"brief"})` (:776), fills `#askChecksSlot` with `paintWarnings`, draws three `paintRegion` cards, replaces the first example with "What is new for X?" if a `card:X` source exists, writes the status line, fills `#askHeadState` and the `#askAbout` popover.

**2. Dock on any other page.** `dock()` (flows-pages.js:185) renders the closed panel with `#askApp[data-mode="dock"]` and loads `flows-dock.js`. First open (tab click or `?` key) runs `ensureRenderer` (flows-dock.js:16): appends the stylesheet, then a deferred script; `onload` focuses `#askQ`. `flows-ask.js` runs with `DOCKED = true`: composer (examples, hint, form, foot with meter and guarantee button), `ai-usage` request, `return` at :865. No brief, no summary, no `#askAbout`, no freshness pill.

**3. Ask a question.** form submit (:832) → empty: sentence "No question was typed..." (:837-841), nothing sent → else `setAsking(true)` + typing indicator → `post()` (:802) `POST /api/flows/ask {question, subject: ON_PAGE}` → worker: `askQuestion` (:1864) → read `brief` (:3785) → `briefWithLive` (:1324) → `askAnswer` (:1878): optional `card:<subject>` Neuron facts, `selectFacts` (cap 14), `askDossier`, `renderFactsPlain`, `askSpend`, then if `env.AI` and chain: `askModels(meteredAi(...))` (:1935) → `guardAnswer(generated, picked)` (:1976) → JSON with `llm`, `guard`, `spend`, `facts` → client `paintAnswer` (:501): spend meter refresh (:503), provenance tag, qualifiers, verdict paragraph, More toggle, name strip, fact grid, silences, example rebuild → `setAsking(false)`.
Failure paths: 401 sets `gated` and replaces location with `/flows/`; non-2xx quotes `error.message`; network failure uses the "failing to reach its route" sentence; the typing state is cleared in the final `.then`.

**4. Load `/flows/unusual/`.** `unusualPage` (flows-pages.js:746) → script order dock, ui, fresh, rt, unusual → `buildFilters` (:189), `wireInfos` (:816), `syncNote` (:145) → `Promise.all([loadAlerts(), loadFeed()])` (:987) → each `take*` classifies the payload and paints: `takeAlerts` (:831) rebuilds `alertKeys` (join key with `r.exp`), sets module states, calls `paintTimeline(true)`, `paintNames`, `paintUrgency`, `paintChips`, `paintFeed`, `paintMeta`, `paintStatus`, `syncNote`; `takeFeed` (:861) rebuilds `feedKeys` (join key with `r.expiry`), paints Feed and Surprise and repaints the alert-side modules → after both: `wireInfos`, `streamFlow()` (defined :979, called :989), seed `streamAlerts(UI.rt.alerts().rows, Date.now())` (:990), `UI.heartbeat({keys:["alerts"], nightly:["flowalerts","unusual"], page:"unusual", onChange})` (:992-998).

**5. Live alerts.** `UI.rt.connect({topics:["fl"]})` → on a frame, `streamAlerts(c.rows, c.at)` (:954): drop `id` and `ts`, key each row by `alertKey`, ignore keys already held, stamp `firstAt`, `lastAt`, `reads: 1`, union with the held rows sorted by `byPremium`, keep `ALERT_CAP` 180, set `seen` and `shed`, call `takeAlerts(next, "ok")`. Heartbeat: a changed `live:alerts` or `flowalerts` reloads alerts then re-merges the ring; a changed `unusual` reloads the feed.

**6. Filters.** Side control sets `view.side` (`all`, `C`, `P`), "Both feeds" toggles `view.both`; both call `repaint()` → Timeline (bubbles get `.is-off`, not removed), Names, Feed, note. "Both feeds" is true for a row only when its `ticker|cp|strike|expiry` key is in both `S.alertKeys` and `S.feedKeys`; with either feed not loaded it is false for every row. `#uaFilters` is `inert` unless at least one feed is ok.

**7. Urgency lanes.** `paintUrgency` (:509) draws immediately from `S.urgency`, then pushes unasked board names (≤ 6) into 3 async lanes that each `fetch("/api/flows/card-x?t=")` and call `draw()` after every answer; states set by `one()` (:548-563): a card-x that is not `pending`, has no `alerts` tape and whose `scope` is not `deep` is `shallow` (row hidden); `pending` (status pending); `unavailable` (no tape under a deep scope, or the fetch failed); the tape's own vendor status when `tape.status !== "ok"`; or `ok` with the tape; a tape dated before the session is marked stale.

### Invariants and traps

1. **Copy rules are tested, and the tests assert prose.** `tests/flows-ask-render.mjs` and the browser block of `tests/flows-ask.mjs` match regexes against sentences produced by `provenance` (:246), `answerHow` (:311), `paintWarnings` (:700), `spendMeter` (:350), `figureOf`, the empty-question text (:837), `failAnswer` and the example buttons. Reword any of them and run both suites; the key phrases include "nothing in it for the guard to check", "not a verification it passed", "This briefing carries 13", "unanswered rather than clear", "counting only this site's own calls", "Asking is still allowed", "failing to reach its route", "the name on this page", "What is new for X?".
2. **`flows-ask.js` must run with only `flows-ui.js` loaded.** The Ask page and the browser fixture (`tests/flows-ask.mjs` :887-892) load no `flows-fresh.js` or `flows-rt.js`; do not call `UI.freshFrom`, `UI.heartbeat` or `UI.rt` from it.
3. **The renderer is loaded lazily on purpose.** `tests/flows-weight.mjs` :137-145 requires `flows-ask.js` (68,416 B) to be larger than the spare headroom of every dock route (largest spare today 938 B), "the whole reason the dock defers it". Never add a `<script src="flows-ask.js">` to a dock route in `flows-pages.js`; never turn the `data-src` into a counted tag.
4. **Weight ceilings leave almost no room.** `askPage` spare 903 B, `unusualPage` spare 163 B (and desk 173, side/watch 190, events 241). Any growth in `flows-unusual.js`, `flows-ui.js`, `flows-fresh.js`, `flows-rt.js` or `flows-dock.js` fails `flows-weight` on the unusual page; raising `CEILING_KIB.unusualPage` (tests/flows-weight.mjs:22) is meant to look like a decision in the diff. CSS is not counted.
5. **Asset ritual.** Any edit under `assets/css`, `assets/js` or `assets/data` requires: increment `assets/version.txt` (240 now), update every `?v=` reference and `ASSET_VERSION` in `shared/flows-pages.js:1` (held equal by `tests/flows-features.mjs` :845-849), then re-run `tests/contracts.mjs` (it compares changed files with the token). A blanket `?v=` rewrite also hits the 16 woff2 references; reset them to `assets/fonts-version.txt` (230) per AGENTS.md. Because flows-ask.css and flows-ask.js are fetched by URL from `data-src` / `data-css`, forgetting the bump leaves dock users on the cached immutable file for a year.
6. **Payload-shape scan covers flows-unusual.js.** `tests/flows-payload-shape.mjs` :39 and :44 read the whole file for `payload.<field>` and `alerts.<field>` and require each field to exist at the root of the pipeline's dry-run `unusual` and `flowalerts` payloads (or be assigned or annotated in the file). Adding `payload.newField` before the pipeline publishes it fails CI. Both `flows-unusual.js` entries are whole-file scans (`fn: null`, no `at`), for which the suite's binding check is skipped (`ok(bound || !(surf.fn || surf.at))`, flows-payload-shape.mjs:128), so renaming `payload` or `alerts` is not caught by name: the only guard is `ok(reads.size > 0)` (:163), which fails only if no `<var>.<field>` read is left at all. A partial rename silently removes those reads from the scan. The regex also matches `S.payload.x` and `S.alerts.rows`. flows-ask.js has no such scan, so a typo there is silent.
7. **Client and server twins must stay equal.** `alertKey` and `SEP` (flows-unusual.js:947-950) mirror `shared/flows-alerts.js:197-207`; `ALERT_CAP = 180` (:952) mirrors `MERGED_ALERT_ROWS` (:209); `byPremium` (:951) mirrors the shared ordering (null premium last, ticker tie-break). Break one and streamed rows duplicate or reorder against the nightly record (`tests/flows-rt-client.mjs` section `unusual` from :903 counts "three windows, not four"). The ticker pattern `^[A-Z][A-Z0-9.\-]{0,9}$` exists in worker.js:933 and :1861, flows-ask.js:453, shared/flows-ask.js:977 and :1352 (also the looser all-caps token scan `TICKER` at :943) and flows-ticker.js `readTicker`; widen all or none (`tests/flows-ask.mjs` :1354-1370 holds `BRK.B` and `RDS-A`).
8. **Banned vocabulary on the unusual page.** `tests/contracts.mjs` :1190-1209 renders `unusualPage` and fails if any of `print|trade|block|sweep|bought|sold|paid|whale|smart money|institutional` (`UA_BANNED_CLAIMS`, shared/flows-unusual.js:10-11) appears outside the `<p class="flows-lede">` paragraphs (or a `<section id="uaBasisPanel">`, an allowance in both scans that no page source emits any more). `tests/flows-worker-contract.mjs` :294-308 runs the same scan over the markup the booted Worker serves. The scan covers shared shell, rail, topbar and dock markup because they are served on this route. `tests/flows-unusual-contract.mjs` :602 applies a similar ban to payload prose. The controller itself legitimately prints "Sweep" labels (Names column :468, chips :781, Urgency :542) because those are the vendor's `has_sweep` flag on flagged windows, not a claim about the counter feed; keep that distinction.
9. **The counter has no date.** `unusual.volumeAsOf` is null and the page may not say "today" or "the day's" about it (DEPLOY.md 10.5d). `feedInfo` (:644-673) states this; `sessionDate` is legal only for `dte`. Do not attach a session to counter rows. `tests/flows-worker-contract.mjs` :310-317 fails the served page if its own words (the sidebar `<aside class="fx-side">` set aside) match `today|this session|the day's`.
10. **"Both feeds" semantics.** The join key is the 4-tuple `ticker|cp|strike|expiry` from `joinKey` (:57); alerts use field `exp`, the feed uses `expiry`. A strike that is `NaN`, missing or a non-finite expiry gives `null` and never matches. `passes` (:135) returns false for every row while `view.both` is on and either key set is `null` (with "Both feeds" off the key sets are not consulted and only the side filter applies).
11. **Timeline geometry is tested.** `tests/flows-unusual-contract.mjs` requires one viewBox unit per CSS pixel (SVG width attribute is a pixel count, not `100%`), exactly one bubble per window that states a time, no horizontal overflow at 320 px, and keyboard reach (`Home`, `ArrowRight`) with Eastern-time readout ("9:31 AM"). `timeOf` (:213) only trusts `spanStart` on the session day, or `firstAt` between 04:00 and 20:00 ET.
12. **Time-bomb guard.** `tests/contracts.mjs` :873-905 (`ANCHORED` :873, assert :899) fails any workerd suite that holds an ISO date in the next 400 days that is not listed in `ANCHORED`; `flows-unusual-contract.mjs` is anchored only for `2026-10-16`. Do not add a new future date to it or to `flows-ask-render.mjs`.
13. **Dock key rule.** `tests/contracts.mjs` :1119-1154 forbids any script sharing a document with the dock from binding a bare printable `.key === "x"` (the dock owns `?`). flows-ask.js only listens for `Enter` on the textarea; flows-unusual.js uses arrow keys on its chart element, not on `document`.
14. **401 behaviour differs by call.** `get()` and `post()` in flows-ask.js and `loadAlerts` / `loadFeed` in flows-unusual.js send the browser to `/flows/` on 401 and then stop painting (`gated` flag in Ask). Nothing retries.
15. **Sweeping the popover registry.** `FlowsUI.info()` deletes unattached builders when the registry passes 600 (flows-ui.js:311-313); a single answer registers at most a few dozen, so it is safe, but a loop that created hundreds of chips before attaching them would lose popovers.
16. **Lazy CSS side effects.** On dock pages `flows-ask.css` is appended after the page CSS, so its global-looking rules (`.flows-body .flows-main > .visually-hidden` at :8, `.ak-head`, `.ak-app`) apply to that page too; keep rules prefixed `ak-` to avoid leaking.
17. **Docs versus source.** (a) AGENTS.md's file map lists none of `flows-ask.js`, `flows-unusual.js`, `flows-ask.css`, `flows-dock.js`; none of the four paths is named anywhere in AGENTS.md (`flows-dock` not at all); only the suites `flows-ask` (:841), `flows-ask-render` (:1008) and `flows-unusual-contract` (:1013) appear in its suite lists; `shared/flows-pages.js` is named only in the asset-versioning section (AGENTS.md:701 and :719), also not in the file map. (b) DEPLOY.md 10.5d says the page controller's own suite greps the rendered DOM for the banned words; the suites actually scan the server-rendered HTML (contracts.mjs :1190-1209 in Node, and flows-worker-contract.mjs :294-308 over the booted Worker's response, which is the part DEPLOY.md does name) and payload prose (flows-unusual-contract.mjs :602), and no DOM scan exists. (c) `docs/flows-audit-2026-09.md` :207 and :226 say the Ask footer is always empty because `buildBrief` returns only `{today, yesterday, next}`; stale: `buildBrief` (:353) now returns `notes` (shared/flows-brief.js:358-369) and flows-ask.js:792 reads them into the About popover. (d) That audit cites `flows-ask.js:1403` and `flows-unusual.js:162`; the files are now 885 and 1000 lines. (e) The source carries no comments by project rule; this is convention only (no test fails on a comment, `tests/flows-strip.mjs` checks that stripping is idempotent and parseable).
18. **The guarantee copy is stronger than the route.** `GUARANTEE` (flows-ask.js:384) and the dock's "answers from the payloads this site has already published ... places no vendor call" are shown to the reader; `askAnswer` (worker.js:1898) can, for a named ticker, assemble the dossier, which reads D1 caches and may call the vendor (AGENTS.md "Flows reading": Ask adds up to ten dossier facts; "Flows dossier": vendor fan-out capped at nine calls). The client does not read `dossierFacts` or `neuronFacts` and has no `dossier:` branch in `figureOf`, so those facts render through the generic numeric fallback (:146-149). If the copy is ever tightened to match, change `GUARANTEE`, `tests/flows-ask*.mjs` assertions (`/It reads nothing live/` at flows-ask.mjs:1293-1296 and flows-ask-render.mjs:480) and the DEPLOY.md text together. Third-party strings (company descriptions, headlines) reach `fact.say`, so keep every insertion on `h()` text nodes: neither controller uses `innerHTML`, `insertAdjacentHTML` or `outerHTML` (grep count 0), and `h` (flows-ui.js:159) appends strings as text.
19. **Test hygiene facts.** `flows-ask` needs Chromium but no workerd; `flows-ask-render` and `flows-unusual-contract` boot workerd (`startWorker`), so in the agent sandbox run them with `FLOWS_TEST_SANDBOX=1` and set `PLAYWRIGHT_BROWSERS_PATH`. `flows-unusual-contract` also spawns `scripts/flows-pipeline.mjs --dry-run --emit tests/.unusual-emit/` at start and removes the directory afterwards. `flows-ask.mjs` prints its `✓` summary at :1919 but more blocks (fingerprint, CPU child processes) run after it, so a failure can follow the summary line. Chain positions in `tests/package.json` `test`: contracts 1, flows-worker 16, flows-rt-client 18, flows-motion 29, flows-unusual 32, flows-payload-shape 34, flows-weight 55, flows-brief 58, flows-ask 59, flows-ask-render 60 (of 77); the chain stops at the first failure, so a late suite can hide behind an early one.

### How to change it

Run server suites in the sandbox as `cd tests && FLOWS_TEST_SANDBOX=1 node <suite>.mjs`; do the asset ritual (invariant 5) for every edit under `assets/`.

| change | edit | then |
|---|---|---|
| Reword an Ask answer disclosure, provenance tag or failure sentence | `provenance` :246, `answerHow` :311, `countSaid` :279, `LLM_REASONS` :216, `failAnswer` :824, submit handler :837-856 | `node flows-ask.mjs` (Chromium), `FLOWS_TEST_SANDBOX=1 node flows-ask-render.mjs`; update the asserted regexes in the same commit. |
| Draw a new kind of fact as a tile or chip | add an id branch in `figureOf` :80 (or a `NEURON_LABEL` :71 entry for `neuron:T/key`); the fact id comes from `shared/flows-ask.js` (`maker`, `briefSectionFact` :727) or `shared/flows-neuron.js:1498`; if the fact should render from a spec, publish `lead {label, keys[], den}` (shared/flows-brief.js:42-49) and use the :141 path | add a case to the `ask(page, {...facts...})` blocks in `tests/flows-ask.mjs` (see the SYN7 block near :1406); run `flows-ask`, `flows-brief`. |
| Change a briefing region or add one | `REGIONS` :621-643 (`slot` must be a key of the brief payload), `paintRegion` :658, grid CSS `.ak-brief` in flows-ask.css:241-252; payload side in `shared/flows-brief.js` `buildBrief` (:353) | `flows-brief`, `flows-ask`, `flows-ask-render`. |
| Add a consistency-check word or mark | `WARN_WORD` :694, `WARN_MARK` :693 (id format `kind:what`); the checks themselves are in `shared/flows-warnings.js` `assess` | `flows-warnings`, `flows-ask-render` (it asserts clean-bill sentences). |
| Change the credit meter | `spendMeter` :350, `ring` :344; numbers come from `spendShape` (shared/flows-ai.js:167) via `askSpend` (worker.js:1259) | `flows-ask-render` meter block (`meterOf` :256, cases :284-348) asserts `data-fill` 84.1 for 8,412 of 10,000 and the withheld and unreadable variants; `flows-neuron`/`flows-reads-contract` if the shape changes. |
| Change what the question box sends or how the Worker reads it | `post` :802, `pageTicker` :448; worker `askQuestion` :1864, `askSubject` :1859, `ASK_QUESTION_MAX` :1245 | `flows-worker-contract` (:386-538), `flows-reads-contract` (:764-765 row ceilings 9 and 28), `flows-ask`. |
| Change example prompts or on-page hint | `EXAMPLE_TOPICS` / `EXAMPLE_SHORT` :425-426, `paintExamples` :438, hint :457-463 | `flows-ask` asserts exactly three examples with no static ticker in them and pressing one fills but never sends. |
| Dock behaviour (open key, panel) | `flows-dock.js` (area 50) and flows.css:1858-1945; markup in `dock()` / `dockTab()` flows-pages.js:180-198 | `contracts.mjs` key scan, `flows-ask-render` dock block (`?` opens, caret lands in `#askQ`). |
