## Tests A (names sorting before flows-l)

Snapshot: `/home/user/anilkaya.org` at `ba2acfe` (origin/main after PR 148), asset version `240`, fonts token `230`. Every line number below comes from `grep -n` / `sed -n` / `cat -n` on that commit. "L123" means line 123 of the file named in the row or heading. All paths are relative to the repo root unless they start with `tests/`.

### Purpose and boundaries

What this area is: the first half (by file name) of the `tests/` directory. It holds the repo-wide static contract suite (`contracts.mjs`), the academy contract, the Flows suites from `flows-alerts-contract` to `flows-garch`, the helper modules those suites share (`board-shift`, `desk-fixtures`, `dossier-fixtures`, `dossier-harness`), the twelve committed `fixtures-*.json` data files and the two Python generators (`gen-desk-lab.py`, `gen-dossier-fixtures.py`). Total: 40 files. The `gen-*.py` files sort after `flows-l` in byte order; they are mapped here because the assignment names them.

What it is not (owned by the "Tests B" part): `flows-l*` onward (`flows-legacy-payload`, `flows-legs-contract`, `flows-live-contract`, `flows-market-contract` ... `flows-ws-probe-contract`), `placement-contract`, `mastery-contract`, `markets-contract`, `market-ticker-render`, `regression`, `worker-regression`, and the shared helpers `worker-server.mjs`, `live-stubs.mjs`, `lk-mock.mjs`, `rt-fixtures.mjs`, `reading-archetypes.mjs`, plus `tests/package.json` and `package-lock.json`. I read `worker-server.mjs` only to document `startWorker`, which four in-scope suites call.

How the area runs: there is no test framework. Every suite is a plain ES-module script (`"type": "module"`, Node >= 22.13 per `tests/package.json` `engines`) that uses `node:assert/strict`, increments a local `checks` counter through tiny `ok` / `eq` / `same` / `near` wrappers, throws on the first failure and prints one `✓ <name>: N assertions - ...` summary line at the end. Exceptions to that summary shape: `contracts.mjs` has no counter and prints `✓ contracts: <topics> curricula, <refs> versioned assets at ?v=<n>, <fonts> font references at ?v=<n>, session hardening` (L1211); `academy-contract.mjs` has no counter and prints `Academy contract OK: 12 courses, 365 stages, 84 skills, 252 challenge variants, 3 verified synthetic snapshots.` (L122); `flows-dossier-reads.mjs` prints `flows-dossier-reads: N checks passed` with no check mark (L569); `flows-garch.mjs` names its counter `n`, not `checks` (L288). `npm test` (tests/package.json) is one `&&` chain of 77 `npm run test:*` steps, so the first failure hides every suite behind it. CI (`.github/workflows/regression.yml`) runs on push to main, pull requests, dispatch and a Monday 06:17 UTC cron: checkout with `fetch-depth: 0`, `npm ci`, `npx playwright install --with-deps chromium`, `wrangler deploy --dry-run`, then `npm test` with `ASSET_DIFF_BASE` set to the PR base SHA (or the push's `before`), 40-minute job timeout. Neither Python generator runs in CI.

The area's three execution shapes (this is the thing to know before running anything):

| Shape | Suites in this area | What they need |
|---|---|---|
| Node only, no browser, no server | contracts, academy-contract, flows-alerts-contract, flows-auth-contract, flows-basis-contract, flows-brief, flows-card-contract, flows-chain-panels, flows-dossier-contract, flows-dossier-reads, flows-features, flows-freshness-contract, flows-garch | Node 22.13+; dossier-reads also needs `node:sqlite` and runs under `--disable-warning=ExperimentalWarning` |
| Chromium via `page.route` stubs, no workerd | flows-ask (browser half), flows-card-render, flows-desk-client, flows-desk-wiring, flows-events-contract | Playwright 1.61.1 Chromium (`PLAYWRIGHT_BROWSERS_PATH` in the sandbox) |
| Real `wrangler dev` workerd (`startWorker`) + Chromium or fetch | flows-ask-render, flows-board-render, flows-chain-contract, flows-desk-contract | `FLOWS_TEST_SANDBOX=1` in the agent sandbox, otherwise the run can hang until killed |

Neighbours: `shared/*` (the units under test), `worker.js` (imported into Node by `flows-basis-contract` and, through `dossier-harness`, by `flows-dossier-reads`; run under workerd by ask-render, board-render, chain-contract and desk-contract), `scripts/flows-pipeline.mjs` (spawned with `--dry-run --emit` and imported), `assets/js/*` (loaded into `vm` contexts or served to Chromium), `schema.sql` + `migrations/*.sql`, `wrangler.toml`, `_headers`, `.assetsignore`, `.gitignore`, `sitemap.xml`, `lab/*.html`, `docs/uw-openapi.yaml`.

D1 tables: `schema.sql` is loaded into `node:sqlite` by `dossier-harness.fakeD1` and into wrangler's local D1 by `startWorker` (`wrangler d1 execute iewt --local --file schema.sql`). Tables read or written directly by in-scope code: `flows_payload` (ids `universe`, `card:EXMP`, `card-x:EXMP`, `regime`, `events`, `roster`, `news`, `brief`), `flows_live` (`live:strips|market|alerts|news`), `flows_tape`, `flows_clock`, `flows_dossier_cache (ticker, kind)` (rows <= 8 KiB; kinds analysts, earnings, fundamentals, identity, positioning). `academy-contract` and `flows-dossier-contract` also scan `schema.sql` and migrations 0001, 0002, 0004, 0005, 0010, 0015, 0016 as text.

Caches: the Cache API fake in `dossier-harness` holds entries keyed `https://flows-dossier.internal/news/<T>` and `.../assembled/<T>` (the 30 s assembled copy; `dropHot()` deletes keys containing `/assembled/`).

### Flows

1. `npm test` in CI: checkout (full history) -> `npm ci` in `tests/` -> Chromium install -> `wrangler deploy --dry-run` -> `npm test` = `test:contracts` first (chain #1) ... `test:flows` (features, auth, card, premium) at #4 ... `test:flows-dossier-reads` #74 ... `test:flows-reading-render` #77. Nothing is parallel.

2. Asset-bump gate (`contracts.mjs`):
   `diffBase = ASSET_DIFF_BASE || git rev-parse origin/main` (L921-927) -> `git diff --name-only diffBase --` plus untracked files (L969-971) -> if any path matches `^assets/(css|js|data)/` then `Number(assets/version.txt) > assetVersionAt(diffBase)` (L973-977); if any path matches `^assets/fonts/` (not `.md`/`.txt`) then `fonts-version.txt` must exceed its value at the base (L978-982). Separately every `?v=` on `/assets/*.css|js` in `articles/**`, `lab/**`, `index.html`, `404.html` must equal `assets/version.txt`, and every `.woff2` URL (base.css `@font-face` + Inter preloads) must equal `assets/fonts-version.txt` (L338-354). `flows-features.mjs:848` separately holds `ASSET_VERSION` in `shared/flows-pages.js:1` equal to `assets/version.txt` (Flows pages are not in the contract's document list).

3. Dry-run emit consumers (`flows-card-render`, `flows-events-contract`):
   `execFileSync(node, scripts/flows-pipeline.mjs --dry-run --emit <dir>/)` (card-render L15, events L34) -> pipeline writes one file per published key via `EMIT.replace(/\.json$/,"") + "-" + key.replace(":","-") + ".json"` (pipeline L3059) -> test reads `-card-<T>.json` (regex `^-card-[A-Z][A-Z0-9.\-]*\.json$` excludes `card-x`), `-card-x-<T>.json`, `-hist-<T>.json`, `-events.json`. events uses `tests/.events-emit` (git-ignored by `tests/.*/`, `.gitignore:16`) and deletes it in `finally`; card-render uses an OS temp dir.

4. `startWorker` suites (`ask-render`, `board-render`, `chain-contract`, `desk-contract`):
   `startWorker({extraVars})` (worker-server.mjs:155) -> free port -> temp persist dir -> `wrangler d1 execute iewt --local --file schema.sql` -> (sandbox: stage Git-visible tree) -> `wrangler dev --local` with test vars -> wait for the port, warm `GET /` -> suite signs a session with `signSession({sub:"anilkaya", aud:"flows", epoch:"1", exp}, SESSION_SECRET)` -> seeds via `POST /api/flows/ingest` with the bearer -> drives Chromium or fetch -> `server.stop()` kills the process group.

5. Dossier harness path (`flows-dossier-reads`, and `reading-worker` in Tests B):
   `world()` (dossier-reads:25) -> `fakeD1()` + `F.seed(f)` -> stubs reset -> `client(f.D1)` signs session and imports a new `worker.js?dossier=N` -> `get("/api/flows/dossier?t=EXMP")` -> worker runs `assembleDossier` (shared/flows-dossier-worker.js) -> one `DOSSIER_SQL` batch on the fake D1 (counted as a trip) -> vendor fan-out hits `fetch` -> `vendorStub` on host `uw.test` -> background writes in `ctx.waitUntil` -> `await r.settle()` -> assertions read `f.trips`, `f.rowsRead()`, `stub.calls`, `cache.store`.

6. Fixture regeneration:
   - `python3 tests/gen-dossier-fixtures.py` (cwd-independent, uses `ROOT`): reads `docs/uw-openapi.yaml` (sha256 recorded), builds 13 bodies, validates each against the operation's 200 schema, writes `tests/fixtures-dossier-vendor.json` (`indent=1`, sorted keys, trailing newline); then `flows-dossier-contract.mjs:140-148` fails if the spec's hash no longer matches the recorded one.
   - `cd tests && python3 gen-desk-lab.py` (writes to the current directory, so it must run from `tests/`): mpmath + scipy; writes the minified `fixtures-desk-lab.json`, which `flows-desk-wiring.mjs` consumes.

7. Course/academy data path under test: `curriculum*.js` -> `node scripts/generate-course-payloads.mjs` -> `assets/data/courses/<id>.json`, `assets/data/courses/<id>/manifest.json` + `<module>.json`, `assets/js/{review-catalog,stage-catalog,lab-suite.bundle}.js`, `shared/{course-points,course-seo,review-manifest,stage-manifest,skill-manifest}.js` -> `contracts.mjs` L48-152 compares all of them; `labBundle.includes(<source>.trim())` for `course-catalog, skill-catalog, stage-catalog, mastery, skill-mastery, storage, gamify, auth` (L294-297; bundle composition: generate-course-payloads.mjs:314-316).

### Invariants and traps

Doc/source disagreements found (source wins):
- AGENTS.md's curriculum section says seven courses, `schemaVersion: 1` payloads and a 14 KiB gzip cap per payload. The source has 12 topics and 365 stages (`TOPIC_META`: ols 20, iv2sls 31, did 29, var 30, panel 30, logit 32, gmm 33, foundations/mle/forecast/coint/financial 32 each), payload `schemaVersion: 2` (contracts.mjs:131), a per-course `manifest.json` plus per-module files each capped at 6,144 bytes gzip (L150), 84 skills and 252 challenge variants (academy-contract:16, 49).
- AGENTS.md says `flows-card-render` "renders through `page.setContent`". It does not: no test in `tests/` calls `setContent`; the suite runs the pipeline dry run as a child process and uses `page.route` plus `page.goto("https://example.test/flows/ticker/?t=...")` (card-render:15, 72).
- `flows-chain-panels.mjs` prints `✓ flows-chain:` (L877), the same label as `flows-chain-contract.mjs`; a CI log line does not identify which one ran.
- `flows-events-contract.mjs` is on AGENTS.md's "no server" list and that is true, but it launches Chromium four times; set `PLAYWRIGHT_BROWSERS_PATH` like the other browser suites.

Traps (each is held by evidence in this area):
1. **Asset bump is mandatory and cross-checked three ways.** Any change under `assets/css|js|data` needs `assets/version.txt` bumped, every `?v=` in static HTML/CSS moved, `shared/flows-pages.js:1` `ASSET_VERSION` moved (flows-features.mjs:848), and `data-asset-version` in `lab/course.html`, `lab/review/index.html`, `lab/placement/index.html` (contracts.mjs:335-337). The font tokens must not move with it: a blanket rewrite breaks the `woff2` assertions (contracts.mjs:349). The gate only works with full Git history (`fetch-depth: 0`) or `ASSET_DIFF_BASE`; without a base the check is silently skipped (`if (diffBase)` at L968).
2. **`lab-suite.bundle.js` is generated and verified by inclusion.** Editing `course-catalog, skill-catalog, stage-catalog, mastery, skill-mastery, storage, gamify, auth` under `assets/js/` without re-running `node scripts/generate-course-payloads.mjs` fails contracts.mjs:294-297. `localStorage` may appear only in `storage.js` and `lab-suite.bundle.js` (L356-360).
3. **Nothing outside `IEWTStorage` touches storage and the reset ordering is pinned** (DELETE waits behind the in-flight PUT, carries no `X-IEWT-Generation`, local state clears only after server success; failed reset keeps local data): contracts.mjs:643-723.
4. **`_headers` must equal the Worker's `SECURITY_HEADERS`** parsed from `worker.js` by the regex `/const SECURITY_HEADERS = \{([^}]*)\}/` (contracts.mjs:847); a reformatted object literal breaks the test. Every entry under `assets/` needs its own `_headers` rule (L864-866), `.assetsignore` must not list `_headers` or `_*`, `.gitignore` must keep `!_headers`, and `wrangler.toml` must keep `run_worker_first = ["/*", "!/assets/*"]` and `html_handling = "auto-trailing-slash"` verbatim (L826, L871).
5. **Compatibility date ceiling.** `wrangler.toml` `compatibility_date` (2026-07-08) must not exceed miniflare's `supportedCompatibilityDate`, which is also 2026-07-08 at the pinned wrangler 4.110.0 (contracts.mjs:907-914). Raising it requires bumping wrangler first.
6. **Future-dated fixtures in server suites rot.** Any ISO date in the next 400 days inside a file that calls `startWorker(` must be in `ANCHORED` or the suite fails on the day the calendar reaches it (contracts.mjs:872-906). Current allow-list: flows-desk-contract (2026-10-16, 11-05, 11-20, 12-18), flows-market-contract (10-16, 10-30), flows-overview-contract (10-16), flows-unusual-contract (10-16), flows-worker-contract (10-16, 09-29, 10-20). Build dates from the clock (as `flows-strategy` does) instead.
7. **No absolute home paths in any tracked `.js`/`.mjs`.** The scan (contracts.mjs:1096-1117) matches `/home/<user>/<name>` and needs > 40 files; scratch probes that hardcode a sandbox path fail it.
8. **Source-scan couplings (exact text patterns).** These break on harmless-looking refactors:
   - `worker.js` must keep `const SECURITY_HEADERS = {...}`, `FLOWS_MAX_PAYLOAD_BYTES = 128 * 1024` (alerts L690 regex, L691 assertion; worker.js:923), the `if (path === "/api/flows/ingest")` ... `if (path.startsWith("/api/flows/"))` bracket in which every `INSERT INTO flows_payload` must sit (alerts L504-513), no `async function refreshFlowsIntraday`, and `FLOWS_DOSSIER.DOSSIER_SCHEMA_SQL` in the lazy schema (dossier-contract L591).
   - `shared/flows-live.js` must keep the literal `"live:alerts": spec("breadth", "actions", <N> * 1024` and the exact empty-read guards inside `mergeLiveAlerts` (alerts L477-497 for the guards, L692 for the `spec(` regex; shared/flows-live.js:19).
   - `scripts/flows-legs/live.mjs` must write `put("live:alerts"` exactly once behind `if (merged.write) await put("live:alerts", merged.write);` and expose `readHeldAlerts` (alerts L498-503, L808-812); `scripts/flows-pipeline.mjs` must contain `publish("flowalerts"` once and `nightlyAlerts(alerts, await readHeldAlerts(readStored, sessionDate)` (alerts L804-817) and the `spot-exposures/strike` request with `limit: SPOT_EXPOSURE_PAGE` (card-contract L1487-1488).
   - `assets/js/flows-ticker.js` must keep `const RICHNESS_LINE = 0.1;` (line 265), equal to `shared/flows-card.js:371` and `STATE_LINES.VRP_RELATIVE`, and every `["Band", ...]` row must use `richnessBand(pm)` (card-contract L665-675); card-render also fails on any `class: "x" + (c ? "y" : "z")` that glues two class names without a space (L36-42).
   - `assets/js/flows-ask.js` must not contain the string `To gamma flip` (brief.mjs:371).
   - `assets/js/flows-desk.js` exposes `globalThis.__FlowsDeskTest = Object.freeze({TENORS, parseBuyingPower, sizeRow, netDelta, frontierOf})` only when `typeof document === "undefined"` (flows-desk.js:51-52); desk-client asserts it is frozen (L19).
   - `wrangler.toml` `crons` must contain the market-hours clock `"<m>-59/<step> 13-21 * * MON-FRI"`, `RTH_CRON` and `FOCUS_CRON` from `shared/flows-live-worker.js`, a half-hour housekeeping cron firing at minutes [0,30] and a summary cron firing at [15,45]; `REFRESH_CADENCE_MINUTES` must equal the step (freshness-contract L269-310). Current value: `["1-59/5 13-21 * * MON-FRI", "3-58/5 13-21 * * MON-FRI", "*/30 * * * *", "15,45 * * * *"]`.
   - `assets/js/flows-fresh.js`, `flows-ui.js` are loaded into a `vm` by freshness-contract (the helper API `FlowsUI.freshness`, `.heartbeat` is part of the contract).
9. **Dossier fixtures are tied to the vendor spec by hash.** If `docs/uw-openapi.yaml` changes, `flows-dossier-contract` fails until `python3 tests/gen-dossier-fixtures.py` is re-run and the diff read (L140-148). The reducers may read only fields in `VENDOR.documented[op]`, and each read field must appear in `scripts/flows-probe-list.json` `reads[op]` and `expect[op]`; `probeList.gated` must still mark the profile and earnings-estimates routes as 403 (L166-182). `schema.sql`, `migrations/0016_flows_dossier_cache.sql` and `DOSSIER_SCHEMA_SQL` must declare the same table after whitespace normalisation (L588-597). No statement in `DOSSIER_SQL` may use `json_each` (dossier-reads L61).
10. **Table parity.** `academy-contract.mjs:114-120` asserts the tables created by migrations 0001, 0002, 0004, 0005, 0010, 0015, 0016 are exactly the tables in `schema.sql`. A new table needs the migration, the `schema.sql` entry, and a new `read("migrations/00NN_*.sql")` + `tablesIn()` in that list. Migrations 0006-0009 create `flows_ai_usage`, `flows_ai_summary`, `flows_neuron`, `flows_ai_usage_model`, which are not in `schema.sql` and not in that list (they are first-use DDL in the Worker). Credential words (`password|passwd|hash|secret|pepper|token`) must not appear in the Flows, live, ledger or dossier-cache migrations (L98-113).
11. **`dossier-harness` fakes can mislead.** `cacheFake` treats a response without `max-age` as already expired; `vendorStub` only intercepts host `uw.test` (a different `UW_BASE` goes to the real network); `client()` imports a new module instance per call so module-level state does not leak, but `shiftClock` replaces `Date` globally until restored; the `HTMLRewriter` shim at harness L6 is needed because `worker.js` references it.
12. **Server suites hang, they do not fail, when run wrongly.** Without `FLOWS_TEST_SANDBOX=1` in the agent sandbox, `startWorker` runs `wrangler dev` against the repo root and can wedge on symlink loops until the outer timeout; ask-render, board-render, chain-contract and desk-contract are the in-scope suites affected (AGENTS.md "Which suites need the dev server").
13. **Live-dependent clocks.** `flows-freshness-contract` compares the arithmetic Eastern clock to ICU for `YEAR_NOW-1 .. YEAR_NOW+6` at every half hour (needs full ICU data) and walks every NYSE holiday 2026-2032, but `NYSE_PUBLISHED` pins only 2026-2028; a calendar change must update that table (table L145-152, compared with `nyseHolidays` / `nyseEarlyCloses` at L154-163). Server suites run on the real clock (`UW_NOW` only pins the vendor read clock); node-only suites use `shiftClock`.
14. **Opt-in screenshots and temp dirs.** `DESK_SHOTS=<dir>` writes PNGs; `flows-events-contract` writes and removes `tests/.events-emit` inside the repo (a crash leaves an ignored directory); `flows-ask` writes `flows-ask-cpu-*` under the OS temp dir.
15. **Credentials roster is a contract.** `FLOWS_USERNAMES` is asserted to be exactly 12 lowercase names, frozen (flows-auth-contract:L25-32, inside the block at L24-33); adding a member in `shared/flows-auth.js` fails it. The generator CLI is also pinned: `--add`, `--set --epoch next`, `--until never`, `--remove`, `--mint --from/--out`, 0600 file mode, 5000-byte ceiling, never clobbers an existing members file (L408-492).
16. **Fixtures with dates are frozen provenance, not live data.** `fixtures-flows-legs-probe`, `-flows-positioning`, `-live-probe`, `-vol-probe` are verbatim first rows from Actions run 35847187962 (session 2026-09-22); their `source` strings say which fields were restored. Do not "refresh" them by hand; regenerate from a new probe run and update the consumers' expectations (flows-legs-contract, flows-positioning-contract, flows-basis-contract, flows-live-contract, live-stubs).

### How to change it

| Change | Edit | Then run / ritual |
|---|---|---|
| Add a Flows suite | New `tests/<name>.mjs` with `let checks = 0; const ok = ...`, one `✓ <label>: ${checks} assertions - ...` line; add `"test:<name>": "node <file>"` and append `&& npm run test:<name>` to the `test` script in `tests/package.json` (no test enforces registration; all 40+ current suites are registered). Use `node --disable-warning=ExperimentalWarning` when the suite imports `node:sqlite`. Decide the chain position deliberately: a late suite is hidden by any earlier failure. Record its class (no server / Chromium / workerd) in AGENTS.md "Which suites need the dev server". | `cd tests && FLOWS_TEST_SANDBOX=1 node <name>.mjs` for server suites; plain `node` otherwise |
| Bump browser assets | Edit anything under `assets/css/`, `assets/js/` or `assets/data/`; `assets/version.txt` +1; every `?v=` in `index.html`, `404.html`, `articles/**`, `lab/**`; `ASSET_VERSION` at `shared/flows-pages.js:1`; `data-asset-version` on the three lab shells; leave woff2 refs on `assets/fonts-version.txt`. | `grep -rn 'woff2?v=' --include=*.html --include=*.css .` (must show 230), `node tests/contracts.mjs`, `node tests/flows-features.mjs` |
| Change a font | Replace file under `assets/fonts/`, set `assets/fonts-version.txt` to the new `assets/version.txt`, update `base.css` and the HTML preloads | contracts.mjs (it also checks `U+2212` in the mono and Inter ranges, Greek `U+038E-03A1`, the system-first `--font-text` stack, no `--font-mono`/`--font-serif` in `flows.css`, no `σ` in `assets/js/flows-*.js`) |
| Change a course or skill | Edit `assets/js/curriculum*.js` / generator inputs; run `node scripts/generate-course-payloads.mjs`; commit all outputs; update pinned counts in `contracts.mjs:153, 177, 215` and `academy-contract.mjs:16-17, 49, 59` if the totals move | `node tests/contracts.mjs && node tests/academy-contract.mjs` |
| Change `_headers`, security headers, or add an `assets/` entry | Keep `_headers` `/assets/*` block identical to `SECURITY_HEADERS` in `worker.js`; add a Cache-Control rule for any new top-level `assets/` entry | contracts.mjs L828-870; DEPLOY.md header smoke test |

## Tests B (flows-l through flows-q)

Snapshot: commit ba2acfe (origin/main after PR 148), asset version 240, fonts token 230. Scope: 23 files in `tests/` whose basename sorts from `flows-ledger-contract.mjs` through `flows-quant.mjs`, 25,731 lines, about 1.7 MB (1,685,038 bytes). Line numbers come from `grep -n` / `sed -n` / `Read` on that commit. Reading depth: `flows-ledger-contract`, `flows-mint-contract`, `flows-permits-contract`, `flows-pulse-contract`, `flows-overlay-contract` and `flows-motion` were read in full; `flows-political-contract` and `flows-quant-card` (tail) mostly in full; every other file by head, block map, final summary line and spot reads of the blocks that carry source scans, subprocesses, hard-coded numbers and workflow pins (the long assertion bodies of `flows-live`, `flows-pipeline-contract`, `flows-overview`, `flows-market`, `flows-neuron` were sampled, not read line by line).

### Purpose and boundaries

What this area is.

- Twenty-three plain ESM scripts in the flat `tests/` directory. There is no test framework: each file keeps a module-level counter (`checks` or `n`), defines its own `ok` / `eq` / `deep` / `near` wrappers over `node:assert/strict` (one file, `flows-legacy-payload.mjs`, uses an `assertions` array instead), and finishes by printing one summary line `<checkmark> flows-<name>: N assertions — <prose list of what was proved>`. The first failing assertion throws and the process exits non-zero. Several summary lines are the best one-paragraph description of the file (they are quoted below in shortened form).
- Every file here is registered in `tests/package.json`: a `test:*` script (lines 11-75; `flows-premium-contract` has no script of its own, it is the last command of `test:flows` at line 21) reached from the `test` chain (line 9, 77 scripts joined by `&&`). The chain stops at the first failure, so a red suite near the front hides every suite behind it (AGENTS.md "Ordering matters too"). Chain positions of this area, counted in `npm test` order: `flows-premium-contract` is the 4th command of `test:flows` (after flows-features, flows-auth-contract, flows-card-contract), `test:pipeline` 5 (runs `node ../scripts/flows-pipeline.mjs --dry-run` first, then the contract), `test:flows-probe` 6, `test:flows-legs` 9, `test:flows-overview` 24, `test:flows-market` 26, `test:flows-legacy` 28, `test:flows-motion` 29, `test:flows-payload-shape` 34, `test:flows-mint` 37, `test:flows-pulse` 38, `test:flows-live` 40, `test:flows-ledger` 46, `test:flows-permits` 49, `test:flows-overlay` 50, `test:flows-political` 51, `test:flows-political-render` 52, `test:flows-quant` 65, `test:flows-quant-card` 66, `test:flows-neuron` 67, `test:flows-positioning` 70, `test:flows-quant-audit` 71, `test:flows-neuron-screen` 72.
- CI (`.github/workflows/regression.yml`): ubuntu-latest, Node 22, `npm ci` in `tests/`, `npx playwright install --with-deps chromium`, `wrangler deploy --dry-run`, then `npm test` with `ASSET_DIFF_BASE`; 40-minute timeout; runs on push to main, on pull requests, on dispatch and weekly (`17 6 * * 1`, held by `flows-pipeline-contract.mjs:3590-3593`). It never sets `FLOWS_TEST_SANDBOX`.
- Three kinds of suite live here.
  - Node-only (18 files): pure-function contracts over `shared/*.js` and `scripts/**`, plus source-text pins that `readFileSync` the Worker, the pipeline, the workflows, `wrangler.toml`, `schema.sql` and `migrations/*.sql` and assert regexes against them. Some spawn child processes (the pipeline in `--dry-run --emit` mode, `tests/live-stubs.mjs` CPU-budget children, the probe CLI, the credential minter, `bash` for workflow steps) but none starts workerd or a browser.
  - Server + Chromium (5 files): `flows-legacy-payload`, `flows-market-contract`, `flows-motion`, `flows-overview-contract`, `flows-political-render`. They call `startWorker()` from `tests/worker-server.mjs` (real `wrangler dev --local` with a persisted local D1 built from `schema.sql`), seed payloads through `POST /api/flows/ingest?key=...` with a `Bearer` token, drive Playwright Chromium against `/flows/*` pages and assert on the rendered DOM.
  - One needs a newer Node: `flows-ledger-contract.mjs` imports `node:sqlite` (Node 22.13+, `tests/package.json` `engines.node >=22.13`) and runs under `--disable-warning=ExperimentalWarning` (package.json:56).
- What it is not. It is not the code under test: the modules these suites cover are mapped in the other parts (Worker core, payload builders, quant engine, Neuron/AI, rail, pipeline, legs, probes, frontend). Neighbouring test areas: files sorting before `flows-l` (alerts, ask, auth, basis, board, brief, card, chain, desk, dossier, events, features, freshness, garch) and after `flows-q` (readers, reads, reading*, record, rt-*, scores, sections, sign, starts, stock, strategy, strip, ticker, track, universe, unusual, variation, verdict, vol, warnings, watch, weight, worker, ws-probe) plus the non-`flows-` suites (`contracts`, `regression`, `worker-regression`, `placement`, `academy`, `mastery`, `markets`, `market-ticker-render`).
- Shared test infrastructure that these suites depend on but this area does not own: `tests/worker-server.mjs` (221 lines; `startWorker`, `SESSION_SECRET`, `FLOWS_PASSWORD`, `FLOWS_TEST_USER`), `tests/lk-mock.mjs` (67 lines), `tests/live-stubs.mjs` (295 lines), nine JSON fixture files (eight rows in the "Fixtures and generators" table below; the desk golden row covers two files).

Cross-check of the docs against the source (AGENTS.md / DEPLOY.md vs code): no contradiction found for this scope. Two staleness notes: (1) AGENTS.md says `flows-pipeline-contract` takes 123 s, measured 2026-09-24; the file has since grown (focus-era call model at 4338-4349, `markGate` from 4350, roster ledger from 4373 to 4695) so the figure is a floor. (2) `flows-neuron-screen` is documented as 18,474 assertions (2026-09-30); not re-measured here.

### Symbol index

Conventions shared by all suites: `checks` / `n` counter; `ok(cond, msg)`, `eq(a,b,msg)`, `deep(a,b,msg)`, `near(a,b,tol,msg)` (the `eq` in `flows-positioning`, `flows-payload-shape` is `strictEqual`; in `flows-quant*` `eq` is `deepEqual`; in `flows-neuron*` the deep one is called `same`). Messages are the documentation: the all-caps lead phrase of a message names the rule.

Environment variables read or set by these suites: `FLOWS_TEST_SANDBOX` (via worker-server), `FLOWS_QUANT_BUDGET`, `FLOWS_INGEST_URL`, `FLOWS_INGEST_TOKEN`, `FLOWS_UW_BASE_URL`, `UW_API_KEY`, `FLOWS_ALLOW_INTRADAY`, `FLOWS_REPUBLISH_SESSION`, `FLOWS_PROBE_TICKERS`, `FLOWS_PROBE_FILTER`, `FLOWS_PROBE_STRICT` (asserted in the workflow), `PLAYWRIGHT_BROWSERS_PATH` (AGENTS.md says set it for browser suites). Vars supplied to workerd: `GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID`, `GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET`, `SESSION_SECRET`, `FLOWS_PEPPER`, `FLOWS_CREDENTIALS`, `FLOWS_SESSION_EPOCH`, `FLOWS_ASK_MODEL`, `FLOWS_ASK_FALLBACK_MODEL`, `FLOWS_INGEST_TOKEN`. D1 tables touched by real SQL in these suites: `flows_ledger`, `flows_clock`, `flows_live`, `flows_tape`, `flows_payload`, `users`.

### Flows

1. `npm test` (tests/package.json:9): 77 `npm run test:*` joined by `&&`; each is `node <file>.mjs` (ledger adds `--disable-warning=ExperimentalWarning`; `test:pipeline` first runs `node ../scripts/flows-pipeline.mjs --dry-run`). Working directory is `tests/`; `flows-mint`, `flows-pipeline-contract` (spawn with `cwd: import.meta.dirname`) and the relative script paths assume it.
2. Server + Chromium suite lifecycle (legacy, market, motion, overview, political-render): top-level `await startWorker({extraVars:["FLOWS_INGEST_TOKEN:..."]})` (worker-server) -> `POST /api/flows/ingest?key=K` for each fixture payload -> `chromium.launch()` -> cookie or UI sign-in -> `page.route(NEW_KEYS | lk)` stubs via `lkMock` -> `page.goto("/flows/...")` -> `page.evaluate` DOM reads -> assertions -> `finally { browser.close(); server.stop() }`. `flows-legacy-payload` has no `try/finally` and ends with `process.exit(failed ? 1 : 0)`; worker-server's exit hooks (`armSweep`) kill the wrangler process group if the script dies earlier.
3. Dry-run emit consumers (overlay, payload-shape, positioning, pipeline-contract x3, live `--live`): `node scripts/flows-pipeline.mjs --dry-run --emit <prefix>` -> `scripts/flows-pipeline.mjs:80-81` reads `--emit` -> at `:3056-3059` each key is written as `EMIT.replace(/\.json$/, "") + "-" + key.replace(":", "-") + ".json"` (so prefix `<dir>/p.json` yields `p-card-AAA.json`, `p-card-x-AAA.json`, `p-hist-AAA.json`, `p-board-long.json`; prefix `<dir>/` yields `-card-AAA.json`; only the FIRST colon is replaced, so `live:strips:series` yields `p-live-strips:series.json`, which is why the live suite maps `^p-` and `^live-` back by hand at flows-live-contract.mjs:1001) -> the suite parses the files and asserts. All five suites depend on the dry run's built-in fake vendor and chain fixtures (`fakeChain`, `fakeIvRank`, `fakeOiLadder`, ... in the pipeline), so a change to dry-run data can redden several suites at once.
4. Live CPU budget: `flows-live-contract.mjs:3162` -> 10 x `node tests/live-stubs.mjs --tier1-budget cold` + 1 warm (`tier1Budget`, windows 16 x 5 ticks, `tickDb` fake D1, `tier1Bodies` production-size vendor bodies) -> JSON on the last stdout line -> thresholds. Same shape for `--focus-budget` with `focusDb`, `focusGroupsSample`, `productionScreenerBody`.
5. Quant budget: `flows-quant.mjs` top-level runs everything with `BUDGET_ONLY` false; at 906 it respawns itself with `FLOWS_QUANT_BUDGET=1`; the child skips every `if (!BUDGET_ONLY)` block, runs `budget()` (540) and prints one JSON line (574-576); the parent turns the median/p95 into ratios against `referenceKernel` (60 passes of a normal-density kernel over 2,048 values with a sort).
6. Quant bundle check: `flows-quant-card.mjs:373` -> dynamic import of `scripts/build-flows-quant-bundle.mjs` (`buildQuantBundle(entry)` via esbuild from `tests/node_modules`, `format:"iife"`, `globalName:"FlowsQuant"`, minified) -> compare to the committed `assets/js/flows-quant.bundle.js` and `flows-quant-read.bundle.js` -> run each in `vm.runInNewContext` -> price the same structures through the bundle and the shared module.
7. Ledger over fake D1: `sqliteD1()` -> `W.rthTick(env, t, {fetchVendor, log})` (`shared/flows-live-worker.js`) -> batches `[clock upsert + ledger tick]`, `[read]`, `[live row + ledger outcome + clock patch]` -> assertions on `flows_ledger` rows and `trips[]` (3 trips due, 2 not due, heartbeat 1, focus 2, meta landing 1). Worker route case: `globalThis.HTMLRewriter ??= class {...}` stub, `await import("../worker.js?ledger=1")`, `worker.fetch(new Request("https://anilkaya.org/api/flows/ingest?key=meta", POST Bearer), env, {waitUntil(){}})` with `env = {DB, FLOWS_INGEST_TOKEN, SESSION_SECRET}`.
8. Pipeline end-to-end child (`flows-pipeline-contract.mjs:4108-4205`): two `http.createServer` fakes (UW vendor serving SPY `ohlc/1d` bars and empty data; ingest store with `heldKeys` for `scores:`, `board:long:`, `board:short:` of the session) -> child `node ../scripts/flows-pipeline.mjs` with `FLOWS_ALLOW_INTRADAY=1` -> first run: log `session gate: archived`, POSTs only `news`, `pulse`, `sector:premium`, no DELETE; remove `board:long:<S>` -> exit 1 with `ARCHIVE INCOMPLETE` and the same three POSTs; add `FLOWS_REPUBLISH_SESSION=1` -> `session gate: republish`, screener read `?date`, exit 1 on empty universe, nothing written or deleted.
9. Workflow contract check (`flows-pipeline-contract.mjs:3486-3614`): read `flows-pipeline.yml` -> regex the four crons, extract the "Resolve whether this firing is the intended one" bash step, run it under `bash -e -c` for eight (event, cron, zone) combinations -> walk every weekday 2026-2030 (loop at 3537-3558) through `easternOffsetMinutes` and assert exactly one admitted cron lands 17:15-18:00 ET and every other admitted firing is after 20:00 ET -> keepalive job re-enables every workflow containing `cron:` -> every workflow's `uses:` must be exactly the two SHA-pinned actions.

### Invariants and traps

Each item: rule, then evidence.

1. First failure hides the rest. The chain is `&&` (package.json:9); do not read a green tail as "later suites pass". Server suites hang rather than fail in the sandbox without `FLOWS_TEST_SANDBOX=1` (AGENTS.md; `worker-server.mjs:14`), and a hung suite looks like a red one under `timeout`.
2. Cwd matters. `flows-mint-contract.mjs:13` uses `../scripts/generate-flows-credentials.mjs`; `flows-pipeline-contract.mjs:1380,4142,4263` use `../scripts/flows-pipeline.mjs` with `cwd: import.meta.dirname`; the rest use `ROOT`/`new URL` and are cwd-independent.
3. Importing the Worker in Node needs `HTMLRewriter` stubbed and a cache-busting query: `globalThis.HTMLRewriter ??= class { on() { return this; } transform(r) { return r; } }` (ledger:395, 586; the same one-line stub is in `flows-reads-contract`, `flows-readers-contract`, `flows-basis-contract` and `tests/dossier-harness.mjs`; `worker.js` uses `new HTMLRewriter()` at line 2724) and `import("../worker.js?ledger=1")` / `?ledger=quota` (query string = fresh module instance). A new top-level use of a Workers-only global in `worker.js` or its imports breaks every Node-side import of the Worker.
4. The ledger DDL has four homes that must stay column-for-column identical: `shared/flows-ledger.js` `LEDGER_SCHEMA_SQL` (line 13), `schema.sql`, `migrations/0015_flows_ledger.sql` (must end with `);` and be re-runnable), and `W.LIVE_SCHEMA_SQL` (the Worker's first-use bootstrap) — ledger:61-72. Likewise `flows_live`/`flows_tape`/`flows_clock` between `migrations/0010`-`0014`, `schema.sql` and `W.CLOCK_ADDED_COLUMNS` / `W.LIVE_SCHEMA_SQL` (live:885-921), and `users.signed_in_at` between migration `0013`, `schema.sql` and `LAB.SIGNED_IN_COLUMN_SQL` (live:2889-2894).
5. The ledger must never cost a round trip nor block a tick: due Tier 1 tick = exactly 3 D1 trips, not-due = 2, focus = 2, heartbeat ingest = 1, nightly `meta` landing = 1 batch whose first statement is the `flows_payload` upsert and second the ledger row (ledger:273-298, 325-374, 394-420). A failing ledger statement must log `ledger statement refused` and leave clock, `live:market`, `live:focus` and heartbeat writes intact (ledger:300-323). The `ledger` field is on the ingest `clock` key only for the nightly (`lab: true`) credential, never the live one (ledger:376-392).
6. Cron strings are triplicated and pinned: `shared/flows-live-worker.js:70-73` (`RTH_CRON`, `FOCUS_CRON`, `HOUSEKEEPING_CRON`, `SUMMARY_CRON`), `wrangler.toml:26` (exactly four, inside the five Workers Free allows, weekdays by NAME because Cloudflare counts 1 = Sunday), and `HEALTH.focusCron` / `HEALTH.summaryCron` in `scripts/flows-legs/health.mjs`. Stale triggers (`*/15`, `* * * * *`) must route by minute: minutes ending in 3 or 8 are focus, :30 housekeeping, :15/:45 summary (live:932-960). A cron whose weekday list is numeric fails live:988-990. GitHub workflow crons use standard cron (1-5 = Mon-Fri) and keep numbers.
7. One writer per live key. `LIVE_KEYS` writers: `live:market` and `live:focus` are Worker-written, the other ten Actions-written (live:68-70). The live module and scheduled handler must contain no `INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE ... flows_payload` and no `refreshFlowsIntraday` (live:736-742); `publish()` in `--live` mode throws on any key not matching `/^live:[a-z]+(?::[a-z]+)?$/`; the live credential source must never mention `FLOWS_INGEST_TOKEN` (live:745-748). `flows-live.yml` may hold no `FLOWS_INGEST_TOKEN|FLOWS_LIVE_TOKEN|GITHUB_DISPATCH_TOKEN`, and its `permissions:` block must be exactly `contents: read`, `id-token: write`, `actions: write`, `issues: write` (live:749-760). A new live key needs: registry entry, byte cap, dry-run emission, payload-shape pin, `LK_MAX_KEYS` expectation text ("eight keys of the twelve"). The live workflow's schedule is also pinned: `.github/workflows/flows-live.yml` must carry exactly 32 single-slot cron lines of the form `<m> <h> * * 1-5` at minutes 17 and 47 for every UTC hour 05 to 20 (`hourly(5, 20, [17, 47])`, live:772-794; every slot `% 30 === 17`, all distinct, so `github.event.schedule` names one slot), `concurrency: group: ${{ inputs.drill && 'flows-live-drill' || 'flows-live' }}` with `cancel-in-progress: false`, a job `timeout-minutes` under 360 that leaves `LIVE_LOOP.budgetMs` plus 10 minutes inside it, and every `uses:` pinned to a 40-hex SHA (uses at live:761-764, timeout at 765, concurrency at 767-770). Two starter-coverage checks hold the schedule: live:794-815 walks four sample days (2026-09-28 and 2027-03-15 under EDT, 2026-11-02 and 2027-03-12 under EST; 2027-03-12 and 2027-03-15 bracket the 2027-03-14 DST edge) minute by minute for every delay from 0 to 300 minutes and requires at least seven landings (eight under EST) in the pre-open wait before 09:31 ET; the loop simulation at live:1841-1890 runs every starter slot through `runLiveLoop` on 2026-09-28 (EDT) and 2026-11-02 (EST) at eight delivery delays (0, 60, 120, 180, 210, 240, 270, 300 minutes) and requires at least seven that would wait for the open.
8. Workflow files are test-pinned (pipeline-contract:3498-3614; probe:572-601; live:749-760, 1843): nightly crons exactly `["30 21 * * 1-5","30 22 * * 1-5","17 1 * * 2-6","47 3 * * 2-6"]`; the gate step admits each primary only in its own zone keyed on the cron STRING `FIRED`, never wall time; both backups in either zone; env-only plumbing (`EVENT`, `FIRED`; no `${{ github.event.schedule }}` inside `run:`); `allow_intraday` and `republish_session` inputs plumbed only on `workflow_dispatch`; keepalive job holds `actions: write` alone, uses no `uses:`, runs only on schedule, and its `for wf in ...` list must equal the set of workflow files containing `cron:` (so a new scheduled workflow must be added there); every workflow's `uses:` must be exactly `actions/checkout@fbc6f3992d24b796d5a048ff273f7fcc4a7b6c09` and `actions/setup-node@a0853c24544627f65ddf259abe73b1d18a591444`, each checkout `persist-credentials: false`; `regression.yml` cron `17 6 * * 1`; the probe workflow is weekly `23 14 * * 0`, strict on schedule, `permissions: contents: read`, `timeout-minutes: 20`, Node 22, inputs only through `env:` (its only `run:` line is `node scripts/flows-probe.mjs`).
9. Ingest call sites in the pipeline are pinned by regex: exactly one `anilkaya-flows-pipeline/1` literal; five occurrences of `ingestURL() + "?(key|keys|list)="` (read, metadata probe, listing, write, delete), each within 900 chars of `headers: await ingestHeaders(` and none building `Authorization: "Bearer " + process.env.FLOWS_INGEST_TOKEN` inline; `LEDGER_PROBE_CHUNK <= INGEST_META_KEYS_MAX` read out of `worker.js` (pipeline-contract:2231-2265). A sixth call site must go through `ingestHeaders`, and adding one means changing the expected 5.
10. Pipeline source regex pins that a refactor can break without changing behaviour: `main()` order (`await resolveSessionDate()` < `intradayRefusal(sessionDate` < `throw new Error(intraday.message)` < `verifyDating(sessionDate`, 3487-3491); `allow: process.env.FLOWS_ALLOW_INTRADAY === "1"`; `foldCardOutcomes(cardTickers, cardsRun)` and `runPooled(cardTickers,`/`stopEarly: () => Date.now() > deadline` (2441-2443); `readBoardMemory(read, sessionDate)` (2735); `iv-rank` called with `...IV_RANK_PARAMS, ...onSession` and never `limit`; `volatility/term-structure` with `...onSession`; `d > sessionDate` not `>=`; three `congress: congressRows(...)` sites (4103); no `05:15` anywhere; no `shorts/AAPL/volume-and-ratio` or `probes:` (3610-3611); ledger-test pins at ledger:543 and :644.
11. The dry run is a shared fixture generator. Overlay (>= 5 cards, every card's last close <= session, no weekend close dates, at least one card joins), payload-shape (every key in `SURFACES` emitted), positioning (>= 1 carded name each with a card-x and a hist; `dpLevels`, `flowExpiry`, `flowStrike` must exercise both `ok` and their silence; a `gexPath` with `flowFilled === false`; a NOPE z beside `short-history`; a `multiLeg` with `truncated`), live-contract (`--live` emits exactly the ten Actions keys) all assume specific coverage in the pipeline's fake vendor. Removing a fake branch can fail four suites.
12. Payload-shape scan is textual: it locates `function <fn>(` and slices to the next `\n  function `, then regexes `<var>.<field>` reads. Renaming a renderer function, renaming its payload parameter, or moving a block anchored by `at:` text makes the scan fail loudly (it asserts the function and variable still exist, and that the scan found > 0 reads), and a renderer reading a new root field fails until the publisher writes it or the field is added to `OPTIONAL` with a reason (flows-payload-shape.mjs:96-182). Update `SURFACES` (33-83) with the rename.
13. Source-hygiene scans enforce the repo's no-comment rule in code: `scripts/flows-legs/*` (legs:897: no `//` after URLs are stripped, no `/*`), `shared/flows-positioning.js`, `scripts/flows-legs/flow.mjs`, `flow-fake.mjs` (positioning:911-914), and every `shared/flows-quant-*.js` (quant:897-904, via `stripComments` equality; also no `Date.now`, `new Date()`, `Math.random`, `fetch(`, `performance.now`). A `//` inside a string or regex in those directories also trips the legs scan.
14. Quant bundles are generated, never edited: `assets/js/flows-quant.bundle.js` and `flows-quant-read.bundle.js` must equal `buildQuantBundle()` output exactly (quant-card:373-378, 488-492); regenerate with `node scripts/build-flows-quant-bundle.mjs` (`--check` to verify) after any `shared/flows-quant-*` change the browser reaches, then bump `assets/version.txt` (files under `assets/js/` are in `contracts.mjs` diff gate). The read bundle must stay under a third of the full one and must export every `FQ.<name>` that `assets/js/flows-ticker.js` calls (quant-card:497-502).
15. Hard-coded counts that move with product changes: quant cases 48 (quant:238); probe operations 38/15/26 (probe:27-29) and `list.gated` exactly the four refusals (probe:528) and the `SEEN_OUTSIDE_SPEC` allow-list (probe:515); `askModels(meteredAi(env)` exactly 4 sites in `worker.js` and zero `env.AI.run(` (neuron:804-807, 1093-1097; the per-name reading calls `askModels` from `shared/flows-reading-worker.js:112` through `deps.ai()` and is outside this count); `NEURON_CONTEXT_VERSION` 6 and fingerprint prefix `n6.` (neuron:128, 834, 1484); `NEURON_TIERS` 7 and 11 tier sentences with no modal/forecast words (neuron:1408-1410); card schema `card.v === 3` (pipeline-contract:1899); `SECTOR_ETFS.length === 11`; 12 live keys, `LK_MAX_KEYS` 8; 12 gated Flows routes in motion (151-154) and rail badge keys `["events","long","short","watch"]` (motion:296-300); `FLOWS_USERNAMES` roster size drives the mint test.
16. Real-clock sensitivity. Market computes `FRESH_SESSION = expectedNightlySession(new Date())` (market:328) so it adapts; overview seeds `SESSION = "2026-08-24"` with `generatedAt: new Date()` and uses `Date.now()` offsets (2170-2232, 3467-3544); pipeline-contract derives its session from `easternNow().date` (4110). The weekly regression cron exists so a fixture date overtaken by the real clock fails within a week (pipeline-contract:3590-3593). Dates inside fixtures (2026-09-xx) are chosen so DST/holiday/early-close logic is exercised; do not "refresh" them without rechecking `nyseHolidays(2026)` expectations (quant:828) and the 2026-2030 DST loop (pipeline-contract:3537-3558).
17. Exact-wording pins: many messages are regex-tested in the health gate (`HEALTH: the Worker's rth cron did not tick for 26 min inside 2026-09-24's session (11:05 ET to 11:31 ET), so live:market ...`), the Lab sign-in note ("lab: the Lab's Google OAuth client was used within the last 120 days; nothing to do"), `D1_QUOTA` text (`5,000,000 rows read a day`, `100,000 rows written`), and Neuron provenance sentences. Rewording a health/provenance sentence in `scripts/flows-legs/health.mjs`, `shared/flows-neuron.js` or `shared/flows-pages.js` will fail these tests by regex; edit both together.
18. Forbidden-vocabulary guards: `PULSE_NOTES` may not contain whale/smart money/institutional/bought/sold/buyer/seller/paid and only the dark-pool note may say trade/print (pulse:172-190); `POLITICAL_NOTES` may not contain return(s)/outperform/beat the market/track record/skill/profit(s)/gains/alpha/insider/tipped/front-run (political-contract:400-409) and must carry the 45-day lag, spouse/dependent attribution and the performance-refusal reason; `TIER_WHY` sentences carry no modal/forecast words (neuron:1410); `OVERLAY_NOTES` must say "not zipped by position", gap "breaks" and "zero", axes "dollars"/"hundred"/"separate scales"/"cannot be compared" (overlay:164-179); `MARKET_NOTES.population` names "SCREENED UNIVERSE" and refuses "the market" (market:104-110).
19. Absent is not zero: `vnum("")`, `null`, `"abc"`, booleans, `1e400` are null across `flows-cross`, `flows-positioning`, `flows-pulse`, `flows-premium` (`numOrNull`) — tests assert this in nearly every file (legs:52-60, positioning:42-50, pulse:25-42, premium:646-650). Open political bands have no midpoint; a ranked ticker-less filer reports `names: null`; `freshBuys` is null when no filing date exists; holders' quantity is `midQty` never `mid`.
20. Mint test depends on the real roster: it expects one `name  xxxx-xxxx-xxxx-xxxx` line per `FLOWS_USERNAMES` entry, passwords with none of `i l o 0 1`, a `# FLOWS_PEPPER` line followed by the pepper and a `# FLOWS_CREDENTIALS` line followed by the JSON (mint:19-45). Changing the printer's labels breaks the parse.
21. Political and legacy render tests depend on server-side keys being registered: `political` must be an accepted ingest key (political-render:179); the `board:*` and `card:*` rules accept v1 and v2 (legacy). Keys, route names and page element ids used as selectors (`#plStatus`, `.pl-row.pl-buyer`, `.fd-mod[data-state]`, `#bdMem[data-memory]`, `#m-signal .ft-fam`, `#ccVerdict [data-chip]`, `.hm-lrow`, `#mkTideCard`...) are part of the contract.
22. The live loop and starter tests use virtual clocks (`sim`) but some waits are real: JWKS wait (`W.JWKS_WAIT_MS`), clock flights 2-3.5 s (live:3381-3420). Under heavy load these have slack of 50 ms (`TIMER_SLACK_MS`, live:34). CPU budget children measure thread CPU; on machines without `process.threadCpuUsage` they fall back to wall clock and become load-sensitive (quant:502-506; live clock label `colds[0].clock`).
23. `tests/.overlay-emit/` is created inside the repo tree by the overlay test and removed at the end; it is git-ignored by `tests/.*/` (so `git ls-files --exclude-standard`, which `FLOWS_TEST_SANDBOX` uses to stage its tree, leaves it out), but a killed run can leave it on disk.
24. `flows-legacy-payload` is the only suite here that reports failure by exit code after printing instead of throwing; it still calls `server.stop()` and `browser.close()` before `process.exit`.

### How to change it

- Add or edit a test in this area: write the file in `tests/`, keep the `ok/eq/deep` + summary-line convention, then (a) add `"test:<name>": "node <file>.mjs"` to `tests/package.json` and (b) append `&& npm run test:<name>` at the right position in the `test` string (line 9), (c) if it boots workerd or Chromium, state in AGENTS.md "Which suites need the dev server" and run it with `FLOWS_TEST_SANDBOX=1` in the sandbox, (d) if it needs `node:sqlite` add `--disable-warning=ExperimentalWarning` to its script and keep Node >= 22.13. Source files carry no comments; the argument for a threshold goes in the commit message.
- Change a Worker cron (Tier 1 / focus / housekeeping / summary): edit `shared/flows-live-worker.js:70-73`, `wrangler.toml:26`, `HEALTH.focusCron` / `summaryCron` in `scripts/flows-legs/health.mjs:9-20`; update `tests/flows-live-contract.mjs` blocks 922-993 (routing tests, the 288+48+96 stale-set count, "four crons" count, weekday names); run `flows-live`, `flows-ledger`, `flows-starts-contract`, `flows-verdict-contract`.
- Add or change a `live:*` key (or its byte cap / cadence): `shared/flows-live.js` `LIVE_KEYS` (registry, builders, `shapeX`), the Actions leg `scripts/flows-legs/live.mjs`, fake in `live-fake.mjs`/`live-world-fake.mjs`; tests: `flows-live-contract` registry block (64-82), byte-ceiling block (522-650), dry-run emission (995-1010), `LK_MAX_KEYS` text (2945), `flows-payload-shape` live loop (872-920), `tests/live-stubs.mjs` if a CPU path; add the vendor operation to `scripts/flows-probe-list.json` and the counts in `flows-probe-contract.mjs:27-29`. Then `flows-live`, `flows-payload-shape`, `flows-probe`, `flows-starts`, `flows-reads`.
- Change nightly or live workflow YAML: any new `uses:` must be the two pinned SHAs and checkout needs `persist-credentials: false` (`pipeline-contract:3596-3606`; pinned-actions check at 3599); a new scheduled workflow must be added to the keepalive `for wf in ...` list in `flows-pipeline.yml`; a changed nightly cron needs the 2026-2030 loop (3537-3558) to still find exactly one admitted firing 17:15-18:00 ET and the gate-script cases (3511-3531); live workflow permissions are pinned at live:749-760. Run `flows-pipeline-contract`, `flows-live-contract`, `flows-probe-contract`.
- Change `scripts/flows-pipeline.mjs`: exported names must still satisfy the import list at `flows-pipeline-contract.mjs:4-37`; then check the regex pins listed in Invariant 10 and the five-ingest-site rule (9). New dry-run branches change what overlay / payload-shape / positioning / live-contract see; run all five plus `flows-legs`, `flows-universe`, `flows-vol`. Update the 3,071-call model (`callModel`, `CALL_COST`, `NOMINAL_SHAPE`) if the call count per name changes (4339-4348).
- Change a publisher payload field that a browser module reads: update the `SURFACES` row in `flows-payload-shape.mjs:33-83` when a renderer function is renamed; add a reasoned `OPTIONAL` entry only when absence is legitimate. For card panels edit the pinned field tables near 553 (`PANEL_FIELDS`).
- Change the ledger: `shared/flows-ledger.js` + `schema.sql` + a new `migrations/00NN_*.sql` + `W.LIVE_SCHEMA_SQL`/`CLOCK_*` in `shared/flows-live-worker.js` (all four must agree, ledger:61-72, live:885-921); update the view-shape key lists (`ledger:164-165`), trip counts, and `ledgerChecks` expectations in `health.mjs`; run `flows-ledger`, `flows-live`, `flows-verdict`, `flows-reads`. D1 quota behaviour: `storeQuotaWait` / `QUOTA_WAIT` in `health.mjs:290-302`, the Worker's 503 `store_quota` mapping (ledger:585-612), and the pipeline write loop regex (ledger:644).
- Change quant maths (`shared/flows-quant-*.js`, `scripts/flows-quant-pipeline.mjs`): update known-answer fixtures only with an independent reference (`fixtures-quant-cases.json` 48 cases, `fixtures-quant-audit.json` scipy); keep the files free of comments, clock, randomness and I/O; run `node scripts/build-flows-quant-bundle.mjs`, bump `assets/version.txt` and every `?v=` per AGENTS.md "Asset versioning", then `flows-quant`, `flows-quant-card`, `flows-quant-audit`, `flows-neuron`, `flows-premium`, `flows-desk-*`, `flows-strategy`, `contracts`.
- Change Neuron / AI wiring: `shared/flows-neuron.js`, `flows-neuron-screen.js` (keep its three-line import header, neuron-screen:306), `flows-ai.js`, `worker.js`; adding a model call site in `worker.js` must use `askModels(meteredAi(env), ...)` and bumps the expected 4 (neuron:807, 1096); the daily caps live in `wrangler.toml:47-48`; `NEURON_CONTEXT_VERSION` bumps move the `n6.` prefix assertions (neuron:128, 834, 1484). Run `flows-neuron`, `flows-neuron-screen`, `flows-reads`, `flows-reading*`, `flows-dossier*`, `flows-ask`.
- Change the political / pulse / overlay / permits / premium / positioning modules: run the single matching suite; for page changes also `flows-political-render` (needs `FLOWS_TEST_SANDBOX=1`) and `flows-payload-shape`. Notes text is lexicon-tested (Invariant 18). Permits: `scripts/flows-pipeline.mjs:368,375` build the two queues from `makePermitQueue`.
- Change a Flows page's CSS or markup: `flows-motion` scans every `assets/css/flows*.css` for min/max width collisions and checks 320 px overflow on the twelve routes (151-154), hidden-element leaks, silences, leading and the ticker bar; add a new route to that list. `flows-overview-contract`, `flows-market-contract`, `flows-political-render`, `flows-legacy-payload` assert on element ids and text; after any `assets/css|js` change bump `assets/version.txt` and the `?v=` references (never the fonts token unless a woff2 changed), then run the affected browser suites with `FLOWS_TEST_SANDBOX=1`.
- Change credentials minting: `scripts/generate-flows-credentials.mjs` output labels (`# FLOWS_PEPPER`, `# FLOWS_CREDENTIALS`, `name  xxxx-xxxx-xxxx-xxxx`), pepper minimum 24 characters; run `flows-mint` and `flows-auth-contract`.
- Add a vendor operation to the probe: `scripts/flows-probe-list.json` (tier `used|1|2`, `expect` names, `reads` for the strict list), update counts at `flows-probe-contract.mjs:27-29`, and the `SEEN_OUTSIDE_SPEC` allow-list (probe:515) if the vendor sends undocumented names; run `flows-probe`, `flows-dossier` (shares the strict list).

## Tests C (flows-r onward, regression, worker-*, utilities)

Snapshot: `/home/user/anilkaya.org` at `ba2acfe` (origin/main after PR 148), asset version 240, fonts token 230. Every `Lnn` below is a line of the file named in the row or heading, taken with `grep -n` / `sed -n` on that commit. Paths are repo-relative. Nothing in this area was run; runtimes quoted come from AGENTS.md (marked "doc") or from reading the code (marked "code").

### Purpose and boundaries

What this area is.

- 44 files in the flat `tests/` directory: 29 Flows suites whose basename sorts from `flows-readers-contract` to `flows-ws-probe-contract`; 6 site/Lab suites (`market-ticker-render`, `markets-contract`, `mastery-contract`, `placement-contract`, `regression`, `worker-regression`); 5 harness helpers (`worker-server`, `rt-fixtures`, `live-stubs`, `lk-mock`, `reading-archetypes`); 2 Python fixture generators (`gen-desk-lab.py`, `gen-dossier-fixtures.py`, also mapped in 60-tests-a); `package.json` and `package-lock.json`.
- No test framework. Every suite is a plain ESM script: a module-level counter (`checks`, or `n` in `flows-vol-contract`), local wrappers `ok` / `eq` / `deep` (some `near`, `same`) over `node:assert/strict`, bare `{ ... }` blocks as sections, and one closing `console.log("... N checks/assertions ...")`. A thrown assertion exits non-zero. Sections are not named in code (no comments, no `describe`); the capitalised lead of an assertion message is the de-facto section title.
- Every suite is registered in `tests/package.json` twice: a `test:*` script (L10-L86) and a slot in the `test` chain (L9, 77 `npm run` links joined by `&&`, first failure stops the run, so a suite near the front hides the ones behind it). Nine `.mjs` files have no script because they are helpers: `board-shift`, `desk-fixtures`, `dossier-fixtures`, `dossier-harness`, `live-stubs`, `lk-mock`, `reading-archetypes`, `rt-fixtures`, `worker-server` (computed by diffing `scripts` against `ls`).
- CI is `.github/workflows/regression.yml`: ubuntu-latest, Node 22, `timeout-minutes: 40`, `npm ci` in `tests/`, `npx playwright install --with-deps chromium`, `wrangler deploy --dry-run --outdir /tmp/anilkaya-worker-dry-run`, then `npm test` with `ASSET_DIFF_BASE` set. Triggers: push to main, pull_request, workflow_dispatch and a weekly schedule `17 6 * * 1`. `FLOWS_TEST_SANDBOX` is not set in CI.

Six harness patterns (a suite uses exactly one or two):

| Pattern | What stands in for production | Suites in this area |
|---|---|---|
| A. Pure Node | modules imported directly | `flows-record-contract`, `flows-scores-contract`, `flows-stock-contract`, `flows-universe-contract`, `flows-variation`, `flows-vol-contract`, `flows-warnings`, `flows-weight`, `flows-sign`, `flows-reading`, `flows-ws-probe-contract` (loopback fake WebSocket vendor), `markets-contract`, `mastery-contract` (vm contexts for the browser scripts) |
| B. Node + fake D1 + `worker.js` imported into Node | counting D1 binding over `node:sqlite` loaded with `schema.sql`, `caches.default` fake, `HTMLRewriter` shim, `worker.js?tag=N` re-import for a fresh isolate | `flows-reads-contract`, `flows-readers-contract`, `flows-reading-worker` (through `dossier-harness`, Tests A), `flows-verdict-contract` (`rthTick` only, no `worker.js`), `flows-rt-contract` (hub, routes, `Pulse` with fake ctx) |
| C. Chromium + `page.route` stubs, no server | assets served from disk, `/api/flows/*` answered from fixtures, `page.clock` | `flows-readers-render`, `flows-reading-render`, `flows-rt-client` (+ `page.routeWebSocket`), `flows-track-render`, `flows-ticker-contract`, `flows-strip`, `market-ticker-render` |
| D. Real workerd (`startWorker`) | `wrangler dev --local` on a loopback port, persisted local D1, stub vendors on loopback | `worker-regression`, `flows-worker-contract` (6 boots), `flows-rt-server` (4 boots), `flows-sections-contract`, `flows-strategy`, `flows-unusual-contract` (browser half), `flows-watch-render`, `regression.mjs` |
| E. Own static server + Chromium | a 40-line `node:http` file server on loopback, `/api/*` stubbed | `placement-contract` (L114-L150 `staticServer`) |
| F. Child process | `scripts/flows-pipeline.mjs --dry-run --emit <dir>` or `bash`/`node` children | `flows-starts-contract`, `flows-ticker-contract`, `flows-unusual-contract`, `flows-strip` |

What it is not. It is not the code under test; the Worker, the shared Flows modules, the pipeline, the legs and the front end are mapped in parts 10-53. Neighbours: 60-tests-a (names before `flows-l`: `contracts.mjs`, `academy-contract`, the `dossier-*`, `desk-*`, `board-shift` helpers, all `fixtures-*.json`, which this area only consumes) and 61-tests-b (`flows-ledger-contract` to `flows-quant`).

Docs versus source, found while mapping this area (source wins):

- AGENTS.md lists `placement-contract` among suites that "need the dev server". The source never calls `startWorker`; it runs its own static `node:http` server (L114-L150) and needs Chromium only.
- AGENTS.md lists neither `regression.mjs` (script `test:browser`) as server-needing nor as server-free, although it calls `startWorker()` at L5 (workerd + Chromium, 9 viewports).
- AGENTS.md states "96-item review artefacts"; `mastery-contract.mjs:20` asserts 106 items and `assets/data/review-bank.json` holds 106 `variantId` entries at `schemaVersion` 2.
- AGENTS.md says `TOPIC_META` contains exactly seven courses (`ols 20 ... gmm 33`). `regression.mjs:8` pins twelve (`foundations`, `mle`, `forecast`, `coint`, `financial` added, 32 stages each) and `assets/js/course-catalog.js` defines them; module payloads live in `assets/data/courses/<topic>/*.json`. `regression.mjs` and `worker-regression.mjs` also exercise `/lab/challenge/`, `/lab/projects/*`, five learning paths and the `/api/v2/{bootstrap,progress,attempt,preferences,project}` routes (`worker.js:2867-2996`), none of which AGENTS.md documents.
- AGENTS.md says CI runs on push, PR and dispatch only; the workflow also has a weekly cron and a 40-minute timeout.
- AGENTS.md says `npx playwright install chromium`; CI uses `--with-deps`.
- AGENTS.md (flows-reads-contract paragraph) says a summary hit reads 3 rows and a miss 18 before the response and 30 with the background generation; the final block of `flows-reads-contract.mjs` (L1204-L1243) asserts ceilings of 4 (hit, L1238), 22 (miss before the response, L1225) and 34 (miss with background reads, L1226), and prints the measured values. The ceilings are what CI enforces.
- `lk-mock.mjs` and `live-stubs.mjs` are absent from AGENTS.md's file map. `tests/package.json` is `engines.node >=22.13`; this sandbox runs v22.22.2.

Sandbox runner and Playwright paths:

- `FLOWS_TEST_SANDBOX=1` is read once at `tests/worker-server.mjs:14`. When set, (1) `childEnv()` (L15-L19) adds `CLOUDFLARE_CF_FETCH_ENABLED=false` and `WRANGLER_SEND_METRICS=false`, and (2) `startWorker` (L163-L167) copies the tree into `mkdtemp(os.tmpdir()/anilkaya-worker-tree-*)` via `stageServedTree` (L139-L153) and runs `wrangler dev` with that directory as cwd. `stageServedTree` runs `git ls-files -z --cached --others --exclude-standard`, skips any path that starts with `.` and contains `/` (dot directories such as `.claude/worktrees/`, `.github/`, `.wrangler/`), skips anything `lstat` does not report as a regular file (symlinks), and copies the rest. Root dotfiles such as `.assetsignore` are copied. Reason (AGENTS.md, confirmed by the code path): wrangler's asset watcher follows symlinks and crawled the `tests/node_modules` loops and the worktrees. `wrangler` itself is run by absolute path (`WRANGLER`, L11), so `node_modules` is not needed in the copy. `d1 execute` (schema load and `server.d1()`) still runs with cwd `REPO_ROOT`.
- Without the flag, the server suites hang in this sandbox until a `timeout` kills them; silence plus a timeout is not an assertion failure.
- Chromium: every browser suite calls plain `chromium.launch()` (no `executablePath`, no args). The sandbox points Playwright at the preinstalled browsers through `PLAYWRIGHT_BROWSERS_PATH` (`/opt/pw-browsers` here, containing `chromium-1194`, `chromium_headless_shell-1194`, `ffmpeg-1011` and a `chromium` symlink to `chromium-1194/chrome-linux/chrome`). `flows-strip.mjs:6` imports `playwright-core` directly; it is not a declared devDependency (only `playwright` 1.61.1 and `wrangler` 4.110.0 are) and resolves through npm hoisting. Lockfile pins: `playwright`/`playwright-core` 1.61.1, `wrangler` 4.110.0, `miniflare` 4.20260708.1, `workerd` 1.20260708.1, `esbuild` 0.28.1; 92 `node_modules/` entries; every entry is `dev: true`.

Per-suite local helpers worth knowing (all file-local):

| symbol | file:line | what it does |
|---|---|---|
| `fakeD1` | flows-reads-contract.mjs:26 | counting D1 over `node:sqlite` loaded with `schema.sql`; every `first/all/run/batch` is one "trip" after `setTimeout(latencyMs=1)`; `scanned()` L39 uses `EXPLAIN QUERY PLAN` so SEARCH costs the rows returned (min one per search), SCAN costs the table's `count(*)`, and a virtual `json_each(p.payload,'$path')` costs the largest array length; fault knobs `fail`, `throwSync`, `hangOnce`, `slowOnce` |
| `fakeD1` | flows-readers-contract.mjs:19 | same shape without row pricing; also `put(id, value)` and `live(id, value, readAt, session, cadence)` seeders |

### Flows

1. `npm test` / CI.
   - `.github/workflows/regression.yml` -> `npm ci` -> `playwright install --with-deps chromium` -> `wrangler deploy --dry-run` -> `npm test` (`tests/package.json:9`) -> 77 links in order. Position of this area's suites: markets 2, market-ticker 3, ws-probe 7, universe 8, record 10, mastery 12, placement 14, worker 15, flows-worker 16, rt-server 17, rt-client 18, sections 25, ticker 27, browser 31, unusual 32, scores 35, rt 41, starts 42, reads 43, readers 44, readers-render 45, verdict 47, stock 48, watch-render 53, weight 55, strip 56, strategy 57, track-render 61, warnings 62, sign 63, variation 68, vol 69, reading 75, reading-worker 76, reading-render 77. `test:flows` (4) chains four files and `test:pipeline` (5) runs the pipeline dry run before its contract.
2. `startWorker` lifecycle (worker-server.mjs).
   - L156 `freePort` -> L157 temp persist dir -> L162 `wrangler d1 execute iewt --local --file schema.sql --persist-to <dir> -y` (cwd repo root) -> L163 if sandbox: `stageServedTree` into a second temp dir -> L173 `armSweep` -> L174 spawn `wrangler dev` (cwd = served tree) with the `--var` list -> L200 `waitForPort` (30 s) -> L202 warm-up `fetch("/")` -> handle. Tests then sign a cookie with `signSession`/`signFlowsSession` using `SESSION_SECRET`, POST fixtures to `/api/flows/ingest?key=` with a bearer token, and drive either `fetch`/`WebSocket` or Chromium (`context.addCookies({name:"flows_session", ...})`). `server.d1(sql)` shells `wrangler d1 execute --command` for direct reads/writes (worker-regression `seedStale` L138, worker-contract live block). `stop()` SIGTERM -> 3 s -> SIGKILL on the process group, then removes temp dirs.
3. Node-imported Worker (reads/readers/reading-worker).
   - `fakeD1()` (`node:sqlite` `:memory:`, `schema.sql`) -> `client(D1, extra)` imports `../worker.js?tag=N` (a fresh module graph per call, so isolate-level memos start empty; `W.memoClock(null, ms)` resets the shared clock memo) -> `worker.fetch(new Request("https://anilkaya.org"+route, {headers:{cookie: FLOWS_COOKIE=token, "Sec-Fetch-Site":"same-origin"}}), env, ctx)` with `env = {DB, SESSION_SECRET, UW_API_KEY?, UW_BASE?, FLOWS_CREDENTIALS, FLOWS_READ_MODE}` -> `ctx.waitUntil` promises collected (the readers client awaits them; the reads client hands back `settle()`) -> assertions on trips, rows, headers (`X-Fresh-State`, `X-Tape`, `X-Live-Overlay`), bodies. Shims required before import: `globalThis.HTMLRewriter ??= class`, `globalThis.caches = {default}` (readers L217, reads L808/`FakeCache`), `Date` offset (`shiftClock`).
4. Browser stub page (readers-render, reading-render, ticker-contract, track-render, rt-client).
   - `PAGES.<name>Page({username})` (shared/flows-pages.js) -> `page.route("**/*")` -> `/assets/*` read from disk (404 when missing) -> `/api/flows/*` answered by the suite's `answer(key)` with `X-Server-Now` and `X-Fresh-*` headers -> `page.clock.install`/`runFor`/`pauseAt` for deterministic time -> `page.evaluate` against `FlowsUI`, `FlowsUI.rt`, DOM. The page scripts under test are the real `assets/js/*` (the version in `assets/version.txt` is embedded by `flows-pages.js`).
5. Rail verification ladder: `flows-rt-contract` (pure + hub on fake clock + `serveRt` against a fake namespace + `Pulse` with fake ctx + source pins) -> `flows-rt-server` (same code in workerd, loopback vendor from `rt-fixtures`, real sockets, 4 boots) -> `flows-rt-client` (browser half; `rigHub` bridges a page socket to the real `RtHub`).
6. Emit-dir suites: `scripts/flows-pipeline.mjs --dry-run --emit <dir>/` writes `-card-<T>.json`, `-card-x-<T>.json`, `-hist-<T>.json`, `-unusual.json` etc. -> `flows-ticker-contract` (L19-L31) renders them through `tickerPage`; `flows-unusual-contract` (L23-L35) parses `-unusual.json`; `flows-strip` renders the first 20 cards stripped vs unstripped.
7. Reading verification: `reading-archetypes` -> `dossier-harness`/`dossier-fixtures` -> `shared/flows-dossier.js` -> `shared/flows-reading.js` (`heldTags`, `promptForReading`, `vetReading`, `readingFallback`) -> `flows-reading` (pure); `shared/flows-reading-worker.js` through `worker.js` -> `flows-reading-worker`; stored `read` field rendered by `assets/js/flows-ticker.js` -> `flows-reading-render`; rows priced by `flows-reads-contract` (final block L1204-L1243: miss at most 22 rows before the response and 34 with the background generation, hit at most 4).
